comments:
Croix is a wonderful host, very cheerful and welcoming. Upon my arrival, she gave me a map and showed me all the places to visit in Geneva. We also had the chance to spend some time together and to have some very interesting conversations and great moments of laughing.
The appartment was very clean and sunny and I really enjoyed staying in it. I would definitely like to stay there if I get the opprtunity to visit Geneva again.
This was an ideal place to stay and Croix made me feel comfortablesafe, and at home. It is located near the tram, grocer and the city center. It was easy to get around. No need for a car!

I went to Geneva for a one week training and stayed with Croix. I very much enjoyed my stay there, not only she was a wonderful host but  made me feel like I was staying at a friends' place.  It even felt like we knew each other from before. The apartment is great, very comfortable with an excellent location to move by tram in Geneva and it is located next to two supermarkets. Very recommended!

Spent a few days with Croix and she is an absolute sweetheart. Her place in extremely well located right between old town and the jet'eau. She was very helpful and made you feel very at home. It is like you have known her all your life. I truly enjoyed my experience with her and would definitely rent from her again if I return here!

Noelle is a fantastic host, she made me feel at home. Thoroughly enjoyed the stay
Thank You Noelle

Nightmare in Geneva.  I'm a law student studying for a semester in Geneva.  I rented a room through Air BnB. I agreed to a one month contract with Nastran Bahiri.  I needed a residency card in order to remain in the country. Nastran's paperwork was not accepted at the agency, therefore she told me just to lie and tell them that I was extended family. I refused and informed her that I would need to find housing that could issue me a residency card.  We agreed that I would get a refund for two weeks of rent once I returned the keys and she found another tenant.  I returned the keys and she already has someone  else living in the room.  She now refuses to answer any of my requests for a refund even though she has all of my banking information.  Also, it is important to know that the room in question does not have a lock on it and Nastran felt it was okay to walk in on you unannounced.  She does not take no for an answer and harassed me until I finally ate her dessert, which I do not eat.  She is an extremely aggressive person, does not understand a person's space, does not honor her commitments and is very nosy.  Do not rent from her.

I had a great time at the apartment. Noelle welcomed me very friendly and told me everything useful about the city. Furthermore the location of the apartment is really great, the tram stops directly in front of the house and you are in a few minutes in the city centre. There are a lot of restaurants close to the appartment as well as supermarkets, pharmacies, etc.
I was really happy to have such a nice host at Geneva!

Noelle was fantastic host for me. She gave me not only useful information about settleing down but culture of geneva. I felt like at home with Noelle. Most of all the location of the apartment is really convinient, the tram stops directly in front of the apartment and you are in a few minutes in the city centre.
If my friend find a place to stay in Geneva, I will recommend Noelle's house. :)
Noelle hosted my son during a summer internship in Geneva and everything went very well.  The location of the apartment is perfect, very convenient for central Geneva, and Noelle was a perfect host.

Noelle was so helpful and kind.
When I stayed at Noelle's house, I could stay feeling at home.
The neighborhood was great persons, whenever I had difficulties they helped me. I will never forget their kindness.
With Great neighborhood and location closed to Old town and Cornavain staition,
I think it is good to the person who want to experience Geneva's real life
She is warm and talkative and helpful. I feel like staying with a friend!
The apartment is in a great location, very clean. 10 mins walk to lakefront, 10 mins walk to the old town. Great value :)

I had a good time staying with Noelle. I had just moved to Geneva and staying at Noelle's place was a good way to get to know the city and look for a longer term place. She was very friendly and helpful, giving me many tips that helped me to navigate Geneva and ease my integration here. In fact she let me keep two suitcases in her living room, which was very considerate of her. Her flat is very cosy & well equipped, especially the kitchen,  with plenty of natural light.  I could even do my laundry downstairs. The flat is located in a very nice area and is close to the lake, the Jet d'Eau, walking distance from the old town and there's plenty to do here. I really loved the location. In fact its right in front of line 12 which made it very convienient to get about. All in all a good experience.
Good position, clean an confortable bed.

Host was lovely to deal with, her flat is beautiful, clean and bright. Everything you need was there and was greeted by her very nice cleaner. Super simple check in and check out, an all round great experience

Noelle's apartment is really great! It is clean, the tram stop is just in front of her apartment, and there is a Migros supermarket just downstairs! There are also lots of cafes, restaurants nearby for ur dinner options. Noelle is also a very nice and approachable host, which made my stay so much more enjoyable. :)

I was very kindly welcome by Noelle. The way to the apartment was very well described so it was really easy to find it. The apartment is proper and has everything you need evan an own bathroom. I was very satisfied with Noelle and the apartment and can recommend it to everybody.

Noelle is a great hostess! She is very welcoming and makes you feel immediately at ease. Her apartment is well located with nice restaurants and shops around as well as public transportation just in front of the building. The room is nice with a comfortable bed and plenty of space to hang your clothes. And you have your own private toilets. Great place in Geneva!

I love, love the place. It is located a couple blocks from Lake Geneva in a very nice italian neighborhood in old Geneva. Surrounded by restaurants, shops. The tram is exactly down from the apartment, however walking is also a good choice since everything is near. The same tram in the opposite direction will drive you to the border with France.
Noelle is an extraordinary host. She was waiting on me to arrive and worry since my flight was delayed. Noel made me feel like home and I will definitely come back to this place. Thank you Noel!

I loved living here.

Great location for work and fun.

Fantastic host

Would definitely come back

I had a very pleasant stay at Noelle's apartment. It's perfectly located, so if you want to explore the center of Geneva by foot, this is the place to stay. Noelle is a very sweet and warm person, a good conversationalist and truly helpful, when you need an extra assistance.
The apartment was super clean, so it instantly made me feel comfortable. Thank you, Noelle. :)
modest

This place is central and walking distance to tourist attractions, restaurants and bars. Noelle was a very pleasant host and we bonded well, though I came to Geneva for a work trip and was not much in. She gave me some nice suggestions where to go out for meals and even a great place for an Ice-cream next to Jet D'eau.
Highly recommended.
Noelle is a warm and hospitable host. Her apartment is homely and bright and well located in a nice part of town, very close to transport and the lake. Noelle took great care to make me feel welcome.

The place is very beautiful and central, everything you need is close-by and easy to reach, the lake is just a 5-10 minute walk away. The house was exactly as described and Noelle made me feel very welcome by offering fruit, snacks and drinks. The bed was really comfy too! I was staying in Geneva for business but would recommend this place for both tourist and a business stay.

Mein Aufenthalt in Genf war durch Noelle's herzliche Freundlichkeit ein beonderes Vergnügen. Obwohl aribnb die falsche Hausnummer angegeben hatte, rief sie mch an und holte mich persönlich ab. Sie gab' mir gute Tipps zu Kultur und Musik, und hat eine extrem gute Kaffeemaschine! Die Wohnung ist mitten in einem schönen lebendigen Stadtteil mit vielen Restaurants.

Noelle was incredible so warm and inviting and knows Geneva like the back of her hand. Her place is fantastic and located next to the old town which was the best location to be close to everything. Would absolutly reccomend staying at her place!
Great location and super easy to navigate around. Noelle is great and i would definitely stay again.

Noelle’s apartment is cosy, bright and welcoming. Check in was easy, and she was able to orient me towards local amenities that I needed on my first day in the city. The apartment, like most in the neighbourhood, is small, but having my own half-bathroom was a big plus. There is a decent amount of storage in the room, and in the kitchen for your food. I would recommend.

Noelle went above and beyond to make my stay great. I was there for three months and I truly cannot imagine a better place to stay. She is incredibly hospitable and kind, and the location can't be beat.

Noelle's place is a superb find and she is a great host!!  It is clean, conveniently close to public transport and very very comfortable with a big sunny room, comfy bed and the extra benefit of a half private bathroom! The shared kitchen has all the amenities and the fresh coffee every morning was a superb treat as was the lovely fruit platter on arrival!! Noelle is a  superhost and her kindness and care and the little welcome touches were so wonderful. She was so attentive to my needs, and is such an easy person to stay with. She gave me good advice about how to get around in Geneva There is a Migros downstairs which was also super convenient. It is a short walk to the beach and lake and very nice restaurants and cafes in the area.  I would recommend her place to anyone wanting to stay in Geneva - it is rare treat!!
Noëlle est très disponible et accueillante, c’est l’endroit idéal pour découvrir Genève

Noelle was a wonderful host! She is really a super-host! From the time I booked, everything was communicated with great clarity. The apartment was beautiful, nicely decorated and always clean. The room is very nice with a comfy bed and study table.  The location was perfect; the neighbourhood is beautiful, pretty calm and safe. It is located in front of the tram and bus stop and you can also walk easily to the lake and the main attractions in Geneva. The supermarket next to the apartment is very convenient to buy ready meals. What made my comfortable stay a memorable one was - The Hospitality. Noelle made me feel at home from the beginning. She would provide you with all the help and assistance you will need to make you feel comfortable. She is so generous and genuinely cares about your well-being. We had great conversations that really inspired me. It was certainly one of my best experiences in Airbnb! I highly recommend her place and look forward to staying there again!

This apartment was my first time sharing and I stayed for a month. Noelle was delightful. The room could have been more comfortable but I was hardly there so it didn’t matter to much. The location is very central.
Noelle's place is conveniently located in Geneva, with a tram stop right outside and close proximity to everything. Super clean and very comfortable!
Host was helpful and responsive. The room is simple but it was nice to have access to the whole apartment and the location is also very convenient.

Expect a welcoming host who will rest very promptly to your request of information. You will be in one of very elegant and vibrant area of Geneva from where you can move around the city by foot or public transport very easily. You will  be in  mint condition home  with all you need  . Your host  Noelle will interact with you with care, discretion  ,  elegant manners all which will make you feel at home  and who will  provide for some flexibility in check in and check out with if you discuss this in advance with her.  A home would like to come back fir futures trips in Geneva.

The room is ok; having a small table beside the bed and room key would make it much comfortable and convenient.  Having a private toilet was very nice and thoughtful. Noelle was very kind and helpful. Hospitality was great.  Location of the apartment is also great and instructions provided by Noelle are precise, detailed, clear and easy to follow. She replied fast on messages and answers were helpful. I would definitely stay another time with her.  Thank you Noelle for letting me stay in your home. Best regards and all the best.

L'appartement de Noëlle est situé tout près de la vieille ville, proche du lac aussi. Une ligne de tram passe juste devant l'immeuble. Je me suis sentie comme à la maison chez elle. Confort de literie: moyen.
Local superaconchegante. fácil localização e perto de todos os pontos de logistica.
Great apartment in a great location - Eaux Vives is a great part of Geneva to explore! Noelle is an excellent host. Highly recommend.

Noelle est une hôte très accueillante qui sait tout à la fois échanger, discuter et vous mettre à l'aise, dans le cadre de son appartement très charmant et lumineux, tout comme elle sait également respecter votre intimité et votre espace privé. L'appartement est très bien situé, près de toutes les commodités. Les équipements sont performants, les espaces communs sont agréables et lumineux et la chambre privée est spacieuse. Le lit est très confortable. Le prix est plus que raisonnable pour Genève, bref, une expérience et une  hôte que je recommande vivement.

When staying in Geneva, why stay at a hotel when you can stay with a friend.  Noelle immediately makes you feel  welcome by making her home yours.  Comfy bed, your own toilet and access to her kitchen/living room for a quick meal prep and dine.  You are within minutes away from the jet'deu and a wonderful shopping district.  There are 2 grocery stores within seconds away for your convenience.  You will stay with a friend if you stay with Noelle.
Very clean and well located spot. I had a great stay and would definitely return

Noelle's place was very very clean. We had good communication. The room is simple but you have access to the kitchen and the living room, as well. The location is very central and convenient. I stayed at her place for almost 3 weeks and I surely recommend it!

Great location. Right at a tram stop and above a Migros supermarket. Lots of nice cafes and restaurants. Really nice neighborhood overall. The flat was very clean and bright. I had the place to myself as Noelle was away. It was very good value!
The accommodation was great so as the location👍

Noelle’s place is very quiet and pleasant. There was clear and prompt information through correspondence, a kitchen and fridge so I could make some quick meals, and a very comfy bed. Even though I was there in the middle of a heat wave, the place stayed cool by closing the shutters during the day. At night the open air windows let in a restful cool breeze.
Noelle had to leave at the last minute but Cora stepped in and was incredibly helpful too!!! I will definitely stay here again!’
Just in the city center, beautiful home with all that you need. Noelle is a very nice person.

Noelle’s place is clean, tidy and is the same as listing. Noelle is on a business trip during the time of my stay, she sent Cora, the domestic helper, to help me to check in and out, she also help me to find the hair dryer too!
Noelle is very friendly and welcoming. All positive reviews she already received are true.

Noelle’s place is very centrally located and a short 10 minute walk to the city centre. Being just above a supermarket (Migros), it is very convenient to get something to eat nearby cheaply. The tram stop is just outside the apartment. I stayed in a room and had my own bathroom, and shared the shower facilities, all of which were kept very clean. Noelle is a thoughtful host who even set aside some space for me in the refrigerator to use for my own groceries, which is really helpful for a one week stay. I would stay at Noelle’s place again if I find myself in Geneva.

Noelle is the perfect host!
She’s super nice and has a very cosy, quiet and clean apartment in a vibrant location at the heart of Geneva.
Cozy place and great host!

We are extremely pleased with Noelle's hospitality, excellent cleanliness and space of the property, location, facilities, security - far better than we have even thought over. In addition, Noell has been extremely helpful and caring far and beyond from any host we expected. Thank you, Noelle, and keep it up.  Of course, strongly recommended with 5+ stars.

Noelle is very welcoming and friendly. My first month in Geneva would be soo much harder without her advice. I wish I could have stayed longer.
The apartment is located in the center of Geneva so, basically, you can visit plenty of famous spots just by walking or by bus. Bus stops are just 2 mins away. Supermarket Migros and Coop are just next door.
In general, I feel pretty safe to stay in this area. It was a pleasant experience to stay there : )
Highly recommanded!!

Noelle is an amazing host! The best! I couldn’t chose any better. I definely would stay with her again. She is nice, helps in everything, polite, her apartament is organized, well-equiped, located in a wonderful neighborhood - close to all the touristic places, you can do everything on foot. Thank you so much, Noelle. I loved to be there.

I had a wonderful time in Geneva and it was greatly in part because of Noelle! She's a wonderful host, making you feel welcomed in a new city, but also giving you privacy when you need it. I LOVED talking to her (she's a really interesting woman), and her advice helped me a lot in my months in Geneva. All the reviews about how amazing she is are absolutely true!
The apartment is spacious and super clean. It's also located in a very nice neighborhood with a supermarket just around the corner and public transportation stops right outside the building. Everything was simply perfect!
Noelle’s house makes you feel at home. She supernice person. everything good, highly recommended.
The stay was uncomplicated and Noelle a very charming lady.

This Airbnb was perfect for my stay in Geneva - exceptionally clean and comfortable, very organized, and well-located in the charming Eaux-Vives quarter - only a few steps away from many quality restaurants, especially Italian, as well as a quick walk from the Old Town and other parts of central Geneva. Noelle cares very much about the satisfaction, comfort, and convenience of her guests - staying with her was a real pleasure. Thank you Noelle - I look forward to returning!

There is a tram stop right in front of the building and other bus stops are also close by, which makes it very convenient to get around in the city. The apartment was always kept clean and I did not have any issue sharing the place with Noelle as she made me feel very comfortable. Some days I had to work from home and she was very thoughtful with ensuring that I had a quiet environment. But I found the mattress a little uncomfortable and it would have been even great if there were curtains or blind for the window in the bedroom. In general, it was a pleasant stay and I would recommend it!

Noelle is the perfect host! The apartment is very clean and it is situated in the city centre, not far from the train station, close to le Jet d'Eau, the beach and the beautiful parc La Grange, the shopping area and the Vieille Ville. I recommend it to everyone!
Tout était parfait

I had an excellent stay.
Noelle is a great communicator and very friendly. The location is superb. Two grocery stores are steps away as is the tram. There is also an excellent gym at minute walk away.
I would definitely stay here again.
Very pleasant stay with Noelle who is a welcoming host. The flat is spacious and  well located. I recommend this accommodation.
Noelle’s place is in an excellent location close to the lake and central Geneva. Everything was clean, and Noelle communicated very well.

Perfect stay, Noelle was lovely and I had a great time in Geneva. Centrally located, very close to tram and bus lines and very quick/easy to get around the city. Also lots of cafes, restaurants, shopping within walking distance. Noelle was super communicative, flexible, and so helpful, kind and wonderful as a host. I felt like I was staying with family and enjoyed chatting with her. I would come back again in a heartbeat! Would highly recommend anyone to stay here.
Noelle is a wonderful host. Kind, communicative, worldly. Her apartment is lovely and well-situated and she is a delight to get to know. I look forward to staying with her again!
Noelle was a kind & welcoming host with a very well-located flat. She gave great advice for things to do while in Geneva and made sure I felt right at home. Would definitely recommend Noelle!
Noelle was a very kind and friendly host. I enjoyed staying with her!
J'ai eu un séjour très agréable chez Noelle. Elle est très gentille et son apartment est confortable et lumineux.
Great stay for a business trip, Noelle was a gracious host. Her place was as described in the listing, and I was glad to be hosted by her for my first trip to Geneva!

Noelle was a great host in every possible way which helped that my stay in Geneva be more pleasant. Her apartment is in the city center, close to attractions, the lake, in walkable distance to all important sights as well as the train station. Migros store next to the building, tram station in front, everything just perfect. Best recommendations for Noell's place.

It was an amazing stay! Noelle was a wonderful accommodating host, very friendly, easy to talk to. With her, I have both privacy and a friend to chit chat with. The place is central, nearby to old town, the lakes, and everything. Easily accessible to any public transportation and major lines and the tram is right outside.
Very friendly host and great location!

Noëlle is such a wonderful host, very responsive and respectful. She is also very caring. She helped me very generously when I was not feeling well. I really appreciate her. Her place is in the center of old town, just a few seconds away from the nearest tram station. There are two major supermarkets around the corner so it was super convenient. Definitely recommend her place.

Mon hôte est une personne charmante qui a un sens de l'humain et de l'accueil hors du commun. J'ai découvert un quartier de Genève que je ne connaissais pas encore. On s'y sent comme dans un village. J'ai pu échanger avec Noëlle et pas que des banalités. Ce n'est pas toujours le cas dans un Airbnb. J'y retournerai volontiers si elle veut bien de nouveau m'accueillir. Je lui souhaite le meilleur pour la nouvelle année.
I had very good time with Noelle. She is  kind and thoughtful. I highly recommend her apartment!

Noelle fue increíblemente amable y estuvo muy pendiente de mi llegada. Todo super limpio, ordenado y acogedor.
Sin duda repetiría si vuelvo a Ginebra!!! 💌💌

Noelle is an amazing host. She is really kind and hospitable. I was traveling alone for a conference, and she made me feel really welcomed and at home. The place was in a really good location with great cafes and parks around. Highly recommend!

Mike was a perfect host, always available on the pone and ready to help me with any enquiry...the studio is centrally located and well furnished...the building is very quiet...if i come back to geneve i will rent again this studio.....

Excellent location, excellent apartment and a great landlord. I booked the apt over a month to give myself free time to search for a permanent place. My experience was very positive. Apartment is close to the lake, restaurants/cafes, supermarket and active bus lines. Highly recommended.

This apartment is just perfect to stay in Geneva! It’s in a great neighborhood, just next to a supermarket and steps away from another one (great thing to have in mind considering that everything in Geneva closes at 6 pm). I had to work late, so having a kitchen for myself, wifi working perfectly and a big flat screen with cable (to forget a hard long day) was all I needed. The apartment is big and has all the things you may need for a stay, plus tons of light during the day. You can even see the Jet D’Eau from your window (did I mention that it is just two blocks away from the apartment? And it’s also four blocks away from the commercial area and the entrance to the Old City). You have bus number 6 around the corner to go to the train station or you just can walk to the Swiss hotel to take number 8 to Appia/UN Nations or WHO. Mike has been an excellent host, always ready to help you with any question, even during the weekend. I will definitely stay there next time I go to Geneva! And I definitely recommend this place and Mike as a host.

Mike is a great host -- very approachable, informative and responsible. His studio is simply ideal. Clean, bright, equipped with high quality facilities -- washer & dryer, coffeemaker, huge TV, special pillows. The location is superb, near the lake, and so close to several types of public transport, groceries and cafes. I really enjoyed my stay there and recommend it highly to anyone seeking a home away from home.

Mike was a great host! I was a guest at his studio for six months and could not have asked for a better situation. Mike was very helpful when I moved to Geneva and made sure I felt welcome at the apartment and in the city. The flat is very clean and has everything you need to feel at home. It is also very close to public transport that can take you anywhere in the city, but you are within walking distance of Old Town and even the train station. Not to mention being only steps away from the lake! I highly recommend staying at this flat!

Mike's apartment was fantastic and he was an excellent host. Although I never met him personally, he replied instantly to any emails and came across extremely friendly, accommodating any needs I had. The apartment itself was just as described, spacious and very pleasant. It was also very tastefully decorated.
If I ever return again, I will reach out and contact Mike.
Thanks again.

This studio was super comfortable and very well located. Mike was very communicative always available via phone and text messages. He met me right when I got from the airport, showed me around and even bought me my favorite Nespresso capsules (for the machine available in the apartment)! As a plus, there is a great supermarket (Migros) downstairs and a gym which sells day passes half a block away.
I needed a comfortable flat for a week in Geneva while I was traveling for business and this was a perfect fit!
Mike is an excellent host, very attentive. Place was exactly as described and location excellent. Could not have asked for a better place to stay in Geneva.

Le logement était en parfait état, soigneusement meublé et proche de toutes commodités. Merci également à Paulina, la femme de chambre.
Mike a répondu à tous mes e-mails et a fait preuve de beaucoup de professionnalisme.
J'y retournerai.
This is the second time I rent a flat in MICKY, the flat is very good, clean and bright, the transportation is convenient.

THANK YOU FOR LETTING US STAY AT YOUR PLACE IN GENEVA
VERY GOOD LOCATION AND GOOD STUDIO WITH ALL NEEDS THAT
MAKE STAYING AT AN AIR B&B LOCATION COMFORTABLE.
WE WILL CONTACT YOU FOR OUR NEXT VISIT TO GENEVA.
Très bel appartement, rien à redire... Propre et bien situé. Micky est à l'écoute de ses hôtes et la communication avec lui est très facile.

Micky welcomed me with a warm e-mail after his kind cleaning lady waited for my delayed arrival. I felt really "looked after"! The place is super comfortalbe and provided me with a great home base. Each day I would run along the lake, enjoy the scenery there, go to the market to get delicious supplies on Boulevard Helvétique. Also there is this great picture house just up the road...great for a rainy Saturday afternoon. Really amazing base to explore Geneva from a nice neighbourhood.
Hope that everybody will enjoy it as much as I did!!!
Très bel appartement, propre, bien situé et proche de nombreux restaurants.

I have visited Geneva on numerous occasions, staying each time for a week and always in hotels. Micky's apartment was my first "Airbnb" experience and I was certainly impressed. The apartment and fittings were as presented. The location is great and contacting Micky was a breeze. I will certainly be back.
Excellent apartment, excellent location and superb host. The host was very helpful, always replying questions promptly making interaction really easy-
Le studio correspond exactement aux photos ,très propre et très bien situé au pied du lac. On a visité Genève à pieds. Le contact est très facile avec Mick. Bonne continuation ! !!

Vi boede i Mick's lejlighed i lidt over 2 uger, mens vi ventede på at overtage vores egen lejlighed i nærheden.

Lejligheden ligger perfekt, i hjertet af Genève i et område med gode indkøbsmuligheder, caféer, restauranter og adgang til offentlig transport.

Lejligheden har alle basale fornødenheder, man har brug for, når man skal en kortere periode det samme sted, men gerne vil have mulighed for at lave sin egen mad og vaske sit eget tøj. Et udmærket køkken, godt toilet og bad, vaskemaskine, internet mv. Der mangler ingenting.

Værten Mick var meget venlig og besvarede vores få henvendelser hurtigt og hjælpsomt. Der er ugentlig rengøring, hvilket var nemt at koordinere med rengøringshjælpen, og meget rart, når man har et længere ophold.

Vi var meget glade for at bo hos Mick, og vil anbefale til andre.
Perfect location, great flat, ultra clean and convenient. Will definitely come again

I had a warm welcome and very flexible check in at Mike's place. The listing is exactly like the photos; clean, fresh, well ventilated and well maintained. Providing once a week cleaning was great. Mike's housemaid is such a nice and cooperative lady. Some maintenance had to be done and I was more than willing to accommodate, because my host was super nice and made me feel comfortable in every possible way. A super bonus is that the furniture is almost new; so, no smell of old cupboards, nothing to trigger allergies if you care about that!
The neighbourhood is safe, upscale, much cleaner than many other parts of Geneva, well connected by transport, right by the lake, lots of restaurants, shops, pharmacies in case you need, grocery store in the same building (open on Saturdays), farmers market two steps away, calm, quiet... and really gives a sense of community. Great experience. Thanks a million, Mike, for making my long stay in Geneva peaceful and enjoyable. Highly recommended and I will sure seek to book again with Mike.

Tout etait agreable dans ce séjour
L'accueil de Paulina malgré l'heure tardive, la situation de l'appartement, sa propreté et ses équipements
Nous espérons pouvoir revenir souvent!!!

Mike is a super host, was there to greet me and help me get settled in.   Great communication from beginning of booking to departure, making sure I had everything I needed and acquainted me with the area. The apartment was lovely, exactly as presented on AirBnB, very European, clean, efficient, with everything and more I could need for a two week stay.  The location was fabulous, just a block from Le Lac and the Jet eau and an easy walk to the Rive and Centre.  I especially appreciated having a market just downstairs that had everything I needed, and a bus stop right outside the door. The apartment is located to the back of the building so very quiet for sleeping with no traffic noise. I highly recommend Mike's apartment to a single or couple traveling to Geneva.
Excellent. Exactly as advertised and one of the best locations in Geneva. Would definitely stay again in the future.

The apartment is fantastically located in Geneva!  We had such a wonderful time using this as home base for our adventures in the area, to CERN, and even ventured into southern France with some colleagues we met at CERN.  Ideally located next to public transportation, stores, restaurants...  Whenever we return to Geneva, we're going to request to stay at Mike's! Mike himself was an awesome host!  We met up for a drink and chatted a good bit.  He was helpful with whatever question I asked.  Thanks Mike!!!

Location, location, location. Could not be more well-situated for shopping, seeing Geneva, access to train, buses, and airport. Comfortable bed, well-supplied kitchen, lots of storage, accessible host. What more could you want?
Flat is exactly as shown, very neat and clean. It is located in my favourite area in Geneva, one street up from the lake!

I spent 4 weeks in Mike's studio apartment, and it suited me perfectly.  It was modern, spacious, open plan (all one large room, with full kitchen with all necessary appliances and a washer/drier (!) and full bathroom with tub), and very functional.  There was plenty of closet space (and lots of hangers! love that!) and room to settle in. The bed was comfortable, and it was very quiet for sleeping. L'appartement est bien situé et très confortable. Nous attendons y retourner ;)

We had a great stay, enjoying the views of the lake and the proximity to Geneva. Going by train is so easy! The flat is comfortable and has all the basics you need. The local restaurants are good. Parking was easy and free! This all helped us to enjoy our few days in Versoix.

We received clear instructions on how to access the flat which was cosy and located in the heart of the community with close access to the train station, shops and a good choice of restaurants.   The shower was great and there was plenty of hot water.  The bed was comfortable and the views across the lake were great.  When we arrived we were dismayed at finding the flat right on a busy road as well as on the flight path for Geneva airport as we thought the noise would keep us awake but once the shutters and windows were closed we could hardly hear anything and it was lovely and dark too.   It was certainly exciting watching the planes heading across the lake towards us - an aeroplane spotter's dream location!  The WiFi worked well.  Be aware that the local shops close early - we had to eat out on our first night as they were shut by the time we arrived (around 8pm).   We left the flat clean and tidy, and put the laundry in the basket and the rubbish in the dustbins as requested.   We enjoyed a visit to Geneva, and some great walks around St Cergue.  Thank you for sharing your flat with us.

Versoix is a beautiful neat area north of Geneva. Gab'ys husband waited over an hour for us to show up as we had followed the suggestion to take the train listed as going to Coppet. Track three didn't work. To get to Gaby's you USE TRACK ONE both to and from Geneva. .03 and .33 on the hour from Geneva to Versoix, .09 and . 39 from Versoix to Geneva. The Versoix station is less than 100 meters from Gaby's apartment. ALERT; the local train stations like Versoix have many steps up and down which makes suit cases a burden. The apartment was compact as well as efficient. We particularly liked the upstairs loft with a comfy king sized bed! The single roof window offers the option to open it for ventilation as well as cover it with a built in movable shade. Leaving it open invites in airplane noise, closing it does a good job of eliminating that noise. Groceries are available within 100 meters of Gabys; a large Coop up the street and a Migros beyond the train station. If you are interested in fast food, there is a Burger King at the airport (no coffee) and both a B-K in the train station and a McD across the street (Geneva Cornavin). Public transportation (80minutes) from the airport to your destination is available in the baggage area of the airport. If you buy a transportation pass (Available at the information area in the train station) which will include free transportation on the 4 water taxi's on the lake, they're are a hoot. Public transportation to the apartment is free at machines in the airport baggage area, good for 80 minutes of travel time, a nice money saving. We very much enjoyed Geneva and our stay at Gaby's.

风景优美，开窗就能看到美丽的莱蒙湖，开门过马路就到湖边。交通也很方便，离日内瓦市中心大约25分钟自驾车程，边上有火车站不过很遗憾没机会坐。Gaby是个很好的房东，虽然没见面但感觉很热情、周到。希望还有机会再入住。
陈昶

We had a lovely stay in the flat, the kitchen and bathroom were excellent, very clean.  The bedroom above was so cosy with ample storage and with the train station close by it was ideal location for going into Geneva.
Great place to stay. Gaby made check out and check in very easy and enjoyable. We loved Versoix and Switzerland as a whole.
The apt is close to Geneve and quite easy to find. Walking distance to supermarket and some restaurant. The pictures reflects the reality.
Gaby gave clear instructions the place was as described and very clean and tidy.  location is superb, shops, station lake etc...

Loved this apartment! It is exactly as shown in pictures. Versoix is easy to get to from Geneva city center and apartment is short walk from the train station! Apartment was clean and the views of the lake are awesome! Keep in mind that all of Switzerland basically shuts down on Sundays and Versoix is a very sleepy town (in April, at least!) so if you need anything (like toilet paper!) better get it in Saturday! I would highly recommend this apartment and would love to stay there again if I ever visit Geneva again!

The neighborhood is extremely nice but we did not know that the apartment is on fourth and fifth floor and no elevator.
All flights coming to Geneva flight over the house for landing or takeoff.
Gaby was very kind and helpful.

Gaby was fantastic as a host.  She was highly communicative in providing suggestions and simply letting me know she was around to answer questions.  The flat was the perfect leaping off point to explore the city.  Highly recommended.
Gaby was fantastic, helping us to secure a rental despite last minute plans. The apartment is exactly as described; beautiful location. It has everything you need.
Très bons contacts. Très réactif lors de problèmes techniques ou autres. Toujours courtois et amical.

Great stay in a great apartment. It had everything we needed. Good location,  very short walking distance from train station, 2 supermarkets and a variety of eateries. Not long from the airport, the centre of Geneva, the French border and the rest of the lake. Not to mention the view!

The apartment was great. Perfectly situated and comfortable.
Thank you for a great stay.

Gaby was great in organising the comfortable apartment for us which is in a very convenient location, close to the train and supermarkets. We arrived late on a Saturday afternoon and unfortunately didn't get to the nearby supermarkets until just after they closed at 6-00pm. We had to make do with a very nice dinner at the Thai restaurant just around the corner. Very few shops are open on Sunday but a quick trip into Geneva railway station got us groceries at the Migros supermarket. After that all shopping was very convenient at the three supermarkets within 5 minutes walk. Half hourly trains to and from Versiox made for easy travel around Geneva. Well recommended and good value.

Everything was perfect. Easy to find, close to good restaurant and very near the train station.
Will come back soon !
Gaby is a great host and very responsive

Nice apartment in a lovely village. We enjoyed the views of Lake Geneva. Within waking distance to shops and cafes.
I feel there were some areas that could have been improved upon:
- Soap: there was no soap for the shower. No soap at the bathroom sink. No soap in the kitchen.
- Fan in kitchen did not work.
- Fireplace not functional
- Cleanliness: hairs were on the floor from the previous guests. :(
- Stains on blue bathroom towels. Would prefer white, bleached towels without stains.
- Smell: there is a sewage smell coming from the bathroom pipes. This could be due to the buidiling being older, but the smell was overwhelming at times.
Again, the location was super, but I feel like I would be doing a disservice to other guests without being honest of my experience.

Very nice and comfy place to stay. Simple, functional furniture with all accessories you might need. It is not 5 star hotel but if you prefere private flat instead cold hotels - that's it. Nearby train station and shop. Host (Gaby) was very helpful and responds very fast when I was checking in, although we haven't met in person. I would recommend and will come again.
Great helpful host. Simple, sweet apartment with all I needed for several overnights (bed, fridge, small kitchen, cafe machine, wi fi).

Petit Nid d'Aigle super sympa au centre de Versoix avec vue du Lac, a 3 min de la gare.
Parfait, même à cinq, nous y avons bien vécu durant 2 semaines!
Top place!!! Merci Gaby
Perfect place to stay for Geveva. Near the station in a quiet village with views of the lake. Gaby was very helpful at all stages of our trip.

Flat is in a great location and cosy. 3rd floor with no lift is not so practical for families with small children. Radiators needed repairing as falling off their fittings but host is aware and said will fix at next opportunity. Overall, flat is good.

Gaby is a great host. This beautiful apartment is  with nice views. Ideal for staying with kids. The location is very good. Close to super market, restaurant, take away, station, ATM. Parking is also convenient. Definitely try to stay again as I go to Geneva almost every month.
Great value. Convenient location. Top floor with many steps. Would stay again.
Would stay there again. The apartment was convenient for the train station and the view is particularly lovely.

Cosy space with a lovely view. Gaby is super helpful and welcoming of families. The apartment includes essentials for a young family- cot, toys, microwave etc   Most appreciated. Handy to the airport and public transport to get you around other parts of Geneve. Supermarkets just down the road. Some noise from flight path and main road but well insulated windows when closed. If staying in Summer, best to ask for a fan as the main bedroom upstairs is quite warm. We enjoyed our stay! Thankyou, Gaby

Gabi is wonderfully helpful and gracious, the apartment is lovely and very close to the station and peer, so very convenient. There is everything you might need , including dishwasher, vacuum cleaner, ironing stuff, washer and dryer. We had a great time.

L'appartement est conforme à la description. Nous étions une famille avec un bébé, il faut prendre en compte le bruit important de la rue ( avion, voiture ), lorsque les fenêtre sont ouvertes ( nécessaire l'été ). Une vue magnifique sur le lac, on assiste à de magnifique lever de soleil.
Gaby's house was within easy walking distance of the Lake, train station (3 minute walk) and the grocery store (Denner and Co-op).  Very convenient.  I would highly recommend it.

The place is small but nice, located in relatively quiet area. The host is very friendly and helpful. He asked our questions quickly. A helpful and trustworthy person. It was an enjoyable experience for us.
Excellent location close to Versoix train station and Lake Geneva

Joli deux pièces cosy ,le bruit des avions qui atterrissent ne sont pas très gênants car la nuit cela cesse jusqu'au matin ,Gaby est sympa et réactive

Beautiful and quiet place.
Really enjoyed staying in this apartment! Cozy, clean, good view from window, comfortable location.
Great place, wonderful location, great host. Had a great time there, no issues, no complains.

Lovely apartment by the lake in the quiet town of Versoix. Conveniently  located nearby to the shops & restaurants in the town and the train station for quick trips to Geneva. Really enjoyed the stay and would happily come back on our next visit to the area :)
Wonderful place, clean, quiet and easy to access. I hope to visit again.

Ottima casa per un soggiorno fuori dal caos del centro ma con praticissimo collegamento ferroviario a pochi passi.
Vicinissima a ben 3 discount, la casa è dotata di tutti i comfort, pulitissima, accogliente e locata in uno stabile silenzioso.

Gaby est très à l'écoute et très serviable. L'appartement est très propre et très fonctionnel et bien situé à Versoix. Le bruit des avions qu'on entend bien la journée disparait la nuit. Merci Gaby et à une prochaine fois.

It was a great location, close to Geneva, but also close to the alps, including Mont Blanc in France and the suisse country side.  Quiet even though it was the flight path for the Geneva airport. Very confortable queen size bed in the master bedroom. 2 minute walk to the grocery store and restaurants. Definitely would recommend this place. Thank you
Wonderful time at Gaby’s place. Great location and pleasant apartment! Highly recommended!

We enjoyed our stay at Gaby's appartment, which is cosy and located  really close to the Geneva lake. As a family of 4 people, we found enough  space and everything we needed. Gaby is an excellent host, she provided us with the necessary information and responded to our questions promptly and friendly. Parking appeared to be difficult in the immediate vicinity of the house.
3rd floor flat in a good location overlooking the lake, just 15 minutes from Geneva, with a train station in walking distance and plenty of free parking on the streets.
Perfect location but be careful of "free parking" and use parking up the street in paid parking lot.  When it's windy the bedroom is VERY noisy.  Otherwise perfect.
Lovely little apartment.

Excellent loft suite.  Full amenities, super clean, close to all services including 1 minute from the train.  Also incredible view facing the lake.  Great place.  Gaby is a great communicator as well.

Really good location. Easy to get to the main city by train and lovely to be staying in a quieter area. Apartment is lovely. Clean and everything we needed for our stay. Gaby communicated well during our stay and although we didn't meet her she seems friendly and was helpful.
Karaoke bar (Artists Bar) just up the road was fun and the local shops had everything we needed. Migrolini at the station is open 7 days a week which is very handy.
We hope to return soon.
Highly recommended. Good value apartment, sparkling clean, warm, homely and well equipped. Conveniently 2 minutes walk to station and large supermarket.
Gaby's place is lovely. The location is so convient with the train station, grocery and lake near by. The bed was very comfortable. I would highly recomend it and would definitely stay here again.
Lovely, homely, clean and well equipped split level apartment. Highly recommended!
El apartamento tiene vistas sobre el lago y está en el centro del núcleo antiguo de Versoix con todos los servicios necesarios: banco, supermercados, farmacia, médicos y la estación de tren.

Gaby’s place at Versoix, is spotless, comfortable, really well located and less than a block to the train station that takes you to Geneva,  and with a big grocery store in the next  block - Really a  nice place to stay with the extra of a beautiful view !!!

A great located apartment, a few minutes from a well connected train station. Geneva city and airport are all 15 mins by regular cheap trains. The views of the lake are amazing and the apartment was as expected, clean with quick and easy check in. An nespresso maker was great (pods available from local supermarkets cheaply)
Gaby was great at communication with replies within minutes of asking questions. Great stay Thanks

Superb location close to station and lakeside. But located at top of building without a lift. Noisy due to roadworks on the Route Suisse but should be better once these are completed. This was a wonderful stay, with clean, warm and convenient amenities. We loved the location too, and would highly recommend Gaby’s place!
Spacious apartment with easy access to the Versoix train station which takes you to Geneva city centre.

An excellent place to stay that is very conveniently located in a great town, and is close to everything we needed (train station and supermarkets). The view is amazing and the place is very comfortable. Thanks Gaby!
Nice and cozy flat, great view, close to amenities and near the train station. Good value, great host.

My little family and I enjoyed our two week stay in Gaby's flat in Versoix. The flat has everything that we needed to make our stay comfortable. It was clean, quiet, and the location is ideal, as it is very close to the train station, the lake and the local supermarkets. And the view is just wonderful from the window. When we had a question, Gaby responded swiftly, and check-in and check-out was uncomplicated.
super appartement avec vue sur le lac

Gaby’s place is a great find in Geneva. It’s clean, comfortable, quiet, it’s great value for money, and it’s in a really nice area. Gaby has been very helpful at every step of the way - 5/5

Gaby's apartment is the best of all the Airbnb's I have stayed in. Its location could not be better, facing Lake Geneva, with an excellent view of the lake and the snow-capped mountains on the other side of the lake. Several supermarkets are nearby, within 2, 4 and 6 minutes, including the Micromigro at the station which is open even on Sunday and holidays and late at night. Versoix station is 3 minutes away and can connect to Geneva in only 13 minutes. There are pharmacies and other businesses. There are plenty of activities to do in the area. Electric bicycles can be rented free of charge from April to October near the Versoix station. There are several public beaches for swimming in the lake, as well as a variety of restaurants and bars around the lake and in Versoix, while still being a quiet and safe place, close to the woods where you can walk, run or ride a bike.
Gaby is a super host, really super. She always answered with kindness and efficiency any question I asked. Her directions and information in everything related to the apartment were correct and accurate. The apartment is in very good condition, clean, bright and with everything you need to live in it and as I said with an enviable view through the windows. I stayed there for a month and I can and will strongly recommend it.

A great apartment with a lovely view of the lake and everything you need for a comfortable stay. Gaby was really helpful, responded quickly, and gave very clear instructions. Easy to get into Geneva centre on the train.
Overhead aeroplanes can be a bit noisy at times, but would still highly recommend staying here.
What you see is what you get - a fabulous well- equipped little flat with a brilliant view on the lake and close to shops, restaurants and public transport.

The apartment is cosy and lean. beds were comfortable.In a great location with lots of restaurants. Trains from geneva take 16mins and only 3CHF for 1 hour ticket. Lovely views of Lake Geneva. Gaby communicates very well with guests.
Great location, close to the train station and yet a very quiet area. Gaby is a very good host who thinks of everything and replies to any questions you might have within minutes.

Exactly what I was expecting based on the description of the host. Peaceful, clean, with a nice view on the like. Suggested to anyone with easy access to Geneva (train station 3 minutes walk). For those arriving by car, just to note that no free parking available in the street during the day time.
Highly recommended.

Très bien

Très bien placé. Check-in et Check-out très facile !!

We had a lovely stay at Gabys place for our weeks holiday in Gevena. It's within walking distance of everything we needed - supermarkets, restaurants in the village, the train station and the bus from the airport dropped us about a 10 min walk away.
The apartment was clean, warm and exactly as advertised. I loved waking up to the views of the lake which is different every morning depending on the weather. We ate in a fair amount and did pack lunches to save on food spends. The kitchen is a tad small but everything worked and we were able to cook fine.
There were a few small things like no bin bags or dish washer tablets when we arrived, but we just bought some and left them for the next guests. When it's windy there is a loud scratching sound on the roof which kept my partner awake a few nights, but other than that the place was perfect and I would definitely recommend it!
Very Good!

Thanks Gaby, your place is gorgeous and would make anyone feel at home. The view of the lake is gorgeous, and is well located in close proximity to shopping for groceries and getting the train to Geneva city.
nice place for family

The location is by far on the of the best in Versoix with easy access to the lake, supermarkets and the train.
The place has everything you need to be comfortable in your stay and to cook.
Worth knowing that the apartment is on the third floor without a lift, but this is made up for by the view.
A good stay - thanks!!

We absolutely loved our time at Gabys! Perfect easy commute to Geneve everyday to work and awesome location so close to the lake (swam most days) and train station . Loads of supermarkets/stores very close. We had everything we needed and Gaby even let us stay till 4pm on the last day as we had a late flight. Versoix is the perfect spot and wonderful mix of old and new and the apartment was comfortable, clean and we could feel like we lived there! ...we cannot  wait to come back....
I completely enjoyed my stay in this lovely apartment in Versoix. Gaby quickly answered all questions I had. The view was amazing and everything I had hoped for.
Great place, location and quality vs. price.

Versoix is a lovely community and this is a very centrally located apartment. It is not really a one bedroom apartment, though - the ‘bedroom’ is rather a loft above the living area. It is quite small but well laid out. Groceries are available very close by. The lake is also close by.
Our main issue, and something which has nothing to do with the host, is noise. The apartment lies under the flight path for landings at the Geneva airport and so there is a lot of noise from planes as they approach (as much as every few minutes at times).
The apartment is also located on a fairly major route in the business district of Versoix so there is considerable street noise as well.
The flat is cosy but there was also a lack of kitchen utensils. Because the flat was so small and we had the sofa bed set up for our son, there was very little space.
For what we paid for the apartment, we could have done better. This is nothing to do with the host - simply the location.

I really enjoyed my stay at Gaby’s. The location was ideal since it was close to the train station, close to the airport, and most importantly close to a swimming area and marina! Loved the view from the bay window. The fireplace made the place feel extra cozy and skylight was a nice added touch!
Pase 3 semanas y el apartamento me resulto perfecto, todo como se indica en la descripción y la comunicación con Gaby es muy buena!
Un joli appartement et très bien placé,  je recommande !

A great stay at Gaby’s place. The apartment is well located in Versoix and fitted out with everything needed for a short stay. There is not much free parking available in Versoix so it’s useful to be near the station. I hope to stay again.

"What you see is what you get". Un appartement dans lequel je me suis sentie vite très à l'aise. Très bien situé, à proximité de la gare, et de nombreux magasins, restaurants et cafés.
La remarque la plus importante à mes yeux: la propreté. L'appartement était très propre, la literie aussi, les couettes et oreillers neufs.
Un appartement propre et fonctionnel avec tout le nécessaire pour la cuisine et la vie quotidienne.

il est au 3eme étage sans ascenseur.

J'ai passé un très agréable séjour et merci encore à Gaby qui a eu la gentillesse de bien vouloir me laisser partir plus tard!
Great stay in Versoix!

Gaby was a very gracious host! She was very responsive and helpful. Her place is within walking distance of the train station (very convenient) and right across from the lake - with a beautiful view! Worth noting, the upstairs mattress was particularly comfortable. Thank you, Gaby!

Lovely cozy apartment. Gaby was super clear with the check in and check out instructions and was very friendly and responsive. Room is on the 3rd floor. If you have super heavy luggages and do not have the strength to carry them up I would not recommend you the apartment. But everything else was perfect.

Apartment is top-rate, top-end - exactly as advertised. Spent a very good week there. Mike is a cool and easy-going guy and everything was very easy and smooth. Highly recommended for those who want good value for money and a great neighborhood.

Mike's place caught my eye on AIRB&B, and was very fairly priced for a central Geneve location. If you are on business in Geneve for more than a few days, you definitely want to stay at this place.  It was a great place to stay, and centrally located if you are doing business or touring on either side of the bridge.  The market on the main floor of the building was a plus for needed purchases.   It was a comfortable and very spacious apartment.  Also, there are number of nice places to eat within one or two city blocks.  The savings I made staying here (over hotels) more than paid for the extremely expensive Geneve taxi's, which were a necessity because of my busy schedule during my stay.

I was a student who got a short internship in Geneva and needed somewhere to stay that was central central and convenient, and this apartment was perfect. It really is in the centre of Geneva, with all the benefits like more security, cool places to eat/drink and shops nearby, whilst not being noisy or expensive (Geneva is normally notoriously expensive when it comes to just about everything, apartment rental included). There is also a supermarket just downstairs, and a couple of great restaurants on the same street. The apartment is very well furnished with everything provided. The host was really very nice, helpful and accommodating. Overall a great stay, and no reason not to consider staying here!

I really liked my stay in Mike's apartment , it was great 10 days in Geneva. The location can't be better , right on the bus stop and just above the grocery store , only few steps from the beautiful lake . Apartment itself is very nice and modern . There is everything you need for even longer stay . Fast wi-fi , flat screen TV ,comfy couch and so on . . .  Mike is very friendly and  well organized  .  Thank you :-)
Had a great stay. Great appartment, great location and a supermarket downstairs (very handy). Stay strongly recommended!

I really loved staying at Mike's place and if you are looking for a great, modern apartment in the heart of Geneva – this would be it!

I felt as if I am back home (nyc)…. it's a cozy one bedroom at a perfect location and there is even nespresso machine!

In details…

About the apartment:

It is a one bedroom place (living room + bedroom). The living room is spacious and has brand new furniture. There is a very comfortable sofa, top of the line TV, surround sound and i-pod duck. Then there is an open kitchen with a small dining area. Kitchen is equipped with all of the cook wear you will need. Bedroom is small but perfect to sleep in with a queen size bed. There is tons of closet space! Bathroom is modern with a rainbow shower (which I loved!) and there is also a washer and dryer!

About the Host:

Mike is a very nice person and he is a very attentative host. He is always there for you and if you have any questions just email or call him. Also there is a nice cleaning lady that comes ones a week and she speaks English.

About the location:

Apartment is 30 seconds away from famous landmark Jet d'Eau. I really loved the location since it is pretty close to everything. You can even walk from the train station – 15-20 min walk but I would suggest a bus. Also in proximity – there is a supermarket, several restaurants, bike rental place, bus stops and more. I biked pretty much everywhere; however, for those interested in bike rentals – make sure to take insurance and keep the bike inside the apartment or bike’s room.

Overall it was a great place and I would it rent this apartment again without hesitation!

Thank you Mike for making my stay very pleasant!

Mike´s got a great, clean and lovely place in the heart of Geneva. Close to everything you need to be close to: the lake, the old town and public transport, if you need it. Much better, however, is it that the apartment is within walking distance to everything, also the UN neighbourhood (a 20-minute walk) if you have to get there. There are also plenty of shops, restaurants and bars around so all your need will be covered. Not only that, Mike is a very nice and helpful bloke who will ensure that you have a pleasant stay.

Mike was a fantastic landlord/ host, very attentive and willing to make sure I had the best stay. The apartment is tremendously well located and super clean (very much in order, rather like a hotel). I had a great stay so,  I would certainly recommend this apartment to anyone I know.

I enjoyed my stay in Geneva. Mike was a great host. He was very responsive. He gave us clear directions from the airport to the apartment and was there to greet us and helped us with the luggage. The apartment is in a great location with a supermarket and bus stop at the foot of the block. There are many good restaurants around the area too. It is also within walking distance to the lake. The apartment itself was clean, has a well equipped kitchen, very comfortable pillows, cable TV and very fast wifi. I would definitely consider staying there again on my next visit. Thanks Mike!

Mike was an excellent host for the 5 weeks we stayed in his apartment. My friend and I were living in Geneva for the summer as interns, and the apartment suited our needs perfectly. The location was very convenient, being right above a grocery store and across the street from the bus stop, and we very much enjoyed being so close to the lake and Parc de la Grange. The apartment was beautiful and very clean, and was well-equipped with everything we needed for our stay. Mike was incredibly generous in showing us around and helping us figure out the area, and very responsive and helpful if we contacted him with any requests. Our experience would not have been the same without his help! In a nutshell, beautiful apartment, great location, fantastic host! A great choice for any length of stay in Geneva!

Mike's place is just brilliant. The location is fantastic, a great area for bars and restaurants as well as being near the old town. It is also good for public transport (several buses and trams stop right outside). The flat itself is a good size, clean with a great bathroom. The kitchen is fully equipped and we spent time cooking - no problem as you have everything you need.

Mike has been fantastic, we had many questions which he was more than happy to help with. We would definitely recommend this place.
Le séjour était très agréable, l'appartement est très bien équipé dans un quartier où l'on trouve tout. Vous ne serez pas déçu du tout.
Mike´s apartment is very nice, clean and modern. It is situated perfectly to go anywhere in town. Mike is a very nice and flexible person, a perfect host!

Hello Maik. Excuse for a delay with the answer. We visited Geneva for Christmas and we very much liked your apartments. Interesting design, purely, comfortably, it is practical, almost house situation. Downtown, nearby embankment, shops, cafe and transport stop, very conveniently. We will be glad to visit you again. Pavel.

We stayed at this apartment for 6 weeks and could not have had a more pleasant stay. The apartment is very modern, clean and basically has everything you need (including a washing machine, stove, dishwasher, refrigerator, Nespresso machine, pots and pans, etc). The bed is very comfortable, and the sheets get changed every week. The apartment has reliable WIFI and gets a ton of sunlight during the day.

We also loved the location. It is very conveniently located right next to a major bus stop, 2 grocery stores, restaurants, bars and other shops. Gare Cornavin, Old Town and other great neighborhoods are within walking distance or a very short bus ride. And best of all, the beautiful lake and jet d'eau are just a few steps away!

Mike is also the perfect host. He wasn't in town when we first arrived, but he made sure we could get into the apartment and even provided an extra set of keys. Appartment is ideally located in central Geneva so close to the lake. I spent 3 months there and every inch of this place is very well thought. The appartment is fully equiped, you just need to bring your suitcase. I had a great stay. Mike was very nice, welcoming and attentive. Thank you !!!

Would I stay again, yes!

thank you very much!

Many thanks!!

Very nice apartment and so clean! I am highly recommend.

Etant à ma première expérience avec AirBnB et recherchant un logement alternatif pour un mois à Genève, j’étais inquiet de la qualité, des soins ainsi que de la proximité du lieu avec l’organisation internationale avec laquelle je travaille ainsi qu’avec l’Université avec laquelle je fais des études supérieures. Sûrement mon prochain hébergement à Genève sera chez l’excellente Lucia!

This was the worst Airbnb that I have been to, specially due to the hostess’ behavior. Lucia is a warm and friendly host. She made me feel at home. We have several cultural exchanges, which I appreciate much. The place is great. Merci à Lucia pour l’accueil chaleureux. Je n’avais jamais réservé une chambre chez l’habitant (je me suis trompé durant ma réservation), du coup j’ai été un peu surpris de ne pas être seul mais c’est uniquement ma faute, Lucia avait un logement très propre et bien tenu.

The apartment is very convenient for an Airbnb with a section of the apartment for the guests completely autonomous from the owners. Lucia is a very nice and attentive host, and has everything very well prepared and taken care. Explains very well and is always supportive, warm and careful to make you feel at home.

I stayed with Lucia for just over a month when I first moved to Geneva. The space was exactly as advertised and made my transition to living in a new country incredibly smooth. Lucia was always an accommodating and communicative host. I enjoyed my stay with her I would recommend this listing to anyone!

Мой первый опыт использования сервиса AirBnb в полностью незнакомом мне городе Женеве, превзошел все ожидания и оставил исключительно положительные впечатления. Мне не только удалось насладиться уютом и комфортом предоставленного жилья, но и почувствовать себя как дома, благодаря беспрепятственному доступу ко всем заявленным удобствам и особенно к приветливой атмосфере гостиной. Хочу выразить особую благодарность хозяйке Люсии — ее гостеприимство, доброта и отзывчивость оставили неизгладимое впечатление от общего пребывания в Женеве. Люсия не только была готова помочь в любой ситуации, но и делилась советами и рекомендациями, значительно облегчавшими мое пребывание в городе. Спокойствие и отсутствие стресса сопровождали меня на протяжении всего пребывания, совсем не оставив места для разочарований. Я без колебаний могу рекомендовать этот вариант проживания всем, кто ищет комфортный и гостеприимный приют в Женеве.

This was my first time booking a room instead of an entire place, and I must say that, thanks to Lucia, my stay was much better than I expected. I definitely recommend this accommodation and want to thank Lucia again for the very warm welcome to Geneva! :)

I stayed in Lucia's place for my first five weeks in Geneva, which I enjoyed, as it was very comfortable, clean, helped me with my new start, and make friends. In the kitchen, every guest has its own shelves both in cupboard and the fridge, & separate plates, & cups. Lucia was providing support to any need. When I arrived, the lamp in my room was not very strong. When I informed her, the next day I had a new standing lamp with perfect lighting. I got also impressed with the proper cleaning that they are doing in the rooms when a guest is moving. As I was new in Geneva, I didn't know many people. Lucia created one weekend a brunch with with all the previous and current tenants. In this event, I had the chance to know more new people, and become friends. Staying at Lucia's place was an amazing experience, ideally for a new start in a new country.
una estadía muy grata y placentera, gracias por todo. Los desayunos, el lugar  y la convivencia eran geniales

Lucia’s place is very convenient and strategic. I have enjoyed my stay unfortunately it was too short. Thanks Lucia!

Lucie est une femme qui sait s’occuper de ses hôtes et qui fait tout pour que leur séjour soit le plus agréable possible.
Quand j’aurai à revenir sur Genève j’essaierai toujours de venir chez elle si elle a la disponibilité. Elle mérite plus de cinq étoiles !

I also had to wait over an hour after the stated check-in time, as Lucia nor her cleaner could meet me before. Therefore, I was walking around Geneva with my bags & case for several hours beforehand.
Overall, I enjoyed my trip to Geneva (its a beautiful city). However, I feel that my experience with Lucia dampend that a bit! I feel that she should be more transparent at the time of booking, rather than dropping stuff eg. Late check-in's & sharing with other guests on you last minute.
Estadia tranquila. Arredores calmos, casa sempre limpa e corresponde bem ao anúncio. Recomendo

Quelques difficultés à entrer dans le logement, pour le reste satisfait.

The bed is very comfortable and relaxing as the whole apartment.

I miss it!

His lovely, gentle Siberian Huskie 'prince' added to the charm of the place. I highly recommend Oscar's. Staying with him was a very pleasant experience

Oscar is the best host!  He showed me around Geneva, helped me make fondue, and was genuinely kind.  I love his sweet dog, too!  I now consider him a good friend. He's located in a great area, too!  Highly recommend.

I stayed at Oscar's place for almost 2 weeks, and my stay was absolutely great.
The room is cosy, silent, and comfortable. And the host is just amazing.
Oscar is a very hospitable, friendly, and interesting person, and he made me feel like at home.
I highly recommend this place.

I had a lovely time staying at Oscar's home in Geneva. Oscar is a kind, considerate and generous host, and he made me feel at home from the moment I stepped into his flat. I can't forget the really wonderful smoothies he made each day, a healthy start to my day! We had good conversations. I'd gladly recommend Oscar's home B&B to anyone who wants to visit Geneva.

I stayed with Oscar for 7 weeks and it was an absolute delight. The place is clean and sunny with balconies on both sides for morning and afternoon sun.
He's a fantastic, accommodating host and I couldn't recommend the place enough. It's close to tram and bus stops, and in the best part of Geneva, Carouge, with lots of cafes and boutiques and the best architecture in the city.

I stayed about one month at Oscar’s home in Carouge (from the beginning of May until the beginning of June this year) and it was an absolutely positive experience in all respects: Oscar is a very likeable person with an open mind. He cares about his guests and is always available for a chat - giving you at the same time all the privacy you need. He is generous and respectful and has a great sense of humor. We were talking a lot about many different topics and even if we disagreed we could laugh together. His dog is adorable as well. He is called Prince and is friendly towards everybody. The apartment is on the 6th floor. So if the weather is nice you can enjoy the great view while relaxing on one of the two balconies. The rooms are very clean and bright and I really felt at home. The apartment is located in Carouge, which is a very nice area with a good infrastructure.  You will find supermarkets close by and there is a number of bars and restaurants not far away. Furthermore, there are two tram stops close to the apartment, so you can reach the center of Geneva easily. Summing up, I frankly recommend this host whom I now would also call a friend.

Oscar and his housemate Martin were very friendly and their apartment was more than suitable for my needs! Clean and modern right next to the lovely old neighbourhood of Carouge. I highly recommend the free bike rental service nearby and go cycle to the mountains! The city is easily reached by tram, but is only approximately a half hour walk too, which I opted for due to the cool cafes and restaurants along the way. Highly recommended!

Oscar has a great personality in terms of genuinity and charisma. His house is well-kept in terms of cleanliness and neatness. Room is also bright and comfy with balcony.

Most importantly, i have definitely enjoyed the hospitality and friendship extended by both Oscar and Martin during my stay. I enjoyed the conversations we had which is truly a great cultural exchange. Short stay with great memories of them.

Oscar's handsome dog, Prince, has an equally sweet nature. A big dog is adorable and gentle.

Thanks to Oscar for trying his best to help me to overcome my fears for dogs. In fact, Prince is fantastic, he puts me at ease totally.

" A Great Swiss Hospitality Experience" ! Thanks Guys :-)

Oscar has been a wonderful host. The house is clean and cosy, the room it's very nice, with an awesome-super comfortable bed (I slept like a God). Th city centre is very close, and you can reach Plain Palais square in ten minutes walking. I highly recommend Oscar's house :-)

Oscar's apartment is in a great neighborhood on the south side of Geneva, about 15-20 min walk from the central attractions and lake (although right on a tram stop!).  We loved the apartment and our stay!  Highly recommended.

Our first experience with airbnb was with Oscar.  He was prepared for our arrival and gave us keys, guide book and some basic info straight away.  He has a husky who is very friendly.  We felt welcome and he even invited us to an excellent bottle of red wine.  His place is immaculate and we loved the location.  Highly recommend!
I stayed with Oscar for two weeks in July 2013 and had a wonderful stay. Oscar is warm, friendly and extremely helpful and hospitable, and the location is great. I would highly recommend a stay here!

I had such a wonderful time staying at Oscar's apartment. Oscar is such a gentle soul and I thoroughly enjoyed our various chats and interesting discussions. The apartment is very cosy and clean, feeling like home, and it is located in Carouge, one of the coolest areas in Geneva with a lot of cafes and bars.  The room itself is spacious with a big and comfortable bed. Oscar's housemate Martin is very friendly as well, and I was made to feel like a member of the 'household'.  So, if you ever visit Geneva or pass by, I strongly recommend you to stay with Oscar - you cannot get a better host!

We had a great stay at Oscar's place. We were looking for a place to stay in short notice and Oscar was flexible enough to accomodate us. One of the best things about travelling is meeting people. Oscar is a character we wil always remember. We loved his beautiful husky and I was actually surprised how clean Oscar managed to keep his apartment. The toilets were always mopped up and dry. His apartment is of really good value and strategically located. Good for people who want to explore the nooks and crannies of Geneva.

Wonderful experience with Oscar in Carouge! I could not have imagined a better stay. I felt quite at home in the apartment. In addition, the views were lovely. Comfortable, affordable, perfect. Geneva is a spectacular area and my advice to you: look no further than this posting.

Oscar was a great host and helped us find our way around Geneva. It was our first visit to Switzerland and he was very helpful and patient with all of our questions. We will certainly call on him for our next trip to Geneva.

Oscar est juste quelqu'un de génial, exactement le genre d'expérience pour laquelle on utilise airbnb!

I just stayed there for 8 nights on a business trip and had a blast. The location is excellent and the entertainment options nearby are a nice plus. A quick, two-stop ride on bus #1 and you are at the main train station with connections to every single place in the city. You can also walk the distance in 10 minutes.

Even though it is located in a lively area (Paquis, two blocks from the lake), the apartment is very quiet (especially the room, which faces the back of the building). I had no trouble sleeping and was never disrupted by noise at night.

The only downside to my stay was internet access. This apartment does not have its own private service; rather one has to catch the public wifi from the plaza just outside. This public wifi is not fast enough and signal strength is poor. I am sure Enrica will take care of this right away, but just make sure to ask before you go.

Overall, my stay was excellent. I enjoyed total privacy in an excellent location and came back home happy.

Enrica is a fantastic host. She she is gracious and professional and makes communication so easy. She is always quick to respond to a question and is very good about giving local information.

And I must say that her apartment is simply fantastic! If you are a road warrior like me and are looking for somthing different, then you must stay at her apartment. I took advantage of her state-of-the art, fully supplied kitchen and spent several nights cooking meals that I could not have made in the US.

I can honestly say that whenever I am in Geneva, and this apartment is available, I will not be staying in a hotel.

Das Schlafzimmer liegt auf der ruhigen Seite zu einer Art größerem Innenhof, das Wohnzimmer zur belebteren Seite mit dem Place de la Navigation, der Durchgangsstraße, die zur Rush hour als Alternativroute für die Hauptverkehrsstraßen genutzt wird. Als sehr schön empfand ich, dass man im Gegensatz zu manch anderer Stadtwohnung, morgens und abends Sonne in der Wohnung hat. Morgens im Schlafzimmer und nachmittags/abends im Wohnzimmer, einfach super. Wie für alte Stadthäuser in Holzbauweise üblich, bekommt man aus dem Flur und von oben etwas mit, was aber nie ein nerviges Level erreichte. Die Ausstattung ist sauber, neuwertig, funktionell und durchdacht. Die Lage ist super, kurzer Weg zur Seepromenade, direkt vor der Wohnung eine Bushaltestelle für beide Fahrtrichtungen, unten im Gebäude Restaurants, über die Straße zwei Lebensmittelläden. Etwas schade ist, dass das Fenster im Schlafzimmer und die Tür im Wohnzimmer keine Kippstellung haben, also nur auf oder zu.
Enrica ist eine höfliche, gut organisierte und hilfsbereite Person. Fragen etc. erledigt sie angemessen schnell und lösungsorientiert. Ich hatte keine Wartezeit bei der Anreise, sie war bereits in der Wohnung zur Übergabe. Die Abreiseformalitäten liefen auch problemlos ab. Alles in allem eine sehr gute Wahl für meinen Aufenthalt in Genf.

To summarize, I highly recommend the flat for both short term and long term stays, and Marie-Antoinette as a host 😉.
