The area is quiet and upmarket but for future guests - you are far from amenities - it is always a bus ride or a car to get even some milk. And this is important as the studio has nothing to help you on your way - most airbnbs come with some general things - either provided by the host or left by other guests - there was toilet paper but nothing else - no coffee, sugar, tea, washing up liquid - this of course isn't essential and as a guest you expect to buy it and I always replace but it just makes the guest feel at home - also as I arrived on a sunday nothing is open, and I feel this could be mentioned to help the guest. Also bear in mind that the kitchen has few items as well - I did mention to Florence that unlike other Airbnbs I had rented it didn't have the basics - from there she offered me a couple of sharp knives and a wooden spoon but she perhaps should visit other airbnbs and see what others provide from saucepans to kettles, graters, wine glasses and kitchen utensils.

The bus route the no 25 is great though - perfect to get into town the ticket system is easy to use but you need change (Geneva is severely lacking in ATMs so be prepared)

This is a secluded spot for someone looking to get away from the hustle and bustle of Geneva. #Kitchen: The Kitchen has all of the amenities that you are looking, Oven, toaster, coffee maker, washing machine. Florence provides kitchen utensils and also provided me with washing up and laundry detergent for me to do dishes and wash clothes, as well as bin bags for the bin. The bin is outside under the tree and garbage pickup is on a Monday. #Storage: Florence provides a huge chest of draws and a wardrobe (with hangers) to store your clothing and personals. #Utility: The studio has a utility room to store bags etc whilst you stay, and it also has a large ironing board and iron, as well as a clothes horse to dry your cloths. Florence has no issues with you taking your clothes horse upstairs to the garden and letting you dry your clothes in the afternoon sun. #Size and Location: The apartment is much larger than the pictures than Florence has posted let on, the apartment is below ground as well, so it remains quite cool during the summer months. Despite the apartment being under ground, there are 2 french doors that let in a lot of light. The apartment is about 30min by train (5,25) from the local train station (Gare Cornavin) and about 45 minutes from the Airport. There is nothing close by way of shops, so if you are going to look to buy groceries, you shall need to take a bus. Most shops close at 7pm in Geneva, so planning is a must when dealing with pubic transport and the location. #Bed: The bed is pretty soft and might not be to everyone's tastes. #Business: I had no issues with mobile phone reception in the apartment (Salt, Swisscom, my phone liked to switch between the two of them). Florence provides internet access and I found the speeds to be far better than what you might get if you stayed at a hotel. There is no desk, but there is a high kitchen table and chairs. If you like to stand and work, like I do, then the kitchen table works excellently, if you prefer the conveniences of a regular desk, then this AirBNB might not be the best option for you. The apartment has a combination of the old (none hexagonal) and new (hexagonal) Swiss power sockets, which is a win for those of us who travel and have the older universal power adapters. #Over All: I spent over 2 months staying at the apartment and I found the hosts to be charming and friendly, I would definitely recommend this to anyone travelling in the Geneva area. I think the studio could definitely benefit with the addition of a couch and a desk, the desk to make it more friendly for more business users and a couch to give you someone where else to sit and stretch your legs out. The apartment was my home for 10 weeks. I honestly have only positive words about this place. It comes highly recommended.
My only side-note would be to agree in advance what exactly is expected at the end of the stay in terms of how the apartment should be left. I merely say this because, apparently, the lady who cleans the apartment had made a comment that "she was disappointed because she expected that it would be cleaned." I admit, this was not a pleasant thing to hear because... I have stayed in many Airbnbs and have always made sure to take good care of the places. When checking out, I never leave a mess, throw the garbage, pick up everything, leave no dirty dishes. And until this stay, this has always been what was expected of me. My reasoning is that, whenever a tenant leaves, surely the place needs to have a more thorough cleaning before the next one checks in.
Anyways, this is in no way a negative comment on the apartment. Just a note to clarify expectations. The place is indeed great.

It is also sparkling clean and is maintained as such throughout the whole stay. The neighboring square can get a bit noisy sometimes, but the bedroom is located on the other side of the building and faces the inner courtyard, so it's not a problem. All in all, I really recommend choosing this apartment if you're going to be staying in Geneva for some time!

Great location for the yearly Fête de l'Escalade. The closing ceremony was 50 meters from the door! Very walkable to quaint restaurants (I highly suggest lunch at Pasta People) and easy access to trams and busses. The apartment had great heat and amazing hot water for the shower.
great location and really homie
Excellent experience
Beautiful property in one of the best places in Geneva, complimented by a wonderful host. Highly recommended!

J’ai passé un excellent séjour dans le logement de Elena. C’est cosy mignon agréable… un univers original qui m’a beaucoup plus. Instruction très clair je n’ai manqué de rien… un grand merci à Elena je le recommande et je garde bien au chaud ce logement que je serais ravie de relouer
Très bon emplacement en vielle ville.

What a great place! Located in beautiful Old Town, a few steps from St. Pierre Cathedral, Eliora's place is lovely, homey and very clean. As described. Very close to cafes, restaurants, shops and public transport. Eliora was very responsive. Highly recommended the next time you're in Geneva!

My second stay at Eliora’s place in a year.  Wonderful home and host. Really love the light filled room and view overlooking a courtyard.  Easy access to restaurants, cafes and shopping just down the hill. Looking forward to coming back again soon!
Amazing value for a lovely apartment in a great location - right next to the cathedral!

Eliora is an awesome host. She is very responsive and got back to me when I wasn't able to find the laundry room key. She had someone come out right away to provide the key. great apartment in the center of old Geneva.  I really enjoyed my stay here.

Very homey, cute flat right next to the cathedral. I absolutely loved it! I felt at home and comfortable instantly and loved being in the heart of Geneva’s beautiful old town. Probably my favorite Airbnb I’ve ever been to.
The location couldn't be better!  This is such a cozy little flat, you can't go wrong.  I enjoyed the proximity to old town restaurants, walkable to all the sites.
Incredible neighborhood, cozy apartment with an amazing view. Quiet yet walkable to lots of sites and restaurants. And what a bonus to have access to a washer/dryer in the basement!
Perfect for a few day stay in Geneva!
This is a nice, clean studio apartment with lots of space. It is extremely well located with many bus stops and shops nearby. We highly recommend!
Elena’s place was as described and in an ideal location for exploring Geneva. Overall a pleasant stay and experience!

Eliora's place was just what I needed for my stay in Geneva - perfect location in charming Old Town and walkable to key spots in the city. The space was very comfortable and perfect for my needs. Would highly recommend and stay again!
Great location, cozy room, great host!

What a great spot! Hills are to be expected in old town as it is a medieval part of the city, but it is worth it! Cobblestone streets right across from a beautiful cathedral, cafés are great… it’s even possible to walk to different grocery stores in the area. Elena’s place itself is perfect for one or two people. Spotlessly clean, comfortable, and definitely easy to make your own food if you wish. Can’t wait to visit again!
Great stay and very close to the Cathedral. Walkable area and up on the hill. It was great for what I needed and plenty of room for one or two. Instructions were super easy.
This is a lovely studio right in the middle of the Old Town and close to all the attractions.

I can't recommend Eliora's place highly enough for your stay in Geneva. It is in an ideal location in Old Town right near the landmark of St. Pierre Cathedral (easy to locate even if you are not familiar with the area). There are wonderful restaurants, bars, and shops within steps, and it's within 15min walk to any place you might want to travel in the city. Eliora was extremely communicative and kind from the moment I booked my stay and provided extremely thorough instructions, making check in a breeze. The building is so nice and made me feel very safe and at home, even late at night. The studio is ideal with large, gorgeous windows, great airflow, and a nice view. The church bells do ring regularly and are quite loud with the windows open, but using the small fan Eliora provided, I still slept through them just fine at night. I work in Geneva often and hope Eliora's place becomes my new home away from home each time I visit.

Eliora was very easy and quick to communicate with. Lovely location although it requires some walking (we didn’t mind). Directions and checkin with pictures were super helpful. Apartment was very clean and comfortable. Bed was satisfactory.

Отличное расположение в самом центре старого города. Для тех, кто приехал с целью туризма, лучше не придумаешь. Небольшая студия , очень уютная, есть все, что необходимо, много может рассказать о хозяйке. Хозяйка отзывчивая, общение с ней было легким и приятным. Все понравилось

I have to say, it was perfect.

The location is great, in walking distance from markets, restaurants, bars, regular shopping, expensive shopping and so many places of interest.

Thank you Eliora, I had a great time.

Thank you Elena!
All was perfect.
I'm going to stay at your apartment again, when I'll be in Geneva.

This was a charming, cosy, small studio apartment with everything I needed. the bed was comfortable. I was able to cook nice meals for myself in the tiny but functional kitchen. It's in a beautiful location in the centre of the old town. It's next to the main St Pierre cathedral of the old town with its incredible archeological museum underneath. The only down side with being next to a cathedral is that the bells ring every 15 minutes throughout the night. With jet lag after 24 hours flying from Australia, the bells were not my friend. I did get used to them eventually and realised I could close the shutters to reduce the sound.
If there is a "Swiss apartment", this is it. Simple, clean, and centrally located. Communication with the owner was quick and easy.
Love Eliora’s place very much!!! Such a lovely spot in the old town! Definitely recommended!!!!

Great location in old town in Geneva

The perfect place to stay for a new nights! Elena was super communicative and responsive to the questions I had. Moreover, the guide she had written was super helpful:)) would recommend this place as it is super convenient too!

入住簡單有效率， 房間還算整齊

This apartment was perfectly located for my business trip to Geneva. It's very close to several mass transit stops and just around the corner from two grocery stores. Charlotte was very communicative and always responded very quickly to any questions I had. I would recommend this as a functional stay from 1 or 2 people.

Charlotte's place is a beautiful, well sized and perfectly formed studio in one of my favourite parts of Geneva. Because it looks onto a large courtyard it is super quiet whilst being in a lively and fun neighbourhood close to just about everything you could need. The clever use of space means there is plenty of storage and a full kitchen and bathroom with a lovely window seat in the kitchen to enjoy your morning coffee. Knowing Geneva prices it is also great value for money. Charlotte was efficient and friendly and was kind enough to meet me at the apartment on my arrival to make sure all was well. Hope to stay here again next time I'm in town.

This is a lovely, clean and well appointed space that is comfortable and quiet. It is wel located with trams right outside the door and a lovely grocery around the corner.  I spent 8 nights and had a busy schedule but found that I could easily walk where I needed to go within about 15 to 20 minutes. I would highly recommend it. The host is responsive and kind and Geneva is a lovely city to explore.

Ha sido un agradable tiempo en Ginebra a pesar de las altas temperaturas características de Junio, he podido disfrutar de la ciudad durante el poco tiempo libre que ofrecía nuestra rutina de viaje, tener un lugar céntrico fue estupendo; buena parte de que haya sido una agradable estadía es debido al hospedaje. Es la primera vez que viajo sola y para mi era prioritario sentirme segura y cómoda, ambas cosas las he logrado en el apartamento de Charlotte. El apartamento está ubicado en un lugar muy tranquilo y cerca a transporte público, comercios, restaurantes, lo que pueda uno necesitar, es un lugar sin ruidos molestos y como no está exactamente en la vía principal, el ruido del tráfico no afecta. Lo que ves en las fotografías es lo que encontrarás en el apartamento, con una salvedad: es mejor en vivo que en fotografía: la cocina está perfectamente equipada y el baño es más amplio que en un hotel, la recámara es espaciosa y equipada dentro de lo necesario para que la estancia sea cómoda. Gracias a la amplia ventana hay una excelente ventilación. El internet fue de gran ayuda. Agradezco la asistencia de Charlotte y su esposo ya que estuvieron atentos a mi durante mi estancia, dispuestos a asistirme en caso de necesitarlo. Sin duda estoy muy agradecida por todo.
Chez Charlotte tout est parfait : la situation, la propreté, le calme et le charme et l'accueil de Charlotte. L'appartement est encore mieux que sur les photos. Je vous le recommande fortement.

The place is amazing, clean and well located. It has everything needed in the kitchen, that is very modern and nice. It is in a quiet area, but close to public transport and commerce. Just loved the place and Charlotte was very kind and nice!

The apartment was located close to public transport, supermarkets, and I felt totally safe walking back to the apartment late at night, after I'd finished long days of meetings. The apartment is really quiet, as it is on the non-street facing side of the building. I'd definitely recommend staying here!
The lodging in apt. was excellent, both for the quality of the property, the amenities offered and the location. In the meantime in Geneva I will look for the availability of it.

C’était très bien passé à cet appartement! Propre, pratique et bien situé pour aller au quartier de l’ONU et centre-ville avec transport public, ou bien se promener au quartier, qui est très agréable avec de bons restaurants et cafés.
I had a great time staying in this apartment! Clean, practical and well situated for going to the UN offices and the city center by public transport, but also nice to stroll around in the nice neighborhood with good cafes and restaurants.
A nice and cozy apartment welcomes you, with its colors and details makes your stay relaxing and pleasant. You will like it very much.
propriétaire très disponible, super expérience

Pros: location. Close to supermarkets and public transport. International organisations are easy to reach by bus. 15 minutes walk to the lake. The neighbourhood is safe and lively. The apartment is quiet, so a good nights rest is guaranteed.
Cons: 24 hours before my arrival, the host said she would meet me at the apartment, but she wasn't there. She sent me the instructions on how to access when I was waiting outside the building. If you can't be there to meet your guests, that's fine. Just don't wait to the very last second to provide access instructions. Also, you need to be able to provide a concise and correct answer to basic questions about how household appliances work. If hospitality is improved, this would be a totally advisable stay, specially if you are in town for work.
Very comfortable stay.  Well-equipped kitchen with brand new oven and dishwasher, strong wifi and very close to all commodities.

The apartment was very comfortable and an ideal, quiet, home-from-home during a very busy week. It's conveniently located within walking distance of the city centre and just round the corner from a tram stop and shops. Many thanks to Charlotte for her hospitality.
Clean and convenient space. Charlotte is a great host who responds quickly to any concerns.
Nice location and kind homeowner. Highly recommend it.

Many thanks for being such a great host!
I only can recommend this place and I definitely would come back next time.

The room is quite big and comfortable, and the kitchen has basically everithing you need
Great apartment, nice spaces, very clean, and super close to the tram.

Very nice apartment, clean, quiet and cozy. Excellent place for cooking my own meals, as the kitchen is completely furnished, fully functional, and there is a large grocery store one block away. There is also convenient laundry room in the building. I felt right at home after a few days.
The apartment is very conveniently situated in a calm neighborhood. Plenty of store and restaurant options nearby. Also close to the train station and downtown, and to major bus and tram lines. The host (Charlotte) was very helpful and promptly answered any questions I had throughout my stay.

There is NO WASHING MACHINE in the apartment. There is a pay-to-use washing machine in the basement, but I was not informed how to access it or instructed how to use it. You have to go through two doors in the basement, which are all locked, and you need keys. I was not informed about this or where the keys were. When you get to the machine, there are 4 sheets of instructions, all in French. And you need a special card to pay, which again I was not provided or provided any information about. I ended up at a laundromat around the corner, and wasted my last night in Geneva. I understand it was holidays and there was no one available to help me. Other than the misleading washing machine amenity, everything else was perfect.
Space is perfect for 1 person or (maybe) a couple. It is very small, just a kitchen and a bedroom and bathroom. Very clean and the bathroom is a good size. I was a solo traveler, so it fit my needs perfectly. You will be provided with 1 toilet paper roll, a palmolive dishwashing soap, a liquid hand soap, some dish towels, and hand and bath towels. There is a laundromat around the corner, and for 5 francs you can do a small load, and the dryer is free to use.
Very comfortable and convenient.

Place is like it’s advertised. Clean and great location. Had a good stay.

Ich habe mich in der Wohnung sehr wohl gefühlt. Charlotte ist eine aufmerksame Gastgeberin, die bei Fragen immer gut erreichbar war.

Quiet nice and clean place. Responsive and friendly host. A lot of food stores and restaurants/cafes are close to the place. 30 minutes walkable distance to UN offices and to the lake side. FYI, Swiss adaptor is needed to use the laptop.
Charlotte's place was clean, peaceful and quiet. Shops and public transportation are all just round the corner. Charlotte was a responsive and friendly host. I would definitely stay there again.

I had a longer stay for work. Host is a good communicator. The flat is a 1 bedroom/living area and a separate kitchen/eating area. It's very basic but has good light. Place was tidy but felt it needed a deeper clean. Wifi worked well. Desk works in a pinch but not a proper and comfortable sized desk for a normal sized adult. It has good connections for public transport and short walk to Cornavan. This building had lots of smokers (you can smoke in flats in Geneva) so there was a lot of cigarettes smell.
Very nice and well equipped apartment. Walkable neighborhood, but also convenient to public transport. Kind host.

I had a great stay at Charlotte’s appartment and she was always very responsive.
Highly recommended

Charlotte is a very responsive and reliable host. The self check-in/out were easy. The apartment matches the photos and description, but do not expect a luxury-style apartment. There is one main (bed)room, which is suitable more for one person than for a couple. The kitchen is well equipped and furnished - one can prepare even big meals if needed. Cleaning was also very good. Bathroom is spacious, with hair dryer, but shampoo could be added and towels quality improved. The bed and pillow could be way more comfortable.  Windows do not have shutters or real blinders, so one can wake up very early in summer time. The apartment overlooks internal courtyards, with no street noise. While it is not in downtown / city center, the location is overall good, in that there are lots of amenities around. All in all, I am satisfied with my choice and I will likely choose Charlotte's apartment if I happen to be in Geneva again - it was also good value for money.

I was in Geneva for work and the apartment was just what I needed. The location was lovely and the apartment gave me my own space where I could cook a small meal and relax at the end of a busy day. Perfect for my needs. Great location, everything is very clearly communicated. Will gladly be back for my other business trips

Clean, safe, comfortable, great location, appreciates the small fan as it was very hot.

Great apartment in a beautiful location, walkable to everywhere.
Great stay! The location is really the highlight of this place, right in the middle of old town. The place itself is also very cosy, and I feel the pictures don't quite do it justice.
Nice cosy studio in a central location in old town Geneva. Worth climbing the hill for. Elena is very easy to deal with with good communication and clear instructions.
Lovely central apartment, perfect for our stay in Geneva. Comfy bed. The cathedral bells were heard with the windows open.

Easy access, easy to find, great location, perfect for a short stay. Cute studio with all amenities slightly run down but fully functional. Bed was comfortable and the location in the old town could not be better!!
Excellent location ,so close to historic centre of Geneva

We really enjoyed our stay-it's a comfortable and cozy flat.  The location in old town is perfect and served our needs wonderfully.  Its quiet and peaceful  area and very good public transport connections to all  of Geneva if you want  to go outside of Old town.

Cozy spot right in old town Geneva with close proximity to the cathedral which was really cool! Very walkable with lots of shopping and food options, parks, waterfront, etc nearby. She has a great selection of books and games, as well, when you're done exploring! Eliora’s place is quaint and enjoyable to stay at: wish I still knew how to play the piano.  Nice spot to stay within the old town as it is close to a cafes and eateries, and close to transit that will take you into the centre of town and attractions.
The place is very peaceful and quiet at night and morning, the building is well designed, the apartment is cozy, if you have a heavy suitcase it needs agood wheels because the roads are hard on them.

Heel fijn huiselijk verblijf, met alles wat je nodig hebt, alsof je in Genève woont. Mooi gelegen in het historische centrum. Je hoort wat straatgeluid en maar geen lawaai. Let op, de host voorziet niet in een openbaar vervoer kaart, ook al heb je hier eigenlijk volgens Airbnb recht op als je toeristenbelasting vertaalt.
Great communication.  Great location.  really could not be better.

Very comfortable stay at Eliora's cozy studio with a personal touch. Detailed instructions on how to get to the studio along with nearby restaurant recommendations. Eliora was a great host and she responded quickly when we contacted her.
The studio is located in the old town of Geneva. Very nice environment and super close to main attractions like St. Peter's Cathedral, Reformation Museum and Maison Tavel etc. But also note that the old town is situated on a hill and there will be some slopes/stairs involved to get to the studio. With luggages, we suggest taking the bus #92, which loops around the old town area and actually goes up the hill. From the Geneva Cornavin train station, take bus #5 or #20 to Place de Neuve stop, then take bus #92 to Cathedrale stop (closest stop to the studio).

Wahrlich ein Bijou dieses Studio mitten in der Genfer Altstadt! Ruhig gelegen, mit einer gut ausgestattete Küche und bestens erreichbar (es gibt einen kleinen Bus für die Altstadt, der fast vor die Haustür fährt und gute ÖV-Verbindungen zum UNO-Areal und ins Zentrum). Ich war absolut zufrieden. Danke Eliora Elena!
lovely place,  very responsive host, would recommend :)

The place was everything I needed for a short stopover in Geneva, which I used as a home base to visit the city as well as the surrounding areas such as Charmonix and interlaken.
It was such a convenient location, walkable to most of the key sights.

Will recommend anyone to stay here. Concierge doesn’t speak English so it’s going to be a trouble communicating if you have issues, best to communicate with eliora

I loved this place. Solid, private, tastefully decorated, clean, quiet, nice personal touches, and an unbelievably good location--just minutes from anything you'd want to see in the old town AND just minutes from busses that would take you anywhere else. I couldn't believe my luck getting to stay there. One of the best AirBnb's I've experienced. Thank you so much!
We absolutely loved staying here! The room was clean, spacious, and well located. Would definitely recommend!

Very good location, close to many good sightseeing. Cozy comfortable room of an intellectual with many books and a piano. I feel very comfortable. Kitchen & bathroom is modernized. Or go from natural museum of geneva down to st pierre church .
Séjour de 3 nuits, parfaitement situé au coeur de la vieille ville. Calme, propre et accueillant. Je reviendrais

I felt immediately at home in this adorable studio and absolutely loved the accessibility and walkability of the neighborhood! Can’t wait to come back.
Very kind host. She went above and beyond! She included nearby stores and places to eat which is always very helpful.

Logement très charmant, parfait pour un couple ou un voyageur en solo. L’appartement est super propre et tranquille tout en étant à quelques pas des restaurants et des magasins. J’ai adoré mon passage à Genève et dans ce logement. Je recommande sans aucune hésitation.

Eliora’s place was easy to check into and close to so much to do! It’s a cozy location in a great part of the city with easy access to the public transportation. The apartment is very lovely, fits the description and the location is central and calm. Big plus for the piano. I hope to visit again another time!
Excellent séjour, studio très bien placé et tout équipé.
Logement bien situé, propre et pratique. L’église qui sonne régulièrement peut surprendre au début mais on s’y fait. Je recommande.
Emplacements et studio parfait
Lovely apartment, very quiet in the very heart of historical Geneva!

A Great little flat right in the centre of the old town, right next to the Saint-Pierre Cathedral (and its bells and regular clock chimes, which I enjoyed - others may want ear plugs). Have felt supported by the host along the way, including when trying to enter and couldn't open the mail box. It wasn't locked just very stiff and needed a harder pull.
Had a fantastic stay, Thank you.

The place was exactly as described. I was a bit cautious about the bell sounds in the review but it was much quieter and low key than I anticipated so no issue at all. Just another sound in the background.

Very sweet and cozy small apartment, the Old Town Geneva location is very charming. Great for any active person with a sense of romantic inclination, adventure and fun. Steep, but brief, walk uphill makes it a bit harder for a person with mobility issues. Otherwise it’s quite good.
I had a fantastic stay and can only recommend this place! Merci

O studio é bem localizado e limpo, recomendo.

Eliora is a great host: very responsive and accommodating.
Her apartment was perfect my business trip: central location, quiet, clean.
Highly recommend
great location! I wish we could have stayed longer.

Great location in Geneva’s Old Town, next to St. Pierre Cathedral. The bed was very comfortable and we will surely return. The host is very responsive and provides great directions, and suggestions for your stay!

Logement idéalement placé au coeur dans la ville de Genève. Très cosy et fonctionnel. Idéal pour un séjour solo ou à deux.

Studio très agréable et bien situé dans le vieux Genève donc quartier pittoresque.

Located right in the old town. Best location. The house is nice and make you feel at home :)
The place was very well located, charming, and clean. I'm very satisfied.

This is a lovely studio located in the old town, right next to the St. Pierre Cathedral. très bon week-end,  emplacement  parfait

Had a cute time in the old quarter. Even though it looks busy it was quiet and restful!

Great place, better location. Always happy any time I’m a 15 second walk from a great view. And from the right angle you can even see lake Geneva and the Jet right from the window. Great host/landlord, very accomodating and always on-call to answer any questions/concerns. Unit is very clean and nicely maintained. Centrally located to all of Geneva and is nearby shopping centers, restaurants, supermarkets, pharmacies, etc. Very convenient. Highly recommended if you plan to stay in Geneva.

I had a great stay in this apartment, it's just as nice as in the photos. For a studio apartment it is really spacious, and it is nicely decorated throughout. The studio looks exactly as it does in the photos. It is situated near shopping and transit. It is an easy walk to city-centre. It is clean and comfortable.

Jean-Luc is a very attentive "landlord". Great experience. I would stay here again.

I spent ten days in Jean-Luc's apartment. Everything was great. The apartment is a 20-25 minute walk from the main station. It also has various bus connection three minutes from the front door. The bed is a fold-out bed. Before I arrived, I was a bit worried about this, but it was perfectly comfortable and long enough.

Jean-Luc himself is a very nice guy and was very willing to help in case I needed something, but there was no problem, so I never had to contact him.

All in all, I really enjoyed my stay at his apartment.

Very quiet and nice area, centrally located, with shops really nearby, a few restaurants... Easy to get there from the train station. Jean-Luc has been very nice and helpful, the place is perfectly clean, and I found everything I needed ready when I arrived.
Great place when you work around the UN, with a direct bus (11) a few meters away from the building ! It was just perfect for my arrival in Geneva, I totally recommend !!!
Lovely flat and well located. It's a perfect place for a short or longer term stay in Geneva. Jean-Luc was incredibly helpful and made my months stay in Geneva a great experience. Highly recommended.

This place was perfect! My wife and I stayed here for three months during the summer. From start to finish Jean-Luc was an excellent host and extremely helpful with all of our requests. The highlight was definitely the balcony!! We ate our dinner out there every night and it was so relaxing and beautiful. It was the perfect way to end each day.

The location is also fantastic. Its on a quiet street, but still near plenty of shopping and several main bus stops.

We just hope this place is available again next time we are in Geneva!

It is easy to get to to the lake or city center by bus (5 minutes) or walk (20-30 minutes). There are neighborhood cafes, bistros and little shops close by plus, just around the corner is a little shopping mall with a supermarket.

Overall we had a very good time in this apartment - we can recommend it.
Very pleasant stay. Host very responsive.

The most beautiful energy, warm and inviting space. Perfect location! I wish I could have stayed longer.

very nice flat and fine location，highly recommend！

It was very nice for my mom to stay there!! She was very happy and could sleep very good :)
I enjoyed my stay!
Thank you Sylvain for a great stay.  I am super grateful for all of the local information you shared with me and for the centrally located, clean and tidy room.

Sylvain est un très bon hôte! Il saura vous orienter si vous avez arriver à Genève ! L’hébergement est très bien situé, proche du lac mais aussi proche de la gare, idéal comme point de chute pour démarrer votre séjour à Genève ! La chambre est très confortable ainsi que les commodités . Je recommande vivement !

Sylvain est un hôte super! De bon conseil et discret👌🏾

Logement pratique et central dans un immeuble récent.

Great stay in a beautiful location with kind hosts. Access to a terrace with a view was a bonus!

Cosy, spacious, and very clean room and apartment. Really appreciated having a private bathroom and I found the bed very comfortable. Super clean space and silence for sleeping, thank you so much
Thanks so much for making me feel at home. You are a star.

Best of all was my experience with lovely hosts, Livia and Michelle.  Livia was waiting for me at the building entrance upon my arrival and allowed me an early check-in. I would love to return and would totally recommend to all!

Wonderful short stay with Livia. Friendly and helpful host. Clean and clutter-free bedroom. Spotless bathroom. She even helped me get a taxi when I was running late this morning. I enjoyed my time here.

Livia and Michelle were fantastic. Their place was cozy and the room was perfect for my two night stay! The bathroom being close to the bedroom is a big plus and they have great water pressure in the shower. The location is prime, you can walk to the lake in less than 5 mins!

Livia et sa compagne Michèle ont été très sympas, disponibles et accueillantes.
Je recommande la chambre avec la salle de bain et toilettes juste à côté dans ce logement très propre et bien situé. Idéal aussi pour les coureurs du marathon de Genève car tout proche du départ et pas très loin de l’arrivée.

Dani et sa famille nous ont très bien accueillit, la chambre est grande, spacieuse et lumineuse donnant sur un balcon. Nous étions comme chez vous. Petit déjeuner servi et bien présenté, nous étions aux petits soins ! :)

Dani and Adam (and their beatiful daughter) are excellent hosts, ready to answer all of your questions, give some advices about the city, bicycle, hospitality at all... And tasty breakfast!

Best place to stay for couple of nights on Geneve, highest recommendations!

very nice people, didn't mind me bringing my infant son over to play and hang out in the room, very clean flat. they let me leave my bag there the second day as i wasn't flying out until the evening.

L'accueil de toute la famille est adorable, plein d'attention, de gentillesse et de discrétion également. My stay at Dani's was great.  Highly recommended!

Dani was responsive and helpful. The room description and photos are accurate.

The room, bathroom, bathtub, toilet and kitchen were all clean and neat.

Dani's husband welcomed me in the evening, explained me around and made me feel at home ("use anything you find in the fridge"). Two towels and sleepers were available in the bedroom.

Dani's little child sleeping in another room woke up at 7.30am and I could hear him. I have two small kids myself so I am used to that. Just in case you plan to sleep in quietly in the morning, bring your earplugs.

The breakfast included cereals, milk, tea, coffee, an orange, a tangerine, and two croissants.

The neighborhood is very quiet, there is a large park just across the street.

Nice place, I would definitely return when I travel alone.

Quite location within walking distance from downtown, good wifi, clean flat and bathroom, great breakfast. I enjoyed my staying there for 2 nights. There were no any problems with 2 years baby. Also I used provided bicycle and had a lovely bike tour near Geneva Lake. Daniela and family were very kind and responsive.

Daniela and her family are really nice, warm people. I booked tat the last minute and they were very flexible, waited for me and made it all really easy - they were very welcoming and friendly, ready to help with anything, offered food, tea, gave some helpful advice on what to do in Geneva. The room is big, good WiFi, a nice park nearby, walking distance to center. The baby is incredibly cute. Note that he does wake up at 7-30 though:-) I didn't mind as I wanted to get up early myself, but keep that in mind if you want to sleep late.

I stayed at Dani's for the second time.

Since last time I stayed in December 2014, the room has become more comfortable. In addition to two towels, now there is a lamp on the desk. Power cable extension, power plug adapters and earplugs are available. There are also hooks and hangers behind the door - very convenient to hang your clothes. Dani's child cried once during the night waking me up. I have children myself, I am used to that so for me it was not a problem at all.

Dani's family is very welcoming and made me feel at home.

Great staying experience, highly recommended, will definitely stay again.

Des hôtes charmants, une chambre spacieuse et très accueillante .
Personnellement : je recommande cette adresse et j y reviendrai avec plaisir !

Séjour très agréable dans un appartement très calme. Excellent petit-déjeuner, beaucoup de choix et très copieux! Nous avons été très bien reçus, la chambre est spacieuse, le lit est confortable, serviettes de bains et chaussons à disposition!
Such lovely hosts.  Very helpful and accommodating.  The flat is in a good central location and is clean and comfortable.  Very easy to get to with good transport links all around.

The apartment is 2 seconds from nearest bus stop & centre is literally 10 min away! They kindly prepared breakfast for me each morning &were very happy to help with anything I needed to know. Would thoroughly recommend them. I think I have made friends for life! Thank you :)

It was the greatest air bnb and i highly recommend you to take this room. It was very clean, comfortable and spacious. The host couple was super nice and we loved the  baby. dani was so helpful from the beginning to the end. You should take this room!!!!

Although I only had a very short stay with Dani and her husband it was enjoyable. The flat is set back from the main road but really close to the centre of town. The room was very clean, spacious and even had its own balcony. I wasn’t expecting such a large selection for breakfast but it was a nice surprise. I would defiantly stay again if I ever come back to Geneva.

Dani and her family were such wonderful hosts - I fully recommend them! They were incredibly nice and helpful. The room is clean, spacious and has a very comfortable bed. The breakfast was especially enjoyable. I will definitely stay again when I come back to Geneva.

Dani is an excellent host. She gave us all the needed information to get to the apartment. Her husband even went to the bus stop to pick us up. She welcomed us with orange juice and gave us really nice tips on what to do in Geneva.
The room is big, bright, nice and clean. The breakfast is really good.
They have a baby boy really cute.
The location is great! Just walking distance from the downtown.
A very warm welcome, clean and neat apartment, huge breakfast contributes to a perfect stay!
Staying with Dani and her family was an amazing experience. They are awesome hosts! Very helpful!! I will go back to their flat every time I go back to Geneva!

C'est toujours un plaisir de revenir chez Dani !
Je renouvelle mes chaleureuses recommandations pour cette adresse et pour l'accueil de Dani !
Very nice people, great care and clean room. Plenty of choices for breakfast, Dani was very flexible with my late night arrival.

Dani and Adan are a lovely couple (with a very cute three-year-old) and they made my sister and I feel really at home, welcoming us with maps, a guide book and a bottle of wine. It's a beautiful apartment with lots of light in a very nice part of Geneva -- walking distance from the natural history museum and two big parks. Their guest bedroom is huge and has a little balcony looking out on their street, which is very quiet. We would have loved to stay longer, we were just there for a night, but it would be a lovely base for exploring Geneva for a couple of days!
Very welcoming host. Super clean place and well located flat. The room is quiet and well lit.

Dani and her husband were very lovely hosts. They met me at my late arrival time as well as gave me directions to get there. They had a continental breakfast waiting for me In the morning and let me take my time with checkout. Very kind and friendly hosts!

Dani is a very nice host. The location of flat is between two parks, that's great! Only one night we stay here, but i was very impressed,  the room was very clean and the host gave us very careful consideration ......

Merci a Dani et son mari pour leur bel accueil. Ils ont été adorables, ils ont tout fait pour que notre séjour soit agréable tout en étant très discret. La chambre est jolie et confortable. Un petit déjeuner copieux et un super emplacement prés de la vieille ville. Adresse a conseiller sans aucun probléme.

Wir wurden von Dani sehr herzlich empfangen und fühlten uns sofort sehr wohl. Dani und Adan waren sehr gastfreundlich, zuvorkommend und hilfsbereit. Das Zimmer war sehr gross, schön und sehr sauber. Das Morgenessen sehr reichhaltig. Es war alles wunderbar.

You would be lucky to stay with Dani and her Husband Adan. They were so welcoming right from the beginning. Adan even picked me up from the bus stop at midnight when I arrived late and set an alarm for me early in the morning to make sure I made my flight. Absolutely wonderful people that provide you with more than you could ask for out of an AirBnB. Breakfast was given and they made you feel at home.  Thank you guys for the lovely stay! Until next time.

Perfect, easy and wonderful. Just as described. The bottle of wine waiting in my room was such a special touch. Thank you for making my stay in Switzerland so easy and warm. Directions were really straight forward and Adam spent a great amount of time helping me plan my time in Switzerland with his recommendations.

I really had a great experience at Dani' home. That was my first time to book a room at Airbnb and I were satisfied with everything. Although I just spent one night at their home, they gave lots of information about Geneva. I love their family and I hope to see them again!
Yes, host made me welcome and things were as in picture. Obviously, there was no picture of the toilet, which was very small. The surrounding is good but the location is far from the city centre.

Very nice and very quiet location. Proper and well maintained room. Dani and her husband are very nice hosts and care about everything. They are very attentive, but also very discrete and quiet people. Very large breakfast, thank you! I stronlgy recommend to stay at their place. It is quiet and in walking distance from the city.
Great experience! Truly warm welcoming. The hosts are really nice and the location is as described. We felt as if we were visiting some good friends. The location is very well connected as well!

Great room in an appartment with a friendly family. Amazingly well equipped kitchen. Very helpful hosts. Excellent for staying with kids/babies, they have everything. Close to groceries. Not too far from the city centre, but very accessible by bus (including to train station, airport and tourist attractions). We would highly recommend!

Belle chambre dans un appartement avec une famille sympathique. Cuisine extrêmement bien équipée. Hôtes vraiment accueillants et aidants. Excellent endroit pour rester avec des enfants ou bébés. Près des supermarchés. Pas trop loin du centre de la ville, mais très accessible par autobus (station de train, aéroport et attractions touristiques). Nous recommandons absolument!

Hi Dani,

it is a good experiences to stay in your home with your family. the location is very near to Old town by walking and the room is good. you are so sweet to prepare the Adjuster to guess.

you are not only making business in Airbnb , but also making friends !

Kiss your lovely son for me
EVE

Très bonne expérience chez Dani et sa famille! La chambre est spacieuse, propre et chaleureuse, le quartier tranquille et très bien desservi par les transports publics. Mais le meilleur est l'accueil, le sourire et la disponibilité de Dani! Un vrai plaisir et une belle rencontre! Je reviendrai sans hésiter.
Great place and great host! Highly recommended!

Warm and friendly welcome to a lovely home. I only stayed one night but my booking on short notice was well received and I felt very comfortable in the room. The hosts are lovely people and extremely helpful.
The room itself is very spacious and the neighborhood is close to the old town and many restaurants.
Would definitely recommend staying here; it's everything you expect from a superhost.

The experience was excellent! Dani and her family are amazing people and are here for any type of information you need on Geneva and its surroundings. I would definitely recommend that place to anyone traveling to Geneva (couples or individuals) looking for an extremely good value for money. The apartment is very clean and the room is spacious. This place has definitely everything you need for a pleasant stay.
I stayed only one night at Dani room. Hosts were very friendly, room clean and location was good.
Accueil souriant et très aimable. Les hôtes mettent tout de suite très à l'aise, et sont extrêmement serviables. L'appartement correspondait à la description de l'annonce, et tout a été parfait.

Daniela et son mari nous ont accueilli avec gentillesse et prévenance. Ils nous ont fourni tous les bons plans du quartier et du centre. Merci pour le thé et merci à leur petit garçon d'avoir joué et prêté ses jeux à notre enfant

Daniela y su familia son unas lindas personas. Desde el primer contacto con ella, se puede sentir la linda energía que transmite. ¡Su Casa es genial!; todo esta muy bien organizado. La atención que Daniela tuvo para con nosotros fue magnifica, siempre al tanto de nuestro bienestar. Es increíble encontrar la amabilidad y calor latinoamericano en Europa. Sin lugar a duda es un lugar que recomiendo al cien por ciento.

Daniela and her family are wonderful people. They helped before the host. And everything was amazing: the room, the conversations and the chocolate with brownie. Thank you for everything and have a good life.
Daniela e sua família são pessoas maravilhosas. Eles me ajudaram antes mesmo da hospedagem. Tudo foi ótimo: as conversas, o quarto e o chocolate quente com brownie. Obrigada por tudo e tenham uma ótima vida.
Everything fine! Jean-Luc is a very friendly host!!
Es ist keine große, aber durch den herrlichen Balkon sehr charmante Wohnung, mit allem, was man braucht. Sie liegt in Laufnähe zum Bahnhof und ist bestens angebunden mit öffentlichen Verkehrsmitteln.
Zum zweiten Mal. Ein sehr helles, schönes Zimmer !

The studio apartment was a great place to start and end the day during my week-long stay in Geneva. It is brightly lit by natural sunlight, surrounded by trees full of birds welcoming the springtime, and well-equipped with a working wifi, clean bathroom, and convenient kitchen. The bus connections to the UN and the city center are easily accessible a block or two away. Jean-Luc greeted me on my arrival and was a very helpful and accessible host throughout my stay. I recommend this studio to all who seek comfort, quiet and convenience in Geneva.

What a wonderful apartment and what a wonderful location! Perfectly located, easy to walk to buses and groceries (and a small shopping mall a couple of streets away), yet not a noise to be heard! A perfect combination. The apartment is sparkling clean, and the building is extremely well maintained. Gorgeous view of trees from apartment, and lovely to wake up to the fresh air and the sound of birds chirping every morning (where you can choose to eat on the balcony, very clean and with a peaceful view). Apartment is exactly as in the photographs. Bed is a fold out but as comfortable as a regular mattress. Kitchen is very functional, and the shower had terrific water pressure. Internet wifi is fast and without trouble.
Jean-Luc could not be more helpful. Extremely responsive by email or sms. Perfect host. I stay in Geneva often and have never had a better experience. I plan to return to Jean-Luc's apartment again! Thank you Jean-Luc!!
Wonderful! Just what I needed. Peace and quiet!

Jean-Luc was a fantastic host and gave a really nice welcome. I like the area very much - it's on a quiet street with a nice view of a field and trees. I had the windows and doors onto the balcony open almost the entire time. Had several dinner parties and it was a great place to host them. I'd love to stay there again.

I cannot say enough wonderful things about Jean-Luc! He was the perfect host! His home was just as he described, centrally located with easy access to public transportation, restaurants and market, very bright and airy, extremely clean and upgraded with a washing machine in the unit! The large balcony was the perfect spot to begin and end our days! My two teenage daughters and I were in Geneva for two weeks for a family vacation, and my eldest daughter (19) stayed an additional 4 weeks interning at the United Nations. While she was there alone, Jean-Luc made a point to be available to her for anything! He checked in with her to make sure that she was doing okay, and as a mom, I could not have asked for a more kind and thoughtful person. Geneva is a beautiful city, and the people are lovely, as evidenced by Jean-Luc!
Thanks for making our stay a memorable one!

Jean-Luc is super friendly and responsive. The area is quiet and accessible to grocery stores and the bus. It was very accessible to main city centre as well. I enjoyed my stay here and would highly recommend it!
Really nice studio. Well equipped, sunny, clean. Quiet location. Landlord always responded timely. Good location for public transport, shops, post office etc.
I’ve stayed in 4 air bnb’s in Geneva and this is the best one in terms of quality/cost. Great spot for a couple or business. Huge balcony, comfortable apartment, very clean
Very good location and apartment. If you were looking to stay somewhere for over a week and want to be central but in a quiet area, this is your best bet.

Great place, great location, great host.
Jean-Luc has been very kind and helpful. Highly highly recommended.

Nice and clean apartment with a spacious balcony. There's a washing machine in the apartment which is super useful for travellers staying for a longer time. Jean-Luc is very helpful and responds to messages quickly. Highly recommended :)

Très bon séjour! Jean Luc est à l’écoute, aimable et réactif. Appartement proche des transports en commun et d’un centre commercial, ce qui est très pratique!!!! Je recommande! (Je vous ai offert un grille pain 😉 )
Excellent AirB&B!
Jean Luc is a very good host.   We recommend his place.
Very quiet if you need to work during your stay. Very clean, a nice balcony with a view to the nature! (u don't believe you are in the heart of Geneva!). Close to myriad amenities
The place is really well located with good bus connections to the city centre and UN institutions. The supermarkets are close. The host is nice and responsive, ready to help! I enjoyed my stay

You can expect excellent hospitality, a superb location and amazing local neighborhood in Charmilles. The place is uniquely placed and walking distance to most important spots in Geneva, including Nations for those coming in for UN related work. Moreover despite being so central, it is nicely hidden. Fully equiped and practical set up. Enoy!
Great as usual. Very helpful hosts
Absolutely great as usual. Super host, great space, strategic location and charming Charmilles! Perfect in winter as well!
Superbe studio très grand avec une belle vue, très bien équipé et impeccable. Jean Luc s’est vraiment démené pour nous rendre service. Merci beaucoup !
Stylish apartment in a convenient and quiet location. Kitchen fully furnished for long stayers. Host responds to questions very quickly. Highly recommended.
Great stay.
Comfortable and clean studio, great location, and view. Great communication with host Jean-Luc. Fully recommended.

Couldn't have asked for more. Spacious single living / sleeping space with separate kitchen and bathroom. Balcony with a lovely view of the distant mountains and plenty of room to eat and chill. Good wifi. Great location - calm, with good access to the centre & organisations. Communication with Jean-Luc was clear and hassle free. Will try to book again next time I come. Thank you.
Great fully equipped apartment in an excellent location, quiet with a nice green outlook but very central. Nicer in reality than in the photos!
Hervorragende Unterkunft, hervorragender Service.
Excellent séjour dans immeuble calme et appartement propre avec vu dégagée( toutes commodités à proximité).Propriétaire réactif .

This apartment was perfect for my 2 week stay in Geneva. Beautiful and comfortable apartment with a perfect kitchen. Clean, modern, minimalistic space in a quiet neighborhood just 10-15 min walk from city center. The balcony view of the mountains is amazing. Plenty of restaurants, coffee shop, shopping just a short walk from the building. Highly recommend to anyone coming to Geneva!
Very comfortable place , location is very convenient.

Lovely place to stay, I was there for around 3 weeks and finally felt like home for the first time in a while. Was really sad to leave
Had all the amenities I needed, the bed was super comfy and the balcony was huge.
The area the apartment is in is really quiet and peaceful and a 15 minute walk from some lovely woodland along the River Rhone
Jean-Luc was a great host, friendly and readily available when needed

Amazing- perfect place for a stay in Geneva. The studio is spacious, comfortable and has everything you need. Transport to airport, centre, UN etc is so easy. Everything is in walking distance. Highly recommend!

Excelente studio remodelado a nuevo, con espacio suficiente y todas las comodidades necesarias para una estadía de casi tres semanas. Ubicado en un quartier menos céntrico y más tranquilo de Ginebra, rodeado de verde, pero al mismo tiempo bien conectado para acceder a la estación Cornavin y a todas las zonas. Edificio seguro y departamento con un balcón al jardín que permite disfrutar más de la estadía. Todo el equipamiento necesario estuvo disponible.
La comunicación con Jean-Luc fue fluida y amigable.
Estuve por motivos profesionales, pero el entorno y el studio facilitaron los espacios para ocio y descanso. Sin dudas, volvería a elegirlo. Muchas gracias

Jean-Luc’s studio was perfect, I had been his guest for two weeks. The studio is equipped with all essentials, a stove, oven, microwave, fridge, coffee machine, kettle, Iron, and washing machine, all of them very clean and look brand new.
The studio is small, but it was more than enough for s single traveler, and I'm sure it's fit for a couple or small families (2 adults and one child). It has a very good balcony size with chairs and a coffee table.
The studio is located in a very peaceful and quiet neighborhood and it's very close to supermarkets, restaurants, bars, and cafes.
The way to the city center is easy, and walkable distance (around 15 to 20 min.) and there are many bus stops nearby.
Jean-Luc is very helpful, friendly, and responsive.
In very few words, don't missed it.

The perfect home away from home!!! Jean-Luc had provisions for everything that is needed to have a comfortable stay. I did not have to trouble him at all for anything. I stayed for 10 days and everything was perfect.
My stay here was very comfortable and Jean-Luc was a very accomodating and available host

Jean-Luc's place is a really good find. Quiet location in the pretty St Jean neighbourhood with the centre a short walk and also close to nature down the Rhone valley. Everything was perfectly clean, nice layout, very responsive and helpful host, and good value for Geneva :). Balcony also has a great view. Would recommend!

Wonderful studio
I was really pleased with my stay.
The studio has been very well renovated, with new wooden floors and freshly painted walls. The bed bed was new as well and so comfortable ( I’m very demanding regarding bedding ) the furniture is efficient and of good taste.
The studio was in an immaculate condition with fresh bed linens.
Everything was there for my own comfort as well as a washing machine and a very good WiFi connection. The balcony is of good size and offers a panoramic view.
The situation of the studio is very convenient, central but very quiet and surrounded by greenery.
The district is safe with plenty of restaurants, small shops as well as a commercial mall.
The building itself is very well maintained and Jean-Luc a great host, caring and very professional.
One of my best lodging experiences
I greatly recommend
Best regards

Excellent apartment with everything I needed for a three week stay. Very comfortable, quiet and easy to get everywhere from, great location.
The apartment was really clean and tidy, sunny and with a great view of the mountains too. Thanks Jean-Luc.
I had a very smooth stay, would recommend.
Very nice and well equipped appartment at a great spot in Geneva. Very good connections to station and nice and close to the lakeshore. Lovely hosts, reccomended!
Lovely apartment in a great location. Very kid friendly, the hosts even provided us with a pack and play for our 1 year old! Plenty of room for two adults, a preschooler and a baby. Would stay again.

Lovely host! Lovely place in very central part of city. Lake, train station are in few steps, supermarket - in front of the door. We would recommend it to our friends and we definitely would visit it once again! Big thanks and hugs to Hortence =-))))

Very pleasant pleasant, spacious apartment that is exactly as pictured and described. Good location, bus stop directly across from entrance, within walking distance of the lake and of Cornavin, the main train station. Restaurants galore runnng the gamut from a place you can linger in to fast food.
The neighborhood, known as the Paquis, is lively and restaurants and bars stay open late. As in any urban setting, use good sense when walking around at night.
For those who wish to use their computer in the apartment, the only wifi connection is a public one provided by the city of Geneva, and speed and stability can vary.
I would stay in this apartment again.

The overall experience was very nice. Hortense is a very friendly, helpful and responsible host. The apartment is clean and tidy with well-equipped kitchen, spacious living room and bedroom, and hygienic bathroom - suitable for couple or small family. The location is great - 10-mins walk to both Cornavin (central train station), 15-mins walk to Lake Geneva, plenty of restaurants, cafes and supermarkets nearby (Coop, Migro & Iidl). I will definitely stay at this apartment if I travel to Geneva again.

Many thanks Hortense for having made my stay in Geneva very pleasant in your cosy apt. The apt was beyond my expectations, all in all an apartment with much charm and particular attention to details. I was glad to come home to a comfortable and well-equipped apartment at the end of each workday. The kitchen is very well equipped and I really appreciated the location of the apartment - could not have been better - with easy walking to many other areas of Geneva, and especially with two big supermarkets in front of the apt which I have made good use of. I felt like a local coming and going to my course, even if for 9 days. I will certainly recommend Hortense's apt as it's been a pleasure staying there and certainly one of my best stays at work. This made all the difference! November 2013

The location of the apartment is perfect. Very near to the train station, tram and bus stops, the lake, restaurants. Hortense was a good host and she responded to all my questions. The apartment is very functional. The description is very accurate. There is a 20 francs fee if you want to check in early.

Hortense's place was wonderful and she was so helpful and accommodating of my check in and check out times.  I loved the flat, wonderfully decorated, plenty of room, fantastic location, comfortable bed, quick wi-fi.  Could not ask for anything more in an apartment of hostess.  Nearby restaurants and grocery stores and close to central station and right off the lake. Thank you Hortense.

Hortense was a lovely host and the apartment was great--colorful, clean, well appointed. It is very centrally located, surrounded by a variety of restaurants and grocery stores and close to the lake. Public transportation is easily accessible. The apartment is on a square with outdoor dining that can be a bit noisy, but they mostly are the happy noises of people talking and enjoying themselves.

Great apartment. Very central. Funky (in a good way) neighborhood (Paquis). 2 blocks from water! Right across from 2+ grocery stores, bus stop, and lots of laid back restaurants. Hortense was extremely kind and helpful. The apartment was just as pictured and very clean. Would love to stay again!

This apartment is exactly like it is in the description and in the photo's. It feels like home almost right away. Very convenient location between the centre of town and the UN. It was perfect for our short stay. Location in the Paquis is very lively. Restaurants and shops everywhere!
Hortense was very helpful and waited for us even when we arrived later than expected. We hope to stay here again next time we are in Geneva.

This is a very nice place to stay in Geneva. It's a 10-minute walk to the lake; there are three supermarkets in the immediate vicinity; so many restaurants all around the neighborhood (Indian, Lebanese, Italian...); a walkable distance to the main train station. The apt is immaculate. We were asked to be quiet because of a "sensitive" neighbor. This was fine because we came in at night and fell asleep right away. Would recommend this place!

Apartment is nicely located between the train station and the lake. In a nice neighborhood with two supermarkets across the street and a dozen of restaurants offering international cuisine. Two bus stops just across the front door. Overall, location is great. Apartment itself is as described, well equipped and pleasant. On day of arrival, Hortense was there to welcome us. I could not retrieve her cell phone number from my email account but Hortense saved us by coming downstairs to the front door! Thank you!
Very nice place, great location.

Hortense Balme was lovely, we were very busy so there was not much time to visit, but she was there to greet us and make feel welcome to Geneva.  Before coming and in booking she was also very helpful.

Lovely apartment. Well located in lively neighborhood, close to the lake and the main railway station. Very clean. Hortense was very hospitable - she came to meet me at the airport to hand over the keys.

I really enjoyed my stay at Hortense's apartment. It's a nicely renovated, comfortable flat. Like with every apartment in Geneva, soundproofing is non-existent, so a good pair of earplugs can be handy!

Very nice homey apartment. Excellent location close to everything. Very well equipped with everything you'll need for your stay including small appliances, tupperware and spices.
Hortense was a very helpful and welcoming host. I would definitely stay there again.

Hortense was there to meet me at the apartment as we had agreed. Thanks. The apartment was excellent, just as described, very well equipped and truly right in the middle of a great little square (Place de la Navigation) with grocery stores, pharmacy, Laundromat (Laverie), and restaurants galore. Superb. It was really only a 10 minute walk to the train station. Can't wait to stay again. ANDY (Beth did not come on this trip to Geneva).
Appartement très agréable et fonctionnel, emplacement idéal, adaptation totale à mes horaires pour l'accueil à l'arrivée et pour le départ. Je garde une impression très positive de mon séjour.
Dani was a fantastic host that had plenty of info about the city. I was able to walk everywhere very easily and explore. Highly recommend
He let us drop off the bags early in the morning and offered to keep then through the next day. He is very kind and friendly.

Hello all,

Staying with Samuel was the greatest stay ever among my trips.

It is difficult to describe Samuel,I mean, all the positive ingredients one can expect in a host, I could find in Samuel! Nice , networkable, patience is one of his master key, polite, sociable, the list is infinite, you name it! Geneva must be happy to have him too! He makes me miss Geneva , I can't wait to come back and stay with him again! And have another hot tea with him, that's how he welcomed me !

So if you are looking for the right place and the right host in Geneva , that's Samuel you have to look for, I am sure that when you leave his place you will be enriched with culture and be global oriented!
I felt at home 100% of the time!

Allan - Brazil

Samuel war wirklich sehr nett und kommunikativ. Er hat mit mir eine Stadtrundfahrt in seinem Auto gemacht und mir viel über Genf erzählt. Er scheint ein sehr interessanter und vielseitiger Mensch zu sein.

A perfect place to rest after days walking the floors at the Geneva Motorshow. The bed was super-comfortable and the location was fine for getting to and from town an Palexpo. Samuel was a great host, too.

I felt really and immediately at home with Iris and her family. The room luminous, nice and clean was waiting for me with some nice friut juice and little sweets. I was warm and felt taken care of gently. I had all my privacy, I had my own very clean bathroom with a nice bathtube, soap, towels and hair dryer. She has been very precise with our appointments and helpful in every need I had.
It as been such a nice little stay.
Thank you so much Iris and Dorin.
I'll come and visit you as soon as I can
:)
Merci Iris pour votre hospitalité. Vous nous avez accueilli avec beaucoup de petites attentions et une grande sympathie. Séjour court mais très confortable. Au plaisir.

It was a great stay at Iris place with my friend. Iris is very welcoming and warm hearted. The room is clean with welcoming ambience. Her breakfast was like that of a nice hotel. Thanks a lot Iris ！ Wish you happy Merry Christmas.

Iris and her husband were  wonderful hosts. Nice house, just outside the Geneva was a perfect place to live in. Although the room was small, the hospitality of Iris will not fail to win your heart. The comfort of the traveller is quite taken into account by her. For us, it was a lovely beginning of our travel. We would definitely recommend others to opt for this on BNB.

My best stay in Geneva ever! This place is perfect for you if you are looking to stay close to Geneva center and have calm sleep in a very quiet neighborhood. The  house is located around 5-minute tram ride from the city center and about 1 minute walk from the tram stop. First time Iris will come to meet you at the tram stop so absolutely no problems finding the place. I really enjoyed the warm welcoming host and how she made me feel at home, at the same time providing excellent service, better than in some hotels! You will have a spacious clean bedroom, your own bathroom with wc and have some drinks and sweets in your room. In the morning a real home made breakfast is served at the time you prefer, so really I couldn't wish for more. And its important to say that sleeping in Geneva center is never same calm as you will hear all night long trams, cars and noisy people in the streets (especially at the end of the week..) so if you are a light sleeper this place is a great option. Iris home is for sure my preferred place for staying in Geneva and I hope to book with her every new time I will come, and can just recommend the same to you!

Séjour très agréable, Iris est vraiment charmante! On ressent son plaisir de recevoir et cette impression ne s'est pas démentie au long de mon séjour. J’ai été comme chez moi.
Merci encore Iris pour ce bel et chaleureux accueil et votre écoute et merci Dorin pour votre vraie gentillesse.
Another great stay in this oasis of peace and hospitality. Don't hesitate and book it!

Iris and her husband Dorin were some of the warmest people I met during the travel to Switzerland for 3 weeks. The whole experience starting from booking till departure was excellent. Iris was prompt in confirming my booking at the last minute, kind enough to offer fruits, chocolates, juice and water to welcome me in the room and to prepare a generous breakfast every morning precisely at the time I requested for it. They were also generous to offer fruits whenever I wanted. The room, nicely setup in the attic of the house on 1st floor, was very cozy albeit a bit smaller than I expected because I had lot of luggage. It was very comfortable nevertheless. The location of the house is just 2-3mins walking distance from a tram station which has service every few mins and a 20-mins tram ride connects you to the Geneva city centre, which can feel a bit far if you are there to experience the city life but on the up side the house is located in a very quiet area which was perfect for a night sleeper like me. In the end, Iris was very kind to offer to drive me to the airport.
Lastly, given that it was slight on the outskirts of Geneva, I was hoping it to be somewhat cheaper but with the kindness and hospitality I received, I left happy.
Iris est une hôte charmante et attentionnée. La chambre est bien tenue et calme ; la maison est rapidement accessible depuis Genève centre.

If you are looking for a charming, warm, intelligent, and friendly stay, this is your place. Very near to the center of town, yet in a quiet and peaceful neighborhood, you will receive a warm welcome, and stay in a cozy room on the second floor of this charming home. I highly recommend this host.

Iris is the most generous and charming host. You feel right at home the moment you enter. Chocolates, water and juice are in your room when you arrive...and an incredible breakfast is ready when you awake. By the time we left, it felt like we had been friends for years...The location was perfect for us. Close to the airport & short tram ride to the city center. Tram is a 2 minute walk form her door. Quiet neighborhood, parking available, close to transportation & great hosts.
Highest recommendation I can give!
enjoyed my stay
Very hospitable couple the breakfast was very nice and thank you for the drive to St Julian. We would return.

Iris was amazing! She met us at the train stop even though it was cold and late at night. Gave us helpful directions and met us at station and helped us find our way. Beautiful apartment, great location and the host did everything possible to make my stay as comfortable and easy as possible.

Hortense and her husband made a great impression. Their apartment is great - it has everything that's needed and is clean, bright and colourful, with lots of space. We will stay here again. Hortense's apartment was perfect for us.
The listing was more than accurate... the pictures make the apartment seem smaller than it actually is - it's got plenty of space for a couple or a small family (note: the second bed is a foldout in the living room kitchen) for a week or so. We liked the convenience of "living" in Geneva, so much cheaper than eating out for every meal, and much nicer when traveling with a young child. There are three good supermarkets within a two minute walk, bus stop right out in front, twenty minutes walk from the old town, ten from the main station.
We had stayed at the hotel about a hundred meters from this apartment before, so we knew the neighborhood. The courtyard/square in front of the building can be loud during the evening/night (seems to be a bit of a hangout for some folks), but with the rolling shutters down, it was much much quieter than when we stayed at the hotel previously.

Hortense was helpful, meeting us on time, providing us with two sets of keys (helpful when one spouse is working and the other is out and about), and full explanations for everything we needed. We didn't talk with her after the first day, but this was because she made everything very clear for us, including several guidebooks, and a catalog listing how everything worked.

Heat was fine, hot water was plentiful (shower is European and older, so Americans might find it small, but fitted with a nice new "rain" shower head), the kitchen was well stocked - including spices, pastas, and oils. Internet is very good, no problems when my wife was working and I watched a video. Locks and keys all worked well. No real interaction with neighbors (could hear occasional walking from apartment upstairs - but not at all bad, just city life). TV was basic local channels. Elevator is tiny by American (and even Japanese) standards, but it got us up and down with no problem.

One thing to note, this is not a hotel or a BnB, it's an apartment, so you do not qualify for the free transportation pass that are provided at Geneva's hotels and campgrounds... on the other hand, it is an apartment with a decent kitchen, at a much better price than hotels. Cook two meals at home, and you've saved much more than train/bus fare would have been anyway.

Hortense's apartment is indeed a cozy, comfortable and welcoming. I appreciated her coming to greet me on arrival.

Place was perfect. Clean, really convenient to the city and everything as easy as possible. Would definitely stay again.
