Beautiful apartment it has everything you need. Is very clean and so close lake! During night I recommend use earplugs to sleep better.

Hortense’s place is very centrally located on a square with many restaurants, coffee shops and bars. Close to the train station, lake and parks. The space is comfortable and stylishly decorated. Hortense was a great host meeting me to make checkin easy.
very nice place and super location highly recommended

Hortense’s apartment is right in the middle of Paquis area, which is really convenient for getting around. But stops right outside the door, short trip to the station and centre, supermarkets are right outside the door too. Bars, restaurants all nearby. If you need to be central for a week or so this place is perfect. It’s quiet given its location in a busy part of town, really clean and comfortable. Hortense is a great host - I had to extend my stay by a night and there was no problem from her side. Highly recommended.
Excellent host and apartment.  Merci!
Everything was as described and a great little apartment in a convenient location that worked perfect for my business travel!
Excellent location and a super reasonable price. Perfect for my time at the Geneva Auto Show.

Great location. Close to everything, especially 3 grocery stores. Bus stop is right outside.
Awesome amenities.
Great apartment in a very central location. Very clean and close to the water, as well as a short walk from the train station. Three grocery stores to choose from within a block!Loved it!

Luis’ flat is simply amazing! Light and quiet as well as elegant and practical. Cozy indeed. Located in the most exciting part of the city, close to the lake and the railway station in the lively and cosmopolitan Paquis, the flat is still exceptionally quiet. This was my second stay already. Highly recommended!
Nice space for work and relax.  several markets and restaurants within 1 minute walk.  It was about a full 10min walk from train station and 2 min walk to lakeside.
El lugar es como es se ve en las fotos. La ubicación es perfecta!
Great place and quite spacious.  Would happily stay there again.

A very well located apartment, right in the centre of Geneva, just seconds to local cafes and supermarkets, and just minutes from the lake. It suited my needs perfect for my short stay in Geneva with my daughter. A baby cot was also available which really helped me out. Being summer in Geneva, it was inevitably noisy with the windows open at night, but this is simply due to the extremely convenient central location. I’d recommend to others.

The apartment is completely lovely and as described. You can see from other reviews that guests had a good time here - close to the lake, great restaurants, public transportation, groceries, and a nice farmer's market on Sundays. The bed was very comfortable with really nice linen sheets. I do not like to complain at all but there were some issues with my stay that I imagine have been fixed by now, and only really apply if you plan on cooking - mainly, that the kitchen sink had a major leak so could not be used at all. This meant all dishes needed to be washed in the small dishwasher, which did not always clean them - therefore I sometimes was washing things in the bathroom sink. I was surprised the hosts did not offer me any discount considering the broken sink, especially since I was there for a whole week.  Also it's worth noting that the windows open to a square with very active nightlife - the restaurants just next to the apartment are open often past midnight, so you need to shut the windows for some quiet and can still hear the sounds. I quite enjoyed the activity, but it's not the best for light sleepers. The bathroom and shower were very clean, comfortable, and functional. Thank you!
This place is amazing! It's close to everything. The check in and check out was great, very easy without any problem. Everything you need is in the apartment. I enjoyed staying there. Thank you!

I stayed for a week at Louis’ place. Very nice apartment, clean and in a very perfect location.
Instructions were very easy to follow and so was check in&out.
highly recommended !
As advertised. Excellent location.

I stayed here for a week during business travels and I couldn't have asked for a better stay. The location is perfect in the Paquis and I was able to walk to the international organizations every day to get to the office (~20 minutes). The flat itself has a lot of charm and beautiful decorative details. Communication with the hosts was easy and they were very generous by giving me a bit of flexibility with check in/out times. Would definitely recommend and stay again!
Great apartment with everything you need and a great location with buses right out front and tram 5-10 min walk. There is also a supermarket just across the road.

The apartment has a perfect location, in a charming square near the lake. It is very comfy and convenient.
PS: I forgot a coat at the apartment and Louis was very helpful in ensuring I got it back (thank you!)

This sunny apartment was a lovely base for us in Geneva. The location was perfect for exploring the city by foot or on public transportation. Close to international agencies where we worked. Lots of restaurants and cafes nearby and two grocery stores right outside the front door.
It was big enough for two of us, though the pull out couch for my guest was pretty squeaky as those beds tend to be. The kitchen is well equipped with induction cooktop and microwave but no oven. The owners were very responsive, getting back to us quickly on a Tuesday evening cooking question.
Given the overpriced luxury market in a Geneva, we thought the value and quality of this friendly space was excellent. A real find!
Bright apartment, very comfortable and well equipped! Hortense was a lovely host with great communication. Location is convenient and lively and central place to have as a base whilst in Geneva.
Nice and easy stay by Iris and her husband. The house is well located, the room perfectly furnished and the atmosphere warm. See you !

I really enjoyed stay in Iris' s house. She and her husband are such nice people, very kind hearted. Iris even made breakfast for me and gave me the grape in their garden. Everything makes me feel like at home. The room I stay was clean and cozy. Love it!!! And it's very convenient to go to their house from downtown,  line 14 few stops from the train  station. I wish I can visit again!

I really appreciate my one night stay at Iris house, she was constantly communicating with me on the phone before my arrival to be sure I don't get lost on my way there.
She will also prepare you a great breakfast (with juicy fruits from her garden).
Really kind person, she even drove me to my appointment early in the morning.
Clean and tidy, the bedroom matches the pictures !!!!

For the traveler who just needs a place to sleep after being out all day, this place is perfect. The room is small but cozy and the bathroom clean. If you would like to have feel-like-home experience with a warm Swiss family I'll definately recommend you stay at Iris's.

lieu très calme avec une accessibilité à la ville très aisée grâce au tram,Des personnes très ouvertes et accueillantes.

Although it was a really short stay in Iris's place, I feel the warmth and comfort altogether from Iris and the home. The room was clean and comfy. Iris is a friendly and responsible host as well where she even wait for us till midnight for our very very late check in. Love the stay <3

This is a great place in a great location. Located in a square, it is convenient to train and bus stations and the beautiful lake. Three grocery stores and early morning meat, cheese, and fruit/veg vendors guarantee you can prepare your meals in the apartment and avoid the higher costs of Geneva restaurants (but restaurants are also close by).
Our main cons are that the towels for the bathroom were small and threadbare, and the shower door did not close well (it opened fine). In the bedroom, there are no privacy curtains at the window - just a sheer curtain that is easily seen through and does not block sun. Also, when the bathroom light is on, the opaque wall between bath and bedroom lets a lot of light into the bedroom. Having said all that, it's still a great place to stay in Geneva. We would definitely stay again.

Louis’s apartment was great! Location is only 6 mins away by the metro from the airport and less than 10 minutes on foot from the railway station. It’s on walkable distance from the port and close to the old town. We were 3 adults and 1 baby and Louis provided us with a crib. The apartment was spatious enough for all of us and was equipped with all the necessary amenities :)

Appartement très bien situé et facilement accessible avec ascenseur. Instructions très claires de l’hôte. Lieu propre et fonctionnel, spacieux. Tout est fait pour passer un bon séjour et ne manquer de rien !
The location was good, close to the center. Many restaurants right in the square where the apartment is located. 2 supermarkets opposite the location.

Louis was very friendly and responsive to our requests. The apartment is located in the center of Pacquis, which is both near Lake Geneva for a nice stroll (from where you can easily access the city center on foot) or take a Tram to access the various international organizations located around Nation. The apartment is located near lots of different restaurants, which was convenient for us with a baby, since I could run down and get some food while my wife stayed with the baby (or vice-versa). There is both Coop/Migros (supermarket) near by and a bus stop that takes you to the train station in case you need to get there quickly (otherwise its only a 10 minutes walk from Geneva main station).
Louis Fue muy amable estuve siempre atento en todo mi viaje, definitivamente volvería a quedarme en su apartamento

Pros
1. Location: perfect location for those who love to walk! 5 minutes to the Lake, ~12 minutes to the main train station, 3 markets(Coop, Migros, Denner) nearby, a bus stop and small fountain park right in front of the house, ~20 minutes walk to old town, ~30 minutes walk to WIPO
2. The house itself: it was very cozy and clean! It has cute paintings and cute ambience!!
Cons
1. Bathroom: shower booth is a little small but it was okay. But it smells something bad so you need to cover up the drain. And the sink could have been cleaner but well,, it was okay.

L‘appartement en lui même est calme, on n‘entend pas les voisins - ce qui est rare pour Genève, par contre la place sur laquelle donne le logement peut être bruyante, surtout en soirée/nuit les weekends. Mais avec des boules quiès, c‘est tout à fait possible de passer des nuits reposantes !
Merci aussi à Louis de sa communication claire et cordiale ! Je recommande !

It's a bit far from the city if you're walking but accessible easily by tram. Dorin is super friendly and was really helpful and thoughtful :) definitely recommend !

Nous étions contents de pouvoir trouver un logement à Onex même, le parking est apprécié, on a pu nous rendre à pied à notre destination. L'endroit est vraiment au calme et entouré de nature, ce qui était très apprécié. Le rapport qualité/prix est très intéressant pour cette région en général hors de prix. L'acceuil était chaleureux, et Iris et Dorin serviables et communicatifs. Nous avons été bien acceuillis, merci!
Cosy small room. Very good and pratical  if you visit Geneva for fun , a bit unconfortable for business purposes if you wear man's suits and ties, no wardrobe niether in the room or common areas.
Ein kleines einfaches Haus mit sehr netten Gastgebern in einem ruhigen Quartier mit grossen Gärten und trotzdem ganz nah bei der Tramhaltestelle.

Les hôtes sont très gentils et leur maison est bien située : tout près du centre-ville en tram, mais vous avez vraiment l'impression d'être à la campagne. La chambre est propre et comprend le nécessaire, cependant on s'y sent un peu à l'endroit. En résumé je dirais que ce n'est pas un endroit idéal pour un séjour prolongé mais que ça fait très bien l'affaire pour qui cherche à passer 1 ou 2 nuits à Genève avec un petit budget.

Great hospitality, nice and relatively quiet house a bit away from the highway. Rooms do not seem to be very large but well and big enough to do your thing for a few days. In the area, I can recommend this place to anyone.

Iris and Dorin are lovely people. Their house is situated in a beautiful area, close to the tram stop. The room was spacious, clean and comfortable. This is a great place to stay at and I would recommend it!
Great location and friendly hosts.

Iris ad Dorin are wonderful. I spend 1 night. They allowed me to do the check in earlier since I arrived in the morning.
The location of their house is perfect, very close to the tram station.
Iris answer my questions very fast.
During the morning they offered me breakfast.
If I come back to Geneva again I will stay with them

Do not hesitate to stay with Iris and Dorin!! If you are lucky, you will get a private concert like I did!!!
Wonderful home, and amazing hosts
집에 옥탑방에서 잤는데 두명이서 캐리어를 펼치고 자기는 좁았지만 침대도 크고 푹신해서 하룻밤 묵기에는 부족함 없었습니다! 다만 오뤠된집이고정원이 있어서글언지벌례갸좀있었고스파이더같은 것들이있었어요 집도 너무 예쁘고 주위도 조용하니 좋았습니다 집주인분들이 너무 친절하셨어요ㅎㅎ 감사했습니다!

Ich war für eine Nacht zu Gast. Das Zimmer ist recht klein und schlicht, aber für einen kurzen Aufenthalt wie bei mir hat es seinen Zweck voll erfüllt. Das Frühstück war ebenfalls sehr schlicht (Brot, Butter, Marmelade, Kaffee/Tee).
Der Check-in war sehr unkompliziert. Ich wurde freundlich empfangen und die beiden haben sich sehr hilfsbereit gezeigt (z.B konnte ich mir spontan das Bügeleisen leihen). Die Unterkunft ist ruhig gelegen, allerdings ist man dank der kurzen Entfernung zur Tram (weniger als 5 Minuten zu Fuß) für meine Begriffe auch recht schnell in der Stadt. Im Ergebnis kann ich die Unterkunft gut weiterempfehlen.
Beaucoup de verdure et de calme... l'impression d'être à la campagne ! Merci pour l'accueil

Habitation située dans une zone très calme à proximité de Genève, très facile à trouver et bien desservie par le tramway, j'ai passé une excellente nuit dans une chambre agréable et pittoresque. Contact avec des hôtes très sympathiques.
lieu calme et proche de transporte publique. J'avais eu un jolie séjour chez Iris un Doris.
Emplacement très pratique pour les transports publiques. Hôtes très sympathiques. Le lit est légèrement petit en longueur si vous avez de longues jambes.

Iris and Dorin were both so kind and welcoming, I really felt at home here.  Their house is in a very convenient location,  just 3 minutes walk to the train.  The only issues I had were that the attic bedroom had a very low ceiling- I bumped my head on it a couple times, so anyone taller than 5'3'' will have to be careful.  Also, the lock to the back door needs to be replaced- my key didn't work but I was lucky that someone was always home.  Great value and location despite these issues.

Einfaches, kleines Zimmer. Nichts für Großgewachsene, da das Bett unter der Dachschräge steht. Bad war ok.
Die Gastgeber sind nett und zuvorkommend.

ダブリンの中心から少し離れていますが、トラムの駅からすぐでした。干渉はされませんが、質問には丁寧に答えてくれて助かりました。最終日の夜は、親切にもアコーディオンを弾いて聴かせてくれて楽しかったです。
可愛くて安心感のあるお家でしたが、寝室が少し手狭なのと布団の匂いが、個人的には気になりました。全体としてはとても良いです。
I had a lovely stay at Iris and Dorin's house. The hosts were very friendly, helpful, and communicative. The room was clean and the bed comfortable.

Un accueil chaleureux vous attend chez Iris et Dorin. Tous deux ont le sens de l'hospitalité et si vous avez l'occasion d'embrayer une discussion sur la musique avec Dorin, vous voyagerez entre monde Divin et philosophique. Vous ne verrez plus jamais la musique comme des notes écrites noir sur blanc suspendues à une portée...
Very welcoming hosts, very clean, easy check-in, good communication.
Excellent accueil et séjour.

Valeriè è stata davvero molto gentile e disponibile nell'aspettarmi fino a tardi per consegnarmi le chiavi. L'appartamento è nuovo ed è in una posizione fantastica, con vista lago dal divano nell'entrata/cucina. L'appartamento corrisponde perfettamente alla descrizione ed è ideale per rilassarsi e dedicarsi un pò di tempo.
Great location, perfect lake view and generous hospitality of Valérie.

Valerie was a polite, hospitable and considerate host, meeting us when we arrived and making sure that we had settled in and knew where everything was.
The view of lake Geneva is truly stunning and we enjoyed sitting and eating out on the terrace. The apartment was clean, quiet, comfortable and well fitted out with an excellent kitchen, a large bedroom and bathroom(with washing machine and dryer), a television and wifi.
There is a small beach at the end of the lane where you can swim off the rocks if the weather is hot. The delightful local village has a well stocked grocery store,coffee shop and restaurants. There is also a local vineyard which has open days when you can sample and enjoy the local wines.
There is a bus stop directly in front of the property should you wish to travel back into Geneva or head over the French border to the beautiful villages adjoining the lake or the mountains beyond.
Many thanks to Valerie and her family.

Warm reception, good bed, fantastic breakfast. Took a few minutes of wandering to find her building but glad when I did. Lucia had fresh linens and a big bottle of water awaiting me in the room. Big, comfortable bed. Mostly quiet (being on the ninth floor helps). Good breeze made summer visit nicer. Excellent spread (especially if one has not yet acclimated to European breakfast of croissant & coffee). You could pay more and get a lot less than Lucia's. I recommend this room without hesitation.

L'accueil est chaleureux, le lit bon, et le petit dejeuner grand. J'ai promené pendant quelques minutes avant de trouver l'appartement mais j'ai profité bien après j'y suis arrivé. Lucia avait mis une serviette propre et une grande bouteille d'eau dans la chambre. Le lit est grand et confortable. La chambre est, pour la plupart, au calme (elle est située à 9ème étage). La brise fait du climat agréable en été. On peut payer plus et recevoir moins que la chambre chez Lucia. Je la recommande sans hésitation.

Fabulosa. El apartamento de Lucía está muy bien situado y conectado con transporte público. El apartamento es espacioso y cómodo. La habitación cuenta con todas las comodidades y es muy cálida. Lucía es encantadora y una estupenda anfitriona, muy considerada. Ha sido un placer estar en su casa, donde me he sentido casi como en familia.

This was my first AirBnb stay, so i'm not sure exactly the standards, but I enjoyed my stay and really liked the host Lucia.  The room was very comfortable, quiet and had plenty of closet space.  The bathrooms were clean, the water hot, and there was a decent selection of fruits and yoghurts and breads for breakfast.  Lucia was very kind.  Two things to consider.  1 - though she has strict non smoking rules, the other guest was clearly smoking inside his room and/or the bathroom.  The smell (not to mention the cigarette butts in the toilet) was unmistakable.  2 - Lucia doesn't give you a key to her door, so you need to let her know when you are going to be coming back.  It never proved a problem at all, but just something to know.
We really enjoyed our stay with Lucia, she was a great host very flexible and accommodating to last minute changes to our trip. The apartment was very clean and tidy I would recommend to anyone.

I booked Lucia's room for my coworker who was traveling to Geneva for the annual auto show. He said "She’s lovely, very helpful, the place is nice and clean, everything was great." We don't send people to Geneva often on business so I really appreciate how easy Lucia made the whole process. Would recommend for friends/coworkers traveling in the future.
I had a great stay with Lucia. Very friendly and helpful. Lovely quiet apartment. Highly recommended.

Lucia’s  apartment is spotless the kitchen and bathroom facilities are first rate . The bedroom is spacious and the bed very comfortable, the location is very close to the bus routes. Lucia has a very friendly and accommodating demeanour

A great stay. The apartment is in a great area, and the room is clean and comfortable. Lucia was a wonderful hostess. She got back to me quickly with all the information I needed and she made me feel very welcome. I highly recommend staying there.

I want  to thank Lucia for the wonderful experience I had staying with her in Geneva. She was indeed a very warm, thoughtful host who took care of the little details, as well the the overall stay which was very comfortable for me! Even the little things like welcome tea, breakfast, the missing bathmat and the reading lamp in the room, which was provided very quickly :) The family dinner was a wonderful evening spent together and great time discussing world experiences. Highly recommend to all who are visiting Geneva for a quiet and peaceful place to stay and a great host indeed! :)
Lucia was a wonderful hostess and helped my friends to have a wonderful host home experience in Geneva. Thank you so much!!!

Lucía ha sido una estupenda anfitriona. A pesar de no habernos conocido personalmente, en todo momento ha estado pendiente, dispuesta a ayudar en caso necesario. Sin duda, recomendaría su alojamiento a familiares y amigos

Lucia's apartment is exactly as she describes it. It is really clean, bright, comfy and very well located, close to bus and tram lines. She complements with such a wonderful calmness and easy demeanour which made for rich conversations and a very relaxed stay, despite my busy schedule. Would go back in a heartbeat!

I stayed with Lucia for almost a week on business. A bowl of fruit was welcoming me in the room, which was very nice and appreciated. The place is extremely clean and very quiet. The area feels secure, shops are just around the corner and it is very central. The host made very attempt to make me feel "at home". It may be slightly difficult to find the place the first time, but I can only recommend it.
Great location, lovely room,  clean and quiet.  Really enjoyed my stay.  Lucia and her family are so warm and welcoming.  Fantastic hosts.  Would definitely stay again.

Lucia's home is just as nice as in the pictures.  She was very welcoming and had fresh fruit waiting for me in my room.  The breakfast was fantastic, and it was nice to eat dinner on the balcony on nice evenings.  Thank you Lucia for the wonderful and comfortable stay.

Fantastic Room with private bathroom. Very well located and close to main public transports that leads you to the city center.
On top of that Lucia is a fantastic host, she makes you feel at home.
I have to say that on top of all that breakfast are amazing! I will totally recommend Lucia, and whenever I come back to Geneva i will definetly repeat my stay at Lucias' House.

It was my first trial of airbnb and I believe it would be one of the best trials! Lucia is a really nice and friendly person. She waited for my boyfriend until 12:30 in the evening! (Because we had a late flight to Geneva) I still can't believe it! She is the most incredible and multicultural person I have ever met. Lovely breakfast, lovely smile, lovely place. The place is well located, quiet and lovely. I would love to recommend it to everyone.

Lucia was very hospitable from the time I walked into her lovely home and throughout my stay. I was very happy staying in her home - it is beautiful, comfortable, clean - the bedsheets, the room, the bathroom and whole house is so clean! It had a warm family atmosphere and a good spread of breakfast. Lucia is friendly and very helpful and we had some nice and good conversations. I had a nice bedroom and the pleasure of making myself feel at home. The neighbourhood is safe and quite well connected. Thank you Lucia..definitely a place to come back again! What you see and read is what you get....and a big dose of hospitality.

I again - the third time - had a wonderful stay at Lucia's apartment. She is a gracious hostess and Rosario is a wonderful housekeeper.
The apartment, including the private room and bathroom, is spanking clean, nicely appointed, light and comfortable.
The balcony with nice seating is the cherry on the top.
The location is convenient and everything is close by.
Being selfish, I hate to do this, but I highly recommend.

10 Stars for Lucia and Rosario and the appartment in Geneve.
Everything was very, very clean. Bathroom and the sleeping room got cleaned evey day. The Towels and sheets were soft and smelled fresh nice. The breakfast buffet was great and really enough to statisfy everyone needs. WIFI was working.
The location between the city and the airport is great. So easy to get around in Geneve from there. The Tram is 2min walk away and #Nr 14 + 18 are running almost every 5 min.
Lucia is so friendly and a warm host. I really felt like beeing part of a family.
I highly recommend everyone to stay there.
The dream team Lucia and Rosario made me laugh after a long day at work.

Lucia is an exceptional host, gentle and helpful. She helped me to discover Geneva with her tips and kindly attention. She and Rosario gave me all assistance I needed all the time.

Her house has a quiet and peaceful atmosphere where I could relax after a day walking throughout the city. The bathroom and my room were very clean and private from the house. During the breakfast, I could experience her friendliness and interesting talking when I had a deep impression of taking part of the house.

I’m very thankful to Lucia and Rosario for my peaceful and pleased stay in Geneva.
Lucia was a very pleasant and welcoming host
Great stay. Great facilities, location and hospitality.  Shall be back again.

Lucia's place is well-located in a quiet neighborhood and well connected to public transport. I enjoy the nice breakfast they offer and the morning chats before leaving for work. The whole apartment is clean and cozy. Lucia and Rosario are helpful and kind people. They really made me feel at home! :-)
The stay was excellent. Lucia is very hospitable. Everything was satisfactory
Once again my stay at Lucia's was very comfortable and pleasant. Nice facilities, good location and Lucia is a gracious host. I shall be back.
Lucia, thank you so much for your hospitality. The accommodations are really perfect. An absolute recommendation to all, who are visiting Geneva.

Lucia was a wonderful host. So much so, she probably the best Airbnb host I've ever had. This was my second time using Airbnb internationally in an unfamiliar country. She was very quick and accommodating in her communication, offered easy directions using public transportation to her home from the main train station, welcomed me for dinner with the family and guests, and gave me great directions and a map to use when exploring Geneva the following day. Lucia is a very sweet and caring woman. I'd love to stay with her again!

It's really a good place for your stay. It's with a nice location, quiet neighborhood, clean environment, and the most importance, the host's hospitality. I do believe you will feel staying at Lucia' place is like staying at home.

It was wonderful for staying with Lucia and her family. She is a warm hearted and pleasant. You could feel like home in her apartment. The location is superb, easy to catch several bus and tram. I strongly recommend.
Kind and respectfull hostess, clean and cozy appartment, friendly environment, lots of books. Totally worth it.

Estuve un mes en el apartamento de Lucía por trabajo. Me sentí como en casa y Lucía siempre tiene un rato para conversar contigo y hacerte recomendaciones sobre la ciudad.
La ubicación es perfecta, caminando 20 minutos llegas al centro y sino está muy bien conectado con buses y tranvía.
He valorado mucho las normas de la limpieza de la cocina, de esta manera siempre te lo encuentras limpio y despejado para cocinar y la siguiente persona también.
Lo recomiendo para estancias largas.
good place to stay
Comfortable, Clean and fully equipped!

We ended up getting upgraded to this planpalais apartment as a long-term renter took the smaller one and it was great. Within steps of the 12 and 15 tram and across the street from a great Sunday Market. The only downside is that this apartment is totally set up for long-term renters rather than short-term and is totally clean of everything except the furniture and pots/pans in the kitchen (i.e. no soap, no salt/pepper, no oil, only 1 roll of toilet paper).  Just be prepared to head out immediately to get some bare essentials - which is easy as there is a Coop just around the corner.

The apartment was just perfect for what I needed! Arrival and departure worked very well and uncomplicated. The apartment was clean and fully equipped with everything I needed. If you want to be close to the city (easily reachable also with public transportation) but be in a quiet and truly beautiful surrounding this is your place. I can only warmly recommend it.

We enjoyed our stay in Anières – Valérie was friendly and always available if needed. The flat was nice and even more as on the photos, close to the lake and beautiful Anières beach, comfortable and pleasant. We would definitely stay there again! Thanks, Valérie!
We had a very good stay. Everything with the apartment was super nice, the small village was lovely. Valerie (the host) was really helpful. We would really recommend this to others.

Valerie is an excellent host and her house is indeed very pleasant with a view over the Lake and the possibility to walk down to the lake in a couple of minutes for a swim. Apartment is clean and has all amenities needed for long (washing machine etc) or long stay. What's more important is that Valerie made me feel welcome from the start.
appartement idéal en tout (fonctionnel et vue), à 30 min du centre en bus. Accueil cordial, juste parfait

The beautiful view is exactly as advertised.  The room is clean and bright.  The bathroom in our room was small but functional and clean - don't know if others are larger.  Parking is right off of a busy street (and I mean right off - you must back in or out directly from or into traffic, so its a bit tricky.)  There are several flights of stairs to get to the rooms,  but if you can handle the stairs, the gorgeous view and host Valerie's hospitality are definitely worth it.  Valerie, is very kind and helpful, speaks good English, and is very knowledgeable about the area. The breakfasts are large and high quality,  with homemade breads, pastries and yoghurt.  All very, very nice.

L'accueil est très chaleureux, Valérie a su s'adapter très rapidement à nos désires.
L'appartement est très agréable, bien adapté et très propre!
Produits d'accueil et fruits nous attendaient dans la chambre pour agrémenter le séjour.
La vue sur le lac est très agréable et l'emplacement est proche du débarcadère d'Anières.

L'appartement de Valérie et sa famille est tout à fait conforme à la description faite. La photo présentée est bien la vue de la terrasse de l'appartement. Valérie est présente, par téléphone, SMS, email etc. pour laisser toutes les informations utiles et rendre le voyage pleinement satisfaisant. Les "plus" de cet appartement sont une vraie personnalisation, loin des locations 100% business où l'hôte n'existe que de manière virtuelle. Ici la famille de Valérie habite juste à côté et elle sait se rendre disponible. J'ai aussi apprécié l'attention d'un réfrigérateur avec eaux, lait, de la machine Nespresso (avec capsules), des fruits frais etc. ce qui permet facilement de prendre son petit déjeuner sur la terrasse si le temps le permet ou à l'intérieur sur les sièges hauts, d'où on profite également de la vue. La salle de bain équipée permet de faire lessives et séchage sur place lors des séjours plus longs. La décoration est de bon goût et de qualité, et le Wi-Fi marche très bien. Enfin, comme annoncé par téléphone, il est très facile de se garer juste à côté et il y a même un transport en commun pour rejoindre Genève Centre. En conclusion un très bon séjour avec des hôtes délicats et disponibles. On en redemande.

Firstly, Valerie was incredibly helpful and always available to answer our questions. My fiancé and I stayed at her lakeside apartment for the 'wind-down' portion of our trip, and it was perfect for an easy-going and romantic getaway. Waking up every morning to the amazing view of the sun hitting the waters of the lake and the mountains in the background is something neither of us will ever forget. It's a short, two-minute walk to a nice little lakeside picnic area where you could also swim in the summer (too cold in fall).

The apartment is conveniently located yet private. It's a short 15 minute drive from Geneva center in good traffic, so a rental car will help. If you do not have transportation, there IS a bus route to and from Geneva but it would take much longer.

The apartment itself was very modern and very clean. Everything from a washer and dryer, to the refrigerator, microwave, and dishwasher were usable and clean, and there was also a TV provided and WiFi for those who strive to remain connected at all times.

Valerie and her family were very quiet and accommodating, and I would most certainly suggest staying here to anybody (if for any other reason, the pricing is unbeatable for everything you get).

Thank you Valerie for making our engagement trip unforgettable!

très bon accueil à l'heure prévue par Valérie elle même
appartement très confortable et correspondant à la description avec la surprise de trouver un lave vaisselle et des douceurs
la vue sur le lac est aussi belle que sur les photos et le lac très proche
ce village résidentiel proche de la ville de Genève est accessible par les transports en commun relativement peu fréquents mais la ville est rapidement atteinte en voiture
le séjour- cuisine est grand et très bien meublé, la chambre et la salle de bain sont grandes elles aussi et tous les meubles sont récents, la literie est de qualité
tout parfait :-) merci beaucoup et une autre fois

Stayed here for two night and was just what I was looking for. Great location in Anieres and the bus stop behind is fantastic to get into the city centre nice and easy! May I also say how pleasant it was to have a bottle of milk, water both still and sparkling and lots of coffee on arrival, nice touch!

I booked the apartment of Valerie for my parents. They had a great time at her place and Valerie cared a lot for them, she was easy to reach and make it so comfy for them how it was poosible. It was really great!
I visited also the apartment and the view was breathtaking! Really nice, calm and still close to the center.
They liked it a lot and they will come again. Thanks Valerie for the nice weekend!!!

A warm welcome from Valerie, a congenial hostess who speaks perfect English. The apartment is on the ground floor of a small modern residential complex. It is downstairs from Valerie's apartment, but completely separate and quiet. Entrance is via a garden/pool area, and a flight of stone steps that make this inappropriate for people with mobility issues. But for most people this a great place to stay in the Geneva area, with a great view of Lac Leman from the apartment and the patio table just outside.

Inside, everything was modern and clean. Valerie thoughtfully left us milk in the refrigerator, and coffee, tea and small chocolates made us feel right at home.

Parking is up the hill and across the road in a public area, but it's very close. One of the surprises of Anieres is the several gourmand restaurants within walking distance of the apartment. We had an excellent meal at Le Cafe de Floris.

Close to downtown Geneva and the Airport, it is a great alternative to a Geneva hotel.

Valerie was very attentive prior to our visit and although she was out when we arrived she arranged for her mother to welcome us. The whole family are delightful, the view stunning and the apartment comfortable. Valerie arranged a sunshade for us and was accommodating on our final day when we had a late flight. Her mother Claude gave us some seeds from her lovely flower bed. We certainly recommend the apartment.
sehr schöne unterkunft, ganz nahe am see!

Logement spacieux calme très bien équipé, bonne literie. Proximité du bus pour Genève. Parking très proche pour la voiture. Disponibilité de Valérie ou de sa mère pour l'installation. Gentilles attentions pour le premier petit déjeuner et délicieux chocolats. Et comme sur la photo une vue magnifique.

Great apartment with stunning views over the lake.
Very peaceful and quiet location.
Fantastic shower!!!
Few metres from a bus stop direct into Geneva.
Highly recommended.

I couldn’t have picked a more perfect place to stay on our first trip to Geneva.
Super comfy place that felt like home the minute we got there. In short walking distance to restaurants, small market and just steps to the bus stop. We bought a week bus pass and traveled all over Geneva using it. Go north a few bus stops and you can walk into France—with a fabulous Italian restaurant on the way!! The view is spectacular from the property with the big windows inviting in the sunsets too! We loved it!!

Excellent appartement avec vue sur le lac. L'hôte Valérie a été charmante et le check-in s'est fait sans aucun soucis. L'appartement en lui même est grand, propre et agréable à vivre.
Je conseille vivement!

Die Unterkunft war genau wie beschrieben in einer wundervollen Lage mit Blick auf den See. Die Bushaltestelle ist 2 Minuten entfernt mit einer super Anbindung an Genf. Im Ort gibt es eine kleine epicerie für das Nötigste. Wir waren 4 Nächte dort und haben uns sehr wohl gefühlt.
Vue magnifique, lieu paisible, logement conforme au descriptif et acceuil sympathique de Valerie

The apartment is stylish, comfortable and very well resourced, with a great view over Lake Geneva. It's a short walk away from the Lake itself. Valerie welcomed me warmly in very good English, explained everything and then left me alone to enjoy it. There was space outside to hang washing and to sit, with the sun reaching there in early evening (July).The accomodation is situated a few kilometres outside Geneva, so, away from the  crowds. However, it's also just off the main road with frequent public transport into Geneva itself. It is within walking/driving distance of Hermance, and so close to the boarder with France. We would be very happy to stay there again.

Merci à Valerie et sa famille pour ce séjour. L'appartement est conforme au descriptif et agréable à vivre. Cette maison permet à chacun d'être indépendants.
Je recommande !
Amazing view on the lake. Cosy place and friendly people. Well equipped, including washing-machine, dryer and dishwasher along with the washing products. Good organisation.
il posto è eccezionale.  la locazione perfetta come nelle foto. valerie molto cordiale e gentile
The place is what we expected. We enjoyed the relaxing atmosphere.
Apparemment très confortable, exact à la description, avec une vue magnifique sur le lac et les montagnes

Anières est une location merveilleuse et l’apartement est très confortable et très bien équipé. La vue sur le lac est exceptionnelle. Notre séjour etai vraiment agréable et Valérie est un hôte très gentil.
Lovely apartment with a great view over the lake

Le séjour à Anieres chez Valérie a été simplement ravissant éblouissant par certains de ses aspects comme ce panorama qu 'on a , à partir du salon et de la terrasse . Une roseraie magnifique avec une pelouse attrayante surplombant la piscine, le tout face au bleu mythique du lac dominé par les cimes verdoyantes du Jura.
Et le calme et la sérénité, Je n'en parle pas !
une semaine de rêve bénéficiant par ailleurs d'un confort très satisfaisant
En partant avec regret on se console en se promettant d'y revenir...!
Omar et Mama.
Bon logement, beau quartier

Overall, Jurgen was an excellent host. He was very easy to access when I picked up the keys to his flat (according to my flight schedule). The flat was extremely clean and tidy when I entered. The flat itself was spacious, with a very comfortable living room to relax in. The location was very central and well-connected; it was also in the most lively neighbourhood in Geneva (Plainpalais), which made it easy to grab a pint or a glass of wine in the evenings. Even though it is close to the night life of Geneva, the evenings and nights, even on a weekend, was quiet enough for rest.

Jürgen's apartment in Carouge was a perfect set up for me. It is very from downtown and to a nice and vibrant Geneva lifestyle. The apartment was clean and organized. Jürgen met me in person to hand over the keys and give me all the information necessary on the apartment and what to do in Geneva (very good idea and convenient for tourists). In general I had a good stay at Jürgen's apartment, he's a great host.

Jürgens Wohnung ist in einem sehr guten Zustand und gut ausgestattet. Es ist gut möglich im Wohnzimmer zu schlafen, sofern zwei Schlafplätze erforderlich sind. Sowohl das Bett als auch die Liege haben eine sehr gute Qualität.
Der Wohnungsstandort liegt nahe dem Stadtzentrum von Genf. Die Straßenbahnhaltestelle ist nahe dem Hauseingang - ebenso viele Läden und Supermärkte für den Tageseinkauf.
Mit der Nachbarschaft hatten wir keinen Kontakt.
Jürgen ist ein aufmerksamer Gastgeber - er bat darum u.a. in der Küche, alles zu nutzen, was für uns erforderlich sei und hielt außerdem Tipps zur Stadt bereit. Für unseren Kurzaufenthalt war der Aufenthaltsort richtig gewählt.
Herzlichen Dank, Klaus und Max
The place is very nice. Centrally located and close to everything in Geneva.
This place was fantastic - great location, clean, and very comfortable. Jurgen was very responsive and helpful in extending my stay. I would definitely stay again!

Perfect place for a stay in the center of Geneva. It is big, clean, quiet, convenient ( shops, tram and bus stops, everything is really next door)
I enjoyed my stay.
Jürgen is a caring host, very easy to communicate with.
Thank you !
We enjoyed staying at this apartment in Plainpais; very well located and close to public transport. It is at basement level so no stairs to climb! Neat, clean, and quiet. A good choice.
Tout était parfait ! De l'accueil au départ ! L'appartement est très bien situé, très propre et très confortable ! Merci beaucoup First
Great apartment in a cool part of town. No problems with the logistics and Jurgen was very responsive via email and text.

The apartment was great. It's conveniently located near a tram stop, which made getting around town easy. The apartment was also clean and had everything we needed.

Because of schedules, Jürgen wasn't able to meet us, but his instructions were very clear so we had no problem finding the keys. He was a great host and he was easy to communicate with.
Sehr schöne und gut ausgestattete Wohnung, toll gelegen im lebhaften Viertel Plainpalais. alles hat wunderbar geklappt - Danke Jürgen!
Sehr gute Lage, hübsche Wohnung und alles so wie abgemacht gelaufen. Top!

Great big, clean flat, super centrally located.

Had everything I needed and Jürgen made it extremely easy to check in and check out. The flat's central location is a win as we needed a well located place but bear in mind its on the main road and the noise of trams, bars, cars and from the flat above may disturb some.

All in all, would completely recommend staying here if you want a hassle free, great value for money comfortable flat.
Very good communication from the host and extra helpful when required.

L'appartement de Jurgen est très bien situé au centre ville. Les trams et les commerces sont à proximité. C'est un peu bruyant mais tout a fait supportable et normal quand on est en plein centre.
Jurgen est un très bon hôte. Je recommande son appartement

Appartement bien localisé, très propre, fonctionnel. Échange avec Jürgen agréable et précis. Je recommande.
Merci Jürgen
A very pleasant stay! Beautiful flat. Great location
Sehr sauber, gemütlich und gute Lage

Everything went perfectly well! Even though we never met, we were able to easly access the appartment with his very clear instructions. The location was pretty amazing as well. Thanks very much for having us!
The place was very nice and cozy!
Excellent location and walkable from the old city as well. Amenities are available nearby. Jurgen was very helpful and responsive to our queries!
Nice flat, quick communication, close to supermarket & public transport, clean => good plan

Jürgen's place was perfect for a quick 3-days trip to Geneva. It's ideally located next to shops and tramways and is very easily reached from the train station.
The apartment itself is comfortable with a large real bed, huge sofa and everything you need to cook in the kitchen.
As previously said by others it can be noisy as trams run directly under the windows, but with shutters and windows closed we slept well and were not disturbed.
I recommend the place to discover Geneva as we did :)
Appartement bien situé , propre à recommander

Le logement est agréable et fonctionnel. Il y a beaucoup d'espace dans le séjour avec un grand sofa canapé où il fait bon lire. Je n'ai pas utilisé la cuisine, mais elle était très bien équipée. Le couchage était confortable, il manquait juste une petite touche : la couette (une personne) n'était pas à la taille du lit.
Les explications données par Jürgen étaient d'une précision exemplaire. Je n'ai eu aucun souci ni à l'arrivée ni au départ.
Le logement est très bien situé sur une rue très commerçante (très pratique), et une ligne de tram qui va au centre-ville et dessert plusieurs directions.

La experiencia en la casa de Jurgen no ha sido para nada positiva. Empezando por la falta de comunicación y que no nos indicó como acceder al apartamento ( gracias  a la atención al cliente de Airbnb pudimos ). La casa estaba sucia, con polvo de no solo de días, sino de semanas. Bater sucio y algunos azulejos de la bañera estaban pegados con cinta adhesiva. La televisión no funcionaba, ya que no tenia conexión a la antena. Positivamente he de decir que está bien situado, la calle está llena de restaurantes y supermercados y además el apartamento tenia a disposición una gran variedad tés y cafés. La cama y el sofá son amplios y cómodos. Teniendo en cuenta las disculpas de Jurgen y si mejorase la casa en limpieza, podría recomendarlo.
Je recommande l'appartement de Yurgen sans hésitation.

Muy bueno departamento muy bien ubicado y decorado.
El sillón grande es muy cómodo para dormir. La ubicación genial con el Tramway al lado.
Comunicación muy fácil y buena con Jurgen!
Gracias
Good value for money. Central location, next to tram stop and supermarket.

I stayed at Jürgen's place for around 10 days while I was working in GVA as I preferred having my own space rather than staying in a hotel. Jürgen's place is in the middle of one of Geneva's most lively neighbourhoods and really well connected to other parts of town, including Carouge, which is 10m away. The apartment is more functional than cozy, and you'll be able to cook, do your laundry etc as it's pretty well equipped. While clean, I found that the photos in the add made the appartement look a bit better (no plants etc) and certain pieces of furniture have probably had better days.
That being said, for GVA standards it's really good value for money and Jürgen provides clear instructions and answers your queries rapidly.
If you're looking for simple accomodation at reasonable prices ar one of GVA's most interesting neighbourhoods, this is your place.

Jurguen es un muy buen anfitrión, siempre estuvo pendiente ante cualquier consulta. El departamento es muy cómodo, tiene todo lo necesario para pasar unos días tranquilos en Ginebra. Asimismo, está muy bien ubicado, y cerca a las estaciones de bus y tram. Súper recomendado!
Good location and well price/cost relation
Great apartment in central Geneva that is very fairly priced.

This is an amazing flat and host!I have stayed for a month and enjoyed it very much. Natalia is very helpful, kind and assist with anything. It was really good to also have city guides and brochures ready in the flat to see the city. The location is very convient and quiet, the bus stops 2mins from the house and takes you to the airport or to the city centre. I would recommend this flat to anyone. Thank you very much Natalia!

Hosts are great! They left fridge with snacks for me. There is nespresso machine with capsules in the apartment too, that is very neat. Apartment is completely new, entire furniture and kitchen equipment looks new and not used. Owners were very helpful, they lend me an umbrella too provide me with free transportation card for entire city.

Très bon accueil, comme d'habitude. Natalia et son mari sont des hôtes très accueillants et chaleureux. Le logement est propre, bien situé à 2 pas de Genève, et très calme. Bref, un très bon séjour !
A bientôt.
C'est un des meilleurs endroits où j'ai été. Les photos sont conformes à la réalité ! J'ai été touchée par la gentillesse, l'hospitalité et la générosité de Natalia !

Natalia was a wonderful host. She waited for me at home when I arrived and she drove me around town to show me how to reach the place where I was supposed to go the next days. She bought some food for me (and chocolate!) as on Sunday shops are closed in Geneva, and bought for me (and my guest) the card for the public transports in Geneva (and I stayed 5 weeks!).
The house is located just in the outskirt of Geneva, but with 10-15 min walk (or 2 minutes bus) plus 10-15 min of tram you arrive easily downtown. The area is very safe and there are supermarkets, restaurants and other shop at walking distance. The flat is nice, new and cozy. Definitively recommend it!

Natalia's Airbnb is exactly as it is pictured in the photos. All appliances are brand new and the flat was extremely clean and comfortable - all at a reasonable rate. Natalia herself was kind and generous, which made my stay have an "at home" feel. I arrived on a Sunday and she even stocked the kitchen with various necessities so that I would have something to eat! The neighborhood is nice and safe and easy to get to via public transportation. Overall, I had a great stay and highly recommend this Airbnb to anyone!

Natalia and her apartment are a great combination! The accommodation is as shown, clean, modern and perfect for 1 or 2 people. Natalia was a wonderful host and all the little touches she put in place really made my first airbnb experience one to remember. The apartment is clean, tidy and modern yet cosy. I was a little concerned what the bed was going to be like but can confirm that it was very comfortable.  The apartment is slightly out of the city centre but this does not matter with the public transport just around the corner and takes no more than 20 minutes or so to the centre. Would certainly recommend

L'appartement est très fonctionnel et très bien entretenu. Natalia est très attentive et propose des petites attentions très pratiques et qui font plaisir (boissons, nourriture, tout les produits de base)
Natalia est une hôte très disponible et s'adapte aux besoins de chacun. La communication a été très facile et précise avec Natalia.

Natalia a été très accueillante et chaleureuse. Son appartement est très joli, fonctionnel et propre.
Elle n'hésite pas à aider ses hôtes, je recommande vivement !

Un séjour parfait du début à la fin. Cela a commencé avec les petites attentions (chocolats, vin...). Studio très lumineux et fonctionnel... Très bien équipé : lave vaisselle, lave/sèche linge...  Quartier calme ! Merci encore Natalia pour votre accueil.

Excellent logement, très pratique, très propre, très bien équipé et décoré avec goût. Les déplacements sont grandement facilités par la présence toute proche de transports en commun.
Natalia est vraiment une hôtesse très gentille et très serviable.
J'ai passé un excellent séjour, encore merci Natalia !

Natalia is a great host. The apartment is very nice and clean. Everything in the apartment is functioning very well. Public transport is easily accessible from the apartment. It does not take long to get from the apartment to the center of Geneva. We were staying 4 nights at Natalia's apartment. We will definitely recommend Natalia's apartment to everyone.

Fantastique! C'est exactement comme sur les photos, de grand confort avec équipements modernes, et d'une propreté immaculée. Les hôtes sont très, très accueillants, beaucoup de petites attentions, genre provisions au frigo et au garde-manger. Tout est comme à la maison. Supermarchés à 10 minutes à pied, Cornavin en 30 minutes en bus/tram (hyper facile). Quartier très tranquille. Fortement recommandé!
Fantastic! Exactly like on the pictures, very comfortable with modern appliances, and extremely clean. Hosts are very welcoming, a lot of little things like food/drinks in cupboards/fridge. Feels like home. Supermarkets 10 minutes on foot, Cornavin an easy 30 minutes by convenient and frequent bus/tram. Very quiet neighborhood. Highly recommended!

Un apartamento moderno, limpio, agradable y muy confortable. Está a unos 20 minutos del centro de Ginebra con transporte público que, además, sale gratuito gracias al bono que facilitan los establecimientos en la ciudad. El trato es inmejorable.

C’était vraiment super propre et agréable
Merci pour l’acceuil

Wonderful host. Wonderful flat!!
Our best airbnb experience by far.
Spectacular apartment and we (2 ladies) felt very safe and private. We will definitely be back upon our return to Geneva again someday! :-)
One of the best hosts that I have ever had on airbnb. Very helpful and everything I needed was provided. I had a great time there.

Our stay at Natalia’s studio was mine and my wife’s first stop in Switzerland as part of our 5-week honeymoon vacation. Check-in was very easy, and we had a nice walk-through of the property with our host, Natalia. The studio was very clean and there were many thoughtful and welcoming amenities made available for our use upon our arrival. The studio is a very welcoming and cozy space with a thoughtful design. Bus stops and grocery stores are very easy to access from the property, and public transportation gets you into Geneva and surrounding areas with ease. We had access to everything we needed, and it was very clear to us the effort and care Natalia puts into providing an outstanding property. We were thoroughly pleased with our stay and will gladly visit again. This property and its host provided a wonderful experience for us and we highly recommend this gem for future travelers!
Our employee was there for 1 month and she was super happy.
L'accueil était remarquable, tout ce qu'il faut pour se sentir comme chez soi ! L'endroit est calme et reposant. J'y reviendrais volontiers !
I recommend 100%. I stayed in this studio during 4 weeks and it was great! Silent, well located, clean, well equipped and Natalie is kind and respectful. I would like to return soon.
Excelent host, clean and cozy, for me the location was perfect, because is near to the company's office. I had very pleasant stay and strongly recommend to all!

logement correct

We stayed here together with my two colleagues during a one-week business trip in Geneva.

It was a nice cosy, two bedroomed, away from home. The place had free wifi, was very clean and had everything we needed.
There are several eateries around and a convenience store very close by.

It is a 5-minute walk to the tram station and the bus stops, thus, it was very easy and convenient for us to move around.

I would recommend anyone looking for an affordable short stay place in Geneva. Thanks, Dimitri!

We are happy with our stay at this apartment.  It is conveniently located.  It takes about 10 minutes to get to the city center by bus.  The bus stop is a minute away.  There is also a convenient store that is open late hours.
Es war alles perfekt.
L'appartement est bien situé, propre et confortable.

Wir haben die Wohnung für eine Geschäftsreise genutzt. Die Wohnung war sehr sauber, bequem und gut gelegen. Es gibt Parkplätze in der Nähe - sehr wichtig in Genf. Der Vermieter war immer erreichbar hat Fragen rasch beantwortet.

très bon accueil, clair par Dimitri qui est vraiment efficace et sympathique. Appartement très propre et grand pour 4 personnes. Proximité des magasins d'alimentation

Touristic flat, well equiped.

Excellent appartement et extrêmement sympa de s´être accommoder à mes horaires. L´appartement est très bien situé et très bien équipé.

L'appartement est très bien situé. Il est dans le centre-ville et proche de plusieurs arrêts de transport en commun. Il se situe très près du pavillon Mail de l'Université de Genève ce qui est très pratique pour les étudiants. L'appartement était propre et la personne responsable du ménage venait régulièrement (chaque vendredi). Dans l'ensemble, c'est un bloc d'appartements plutôt calme.
Par contre, nous avons trouvé qu'il manquait quelques éléments pour un long séjour. De plus, il faisait très froid dans l'appartement...
Aussi, nous nous attendions à nous faire accueillir par le propriétaire comme le laissait sous entendre plusieurs commentaires. Malheureusement, personne n'était là et la clé n'était laissée que dans le casier postal. En 3 mois et demi, nous n'avons jamais su à qui nous louions cet appartement. Nous avons donc dû communiquer par courriel pour des informations qui sont assez importantes (ex : gestion des déchets). Bref, j'ai trouvé très dommage de ne rencontrer personne pour notre arrivée.
Fantastic location with easy access to lots of different buses and trams. Near lots of grocery stores. Safe and quiet building.

The space is clean and very large, equipped with a washer and dryer as well which was very helpful. Additionally the kitchen is stocked with everything you need (pots, pans, plates, etc.). The host was helpful and check in and out was very easy, though responses to questions took some time. I would definitely recommend the space to someone staying in Geneva for an extended amount of time!

First of all, the good things: Dimitri was very efficient to accept the reservation for a quite long period with very short notice and the apartment has all the things you'll need even for a long stay. The location is also very convenient, near the center and with a couple of market at short walking distance.
Then, unfortunately, the bad things: it was not very clean, with dust and hairs in the bedrooms and bathroom and some greasy pot and forniture in the kitchen (we considered this being because of the short notice reservation and we did clean everything without complaining), but especially the apartment is VERY loud, having a bedroom near the building's main door, slamming all day and night, and near the mailboxes, the elevator and the stairs to the recycling room; basically, you'll hear all day and night long the doors slamming.
We wrote immediately to Dimitri about it, and he answered (always after a lot of time and only after many messages) that he'll try to switch our apartment with some other that he is managing. Not having results for some days, we asked him and planned to leave after 2 weeks total (instead of the 6 that we needed), the amount that he wanted to charge us as minimum stay.
After a week, he gave us the key to an apartment on the 5th floor of the same building, writing many time that we could stay there for the second (and last, with him as a host) week, but the day after he called us, saying that the landlady needed the apartment and that we had to move back to the loud one. We didn't understand how he could have us move to that apartment without having the landlady knowing about it at first!
After many troubles and after opening a claim with airbnb, we decided to rent a different place, from a different host, for the rest of the period and we left before our check out date.

Maysoon was a great host ! The apartment is big and comfortable. It is also very well located, at a walking distance from Geneva center. I particularly appreciated Maysoon's flexibility in making arrangements to get the keys. I highly recommend staying there !
A fantastic place to stay with everything as described. Natalia was an outstanding host and ensured everything was perfect. Highly recommended and I wouldn't hesitate to return.
Natalia is a great host and her studio is realy nice and cozy place. Were you will find everything you need for a pleasant stay in beautiful Geneva.
Amazing place with even more amazing host. Really nice interior in the apartment and regular cleaning. Natalia really takes care of all the details. I am glad I chose her place.

Perfect as usually.
I recommend it.
The place is very good and comfortable. The host(Natalia) is a very responsive and nice person.

Perfecto para estancias tanto cortas como largas. Funciona bien todo. El jardín privado viene muy bien para relajarse. Los vecinos son muy amables y respetuosos y el barrio en primavera huele a jazmín. Natalia nos recibió en persona y nos aconsejó perfectamente. Siempre se adelantó a nuestras necesidades y estuvo accesible en todo momento. Volveremos en cuanto podamos. El apartamento está muy bien amueblado incluye todo lo necesario.
