The studio is a bit tucked away in a quiet neighborhood, but once you find it you will appreciate the quiet in the evenings.
I would give 10 stars if i could! Everything about the stay was amazing, lovely studio and extremely welcoming hosts. I will be back :)
An excellent place and an excellent host. I had a longer stay,  but enjoyed all of it. The studio had everything I needed, and I absolutely loved the small garden.

The studio offers complete privacy in a peaceful residential area. All amenities are available to settle for a long stay. The welcoming gifts from the hosts and their constant support throughout my stay made it exceptional.

Natalia is super friendly and easy to communicate with. Also very thoughtful of her to include some snacks (fruits & coffee etc) to make my stay more homely! i particularly love this area because is quiet and private.

Un immense merci à Natalia et José qui ont été on ne peut plus accueillants et d’une gentillesse inqualifiable. Ils m’ont proposé un logement parfait, extrêmement bien entretenu dans un quartier paisible et très agréable au quotidien. Mon séjour chez eux fut très agréable et je les remercie pour tout ce qu’ils ont fait pour mon confort et mon bien-être. Je les recommande vivement !

Ho trascorso tre mesi nell’appartamento di Natalia e José a Ginevra per motivi di studio, e non avrei potuto desiderare un’esperienza migliore. La loro accoglienza e disponibilità mi hanno fatto sentire come in famiglia fin dal primo giorno. Natalia si è sempre dimostrata pronta a rispondere a ogni mia necessità, con un’attenzione e una cura davvero invidiabili.
L’appartamento è perfettamente organizzato, dotato di tutto il necessario per un soggiorno confortevole e curato nei minimi dettagli. Il quartiere è un piccolo gioiello: tranquillo, residenziale e ben collegato al centro di Ginevra, che si raggiunge in soli 20 minuti con il tram 15.
Consiglio vivamente questa sistemazione sia a chi viaggia per lavoro sia a chi si trova a Ginevra per turismo. Grazie a Natalia e José, la mia esperienza è stata eccezionale e indimenticabile.

I think 5 starts is not enough to describe how good we felt. In my opinion, the place someone’s stay is important and the place was exactly how it was described; clean, good smell, cozy, smart TV, renovated and peaceful. But for me the thing that really stands out was how kind, welcoming, present and available Natalia and Jose were. I felt like I have been knowing them since years and she treated me as I was her son. Trust me, the words I will put in this review will never be enough. I hope I will be back to see them again, and I recommend everyone to have this BNB revolutionary experience.

Natalia et son mari sont des hôtes absolument charmants. La communication a été fluide, l'accueil très chaleureux et nous avons été touchées par leurs délicates attentions. Grâce à cette location, notre week-end a été encore plus mémorable. Nous recommandons sans hésitation !

I stayed at Natalia's apartment for almost one month and had an absolutely wonderful time. Natalia and her family were very nice and kind to me. They went out of their way to make sure that I was comfortable and felt at home. I truly appreciate everything they did for me and would love to return :)

L'endroit était parfait, Natalia et José ont était super avec moi, ils ont même pensé a me laisser 2 ou 3 trucs pour que j'ai puisse me faire a manger a mon arrivée. Le canapé lit pour moi c'était comme un vrai lit, très confortable. Sincèrement je n'aurai pas pu trouvé mieux. Merci Natalia et José j'espère qu'on ce reverra.

Un super endroit ! Je recommande ce studio à 100%. Les hôtes sont adorables et très accueillants. J'ai passé un séjour génial. Le studio est très accessible en transport et dans un quartier très paisible. Encore un grand merci Natalia !
Great flat: central with quiet neighborhood; cosy atmosphere; designer furniture. We felt at home!

My friends and I spent 4 wonderful days in this apartment. The apartment is exactly as in the pictures, clean, cozy and vintage. The location is excellent, close to all the main attractions. There is a large supermarket, pharmacy and favorite restaurants near the house. And most importantly, close to the main station. We walked to all the main sights, we didn't use city transport.
As for the hosts, Fanny & Thibault are very attentive, answering all questions in a timely manner.
We will definitely return to Geneva and will only stay at their place.
This apartment made our trip to Switzerland very cozy and unforgettable.

Fanny à été très clair dans son descriptif pour accéder au logement ce qui est agréable pour arriver en toute sérénité, et gros plus nous avons pu avoir le logement à 11h00.
Bien équipé pour visiter Genève l’emplacement est parfait.
En revanche, le matelas dans la seconde chambre, la plus grande, mériterait je pense d’être remplacé car creusé.
Appartement très bien placé, lumineux, spacieux et joliment meublé, communication très facile et efficace: à recommander absolument!
Fanny was responsive and friendly. The appartement was good value for money.
We had a really lovely stay in Geneva. This apartment was gorgeous and comfortable. Many thanks!

Abbiamo trascorso un soggiorno eccellente in questo alloggio a Ginevra. L’appartamento era impeccabilmente pulito, arredato con gusto e dotato di tutto il necessario per sentirsi come a casa. La posizione è ideale, ben collegata ai mezzi pubblici e comoda per visitare la città, il lago e le principali attrazioni.
L’host è stato estremamente gentile, disponibile e reattivo, fornendo istruzioni chiare. Abbiamo particolarmente apprezzato l’atmosfera tranquilla, il comfort del letto e la qualità generale degli spazi.
Consigliamo vivamente questo alloggio a chiunque visiti Ginevra, sia per lavoro che per piacere. Ci torneremmo senza esitazione!

After just one short day in Geneva, I can honestly say Fanny’s apartment made my stay even more enjoyable. The apartment is beautifully designed, spotlessly clean, and exceptionally well maintained. Every room is tastefully furnished, creating a warm, elegant atmosphere while still feeling practical and comfortable. One of the highlights was Fanny’s amazing collection of plants, which brings so much life and character to the apartment. They are clearly cared for with great attention and make the space feel fresh, peaceful, and truly unique.
The kitchen is fully equipped with everything you could need, the bed is exceptionally comfortable, and the apartment is bright, quiet, and welcoming. Its location is excellent, making it easy to explore Geneva while offering a relaxing retreat after a busy day. Communication with Fanny was outstanding from start to finish. She was friendly, responsive, and made check-in and check-out completely effortless. Highly recommended. 5 star accomodation

Angela was a fantastic host, and the apartment was very comfortable for my 10-day stay. Very modern, clean and nicely furnished apartment in my favorite neighborhood in Geneva, with great cafes, bars and boutiques just steps away.  Easy access to the center of town as well. Angela runs a contemporary gallery across from the garden, so she is great for advice on the art scene in Geneva and Genevois life in general!

Angela and Daniel's garden flat was absolutely gorgeous. A very quiet and comfortable place in a great location.
They were both extremely welcoming and accommodating to my uncertain arrival time, and explained all what needed.
I couldn't recommend the place better.

Angela and Daniel were truly the best hosts. They made everything so easy and were wonderful about communication. The house itself is beautiful and extremely comfortable - there is a full kitchen, very reliable internet and a TV with lots of dvds. The space and garden are even more beautiful than what is pictured and it is very clean and well maintained. Angela and Daniel also went out of their way to make sure I knew how to navigate the tram system and they were extremely kind and flexible about check in/out. The house is wonderfully located and Carouge is beautiful and very charming. This was a wonderful airbnb experience!
Angela and Daniel are wonderful hosts. They are frindly and helpful. The house is beautiful and there is no better location in the Geneva area to spend a few days. Simply fantastic.

Everything about my stay was wonderful. Angela and Daniel were amazing hosts, and did everything they could to make me feel welcomed and comfortable. Daniel met me when I arrived and got me settled quickly. The first things I discovered was that the flat is far from the main road and on the other side of an interior garden so it is super quiet--there is no street noise at all! Second the garden is a beautiful addition, which makes the place feel charming and natural. The flat is an independent quarters--a studio--that has been recently remodeled with very modern fixtures and great taste. Everything was ultra clean, the bed was comfy--just perfect for my weeklong stay where I had to do some writing.

Angela welcomed me to take some herbs from the garden for my cooking...she's really got a green thumb and was lovely to talk to.

The Carouge neighborhood is one of the most charming in the Geneva area. It is filled with so many restaurants and little shops. It's a bit more expensive than other areas, but if you look carefully, you'll find places that are affordable. It has a small town feel--and there's a Migros a less than a minute a way. Lots of public transportation right out the door.

Although there's no washing machine, there's a laundromat just next door.

Don't miss a haircut with Fred at "Autre Chose" two doors down. He's got guitars and and a piano there which he plays and will let you play too! Tell him Steven sent you :)

I would surely stay there again, and highly recommend the place, which provides great value--such a beautiful flat in such a great place owned by fantastic caring people.
Such a great experience with Angela and Daniel. The garden house is beautiful and in perfect location. We absolutly recomend.

Angela and Daniel were welcoming, kind, and responsive hosts, and also demonstrated good flexibility when I needed to extend my stay. Their garden house is truly a standalone suite with everything you need, modern, comfortable, and located in the heart of old Carouge. A terrific Airbnb stay.
Accueil chaleureux, décoration soignée, on se sent chez soi

Angela & Daniel sind sehr herzliche Gastgeber. Die Kommunikation ist einfach und sehr schnell. Wunderschönes Häuschen, toll eingerichtet, herrlicher Garten und ruhig gelegen. In der Nachbarschaft gibt es viele kleine Cafés und Läden. Der öffentliche Verkehr ist in 1 Minute erreichbar. Was will man mehrn bei Angela und Daniel wohnen.
Ich war innert kurzer Zeit 2x bei Angela & Daniel. Wunderbares Häuschen, liebenswerte Gastgeber, Ruhe und trotzdem ganz nah der Stadt - einfach hinreißend.

By far my favorite AirBnB stay! I could go on and on but I won't, in the hopes it will be available next trip! The only problem is, it is so relaxing here it makes you want to just stay in! The garden is the highlight. And Daniel and Angela are the nicest people.

I spent two weeks at Angela's and Daniels place and highly recommend it on a number of levels. They are wonderful hosts and immediately make you feel at home. I arrived to a fabulous block of cheese and fresh grapes that they thoughtfully arranged as I arrived on a Sunday and shops are closed. This friendliness and warmth was consistent during my entire stay...( They even arranged for tickets to a local play when I expressed interest - sadly was unable to attend) There also have a wonderful herb garden and they offer fresh herbs on request. They are truly great people with very interesting lives and great to chat with.
They place is extremely comfortable, and well equipped. It is a quaint cabin/cottage/guest house at the back of their property with a private entrance to the street which allows one to come and go. There is a garden to sit and relax in at the end of the day. It is extremely relaxing and comfortable.
I traveled to the OMS/WHO each day and loved the commute....two direct routes via #18 and 8 which both run frequently form outside the door. This time and distance ( 30 mins - 15 to train station) was not an issue but rather became a joy as their place is an neighbor that is unlike downtown Geneva. I appreciated the transition from the hustle and bustle of work to the vibe and tranquility in this artisan community. There are great shops, bakeries, pubs and close conveniences as laundry and groceries. The most comforting is the "grounding" of family in the area - the sounds of kids laughing people living their lives - one feels as if they are at home.
This is a great place, run by great people and in area that is most relaxing. I would highly recommend it and the hosts to anyone spending time in Geneva.

The apartment is well located and well connected.
The apartment seems to be a running house but probably was unattended for past few days.Personal things and books/ papers were scattered in the living room. The apartment, though a good one wasn't really very clean. The floor was sticky. Fridge had some unpleasant odour.
Otherwise, the apartment is nice and very spacious. Beds were comfortable. Bathrooms had all the expensive and branded toiletries. Trusting guests to use and misuse such expensive stuff is possible when someone has a genetous heart. So kudos to the host !! But , we used our own things :-)
We did face wifi problem as well.
Though we could not mert the host but he ensured that we were received by someone at the apartment to guide us.The check in and check out was smooth.
Would like to believe that issues we faced were not regular ones and are exceptions.
Hence Recommend this place :-)
Jitindra

personne tres agreable mais si je ne l ais pas eu en contact direct.l appartement est tres bien situer (dans la rue juste en face du ponton du jet d eau) au dernier etage avec petite terasse bien sympathique.l appartement est tres grand avec une grande chambre, une mezzanine et un grand salon

L'appartement était très grand et bien situé. Nous n'avons pas rencontré l'hôte mais nous pouvions facilement lui parler par courriel. Il y avait énormément d'effets personnels dans tout l'appartement ce qui nous mettait moins à l'aise, mais pour une nuit c'était correct.

First of all, I want to say I found the host very responsive as I booked last minute and she was flexible with our time and the key exchange.
This is a great loft on the top floor of a very nice old building. It is a big apartment with enough space for up to 4 people. The beds are very comfortable. The house was clean and had more than enough essentials (soap,tissue,sheets,towels...). It seems the host or someone lives in the apartment as there are lots of stuff in the house but this is not a problem as you have enough space for your suitcases and clothing(maybe not enough space for hanging them but you can hang clothes on the chairs in the living room). The sofas are also very comfortable.
The kitchen has a microwave and a boiler which we found useful.
There is a bus station 3 min away which is good if you don't want to walk everywhere. Bus #9 and then transfer to tram 12 which will take you to the center of high end shopping and in the direction of the old town. It will only take 20 min to walk to the old town.
Overall, this was a great experience. I would recommend this place as it is in a great location with cafes and restaurants nearby and also clean and spacious.
P.S. the house is better than the pics!
The apt is very clean and pretty. It's well positioned in Geneva. I'll come back there absolutely!

J'ai passé très bon séjour à l'appartement de Maysoon, elle est très accueillante et sympa.
Le quartier est parfait, à côté du lac et le centre ville ainsi que l'arrêt du tram et bus.
L'appartement est lumineux,je me suis sentie comme à la maison.
Merci Maysoon.

Great landlord. Good comunication.
The apartment is fantastic, good located and big enough for 4 people. We were there for a weekend and we enjoyed our visit. The apartment was clean and got everything we needed.
Just 5 minutes walking to the city centre, the apartment is good located, safety area and with some restaurants around.
Really nice experience in Geneva although we didn't see our host. The location is really good and it was on the top, which was really nice!
Appartement très confortable, bien équipé, à 2 pas du lac. un excellent séjour.

It was convenient that we were able to get the keys on our own so we did not have to coordinate check in/check out time. The listing was exactly what it said from online, although it was definitely better than the pictures made it look. Great location and great views. We were happy with the experience.

Alojamiento muy bien situado y con buena comunicación con el aeropuerto.
Maysoon nos ofreció una buena disponibilidad para la entrada y salida con todas las facilidades. Recomendaria este apartamento a mis amigos si van a visitar Ginebra!

El apartamento tiene una ubicación muy buena, es un apartamento maravilloso, estuvimos muy cómodos, fuimos 4 personas adultas.
Las camas son muy buenas, se duerme muy bien. El apartamento es muy acogedor y te hace sentir como en casa.

Hay un gran centro comercial a 100 metros. Muy buenas comunicaciones y las vistas desde el piso son buenas, además tienes el Jet D'eau muy muy cerca.

Nuestra anfitriona estuvo pendiente nuestra en todo momento y fue muy flexible con el check in y el check out. La única pena fue no conocer a la anfitriona.

Tuvimos una estancia maravillosa y disfrutamos mucho de Ginebra.
Si volvemos allí repetiremos sin duda.

Maysoon is prompt in her responses and also very accurate when it comes to providing directions to her place. Her house is in a good and safe locality and has very decent access to bus and tram locations.
Great apartment! Really worth the price. Beautifull rooftop terrace!
Very good location and spacious, nice apartment,  good wifi connection. Very flexible and adoating to our needs on check in and out. Thanks
very nice flat, very cozy
The apartment was very nice, cosy and clean, it is also well located, we had a very pleasant stay!

Quartier très agréable , proche du lac , possibilité de se garer. Très bien placé, calme ,on peut tout faire à pieds. Appartement spacieux qui a du charme et agréable avec sa petite terrasse. Très bien pour 2 couples. Une des chambres est en mezzanine et est très petite, l autre est grande. Nous n avons pas rencontré notre hôte , les consignes étant données par message pas d accueil. Une bonne location pour visiter Genève et ses alentours.
Appartement avec du charme, bien situé, propre et correspondant à l'annonce. Terrasse agréable. Avec une voiture, il n'est pas facile de se garer.

Maysoon's place was quaint and beautiful - much nicer than the pictures! We enjoyed our stay there very much. Location was fantastic as well - the Jet D'eau was right down the road. Would definitely stay here again!

L'appartement est très bien placé. Propre, spacieux  et doté d'une terrasse très agréable. Nous sommes arrivés plutôt  tard  (1hr du mat) ce qui n'a posé aucun problème pour récupérer les clefs. Je recommande
Lovely apartment (far better than the pictures), great location, and a wonderful host. Would definitely come back.

Nous sommes arrivés dans un appartement vide. Notre hôte n'est jamais venu nous voir. Je l'ai certes eu une fois au téléphone pour lui dire qu'on était bien arrivé mais la seule fois ou elle s'est manifestée, c'était tout à la fin pour nous demander quand est-ce que l'on allait partir. Des prises étaient cassées, les murs et autres listes en bois n'étaient plus en bon état, pas de clé Wi-fi à disposition et la cuisine et la salle de bain n'étaient pas très propre. J'ai dû d'abord nettoyer le lave-linge avant de pouvoir l'utiliser. Sinon, un appartement correct pour Genève, dans un quartier bien trop bruyant et cher au niveau parking, car on ne peut pas rester parqué plus d'une heure trente au même endroit. Maysoon, vous devriez être plus présente pour vos invités.

Maysoon's apartment is much more beautiful than in the pictures, it is cozy and made us feel like we were home. It is in a convenient location, you can walk to the Jet d'eau and is a 10 minute tram ride to the city center. There are restaurants and a big supermarket close by as well. I will definitely come back, as Maysoon made our stay extremely pleasant with her quick responses and comfortable home :)

Maysoon tres disponible par sms ou mail pour toute question.
Super quartier, la rue donnant directement sur la rade et le jet d'eau

Appartement très bien situé dans le quartier des Eaux Vives, accès aux transports publics excellents, magasins boutiques restaurants à deux pas, veille ville accessible assez rapidement à pied, quartier évidemment un peu bruyant, équipement complet, accès WIFI parfait. Pour quatre jours complète satisfaction.

When you rent a flat via Airbnb it is most often a flat that is being rented all of, or most of, the time. There is someone living in this flat, and it is being rented out now and then. This is not a problem, and works well.

The flat is nice, large and airy. It is nicer that the photos.

When we had questions Maysoon replied swiftly.

L'appartement est remarquablement bien situé. Une grande chambre et une chambre en mezzanine plus un grand salon, très confortable, avec une terrasse situé au centre de l'appartement. Un endroit très charmant.
L'hôte a été très réceptif et réactif.
Un trop beau séjour! Je recommande vivement!!

Maysoon is very friendly and quick responsive. The view from the main bedroom is fantastic. The little terrace is lovely too. Her apartment is also located in a good neighborhood with a lot of good restaurants and close to Jet d'eau.

The only drawback is that the other bed at the attic is too close to the ceiling, you may bump your head if not careful.
Maysoon has a lovely apartment in a great location in a great city. Exactly as described. Will stay here again.

Amazing apartment with a lovely little roof terrace. Very comfortable and much better than being cooped up in a hotel. Pictures don't do it justice. Host was very helpful and on hand for any questions. In short, loved it!
Great location, perfect for two days spent exploring the city! Comfortable beds, clean bathroom, and was perfect for four people! Thanks Maysoon!
From the pictures the flat matches the description.  The apartment definitely has a lived in feel to it, and there is a lot of clutter.  The location is great though, right in the center of Geneva.
It was a great place and easy to go to places.. will come again...

The home is very nice and in a perfect location!Just be aware that probably the host leaves there, so there are a lot its stuffs anywere, but for us it wasn't a problem.
Check in and check out were flxexible so thnks To Mysoon we Can go on visit city till The last day!

The place was a bit messy when we went in because the cleaner was still tidying it, which probably happened because of miscommunication regarding the check in times. Regardless, the apartment is beautiful and quite comfortable and quite near the central of Geneva. Just note that because the host lives there, most of her things are there and you may feel that it's a bit cluttered. There was also the smell of cigarettes which made my family members feel uneasy.
Appartement proche du centre ville et du Lac. On peut tout faire à pieds: visites,courses,sports etc..

Nous avons passé une nuit chez Maysoon pour le nouvel an 2017. L'appartement était très propre et bien situé (environs 20min de marche pour le quai du Mont Blanc, lieu animé où nous sommes allés pour les festivités). Très bon rapport qualité/prix.

Maysoon's flat is easy to get to, central and walking distance from some great restaurants and shops. She does live in this flat - so be aware that her personal things are around. She has quite the collection of products which take up all spaces in bathroom and bedroom. Also note that this is a smoking friendly flat - meaning that there have been indoor smokers. If you are a non-smoker I would not suggest that you stay here. If you are a smoker this would not bother you. Maysoon was amazing with communication and directions to her apartment which lead to a stress free stay! She also allowed for us to have an early check in which was incredibly helpful for us as our flight landed at 7am.
Maysoon thank you  , was really great
Fantastic apartment and incredible host! Loved it! Thank you Maysoon!
Great place very nicely located. Beautiful little roof terrace with morning sun. Close to the lake and close to public transport.

The apartment is located very closly to Jet d'Eau and Jardin Anglais. The bus stop is just 5 minute walk and Maysoon is a very helpful host. Just one thing to keep in your mind this place is her home as well so there are a lot of her belonging.
Maysoon's place is good located, near the public transport and supermarket. The terrase in very fine. The aprtment is spacious and well equiped. Thank you,Maysoon. If we can we will come back.

Hi, Maysoon! I am so glad I found your place. We had a great time staying there. The apartment is very homey, the location is superb and the internet is excellent. I hope to be able to book your place again in the future. :-) Thank you very much. God bless you.

Malgré l'emplacement idéal pour découvrir Genève, le potentiel agréable de l'appartement et la réactivité de Maysoon (que nous n'avons pas rencontrée), qui a tout de même essayé de nous arranger dans un premier temps, nous avons été déçus par les deux semaines passées dans l'appartement.
La deuxième chambre en mezzanine comporte un lit en mauvais état (sommier cassé qui grince au moindre mouvement) et la barrière n'est pas bien fixée, ce qui dangereux. L'appartement est bourré d'effets personnels poussés dans un coin et nous n'avions pas d'endroit pour ranger nos affaires.
Pour finir, nous avons annulé la dernière nuit et Maysoon à loué son appartement immédiatement, sans nous contacter pour savoir à quelle heure nous partions: nous avons donc rencontré les voyageurs suivants alors qu'on finissait de faire le ménage...
L'appartement était propre et les serviettes aussi, mais tout cela a entaché notre voyage.
Petite note pour l'été : l'appartement est sous les toits, il y fait donc très chaud (mais il y a une clim à dispo) et avec les fenêtre ouvertes, c'est très bruyant.

Maysoon's place has a lovely glassed-in terrace that makes the home very special. The 1.5 bathrooms were great for two people. The space is a bit cluttered and the second bedroom is a small loft space which could get really warm during a heatwave. Having a fan would have helped. The big bedroom is spacious and the bed very comfortable. Communication with maysoon was very easy with flexible check in and out times.
Good location. Nothing special overall.

Maysoon was a great host, communication was really easy and she was really helpful in everything.
The apartment is well located, easy to walk around and really comfortable.
The only problem we had was with the maid, that arrived after our check in to organise the apartment.
Besides that everything went just fine, and the pictures really don't describe the place.
It is close to the lake.
Luvley place, amazing location and great value. Highly recommended

It's a great space in a fantastic location with comfy beds and lots of TV channels in English, French and German. However, the second bedroom is not suitable for adults and the landlady could pay more attention to the apartment; e.g. cleanliness and other housekeeping matters.
A good place to stay!
Nice and cozy place, perfect location.

Great little flat to stay in near Lake Geneva. It was booked for colleagues of mine, and they reported no problems. You can tell it is lived in year round as there is a bit of clutter, but it brought a coziness value to the place.

Great location. Great value. Much nicer than the photos imply. Has a nice open terrace and spacious living room. Responsive host.  Really enjoyed our stay.  Highly recommend to anyone needing a stay in Geneva!

The apartment is close to the bus station, main train station and the lake. All within walkable distances. Supermarkets and restaurants close by too. Maysoon is extremely quick with her responses even late at night. A cute balcony and the place is much better than the photos.
Also, don’t be confused when you find a lot of her stuff in the apartment. No one will enter while you’re there. :)
I will definitely book Maysoon’s apartment when I come back to Geneva!

Very quick to respond. Her apartment is very charming and a short walk to the water jet. Let us check out late as well!
Would recommend her place.

Maysoon's place was located in a great place. It was easy to gain access and the lift was great. Maysoon was very responsive. The other reviews were correct. It does looked lived in. All of Maysoon's personnel stuff was left out. Not an issue for us but was worried once we arrived. The only thing you should know if the air conditioner is a portable unit which was fine as we used it in the bedroom as we like it cool at night for sleeping and it was very hot during our visit.
I would recommend this place for someone wanting to see the sites in Geneva.
Great property with excellent location but in need of repairs and cleaning, especially kitchen.
A lived in apartment that is well located. the second bedroom is upstairs and could get hot even with the portable AC.

This stay made a two week business trip more like a vacation! It’s probably the most unique airbnb I’ve stayed in globally and will always have such fond memories of staying in a beautifully designed glass fronted studio overlooking a garden. It’s a great place and Angela and David are lovely and flexible. The area Carouge was new to me and it’s a real adventure, boutiques, coffee shops, cute restaurants and historic. The tram is right there, the supermarket a block and laundry next door.
Highly recommend for business or leisure trips. Will stay again!

Adresse fantastique, havre de paix niché dans Carouge, à recommander chaudement !
Daniel s’est montré disponible, ayant le souci que tout se passe bien !

Beautiful quiet place - very nicely decorated with everything you need. Very close the public transport in one of the nicest neighbourhoods to Geneva. Daniel and Angela are lovely and perfect hosts. Very much recommended.

A very stylish space in the garden behind a small townhouse in Carouge.  In spring the garden was a real pleasure.  It's also located in a beautiful neighborhood, with trams, supermarkets and a local farmer's market just steps away.
Superbe studio situé au fond d’un agréable jardin. Pratique et moderne et proche de toutes les commodités. Vraiment une superbe adresse !

Un estudio de diseño con todo lo necesario, un jardín precioso para disfrutar del sol y los pájaros. Inmejorable la atención de Angela y Daniel, cultos, simpáticos y nos quedamos con ganas de conocerlos mas. Nuestra estadía fue perfecta, volveremos.
Adresse à recommander

Daniel and Angela’s place is a tranquil oasis in the heart of Carouge. While the space is small it was a perfect fit for my husband, myself and our infant daughter.   It is a perfect little studio complete with kitchenette, dishwasher, coffee machine, breakfast table and sofa hidden away in a garden which allows for great privacy. While we never tried the provided flatscreen TV, the internet worked very well so would also be good for work travellers.  Daniel was a very helpful and accomodating host. Grateful thanks and we hope to be back soon.

C'est un studio indépendant très mignon, tout calme, avec équipement moderne et de qualité. Jolie déco, literie très confortable. Petit coin cuisine bien équipée avec de beaux éléments. Petite salle de douche, très bien conçue. Et cerise sur le gâteau: la terrasse privative et le jardin lui donnent un charme fou. Tout cela au centre de Carouge, le plus joli quartier de Genève.
Accueil très sympathique.
Une excellente adresse où je reviendrai volontiers.

My stay at Daniel's was great. I think this can be considered one of the nicest Airbnb I even stayed at and the value for price is awesome for Geneva. The position is quite good even to get to the Palace of Nations which is quite far. I have been a couple of weeks for business but I would recommend it also for vacation.

Beautiful coach house with a garden in the heart of Carouge! Very close to public transit (trams), shops and restaurants but at the same time very quiet, with occasional church bells.
Also worth mentioning that you're getting a great deal for your money if you're at all familiar with price tags in Geneva.
Excellent accueil, adorable petite maison du jardin, avec accueil particulièrement chaleureux par un petit chat. Très propre, bien équipé, emplacement idéal.
Great house. near to public transport, supermarket. cozy room and lots of nature things in there.

J'ai passé un excellent séjour chez Angela & Daniel.
Les instructions pour me rendre à l'appartement étaient très claires, le studio - situé en plein centre de Carouge, était nickel et très bien équipé (le ventilateur -en pleine période de canicule, a été très apprécié).
Je reviendrai sans hésiter si j'en ai l'occasion !
Angela and Daniel place is a great quite refuge in Carouge, one of the most charming neighborhood of Geneva. Highly recommended!
Great calm place
Ok
Un havre de paix tout en harmonie au cœur de Carouge jouxtant le jardin de Angela et Daniel dont l'accueil et la compagnie ont été les éléments d'un agréable séjour.

Eine super schöne Unterkunft in den Hintergärten der Altstadt von Carouge. Die beiden Gastgeber sind sehr höflich und zuvorkommend. Einziges Manko ist die fehlende Spülmaschine. Wir kommen trotzdem gerne wieder.
Feel good contemporary little house in the Garden + Living in Romantic Carouge.  Super practical, cosy and We loved it.
The garden studio was absolutely fantastic. I stayed there for two weeks and felt totally at home. Nothing else I could have wished for.

Lovely quiet oasis not far from city center. Hosts are very welcoming and accommodating. Flat is very nice, clean and has everything one need. Very close to public transport, restaurants and shops. I enjoyed little private garden. Would definitely stay again.

The garden house lived up to all of our expectations. For us, while visiting family in Carouge, the location couldn't have been more ideal. While living close to our family members, we were right in the heart of the commercial district of the town of Carouge with a Migro grocery store, a laundromat, a bank, bakeries, restaurants, public transportation, etc. all within easy walking distance. However, at the same time, the garden house was located in a exquisite boutique garden, set back from the hustle-bustle of the street, which provided the quiet one needs to relax. Although we didn't make much use of the kitchen, it seemed well-equipped. The wifi could use a bit more bandwidth. However, I know that Daniel is working on improving that situation. Many thanks, Angela and Daniel for a lovely three weeks.

La estancia fue excelente. Daniel y Ángela hacen todo por acomodarte y hacerte sentir como en casa. El departamento está muy bien ubicado con un jardín en plena ciudad. El único problema fue el Internet que los anfitriones buscaron arreglar desde el principio. 100% recomendaría este lugar.
Superbe situation, au calme et au centre de Carouge. A la hauteur de mes attentes. Je le recommande les yeux fermés!
Ein gemütliches Studio in bester Lage in Carouge! Besonders schön die kleine Terrasse und Möglichkeit, draussen zu sitzen

Le Studio est un petit havre de paix merveilleusement situé au cœur de Carouge (et à deux pas du centre de Genève).
Le contact avec Angela et Daniel était très agréable et facile.
Le studio est dans le fond du jardin. Il bénéficie d’un accès indépendant et offre un complet sentiment d’intimité.
Le jardin est également très agréable.
J’ai eu beaucoup de plaisir à écouter des CDs mis à disposition et à feuilleter des livres d’art également.
Le lit est très confortable.
La cuisine a tout ce qu’il faut pour se préparer des bons petits plats.
Extremely well functioning garden house equipped with all you need and friendly hosts.

The apartment is very functional, it has all the kitchen appliances you may need, it is sparkling clean and the location is unbeatable, only a few steps from many restaurants, bars, supermarkets, etc. The bus/tram stop is only a few steps away. The little garden is also a plus. Highly recommended.  Daniel and Angela are great hosts.

Angela et Daniel sont des hôtes très
attentionnés. L'accueil est chaleureux. L'appartement très bien conçu et équipé, d'une propreté irréprochable. Le très beau jardin est un réel plaisir. Excellent séjour !

Charmant studio au fond du jardin à Carouge que nous apprécions .
Tout y est pour un agréable séjour .
Daniel et son épouse absents une partie de notre séjour chez eux sont restés atteignables en cas de soucis.

Ce petit studio est à recommander les yeux fermés! Situé au coeur de Carouge,à l’arrière d’une maison au calme,il est très fonctionnel, propre et bien équipé (Nespresso,lave-vaisselle,épices,jolie sélection de livres et dvd,armoire pour ranger ses affaires,…). Le jardin est charmant et il y a une petite terrasse abritée où il fait bon prendre son petit-déjeuner le matin. L’arrêt du tram est à quelques pas et le quartier regorge de jolies petites boutiques d’artisans et autres.
Les échanges avec Daniel ont été très faciles et rapides,et il nous attendait à notre arrivée.

I kept referring to it as my little fairy-tale home throughout my two-week stay with Angela&Daniel in Carouge - which it absolutely is.
The garden is a true pearl - an oasis of calm and nature, several degrees cooler than the temperatures on the street during the summer heatwave, perfectly quiet and extremely well-equipped for the little space it occupies behind the artsy old-town line of shops on Rue Ancienne.
The studio has everything one could possibly wish for in terms of equipment to feel at home (incl. an impressive collection of world literature! mainly in French, but not only) and is fully furbished in a wonderfully clean, modern design (better than in the pictures, which must have been taken before some final touches were made). It has strong internet, a comfy sofa, a beautiful little "veranda" for star gazing - even a dishwasher (no microwave, but that's about the only amenity missing).
One word of caution for the home-office generation: if one needs to spend more time working from home than checking the occasional e-mail, the seating and little desk are not ideal for long hours - however, several lovely cafes in the vicinity provide viable alternatives. It was a great stay & definitely recommended, especially when travelling alone.
Beautiful place to stay in Geneva. Well furnished and perfect location. Very calm.

A very charming fully-equipped studio in the heart of Carouge, in the back of a beautiful garden. Everything is new and with high-level materials, it is very pleasant to stay there, like an oasis of peace and nature in the city.
It is very comfortable and pleasant, Daniel takes care of all details, nothing is missing. He was also very flexible with our arrival and departure, always available and willing to make our stay more comfortable, which was highly appreciated.
Carouge is a bit far from Geneva city centre but there are good connections with the public transport, and the village has a very pleasant atmosphere and beautiful architecture, full of cafés, bars and restaurants. It has lots of charm, like a holiday village across the river. We ended up spending a lot of time there
Totally recommended!!

This is a nice place to stay. It is very convenient, excellent location, peaceful garden to enjoy. There are shops, restaurants and coffees walking distance. Daniel is an amazing host.
We are very pleased!
I recommend this place if you are planning to visit Carouge, you won’t regret.

This was the perfect place for the two us to stay for a week. The location on tram lines 12 and 18 made it easy to get anywhere we wanted to go, and we loved the neighborhood too. The apartment has everything you will need for your stay, and the garden was really lovely. Daniel and Angela are excellent hosts, who are genuinely interested in making their guests' stay as convenient and enjoyable as possible.

Un petit coin de paradis ! Nous avons passé un excellent séjour. Le logement est d'une propreté irréprochable et bien équipé, la literie de qualité et l'endroit paisible. Daniel et Angela sont flexibles et sympathiques. Carouge offre une ambiance de vacances, des commerces, bars et restaurants variés, des boutiques originales, des transports publics efficaces... Nous recommandons sans hésiter et reviendrons volontiers !

Excellent séjour dans la maison d'Angela et Daniel.
Le studio est très confortable, très bien équipé, la décoration est soignée, le fait de donner sur le jardin, au calme, est un vrai bonheur. Le logement est idéalement situé dans Carouge, avec toutes les commodités et les transports à proximité.
J'ai été très bien accueillie par Daniel, et la communication a toujours été très fluide.
J'espère avoir l'occasion de séjourner à nouveau chez Angela et Daniel !

A wonderful studio in a summer house, with a courtyard that sparkled with gold and burgundy leaves in the autumn.  The studio is very cleverly organized by smart and charming hosts.  Moreover, in the most interesting area of ​​Geneva, in my opinion.  In short - everything for happiness
Tutto molto bene

Le logement de Daniel est entièrement indépendant; situé dans un cabanon moderne donnant sur un jardin, et disposant de tout le confort moderne attendu: chauffage, salle de bain, cuisine; lit de qualité, connexion à internet haut-début et mise à disposition d'une Tv et d'un abonnement Netflix.
L'emplacement est absolument idéal donnant sur une rue historique de Carouge, traversé par un trafic très très faible puisque partagé par le tramway.
Le quartier est absolument charmant avec une atmosphère de vieille ville, de petites boutiques indépendantes tenues par des personnes passionnées. Pour moi il n'y a aucun autre meilleur quartier à Genève que celui de Carouge!
Daniel est un hôte disponible et soucieux du confort de ses visiteurs. Vous recevrez un accueil de qualité.
Gorgeous studio, well stocked kitchen, impeccably clean, beautiful and charming neighborhood with unique history; right off public transportation. Communications with Daniel was perfect! ✨🌟💫

Je recommande vivement ce logement très bien placé et très confortable. Il est très bien situé dans le très joli quartier de Carouge. Accès indépendant, au calme car au fond du jardin de la propriété. Tout est très propre et très fonctionnel. Il y a du rangement pour les vêtements et les affaires de toilette. Côté cuisine c'est aussi très bien équipé et il y a des épices et capsules de café qui donne une impression d'être "comme à la maison". Toutes les indications données sont claires, aucun problème pour arriver/repartir. Encore merci !
A clean, well equipped and cozy garden house in a lovely garden. Located very conveniently near supermarkets, laundry services and the tram. A great atmosphere. Thank you Daniel and Angela.

Perfect location in the heart of carouge close to numerous restaurants and bars but at the same time lovely quiet garden oasis at the back of the main street.
Only 15 minutes on the tram back to geneva department stores and railway station.

A beautiful and peaceful haven in such a perfect location. I hate to recommend it because it means that I have a smaller chance of booking it again! Honestly can’t wait to return to this charming oasis in wonderful Carouge. Don’t miss market day (Weds/Sat) if you’re there!

Ein schönes Architektenjuwel mit allem was man für einen Aufenthalt benötigt. Das Haus blieb auch während der Sommerwelle angenehm kühl und der kleine Garten zur Mitbenutzung war ein zusätzliches Geschenk.
Die öffentlichen Verkehrsmittel sind leicht erreichbar und man ist schnell am Bahnhof oder in Genf. Es gibt viele Geschäfte, Restaurants, Kinos, Gallerien in der Nähe und der Ort ist absolut ruhig.
Sehr nette, unkomplizierte Gastgeber auf die man zählen kann.
Wir kommen sicher ein nächstes Mal.

Lovely studio in a beautiful garden in the heart of Carouge village.
Nice and welcoming hosts.
Un joli studio de jardin qui a tout ce qu’il faut pour un séjour agréable à Carouge… que j’ai prolongé pour ces raisons. Les propriétaires sont très gentils et maintiennent un très beau jardin.

If you want a high quality stay then look no further than Daniel and Angela's garden studio. The place itself is very comfortable and relaxing, everything works and is of great quality. It is especially calm with access to a lovely terrace and garden. The area, Carouge, is such a gem compared to the bustling city, an oasis to retreat to, but also very accessible on the tram. Geneva as a city is underrated. We stayed for 5 nights as part of a holiday and could have done so much more there. Highly recommend.
Un studio jardin carougeois idéal pour se détendre et se ressourcer. Parfaitement équipé et parfaitement propre avec des hôtes parfaitement accueillants.

The studio is settled in a beautiful garden which is perfectly placed in a nice street in Carouge. Couldn’t have had a better place for us to work in for a short time while visiting. Super close to the train as well and the hosts were great!

I stayed at Daniel's place during a two-week work trip to Geneva. The place was lovely, with access to a beautiful garden. It felt like a secluded paradise in the middle of Carouge.
Even though I had to take the tram to get to work, transportation was very easy. The tram station was a few steps away.
Daniel was really responsive and welcoming.
I would definitely stay there again!

I couldn't recommend this place more! Particularly the location, I didn't know anything about Geneva, but I'm noticing that les Genevois even come to this neighborhood to hang out. It's like a village inside the city.
And the place is also wonderful, it feels very cosy and homely (partly because of the books that are here I think). Very nice kitchen also, I've been cooking every day.
Thanks a lot Daniel!
短い滞在でしたが、くつろげました。

Nice secluded studio with modern appliances at the back of a cute little garden. Daniel and Angela were very hospitable and accommodating. Transport to the center of Geneva is very simple with frequent trams that whisk you there in about 10 minutes. Would gladly stay there again.

Such a beautiful and peaceful sanctuary in the heart of Carouge.
Very friendly and helpful hosts.
Would recommend this lovely airbnb

Amazing peaceful stay, the pictures don’t do the studio interior justice. The garden is beautiful, perfect for summer outdoor meals, the studio is well-designed with everything you need. There were some occasional ants and Daniel was quick to help and it’s expected for a lush garden setting. Would definitely stay here again.

Un petit coin de paradis au coeur de Carouge, un havre de paix hors du temps et de l'effervescence de la ville.
Idéal pour une séjour romantique à deux....

Ein aussergewöhnliches, kleines Haus mit einem Zimmer, integrierter Küche und Bad, eine große Terasse. Die Küche ist super ausgestattet. Wunderschöner Innenhof mit vielen Pflanzen, einer freundlichen Katze und Sonne. Alles sehr geschmackvoll. Mitten in Carouge, fußläufig die schönen Restaurants und der tolle Markt am Samstag. Daniel ist freundlich und hilfsbereit, ich kam sehr spät am Abend an und trotzdem lief alles problemlos. Ich habe mich sehr wohlgefühlt. Ich empfehle diese Unterkunft für Alleinreisende oder Paare.

Carouge is a very special Quartier of Geneva and Daniel’s little garden house is right in the center of this animated neighborhood, while being private and sheltered from the noise of the street.
It is a cozy stay, a home away from home with a very practical set up.
Thank you again, Louise & Ahmad
Excellent séjour, très beau lieu préservé avec un petit carré de verdure et très facilement accessible, communication avec Daniel aisée. Je recommande vivement !
Daniel was a great host and the place is lovely. Carouge itself is a nice neighborhood and is still quite close to the city. I would definitely stay here again!
A wonderfully peaceful, practical, welcoming small nest in Carouge! Thank you , to be reccomended

We had a lovely stay.  The apartment was comfortable and cozy, and the garden view is beautiful and serene.  The tidy kitchen has everything you would need to make a meal, with well-working appliances and plenty of pans and utensils.  There are a variety of interesting books available to read and others media for entertainment.  The communication from our host, Daniel, was great.  Daniel provided perfect recommendations for dining nearby, and there are many wonderful options for in walking distance of the apartment.  The combination of a private, comfortable apartment and the walkable neighborhood close to public transportation made this a great home base for a trip to Geneva and Carouge.  We had a very pleasant stay and hope we have another opportunity to visit.
Merci, ce logement est un havre de paix.

Fabulous location,  loved the garden house, perfect for exploring Geneva and Carouge a quaint charming place to stay, well equipped and very comfortable . Wonderful bars, restaurants and local shops.  Private and peaceful enjoyed waking upto the birds in the garden. Will definitely be back but would stay a week next time. Daniel was a friendly informative host we would not hesitate to recommend to anyone visiting Geneva.

Logement original et luxueux. Cartier TRÈS pittoresque. Transport publique efficace, les tram 12 et 18 nous mênnent partout facilement et rapidement. Super marché Migro à proximité. Bons et charmants restos dans le secteur.  Nous y retournerons à coup sûr. Mario Canada.
I had a wonderful stay at Daniel’s airbnb - the garden views were lovely and the space comfortable and very clean. I would highly recommend booking his place!

The garden house is very clean with a lovely garden view. It looks just as good as the pictures. When we checked in, the owner was very friendly and explained everything well to us. This is a nice place to stay in the city and has everything you need for a short stay. Recommended!

The stay was beyond amazing. Daniel was very welcoming and helpful. We enjoyed a quick chat with him and he made us feel right at home.
The garden was so peaceful and beautiful and room had a Dyson heater which was much needed in Geneva weather.
There was everything we need from the kitchen to the bathroom to the living room. It was easy to find easy to access and 1 tram away from the city everything is within walking distance including some amazing restaurant.
I would definitely stay in that peaceful small cocoon when i visit Geneva.

De passage à Genève pour raisons professionnelles, j'ai passé un excellent séjour dans ce logement particulièrement calme et paisible  (en retrait de la route) et bien équipé. Le petit jardin permet de outre de s'installer à l'extérieur pour prendre un verre ou bouquiner. Je recommande vivement ce logement très agréable, bien desservi par les transports publics et à deux pas de la charmante place du marché de Carouge.

Daniel was super helpful and always available for our questions. He was very flexible with Check-in and Check-out. The area is lovely and there are many great places to eat close to the house. I would totally recommend this place.

un appartement bien équipé et meublé avec goût et chaleureux (livres et nombreux DVD) avec un accès au jardin bien appréciable dans un quartier calme et charmant et un hôte très accueillant. Merci Daniel et nous retiendrons l'adresse quand nous reviendrons à Genève
Ruhig gelegene 1-Zimmer-Wohnung hinter grüner Oase. Gut eingerichtet mit Küchen-Utensilien, Bibliothek und Film- und Musik-Sammlung. Flexible und freundliche Gastgeber.

logement très sympa
avec un petit jardin entouré d arbres fruitiers et petits oiseaux
avons profité pleinement des repas à l extérieur
cuisine fonctionnelle
Le quartier est très vivant avec ses petits restaurants et places
il y fait bon vivre
Plezierige kleine studio met alles wat er nodig is, in mooie tuin. Erg leuke buurt met veel restaurants.
Very satisfied with my stay.

Daniel’s place was lovely. It had everything we needed for a wonderful stay. Didn’t use the great kitchen but appreciated the nespresso coffee and sugar to help jump start the mornings. We asked for Daniel to adjust the heating in the house as it was too hot for us and it was perfect for the remainder of our stay. We loved watching the birds in the garden too. Also Carouge was a perfect spot for our visit to Geneva. Restaurants, cafes and grocery all within a short walk. Thank you Daniel and Angela.

Très charmant lieu pour séjourner à Carouge.
A recommander ++

Daniel m'a très bien reçue dans ce petit havre de paix. Le logement dispose de tout ce dont on peut avoir besoin (four, lave-vaisselle!) et le cadre est magnifique. Merci encore pour votre réactivité et votre compréhension!
A comfortable and peaceful stay. Carouge is quieter than central Geneva but 10min tram ride away so very convenient. Daniel was a welcoming and responsive host. Really enjoyed.
Sehr tolle Unterkunft im Herzen von Carouge. Daniel ist ein sehr guter Gastgeber. Hat alles perfekt geklappt. Wir hatten eine gute Zeit. Danke für alles...
5* stay in all senses. Merci pour tout Daniel + Angela!
Tout s'est très bien passé, nous reviendrons 🙂
Perfect. Comfortabele studio in rustige tuin.  Leuke buurt met veel cafés en restaurants. Aardige hosts.
Daniel et sa femme était très accueillants dans ce havre de paix au sein d un quartier magnifique.
Wonderful private flat in a garden in a great unique neighborhood of Geneva.

The ´Pavilon’ is located in Carouge one of the oldest neighbourhoods of Geneva, known for its artisans, boutiques, art galleries and the market. Carouge is full of cafes, bars , brasseries and excellent restaurants.
The shopping area is just 5 min walk from the studio.
The studio itself was perfect! Located just behind the main house with a wooden patio and a beautiful private garden.
The space is ideal for two persons with plenty of room to relax. The furnishings are tasteful and the bed and sofa very comfortable. The kitchen and bathroom are fully equipped. The place was very clean and cosy. Felt just like home!
The hosts were incredibly responsive, proactive and very friendly.
An excellent experience!!! It was very hard to leave…
I highly recommend it!!!

Un lugar fantástico con todo lo que uno necesita para pasar una estadía agradable y placentera en Ginebra.
El anfitrión Daniel es muy amable y da instrucciones precisas.
Me encantó el lugar.
Felicitaciones!
Sehr angenehmer Aufenthalt in dieser wunderschönen Umgebung in Carouge.
Très bon accueil, le lieu était charmant. Nous recommandons vivement ce logement.
Super emplaçement et hôtes réactifs. Très paisible tout en étant près de tout. Un des meilleurs Airbnb que j'ai visités.
Very nice place in extremely convenient location.
We loved staying at Maysoon's lovely apartment. It's a beautiful space, very comfortable and in a great location. Maysoon is very fast and helpful in responding to questions.

El departamento estaba demaciado sucio, no habia hecho el aseo, habia basura, no dejaron suficientes toallas para el uso de nosotros, las sabanas estaban sucias, habia cabellos en las almohadas, habia comida de dias en el refrigerador. abviamente alguiem vive ahi y solo se sale para dejar el departamento para rentarlo pero deja todas sus cosas ahi desacomodadas. no nos puso jabones ni papel de baño. una muy mala experiencia
The rooms are good size and location is close to all the attractions and downtown Geneva.

Maysoon’s apartment is great. Location is right by a super critical bus stop, it’s walking distance to the water, and there’s plenty of food/markets nearby. The photos of the place don’t do it justice, it’s more spacious than it looks and the patio outside is a great spot to read or scroll on your phone endlessly. Maysoon was communicative and beyond helpful.
This place is in a fantastic location!  Checking in is a breeze, amazing views of the mountains... and it is exactly as described. We would come back again definitely!! Maysoon is an amazing host!
Really great trip ;)
Very nice apartment in the center of Geneva with a small rooftop which makes it perfect for summer use and gives a lot of light to the apartment. The location is perfect.

Maysoon‘s apartment has a top location, just a few blocks feom the jet d’eau, is really spacious, has a lovely rooftop terrace and is much more beautiful than shown in the pictures. It was clean and Maysoon was a really caring host, even not being in town. As said in other comments, the house is obviously lived in, so there are bath products around the tub and some food in the fridge (but also free shelves for our usage, of course) and cabinets. This also has a plus side, as nothing is makeshift, you are sleeping in real, good quality beds and not on a pull-out-sofa. There is some need for maintneance (lose tiles, somewhat wobbly handrail). The portable air conditioner that was available really saved us in the hot summer. I would definitely come back, the value/price ratio was very good.
The apartment was at a perfect location, with plenty of restaurants and bars around, and the lake being minutes away. Maysoon was very patient and communicative. Wonderful stay!
I stayed in Maysoon's apartment for one day. She is friendly. The apartment is very close to Geneva lake and the old town.
Very nice place, central and with a beautiful view. Maysoon has been very helpful with my last-minute request. I really enjoyed my stay.
Maysoon was very nice and an amazing, helpful, funny host. The flat was nice and clean, and in a very nice location, close to the city centre and yet quiet. Thank you for having me!

A lovely and very well located apartment. Easy to get to the centre and one short bus ride to the station
Maysoon was very helpful with our last minute request.
夏天的顶楼不是一般热
It's a perfect place to stay in Geneva, the apartment is clean and comfortable. It's located in the main street which gives direct view to the fountain and the lac. We were very happy to stay there.

I sent a hosting request to Maysoon on the same day that I needed a place to stay. She replied almost immediately and within 15 minutes we had everything sorted out!
Her apartment is very well located and comfortable and we really enjoyed our stay.
I couldn't meet Maysoon in person because she was traveling, but even from a distance she was able to arrange everything nicely and quickly.
Thanks for hosting us, Maysoon!

Maysoon is really flexible regarding check-in and check-out. The flat is really good located near the lake and the city center. The flat is nice and and quite big. If I am ever again in Geneva I would definetly stay again in this flat.
The home was very well kept, and fit the description perfectly. We were very comfortable during our stay and had access to everything we needed (bathroom, shower, towel, kitchen, patio, etc.)
非常好的体验，Danke

Maysoon's apartment is very well located, several places of interest in Geneve are nearby her place. I went with my girlfriend to stay one day and we were able to visit all we planned by foot. The apartment itself was clean and fitted the description. Maysoon was very helpful during our stay, she gave good suggestions on what to visit and where we could exchange money. She even let us use her washing machine. Our only problems were regarding our arrival. Since we were depending on WiFi, we were unable to call her, which made things a little complicated because she didn't give us the pass code to enter the building before our arrival. Not much recommended for those who dislike smoking smell. Nevertheless, the place is good and provided a good experience.

I only got the chance to see her once as she left for London the day after I moved in. She is a really nice host and even left me some really good pasta after she left. She was very responsive. The house is really well located in Eaux-Vives, near Coop and tram12. There is a bakery just down the building. The house itself looks much better than in the pictures.
The bed was comfortable and Maysoon was a great host and very flexible with my check in time. The apartment was easy to get to and centrally located.

We didn't meet Maysoon as she was away on business but despite the time zone differences she kept right in top of communication which arose due to the very short notice booking we placed.

The apartment is on the 6th floor,well away from traffic noise and reached by elevator. It has a lovely feel to it, huge wooden beams defining the living areas. There's a well equipped kitchen, 1 1/2 bathrooms and a comfortable lounge/dining room with a large flatscreen TV with Apple TV. For warmer days there's a lovely sheltered outside patio. All in all, it's a label clean and well equipped apartment in a great area. You can look down the street and the the Jet d'eau. There are plenty of local restaurants , supermarkets and public transport close by. The Eau Vivre stop is 5 minutes walk and that's where you get the 10 tram to the airport for 3 chf. All the best sights of Geneva are within about 5 to 15 minutes walk. I not hesitate to recommend this apartment to anyone visiting Geneva.
Oui, je me suis retrouvé dans un logement conforme à la description, vaste et confortable.
Fabulous! Maysoon is super nice and the location can't be beat!
Thank you for the warm welcome, for adapting your place because of the presence of my little daughter! that was very kind and helpful!
It was a nice stay. Location is great. Well connected. Maysoon is very friendly.
Nice stay in a lovely appt very well located. Maysoon is a friendly and accomodating person. I recommend.

The room and the apartment itself are lovely.
the service itself not so much.. Maysoon was very responsive to my every demand, but at the same time she was not very helpful and a bit disorganized (due to a misunderstanding she had with the cleaning lady I was locked out of the house...). furthermore, she did not provide essential information (es: code of the door) and I had to ask it myself. seems normal, but for a person, who never used this service, some things might be forgotten.
the rest was just fine.. the apartment is located marvelously, very spacious and lovely. made our stay great overall.

I had a wonderful stay in Daniel's cottage. The setting is lush and peaceful, with flowers and vegetables growing in the garden. Carouge itself is picturesque Swiss while still alive, and the direct tram into central Geneva made it easy to get around.
Eine ganz tolle Unterkunft, modern und geschmackvoll eingerichtet.  Ich habe mich auch mit den wunderbaren Gastgebern Daniel und Angela sofort rundum wohl gefühlt.

Daniel is a very considerate and kind host. The annex is a lovely, modern hideaway with a charming, quiet garden - a perfect space from the city streets right outside the front door. The area of Carouge is pleasant with many shops, bars and restaurants. The tram stops right outside, and a parking garage is also within a few minutes walk. I can only recommend staying with Daniel!

Daniel was an extremely warm and welcoming host, he met us on the first night and showed us around and gave us some good recommendations and helped with parking.
The flat was lovely and cosy, it had everything needed and was very close to a tram stop, amenities, and lots of good cafes and restaurants. Carouge is also a beautiful and vibrant place with lots to explore.
Can't recommend enough! Thanks Daniel and Angela.

The apartment is a nice simple flat for a great price.  The location is great, plainpalais is a very nice area of Geneva.  The kitchen is new and fully equipped.  The bed is comfortable and has space for two.   There was a bit of trouble checking in but they solved it quite quickly.

Place was clean , ideal location and close to tram 12 and the Co Op for grocery shopping. Apartment has everything you need with a fully equipped kitchen if you want to cook, and dining area. I would stay here again.

Thanks to AirBnB, we had a wonderful ten days in Geneva! We chose this apartment because it was close to our daughter's dorm at the university. It is halfway between the Augustins and the Blanche tram stops on the #12 and the #18 tram lines. Geneva has a very user-friendly public transportation system. The most a traveler will have to walk is a couple of blocks. Hopefully, you'll never need the services of an emergency room but, just in case, there is one approximately 4 blocks away.

The flat was exactly as it was pictured on the website, clean and tastefully furnished with a very comfortable bed. Lots of storage was also available so it was easy to keep the flat clean. A closet with plenty of clothes hangers, an ironing board, a vacuum cleaner, a washing machine and a dryer rack were also provided.

In the kitchen, we had plenty of plates, bowls, mugs, glasses, and silverware with which to enjoy several meals at the dining room table in the flat. In addition to picking up bread and sweets from the neighborhood boulangeries/patisseries, we also bought groceries from each of the three different grocery stores (Lidl, Migros, and Coop) located at the Augustins tram stop. The kitchen also had a toaster, a coffee maker, an electric kettle, a baking sheet (which we used for frozen pizza), a pizza cutter, a pair of scissors, knives, and hot pot holders.

Overall, we absolutely loved our stay at this flat and would highly recommend it.

Integrali appears to be a commercial arrangement and we kept in touch with one person, Vadim. Soon after making our booking Vadim asked if we would stay in a different place as the booked one needed work done on it. We agreed. From reading the Integrali website I understood they have a 24 hour concierge service (my mistake). We arrived and noone was there but after phoning Vadim he came to let us in and show us around.
This was a ground floor, spacious 2 bedroom apartment, conveniently located, reasonably well set up, clean, with good wi-fi, TV and access to a washing machine. We enjoyed staying there.
A really nice and clean, comfortable place, in a great location. Was here on business and had everything I needed. Thanks for a great stay.

Nice little apartment with modern, new furniture. Cleaning service every week, which is great. Extremely quiet apartment at the back of the building, first floor walk up. Checkin starts at 13.00, so plan accordingly. Smooth communication with the host. Location excellent, close to public transportation, many supermarkets, restaurants and a nice running path along the river. A few things I missed were a place to hang clothes (suits and dresses), and cereal bowls, but nothing serious, it's a very complete and functional apartment. Great for longer stays.
Fue muy buena. Estoy realmente agradecido por la ayuda que me dieron y como me trataron. Recomiendo el servicio 100%
Good 2 room flat - comfortable, clean and quiet. Ideal for a good night's sleep!
Had good times at David’s apartment. The place is quiet, functional and close to shops, bars and public transport. Host availability and communication topped my stay. Thank you.
Great apartment, in a great location. It has everything you need!
Super professional and attentive. Without a doubt I recommend this guy and his team. The super good and well equipped apartment

This is a wonderful bright apartment with a good renovation and large windows. Excellent area, everything is within walking distance: from supermarkets to a veterinary clinic.  Very friendly neighbors.

David's company was acommadating when the apartment we booked wasn't clean. The member of the team we dealt with, Pavel, was excellent in responding and getting problems solved. We loved the area as it was cool and fairly quiet given the surroundings, we were close to the river so walking our dog was very easy.
Great apartment and very well located.

It was huge luck for me to stay here. Iris and her husband are really nice and hospital hosts! Room was really clean and private toilet was neatly cleaned too. It was really close to tram which goes to the train station. I can't forget my staying there.

It was my first experience in the Airbnb and I was really satisfied with Isis and her husband.
Even raining, Iris was waiting for me at the train station (line 14 - very close of her house) and during my stay let me fell "at home".
The room and the private bathroom were really clean and the breakfast was good!
Isis is a friendly host and I'd come back for sure...
Thank you for everything, Isis.

My very first experience with Airbnb and it couldn't be better!
Iris and her husband are super friendly and welcoming hosts. I felt at home right away! She came to pick me up from the bus stop and she prepared an hotel-style breakfast each morning. She also tried to help me learn some french!
The room is very clean and the bathroom is almost-private (I had to share it with other guests just for a couple of days and Iris would always clean it after each use).
The position is super convenient as well. Thought if you look in the map it can look a bit far from the center, since the bus stop is one minute walking from the house, at the end was just like staying in the city center. Plus the neighborhood is really quiet and safe.

Iris is very kind to me. I enjoyed my days in Geneva and in her apartment. The room is nice and have enough sunlight, with a big table and big bed. I felt so touched by Iris patience and kindness. And she even prepared breakfast for me. The tram station just 5 minutes walk from the house. I would definitely choose her house if I come back to Geneva. Highly recommend!

Iris and her family, her place was just great. It felt like staying in my family's house.

At the first day, I was welcomed to her family's lunch at the backyard with good foods. The room is just like what you see on the pictures, and it was nice. The tram station is 3 minutes away from house, and you can find restaurant or mart near apartment. I would definitely recommend this place for those visiting Geneva.

Thanks Iris,

Iris made me feel incredibly welcome and at home.
It was great to enjoy her garden during the heat wave in Geneve.
The room is lovely and Onex has many good transport links.

I encourage summer visitors to try Geneva's amazing public swimming pools. I went to three different ones in three days.

Merci Iris for your kind hospitality.

Iris and her family warmly welcomed me into their lovely Swiss home.  The home is located  in a safe,leafy neighborhood and the home has a charming garden/yard carefully cared for by Iris.  The room, while petit, is accurately portrayed in the photos.  This was a good Air Bnb experience and I recommend.  Many thanks!!

La chambre est bien agencée, lumineuse, propre et agréable. Le jardin est superbe et reposant. La localisation à proximité du tram mais au calme absolu est précieuse. Mais surtout, Iris est une hôte inégalable ! Bienveillante, douce, attentive, elle aime recevoir et rencontrer de nouvelles personnes et vous fera passer un moment inoubliable
I think that she is the best host, her house is really beautiful and the family is really kind

J'ai hâté de retourner chez Iris. La maison est aussi charmante que l'hôte !

Overall, the place was okay. I stayed at this place for two weeks near the end of May before moving to a different place for a long-term. Both Iris and Dorin were very kind and it was extremely generous of them to offer breakfast every day and sometimes even dinner. That being said, a couple of caveats for those who are looking to stay for more than 5 days. Firstly, I was not allowed to use the stove at all, and had to do all my cooking with the microwave. This detail was not available in the 'Amenities' section that you can view prior to booking the room; I only got to see this some time after booking the place in their house rules. Having to figure out how to translate all my stove-cooking to microwave-cooking was a great difficulty, and it was more dismaying to find out that a different person in another room who stayed in an overlapping time frame was permitted to use the stove. I'm not sure why there was such arbitrariness in one being allowed to use the stove while the other not. Second, there is no laundry machine. Unlike the stove portion, the unavailability of laundry machine is clearly indicated. In any case, even though the laundry place isn't hard to access (so claimed by the hosts), I never went there myself and did my laundry with hands. The hosts were kind to lend me the tools for laundry, but it goes without saying that it would have been much more comfortable with a laundry machine. Third, there is no "continuous access" to wifi as advertised. There is a strict schedule (Weekdays, 6:30pm-12am; Weekends, 6:30am-12am). Even this schedule, I found, was not so "strict" because the wifi would be available later than the time posted or would disconnect every now and then. Fourth, there was no lock on my door, so very often I had to carry valuables to work. I admit that I never asked why that was the case, but I presumed that the door would come with a lock as a default. I noticed that one of the bigger rooms did come with a lock, so I'm not sure why my room didn't have one. Lastly, the floor creaks rather loudly. If you are sensitive to sounds when you go to bed, like myself, it may be an issue especially when guests (there are two other rooms listed on airbnb) move in and out at night. Many of the things I pointed out above are mostly applicable to those who are thinking about booking their place for more than just a day or two. As described by others, the hosts are great people and I absolutely agree with that. They really do try to accommodate many of your preferences. However, there are important things about the listing that also need be pointed out so that future visitors are fully aware of what they do or do not have access to.

ההגעה לדירה הייתה מאוד קלה ונוחה באמצעות התחבורה הציבורית. כך שההנחיה מראש של דייב - בעל הדירה הייתה מדויקת. בנוסף לכך קו מס 14 של הרכבת הקלה אשר מגיע אל הרחוב שליד דירה הוא קו אמין אשר מגיע גם לאזורים שונים בעיר, והיה בהחלט נוח לנסוע בו. בדירה הייתה אווירה מאוד חמה ומכניסת אורחים, כאשר דייב הוסיף בה הרבה תאורה מיוחדת כולל עץ אשוח. וזה נתן הרגשה של חמימות וחגיגיות לקראת השנה החדשה. אני מבקש להמליץ על פריט אחד שיש לתקן בדירה: אני הייתי כאן ביחד עם ביתי, שהיא בת 35. היא קיבלה את החדר ואני ישנתי במיטה שניה שהכינו בעבורי שהיא מיטה בעלת מזרון אוויר. אשר מוקמה בתוך המטבח. אני בן 68 וזה לא היה הכי נוח או אידיאלי בעבורי. אבל הסתדרתי. אני מאמין שיש לתקן/לסדר אלטרנטיבה נוחה יותר. מעבר לכך, יש לציין את הקרבה הרבה אל 3 סופרמרקטים שונים. כמי שמטייל בעולם מזה 45 שנים ברציפות לא תמיד "זכיתי" לזה. וזה בונוס רציני שעומד לזכותו של מי שמתארח בדירה של דייב.
לסיכום: יש כאן בהחלט תמורה לתשלום בעבור האירוח בדירה זו !

Dave's apartment was very cozy and well-designed and helped us have a wonderful three days in Geneva！🤩
The kitchen appliances were very well stocked and we would have made dinner at home ❤️
The location of the apartment is great, with amazing sunrises in the morning and close to the supermarket, it is a very convenient location. if I have the opportunity to come back to Geneva, I would choose to stay here again!！
Amazing stay
Great location, comfortable place
Great apartment with a very unique personal style. Would stay here again!
Great location, easy to get around and lovely local eateries and shops nearby. Place is cozy and comfortable and would definitely stay again!

Super light and bright apartment on the top floor with an elevator.   Great colors and travel art throughout.    Thank you for having the coffee available.   Highly recommend this place for the center of Geneva

Dave’s place was perfect for our trip! So easy to get anywhere as the bus stop is right by, plus most places are walkable. Very clear instructions on getting in and out, and very cozy apartment. Thanks Dave!

Really friendly and helpful Host. everything was as described and the Apartment was beautifully decorated. I would go again anytime.
Thanks a lot

Dave's place was wonderful and cozy. Very conveniently located and close to local transit. Beautifully decorated if you are looking for some MCM style ideas. Clear check-in instructions and responsive communication.
I'd recommend Lahore restaurant down the street, some of the best butter chicken I've had but ask them to make it spicy!
We had a great stay in Dave's cozy apartment in the heart of Jonction. It felt like home away from home!

We absolutely loved Dave’s place! His guide and manual were so detailed, it was truly incredible. We loved the location, the apartment is cute and cozy, loved all his recommendations for things to do and what to eat. Will 100% be back to Geneva, we were so happy with everything. Highly recommend this listing and host!!

This apartment was so unique and beautiful! We really enjoyed our stay here. We had plenty of space to relax and enjoy ourselves, and we really enjoyed the location. Our only downside was that on the day of checkout, we walked back in to the apartment already being cleaned 2 hours before checkout was stated to be. Other than this hiccup, we had a great stay.
Eine stylische kleine dachwohnung. Super gelegen. Wir haben uns sehr wohl gefühlt dort. Dave ist uns noch entgegengekommen mit dem checkout. Das war super nett von ihm. Gerne wieder!

Enjoyed my 2 nights at Dave’s place - very eclectic decor and fun to check out all the travel pictures and souvenirs. Dave was very responsive when I needed help even though he was in an earlier time zone. Very walkable to Old Town and everything I wanted to do. One of the most homey airbnbs I’ve stayed in.

Despite our stay at Dave’s AirBnB being an extremely satisfactory experience, I must note that he failed to supply us with the Geneva transport card which we were entitled to.
