He apologised and claimed to be unaware. After negotiating, the host fully reimbursed us.
The apartment in itself is splendid. It’s quiet, has lots of character, includes all necessary amenities, has great temperature control (we stayed in July), is in a perfect location with a tram stop one block away.
Hopefully, the Geneva transport card issue won't affect future guests since the host informed us that he will register the property with Geneva Tourism &Congress at the end of July 2024.
Dave’s place was wonderful and so convenient with public transportation!
Short and comfortable trip. Enjoyed the decor and feel of the place. Would recommend/stay again
My daughter and I enjoyed our stay!  Comfortable, clean, close to transportation. We enjoyed the restaurant recommendation. Would stay here again!
Great studio apartment in a good location. Close to downtown and major public transit system. Enjoyed our stay

This was the perfect apt for the three of us. We have a one-year-old and it worked well. We cooked etc. My husband was working at the UN but found the bus transport very easy and convenient. My son and I walked all over and enjoyed it very much. Parc de la Grange was very close and a lovely adventure. The apartment was a little warm but Phillipe had a fan for us so we were fine! We love this place and will come again when we are in Geneva!

Acceuil très convivial de Philippe
L'appartement était parfait tant pour sa situation,que sa propreté et ses équipements

Our stay was perfect!  Everything has been well thought out in this apartment.  It was very clean and comfortable and the location was great for sightseeing.  Philippe was a gracious host and we felt extremely comfortable!

Really excelent apartment! Very comfortable, well-equipped, modern, and the location is great. Phillipe is very helpful and kind. Thank you for everything! My husband loved the Nespresso coffee machine!

Philippe was very welcoming and helpful. The place was very clean and a great use of space. Location is very close to grocery and public transport. 4 people were very comfortable. Be sure to try the espresso machine! Kitchen has everything needed to cook at home if you need it.

The apartment was very clean and comfortable and I had a most enjoyable stay. Philippe was very helpful and easy to contact. The location was great, in a lively neighbourhood, just 100 meters or so from the lake and the Jet d'Eau, with lots of shops and supermarkets nearby. If you want to stay at a place which is fantastic than you should choose Philipps place. All is a described and just great. Plus Philipps a super host. Even working close to the airport it is no problem, thanks to easy public transport connections.  Thanks

The location was amazing. It's really close to the lake and groceries. We were able to check in early which was super helpful. After eating out for 9 days, it was nice to finally cook dinner ourselves. Loved every minute of staying here.

Lovely apartment well situated near the lake. Everything within a walking distance. You don't need a car and parking is a real challenge and expensive. Great experience. Both Philippe and Elizabeth were cordial and helpful. We recommend the place.

Philippe is a superhost, the first choice we made was unavailable for the times we booked but at no extra cost Philippe upgraded us to his best apartment. The apartment was in Old Town and could not have been any better anywhere in Geneva. The apartment was modern and warm, just as well as it was very cold outside. Philippe was quick to respond whenever we needed anything , and always on time when he said he would be there.
Anyone thinking of Airbnb in Geneva please contact Philippe, you will not be disappointed !

Apartment très bien placé et confortable. Le mobilier et la cuisine sont récents et fonctionnels.
La cuisine contenait même quelques essentiels comme du sucre, du sel ou si riz.
Philippe nous a également dépanné d'un lit bébé pour notre fille de 1 an.
Je reviendrais sans hésiter.

The apartment is amazing. It's very clean and comfortable to live. Everything is there, so you don't need to worry about kitchen utensils or cleaning stuff. It's only 3 min to Jet D'Eau. Philippe is very pleasant and communicative host.

Philippes's apartment was exactly what we were looking for, and after 30 days of hotel rooms throughout Europe it was fantastic to have the extra space and freedom.  Lots of little extras in the apartment that we didn't expect but helped make the stay very comfortable.  Philippe was a very accommodating and flexible host.
Clean apartment, and amenities available as described. The photos that Philippe's shared is accurate. Location is very convenient to central location

I will recommended this appartments!
I traveling with my mum and my little 5 month baby. We had a double bed and Philippe brought special for my baby a baby crib. It's was very comfortable to have separate bed for baby.Everything fine and perfect! Right on the Corner you will found the Jet. Just 10 minutes walk to the Old town.

The apartment is centrally located to shopping, restaurants and the lake... the apartment is clean, modern and well appointed. Connectivity is a breeze. Philippe was a great host with good communication.

Fabulous location just a few minutes from the beautiful lake, and the jet d'eau. the flat was super clean and very well equipped - for example the kitchen has everything you would need to cook properly, there is an ironing board, a drawer of helpful maps and guidebooks and even dvds. Across the road is a wonderful bakery with fresh juices and salads, a supermarket around the corner and lots of restaurants of different prices.

This place is a gem. Superb location right near the Jet D'Eau, easy walking distance to everything you could want. Very clean, well furnished, and plenty of space. We were 2 adults and 1 child (9 year old) for a full week and found the accommodations perfect for us. Great bed and surprisingly comfortable sofa bed. Philippe was very responsive and ensured we had everything we needed as per the posting.  Only thing to note is that Geneva can be quite warm in summer and there is no air conditioning, but Philippe provided 2 fans which worked fine for us. We would absolutely stay here again!
Wonderful place to stay, at an ideal location. Everything is clean, well organized and perfect for a couple or small group of friends for a holiday.

The stay at Philippe's apartment was perfect in every respect! This apartment is beautiful, very nicely cared for,  in a fantastic location, and felt just like 'home'. I enjoyed the plethora or restaurants in the area and running along the lake in the early morning. Philippe is truly a SUPER host! He is incredibly responsive, helpful, and kind. Es un lugar muy recomendable tanto por ubicacion como los servicios del apartamento.

Super hôte et joli appartement

The location is near all sorts of places,  such that walking was our norm.   For furthern destinations. the bus stop is less than a block away.  Great value in Geneva.
Perfect location and a nice clean place!

This is a great apartment - perfect for a single or couple. It’s got everything you could need and it’s location is central whilst also being a real community. Great location!!

The apartment is clean, modern, a good size and has a lift. There are so many thoughtful touches, from the maps to the umbrella for the wet March weather, the Netflix on TV, the English channels, Swiss charger plug if you bring only the euro socket converter as we did! I could go on.
Philippe was an excellent host and went above and beyond! We are super grateful for his hospitality and his fantastic communication throughout.

This was also great as it was our first introduction to the fantastic public transport network of the city.
We were a group of 2 couples, 2 in the bedroom and 2 on the comfy sofabed - We recommend this apartment!

Amazing place in the center of Geneva. The apartment is much better compared to the pictures! Very nice district and a warm thanks to Philippe for his kindness and flexibility!

Excellent flat. Spacious, clean, very practical and in a wonderful location just two minutes walk from the lake and with all the amenities within walking distance. I stayed in this flat for over a month and really felt at home.

Found Dave’s place easily enough. I know Geneva fairly well, but first time in this end of the city. Fantastic gym right next to apartment though only worth it if you are staying more than few days. Went swimming in the river at the end of the street and it was the ultimate crazy river. Awesome! Was over 30 degrees so that helped too.

We loved our stay here and probably enjoyed spending time in this Loft just about as much as we enjoyed exploring Geneva! Also, Dave gave great restaurant and activity recommendations which set us up nicely for a short but thorough trip.
Just perfect! So cozy and comfortable. I love it and will try to stay again!

Dave's place is located in a very convenient spot to get anywhere, by foot or by the excellent public transport Geneva offers. The bus stops a minute away. Dave's apartment is beautifully furnished with vintage furniture. Although on a main road the apartment is facing the back and the river and suffers from no noise.
Dave was very responsive and helpful, always available.
A great Pied-à-terre for exploring Geneva.

Dave’s place is a real gem! Fantastic location for exploring the city and very easy to find. We really loved the vintage interior and cosy vibe of the place. Highly recommend.

Un bel appartement mansardé pour séjourner avec l'intérieur vintage et l'ambiance confortable. Il était propre, bien organisé et l'arrivée était facile. L’appartement correspond à la description. Dave a été très réactif lorsque nous avons eu des questions. La communication a été claire. Au-delà des attentes !  Un excellent pied-à-terre pour explorer Genève.

We felt very comfortable in Dave's beautiful flat. The furniture and furnishings are very stylishly put together and we found beautiful details right up to the last day. It was a lovely and cosy retreat for a week in Geneva. And Dave was very quick to respond to our questions!
We will be back when we come to Geneva.
Many thanks for a lovely stay!

The apartment is part of a beautiful old building with great views of the mountains. There’s everything you need inside and it feels really homely. Dave is an excellent host, really communicative, flexible and thoughtful. I would 100% recommend this to others and stay again! Love Geneva, love the location, love the apartment!

Dave’s place was great! Check in was easy, the bed was comfortable, the decor was charming, and it was very clean. Dave was very responsive to our questions and very helpful!
It got warm in the apartment but opening the windows cooled it down. It’s in a great location to walk the city. Note to visitors who have a car: there is a parking ramp near by that’s reasonably priced. You’ll want to get your ticket upon entering and bring it with you. When you return to pick up your car, pay at the pay station outside the ramp first, then bring the receipt to use at the exit. You cannot pay at the exit gate like in the United States - we learned that the hard way!
Anyways, we’d recommend Dave’s place! We really enjoyed our stay!

Loved Dave’s place and would definitely stay again if we’re in Geneva. Great location, walkable to the lake and the train station, and he’s an incredible decorator! Also really appreciated the restaurant recommendations - thanks, Dave!
Nice for a short visit. The flat was a little cluttered and it was hard to find available electricity outlets.

The apartment was well equipped and lived in, clean, with a great location. There are good restaurants nearby, and the River Rhine has swimming locations within close walking distance that were the highlight of our visit to Genève! Dave was very responsive and provided good directions. The apartment was too warm one night due to limited air conditioning, but that was on a very hot day (around 90F). Our second night was only a hot day and the air conditioner kept the sleeping area cool enough.  The windows also open  providing a breeze through the unit when needed. I would definitely stay in this unit again!

Nice living room with plenty of seating, entertainment center, and full dining table. The whole apartment is so stylishly decorated I was obsessed. Also he had an AC unit for the bedroom so despite the heatwave the apartment stayed cool (it’s open layout), especially the sleeping area. Would stay here again 100 times. Would move in if he let me.

Dave's place was squeaky clean and very very cool – he's done such a great job with his decor and theme, we loved it. The location was so close to the river which made going for a swim very easy, and lots of cute spots nearby. We loved our time at Dave's and would definitely stay again in the future!
Deuxième séjour chez Dave.  je suis toujours aussi ravie. Merci Dave

Amazing place - super thoughtfully designed and in a convenient location, easy to get to and loved spending time in the place (didn’t even want to go out!). Would definitely recommend to anyone thinking of staying in Geneva and would love to return.

Well this has to be the most beautifully decorated AirBnB I have been in.
I love the warm colours and design of the 1960s-1980s, and his place was so tastefully decorated and furnished with things from that period, plus excellent lighting, and with Christmas close, even had three Christmas trees of various sizes, all decorated and lit in of the same period too.
The area is good - to get a solid feel of what inner suburban Geneva is like, with supermarkets, cafes, and lots of publc transport passing on the street this place is on.
It's walking distance to the city centre, so can see the variety going from Jonction suburbia to the hearts of the old and new centres of Geneva.
Thanks Dave for kindly letting me experience you skill and passion to make a beautiful living space.

Had a lovely stay and would highly recommend this Airbnb. The location in Jonction is excellent—central, well connected by tram and bus, and surrounded by great local spots. Having a Migros just across the street was especially convenient.
Stayed for six nights over the Christmas period, and the apartment felt warm and welcoming. It was nicely decorated with a Christmas tree and festive touches, which made spending the holiday there feel special and comfortable. Everything was well appointed and thoughtfully arranged, and just as beautiful as it looked in the listing. The kitchen was great to use, and the bathroom was clean and well maintained.
A big thank you to Dave for kindly accommodating our request for a later check-out on Christmas Day—it was very much appreciated. Overall, a wonderful stay and a place we’d happily return to.
Amazing place. Super cosy with thoughtful decor and gadgets.
Great communication, nice place, short commute or walk into the centre. Recommended spot with a nice host.

I was drawn in by the MCM design and found Dave's place quite comfortable in a great location of Geneva. Dave was a proactive host and a stellar communicator. His place had everything we needed as a landing pad for exploring Geneva - easily accessible by tram or foot. One can get to the lake easily, or to historic old town, or up the street to a peaceful forest with a surprise zoo.
Having had a few hot days leading up to our visit, it was nice to be able to open the windows for a cross breeze or use the a/c and fan. Dave's got it all!
There is a bit of street noise on the living room side due to a busy street below, but the bedroom is located at the back and is a quieter area of the flat.

Lucia is an absolutely wonderful host. She is very friendly, helpful, and always available if needed. When I arrived in Europe, my plane was several hours late after various mishaps in my connection in Rome. Lucia worked with me and was very understanding, and after I arrived was provided a delicious warm dinner which was exactly what I needed after the ordeal. Lucia provided maps and walked me around the neighborhood, showing me how to get around the city and helping me find the services (tram stops, etc) I was likely to use. I stayed in the apartment for a little under three months, in that time I only have positive things to say about my interactions with her.

Lucia's apartment is large, spacious, bright, clean, and beautiful. The apartment is split into three areas: a common area with kitchen, living room, and dining area (where the delicious breakfast is every morning), and then on either side of the common area are two wings with bedrooms and baths. Since the guest area has its own wing there is a lot of privacy if desired, but the common area is also very welcoming. The apartment is located less than 5 minutes walk away from both the Vieusseux and Servette TPG stops, which makes it convenient to get around the city.

The breakfast is fantastic. There is always fresh fruit, yogurt, meats and cheeses, cereal, and toast with a variety of spreads, and there are always warm meals ready to order: scrambled eggs with ham, crepes, bacon, whatever you like. She is very receptive to requests if there is something special you like. She also will definitely work with your schedule, whether you want to eat early in the morning or have a brunch, she is a very accommodating host.

Towels and slippers are provided. The bed is also made every day, making for a very comfortable experience.

I can absolutely recommend Lucia's apartment to anyone visiting Geneva without any reservations.

Again a wonderful experience at Lucia's.... The layout of the apartment is just ideal.... Its super clean and Lucia herself was just superb. Can't rate this place highly enough and would look to stay here again in the future! Thanks again Lucia

This was my first time with Airbnb, I went to Geneva for one week for working in UN. I can assure that was awesome. I had previously made a reservation in a local hotel, however I canceled when  a friend told me about Airbnb, where I found Lucia’s apartment. Her location is unique for who’s going to have a meeting at UN. It's very easy to go by bus. You can even go walking, takes no more than 20 minutes in a pleasant path. I went walking some days. If I had some more time, I would have rented a bike. The apartment is close to Central Station (Gare Cornavin), the lake and the Old town. You can either choose among taking the public transportation or walking and take advantage to know shops, bars and restaurants. You  can be sure that location, comfort, cleanliness and hospitality are Lucia’s highlights. The room is very silent, large and comfortable, just as shown on the pictures. You can count with a good space to store your clothes, important in case you need to stay longer. I would highlight, yet, privacy and a wonderful breakfast, as told by other guests.  I’m an usual traveller, and client of Marriott Hotels and I can assure that I was accommodated as well as Lucias’s apartment. Lucia is an adorable and polite  person. As a hoster I wouldn’t do better.  She provided me with valuable tips and was always concerned with my welfare during my stay. I’m sure that, if had stayed in a Hotel, I wouldn’t had such a great time as I did staying with Lucia. I hope to  meet  Lucia soon, if not in her apartment in Madrid, in my home in Brazil, she is already invited. Thank ‘s to you, Lucia, my trip was so  special! Hug, Juliana.

I stayed at Lucia's place for 4 nights prior to a conference I was attending in Geneva. Although I feared it might be weird to rent a room in an apartment that other people are living in, I had a very good experience. The apartment is divided nicely into a residents sections and a visitors sections, with toilets and bath. Everything was very nice and clean. The breakfasts were a real treat (compared to what I got at the hotel I switched to afterwards). She even went through all the trouble to get me vegan products for breakfast especially!

The apartment itself is located near the city center (which is very small, and can be crossed by foot in 30 minutes) and public transport lines. Lucia was very lenient with me getting in and out whenever I wanted, even when everybody else already went to sleep.

As you can see, Lucia is a wonderful host. Very kind and always willing to help and explain. I enjoyed my stay in her home very much, and I recommend anyone coming to Geneva to stay at her place.

I spent 5 weeks in Lucia's house during my internship in Geneva. The house is big, very comfortable, well furnished and always clean. Public transports are just 1 minute walk from the house, shops, restaurants and groceries 3 minutes away. The area is very quiet and you can reach both the city center and the UN headquarters in a nice 15 minutes walk. Lucia is a wonderful host, she's very helpful, kind and well tempered. She's always willing for advices or for nice chats. I kindly reccomend her place and I would definitely stay there again in my next stay in Geneva. Anna

I have booked a place for one month with Lucia as I was moving to Geneva and needed some time before I could settle and find a more permanent place. Due to some issues back home I have arrived a few weeks later, and then reserved another month, staying in total slightly over 1 month.

The location of the apartment is close to several tram and bus stops, or it takes only 20 minutes to walk to the main train station.

On my arrival Lucia has answered all my questions about the city, gave advice and even got me a map! She is very respectful and understanding, and we didn't have any problems during my stay. Also, I could come to her with any questions regarding the culture and the city.

The apartment is spotless, what is quite important for me. The room itself is quite small, but I could study in the living room (just clean up afterwards). It is a quiet and calm environment for somebody who studies or works. Overall, the stay was pleasant and I would recommend to stay there.

I had a LOVELY stay at Lucia's in Geneva. I was in Geneva to conduct research for my PhD so it was great being able to work from the apartment and be walking distance to UNHCR, ICRC and central Geneva (20-30 minutes walk). The room was bright and comfortable - lots of space to hang my clothes and unpack which was nice and a desk to get some work done. Lucia was incredibly welcoming, when she noticed that I preferred plain yoghurt and nectarines brought some especially for me. When I am next in Geneva for my work, I shall definitely stay here again.

I stayed with Lucia for 10 days.  Lucia is kind, gentle and gracious host and I enjoyed very much my stay with her.  My room is fully furnished and the apartment itself is very clean and tidy.  Plus, the location is very convenient and I didn't have problems finding my way around Geneva.  I also enjoyed the few times chatting with Lucia and learning something from her.  I hope that in my next visit to Geneva, I will be able to stay with Lucia again.  Thanks so much Lucia!  - Kathy

I had a wonderful stay with Lucia at her apartment in Geneva recently. Lucia is a fabulous host, kind, friendly and thoughtful. She went out of her way to make my stay as comfortable as possible; she made sure she got me the breakfast of my choice, showed me around the immediate area so that I felt at home, provided me with maps and directions and even offered to meet me in case I got lost! She even gave me a gift which was a lovely surprise. The room was beautifully clean and I had all the space I needed for my things. I'd never done Airbnb before but I definitely made the right choice going to Lucia's. Thank you so much Lucia, I will be back!

Lucia's apartment is very clean and tidy. The room is very comfortable. Lucia is a nice and gracious host. The location is good because it is close to the international organizations that can be easily reached by taking bus n. 11

Mon séjour dans l'appartement de Lucia s'est très bien passé. Je n'ai pas été déçue. Il est vraiment très proche de la gare et du quartier des Nations Unies, ce qui est super pratique pour ceux qui viennent en train et qui doivent assister à des conférences ou autres. Je n'ai pas eu de difficultés pour le côté des transports communs. Il est aussi situé dans un quartier paisible à proximité de points de commerce pour aller faire ses courses, pas besoin d'aller bien loin. Le logement était super grand, propre et toutes les pièces étaient bien entretenues.
Je n'ai pas eu la chance de croiser Lucia car elle était en vacances. Mais par l'intermédiaire de son voisin, elle a veillé à ce que tout se passe pour le mieux en étant aux petits soins :)
J'ai vraiment passé un bon séjour, j'en garderai de très bons souvenirs et je recommande vivement l'appartement de Lucia car on s'y sent vite comme chez soi. D'ailleurs, je reviendrai, à coup sûr :)

I stayed at Lucia's apartment from 17-26 July. From booking, to finding and staying at the place, up to making last minute extension had been smooth and hassle-free.

Her place is clean, well-maintained. My visit coincided with her vacation, so I wasn't able to personally meet her. But Lucia kindly made arrangements for me to be welcomed by her home-keeper, and show me the way to the apartment.

Truly recommend her place for Geneva trips.

Her apartment is really clean, tidy and big! I spent very nice time in her place. She was on vacation so I didn't see her. However, she was really supportive with her e-mail, and told me how to get there or what to do. Thank you very much!!

This was my first experience of Airbnb and at first I thought I must be expecting too much because nothing seemed to match what I'd been led to believe.  I arrived when my host was away, so had to find my own way there, and be let into the apartment by someone who spoke virtually no English. We coped, with my extremely limited French. Some food was provided for breakfast but the reality was I catered for myself. So it took some time to find my way around, and three days to reset the TV to get it working. For a week I was the only one there, which had its good points but again was not expected. Then, given I had booked For Ladies Only, I was surprised when the other guests arrived and they were men. Fortunately Lucia was always on email to answer my questions, and, when she returned was able to explain things. Lucia was a lovely host, kind and generous, and her apartment was extremely pleasant: sunny and spacious, with a balcony I found pleasant to use on warm evenings. The street was generally quiet and my sleep was undisturbed. I love to walk and found it a manageable distance walking to the central train station, though not with luggage. It is a short tram ride.  Lucia's house rules are reasonable and the room itself had everything I needed. My stay turned out to be a great experience and I even liked the guys who so took me by surprise. I will be returning

Lucia is a very nice host, always willing to help! The apartment is really clean, room is rather small but sufficient for one person. The area is quiet and has a few shops and restaurants. The tram stop is within 3 minutes walk for the house, and it takes you directly to the city center. I really enjoyed my stay in Lucia's home! She is a very nice, open and interesting person!

This was a wonderful place to stay: great location, easy access and communication, great amenities. The host was very understanding when I had to make changes to the booking, which was much appreciated.

Estar en la casa de Lucia fue sin duda una linda y agradable experiencia. El día de mi llegada, la persona encargada de recibirme, Rosario, había cocinado una cena y me mostró el espacio que me correspondía, me enseño acerca de como usar los servicios y la cocina; y aunque Lucia no se encontraba en casa Rosario siempre estuvo pendiente de mis necesidades, al igual que Lucia a la distancia.
En la habitación habían detalles como agua y frutas, mapas de la ciudad, guía de transporte público, algunos panfletos de actividades culturales a realizarse en Ginebra y pañuelos desechables.
El desayuno fue excelente y saludable.
La organización de la casa te permite tener tu propio espacio, donde tienes acceso a un baño privado y de aislamiento sonoro del resto de la casa.
La cocina esta adaptada para poder cocinar y se tiene espacio en el refrigerador para las compras propias.
La ubicación de la casa no es tan céntrica pero queda cerca de una parada de tramway, lo que te permite estar en el centro muy pronto.
El barrio es seguro y la casa se encuentra cerca de un supermercado, lavandería y restaurantes de comida rápida.
Fue en general una gran estadía!

I had a great stay at Lucia’s. Having been a first-timer both on AirBnB and in Europe basically, Lucia’s hospitality made it quite easy for me to adjust quickly. She and her family were very kind and considerate, and always ensured that my stay was comfortable. Her house was always clean and smelled nice all the time. Their location is also superb! It was so easy to get around with several public transportation options.
Appartement propre et bien placé. La chambre n’était pas tout à fait comme présentée dans l’annonce. Un peu difficile d’y trouver sa place pour un séjour de long terme. Mais globalement bon séjour.

Lucia's place is better than the photos show you. Its a beautiful apartment and very bright and cosy. It is very easy to move around from anywhere and access to public transport was very easy. The house is clean and quiet too! It is definitely the place to stay when in Geneva!
I am grateful for a clean home and a friendly host, who even provided breakfast, during my stage. A big thank you Lucia!

Great host who paid attention to detail which made my work trip less strenuous. Easy check-in and check out. Very central to my location I had a choice of walking or taking the bus to my workshop location.
Lucia est très accueillante et la chambre était très bien.

Lucia and her cohost shalem are very friendly. I had a wonderful experience there. We share our own culture, stories and hobbies, and even play board games and cook together. The room is clean and tidy. Their place is an ideal choice for your short-term or long-term stay in Geneva.

The room is very small and not really clean. The walls in the apartment are very thin, so you can hear every sound from the toilet. In addition, the hostess is sometimes very loud in the evening and invites friends, so that one can sleep badly. The cleanliness in the rest of the common rooms is bad, there are ants and other insects in the bathroom, the toilet was dirty and the kitchen is dirty too. Furthermore my blanket was stained. Lucia is a very unfriendly and unpleasant hostess. This was the worst experience I ever had in an AirBnB!
The price-performance ratio does not match what you get.
Je suis extrêmement satisfaite de logement dans l'appartement Lucia. Le service était de premier ordre. Toutes les conditions de confort étaient réunies.

Así como existen superhéroes sin capa, existen superhost sin sello y definitivamente Lucía es una!
Lucía te abreas puertas de su casa y te hace sentir un hogar cuando llegas a un nuevo lugar lejos de tu familia.
Desde que ví el anuncio sentí una buena energía y lo reservé para tener un lugar a dónde llegar antes de encontrar un lugar permanente en Ginebra.
Desde las instrucciones y comunicación previa a mi llegada Lucía fue muy amable y estuvo pendiente de mis necesidades, hora de llegada y gustos del desayuno.
Al llegar, desde el primer día me sentí como en casa 🏠
Las áreas comunes se comparten con otros huéspedes y con la buena energía de Lucía se crea una linda comunidad con la que compartimos experiencias historias y consejos.
Quedarte en la casa de Lucía más que un hospedaje, es una EXPERIENCIA!
Gracias por todo Lucía 😊 te doy mis sellos: 🦸🏽‍♀️🦹🏽‍♀️👼🏽🪽✨💫💯

Mejor experiencia de un Aribnb hasta ahora, Desde la hora de llegada me sentí acompañado y así fue todo el tiempo que estuve de visita. Para cualquier situación o problema que se pueda llegar a presentar está presente y dispuesta a ayudar.
Muchas gracias por el acompañamiento y recomendaciones, no duden en rentar con Lucia, no hay una experiencia igual, muchas gracias!

Great place! I would definitely recommend it for any length of stay. Lucia is a fantastic host very understanding, caring and attentive. The place is clean, nicely decorated and has a kitchen with all that you can possibly need. The location is quiet and serene, making it ideal for a relaxing stay. My room was tidy and  comfortable. Will definitely come back in my upcoming visits to Geneva. Thank you Lucia.
Not a bad one but there are room for improvements

L'appartement est charamant mais le bruit de la rue terrible ( la chambre donne sur la rue et au 1er étage et aussi en face d'une église ...)
la deuxieme chambre est en fait un clic clac ... donc en résumé malgré un appartement très agréable ... le lieu est cher compte tenu q'il n'y a en fait qu'une seule vraie chambre ...
Les images du lieu sont très justes ...
Lucas le propriétaire à par contre été très sympa et cordial au téléphone au tel ...
Un deuxieme vrai lit, et une vraie isolation sur la rue ... Je serai peut être revenu dans cet appartement ...
Merci quand même Lucas ...
Michel

I was looking forward to my stay and felt it would be a good option for my work trip to Geneva on which a friend joined me to explore the city. Instead, the apartment was a major disappointment and we were only able to stay one of the four nights I booked. After being informed that an air conditioning unit was in the apartment (which I checked in advance knowing it was warmer than normal in Geneva) we arrived to an extremely hot apartment after a transatlantic flight since the unit did not work properly. We informed the owner who told us it worked and brought us one additional small fan. On the one night we attempted to stay, we learned there was not enough bedding for the two beds advertised and noted other issues (ripped and stained couch, broken shower, scuffed walls throughout) that do not fit the description of a modern and clean apartment on the Airbnb site. I see a few other recent reviews, but then nothing for a couple years so I’m wondering if the apartment used to be nicer and of course it will be more bearable in other seasons. I know everyone has different standards but this experience unfortunately did not live up to mine (and this is my only negative Airbnb review after years of using the service).

Apartamento muy bonito, tal como está en el anuncio.
Esta muy bien ubicado.
Phillip muy amable

A wonderful stay in a great location within close walking distance to everything. Even has a washer AND dryer which was key with young kids. It is on the 5th floor though so be prepared to walk up, otherwise the elevator was large enough for a small stroller and suitcase at the same time. A great stay!
I’ve stayed with Philippe now so many times I forget.  This was my first time in this flat though and I can say it is perfect.  It is notable for being spacious, modern, and extra clean.
Phillips apartment is perfectly appointed and he is a very good host.
Great place, as seen in pictures.  Wry central and easy to access all points of interest in the city. The communication with Philip was easy, timely and precise.
Perfect place to stay, near old town and fountain. It's clean and cosy

Very comfortable and well situated apartment. Street can be busy but quiet if you close the windows. Sofa bed is very comfortable and easy to pull out and put back up. Small convenience store right next door that stays open late, tons is shopping and restaurants nearby.
excellent location! greatly equipped

We enjoyed our stay. Good public transport and code to lake. Quiet and private. Equiped with most necessities- dish washing tablets and more washing up liquid would have been helpful. Comfortable bed. Sheets as a cooler option rather than just a heavy doona would have been good. Everything else was great 😊
The apartment was great. We were 2 blocks away from jet d’eau
We had stayed in this building years ago as it is five blocks from my daughter and her family. We were aware there was no a/c, but didn’t expect hot hot weather in Geneva.
Great place in a perfect location
Excellent location, good apartment for a couple! We enjoyed our stay and would love to come back again !

Phillippe hosted my husband and son. They had a great stay! Phillipe was very responsive with his communication, which really helped me as I was relaying messages to my family. If any of us are in Geneva again, we will certainly hope for a stay at Phillippe's place. Thank you!
Appartamento completo di tutto, posizione perfetta e Host gentilissimo. Lo consiglio.

We had a lovely stay here in Genève! We loved the neighborhood, near the lake, easy to walk to many places. The apartment was clean and the kitchen was very well equipped. The hosts were very quick to reply to any questions, we would come back anytime! Merci bien Philippe!
A very good base near the centre of Geneva.

Philippe’s place is wonderful. Everything is clean and in order. Comfy beds and all amenities provided are good. The location of this place is great! Even though at one of the main street but it’s extremely quiet and peaceful. Philippe was also very helpful. We had a great time in Geneva staying at his place.
This place is two blocks to the water Jet in the lac. Great location and neighborhood. Lovely apartment. Our host is awesome - helpful and very responsive👍👍

Phillipe's place is nice overall, clean and reasonably well appointed.  The location is on a main street and is therefore noisy, even late into the night.  This is an issue when you open the windows (which you have to, given that Switzerland doesn't believe in air conditioning), making it hard to sleep with the noisy scooters zooming by at 1am. Apart from that, no major issues.
close to the water and nice apartment for a short visit. Phillippe was very helpful and communicative.
The unit was as described and very clean with great amenities.
this definitely wasn’t my favorite airbnb that i’ve stayed in, but it was pretty cheap and a last minute booking so it was fine for a quick stay

Lovely apartment close to lots of restaurants and shops and the Jet d'eau. The only downside was that the AC was only in the bedroom, so we didn't really use the living room at all because it was too hot. They did have fans that helped though. All in all it was a good experience.

Fantastic location. Well appointed kitchen with everything you need to cater for the family at home. Pleasant view. Comfy bed and sofa bed. A bit noisy and hot at night but plenty of fans provided and the flip side is great people watching from the window.
Nice apartment and nice host

We had an excellent stay at Philippe's place in Geneva. It is close to Eaux-Vives with easy transportation to anywhere, and the Jet d'Eau is right at the street corner. There's a good view of Salève from the upper-floor apartment. We had everything we needed, and there's easy shopping for groceries and bread in the street. Note the bathroom is a bit cramped. The neighborhood is not too busy and we slept well every night.

Appartement très bien situé! Hôtes disponibles, attentionnés et réactifs.
Je recommande cet Airbnb!
Great apartment, has everything you need, my stay was wonderful

Our stay in Geneva was perfect staying in this accommodation. Very close to lake, jet, markets, old town and shopping. Mini market and large supermarket near by. Kitchen facilities were great for cooking simple meals. It was a great stopover to catch up with washing etc. having the washer and dryer in the room was fantastic. Being up high and able to open windows was a big plus. Would love to come back…

The pros: great location near the water jet, Geneva Open tennis venue, and an easy walk to the old town and shopping district. The unit was well equipped, with dishes, cutlery, and essentials (shampoo, toilet paper). Great/safe neighborhood, with restaurants and grocery stores nearby. Philippe's co-host was very helpful, trying her best to address a tv issue and connect the AC (see below). She also showed us how to empty the water from the non-vented dryer after each load (as North Americans, it was our first experience with a dryer not having an outflow air vent). Good Wi-Fi and laundry.
The cons: the AC is a window unit not central air, so realistically it can cool only one room so you must choose between cooling bedroom or living area. The AC had not been prepared in advance of our visit because the weather had been cool but fortunately our co-host was willing and able to set up the window unit when we insisted. The bathroom was dimly lit, is a tight spot, and could use updating.
Had a lovely stay, perfect for the quick stop over, near the lake and restaurants

Locația e foarte buna, locuința frumoasa, dar nu are aer condiționat, doar niste ventilatoare care mișcă puțin aerul. Cu geamurile deschise noaptea, nu se poate dormi de gălăgia care vine din strada... Din păcate nu ne-am putut odihni noaptea in apartament.

We really enjoyed this Airbnb. It was a comfortable walking distance for us. It’s a few blocks away from the bus station. Possibly a 3-5 minute walks not bad at all.
The space was very clean. They provided fans for us which was very nice. The place was clean and all the neighbors were very polite and nice.
I would recommend this place if you want to stay in the Eaux Vives area.
It was a very pleasant stay, a great location. Right in between two bus stops, basically a block from the lake. I would definitely stay there again. The hosts were very responsive, good people.

We had a wonderful stay at Philippe's place. The apartment is in an excellent location. Walkable to Geneva fountain. Kitchen well stocked. Very responsive host. Will recommend to friends and would love to stay again.

Already few times was a guest in Philippe apartments.
As always he's apartments in a good condition with all necessary to stay for a few days or weeks.
Responsible and good host.

The apartment was great! It had everything we needed four our stay in Geneva. Very clean and had great amenities, especially the smart tv and washer and dryer. After two weeks of travel it was a great place to unwind before going home.
Location is great: near the lake, a supermarket next door and an excellent sandwich shop on the corner.
We would definitely stay here again!
Lovely location, well equipped.  They replenished stock when requested to do so.
Todo perefecto. Departamento tal como se describe, muy buena ubicación. Siempre que les escribimos, respondieron con ambailidad. Recomendable!

We only stayed for a few days, but everything was perfect great location, quiet surroundings, and excellent service. The owner was very responsive and always available. Thank you for a wonderful stay. 5 stars! ⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐

Sono stato molto soddisfatto, ho trovato camera molto carina ben arredata e pulita , ho trovato la colazione pronta in frigo , un cesto di frutta fresca sul tavolo , caffe' in cialde , asciugamani , accappatoio e doccia schiuma .  Il posto almeno per la mia comodita' vicino all'aeroporto. Anche il coinquilino molto gentile  e riservato . Se avessi ancora bisogno , sicuramente non avrei dubbi a ritornarci . Grazie . Giampietro

This place is nicely situated near some international organizations with good public transportation to Geneva centre. The room is spacious, clean and comfortable and I got a warm welcome. Since a heat wave hit Geneva it was really a bit too hot because the room has no airconditioning. Fortunatly I brought my swimming trunks and could jump in the pool. Breakfast was simple but sufficient, with the food being available in the present fridge. A plus were the drinks fruit and chocolate! The coffee was nice too. I really liked the little village of Vernier with some beautiful views and some nice restaurants (5 min walk, I strongly advise you to walk through the park of the 'mairie' and enjoy the view of the Mont Blanc). A had a really nice stay, the only downside was that you could hear the plains flying over.

Ho scelto questa casa perché era tra le più vicine all'aeroporto perché sono partito di mattina molto presto, e infatti le linee di autobus che mi portano lì sono numerose tutto il giorno - per il resto a casa ci sono stato molto poco e il poco che ci sono stato non ho avuto problemi anche perché, nonostante la presenza di altri ospiti, ci sono due bagni con lavandino e gabinetto, mentre la doccia è in uno solo dei due.
Lovely hosts, the fridge stocked with basics was much appreciated. Close to aéroport and palexpo and not too far from the city centre

we needed Yael's place for 5 nights due to close location to my husband office, the house is very nice and clean, the bathroom is on the same level as the room  (not in the room), a bit of noise from the airplanes flying just above the house, breakfast was ok.
Great place near airport. Nice rooms nice lady.

Yael et sa tante (oncle aussi) sont adorables. L’accueil chaleureux et efficace. La chambre est trés confortables et propre. Pour moi la localisation était parfaite. Le bus 28 a quelques pas me convenait beaucoup. Je vais surement rentrer chez eux. Il y avait toujours des petits délices au frigo. On sent la vraie hospitalité suisse chez eux. Merci
Very nice and cosy room in beautiful place ( 7 min. on foot to Rone). Very friendly people. Thank you!
Very nice and pleasant rim in a private house. Very recommendable! And it came with a fridge stocked with items for breakfast. Thank you!
it was a pleasure to stay at Yael's place again. Thank you!

Lucas and his wife were very welcoming and showed me around the apartment - where everything was located - where to find cutlery, dishes, pots/pans, etc. - explained how everything worked.    They included some basic necessities so we didn't have to immediately run out to the store, which was quite nice as I had spent the 17 hours prior to arrival travelling to Geneva.   They explained how to get to the bus line that I needed for business.    All in all a very positive and comfortable experience!    We would definitely stay there again

EVERYTHING WAS ABOVE OUR EXPECTATIONS ! We will keep a wonderful memory of our trip to Geneva We would love to come back to beautiful place and espescially this appartment..
The apartment itself met our every need, it was so comfortable and stylish we had absolutely everything we required, i stayed for 14 days and it was amazing experience to discover Genève from central and closed location.
Everything is nearly, (supermarket, pharmacy, restaurants) and i took me a view mintes to reach the downtown by walking.
The apartment was so well equipped and comfortable, large space with a beautiful living room and a fully equipped kitchen, wich help us to cook for my kids.

Lucas Thank you again for your kindness helping us.
Hope to see you again

Great location, spotless and extremely comfortable!  Many little grocery stores and we cooked in more than we ate out.  Exceptional amenities like apple TV and Nespresso coffee maker.  Lucas filled the fridge with food for us for the stay.  Very thoughtful!
Everything was perfect! Lucas is an amazing host.

Lucas is friendly and a nice guy. The flat was accurate to the description. The location is nice and clam.
I would stay there again and do recommend Lucas as a host
공항과 도심에서 접근이 너무 편리하고 르혼 강과 제네바 호수 등 중요 지역에 편리한 이동이 가능해서 좋았습니다.
The place was very clean, comfortable and near to the center. The Bus stop was not even one minute away. It was a great stay

I had guests from abroad so they were in Lucas apartment. The place is great, just as described and even better. Lucas is most attentive host who is interested in your needs before you come, so when you arrive all is in perfect order. I am fully recommending his place. Thank you for everything!!!!😀
Gepflegte Wohnung, gut organisierte Übergabe. Wunderbar.
A great spot for our family to spend a couple of days wandering around Geneva!
Logement très agréable et spacieux, parfait pour un groupe de 5-6 personnes. Impeccablement propre et très pratique d'accès depuis la  gare ou l'aéroport.

Wir kamen in einer familiären Abgelegenheit, und dieser Ort war großartig um
Zeit zusammen zu verbringen. Wir fühlten uns sehr wohl, alles klappte reibungslos!
Central, large and clean flat. Groceries, pharmacy and restaurants nearby. Easy walk to town. Host was easy to reach and accommodating.
Nice and cozy place at a good location in Geneva and a very nice host. Very suitable for families with young children as well.
Super appartement!
Bellissimo loft arredato con cura. Pulito e ben collegato con i mezzi pubblici sia al centro che all’aeroporto

We had a wonderful stay in Lucas’ apartment! Lucas was very responsive to email questions and left us great instructions. The apartment was very clean and nicely appointed. We enjoyed the easy access to the bus stop just across the street. We appreciated the food etc that was left for us to have a bite to eat after a long day of travel getting to Geneva.

Visited Geneva with my parents, Lucas’ loft was just what I’d envision for a home away from home. Cute apartment with a lovely patio, All amenities were provided for a very convenient stay, super clean apartment, a little short of a 30min walk to the city center, with restaurants and grocery stores nearby.

Staying at Lucas place was a good experience for our family with two kids. The space was like in the pictures - sleeping arrangements a bit different but it was fine for our needs. We found the loft cozy, large, bright and properly equipped. We enjoyed the small garden and terrace as well.
The neighborhood was a bit noisy due to closeness of public transportation, but the immediate access to bus station was a big plus for us.
So, thank you for accepting us as your guests. Monica
Beautiful house with supermarket and shops nearby. 20 minutes walk to shopping and Cornavin train station. Great location
We enjoyed our stay at Lucas place. He is a great host.
This place is nice and  clean. It's also located by the bus station which is very convenient.
Gorgeous space in a beautiful neighborhood. Had a splendid time.

Our stay at Lucas’s place was amazing! The space is beautifully decorated and actually felt like our home. It is equipped with all the essentials for a comfortable stay. There are several buses and tram stations nearby the apartment. Its central location allowed us easily explore the city.
Lucas is a great host. He provided every information we need for check-in and responded quickly.
We highly recommend this apartment to anyone seeking a cozy place in Geneva!

L'appartement de Lucas est superbe, très bien équipé et il propose une place de parking où j'ai pu garer mon gros Vivaro 😅
Tout est à proximité, à pied une boulangerie, des restaurants et autres commerces.
Un arrêt de bus est situé au croisement de la rue, ce qui est très pratique car se garer avec une grosse voiture dans Genève n'est pas évident.
Lucas est très sympathique, toujours réactif en cas de question.
Dans l'appartement, il y a une Nespresso, Netflix, prime et le Wifi (pratique car pas le même réseau qu'en Europe)
Pour résumer, je recommande vivement !
A une prochaine fois si nous repassons sur Genève, merci pour tout.

Le logement est bien situé avec les transports en commun. Beaucoup de commodité à proximité. Par contre, nous n'avons pas été satisfait. Il y avait une drôle d'odeur dans le logement, le logement n'était pas très propre. En plus, la femme de ménage est arrivé à 8h30 la journée de notre départ alors que nous avions avisé que nous partions à 10h00. Elle nous a demandée la clé du logement environ 10 fois, malgré le fait qu'elle savait que nous en avions encore besoin pour sortir l'auto du stationnement.

Lucas was an extremely responsive host. The space was exactly as described and what we needed. The location is also right outside a bus station so transportation was incredibly easy. Overall a solid stay.

Lovely condo in Geneva, as described in the listing and photos. Excellent for a family, safe and comfortable. Walking distance to the river and loads of convenient amenities nearby.
Lucas was very helpful, accommodating and responsive. We would 100% recommend this condo for anyone visiting Geneva.
Very comfortable apartment in a great location for getting around Geneva. Easy to hop on the bus and get to the lake.

We would rate Lucas’s listing as 4,5 stars. The half point reduction was due to faulty shutters in one room, thus not blacking out the windows at night/early morning. Easily corrected though.
The apartment was very neat & made us (family of 5) feel right at home. Complete kitchen, with all amenities, including very good wines glasses!! Rooms were well organized, had toys for our kids & comfy beds. No issues except for the aforementioned shutters.

Lucas was a great host; very communicative & proactive. Check in/out was easy & flexible. It’s not easy/possible to always attain to a strict schedule with 3 children, so having a bit of flexibility helps a lot; plus point compared to other Airbnbs.
If we ever go back to Geneva, we will certainly try to stay at Lucas’s listing. Merci, Lucas!
Ruth was a very hospitable host and extremely  welcoming.
Pedro estuvo pendiente de nosotros en todo momento. El apartamento esta muy cómodo, es amplio y ha sido decorado con mucho encanto. Gracias por una semana fantástica en Ginebra
I never rent the flat before,and I found it is very comfortable for the lo green period.It was very clean,nice and cozy apartment where feel yourself like at home.

In summary, it met all my needs and was a good price. There are some grocery stores and a bakery in walking distance. Very short walk to bus stop.
Excellent host. I got more than I even expected. Thanks

Couple très agréable et accueillant. La chambre a ce qu'il faut et la maison a un beau jardin, dans un quartier calme. Yael's place is clean and convenient especially for those looking for a place near the airport
Wonderful location and cozy room. House owner is very helpful. Thanks!
Bon séjour, chambre indépendante, quartier calme à proximité immédiate du centre de Vernier !

Staying at Yael's house was wonderful. I was welcomed very warmly, it is a nice old house with garden, including two chicken:-). The bed was extremely comfortable so my sleep was awesome.
I was served with self-made pie and marmalade, yummy!

We were four guests at the house and the bathrooms were not perfectly clean.
Thank you for hosting me, I warmly recommend this place.

It was an amazing place to stay, really complemented my visit to CERN open days.
The hospitality was fabulous, such as the food in the fridge (even chocolate), so that I should not have to go shopping after arrival, or the coffee machine or chocolate in the room. Not even mentioning the home made plum cake I got the last night.
Communication was perfect as well despite the fact that I did not speak french. The old lady was really really adorable, I wish I could find the half of her attitude at other places.
All the things really took a part in making this weekend unforgetable ;)

La chambre a beaucoup de charme, est proche de l'aéroport, adaptée en cas de voyage pour affaires. Mention spéciale à la tarte aux pommes et à la confiture de pêche de vigne, faites maison toutes les deux. Merci pour l'accueil !
Very nice, and lovely wellcome plate with food.
Great Neighbourhood, close to Airport and Bus stand. Highly recommended.

Christine's place is in the best location! You are right in the center of everything, you really can't get a better spot.

My 2 colleagues and I stayed at Christine‘s place one short night for a quick work trip to Geneva for work. It’s difficult to find a hotel in Geneva that’s not notoriously overpriced. Christine‘s apartment is located centrally near the old town in a nice building. The flat is spacious and has basic amenities. It was not clear to me that the flat is actually in a hotel. Great location and great service!!

Christine's place was perfect for our stay in Geneva. Very centrally located (near transit, the Lake, many shops and restaurants) and had all the amenities we needed. Check in was easy and luggage storage was very helpful given our morning arrival. Highly recommend for travelers who are looking to be centrally located and well positioned to explore the city!
Very big appartment,very centrally placed in Geneve.
Wonderful and very large apartment. The AC was a great bonus. The views from the top floor were awesome and location was perfect. I would highly recommend staying here!
Super Lage, Empfang super gelöst durch die Hotelreception, sogar mit Frühstück.
房东回复很及时，入住流程分享的很清晰。反观描述和图片一致，值得再去的民宿。

Great location, free continental breakfast, friendly staff. The apartment is located in a hotel, so this isn't like a hosted experience, but it's nice nonetheless. The apartment was clean, the beds and furnishings comfortable. The light breakfast was nice. The only drawback was late-night music (from a nearby club?). The hotel provides ear plugs, which help. Overall a great stay.

Organisation au top du top, lieu agréable, facile d'accés ... Tout est fait pour vous rendre la tache la plus facile possible. Je le recommande à un petit groupe de 2, 3 personnes ou une petite famille.
Great location and good service

This Airbnb was great! Perfect location, very clean, easy instructions, and breakfast every morning. We had questions, and Pierre (the concierge, front desk man, local guru) gave us great advice and always made us smile. There were 3 of us, and we felt like we definitely had enough space. Fast wifi and great AC as well!

We stayed in the the 2 BR unit and were 3 adults and a 5 year old. The place is very clean with lot of windows.  The beds were comfortable  to sleep in.  We stayed on the 5th floor which has an elevator. he main rail station of Geneva can be accessed by 14/18 no. tram ( 2 stops) or a 10 min taxi ride.  The central bus station is also near-about. The shopping district is just a street away.  You can just walk down to the lake (10 mins) You have restaurants in around and everything is within walking distance.  There is a cabaret discotheque downstairs which may generate some noise till 2am or so. But if you close the windows, there is only a distant hum..not too much of bother if you are not extra light sleeper. The all inclusive breakfast is not great as it includes only  croissant/coffee/juice/bread/butter/jam.  Someone who is interested to cook can't do so, as there is no chimney on top of the induction hob. We thought of cooking pasta but dropped the idea. There was no dishwasher, so you have to do them yourselves or keep them for the housekeeping. Most of the channels on the TV were encrypted. I would suggest few toys and netflix on the TV to keep the younger guests occupied after dinner. The check in is a breeze. The staff was kind enough to give us the room at 12 noon instead of the regular 2 pm. A point to note,  WC is separate from the shower cubicle..if that sort of thing is important to you.  The tub in the shower room is little high to climb for someone who is old ( like my 72 year mom-in-law ) so maybe a small step on stool can be procured.
very good location,  easy and timely communication, rooms are big and comfortable

This is a great central location, in the city center. It’s close to the lake and many restaurants. The apartment is actually part of the hotel central so you get the advantages (breakfast served to the room, public transport travel cards, cleaning service). It has an elevator which makes getting bags up easy.

Wonderful apartment in a perfect location! The host is extremely accommodating and responsive.  I highly recommend and if my travels ever take me back to Geneva, I would request to be a guest of Christine's again.

Lovely apartment! Central and quiet, perfect for a short trip. Brights rooms; high ceilings and modern decoration. There is even space for a family with two kids. Christine has been super helpful and let us stay until the afternoon before check out.
Highly recommended to explore the beautiful city Geneva.
great service and great location, highly recoomendeed
Fantastic location,  easily reachable from the  train station, lovely apartment with loads of natural sunlight. Friendly service and easy check-in. Recommended.

Very nice airbnb.  The owners were very kind and helpful. Would gladly stay again!
The location and apartment are great. I recommend.

Had a wonderful experience! Christine and team made arrival and check-in extremely convenient. Christine was very thorough and efficient during booking. Appartement très agréable , idéalement situé dans le coeur de Genève. Accueil sympathique et prestations très correctes.

Great stay, would book again!

Loved the location.  Great place to anchor your Geneva experience.  We loved hotel central!
A very clean and stylish flat for a good price in Geneva.  Good bus access to Palais des Nations and downtown.  Comfortable bed and quiet neighbourhood.

Pedro was so kind and charming. He was very quick to respond and helpful with my initial questions. His apartment is every bit as delightful as it looks in the pictures. Pedro has simply been a perfect host.

His flat looks just like the pictures, is very nice, in a very good neighbourhood and just at a walking distance from the lake, downtown Geneva and the train station. Thanks for everything!

Clean and well decorated apartment with nice balcony. Felt right at home. Convenient location near bus stops and transport links.
Pedro was very helpful and responsive to any queries we had! Very good, would stay again, highly recommended

Perfect/best place to stay in Geneva. Close to everywhere. You won’t be needing a taxi or bus at all. Walking distance from everything you will need. Restaurants. Shopping & sightseeing. Would love to come Back here
Super zentrale Lage für ein kurzer Städtetrip in Genf. Es hat alles reibungslos geklappt. vielen Dank, Christinae!
This is a hotel close to old town. Everything is a close walk, including food shops and sights. The room is a suite and it's very spacious. Would absolutely stay here again.
Great location in Geneva. You can walk to a lot of shopping options as well as a good number of restaurants.
Fantastic accommodation and Christine was very helpful. Thanks!

We (a family of two adults and one pre-schooler) had a pleasant stay at Christine's place (an apartment within her larger hotel). We did not experience the nightclub noise others mention, but that could be because our stay was on Sunday and Monday nights.  From a family perspective, we appreciated the elevator, the bathtub, and Christine's kindness toward my little one.   Christine is a warm, responsive, and helpful host (she even responded so quickly to our last minute booking request when we unexpectedly had to vacate the AirBNB we had originally booked, no small feat on a Sunday night in Switzerland).  Merci Christine for a wonderful visit.
Super place with super host

Appartement encore plus spacieux que je le pensais, très agréable, super bien placé dans la ville. Idéal pour notre famille de 4 (avec enfants petits). Accueil sympathique et convivial, grande disponibilité.
Je recommande vivement !
Very comfortable and conveniently located.
Great place!

Overall we had a great time in Geneva. The initial place that we requested was not available, but Christine was able to help find us a slightly smaller place in the same building. Check in went relatively smoothly although we hit a snag with the Geneva tourism travel passes which they were able to rectify.
The air conditioning was a plus as it did get pretty hot while we were there.

Overall great stay in Geneva. 5 stars for Christine.

The apartment is quite spacious. The kitchen isn't the most updated or stocked, but it has the necessities! The location is great - close to everything.

Fantastic location, very elegant, very central. highly recommended.
Host was supper communicable. Location was great and the check in process is easy.
Well priced and in a good location - quirky mix of offices and rooms in the building, but a great value, clean, and safe.

Perfect apartment for our family of four, ideally located for exploring Geneva - especially the old town. The staff were very friendly and helpful. The free passes for Geneva’s transport system were a welcome bonus.

Location and unit was what was described but the listing said AC is provided but was not working during our stay and the internet and WiFi service was spotty, some apps and games where not loading too.

Had a great stay!

I found the check in process was clear but I also checked in during work hours so was able to speak with the front desk.  I appreciated the flexible bed configurations. The balconies were a nice surprise and certainly came in handy. I would definitely come back.
this was my favorite place I rented in Europe in two weeks. it was very spacious, amazing central location, helpful front desk staff, perfect!

Our family of four had a relaxing and enjoyable stay in Geneva.
The apartment was clean, spacious and exactly as described. We particularly enjoyed the separate living room with comfortable seating and the large light-filled main bedroom. The location was very convenient and the host was responsive and gave us clear instructions.
We also appreciated the free public transport cards and the luggage storage at reception.
Perfect place to stay in Geneva - great central location on the edge of the old town and a 5 min walk from the lake.  Very helpful person on reception, we had a lovely time and would stay here again.

We had an amazing time there. The place was super!!! We loved the atmosphere and the receptionist were GREAT!!!! Good place for family for sure. I just wish they can have better pillows.
My kids love the terrace and that the staff were very kids friendly. They have access from there to SO many different places and events. I will come back!!! ⭐️💫💃🏻🥰

The apartment was very comfortable and spacious. It was also conveniently located near many stores and great restaurants. Additionally, check-in was very easy, and the host kindly allowed us to check in much earlier than expected, which was very helpful. Overall, we had a great experience.
Ruim appartement met uitstekende ligging centraal!
Great location, charming accommodation, would highly recommend,

Was nice to be able to stow our luggage as well as to receive a complimentary TPG pass for our stay.  Great location, couldn't have been better. Thank you!

The place was as expected. Amazing area, easy check in, all the basic necessities. My only complaint is that the building has a disco tech below that is open from Monday to Saturday 11 PM to 5 AM. LOVELY stay in Geneva. The AC was phenomenal and saved us during the heat wave. Tons of space, the photos really don’t do it justice. Thank you so much for having us! We hope to be back!

Use the ear plugs provided as there is noise from the near by club till 5! Apartment is made from a series of hotel rooms. Kitchen very basic, lot of knife marks on worktop. Reception staff very helpful central location

Great central location. Walking distance to all attractions. Close to old town.

Great stay in Geneva! My husband and kids (3 yrs and 7mos) stayed here for 5 days and we enjoyed the size and location of this apartment. A baby crib was provided which was appreciated. Other than that, the place seemed clean and well appointed. There was no blow dryer though so heads up to future renters.

The apartment was surprisingly spacious. The kitchen is small, but that's fine for a short stay. Location is great. Near many restaurants and shops. Short walk to the tram at Bel-Air which connects to most of city. Neighborhood felt very safe.
Literally the best and most central location, less than a minute walk to the town (I timed it). Great host and a very large apartment. Would definitely stay again and would recommend to others.

First, the host was responsive and helpful.

Another inconvenience was that the shower only had a handheld/removable shower head, so you had to hold it while showering.
For the price, the apartment is outdated. The freezer didn’t work, the lighting was mostly overhead and harsh, and the drapes did little to block sunlight.
The AC was a highlight. it worked very well, with full temperature control in each room. Location was great.

Great apartment, very nice host, superfurnished with everything you might need. The are is quite nice and very close to the Cornavin Station. There are 2 big balconies with wonderful views really nice in summer. The apartment is very spacious with a very big kitchen.

The apartment is very stylish and cosy. Anne Monique is very tactful and will be halpeing you a lot.
For my first use of AirB&B, I was lucky to find it

A lovely top floor flat in a residential neighborhood of central Geneva, convenient to everything., with a large comfortable bed. The views of the city are a photographers dream. The host was awesome, informative, and very caring. Well equipped modern kitchen as well as a boulangerie at the corner of the next block.  Merci Anne-Monique pour tous!

Food in the fridge, a nice bottle of wine and two cute Easter Bunnies made of delicious Swiss chocolate were waiting for us when we arrived at Délices Apartment, where we stayed for six weeks while looking for our own place to live in Geneva.

The apartment is very nice, good location, good size and has a very well equipped kitchen, where I enjoyed cooking there everyday. And definitely, the best thing about it is Anne-Monique, she was overseas during our stay but it was very easy to reach her at anytime. She was extremely nice, ready to help with anything we need and always keen to make everything as eaiser as possible for us.
Overall, an excellent experience!

The listing information and the pictures were extremely accurate. We never met Pedro, but he was very happy to help us make the most out of our time in Geneva and his apartment had a very welcoming welcoming feel. The building is in a fairly residential area but it is close to the bus that takes you into the city center and the airport very quickly.

The entire apartment was very clean, very well equipped, stylish, nice kitchen, spacious living room and beautiful master bedroom - like shown in the pictures. I should mention that the second bedroom (which isn't part of the image gallery) is very small though, with a big closet but really not much space for anything else then just a single bed). I haven't met Pedro in person but he was very quick to respond to all our questions.
Location is very good and central, the 10 minutes indication to the water-front may be a little optimistic though (water as in the lake, not to the river). Good connection by public transportation, 7 mins walk to nearest bus stop. All in all, great experience.
Pedro's apartment was perfect, both locationwise and price. We highly recommend this place to stay.

If you are staying in Geneva, you will not find a better place than "The White Apartment". The flat is beautiful, tasteful, and has absolutely everything you will need. Pedro's neighbours are all very friendly, and the building itself is quiet. And then, of course, there's Pedro. He made me feel very welcome, indeed. During the course of my 4 weeks stay, if I had any questions (there were very few because his apartment is so complete), he responded swiftly and courteously. Having met him, he is also a super nice, friendly and outgoing man.

Simply put, I cannot recommend The White Apartment highly enough. I know the next time I find out I am coming to Geneva, I will be immediately checking to see if Pedro's gorgeous (and very comfortable!) flat is available. After my recent experience, anywhere else in Geneva would just seem second best.

The apartment is great, very nice and clean and has everything you need. Pedro is great, very attentive and gentle. He made everything possible to help me,  even with my luggage. I definititely recommend this apartment.

The apartment and Pedro are great. Location is 3/4 bus stops from Cornavin train station ir you can even walk. I already gave a more intensive review so I hope that one is the one that airbnb publishes. In any case I 100% recommend this place.

The apartment is flawlessly clean, very well-equipped and in a nice quiet block. Public transport is one of the best things about Geneva and so getting to meetings was easy. Pedro very attentive.

I had a great time staying at Pedros.  His apartment is beautiful and it is in a great location.  Everything went smoothly and although unfortunately I did not get to meet Pedro I don't think I could have asked to stay in a better place during my time in Geneva.  Thanks so much Pedro!!

The apartment is really great. It is well appointed - you will find everything what you need and very comfortable. The apartment is also perfect situated - only 10 minutes from train station. Pedro was a perfect host.

Pedro nous a très bien accueilli, l'appartement est très charmant et décoré avec beaucoup de goûts. Très bien situé et desservi, nous avons pu nous rendre où nous le souhaitons pour visiter Geneve sans problème. Je vous recommande cet hôte et son appartement. Merci Pedro pour le séjour.

Appartment was lovely and as described on the website. Great location for both the Airport and Lake. Pedro is a very helpful and welcoming host who seems very happy to answer every question you may have and he was very accommodating with our check in/out requests.

Great place to stay in Geneva :)

L'appartement était conforme aux photos et était très propre. Nous avions tous le nécessaire pour passer un bon séjour. Pedro répondait rapidement aux messages et nous à aidé à trouver une solution de Parking dés notre arrivée. Je recommande.
Pedros apartement was great and everything worked out well. I would recommend it a lot. It's very close to the city center. We had a great time, thank you.

This was my first airbnb experience and I am happy to say I had a very pleasant stay at Henrique's apartment.  He is a very kind host and is extremely helpful.  The pancakes that many of the other guests comment on are one of the many gestures of hospitality that he extended to me.  Coming from another country and not speaking French is also not a problem as Henrique speaks perfect English.  I found the apartment and room to be clean and furnished with a very modern design.  The location is great for anyone working at one of the many international organizations in Geneva including the WHO and UN.  You can walk to these locations from his apartment (which is on the 6th floor and has a great view of the mountains from the balcony) but if you're in a hurry or don't feel like walking there are many bus and rail stops that are very close and not hard to find.  I found these were great for visiting stores and some of the older parts of Geneva that are too far to walk to but easily reached by bus (10-15min ride).  In addition, if you are coming in from the airport and don't have three suitcases like I did then you can easily take bus 5 and get dropped off less than 1 min away from the apartment building.
