Die Wohnung von Nadja war herzig und angenehm( noch fast neu renoviert). Tramstation ist in 1 Minute erreichbar,  trotzdem war die Wohnung dank 5.Stock(gute Fittness!) sehr ruhig. Nadja selber ist unkompliziert und nett. Wir haben uns dort sehr wohl gefühlt. Danke!!

Cozy apartment close to tram / bus and the city center. It’s small and has no lift, but feels comfortable and it’s clean and nicely renovated. Nadja was a great host and the communication with her was always easy.
We had a great stay at Nadja's apartment! It is conveniently located, comfortable, and it has all the amenities you could need.

We were two people staying for 2 months who were going to be working. The apartment was very cute. But we were never informed we would only have ONE key! and there was no access to the mailbox. In a two month stay this is VERY uncomfortable (Actually, if you are two, even for a couple of days having only one key is very inconvenient). As the description mentions, there are stairs. It's a fifth floor so prepare to climb. The kitchen is very well equipped, with everything you might need.

Nadja and her husband are very kind and helped me with moving the luggage up in the apartment. The apartment is small but well equipped and cozy! Very convenient to have a tram around the corner that goes all the way to the center. I recommend this place. Thank you!

L'appartement est conforme à la description - à noter toutefois qu'il n'y a plus de machine à laver dans l'immeuble; mais il y a deux laveries à distance raisonnable. Il est confortable, dans un environnement calme et agréable (5e étage sans vis-à-vis), très bien situé (Eaux-Vives, avec tous les commerces, restaurants, services, accès au lac et parc de la Grange) et bien desservi par les transports publics.
Nice apartment next to the Gare des Eaux Vives. Close to the park and tram station.

I spent a week here. Location is good.
Check in was nightmare. I came on time, but the apartment was still being cleaned. I had to come back later. Still I could not get the key. I had to walk around town for 1 hour, in the rain, to get the key from Nadja apartment.
There was no washing machine. So I was told to go 1km away to a laundrette to do my laundry.
Be ready to be in good shape - the apartment is on the 5th floor with no elevator.
Will not come back.

Had a really great time at Nadja’s place. Location- best in Geneva: Eaux-Vives is lively and full of great bars, restos, etc. while still very close to the centre and accessible via bus/train to public transport. 5 mins from a beautiful park, next to a voie verte for running/cycling, and 10 mins from the lake and a public beach. The studio is cosy- it’s small (tho a huge bathroom!) but has pretty much all you need. It is a walk up the stairs (which is clearly indicated in the Description) and was hot in summer- tho there is a fan. But it’s quiet, good WiFi, and makes good use of the space. I would happily have stayed for longer. I didn’t meet Nadja but she was always responsive and helpful on the phone, and her partner was very friendly and shared lots of great tips. Oh and merci pour la bouteille de vin, Nadja!

Après avoir eu quelques difficultés à obtenir toutes les informations utiles pour l'arrivée, Nadja s'est montrée à l'écoute et très intègre dans la résolution de la situation. Le petit appartement sous toits de Nadja est charmant pour une personne et étonnement calme vu l'emplacement, central et proche de tout. Merci encore, nous gardons l'adresse avec plaisir!

Bona comunicació amb Nadja i el seu marit per organitzar l'arribada, qui ens han permés d'adapter els horaris segons l'arribada de l'avió de la meua convidada. Gràcies per tot, Thando ha estat molt a gust!

Ich habe das gemütliche Studio von Nadja für 14 Tage gemietet.Ich hätte mir nichts besseres wünschen können. Die kleine Wohnung ist gemütlich und hübsch eingerichtet mit einem bequemen Bett und einer voll ausgestatteten Küche.
Nadja ist sehr sympathisch, unkompliziert und stets erreichbar.
Vielen Dank für die tollen Tage, Ich komme ganz bestimmt wieder

the apprtment was just repainted and the smell was very strong.
the appartment was very small for 2 people/
the hosts were very nice and pleasant
good place to stay while you are in town

The apartment is clean and as pictured and the host is more than willing to make sure that you have everything you need. He was extremely accommodating with a last minute reservation and flexible and communicative about check out.

José is a great host! He's more than helpful and one of the nicest persons I've ever meet :) The flat is cosy and comfy. Great situated! Five to ten minutes and you're on the river near the lake. All museums are in a short walk. Maybe it was a little bit chilly inside and I have to notice that the floor is cold so don't forget to take some sleepers with you :)

I had a very pleasant stay in José's charming apartment.  He was an attentive and very helpful host.  The apartment is conveniently located, well-equipped and within walking distance of Geneva University and the Old Town.  It is near public transport and many nice neighbourhood restaurants.  With spring here and summer around the corner, this is a very nice place to stay in Geneva and from where one can enjoy the city.  Thanks José!

Jose was a great host! He met me at his place on the first day of my visit and showed me the flat. He also signed documets on my stay for my employer. By the way, the flat is well equipped and has all necessary home appliances. The house itself is under renovation now but it is no problem at all - I have not heard any noise during my visit. The location of the house is perfect - 7 minutes walk from the Parc des Bastions and 30 minutes by bus from the airport.
Thank you very much, Jose!

Nice and comfortable little apartment in an old building with everything listed on the page. Newer bathroom and comfortable bed even though it is in a very small bedroom.
The location is convenient to the old town and walking distance from the lake, shops and parks. Also with access to many good restaurants. José welcomed us and gave us information on all the amenities we had near by including public transportation to main tourist sites in the city.

The apartment was clean and stylish but the bedroom and bed (double not queen) was too small for two people and didn't have enough air.
Jose was nice enough to leave a fan but it wasn't enough.
We tried to cancel the last day because of the heat but there was no room for negotiation. Jose is very strict about the 3 night minimum policy.
Also there was no space to open a suitcase in the bedroom.
We had to leave the suitcase on the couch because the bedroom was too small.
And there seems to be a pigeon problem because when we opened the shutters in the kitchen there were many pigeons perched on the windowsill trying to get in, something that has never happened to us elsewhere in Geneva.
Clarisse est un hôte très attentionné, soucieux du bien être de son locataire. Vous serez bien accueilli et très content de votre séjour.

The lovely apartment is well appointed and perfectly located. Quiet, friendly area with beautiful parks nearby and the centre with old town and lake just a short walk away. Clarissa was also incredibly welcoming and couldn’t have been more helpful. Highly recommended.
Best experience in Airbnb so far and, Clarissa is a wonderful host, So lovely and  very helpful.
We enjoyed our stay! Wonderful apartment and amazing host! 😊

Fantastic place to stay. Very clean and beautifully furnished. You can see vineyards and Mont Blanc out the front window---it feels like you're staying in the countryside, but it's only a 15 minute drive from Geneva (and there's a bus too, but we drove). The hosts were extremely friendly and accommodating. Highly recommended!

Dunja and Robin are very friendly hosts. They were accommodating to last minute changes that we had, and were very ready to welcome us to Geneva. They took time and special care to make us feel at home in their apartment.
The apartment is clean and cosy. It has good wifi which we were very happy with. It is located in a very pleasant location, quiet with beautiful views. It is literally 1 minute from the bus stop which takes you into the heart of the city.
I would gladly recommend this place for anyone looking for a relaxing and comfortable getaway in Geneva.

Staying at Dunja and Robin was just like a dream. Easy with communication, easy with parking, the flat itself is really beautifully designed everything with extraordinary taste! thanks so much again for letting us stay there!

Notre séjour était court, trop certainement!
L'appartement est magnifique, très agréable et dans un coin calme et pourtant très proche de Genève. Dunja et Robin, que nous n'avons malheureusement pas pu rencontrer, sont restés très avenants et nous ont laissé de multiples indications et conseils fort utiles pour le séjour. À noter une impressionnante et très pointue collection de vinyles! Lieu hautement recommandé! Merci!

Dunja is a great host, offering my family and I everything and more to make sure our stay was extremely comfortable. A bus runs direct to downtown Geneva frequently and  there is also free parking for those with a vehicle. Her loft space is not to be missed as an opportunity to stay in a 4-star Airbnb accommodation.

A perfect place to relax. We enjoyed our stay at Dunjas&Robins Place very much. We spend hours reading through tons of interesting magazines and books, listening to the fabulous music collection, going for long walks and having wonderful meals. Cooking in Dunjas&Robins kitchen is a pleasure! Highly recommended!

makkelijk bereikbaar en proper appartement in een rustige buurt.

The picture captures the apartment well. It is warm and cozy. It was perfect for my needs. It was very clean and had everything that was needed. Logement propre et fonctionnel.

Es un piso muy centrico y está muy bien comunicado. Tiene todo lo necesario para pasar unas vacaciones estupendas.

L'alloggio è in posizione centrale, vicino al centro storico di Ginevra. Si tratta di un appartamento veramente carino, dotato di tutto, confortevole e ottimo per soggiorni sia di lavoro sia di piacere. Il proprietario è molto gentile e disponibile per ogni chiarimento. Lo consiglio vivamente!

great and easily communicable host - perfect weekend getaway (:

We has an excellent stay and loved the location! Thanks for everything Jose!

Jose's place is great. Central, clean, well-appointed. Jose is a great host. I would definitely stay here again.
Un apartament a prop del centre, ben comunicat, tranquil, net, l'habitació on està ell lit es una mica petita, però en general l'apartament està molt bé per passar uns dies. El recomano.

This was probably the best stay I have experience on Airbnb! José left the house with everything you can think of. He's genuine and leaves you well informed about your surroundings. Communication was very good! Would definitely book this place again!

Dear José, I would like to start from a little question: Do you have the same bed in your bedroom? But in general we are are satisfied by the staying in your apartment. Just some small inconveniences didn't make our stay perfect.
And also we were a bit disappointed in the beginning when we didn’t get the key as we were supposed to.

The flat was clean, easy to find, and in a great neighbourhood, close to a number of restaurants and convenient bus lines. Jose was incredibly responsive and gave clear, timely instructions and information. The home was lovely, and I would certainly stay again.

The apartment was very clean and cozy, and in a great neighbourhood.
The bus lines were close and convenient. Jose was incredibly responsive and we had all the information we needed for the check in and the apartment. We would certainly stay there again. Lovely place - thank you Jose.

The location was ok and the apartment was quiet clean. The bed is seriously too small for two friends to share. It is also very old and makes noise each time you move.
Heads up, there was also absolutely no soap at all when we got there and the towels smelled like mold.. Unfortunately, the apartment is not José’s main house and it very much feels like it.

Appartement très bien agencé et central dans Genève qui permet d’aller facilement partout à pied !
Hôte et petite terrasse avec vue dégagée très agréable !
El piso está muy bien, tanto a nivel de ubicación y servicios, como el piso en si.

El apartamento es perfecto, cómodo y limpio (todo tal cual se ve en las fotos). La ubicación es ideal para conocer Ginebra, se puede ir a todos lados caminando y sino encuentras una parada de autobús a 2 minutos. Hay un Lidl también en la calle de al lado. El anfitrión es muy amable, contesta rápidamente cualquier duda que te pueda surgir antes o después de llegar.
Everything was great, highly recommended!

Shortly after moving in I realized that the heater in the bedroom was not working with freezing night temperatures. I called José who came in right away but it became clear that he had not ordered a proper inspection of the heating system before the winter, while the apartment is rather old, including the heating system (radiator panels heated with hot water from the inside) and needs yearly regular / pre-seasonal check up.
This was on Saturday morning and Jose promised to have it fixed on the coming Monday.
On Monday José informed me that it can be fixed only on Wednesday after which I asked him for some compensation since I had rented the apartment for 3 weeks and the overall apartment was definitely not warm and needed to use 24/7 extra portable heater to keep the apartment warm.
Surprisingly I have not heard from José for more than a week and after my second email I was informed that he was traveling and there will be no compensation for the not working heater in the bedroom for almost a week during my stay.
That experience left me very unhappy as I do not feel that anyone should be renting Airbnb apartment that has no proper heating in any of the rooms abd if so he or she should be compensated. In addition I have fallen sick during my stay, which obviously I can not claim has anything to do with not having properly working heater in the bedroom but it most likely has not helped.
Superbe

Wonderful location, close to several bus routes: from a bus stop about 200 meters from the front door, trip time to the Airport is 28 minutes. Just as described, in a quiet, but bustling section of the Geneva. The apartment is charming and spotless. The hosts sent explanations of everything in the apartment and even info about nearby food, grocery stores, emergencies, etc. Check-in, check-out was a snap. Great place. For those interested, the kitchen is well equipped, and they supply coffee and a couple of ways to make it. I would certainly stay there again.
Great sized flat, very clean and fantastic location.
Merci pour l’accueil  dans ce magnifique appartement merveilleusement situé . La chambre est vraiment petite mais tous les autres éléments compensent largement. Séjour très agréable

The area of the flat suited me perfectly, as I have friends living on the next street, it is well connected (8 minute tram/bus ride to Cornavin) and has everything you need. As I frequent Geneva for business, I would definitely come back to Jose's place again.

Appartement conforme à la description, confortable.

Excellent place, great location, easy to access. Would stay again.

Very convenient, practical and pleasant appartement super well placed in Geneva. Jose is super responsive and very helpful. I highly recommend this appartement.

Joli appartement, bien situé. La remise des clés est Très pratique et je remercie José de m’avoir permis d’y venir plus tôt. José est très réactif, et ce fut très aisé de communiquer.
Le balcon est un plus.
L’immeuble est très calme. La chambre donne sur une petite rue, donc très peu de passage.
Il y a tout ce qu’il faut de base pour cuisiner. Ce fut parfait, j’y reviendrai volontiers.

Tout était parfait et excellente communication avec José. Malgré la proximité à l’hôpital, on entend pas de bruit du tout. (Tout au plus, le matin le roucoulement des pigeons dans la cour intérieure..)
A recommander!
Well equipped space ideally located for easy access to central Geneva. Quiet residential area. Jose very helpful and responsive.

L’appartement est agréable et bien situé. Toutefois, il manque clairement de finitions dans la propreté, et quelques attentions pour les hôtes seraient les bienvenus : une simple bouteille d’eau, ou des capsules de café, ou quelques condiments. Cela rendrait le séjour plus agréable

Dunja was a very accommodating host, making last-minute arrangements so we would be more comfortable and giving us print-outs of the bus schedule, which we had been unable to access online. The apartment is a chic music- design- and book-lover's dream in a beautiful country-side setting. We were there on a holiday weekend, but found a charming restaurant with a good cook at less than 10 minutes walk away, so didn't have to cook every meal. All in all a wonderful place to stay.

We had the most wonderful stay at Dunja and Robin's. The apartment is absolutely gorgeous, in such a beautiful location, but it was very easy and quick to get into Geneva. The local pub across the vineyards is a must see. The host did everything possible to make us feel at home, and we had a lovely time cooking in their great kitchen. Best of all was the amazing record collection, we had a few late nights trying to listen to as many as possible!

This is a very lovely apartment in the Geneva countryside. For those of you travelling by car, there is no better place! Our stay was without any incident and the host was very responsive. The apartment is spacious and bright with a terrific appointed kitchen, living and dining room. Our family had lots of fun playing tunes from the vast vinyl collection and exploring the local area. The views from the apartment are truly lovely. This is a good base to tour Geneva and travel surrounding area.

Dunja's flat is beautiful.  Easy living in a great location with views across fields to mountains and an easy and reliable twenty minute bus trip into central Geneva as well as nice towns for shopping and eating nearby.  Great record collection, fantastic shower and firm bed.  Dunja was a very friendly and helpful host.
This apartment is perfect. Spacious, stylish and with perfect views. A great balcony too.

Loved, loved, loved the apartment. Filled with quirky trinkets. In the middle of the countryside but only 7kms to downtown Geneva with the bus at the door. Views of Mont Blanc and the vineyards from the large living and kitchen area. Just loved it.

This apartment has so much to offer! The location, right on a bus route, but also surrounded by vineyards with great views of farmlands and mountains (even the Mont Blanc). The building is an old traditional farm building that has been renovated tastefully, combining new and old in a way that has so much character. We loved the large, airy living space and the many personal touches made it feel like a home. Dunja was always very friendly, helpful and generous. We would love to return in the future

The apartment was fully equipped and very comfortable. It has a full kitchen, two bathrooms, one with a with shower, and two separate bedrooms. The living area is very large, nicely furnished with large windows and a balcony looking out over the street.

Just 200 m from the University and less to Parc des Bastions. About 5 minutes walk takes you into the old city and the St. Pierre Cathedral. The tram is only a few minutes walk and then its only moments to anywhere in Geneva. Great neighborhood. Its a bit noisy in the daytime but it quiets down at night for a good sleep. The opera house is close by and lots of good restaurants. Many of Geneva's museums are a short walk away. A great location.

I hearty recommend this flat and would stay again.

Oscar was such a delight to stay with. He was very welcoming and knows the area well. It`s conveniently located by many trams/bus stops, so it was very easy to get to and from work, grocery shopping, city central, etc. It was fun getting to know the other airbnb guests as well.

Oscar, overall, was an extremely nice host and very accommodating, I felt at home for the month I was there.

Oscar is very nice, helpful, and dependable. His apartment is clean and comfortble. the location is also good, which is easy to find, close to suppermarket as well as bus, tram stations , and of course, beautiful views too.

I had an awesome experience staying at Oscar's. He is always an interesting and nice person to talk, and above all very considerate - he is willing to go beyond the nominal duties of a host to help you out. The apartment - especially the bedroom and the kitchen - is small but very thoughtfully laid out (I'm impressed, for example, by the ample well-placed light sources in the bedroom), and the multiple balconies are a huge plus.  The neighborhood (Carouge) is arguably one of the nicer neighborhoods in Geneva, and the apartment is well-served by public transportation: stop for tram 12 and 18 is merely 2 minutes away; stop for tram 15 and buses are also not very far.  I would love to stay at the apartment again whenever I come back to Geneva!

L'appartement est très bien localisé, plusieurs bars et restaurants à proximité. Oscar est un excellent hôte avec qui c'est agréable, par exemple, de partager un souper et d'échanger autour d'un verre. La chambre, bien que petite, est confortable. En somme, une belle expérience de colocation, aussi courte fut elle.

Oscar was an exceptional host! Would definitely recommend his flat to anyone I know visiting Geneva (and already have sent friends his way). He made us breakfast (and a green smoothie!) in the morning, sat down to have coffee with us.. and he even came along to help us rent bikes, and then brought us on a little bike tour around the neighborhood. Super nice and helpful about what to do in Geneva. The bedroom was clean, and between the couch and our private terrace, it was just spacious enough for the two of us to share for the weekend - even sharing the bed was no problem. Carouge is a cute neighborhood, pretty and quiet, and very easily accessible from downtown Geneva. Oscar's flat is right by a bike station and several tram stops, and we even walked home one night from the city center.
I had only a really short stay at Oscar's place. The room was cozy and the bed confortable. He's a great host and it was nice to chat with him. I would definitely recommend this place.

You could feel as if you are in your own home since there were no specific house rules, and at the same time respecting each others privacy was always there. Oscar has a very nice and friendly personality which I admired a lot. I had a very nice warm welcome from him and we had interesting chats now and then. W.r.t. the room, although it was tiny as the title clearly says, but I managed to propose a reconfiguration which made the room practically much more spacious and to me, very nice and cozy :) Overall, I was very satisfied with my stay, and I know that I will have a good memory of my stay whenever I think back. Thanks Oscar!

I stayed with Oscar for a week because of a studyingproject at my school in Genèva. It was very nice and calme and I really enjoyed this!
Thanks!

Oscar is an excelent guy, very chill and welcoming. He really knows how to be a food host.
Everything that is described in the announcement is true. You will be just 5 minutes walking to old caouge, which is a must see in Geneva.

Oscar was an amazing host!!! He made me feel very comfortable.
The place was very nice and located very close to the tram/bus station.
I really enjoyed my staying there!!
Thank you for everything Oscar!!

Oscar was a wonderful host. The room and apartment are very cozy and located in a quiet, peaceful location that is close to public transport, shops, and restaurants. I'd highly recommend to anyone looking for a calm, practical accommodation in Geneva.

Oscar has been a great host. He is very friendly and always willing to provide advice when needed. The flat is located in a very nice neighbourhood, with lots of lovely restaurants and cafes - in Geneva's Little Italy. I can only recommend his place!
Great time in a lovely district and apartment!
Oscar est quelqu'un de très gentil, il rends service, l'appartement est très agréable et cosy. Il m'a fait sentir comme chez moi!! Je recommande sans hésitation! :)

I spend 3 months at Oscar's place. Oscar is a very nice guy, he was very helpful since the beginning of my stay (he even looked for a parking place for my car, while i was working, because i couldn't find one the day before) and he was always there for giving advices, no matter what it was. We had some great talks in the evening, but still he is a person who gives you a lot of space for your own, which was quite comfortable as well.
My room was quite small, but still i managed to put all my stuff in it, which was a lot!;) the rest of the Apartment is nice and cosy. there are two balconys to each side of the apartment and it was great to have your breakfast out there in the sun. The Apartment is very well located, close to all the Bars and Cafés in Carouge and near to the City as well.
Highly recommended!
Everything was perfect, I enjoyed my stay in Francisco's place. The room is not too big but very well suited for 1-2 people. Public transport is right on the corner. I highly recommend it!

This place is fantastic, exactly as described. Oscar is not only a perfect host but after six weeks staying his place, he became a good friend.
The location is perfect, Carouge is a hidden gem in Geneva. If you're interning at the UN like I was, this is a great choice. It is more affordable than most other options and the apartment is right next to a tram lime that runs directly to the UN (the number 15 tram - Nations)
O local otimo transporte, mercardo lojas tudo proximo.  O quarto limpo, cozinha equipada,foi muito agradavel os dias que estivemos de ferias.

Séjour très agréable.
L'appartement est propre et bien placé.
Oscar est une personne très sympa et accueillante.
Je vous recommande vivement cette colocation.

Highly recommended host. I've stayed with Oscar for one week and he's such a pleasant presence! The place is clean, the room as described, it offers a comfy space and access to the terrace. We even went running during the weekend :) Thanks  Oscar for this great experience!

Great host. The room is small, but you manage to put all your stuff in. Very clean house. Oscar is a really nice person and was flexible for my change in checkout. The kitchen and the room even have a balcony, so I sometimes ate in the fresh air. Only thing which could get better is the kitchen by adding and extra cooker. In general, really enjoyed the stay.

Oscar is a really cool, chilled out kinda guy. His flat is spotlessly clean, and the room he offers if comfortable. I would recommend staying here to anyone, and I would have liked to have stayed longer.

If you are seeking for a cozy place hosted by a really good friend, Oscar's place is your best choice. I stayed several months for work here. We've had a lot of fun. They gave me the warmest welcome. And they also gave me enough space whenever I need it. As for the location, it was ideal for me. It locates very close to the center of Geneva. 15min walk I think. And the town Carouge, where it is located, is really peaceful and beautiful. Additionally, for a room in Geneva center area of such kind, the price is unbeatable. I would definitely recommend this place for any friend of mine who want to visit Geneva.

Oscar est un excellent hôte, gentil, discret et attentionné. La chambre est un peu petite mais très bien agencée, pourvue d'un grand balcon, très calme, très propre et très confortable. Le quartier est également calme et agréable à vivre. Je recommande vivement cette colocation.
As described, this home is small but the space is well utilised with seating area and storage under the bunk bed. The flat was very clean. Oscar is very helpful, and responsive.

I stayed her for a few months during an exchange at Geneva university. The location was great, 5 min walk to the faculty. The room was not that big but efficiently designed so you have everything you need.
Oscar and Loredana were great hosts! They were very warm and welcoming and helped me get to know the city. They were always in for a nice conversation, whilst providing privacy if I prefered that. I can really recommend a stay here (especially for students)!

Oscar's a great guy, highly recommend. 10-15 minutes by tram to Old Town or Rail Station (Gare Cornavin), around 40 minutes by tram to Palais de Nations (United Nations), and around 45 minutes by bus to airport.

Pretty nice place. Location is great, near beautiful Carouge and highly accessible by public transit. It was difficult to stay there in the summer - the apartment is on the top floor, there is no air conditioning, and the bed is raised almost to the ceiling. There is not much you can do to cool the room if it is hot outside. If heat is an issue for you, take that into account.

J'ai passé un mois chez Oscar et Loredana et tout était très bien. Ils sont très attentionnés tout en laissant de l'intimité. L'appartement etait toujours très propre, et  agréable avec ses deux balcons. Il est bien situé (5 minutes à pied du tramway et du centre de Carouge).

I stayed in Johannes's amazing apartment for nearly a week while in business in Geneva, and it was nothing short of spectacular. Not only is it of very high quality, but it is centrally located and spacious. The neighbourhood is also very quiet. I would highly recommend this location to any professiona as an alternative to a hotel.

Also, when I enquired to ask Johannes to leave the iron out for me, he replied he did not have one in the apartment at which point he went out and purchased one. It was much appreciated and demonstrated his committment to ensuring I had everything I needed for a pleasant stay.

Thanks again, Johannes!

Very good location. Excellent flat. Very responsive owner! We had to leave a few things in advance because we were coming with out little baby and Johannes was very accommodating. Overall a great experience. While the lift is small, the 2nd floor location is not very hard walk up the stairs. There is a great park next door and it is very close to old town. In summary, if you want to stay in a nice place, this is most certainly an option. Johannes will get my repeat business should the opportunity present itself and in my view that is the biggest vote of confidence I can give him.

We were priviledged to have use of Johannes' apartment for 6 days while on vacation. Airy, spacious and scrupulously clean, it was a delight to return to each evening. Two bathrooms, two bedrooms, a well-stocked kitchen and a huge living room overlooking Rue de Candolle-it felt like home. An amazing bargain compared to staying in a hotel. We wouldn't hesitate to re-book, and give Johannes our highest recommendation and thanks.

Johannes' flat is great. It is really clean and neat, very tidy. The flat is in a very quiet area, near the centre town and the opera house. There are a very big lounge (which compensate a bit the fact that the kitchen is in the entrance) and two proper bedrooms. We found that it was very thoughtful to let a computer with an internet access, although we did not need to use it.
It is a really great place and we are really happy to return there so soon.

Again, very nice experience in this flat very well situated. The whole plainpalais, bastions, old town area is great.
Welcoming atmosphere, warm, clean, internet working perfectly... We would come back another time with pleasure.
Nice spacious and comfortable apartment, great location!

I stayed in Johannes appartment for more than a month. Everything was great. It is a very convenient location just 5 minutes walking distance from the city center, a very nice park around the corner, pleasant and residential area, the tramway is 2 minutes away. The appartment is amazing very clean , neat, the furniture is new and very stylish. I highly recommend this appartment it fits 3 persons ideally. Johannes is also very nice helpful and professional. I will definitely come back and I highly recommend you to stay in this appartment. The only negative thing to mention is the elevator it is too small and tiny it fits only one person at a time!
This apartment was excellent -- clean, spacious, centrally located.  We had a wonderful stay there and would gladly visit again.
The flat is wonderful and Johannes was very quick to answer any questions and concerns.  I highly recommend and look forward to staying again.

Our stay at the apartment was very pleasant. It is located in a very nice area of Geneva, and there is public transport near it. It also has a good  distribution , with 2 two separed areas: the dinning room and kitchen, from bedrooms and bathrooms.  All rooms very clean and tidy. I hope to repeat soon!

A wide and cosy flat, very well equipped and good furnished, in a beautful district of the town, near the center and near the university facilities, with plenty of shops and cafè all around.
Higly recommended.

Johannes flat is very nice and spacious, and is excellently located by the university and close to many tram and bus lines. Everything is as advertised and shown in the photos. He was responsive and easy to communicate with, and has excellent English. His friend meet us at the apartment at our agreed upon time for checkin and spoke only limited English, but more than enough to get the idea.

The kitchen is perhaps a little small for cooking a big dinner, but fine for everything else, and since we ate out at the many conveniently located restaurants that was not a problem.

Would certainly recommend Johannes and his nice flat.
Wunderbare Wohnung direkt beim Park- groß und ideal gelegen!

Living for four weeks in Johannes's Geneva flat was a wonderful experience. The apartment is as described—spacious, bright, neat and clean, and well-located. The salon is lined with books in (at least) three languages. The salon and the second bedroom are excellent work-spaces. The Old Town and shopping district are minutes away on foot, Carouge within 15 minutes, and the public transport from Plainpalais is very convenient, including trams to CERN or the UN. If you are traveling light, the 5 Bus from the airport brings you within a short walk. Johannes is thoughtful and responsive, and his Geneva representatives were efficient and helpful.

We stayed for 2 months for work in Geneva.
The location is very nice, close to the old town, shopping and transportation.
The apartment is spacious, clean and sunny, with a big living room, if a bit neutral and 'unlived' in, for example light fixtures are not installed in the living room, a number of lamps in the house were not working, or needing bulbs, there was no real kitchen knives etc., or a place to hang a coat in the entrance..... but overall we enjoyed staying there and would recommend it.
Johannes was very quick to respond and organized our check in and check out well.

The apartment of Johannes was very conveniently located near the Old Town, close to bus stops. The photos are accurate.

We spent 15 days in the apartment, and got to know the neighborhood. It would be helpful in the future if Johannes would list a few places we could do some grocery shopping nearby, and a list of recommended restaurants in the vicinity. We eventually found these out for ourselves.

Suggest that there be instructions to operate the oven (in english), and other appliances.
Suggest that he add blinds in the bedrooms like what he has in place in the living room.
Suggest addtional pillows for the guests, and a trash can in each toilet/bath.


We would come back to Johannes' apartment. We were quite comfortable. He was very prompt in responding to queries, and was very accommodating.

We were greeted and the workings of the apartment explained.
The apartment was warm and v comfortable.
The apartment was nice, clean and well appointed. I was met on arrival and departure very professionally. Best of all was the location, close to transit, parks, shops and the old quarter of the city.
The flat was clean, comfortable, and exactly as advertised.  It had plenty of space, and was in an ideal location, close to the university and the old city.  Would definitely stay here again!

My wife and I spent a month in the Geneva apartment and we thoroughly enjoyed our time here. The rooms are spacious, close to lots of shops and restaurants, the Plainpallais sunday markets, and there are many public transport options. The park is just around the corner for picnics. We would recommend this place for short to medium terms stays.

My (second) four-week stay in Johannes's apartment was a total pleasure. The location near Parc des Bastions is excellent, the building is fine (and quiet), the flat is well-equipped and highly livable. The kitchen is very functional, and the salon receives copious daylight. Johannes is responsive and helpful, as is his representative.

We had a very pleasant stay at Johanns' apartment. He was always quick to reply to my emails and check in and check out were well organised. We were met by his representative who was extremely helpful and showed us around the apartment.

The apartment is as it appears in the photos. It is very spacious, lean, comfortable and quiet with an adequately equipped kitchen.

The location of the apartment is very convenient. It is ideally located within walking distance of transport, shops, cafes, and restaurants. t is close to the Parc des Bastions, Plainpallais and the Old Town. The No 5 bus to the airport is only a short walk away.

We enjoyed our time in Johannes' apartment and would definitely stay there again when visiting Geneve again. i would highly recommend this apartment to others.

Exellent location
The apartment is very confortable and spacious. You are really in the center of Geneva and you can walk to the main spots or take a bus for max. 2 stations. Nearby you have a supermarket Coop and several restaurants, a bistrot, cinese restaurant and a delicious chocolaterie. I certaintly recomend this luxury flat

Very good experience here! The flat is quite spacious and has everything needed for either a leisure or business traveler. For the three weeks of my visit, I was very glad for the excellent location, near several good public transit options and many shops, and for the fact that the flat is very well kept with lots of good amenities, including wireless internet. Johannes was out of town during my visit but remained responsive and approachable the entire time, which was much appreciated. The place is nice and warm, which is great for winter (especially as I was coming from southern California and not used to the mild cold weather). Some basic cooking and cleaning supplies were provided, as were towels and other necessities. The place gets a lot of natural light, which is quite nice. Really, this place was perfect, and I would say it is ideal for anyone's first (or repeat) visit to Geneva.

The apartment was pristine and a pleasure to stay in. The neighbourhood is very elegant and quiet but close to the Old Town and transport options in every direction. Would stay here again when in Geneva but Geneva prices are high.

I met both Johannes and his representative at different times; they were both efficient and charming.

The apartment was lovely, nicely furnished and very clean (Johannes has a cleaning lady available if needed).

Johannes provided a starter stock of all useful things of dishwasher soap etc. Very helpfully there is a washing machine and tumble drier in the basement.

The bedrooms are at the back of the flat and very quiet; perfect for a good night of sleep.

I thoroughly recommend Johannes and his flat. I hope to stay there again myself.

Thanks Johannes!

Wonderful location and great place. Johannes was very responsive and was very accommodating on our arrival and departure times. The apartment was spacious and comfortable. Walking distance and convenient to old town and planpalais. We were there during the EUROgames which was exciting and we could to walk to the fan zone.
It was a little noisy in the evenings after the games....because the fans were so excited, but we'd definitely stay here again. Johannes was a great host.
Great place in a great location. Very clean and comfortable. I would definitely stay here again.

My third time spending a month in Johannes's Geneva flat. The building is fine, the location excellent (also for public transportation), and the flat spacious, well-outfitted, and functional. It's a very pleasant base.

Absolutely Wonderful apartment in the heart of Genève. Big, Beautiful, with lots of natural light, comfortable, modern, very quiet, well connected, with great design, with elevator and with everything you need to feel good, confortable and at home.
I stayed 1 months in Johanne's apartment and i had absolutely Wonderful time. I will definitely back there also next time.
I didn't meet Johannes, but he managed our check-in in great way and her friend was also really kind.
I had Wonderful time in this gorgeous apartment and I really highly recommend to everybody.
As described. Ideally located.

Excellent experience - the apartment is in a prime geneva location, next to Parc Bastion and on edge of the old town, 10min walk from lake and at a hub of transport. The Apartment itself is bright, secure and spacious and very well equipped with everything you need. Communication with host A+
Many thanks Johannes for stay

This is a great, spacious flat in a convenient location. Bedrooms at the back were quiet and a great breeze came in through the large windows. It was very hot in Geneva when we were there, but the flat stayed surprisingly cool. Quick access to transit, restaurants and large Coop grocery store nearby. Highly recommend!
excellent location.Very close to the old city.
I don’t have the key of my room, and there is no lock
bon endroit, couple tre sympa
It is a very clean and nice little room located in the center of the city. The hosts are nice people. Overall I would recommend staying at this place.

I was in Geneva 4 weeks because of work, and thanks to Oscar my stay was like being at home. Oscar, his girlfriend and his dog are really friendly, polite and easy-going. The flat is like in the photos, everything clean and tidy. I can say I have a friend now in Geneva....thank you Oscar for everything!

I had the chance to stay at Oscar's place for more than a month. Couldn’t have been better. The apartment was beautiful and equipped with everything I needed . Its a short walk from supermarkets, pharmacy, restaurants and bars. It’s also right next to the tram and bus stop so you are minutes away from the heart of Geneva .Oscar was very helpful and always reachable. I strongly recommend.

Oscar and Loredana are very nice, friendly, and helpful. I stayed for one month and a half and always felt comfortable. The location is very convenient, close to everything but in a quiet quartier. The place is very clean, I had a window with a mountain view. Highly recommend!
Génial séjour à Carouge avec Oscar et ses deux chiens. 100% recommandable comme airbnb pour moyens et longues séjours.

Oscar est un hôte très accueillant et il a su me mettre tout de suite à l’aise, c’est une très belle personne
Ses chiennes sont adorables :)
J’y ai passé un très bon séjour, comme à la maison
Je recommande fortement :)
only stayed there for a couple of days, but was very nice! very easy to get to the centre of Geneva. His dogs are very cute and friendly!
Oscar was very helpful and friendly.  He picked me from the train station. It was very comfortable stay at his place. He is an amazing host.

J'ai séjourné 3 mois chez Oscar.
J'ai été très bien accueilli par ce dernier (et ses deux très gentils chiens) qui a su se rendre disponible et réactif. Nous avons beaucoup échangé autour d'un repas ou d'un verre durant cette longue période ce qui me permet d'affirmer qu'Oscar est une personne sans prise de tête, bienveillante, et qui saura vous orienter vers les bons coins de Genève !
L'appartement est quant à lui plus que correcte, avec une chambre et balcon qui font parfaitement l'affaire si vous avez besoin de vous loger quelque mois à prix raisonnable. Sans compter la propreté impeccable.
La localisation est à proximité des transports et à 10-15 minutes à pied du centre. J'ai trouvé l'emplacement très attrayant.
Je recommande fortement !
The room nice, cozy, but really very small, better suitable for shorter stays. The whole stay was without any complications, Oscar is very friendly, for sure I can recommend.

Oscar was an extremely friendly host and gave great suggestions for things to do in the neighborhood. He also went out of his way to walk with me and my husband to show us some of the best local dining spots. Oscar also explained how to use the trams that run through the city. He was very helpful and I would highly recommend his place!
Charmante pièce chez un hôte accueillant et cordial. Très propre et sympathique

I stayed here for a month and half, and already miss this wonderful experience there! Oscar is always available and very kind, and the dogs are very friendly. I also went with them to a mountain nearby and it was an amazing experience. Further, the house is well cleaned and located near several bus stations. Very reccommended!
Monsieur Oscar est très gentil et sympathique.
Apartamento muy cercano al centro de ginebra, muy fácil de encontrar y un ambiente muy comodo y tranquilo en casa, los perros son muy dóciles, y Oscar muy amable y respetuoso.

Living with Oscar and his sweet dogs was great, it felt as I was at home.
Location was convenient and quiet.
I highly recommend it.
:)

Oscarさんは私が今まで出会った中で最高のホストです。彼ほど素晴らしいホストはいないと思います！
Oscarさんは車で迎えに来てくれたり、ハイジの映画を見せてくれたり、会話を楽しんでくれたり、そのほかにもたくさんの気遣いをしてくれました。彼の家でたくさんの思い出を作ることができました！ジュネーヴにいる間、彼の家で滞在することができて本当に良かったです。
彼の犬たちもとても愛らしいです！私を歓迎してくれて、仲良くなれました😊次に彼女たちに会う日が待ちきれません！
最後の日はお別れするのが悲しくて泣いてしまいました🥲次にジュネーヴに来るときは必ずまたOscarさんの家に泊まりに来ます！！ありがとうございました✨

Oscar is a really gentleman and warm welcoming!
His 2 cute dogs are friendly and super calm.
You’ll get your privacy 100% and will get great stay!
Highly recommend!
Lovely host, very clean apartment, comfortable bedroom and felt right at home!
Oscar was the best host! Very kind, responsive and accommodating. His dogs are the cutest, too! Really wonderful stay, would definitely recommend!

Mes trois mois chez Oscar se sont parfaitement bien passés. Oscar est accueillant, réactif et amical ; il m'a une fois proposé une randonnée au Salève dont je garde de superbes souvenirs.
La chambre en elle-même est un peu petite, mais elle est aménagée intelligemment et je n'ai pas ressenti de manque de place. De toute façon, si vous êtes à Genève, vous risquez de ne pas passer tout votre temps dans la chambre !
Oscar a deux chiennes de taille moyenne. Elles sont super gentilles, mais c'est bon à savoir si vous avez peur des chiens.
Pour le reste, tout est conforme à la description.
Je recommande chaudement !

Oscar is an incredible host! We had great conversation, and he recommended that I swim in the Rhône, which was an amazing experience that I would not have had otherwise. He was very responsive and accommodating of my schedule, and his dogs are adorable. His apartment is beautiful, with two balconies, one of which is accessible from the bedroom.

Excellent stay in a super central location - access to the city center by a 20-30 min walk as well as any lake & river location by easy rentable bikes. Oscar's lovely manners and his beautiful dogs are the cherry on top!
Oscar est un hôte amical et disponible.

Elegir el alojamiento de Oscar fue una buena decisión. Ubicado en el hermoso barrio de Carouge, la habitación tenía todo lo que se indicaba. Bien ubicado para el transporte público. Oscar fue siempre muy amable para conversar o hacerle cualquier consulta. Los perritos de su casa son adorables y se portan bien. Gracias Oscar.
真的是非常棒的住宿地點，我每天都住的很開心，有兩隻可愛的狗狗，房東人超級nice，環境也非常乾淨，總之就是很棒！

My stay was amazing! Oscar is an incredible host and treats guests with nothing but respect and kindness. We even celebrated my 19th birthday together since I was on an exchange. My stay was incredibly comfortable and the location is very convenient. The place is very clean and tidy and great added bonus, his dogs are wonderful, I totally recommend him for your next trip to Geneva 😊

J'étais bien contente et heureuse d'avoir été chez Oscar. Oscar est très gentil, pas du tout compliqué et je me sentais très bien chez lui. Il est très jovial et est toujours prêt à aider quand on a besoin de lui. Je reviendrai en tout cas et peux recommander à 200% la chambre chez Oscar. Les deux compagnons d'Oscar que vous voyez sur la photo sont très calmes et sociables! Ils viennent toujours me saluer quand je rentre et je ne les entendais pas du  tout pendant la nuit. Je souhaite Oscar tout de bon et remercie de tout coeur du bon séjour chez lui!

I really enjoyed my stay! Oscar is a very welcoming host and was always happy to help – from picking me up at the airport when I arrived to making raclette and visiting Mont Salève on weekends. The apartment had all the amenities described on the listing and it’s very well located for getting to the city centre. As a student doing an internship,  this was an excellent value accommodation option.

Excellent, hôte très sympathique
Parfait un grand merci
Oscar is a very friendly and helpful host. The place is modest, but comfortable enough for a short stay in Geneva. And there is no better neighbourhood than Carouge.

I do not recommend this host. While the location was as described, the living environment felt hostile and unsafe. The host repeatedly yelled at me and made unfounded accusations about the cleanliness of the space. His aggressive behavior created a highly uncomfortable atmosphere. I felt forced to checkout early. I hope he finds peace.

Oscar is an exceptionally good host, always available to assist. He is a well rounded person, who is conversant with a lot of topical issues on geo politics, socio-economic issues. He debates with calmly yet drives his point home. I enjoyed and finished his coffee, which I brewed every morning. I’m sure about  coming back again next year.
Magnifique endroit, je recommande vivement !
This is a lovely apartment - stylish, clean and well located.  Patricia is a very good host, highly recommended.
Beautiful home, easy access to shopping district of town ( 5 -7 mins bus ride) very well upkeep and amazing find.  Will definitely stay here again 😀

Ich möchte mich bei Afsaneh herzlich bedanken. Sie war eine sehr nette und hilfsbereite Gastgeberin. Sie hat auch an den Kaffee, Säfte und Obst gedacht, um den Aufenthalt zu versüßen. Das Haus war sehr sauber, die Betten sehr gemütlich und der Garten gepflegt. Ich und meine Begleiter waren sehr glücklich über diese Bekanntschaft. Ich kann Afsaneh nur empfehlen.

L'ospite è stata disponibile e nello stesso tempo discreta.
La descrizione della casa era perfettamente corrispondente e addirittura l'abitazione si è rivelata più gradevole e luminosa di quanto risultasse nelle fotografie.
Il quartiere è molto verde e residenziale, tranquillo e non lontanoda Ginevra. Non vicinissimi supermercato e negozi.
Nice view, solace  place

I stayed at Afsaneh's place for only one night. Although she wasn't there for ckeck in but she was very helpful arranging it and even sent me the bus schedule. Her friend, Pascal was there for check in and he was super nice and welcoming. I had a long talk with him and he prepared everything for my breakfast. It was super. Highly recommend staying there.

Affie and Paskal were a great host while we were in Geneva. They were very hospitable and willing to work with our late itinerary. Affie even introduced my girlfriend and I to the best croissants we have ever had! They gave great tour suggestions and even helped us out planning our trip around Geneva. They are both truly one of a kind and even better genuine people. If you are lucky enough to stay at this house, you won't regret it.
Also, the house has an amazing view of the Alps. 10/10 would stay again!

Endroit paisible et dépaysant avec l'énorme jardin et la terrasse en plein Genève. Vous avez la valeur de l'hospitalité, du partage ce qui font de vous des accueillants fantastiques et riches humainement.
Votre chambre était agréable et confortable pour un séjour express entre amis !
Bonne continuation vous êtes géniaux !

Had an great stay, Affie and Pascal are amazing hosts. Super friendly and really cool. The room was pretty basic but it was comfortable and great if you just need a place to crash.
The location is great, only a 10 minute drive from Geneva, enough to get away from the busyness of the city.

We are so happy to stay with Affie and her family ! There is really nice environment , beautiful and confortable room. Not far from Genève ! Very nice to meet you and your dog, hope to see you again !
Excelentes anfitriones, muy accesibles en los que además puedes encontrar un amigo, un cuarto cómodo, baños limpios y una casa acogedora con un hermoso jardín. 100% recomendable!

The house is in a quit countryside with great view, Pascal and Affie are very friendly and helpful for all you needed. Maamoun is a charming and very attentive host.  We stayed in his flat for five weeks. This studio apartment (it’s not a one-bedroom) is located in a beautiful building on a charming street in Geneva’s elegant Champel neighborhood. For Fr 15 a day, we had our own private parking space in front of the building, but often used the number 3 bus which stops right around the corner and takes you downtown, to the train station and to many useful connections.  The living room is decorated in Asian style, with mostly ornate furniture but a lovely modern dining table with six chairs and a matching TV table.  The TV is large and offered many channels.  The large bed (seemed king size) is a pull-out but nevertheless comfortable - we left it open all the time.  In addition, there is a couch but it’s also a pull-out and not very comfortable. The room is bright and well lit, with large windows and a door that opens onto a small terrace with another 6-seat table and comfortable chairs plus a quiet grassy area. The bathroom is generously sized, with a bidet and a high-sided bathtub and portable showerhead with good pressure. The kitchen was the weak point for us. Half the size of the bathroom, it had an oldfashioned three-burner electric stove, a sink with a draining board, absolutely no counter space, and a small counter-height fridge.  There was a small round table.  On the plus side, it had a window onto the terrace but when opened one could not open the fridge!  The building’s basement has excellent washing machines ( took three 1-fr coins) and a powerful heated drying closet.  I cannot stress enough how gracious Maamoun and Irina were,  kindly offering us kitchenware that we needed and even some space in their own fridge for a cooked dish that needed chilling overnight. Irina and I even exchanged samples of our homemade baked goods.  In sum, Maamoun’s flat is ideal for short stays or, for for longer stays if you don’t plan on spending much time cooking.

I couldn't have had a better Airbnb experience. However, Maamoun and his wife's amazing hospitality and kindness really made the experience special. As I could not leave, they often brought me home-cooked food and checked in on me to make sure I was doing well. On top of everything else, this flat is very safe, and it's in a gorgeous and peaceful residential area. Thanks to my gracious hosts, I had an amazing welcome to my new home. I highly recommend this apartment for any kind of stay in Geneva.

After having spent a whole month in Mr. Maamoun's place, I have nothing but words of praise for the apartment and the host. It is a truly comfortable place, located in a very quiet and safe area of Champel, perfect for a peaceful rest. It is well-connected with the downtown as the trolley-bus No. 3 stops right next to the building. There is also a lovely park in the neighborhood and two supermarkets. The apartment is clean and equipped with everything one can possibly need, including a small but well-equipped kitchen, and even if there is something missing, the extremely kind host and his wife, who live next door, will do everything to provide it. The apartment opens up to a garden, which came very handy during our visit as we had to spend the initial 10 days in quarantine. We were a party of two,  one of whom underwent a surgery in the University Hospital in Geneva, also 10 minutes away, and the apartment proved to be a very good place for recovery. The heating was quite good, which is not often the case in Geneva. If ever I return to Geneva I will stay at Mr. Maamoun's place and would highly recommend it to everyone, particularly for the kindness of its hosts.
Super host
