I really recommend it
We loved our visit and would definitely stay there again! Thank you!

Perfect apartament for a family .
Everything as described in the old town.
Cosy, comfortable and perfectly clean

Die Wohnung ist schön und praktisch eingerichtet und super gelegen.  Lärmpegel war etwas höher als erwartet, da früh morgens mit Anlieferungen, Müllabfuhr und Strassenreinigung ziemlich viel los ist. Bei geschlossenen Fenstern kein Problem, sie dichten gut ab.

Die Wohnung von Francoise ist wunderbar gelegen und mit allem ausgestattet, was man braucht. Es ist sauber und die Wohnung ist auch für Familien sehr empfehlenswert. Francoise reagiert immer sofort und ist sehr hilfsbereit!
Der einzige Nachteil der tollen Lage ist bei geöffneten Fenstern der Lärmpegel der Altstadt wie z.B. in der Nacht die Straßenreinigung und Müllabfuhr. Die Fenster sind aber sehr gut und schalldicht und dadurch hat man mit geschlossenen Fenstern seine Ruhe. Wir kommen gerne wieder!

Francoise’s apartment is in a stunning location, right off the most beautiful square in the oldest part of Geneva. There are fantastic places to eat, have coffee and visit within a few minutes walk. The apartment itself is a good size, very comfortable and warm and with little noise from the street below. Francoise was a great host, always responsive if we had questions.  I cannot recommend her place highly enough.

I grew up in Geneva, now live near San Francisco, and always wanted to experience the old city and it was fabulous. The flat is very well furnished and there was supply for your every day needs like coffee, tea, condiments, etc... I have 2 grand children and there are plenty of toys for them so I was able to have them in the flat and it was great. The location is great, you can walk to great restaurants, bars, shops and Geneva public transportation is the best.

We had a wonderful stay at Francoise's place! The location is perfect, right in the middle of Old Town Geneva, walkable to everything. The apartment is very spacious and comfortable -- looks just like the pictures. The kitchen and bathroom are very modern and included all amenities that we needed. We were glad to have access to the laundry in the building during our stay. Francoise provided clear instructions on how to let ourselves in and responded quickly to all communications. We greatly appreciated her allowing us to check in a few hours early after a very long day of travel! If you're looking for a great place to stay in Geneva, I highly recommend Francoise's place!

A gorgeous apartment in the best part of town. Super convenient, with public transport stops nearby and very walkable. I walked the 22 minutes to and from the main train station (Geneve/Cornavin) with ease. The neighborhood is quite safe at all ours with a large police station just down the street. Although the cafes nearby can be busy, especially on the weekends where they operate late, the newer windows offer excellent buffer from sounds of the street. Pure silence most nights. Great restaurants nearby, I highly recommend Les Antiquaries on Grand-Rue (closed Sunday and Monday).
The apartment had everything I needed, was clean and secure, and the bed was very comfortable. Having a newly remodeled bathroom (with a great shower) and kitchen in Old Town is so nice. I will certainly look to stay here again when I return. Thank you Francoise!

Great location and very comfortable space.  Yes it can sometimes be noisy but if the windows are shut that’s not an issue.  Worth it regardless for the space and the location.  High recommended.  And very family friendly.

Nice apartment with good use of space. Two of the beds are in the large living area. This worked well for us. Washing machine is available but is in the attic of the building. Did not need it so cannot comment on ease of use etc. Nice remodeled kitchen, well equipped.
Location is incredible. Right in the pristine old town of Geneva. Bus stop 5 min walk from the house. Center of town is 5 min walk down the hill. Abundance of cafes and restaurants in the old town. Very lively on summer evenings, people are out till late. Just how it should be. If you like it quiet this is a challenge as the noise is loud even with the windows closed. In the morning street cleaning and trash collection - also loud - starts early. I slept with ear plugs and none of this bothered me.
Loved our stay and would love to stay again.

Perfection! We loved our stay for a week with the kids. Great size apartment for kids. Spotless. In a great location in the middle of the old town. Walking distance to everything and easy access to public transport. Françoise is a great host. Very kind and responsive. Thank you!
Appartement très bien situé dans la vieille ville et bien aménagé.
Fantastic apartment in great location.

Francoise's apartment was the perfect place for me to stay while I was working in Geneva. The bed was comfortable, the WiFi quick and reliable, the area ideal and the whole stay enjoyable. A perfect Airbnb experience!

I love this apartment so much. It is a perfect location and walkable to everything. Absolutely fantastic to explore Geneva. Everything you need is close by. Host is wonderful, kind and very responsive. Perfect experience

This is my second review because I stayed an extra month. I cannot even begin to state how perfect this place is. It is ideal for visiting or working in Geneva. Exceptional location. Very well equipped with everything you need. Françoise is an excellent host and very responsive. I wish I didn’t have to leave. I would definitely stay here again my next trip to Geneva
Super localisation et communication facile !

Great sizable one bedroom apartment right in the heart of old town where all of the action is. Everything is walkable within 10 minutes and if not then public transport is readily available and can take you anywhere in 15 minutes. Apartment is well equipped with everything you need and very comfortable.

Having lived in the apartment for a month, I can fairly say I know the apartment well. Anne-Sophie and Guillermo have hospitality in their blood and will make sure their guests have a pleasant stay.
The apartment is spacious, very clean, well maintained and equiped with a small kitchen, tv and wifi. The location is also ideal. Being close at the highway it can be reached by car very well and makes trips to the surrounding area very easy. And the tram at the end of the street brings you to the city center within 20 minutes.
I can recommend this apartment to anyone who wants to have a pleasant stay in Geneva.

Anne-Sophie's and Guillermo's apartment was indeed very cozy. Well decorated so you feel at home. Also it is equipped with everything you need and Anne-Sophie was always ready to help out or give recommendations about public transport and places to visit in the area. Its location in Confignon is great as well: it has winefields around the corner for taking walks and with the tram you're in down town Geneva within half an hour. All in all I had a great stay and would recommend it to anyone!

5 Stars! I had a very pleased stay at Anne-Sophie and Guillermo's apartment. The studio is very very clean and well kept, Anne and her daughter were kind and polite and very welcoming. I definitely recommend this place for anyone that is looking to stay in the Geneva area.
good expenrise and big room. Convenient
We had a great stay here in Confignon. The hosts are very friendly and available, and the place is large, clean very well located. Highly recommended.
Our second short stay has been as good as the first one. Highly recommended. Nicolas

We had a very pleasant stay at Anne-Sophia and Guillermo's place. The studio is very nice and has a very good location. You can park your car in front of the house and can leave it there during your stay because public transport is just 100 metres away that brings you straight into the city center.

I stayed at their place for 6 weeks and things went pretty smoothly with the hosts. The communication was excellent and they were always at my disposal whenever I had something to ask. They were very welcoming and always smiling at me - no wonder why I felt so home there. I am more than pleased to stay at their place.
The place was clean and it had anything I ever needed. Geneva is famous for its high cost of living so I always needed to cook, but I didn't have to buy any cooking equipments or cutlery. The internet connection was great.
If you are staying with two persons, the price would be considered pretty cheap. (I basically stayed there alone so that's why I needed to put star 4 for one of the evaluations.) Definitely recommended.
The place is really nice , clean and with all what describes in the announcement. The area is surrounded by vineyards , great for walking or bike.

Studio confortable, bien agence, tres bien situe avec les transports publiques. Anne-Sopie, Guillermo et leurs deux filles sont tres serviables, prets a repondre a toute demande. Nous recommandons chaleureusement ce logement, nous y reviendrons tres volontiers. Gerard & Ulla-Britt, Espagne.

Anne-Sophie is a super nice host. Very welcoming and warm-hearted so as her family! They provided us so many good information for travelling and they are also willing to offer help at any moment. They are also very fluent in English so communication was never a problem.
The studio: It is very well equipped, you could find anything you need, ranging from cooking utensils to cleaning/ Ironing stuff. The studio looks exactly like the photo and the bed is large enough for 2 people. We have our own entrance to the studio which is located on the basement floor making it highly convenient. The neighbourhood is calm and quiet.
Location: Although it is located slightly in the south of geneva, going to the city and work in the centre is very easy. Tram 14 is right in front of the studio (3mins walk) and within 20 mins you will be in the city centre. Tram 14 is also running every 3-10mins (3/4 mins in rush hour).
My stay was highly pleasant and I will definitely come again if I am travelling or visiting Geneva again.
Excellent accueil et emplacement très central Parfait pour découvrir Genève et la région. Bonnes prestations
Very friendly and helpful hosts! Awesome apartment!
Good size studio, very comfortable bed, parking is appreciated. Very nice hosts.
It was a lovely plave.

Toute la famille est très accueillante, disponible, prête à répondre à toutes sortes de questions, à partager des informations et à aider à tout moment.   Je me sentais très à l'aise et avait un séjour très agréable.

Close to bus stops and a little supermarket, this little, nice and warm flat is providing you with anything you need for your staying in Geneva. Owners are very kind and always ready to answer to any of your questions. I highly recommend it.

The basement flat is just as cosy and warm as portrayed in the pictures! It is a very homely place. The family was very friendly and helpful. Whenever anything happened (such as if a light broke) they always responded promptly and would fix it very quickly. They are also very good at giving advice about where to go in Geneva. Everything was great and worked well (e.g. excellent coffee machine, TV and very comfortable bed) - the only issue I had (at times) was the wifi connection.
Confignon is a pretty and quiet location. It is slightly out of Geneva with very fast and regular links to central Geneva via the 14 tram. It is excellent if you are visiting Geneva but want to stay somewhere pretty and relaxed. The area has plenty of nice walks, whether down to the Rhone or the River l'Aire (as I believe it is called) or to nearby Bernex or Confignon, which feel very villagey with nice boulangeries, cafes and craft shops.

Super accueil , très beau studio!
Pratique pour se rendre au centre ville avec le tram
Nice, well located studio and super friendly hosts. I would recommend this place.

The studio is quite large. Private entrance and easy parking at the front.
Hosts were good. They live above but you can't hear them.
Bed and internet fine. Clean place. The kitchenette is small but does the job (microwave oven+ 2 induction cooking plates+ a small fridge).
The only thing you should be aware of is that this is in a basement, i.e. the ceiling is about at street level. You do get some windows at both ends of the apartment and some natural light / fresh air but it may not be for everyone.
Overall a pleasant stay and would recommend.

Anne-Sophie and Guillermo’s studio is a lovely place to stay, in a pretty and secluded village among the vineyards, yet with easy access to central Geneva. The studio has everything you need and more, and is very comfortable. There’s a supermarket and a couple of restaurants close by and lots of lovely walking/running trails by the river.
Vous serez content de votre séjour

The studio is located on the edge of Confignon, right in-between the city and the beginning of the countryside, in a quiet neighbourhood, yet a minute away from the tram. Couldn't be more convenient commuting-wise!
The interior design is charming, with quality furniture and various types of lights, the combination of which provides a very cosy atmosphere. Icing on the cake, the studio keeps cool in the summer!
Last but not least, I've received a very warm welcome from Anne-Sophie and Guillermo, who have been helpful throughout my stay.
I can only recommend this place: 5 stars.

I stayed with Anne-Sophie and Guillermo for one month and decided to continue my stay there. It’s a really nice place with all necessary things inside. They are always ready to help and answer all questions. When I just arrived and did not know anything, they showed all the bus/trum stops, shops etc. Helped me to make bus/tram ticket. Location is very good too. It’s only 25-30 minutes from the airport by bus, by car 15 minutes. So if you think where to stay it will be the best place in Geneva 😄

I have been living there for almost 4 month and never regretted about it. I lived there alone but two times my aunt and friend came to visit me for a couple of days. The hosts have provided to them all necessary things like towels, pillows etc. It’s very convenient.
Also it was really easy to communicate with them. When I was ill I just asked them to bring me medication and they helped me. It was really important for me.
The apartment was clean and cozy, I always came back with pleasure.
So, if looking for apartment for living in Geneva it will be a good option for 1-2 person.

I recommend Anne-Sophie’s studio. Studio is quiet, and well decorated, and very clean.  Anne is quick to respond our request.  We can also use a laundry machine and sewing kit, and that makes our trip much easier.  I want to stay this place again when I come to Geneva.

I stayed at Anna-Sophie and Guillermo for 1 month while I looked for a permanent place to stay in Geneva. Their cosy and well-equipped studio made my first time in Geneva very easy and comfortable. They were excellent hosts which provided me with useful tips and information when being new in Geneva. I can highly recommend staying at Anne-Sophie and Guillermo's place.
nice

Very helpful and nice hosts, comfortable place with all needed amenities.
Situated away of Geneve but thanks to public transport you may reach both city and the airtport within 30mins.
Great host, nice place to stay.

I stayed at her place for 1 month and had a really great time. She responded me very quickly to all my requests, and provided me with new bed sheets and towel weekly! She was very thoughtful and very kind!

Exactly as photo showed. Very clean. Convenient located just 3mins to tram station which you can reach city center in 20mins. Very quiet. Big enough space for 1 or 2 persons. Recommend to stay here even for a long time.
Anee-Sophie's and Guillermo's air bnb studio was well equipped, large and clean. Communication was excellent and the commute was much simpler and easier than i expected. Highly recommended

Mr. Guillermo is very nice gentleman, the studio was quite clean. It’s not in the downtown but there’s bus just outside the main road, it’s convenient to the center of Geneva within 20mins by bus. There’s coffee bar, restaurant and grocery store in the community center. I’ll choose again if next time being Geneva.

I really enjoyed my stay in this house. Especially, I loved the large space and the convenient location to the city center. And the host couple is very kind and friendly. I decided to stay here longer. I recommend this accommodation.
Thank you for hosting us. Perfect just like last time.
I stayed here for almost 6 months. The place is cozy and the host family is very friendly. And the location is good, too.
Nous sommes très content de notre séjour chez Anne-Sophie et Guillermo. Des hôtes très gentils et très arrangeants qui nous ont bien accueilli pour notre premier séjour à Genève. Je recommande !

Accueil chaleureux.
Studio agréable et pratique.
Tout près du tram, dans un joli village .

We spent several weeks with our hosts, Anne-Sophie & Guillermo, in their apartment in Confignon, a pleasant neighborhood 15 minutes from downtown Geneva by tram. Throughout our stay, our hosts were friendly and attentive. Whenever we had a question, they were always willing to help. This quiet apartment comes fully furnished, with plenty of storage, cooking facilities, a tv, internet, and a comfortable bed. We recommend this unit and our hosts without hesitation, and we would readily agree to stay with them again.

This studio apartment is nice and cozy and functional for a short stay just outside of Geneva.  Everything one needs is available, even a small cooking area with Nespresso machine, toaster and washing machine.  Anne-Sophie and Guillermo were gracious and accomodating to our smallest needs, and we would stay with them again without any hesitation!
By far, the best Airbnb stay I have ever had. The perfect place to stay in Geneva! Great location, and very much worth the trip!

Anne-Sophie and Guillermo are lovely people. We had some good conversations and they were really helpful with our questions and queries.
The apartment itself is in the basement but there's plenty of light incoming and feels like a little home away from home. You will get all what you need including towel sets.
Becareful with heavy luggage because you will have to go down a narrow but short flight of stairs.

I was in Geneva for work and had a restful and lovely stay. My work is in downtown and it was very convenient to catch the 14 tram which is just a 2 min walk. Airport was 10 min drive. There is a tiny grocery store open late just a 7 min walk away.
Room was comfortable and lovely with great wifi, desk and a nespresso.
Host met me and was very helpful to show me the place and even offering an early CheckIn. Would stay again!! Thank you.
Calm and peaceful place to stay, great hosts
Very kind host; place is safe, quiet but super easy to get to the centre of Geneva (direct tram)

I felt like home, great communication with the host. thank you very much for the hospitality. The place is very close to the Public transportation, you can easily reach Geneve city center. the house is clean and cozy, I would recommend it to anyone wanting to visit Geneve but would like to avoid city chaos. thanks again, hopefully I'll stay again in your place.

The apartment is very quiet, clean and comfortable. The area is nice and quite - just 20 minutes to the centre on the tram. Everything went smoothly and the hosts were very friendly, accommodating and discreet. Very good stay, thank you!

We have stayed here a couple of times and each stay is very nice!! It’s located in a very beautiful and quiet neighborhood.
Guillermo and Anne-Sophie are very friendly and helpful!!

This is my second time staying with Anne-Sophie and Guillermo. It must be one of the most quiet and peaceful places to stay in Geneva. Perfect for one person or a couple, very clean, truthful to the pictures provided. Anne-Sophie made the check-in experience very easy, as she was there to meet me in person upon arrival. She is extremely friendly and accommodating with guests’ requests. The place is comfortable, and has all that is needed for short to medium stays. Location-wise, unbeatable: the charm of Geneva country side, well connected to the city centre (tram 14 stop is just a few min. away) and quite close to the airport. I really appreciated my one week stay here.

Anne-Sophie and Guillermo were wonderful hosts.  Extremely kind and accommodating.  The location is conveniently located to public transportation and a local park is nearby.  Wonderful space.  I would certainly recommend staying there.
Wonderful stay with friendly and responsive hosts. Appears as pictured.
Great location, close to tram line and to Confignon square where there is cafe, grocery, restaurant and a bar.

Great apartment close to the train station which was very convenient. Cyril communicated well and answered all of our questions. There were a few issues with the power in the apartment which was inconvenient, but it seems like that was just unlucky.

Notre séjour dans le logement de Cyril s'est très bien passé.
L'appartement était propre et conforme à l'annonce.
Seul point négatif à noter : le vitrage et les murs sont très fins (prévoyez des bouchons d'oreilles)
Habitué au logement Airbnb, nous ne nous attendions cependant pas à loger dans un appartement où l'hôte vivait, où il y avait toutes ses affaires, mais ça ne nous a pas dérangé pour autant.
L'appartement est effectivement très proche de la gare (Cornavin) ce qui est un vrai plus pour les déplacements.
Cyril est un hôte réactif et très cordial.
Petit plus : il était indiqué qu'il n'y avait pas de wifi et Cyril avait quand même un boîtier 4G, ce qui est très appréciable en Suisse, pour des étrangers le hors-forfait monte vite !
Bref, nous recommandons ce logement à tout ceux qui sont de passage à Genève :)
Superbe appartement à Genève, très joli, avec un autre très accueillant et flexible. Je recommande

Die Unterkunft von Cyrill war sehr schön.
Die Lage in der Bähe des Bahnhofs ermöglicht es in 10 Minuten am See zu sein.

l'appartement proposé par Cyril est très agréable et bien situé, à mn de la gare et des commerces. le contact avec Cyril est facile et sympathique,
j'y reviendrai volontiers

Le logement était parfaitement en adéquation avec les descriptions de l’hôte : parfaitement équipé et très confortable. D’ailleurs, nous avons pu tout faire à pied tellement l’emplacement y est propice (lac, balades, parcs). On s’y est vraiment senti bien.
Grand point positif : le boîtier 4G, à haut débit. Il est agréable de pouvoir profiter du voyage sans faire gonfler la facture de hors-forfait. 😊
Tout petit point négatif : la localisation près de la Gare est un grand +, malheureusement, cela reste assez bruyant, notamment la nuit.
Nous avons tout de même passé un merveilleux séjour.
Un grand merci à Cyril !

Appartement fidèle à la description et aux photos :) avec un emplacement très pratique à 5min à pied de la gare, mais qui est toute fois dans une rue peu passante!
Très belle découverte, je recommande.
A lovely room close to the station. JP and Xuong are very helpful hosts.

Wonderful Room with seperate own bathroom, Very comfortable.
I felt very welcome, and enjoyed my stay very much. Jean Philippes gives the feeling of "coming home"
The flat is located very close to the staion and walking distance to old oart and lake of Genf!
Whem i come back to Genf again, i would book again to stay with them.

Der Aufenthalt bei Jean-Philippe und Xoung war außerordentlich schön! Wir wurden sehr offen und warmherzig empfangen. Alles war perfekt vorbereitet, inklusive eines Audio-Guides für eine Stadtführung. Wir hatten einen Anlass zu feiern und wurden von unseren Gastgebern mit liebevollen Details überrascht. Wir hatten um einen Restaurant-Tipp gebeten - auch der war ein voller Erfolg, den Tisch hatte unser Gastgeber bereits reserviert.... Das Zimmer ist wunderschön und alles sehr gepflegt.
Also besser geht nicht! Insgesamt sehr zu empfehlen!!!!

We have a very good stay, Jean-Philippe was very friendly and helpful. The apartment was 2 min for train station, very well located, cosy room, cute bathroom and all very clean. I would recommend this place for sure!

Acceuil extraordinaire des 2 hotes. Un emplacement irreprochable, un acceuil si chaleureux, une hygiene hors du commun, On ne peut pas juste pas trouver mieux. Tout le Monde a Geneve devrait passer par cet hebergement ou l'on peut se sentir que "Comme A la Maison". Au grand plaisir de se revoir, au grand plaisir de re-sejourner chez vous deux. Merci Encore

What a treat. We decided to visit geneva at the last minute and jean Philippe and xuong welcomed us with no hesitation. I cannot describe in words the beauty of their home and the level of hospitality we received. They act as professional tour guides and BnB hosts. The maps and travel recorder were fantastic and we saw so much more than we ever imagined we would. I recommend them completely. You will be so happy you stayed with them. Oh, and eat at the restaurant they recommend.

Jean Philippe and Xuong are awesome hosts. 24/7 available, very responsive and helpful. Their place is very well located and comfortable. They welcomed us for only one night but we will definitely contact them when we go back to Geneva again.

I had a very pleasant two-night stay at Jean-Philippe and Xuong's beautiful apartment in Geneva.  My room was attractive, immaculate, private and quiet and the bathroom very nice and also private.  I had easy access in and out of the apartment (but very safe access) and Jean-Philippe and Xuong were gracious and friendly.  The apartment is located just a couple of blocks from the train station, very close to public transportation, the UN and related agencies, and a short walk to the old town.  While the price may seem high by AirBnB standards, the place is a great find in a city with exorbitantly priced hotels.  I certainly would recommend this place and stay there on future trips to Geneva.

We were both very happy with choosing the room posted by Jean-Philippe and Xuong. They were great hosts, welcomed us very warmly even though we arrived very late (past midnight). The room itself was very cozy, nice and clean with all amenities possible. Jean-Philippe recommended us a place to eat too, which was also very nice. This was a surprise for my newly-wed husband Gabor, and he was extremely happy :)

Jean-Phillippe and Xuong couldn't have been nicer or more welcoming hosts-- Xuong even ironed my suit for me to help me out. The room was beautiful and very clean and the apartment is very centrally located.

Jean-Phillippe and Xuong are great hosts! They welcome us with juice + cookie and a good conversation upon our arrival. We enjoyed talking with them.
The room was very beautiful,tidy and cozy.The location of the apartment is very convinient. I highly recommend to live here!
Jean-Philippe and Xuong were very caring, helpful and friendly and gave us tipps about Geneva. The room was very clean, quiet and the bed was excellent! We slept very well. Thank you guys.
The room was perfect. We had a warm welcome and a wonderful stay. Thanks.
A perfect room and bath in an ideal location with delightful hosts!  I hope to see them again in the future.

Stayed 2-nights at Jean-Philippe & Xuong's apt. Location wise, it is very central to stay and explore Geneva (10mins walk to Lake Geneva and the main train station). Jean-Philippe & Xuong are very friendly, caring and helpful hosts. They made us feel very much at home, sharing their nicely decorated apt. We stayed at in their 2nd bedroom that had an attached bathroom with heated floors, comfortable bed and good powerful shower. They were responsive to queries and even provided us with an audio guide to explore Geneva. I would definitely stay with them again if I am visiting Geneva.

Jean-Philippe & Xuong are really warm & friendly hosts! Beautiful apartment (my husband & I were so impressed), very clean room, bed was so comfortable and excellent location that's really near the train station.

Would highly recommend to family & friends!

Jean-Philippe et Xuong son super simpáticos, accesibles y sobre todo unas super guías. Con respecto al apartamento, éste se encuentra muy bien localizado con lo necesario a un sólo paso (transporte urbano, tren, supermercados, etc).
Encore une fois merci beaucoup a vous deux pour votre accueil.
Cette une adresse à ne pas louper!

A wonderful, albeit brief, experience in Geneva with Jean-Philippe and Xuong. Jean-Philippe was extremely accommodating - I made the reservation the night before after making last minute plans to drive to Geneva in the early morning. He was kind enough to let me in very early in the morning, and provided me with maps and a recorded walking tour of the city. Upon my departure early the next morning he had coffee ready as well. The room is lovely, with private bathroom and excellent shower. All in all a lovely room with a wonderfully accommodating host, and I"ll be back should I ever find myself in Geneva again.

Un séjour fantastique, Jean-Philippe et Xuong sont des hôtes remarquables. Ils sont plein de petites attentions à l'égard de ceux qu'ils reçoivent et sont à l'affût de la moindre demande!
Connaissant très bien la ville, ils donnent de très bons conseils pour profiter au maximum des loisirs, des plaisirs et de la douceur de vivre de Genève.
Ils disposent d'un très bel appartement, confortable, décoré avec goût et délicatesse.
Nous recommandons fortement JP&X pour votre séjour.

J'ai été accueilli très sympathiquement par Jean-Philippe et Xuong, tous deux d'une grande gentillesse. L'appartement est très confortablement aménagé et joliment décoré, la chambre l'est tout autant, un vrai nid douillet !
J'ai beaucoup apprécié les indications précises et les conseils avisés de Jean-Philippe concernant les moyens de transport, les trajets et la restauration à proximité. Il m'a permis de découvrir un restaurant typiquement suisse où je me suis régalé tous les soirs.
J'ai donc passé un excellent séjour et je ne peux que recommander d'y résider lors de votre passage à Genève.

Я была у Жан-Филиппа и Ксуонга в октябре. Всего одну ночь. Могу сказать, что они очень приятные и общительные ребята. Атмосфера в доме очень теплая и доброжелательная. Это был мой первый опыт , снять комнату у местных. Я очень рада что выбрала именно эту комнату. Удачное расположение (пешком можно дойти до центрального вокзала и набережной). Комната очень теплая с отдельным душем и туалетом. Кровать очень удобная. все чисто и красиво. Создается полное впечатление что здесь ждали именно тебя. Сами хозяева очень дружелюбные. Мы прекрасно провели вечер. Я уезжала рано утром и Жан-Филипп меня провожал, несмотря на ранний час. Всем рекомендую. Вы не разочаруетесь! Жан-Филипп и Ксуонг-спасибо вам, надеюсь скоро увидимся)

Séjour très agréable dans un vrai petit cocon douillet. Jean-Philippe et Xuong sont des hôtes charmants, pleins d'attentions et de bons conseils pour profiter au mieux de Genève.
Nous gardons un excellent souvenir de notre escapade genèvoise et reviendrons avec plaisir.

This was my first time using Airbnb, and I am convinced!  I made a same-day rental, with a late arrival and very early departure, but Jean-Philippe and Xuong were extremely accommodating.  The room I rented was spacious, clean, and comfortable, as well as nicely decorated.  The hosts were friendly and charming, but unobtrusive.  I would gladly stay there again, and will recommend it to friends.

Logement super, proche gare et commoditées.

nous avons passé un très bon séjour chez Cyril.

Cyril a été réactif quand nous en avons eu besoin (on a fermé la porte avec la clef à l'intérieur...). Nous avons beaucoup apprécié ses présence, disponibilité à trouver une solution, son aide à trouver éventuellement un hôtel.

Location perfect, the apartment has everything except for cabinet with hangers for shirts, jackets and coats.
We had a lovely stay at Cyril’s place. It’s just a few minutes away from the main train station and a few bus stops, making commuting into nearby towns and the UN/WTO effortless.

De locatie ligt dichtbij het station en de stad. wij hadden de pech(0f het geluk) dat het heel warm was. Het appartement was hierdoor heel warm, geen ventilator o.i.d. aanwezig. Het appartement heeft alles wat je nodig hebt.

Logement situé idéalement a côté de la Gare de Cornavin, pratique pour se déplacer et découvrir la ville a pieds et en transport en commun ! La décoration est très sympa et Cyril est particulièrement réactif !

Piso en buen estado, y bien ubicado, a un precio competitivo (para los precios de la ciudad).

Thanks Cyril you were really prompt in your responses!

Mon séjour chez Cyril ne fut pas très agréable. Je ne le recommande pas. Je n'y retournerai pas. D'abord, Cyril communique assez bien et l'arrivée s'est bien passée. Il a accepté que j'arrive plus tôt que l'heure prévue, ce que j'ai apprécié. Ce n'est pas là le problème. Lorsque tu entres chez Cyril, tu découvres un logement plutôt vieux et pas très bien entretenu comparativement aux photos. Il y a une odeur de cigarettes et de poussière ambiante qui reste malgré l'ouverture des fenêtres. Étant asthmatique, ce fut un problème pour moi. Aussi, certains éléments sont évités dans les photos (ex., il y a de la merde de pigeons sur les bords de fenêtre - c'est dégueulasse). De plus, le wifi ne fonctionnait pas bien durant mon séjour. La vitesse est très lente. Étant à Genève pour le travail, ce fut un problème. Cyril a dit que cela n'arrive jamais... Il a suggéré d'aller dans les cafés, pourtant fermés les soirs et très chers, sans proposer une compensation $. L'endroit est aussi bruyant.

It started with the communication problems. Indeed it is not Fatima who looks after this Airbnb, but her son, who was not in town and was out of reach. I had to call Fatima in Oman, and honestly after I called her for the third time as she tried to organize our stay from very far away, all I wanted was that she'd cancel our reservation to get my money back and reserve something else, but she was not able to check my booking on Airbnb - because she doesn't know how it works!! After a lot of waiting and calling backs, Fatima could organize a person to wait for us - the house does not have self check-in. I think if you have instant booking active for your Airbnb you should always be prepared to receive someone - or just turn it off when you can't. It was awfully stressful as we paid a lot of money for the 4 days we stayed. Anyway, after getting in, the real deception came. The house is old, the heater didn't work in the main room (and it was cold), the cleaning lady left one small and thin individual duvet for each person (even though we were two couples sleeping in two double beds), we had to sleep fully dressed in order not to be too cold. In my step son's bedroom, a couple of lats were missing from his double bed, so he and his girlfriend had to sleep on the mattress on the floor. We bought a lot of nice food to cook in our "delux villa", but the kitchen is very crappy, all pans are old and their coating gone, no sharpened knives, many items missing, just very poorly equipped. We only cooked there once, as it was too depressing. Fatima is nice and the people who work for her also tried to help us, but the house should cost way less than it does and calling it a delux villa is simply lying.

We had a fabulous evening at Phillippe and Xuong's apartment. It is located near the train station and the lake. They were very helpful and friendly. The room was clean and neat and had good views. Thanks guys!

We stayed one night with Jean-Philippe and Xuong and had a great experience. The room was clean and tastefully decorated, exactly like the pictures. Everything worked and the aircon was a godsend (the weather was very very warm that week)
Wir hatten eine sehr nette und herzliche Begrüßung und wurden gut mit Informationen versorgt. Das Zimmer ist sehr nett  ausgestattet und zentral gelegen.

The apartment is excellent, really close to the train station and the lake. The room upstairs is really well decorated, a lot of light and a view over the Mont Blanc. Walking distance from everywhere. Jean-Philippe and Xuong were really kind, welcoming and helpful. They also give you a tour map and amazing audio guide to visit the city. I only stayed for 2 nights and will definitely come back!

Jean-Philippe & Xuong have an Amazing, cosy appartment right in the middle Of Geneva. It is super close to everything you need for a stay in this beautifull city - unfortunately we only had one night in Geneva. JP and Xuong were super quick in answering questions both by mail or SMS. We can highly recommend this appartment and JP and Xuong are truely super hosts.

Upon arrival, Jean-Philippe greeted us with an informative video on Geneva and gave us some great tips on how to go about exploring the area. The room was lovely - exactly as pictured in the photos, and the bed was so comfortable! Area is right near the train station and the building itself is very secure with door and elevator codes. Overall an excellent stay for 3 days! Thank you!
Xuaong was a really nice host!he made us feel really comfortable and arranged a beautiful room!! (Architect-approved
I chose Jean-Philippe and Xuong's lovely room twice. It was clean and cozy. The location is great! Jean-Philippe and Xuong are very nice!

Nous avons été parfaitement accueilli mais aussi très bien renseigné. Les lieux sont splendides et idéalement situés. D'une propreté irréprochable, l'on se sent dans la chambre comme dans un cocon. Si nous devions retourner a Genève se serait sans nul doute à cet endroit que nous aimerions loger.

we have a very nice stay in your home, it's a great experience! Thanks for everything you make for us, you make our journey so happy! I hope can come back again, and I will recommend to my friends too. Best regards!

What a lovely stay!
The room is on the second floor of a duplex apartment. It has a private bathroom and it is as pictured.
From the beginning, Jean-Philippe and Xuong were very responsibe in replying to emails and answering questions. He also offered an audio guide that explaines the history and information about the sights.
Charming place and people! I wouldn't hesitate to recommend it!

Accueil tres chaleureux, les deux hotes sont vraiment sympathetiques. Tres belle chambre, lit confortable, et l'appartement est tres bien situe, propre et spacieux. A recommander absolument. Merci pour tout!

One of the reasons we chose to stay at this lovely place was because of all the positive reviews (and there are many). After staying with J Ph and X, all we can say is that ALL of them are true! Amazing hosts who truly made us feel very comfortable, welcomed and who certainly provide a "home away from home". Definitely reccommended.
Great experience very nice people and very helpful we recommend it 100% nice room

We had a wonderful time staying with Jean-Philippe and Xuong.  They were wonderful hosts and gave us great recommendations both for restaurants and things to do around the city!  The apartment is centrally located and is easy to get to from the Geneva airport.  The room was private and comfortable and was exactly as it was depicted in the pictures. We highly recommend this place to anyone visiting the area.

Très belle chambre, décorée avec goût, comme on peut le constater sur les photos. Propreté impeccable. Accueil très chaleureux. Literie confortable. J'ai aussi beaucoup apprécié le thé et le café (Nespresso) offerts. Le fait que la chambre soit au deuxième étage d'un appartement en duplex offre une intimité agréable.
En deux mots, je n'hésiterais pas à revenir !

Jean and Xuong are really nice! The room is vey tidy and everything is in order. The location is super closed to the fountain and central station. Jean gave us a detail tour route and Xuong recommended a very nice Vienamese restaurant. We also make friends with a cute couple from San Francisco downstairs. Very impressive experience in Jean and Xuong's apartment.

The hosts did a good job making us feel welcome. They showed us a map of the area and showed us where to go during our time there. The description was very accurate of the room--great place to stay! It was right downtown. They were very well organized!

Jean Philippe & Xuong's place is the nicest place we found at Genève. Its geographical location made everything even easier for getting to know Genève in a short time.  We could see from our window the top of the Mont Blanc mountain and Jet d'Eau as well. We didn't have the opportunity to meet Jean-Philippe but Xuong is the nicest and friendliest person we met in this trip. It was really surprising how he had everything prepared for our visit, he new we would be able to spend only half day in Genève, and he provided an audio guide and a map so that we could know as much as possible of this great place, and we did. Thank you Xuong, we will be back for sure!
Good Location .The House is close the central of city.t's real nice and comfortable house. Philips was very enthusiastic commentary details. it's a good experience in this trip.

Excellent location, friendly and very helpful hosts. Clean living space; top notch.

Fantastic experience!

Philippeさん、Xuongさんともとても親切で、安心して利用できました。到着後すぐにジュネーブの街の紹介もしていただいて、おかげでジュネーブの見どころがよくわかり、2日間という短い滞在でもいろんなところに行くことができました。チェックアウトの日もフライトが夜だったんですが、それまで荷物を預かっていただき、大変助かりました。部屋も広くてきれいで、快適で、駅からも歩いてすぐ、絶好のロケーションでした。本当にありがとうございました。

The hosts were super friendly and helpful, and the apartment was really clean with comfortable beds. The apartment is within walking distance to both the train station and geneva lake so location is great too. Highly recommend this to anyone who's going to geneva.

Very nice and clean room with lovely hosts who took very good care of us. Room is conveniently located in the heart of Paquis and easy to get around in Geneva.

Highly recommended!

Mariya and Susanne
The apt was perfect. ..great location and fabulous hosts. ..totally recommend the place.
They made me feel very welcome. A clean and homely place. A very central location and very nice hosts.
很好的一次体验，房东很热情，房子很舒服，干净，独立浴室，床很舒服躺下就不想起来房东会给你良心建议，下次还会去的！

Unfortunately I did not meet Jean-Philippe, but Xuong met us and was wonderfully helpful.  He had various suggestions on places to eat, walks to take and he even helped us with laundry needs.  The location is par excellence and within walking distance to everything. Merci Mille fois Xuong!

Very good stay in the apartment! It is very close to the train station, around 5 minutes walk only but far enough away from the noise. Xuong received us and provided us lots of useful information, the restaurant, the attraction and the shopping area. The apartment is well designed. We can also share the kitchen with other guests. Definitely recommend!
the room is nice and warm.
my daughter and I had a wonderful stay! Great and very clean and calm room. And wonderful hosts! We felt like home. We'll be back again.

We had a great time in Geneva with help from Philippe and Xuong. This is part of our Honeymoon trip and we really enjoyed it.Philippe is a very organised and detailed person. C'était le deuxième séjour pour moi chez Jean-Philippe et Xuong, mais le premier dans cette chambre.
Jean-Philippe a été extrêmement réactif pour répondre à tous mes mails avant mon arrivée. Sur place, son accueil a été chaleureux et efficace.

L'appartement est très bien situé, à deux pas de la gare Cornavin, avec de nombreux restaurants et des supermarchés à proximité immédiate. Le lac n'est pas loin non plus, pour ceux qui ont le temps de faire du tourisme !
Une adresse à garder !
Jean-Philippe and Xuong Garde were amazing hosts for the second time. The room is impeccable and very nicely decorated and both of them are warm welcoming hosts.

The hosts are really friendly and made us feel at home. We can definitely recommend it!
The room was perfect for our needs. Jean-Philippe and Xuong are the best hosts I have ever met through Airbnb!

Superbe accueil. La chambre était très propre avec sa salle de bain privée très agréable. L'appartement est très bien localisé, on est proche de tout ce qui permet de visiter Genève (train, tram, bus, lac) tout en étant calme.

Avec Jean-Philippe et Xuong il est très facile de se sentir à l'aise, ils sont disponibles et à l'écoute de leurs invités. La cohabitation est très agréable. Cela rend le séjour encore plus mémorable.

Just Like Coming Home

Jean-Philippe and Xuong are wonderful hosts. Upon arrival, we were greeted with everything we could possibly need. Location is fantastic and about a 3 minute walk from Lake Geneva. Great stay from start to finish, my friend and I started referring to the flat as "going home".
I had a great stay in Geneva
Nous avons passé un très moment chez Jean-Philippe & Xuong. L appartement est très bien situé, et l appartement très agréable. Vous pouvez y allez les yeux fermés.

Excellent experience, Xuong was ready to greet us, even though we arrived quite late! His and Jean-Philippe's knowledge of the city was excellent and they even helped us plan our day trip to Montreux! Room was great and perfectly located with only a short walk/tram ride to all parts of the city. Would thoroughly recommend!

This is a perfect option in Geneva! It is a lovely, light-filled, and clean space, with complete privacy. The apartment is also in an extremely convenient location. Jean-Philippe and Xuong were very welcoming and helpful. I hope to stay here during my next visit to Geneva!

Jean-Philippe and Xuong were warm, welcoming hosts. When I arrived, Xuong made me a cup of coffee, showed me a map of the city and highlighted some of the more interesting sites. The bedroom was bright, clean, and welcoming. The room has its own bathroom, which was perfect. The bed was very comfortable. I had everything I needed, and would gladly stay here again. I wholeheartedly recommend the room to anyone traveling to Geneva!

Esperienza molto positiva.
La casa è bella, pulita, accogliente e proprio in centro.

Perfetto ++
Everything was as described and better!  Jean-Philippe & Xuong are incredible hosts and go above and beyond airBnB expectations.  Highly recommend staying with them!

A lovely experience, minutes from the train station. Clean, sunny and exactly as advertised, with fast internet, Jean-Philippe and Xuong were there to greet me as they said, with detailed and accurate instructions for accessing their apartment. So much better than a dreary, expensive Geneva hotel.

The location is the best thing of this house!!! When arriving look for the elevator!! It was my first stay with Airbnb. The policy about check in was not clear enough so we arrived later then Cesca expected. It was very unpleasant to get it first on arrival.

La anfitriona me dio muchas facilidades para la hora de entrada e hizo todo lo posible para que me sintiera como en casa.

L' appartement était conforme aux photos. La cuisine était à disposition ainsi que des serviettes de bain. On a apprécié le petit balcon dans la chambre!
Cesca a répondu très vite à notre demande Airbnb et a été très arrangeante.

Cesca was always available and nice... An host I would recommend in Geneva!
Cesca was very kind and accommodating, and the place was clean and organized. Would recommend!

Cesca's apartment is clean, centrally located (loads of chic cafes and restaurants steps away), and artfully decorated as pictured. She kindly re-adjusted her schedule at the last minute when I realized I'd misread my arrival time--much appreciated! My interactions with her son were very pleasant, and both were helpful with finding my way around the apartment and neighborhood.

This also meant having the smaller (but still very comfortable) bed, as the larger one was moved into the living room. Was not an issue for me, but worth addressing in advance if important for you.
Although the apartment opens onto a lively street, I slept fine with a white noise app on my phone.
Overall, met my needs for the few days I was in Geneva. Thanks, Cesca!

Cesca was a wonderful host and the location is very unique. The room and entire appartment has a wonderul artistic flair! What was simply amazing is that Cesca didn't mind to stop by at my office to hand over the room keys as I had to work longer that day! Overall, given the location, the wonderful host, and the reasonable price, it's a great place to stay in Geneva. Highly recommended.

Chez Cesca on se sent comme à la maison. Elle vous fait sentir à l'aise et fait tout pour que votre expérience à Genève soit très positive.
La description de l'appartement est tout à fait en accord avec les photos, il est très bien situé et desservi par les transports, clair et ensoleillé.

Cesca has a beautiful apartment in a great location. The room was very comfortable and Cesca made me feel very welcome.
Cesca's apartment has a good location. The rooms and restrooms are all very clean. My friend and I had a good time here. Also, Cesca is a very nice host!!

Cesca is very nice and accommodating! She moved around her check in time for us and had a very well-kept apartment. It's a little bit of a walk from the Old Town and Lake Geneva but great area overall.

Cesca's home is beautiful (simple and interesting design), comfortable, and accessible to nearby restaurants, cafes, shopping area, and old town. It's helpful to download the application for tpg for the bus lines and schedules as you'll need to take bus/tram, about 10 mins or 3 stops, going to Cesca's place from gare de Cornavin.
Great place close to the city. Cesca was a great host and all went smoothly

Stayed for four nights. The room was great with a small balcony. The apartment is within walking distance from any central location. The host was very friendly and I had no problems whatsoever. Highly recommended!

Centrale, molto molto vicina alla piazza da cui si prende il tram ( se dovete andare all'onu è davvero perfetta ). Great location a walk away from the city centre, with shops and restaurants close by. Public buses and trains are also within 3 to 10 mins walk or drive.

Cesca’s apartment is wonderful. As she is too! It was the perfect place to spend my three days in Geneva, mainly a work related visit. I got to use the living room as my room. If you are traveling to Geneva for any reason, stay at cescas place. It was absolutely darling, with your own balcony and a beautiful room. La casa è molto bella e molto pulita, in una bella zona molto vicina all'università. La stanza è spaziosa e ha anche un balcone.
Located in a very lively district. The room is very lovely and clean. Cesca is very nice and helpful, and a responsible host. Generally, my experience is totally positive. 🥳
Bon appartement. Seul problème, je me suis fait cambriolé dans la nuit.

Cesca’s place was exactly what I needed for starting my life in Geneva. Beautiful apartment in a fantastic location. I highly recommend this apartment.

The apartment was nice and it was advantageous that there was a washing machine and WiFi. Cesca travels a lot so you have a lot of time for yourself. She was very friendly and always available to answer questions. Gladly again!

Françoise's apartment in Geneva is perfect for a short journey in Switzerland or a more extended stay. I had a fantastic time there and could hardly think of a better place to stay in Geneva. Super séjour, appartement très propre, bons équipements et très bien situé. Je recommande.

Great locations. Very respectful host!

I had such a good time in Geneva.

The place was lovely. Bruno is a kind and generous host. My checked bag was delayed, and Bruno kindly received calls and texts from the airline because I didn’t have a local number. I had a great stay!
Truly and marvelous, cozy refuge and super conveniently located. I would gladly stay again.
Simply the best Airbnb ever. Jean-Philippe and Xuong offered everything you could possibly want and, a home.

Jean-Philippe and Xuong are great hosts! Check-in was relatively flexible. The room and location is perfect for those on business travel. I'll definitely be keeping their place on mind for my next trip to Geneva!

Fantastic hosts in a beautiful city. Jean Philippe took time out of his day to explain important information to us such as where to find landmarks, how to use public transport and even provided us with maps and an audio guide! The room was clean and private with a lovely view. We hope to return soon!
One of the friendliest hosts I've ever met. The room was amazing and they were both very kind to us, even if we didn't stay there for long. Next time I'll be in Geneva, I know where to turn to.

Great location, easy to find. The hosts are smiley and polite, they give clear directions and reply very fast. The cosy penthouse room is super-clean and nicely furnished. It's far better alternative to over expensive and mostly shabby hotels in Geneva.

I enjoyed my very short stay (one night) at Jean-Philippe and Xuong's place. Very good experience!

Wow! We had an amazing time. Our hosts were incredible, gracious and very accommodating. Excellent location especially with a fantastic view. Answering all our questions through email quickly and efficiently. We would definitely recommend and stay here again.

Foi uma experiência otima. Conforto, limpeza e privacidade, muito melhor que ficar em um hotel.

They are very nice and helpful and made me feel home.The house is neat and warm, and I even have a very clean bathroom in my own room. The traffic is very convenient, close to the train station and 5 minutes walk to the beautiful lake. In a word, I highly recommend it as your home in Geneve~

Great TV in the bedroom with lots of English channels. We would definitely recommend this room and hope to go back.

Très bonne adresse pour un séjour pour le travail.

Very well located in the old town district. Plenty to see and do within a very short walk. Main station is only 10-12 minutes walk. The famous fountain isn’t far. Plenty of restaurants. Thai massage available on the ground floor if you’ve had a hard days travelling. Easy to find once you have worked out the numbering system of the square - odd numbers on one side, even on the other. Apartment located on the lower side of the square. I’m sure you will enjoy your stay.
The most beautiful location ever. Host is very nice and responsive. Will definitely go back.
Parfait !
This is a winderful place to recreate, middle of the old town with everything needed even at a rainy weekend! And absolutely calm and the same time. Wonderful. And a caretaking host, too.
Stunning location! Very cute apartment! You won't be disappointment!

Spent more than 2 weeks in these beautiful apartments located in the centre of the old town. Pierre had been a very good and careful host, reply quickly to any of my questions. Def recommend this place!

Mon séjour chez Pierre fut parfait! C'est un hôte souriant et à l'écoute, facile à contacter si besoin. L'appartement était très propre, le lit confortable et le salon lumineux et épuré. On s'y sent chez soi dès l'arrivée. Il est au 4e étage mais il y a un petit ascenseur ce qui est bien apprécié avec la valise! On s'y sent en sécurité, quartier assez animé (vendredi soir) mais calme malgré tout, puisque les fenêtres donnent sur la ruelle arrière. Il y a un petit supermarché où on trouve de tout (sauf du poisson) qui est à 30 secondes de marche ce qui est super! Plusieurs restos à l'intérieur de 5 minute de marche il y a du choix! Ensuite pour visiter tout est proche à pied c'est super! Magasinage, marche au bord du lac, musées, restos, arrêts de bus, jet d'eau....tout y est! Si vous voulez avoir plus de choix qu'au petit marché tout près, à 10 minutes de marche il y a le marché Halle de Rive qui est couvert et vraiment rempli de tout ce que vous désirez. Bref, allez-y sans hésiter vous serez satisfaits j'en suis certaine! Merci beaucoup Pierre, je louerai certainement votre appartement une autre fois!
Had a great stay in Geneva, the apartment was very cute and in the best location. Pierre made sure everything went well!

The location is incredible. Feels like you are living in an old disney movie! Great amenities right below - cafes, pharmacy, deli, restaurants and open sunday too. Right in Old Town and great bus links too. Will def try stay again!
Pierre’s home is in a really great location and is a nice and comfortable space.
Emplacement superbe, vraiment central
All the positive reviews are very accurate.  It was a pleasure to stay at Pierre's place.  Good wifi and cable -  great location!

Nous avons réservé ce logement pour un de nos consultant. Il était ravi de son séjour, il a aimé la propreté, la commodité et la qualité du logement, Sans doute un endroit a recommander lors d'un séjour à Genève.
Nice little place. Good location
In the center of Geneve, where you are charmed from the old city, 2 minutes to the lake, well connected with public service, silent an clean
It is a very nice apartments with great allocation and very polite host Pierre! I will recommend this apartments to my friends!
Es ist eine schöne, saubere und sehr zentral gelegene Unterkunft mitten in der herzigen Altstadt. Für einen Städteausflug zu zweit ist es perfekt.
Immaculate and ideal location

Appartement petit mais très fonctionnel et tout à fait charmant. Remarquablement situé en plein cœur du vieux Genève tout en étant très calme. Tout est accessible à pieds, le reste se faisant en transport en commun...
Adresse que je recommande sans réserve!
The place was in a nice location, and easy to get to. I never met Pierre, but he was very easy to communicate with, and provided prompt responses. This was a nice place to stay.
Great place! Pierre was great. Very helpful with finding local places to eat and hang out. Will definitely recommend to friends traveling abroad
The perfect place! 10 out of 10. Pierre was super helpful when I got a bit lost too
The apartment is very well located and Pierre makes sure to answer all your questions before and during the stay. Would recommend for people staying in Geneva for a few days.
Located right in the center of the city, this is a great place to stay and visit Geneva. The apartment is very clean and nicely decorated, I would definitively recommend.
Great location in Old Town Geneva!

Pierre’s place is compact, super cute and has everything we needed for a couple’s stay. The best thing about it is of course Location! It is in the centre of the Old City within walking distance to restaurants, lake and the shopping district. Self check-in was very convenient and easy as we arrived late. Pierre was always available via text if we needed anything. I would recommend his place for a great stay in the heart of the old city

I was stranded without a place to stay because Agoda cancelled my reservation. Pierre was very prompt with his response and I was able to book really quickly.
His place is in a quaint street in old town, spacious and sparkling clean. Very good amenities, wish it was available for more than 1 night. Thank you for saving me for the night!
easy communication and everything was as described.  pierre was very accommodating.
Perfect location to explore old Geneva! Lots of great restaurants and cafes nearby! Pierre was very easy to communicate with and check-in was a breeze!

La casa è ben collegata, ed è molto facile spostarsi in quanto è vicinissima alla stazione centrale.
Situata in una zona residenziale, dove ci sono molti fast food, ristoranti, cc.
La stanza è accogliente, molto calda.
Una doccia eccezionale.
Con l’host la comunicazione è semplice e rapida.
Unica pecca spesso vi è un forte odore di cibo, probabilmente che risale dai ristoranti vicini, in particolare nella finestra del bagno!

Première expérience airbnb, très satisfaisante. Très bon accueil, précisions préalables précises et réponses rapides. Logement conforme aux photos du site, très propre et idéalement situé dans Genève, en bref une adresse à retenir.

Expect great hosts in a great location.  This home was very clean and the hosts were awesome.  There is a little construction going on, but it didn't bother us in the slightest.  The room was clean and had all amenities you could want, including a refrigerator to use in the living room.
This place is probably one of the best located airbnbs you'll find, especially at its price. It's nearby one of the best restaurants (Parfums de Beyrouth) and near Cornavin.

Un appartement a deux pas de la gare et de tous les services (restaurant, poste) ou tout est possible a pied.
Appartement tres securise et tres bien decore.
Nice room
Definitely a great place to stay, and they’re wonderful hosts! Sparkling clean and very attentive communication. Would definitely recommend!

Xuong and Jean-Philippe were very friendly and welcoming hosts. The room is cosy and well-equipped, with a private bathroom. The location is fantastic, close to supermarkets, the train station, public transport and Lake Geneva.
Very nice flat, perfect location downtown, very friendly hosts

Alles prima, die Lage zwischen Bahnhof und See nützlich. Das Zimmer ist weit oberhalb der Stadt und nicht leise bei geöffnetem Fenster. für uns war es o.k.. Für den Sommer gibt es unter dem Dach zum Glück eine Klimaanlage, die haben wir bei eher kühlen Nächten nicht gebracht.

Would highly recommend this room to anyone staying in Geneva. Near all of the main attractions, remarkably clean and the greatest hospitality one could ask for in an AirBNB. We were assisted with our laundry and we received great recommendations and information about the town.
The flat is right in the centre of Geneve and very handy for the train station and close to a lot of really good value (for Geneva) restaurants.
Grande chambre confortable. Accueil chaleureux
I can recommend this place to anyone. It was very clean, it is walking distance from the water and Jean-Philippe was very friendly and responsive.
位置非常好，距离日内瓦火车站步行5分钟，然后距离日内瓦湖大喷泉步行10分钟就到。是个阁楼，有单独卫生间。房东人非常周到，下次来，还会选这里。

Hôtes sympathiques, attentionnés et réactifs. Logement au dernier étage d'un immeuble avec ascenseur, parfaitement situé entre la gare Cornavin et le Lac, dans un quartier vivant et cosmopolite. Chambre agréable et confortable

Jean-Philippe es una persona muy amables, su atención y cordialidad fue excelente. El tranvía pasa por el trente de la casa por lo que es muy fácil llegar al centro de la cuidad en unos 7 min. El alojamiento está bien ubicado, es de fácil acceso es muy cómodo y limpio; gracias, Jean-Philippe por su cálida hospitalidad.
Très bien placé, système de cle permet d'être independant, hôte très accueillant.

If you stay here, you will experience the kind and helpful owners. And it is such a strategic location that you can go by walk to almost anywhere!
Expect a cozy and clean room here as well!

Great location close to the train station. It was easy to take day trips and return home to this charming room. We visited during a heat wave, however we were pleasantly surprised how much cross air ventilation we got from opening all the windows and using the fan. The bathroom was clean. Great stay!
Very central, 2 minutes from the station. Clean. Suffient space for a couple. Good shower. Kind host. Heat can become a problem on hot nights, although the fan they supplied helps.
Great location for getting to different parts of Geneva from Gare Cornavin. Very clean room and it was cool with good air circulation at night. The hosts were helpful but gave us full privacy.

This was truly the best AirBnB experience that I’ve had. Jean-Philippe and Xuong were incredible hosts. I was traveling with my best friend from college and frankly we were a little nervous as this was the first Airbnb of our trip but it was the best start to the trip. First of all, our flights were a MESS and Jean Philippe was incredibly responsive and accommodating. He made checking in a breeze, and totally effortless. Took off so much stress. The place is adorable. It is exactly what the pictures represent — a great space, and the room upstairs was very private. The room was a little warm initially but once we got the fans going in there it was fine. They have plenty of fans and a mini AC unit so once we got all of those running it was fine. The building itself takes a code to get into and another code to get the elevator to go up to their floor (plus a key to get into the apt of course) so we felt extremely safe. They have a nice living space downstairs that we lounged in a bit and they also have a fridge out in the living room so that was nice to have to. The location is also perfect. About 10 min, beautiful easy walk across the river to the old city center and shopping and carnivals and things, a few blocks away from a huge food market, and right in the middle of a ton of delicious local restaurants. 3 min walk to the train (and Starbucks, and Lauderee, the French macaron store — for those who care about those things). 5 min walk to bus station where group tours for day trips pick up. Truly amazing location.
Okay. The hosts. They were the BEST. Upon arrival, Jean Philippe gave my friend and I the most extensive list of recommendations. It was amazing!!! We really only chose Geneva because we thought it was beautiful but had no idea what to do there and he gave us so many suggestions that our days were totally packed!! He knows the city super well and gave us a map and diagrammed where to go and was just amazing. Very welcoming, extremely helpful, and again, always responsive. By about day 3 of our stay we asked the hosts if it was possible to do a wash and we were taken aback by how accommodating and helpful Xuong was with that. He washed, dried, and folded our clothes, and left them neatly in a shopping bag outside of our door. We were so grateful!!!
Overall, really the greatest experience staying here. Would absolutely recommend to anyone!

Hosts are great, location is fantastic.
Very short walk from the station and close to the lake and old town. As a regular visitor to Geneva we will stay here again.
Great appartment and location. Host was great and responsive
The room is exactly like in the picture and the bathroom is superb. I really enjoyed my stay. They are really nice and everything went super smooth.

Stylish space in a very good location in Geneva. Jean-Philippe and Xuong were very helpful and communicative, even when I arrived a bit too early. The only issue was that the room was very hot and the fan wasn’t enough to cool it (outside temp was about 30).
I can highly recommend this appartment :) Communication is perfect and the flat is very clean and has anything you need :) From the spot you can explore Genève very good ;)
I highly recommend, location, nice room and attentive host.
Great place ...great location.....great host
Friendly and helpful host. Central location with easy access to the train station, the lake, and Old Town.

Super appartement à Geneve
Prix correcte

Great little flat in a convenient place, we were only there two nights but explored all round Geneva, which was amazing! Jean-Phillipe and Xuong were very accomodating and always replied quickly to any questioned we had.

Xoung es muy amable, me dijo cómo llegar al departamento desde el aeropuerto, no me perdí y eso es ganancia.
Si quieres ir a Ginebra por algunos días y estar cerca de todo es recomendable, no se ofrece servicio para cocinar pero hay restaurantes muy cerca.

Xuong and Jean-Philipe were most accommodating not only to meeting me on arrival but also for my departure when I wanted a quick tour of CERN after checkout time. They have a great location that is within walking distance of most anywhere with great views of the city.
Very comfortable stay. Excellent location and very helpful host.
Great host, excellent location !!!
Had a wonderful stay in Geneva and both Phillippe and Xuong are such lovely hosts. Very prompt and helpful. Made our stay very comfortable.
The hosts were welcoming and helpful.
This  was my first AirBnB stay and I couldn’t have asked for a better experience.  Such a great location and easy access in and out.
Loved our host!!! Hospitable, warm, friendly and helpful with any questions.  We will definitely come again!!
I strongly recommend to stay in this place, with all the facilities needed. Thank you Jean-Philippe and Xuong
Great stay, cozy and super convenient to train station.
Pierre’s apartment is conveniently located in Old Town Geneva. It was perfect for my husband and I. Thank you!
Very good location and cosy place. We can only recommend!

Wonderfully cozy flat in a lovely neighborhood - I think the most charming part of Geneva. Check in was very simple and Pierre was always helpful. The space would be perfect for a solo traveller in Geneva for work or a couple. Very easy commute to the airport or UN buildings. Incredible space and location for the cost.

L’appartement de Pierre est tout à fait conforme à la description; très bien localisé, la vieille ville est très représentative de la culture locale... merci à Pierre pour sa communication fluide et réactive !
This location is terrific.
A nice cozy place right in town!
Nice, cosy place in the old town of Geneva. Close to public transport too.
Pierre is a great host - very responsive and makes sure his guests feel welcome. This is a small flat in the middle of old town, very convenient location.

Pierre’s place is a beautiful compact flat in the best area of Geneva.
The flat itself has everything you need for your stay.
There are buses around the flat but you could also walk around - all Gva attractions are wishing short walking distance.
Pierre is also very kind- and easy to communicate with.
Will definitely come back to this place! Thanks Pierre:)

Pierre is very responsive and very helpful. The apartment is on a great location for visiting the old town of Geneva and in a very practical location with cafes, restaurants, transport etc at your doorstep. Very quiet place and ideal for a single traveler or a couple.
Excellent Location. Within walking distance to almost everything. Would definitely recommend and stay again.
The central location in the Old Town is excellent and I liked the stylish but open & simple flat. Check-in was a little slow, but otherwise I would warmly recommend it. Hope to stay again! Thank you

The place was easy to get into with Pierre’s instructions. Washer and dryer were nearly impossible to find, and then found them be either not working or I had no clue how to use them (I know how to do laundry, these machines were unfamiliar). However, great location making doing anything in old town a short walk. Bars, restaurants, coffee shops, and other places really close.

As a solo traveller, I loved staying at Pierre’s apartment. Located in old town, it was close to sights, right on a square with plenty of food and drink options and only a short walk to the lake. The apartment was totally adequate for one person and would also suit a couple. Tho the building lift can be a bit of a squeeze! The apartment was very clean and had all the amenities I needed. Would stay again if ever I find myself in Geneva again. Thank Pierre!
The location is in the centre of old town, very good location, that's all advantages
Great little studio in old town. Enjoyed my stay. Thank you!
Great location in Old Town! The place was a little smaller than it seems in the photos but it’s perfectly for two people. The place was clean and Pierre was very responsive.

A clean, cozy and quiet place in the heart of old Geneva.  Amazing location and very good value!  Pierre was a great host - very responsive, and helped resolve the one issue I had within minutes.  Great for a restful night after a long day, and a busy morning to follow!
Fantastic location in the middle of the old town!
Great location
Great place, middle of the old town, walking to everything... cafe's supermarket all that is needed.. the place needs a bit of TLC.. overall exactly what we needed for a few nights.

Great location. Restaurants right outside the apartment. A short walk to the lake and central city. The city itself is very clean and every where you look is picturesque. Apartment is very clean and a good size for a couple. There is no door on the bathroom, however. Host communicates well but there are a lot of rules to follow. All in all, would recommend.
Impeccable studio, well laid out, easy to check-in. Don’t be put off by lack of pics.

Un endroit calme, propre et bien équipé. Localisation centrale dans le quartier historique de la ville. The place to be! Une opportunité à ne pas rater. Au centre de la ville et à deux pas de toutes les commodités.
Difficile de trouver plus genevois. Un vrais coup de cœur.
The apartment was awesome and the perfect size for us.The area was absolutely great. We can hardly wait to come back for a visit.

If you're looking to stay somewhere central, Pierre's place is ideal for one. If you're a party of two, I hope you don't mind that the washroom doesn't have a door.  If you're looking to do laundry, it is challenging to get to and once you do, ensure that the fob is loaded with money or else you are out of luck. It is not the most straightforward washer either.
Great surrounding! Cosy and clean flat. Great stay!
Great location, very clean and ideal for solo travelers. Pierre is very responsive and checking in was very easy
Perfect location in the heart of old town, easy access to public transport.

This apartment is the perfect location for exploring Geneva, within the City walls in the Old Town which is in the main pedestrianised and very close to the Cathedral.
We had a little apprehension following comments of previous guests stating the nightlife is loud and smell of cigarette smoke etc. This is not the case. The apartment backs onto a back street rather than the bars, no noise form the nightlife could be heard or any smells of tobacco. The apartment itself was very clean and fresh with fresh towels and bed linen being of homely comfort.
Opposite the entrance to the five storey apartment block on a raised area is a terraced area of bars which was clearly a hip and local place to be and we wended up having a drink there most days at some point. There is also a coffee/breakfast bar just to the left of the entrance to the apartment blocks which offers great coffee and start to the day.
I would definitely recommend Pierre's place to anyone who likes peace and quiet but to walk out into a cultural, atmospheric part of Geneva and clearly where the locals like to kick back and relax too.
Pierre was oversees when we stayed in his apartment but mobile numbers were exchanged and communication was very prompt and our late arrival at Geneva airport could still be accommodated.

Pierre's place was in the perfect location in Geneva. Seriously, as visitors from the US, I couldn't imagine staying in a different location. The unit itself could use a bit of love, but had all the amenities my wife & I needed. The bed was quite comfortable, but just as a fair warning to other couples - there is no door on the bathroom. So just a heads up! Overall we enjoyed our stay.
Wonderful place in a great location. Terrific communication. I'd highly recommend!

Highly recommended! Perfect location in the very heart of the Old Town.You do not need a car or public transportation - everything is in reach of a minutes stroll. Pierre was very nice,precise and quick to respond.Apartment was clean,bed - comfortable. Everything in perfect order.Though, some of us may find bathroom without a door a bit challenging...But, on the other hand, you've got a full experience of La Cité Médiévale.
Great couple stay in the heart of the old town, recommended A+++
Very good host with very cozy flat.
If you like cosy places and downtowns, this is the placecto book.
Cute little charming apartment in amazing location.
Best location for Geneva, neat!

Could not be better situated.
Many restaurants nearby, 10 minutes by feet to the center (taking a bus is possible but not faster). The appartment is not spacious, but gives certainly a better accomodation that a hotel room.
It is quite, I could easily sleep with windows open. Highly recommended.
A great stylish space in a perfect location. Bed is very comfortable, shower is good but somewhat small. Had a lovely stay here, would recommend.
Great place for exploring Geneva- great host, very responsive and helpful!

Bigger than a standard studio, cosy, and very well located in the city centre with very good transport links. Located in the Old Town, all necessities are accessible by foot. The windows give onto a very quiet backstreet. Ideal for anyone looking to find a little bit of 'home' in Geneva.

Charmant appartement calme, très bien situé.
Pierre a vraiment été un hôte sympathique et s’est rendu disponible. Une adresse à conseiller sans hésitation !

I stayed at Pierre’s place for a week, and it was just perfect. You won’t find a place in Geneva that is this affordable for the location it is in! The appartment was clean, quiet, close to everything and cosy. The only “problem” is that there’s no door to the bathroom, but as I stayed there alone it didn’t bother me at all.
Finally, Pierre is an amazing host. Even though I never met him in person, he was always very friendly, communicative, and quick to respond to my messages. Would definitely recommend and stay there again!
Great place, central location, clean and comfortable.

Petit appartement cosy au coeur de la vieille ville de Genève donnant sur la place du Bourg du Four à proximité de commerces, cafés , restaurants et boulangerie. Situation idéale pour découvrir la ville à pied. La communication a été très fluide avec Pierre.
Bref séjour très agréable.

Studio hyper bien placé dans le vieux Genève place du Bourg du Four.
Propreté du logement impeccable.

Il y a des cafés juste en bas ou apporter votre filtre.
Si vous aimez marcher, tout est à proximité (musée d'arts et d'histoire, de la Réforme etc).
Sinon, transports en commun à disposition.

L'appartement est idéalement placé dans la vieille ville, sur une place animée mais donnant sur une rue calme. Très paisible. Il est très bien équipé pour y vivre/cuisiner - attention pas de cafetière :) - et la déco est soignée. Communications virtuelles avec Pierre tout à fait fluides. Je recommande !
Great location for a trip to Geneva! In the heart of the old town!!
Cet appartement est bien architecturé et décoré. Propreté impeccable et surtout très bien situé, avec un ascenseur pour monter au quatrième, ce qui est bien appréciable.
Très bon séjour en plein coeur de Genève, l'appartement est top !

Tolle Lage, in Mitten der Altstadt und unzähliger Restaurants. Schön eingerichtes Appartment mit allem was man benötigt.
Eine Möglichkeit für etwas mehr Privatsphäre im Bad wäre toll, da es keine Türe gibt.
Perfectly located studio flat in the centre of Old Town Geneva. The space is small, but perfectly fine for one person.

Super logement, très bien situé et très confortable. Tout pour passer un agréable séjour sur Genève ! Merci !

Awesome stay at Pierre’s. Location is unique at Geneva’s old town close to everything: parks to go run, shopping, awesome cafe right at the doorstep.
