Great room in a very convenient location. Excellent communication. I’d stay again next time I come back.
Easy to find, clean and cozy. Friendly and welcoming host.
A great place and very convenient location, close to everything. The hosts are very kind.
Les hôtes sont chaleureux et accueillants. Une bonne adresse pour un week-end à Genève!
location is prime

Amazing host! Room was nicely presented. Provided us with a kettle and TV, a fridge and a minibar. Gave us ideas on different tourist attractions. Super welcoming and nice!!!! House was decorated with lots of fairy lights - a very cute set up

Perfectly located between Gare Cornavin and Gare routière, you can get anywhere from here. Lots of restaurants, easy to get to the river front, shopping. JP & X have a lovely place that served as our base for our Geneva stay!

This is a peaceful, warm and clean room very well located in central Geneva. Xuong welcomed me, was very understanding when my flight was severely delayed and made me feel at home straight away. I enjoyed staying here and felt safe and welcome throughout.
Great place, I recommend!

Great place to stay, walking distance from the train station and main attractions. Xuong was so helpful and made us feel very welcome.
We are definitely staying again in our next visit.
Very good location in Geneva, Xuong is a very nice host.
I enjoy my short stay. I am pleased and highly recommended.

Amazing location a couple of minutes from the central train station! Ensuite private room was beautiful, super comfy and spotless with some lovely touches like complimentary tea and coffee! The hosts were the quickest I have seen on Air Bnb to respond to my messages with check in/out info and local tips. I would 100% recommend this to anyone travelling to Geneva!
Thanks again guys!!

One of the best places I’ve stayed in! Jean-Philippe and Xuong were so welcoming and helpful! The place was really cosy as well and they had nice hot showers. The place was really clean too! Nearby had lots of restaurants to buy food from and overall our stay was 10/10.
Très propre, localisation parfaite ! Chambre spacieuse et confortable pour un couple. Bonne communication ! Séjour parfait 😊

I am a solo female traveler and I felt very safe in the neighborhood and I felt like at home at Jean-Philippe & Xuong house.
The room is very clean and as shown in the pics. If the windows are opened it could be a bit noisy at nights but otherwise, if closed, it is perfectly fine.
Jean-Philippe and Xuong welcomes you very warmly and they are very supportive and take the time to give you very good tips about Geneve. They will definitively add value to your stay in Geneve!

Thankfully, Xuong provided us with two mini water air cooler, which helped with the mini fan in the room. Otherwise, we absolutely loved our stay and could only recommend it! Thank you Xuong!

I was very lucky to find this gem of a place in Geneva for a last-minute three-night stay over the Swiss National day weekend. My  5th-floor penthouse room and private bathroom were very well appointed and super quaint to come home to after a day of exploring.  Both Hosts were excellent communicators and extremely gracious.
Tout simplement génial. Proche de tout très bien tenu accueil parfait et l’hôte est réactif. Vivement recommandé!!!. Merci pour tout .

Nice location, the room is indeed bright for being on the top floor. Airconditioning was present which was a huge relief (it otherwise gets really warm). Very nice welcome too and all the information/facts about Geneva you ever wanted to know can be provided by Jean-Philippe and Xuong.

La location est très bien placée et confortable à vivre.

Great stay for one of my clients.

Great location

I stayed solo, but the apartment’s room and bathroom are large enough that it would be comfortable for a couple with a child. If it is hot you will want to sleep with the windows open, but the restaurant downstairs can be noisy late. Not a dealbreaker or a complaint, but something to be aware of. The windows are soundproof when closed.
It was very straightforward: just as advertised, well located, clean, very fast internet, small and usable kitchen. I’d stay again.

Absolutely wonderful location right in the heart of old town. It was very easy to get around with train/bus stops just down the road + on foot. We were also relatively comfortable, even in this heat! Having the fan and blinds pulled during the day helped a lot.
We had trouble getting in at first. The bottom (main) door is unlocked but the handle doesn’t turn, you just push it open. We also had an issue unlocking the apt door, you have to twist the marked key two full turns in the lock just below the door handle before opening.
Wifi was fast and reliable, it even worked from the little Italian restaurant across the alley (which we highly recommend, regardless!). Philippe also provided a plug adapter which came in handy because we brought the incorrect one.
The other reviews mentioning the noise are not exaggerating. There is a club just across the alley that is open 7 days a week until 5:30 AM. While the club itself can’t be heard, the club goers waiting outside of it sound like they’re right outside of your window. We were in no rush during our time in Geneva, so sleeping in after a poor night sleep wasn’t a problem for us, but if you have strict plans, etc. during your time here you might want to bring some ear plugs!

Solid little loft right in Old Town. Was a very warm week, so super happy Philippe had a good fan in the place. Philippe was excellent from start to finish.

Philippe was very gentile, helpin us to get free public transport pass, providing an extra baby cot,, the studi app was small , but very well arranged ,, everything needed for a short trip. 4，性价比：在日内瓦能这个价格住到这样房间非常棒，以这个价格来说无可挑剔。
5，改善方面：如果有比较明确的住宿指南或者图片介绍更好；房间钥匙不是特别方便使用；房间冰箱声音有点大，会影响睡眠，睡觉时候最好关掉冰箱。

Ich hatte einen schönen, zweimonatigen Aufenthalt bei Erika und Nacer. Die beiden sind sehr nett und offen, ich habe mich gerne mit ihnen unterhalten.
Die gesamte Wohnung ist immer sehr sauber und ordentlich, das Zimmer ist gemütlich und hat einen eigenen Kühlschrank.
Die Lage ist super, die Straßenbahn fährt quasi genau vor der Tür und man ist in 20min im Genfer Stadtzentrum.
Leider durfte ich den Herd aus Sicherheitsgründen nicht mitbenutzen, was aus der Beschreibung der Ausstattung nicht hervorging. Trotzdem konnte ich mich mir mit Mikrowelle und Wasserkocher kleine Mahlzeiten zubereiten.
Ich habe mich sehr wohl gefühlt und empfehle die Unterkunft gerne weiter!
Erika et Nacer ont été adorables,  très accueillants. Adresse a recommander sans aucune réserve !

C'est un couple très accueillant et généreux qui n'hésite pas à vous garder une place à leurs table. Le logement est bien situé, calme et à proximité des transports. La chambre est aménagé comme il se doit avec une magnifique vue sur les alpes et le Mont-Blanc lors des jours ensoleillés. Ils sont de bonnes personnes avec qui partager un logement et une conversation des plus intéressante. Je les remercie très sincèrement pour ces 6 mois en leurs présence et ne peut que vous conseiller cet endroit.

He was a great host!! The apartment was exactly as described and was in prime location for my travels by train. He was incredibly easy to communicate with and made sure everything was perfect. He even helped offer advice when I was having trouble figuring out the train and bus schedule. Also the Wi-Fi was super strong!! Was able to download videos and skype my parents.
Would highly recommend :) everything was perfect.
The room was simple and comfortable, exactly as listed. Host was very accommodating when I had to extend my stay. Great location, and reasonable price.
Great location, everything works. Isi is a great host, I stayed for 3 months, never had any problems.

A most satisfying experience. Excellent price and extremely convenient location, and Isi was very helpful, welcoming, and responsive throughout the process. Isi lives elsewhere (unfortunately we did not have the opportunity to meet), and another lodger (longer-term), very friendly and thoughtful, was rarely around due to his work, so most of the time I effectively had the apartment to myself. One small bit of advice -- soap not provided, so you'll want to bring your own. Also, small hiccup with the check-in and had to wait a bit, but all worked out just fine. Overall, though, I would highly recommend this location.

It was a great place. I had the instruction to access the flat before my travel date and had no difficulty finding the place and accessing my room. All the instruction were clear. I could contact Isi and get response quickly if I had any query. The place was clean and quiet. Was very close to the Geneva train station and superstore Migros. Isis made efforts to meet me in person and I really appreciate that. Overall I would say a very good value for money.
Chambre simple, mais bien située. Contact et accès simple et efficace. Merci.
Great location and Isi was very attentive and responsive to messages.

Isi was a great host. We booked late afternoon/early evening and Isi messaged us promptly. We were in the room within an hour or two of booking. This room is in a great location near the station, and Isi pointed out a very nice area where we spent our evening. Highly recommended host.
Excelente ubicación, Isi es súper amable, lo recomiendo muchísimo

Isi was a great host! He was easy to reach, gave helpful directions and the apartment was as promised - clean, quiet and well equipped. It's perfectly located next to the main station so that many sights are reachable on foot. I recommend the stay if you're looking for a good value for money accommodation.

Pictures are a bit deceptive. They look much better than the actual place, which is old and withered. Apartment is fine for a single traveller with least luggage. Bed is very comfortable for a good sleep. No lift in building (room on 4th floor).
A 6 feet tall tree next to the bed is weird, and little scary at times. Host is responsive. Good connectivity, very near to city centre and train station and other transports.

I stayed in Isi's apartment for three months while doing an internship, it is the perfect location if you are working at the UN, WHO, or any other organisation. It is also very central and two minutes walk from the train station. Isi is very helpful and knows Geneva well, anytime I had a problem he was quick to respond. Overall was a great place to stay

Jean-Philippe and Xuong were amazing hosts! They made us feel at home the moment we knocked on the door.  Their place is AMAZING!  Its centrally located and everything is within walking distance.  Everything was in place and we felt like we were staying at a five star hotel. And since this was our first AirBnB experience, we actually were a bit anxious as we typically do the typical business hotel accommodation.  It turns out our concerns were unwarranted and we couldn't have asked for more.  We also made friends in Geneva and we hope to take go back and enjoy their gracious hospitality in the future. Count us AirBnBed :)
Séjours très agréables qui ont fait de moi un habitue hebdomadaire ....
perfect stay! very cozy, comfortable and warm atmosphere. merci beaucoup jean-philippe et xuong!

Accueil et prestation d'une régularité exemplaire.
Cela me permet d'affronter ma journée hebdomadaire de travail a Genève avec serenite.
Jean Pierre

Our first experience with Airbnb has left a positive impression, which of course we have to thank you. Your apartment is comfortably furnished, clean and very well located. We were cordially received and made us feel right at home, as it should be. You both are sympathetic, funny, friendly, helpful ... a perfect host. Thank you – Merci beaucoup – Cảm ơn

Je vais toujours chez mes hôtes avec la même serenite , la certitude de trouver un accueil chaleureux et uhavre de paix pour affronter ma journée de travail le lendemain.
Jean Pierre

Have only good things to say...J-P&X showed warmth and hospitality, were very helpful with finding my way around and with a welcoming smile. The room was very clean and comfortable. The adjacent bathroom (no toilet) was shinning clean and very comfortable. The location is super central. I enjoyed it very much and highly recommend!

Had an amazing time at Jean-Philippe & Xuong's place during a weekend trip to Switzerland with my girlfriend. They were extremely friendly and gracious hosts and made us feel extremely welcome. The apartment itself is gorgeous and located perfectly in the center of Geneva.

Extremely clean and well stocked with everything from movies for the large flat screen (and a playstation! but my girlfriend wouldnt let me play..) in your room and toiletries. This was truly the perfect place to book your stay in Geneva.

Jean-Philippe & Xuong were both went above and beyond by providing us with maps, audio guides, and a lot of great extra information about the city itself so that we could navigate Geneva reasonably.

Sincerely one of my best experiences on airbnb ever and the only place I would want to stay in Geneva.

Philippe & Xuong were excellent hosts. As soon as we got there late at night, they greeted us with a smile and showed us all the attractions of Geneva on the maps and even gave us mp3 tour guide. They were very helpful and was always willing to help. The location of the place is very central. Walking distance to most of the attractions and sightseeing. The room was exceptionally clean. Even better than hotels. Everything was comfy and perfect. I would recommend their place to anyone that visits Geneva.

Jean-Philippe & Xuong Garde are great hosts. The location of the flat is fantastic. Even right in the center, there are no noise and you can sleep real well. The decoration of the flat is amazing. Nice place.

Jean-Phillippe and Xuong are the most gracious hosts. I had been traveling for several weeks and gave them an incorrect arrival time coming about 6 hours early, waking them up and yet they opened the door with welcoming smiles and made me feel right at home. The coffee was delicious, their home warm, cozy and beautiful and they were simply phenomenal hosts giving me excellent information about Geneva and opportunities outside of the city. If you want a lovely warm welcome to Geneva, stay with Jean Philippe and Xuong.

jean-philippe and xuong are the perfect hosts: silent when you need rest, ready to have chat when you need to be more social. They provided logistic information, a mp3 touristic audioguide, suggestions for good and not too expensive restaurants, and a wide room, centrally located, warm and comfortable, with all facilities. Much better than a hotel. We strongly recommend them.giulia and francesco.
Je retrouverai avec plaisir Jean Philippe et Xuong au mois de Février.......
Amazing hosts. Terrific location. Fantastic room. Highly recommend these guys!

Jean-Philippe and Xuong were total sweethearts. The place is really cool and had every comfort we needed. Plus it is literally a 5 minute walk from the train station. And the guys were great hosts, mapping custom walking tours for us and making sure we had everything we needed. We came and went as we pleased and mostly kept to ourselves, and they were totally easy going and cool. Would stay here again in a heartbeat.
fantastic apartment in great location with very friendly hosts, recommend.

Jean-Philippe & Xuong were really special: always smiling, ready to give advice and information about the city (we were also given a map and an audio guide) .... the house is really beautiful and very tastefully decorated and especially hot ... all this gave a very pleasing to our stay.
Thank you wholeheartedly!
awesome flat and the loveliest people. Thank you guys! see you again soon

Un grand merci à Jean-Philippe et Xuong. Ils nous ont accueilli comme des rois. Nous nous sommes très vite sentis à l'aise. La gentillesse est le maître mot de ce couple adorable qui nous a fait passer un très très bon séjour. Si nous retournons à Genève, c'est sûr que nous retournerons chez Jean-Philippe et Xuong. Un grand merci à eux.

Superb Room (even better than picture) / and very nice bathroom as well with a jacuzzi.
But the best is the Host: Jean-Philippe & Xuong are great. interesting. considerate. full of ressources to visit the city / restaurants / bars.
Would come back just to see them.

Après avoir réalisé plusieurs expériences airbnb, je peux dire sans hésiter que celle-ci est ma meilleure. Jean-Philippe et Xuong sont des hôtes vraiment au top ! Ils connaissent très bien la ville et donnent de très bons conseils pour éviter les attrapes-touristes ! À l'écoute, attentionnés, leur service est irréprochable. La propreté de la chambre et la salle de bain, dignes d'un hôtel 4 étoiles ! Vraiment je recommande à tous voyageurs leur rencontre ainsi que leurs chambres privées. Merci, vraiment !

Jean-Philippe & Xuong were wonderful hosts.  They made us feel right at home and the room was beautiful.  The room is actually prettier then what is depicted in the pictures.  The location is also great, close to everything we wanted to do.  I would recommend staying here, definitely a pleasant experience.

...perfetc location in a nice street close to Central Station and 10 minutes walking from old city...
the guests are very friendly and helpful..

Excelente experiencia, Isi combinó con nosotros en la estación y nos acompañó hasta el departamento, fue súper atento en las indicaciones y recomendaciones, estuvo siempre presente, la comunicación fue fluida, la casa es tal cual se ve en las fotos, no hubo inconvenientes de ningún tipo. Nos tocaron días muy fríos y lluviosos y el ambiente calefaccionado estuvo muy bien. La Cocina está bien equipada y a disposición. Está situado muy cerca de la estación principal por lo que es muy cómodo manejarse a pie. Lo recomendaría. Gracias Isi por la linda estadía!

Isi was very quick in answering my request, he's very flexible and communicative. The appartment is clean and in a central location, just 2 blocks away from Geneve Cornavin, the train station. Its a perfect place if you're planning on staying a few days or if you want to move around Switzerland

Isi is a great host.
Provided us with very detailed and very helpful information on how to get to the apoartment and everyrhing about the appartment and the facilities.
The stay was most pleasant and uncomplicated.
The location is most convenient - 3 minutes on foot from the central railway station and the bus terminal.
Supermarkets and cafés in abundance.
The place is quiet.
The appartment neat and has everything a person needs to feel like home.
Good location! Very close to the central station, 2mins bt foot!
Es un luger centrico y agradeble.

Llegué muy tarde por la noche e Isi fue muy amable dejándome las indicaciones para poder entrar. No he tenido el placer de conocerle en persona en toda la estancia pero ha sido muy atento y disponible conmigo. El piso es un cuarto sin ascensor (lo cual para mi no fue gran problema pero creo que hay que mencionarlo por si para alguien pudiera serlo). El piso está a 2 minutos andando de la estación y eso es muy cómodo. La habitación es exactamente igual que lo que ponen las fotos, y tanto almohada como colchón son muy cómodos. Por otro lado la estantería estaba llena de polvo y he echado de menos no digo un armario, sino al menos un perchero. También me pareció malo que la habitación no se pueda cerrar con llave. En el piso entra y sale gente que no conoces (lo que están en la otra habitación como otro señor que no se quien es, pero que venía al piso de vez en cuando) y el hecho de dejar todas tus cosas allí sin poder cerrar con llave a mi no me gustó para nada.
En el anuncio no vienen fotos del baño ni de la cocina y creo que deberían añadirse. En general el piso es bastante antiguo, lleva tiempo sin ser pintado y en algunos puntos la pintura se ha ido lo cual da una impresión un poco mala.
Con respecto al baño, como dije, debería llevar fotos para que cada uno pudiera elegir si le puede gustar la situación o no. Lo que a mi me ha pasado es que, mientras me duchaba, el desagüe de la lavadora empezó a vaciarse en la propria bañera, saliendo un agua entre naranja y marrón. No fue nada agradable. Además yo no me lo encontré muy limpio. La cortina de la ducha no estaba limpia y el lavabo tampoco. Puede que haya sido mala suerte ya que muchos otros comentarios han reportado una información muy diferente. También es cierto que eso lo comenté a Isi y me dijo que eso era extraño y que hablaría con la señora de la limpieza. Aun así, en este sentido, mi experiencia no fue positiva.
La cocina no la utilicé para nada con lo que no puedo decir nada sobre ello.
En resumen, el piso es centrico e Isi fue cordial pero creo que, por 80€/noche hay que ofrecer un servicio mejor. Si volviera a Ginebra no volvería a este piso ni lo recomendaría a nadie.

Rommet vi leide var akkurat som på bildet. Men det er en gammel leilighet som gjerne trenger et strøk maling. Toalett og badekar i separate rom, ingen av delene noen hyggelig opplevelse. Ingen lås på rommet gir ingen trygg følelse når man forlater leiligheten med tanke på eiendeler man forlater.
Verten er særdeles hyggelig og alltid hjelpsom. Selv om vi ikke fikk hilst på hverandre fikk jeg et veldig godt inntrykk.
a good place to have fun. and the host is really nice

Isi's home was only a few minutes walk from the train station and close to downtown and several restaurants, including Parfums de Beyrouth, a tasty and reasonably priced Lebanese restaurant. Isi was accommodating, and while not luxurious, his place was clean and accurately described in the listing.

Appartement vétuste mais bien que vieillot, les équipements sont complets et fonctionnels.
Bien situé près de la gare de Cornavin et des nombreux transports en commun (Bus, Tramway)

L'appartement de Isi est impeccablement situé, à quelques dizaines de mètres de la gare de Genève-Cornavin. Au dernier étage d'un immeuble ancien de 4 étages (sans ascenseur) l'appartement est accueillant, avec une cuisine, salle de bains et toilettes. Deux chambres sont louées et partagent ces parties communes. A toute proximité se situe le quartier très vivant «des Grottes» ou l'animation et les activités culturelles et artistiques sont nombreuses. Je recommande cet appartement !
Isi place is great if you want to take train on the next day. Because it really close to the train station. And isi accepting us at the last minute. And we  are grateful for that.

Isi was very responsive to my request and my reservation for the same day was confirmed within 2 hours. Great location, right behind the main train station and near some excellent restaurants and bars. A quiet private escape in the heart of it all.
Too easy... 50m from the main station and I was there. Perfect!

Emplacement très pratique pour ceux qui veulent marcher, bien placé.
Isis est très sympa et arrangeant.
L'apparat est pratique pour des jeunes voyageur qui désire visiter sans se prendre la tête avec le confort.

Logement tout près de la gare, très pratique. La chambre est grande et agréablement aménagée avec un  bureau, un canapé, des plantes, une bibliothèque. Il y a le wifi. L'appartement est assez ancien mais tout est fonctionnel et propre. La cuisine est bien équipée, on peut y cuisiner et y manger sans problème. Petite remarque pour ceux qui auraient des gros bagages ou de la peine à se déplacer : c'est au 4e étage sans ascenceur. La communication avec l'hôte s'est très bien passée, les informations étaient claires et transmises très rapidement. Une bonne adresse à retenir pour vos passages à Genève!
Isi는 굉장히 친절했습니다. 위치에 대해서 정확하게 말해주었고 우리의 교통수단까지 챙겨주셨습니다. 메시지에 대한 대답도 빠르며 변경사항에 대한 정보도 전달해주었습니다. 숙소는 역에서 굉장히 가깝고 깨끗합니다. 다만 아쉬운점은 복도가 맨위라 엘리베이터가 없는 것입니다.  짐이 많으신분들은 힘들수도 있을거 같았지만 저희는 큰짐이 없어 다행이었습니다.

We stayed as a couple for 4 weeks at Isi's place and found it to be a nice refuge with a great location. Much of Geneva can be reached by foot easily. The room was tidy and we settled in well. Isi is a very trustworthy and helpful host. However, while we only rented one room, the apartment was sometimes a little crowded which is probably ok if you aren't planning to spend your days inside.
I can only recommend Isi's place. It is great for travellers that need a place to stay that is well located, not too expansive and comfortable.

Isi is a great host. friendly and very easy to reach. the location is also great. right next to the central station. so it's very well connected to anywhere. BUT the place needs renovation. it's run down.

Die Wohnung ist echt super praktisch gelegen und die Organisation war echt super unkomplizierte:)
Kann ich sehr weiterempfehlen!

Isi is a great and responsive host. The flat has everything one needs including kitchen stuff for cooking home (quite useful at times considering the average prices in restaurants... ;-). The location is great.

Litt bofellesskap - følelse. 4. Etasje uten heis. For å ligge rett ved jernbane forbausende rolig( hørte ikke jernbane) ; grei WIFI og dermed jobbmulighet. Ikke høy standard, men prisene for Hotel i Genève er ellers veldig høyt: derfor i summ likevel bra .

La chambre est conforme à la description et aux photos, grande, claire et agréable. L'appartement est très propre. La salle de bains est juste un peu viellote. L'appartement était bien situé àquelques mètres dela gare età 30 minutes du palais des nations. Isi est très sympa, la communication était simple et fluide aussi bien avant que pendant mon séjour.

Had a last minute layover stop in Geneva before getting on a train. Isi was very responsive and informative  even though I came quite late and the location is perfect if you’re grabbing a train the next day
Isi was very responsive in all our communications.  Place was as described, just what we needed for a week at CERN.

Isi was a very helpful host,  and the place is very conveniently located close to the train station. To be sure though, this a very small and simple room; Switzerland is expensive, but this still didn't feel like a great value for the price.
La chambre est simple, grande et le lit confortable. À 2mn de la gare c’est incroyablement pratique! Accueil attentionné et sympathique. Attention pour les grosses valises: dernier étage!

I've already stayed at Isi's place for three times, and I recommend it. Isi is very friendly and accommodating to people's check-in needs, and the apartment  is simply perfectly located: just a two minutes' walk from the tracks of the train station, and yet in a very quiet street. The room is just under the roof of the building, so it can get a bit warm during hot days and nights.
Nos gustó mucho la atención brindada por Isi, es muy atento y resolvió todas nuestras dudas. Muy recomendable
Unkompliziert
Really good appartement for the value. had no particular issue with anything. really quick communication. I recommend it.

The best part of this place is the location. It's so central to restaurants and the lake, but literally a jump over to the train station, which was fantastic for us. I and my husband messaged Isi on the day and he was very quick to respond and accommodate us to being so last minute. We got to meet his family which was also lovely.
The only thing I would point out is that it's located on a quiet road just off a main road- which is never quiet. So if you sleep with the window open and you're a light sleeper this may not be the best option.
Apart from that, pretty perfect for a short stopover in Geneva.

The location is the best of Isi ‘s place, it’s just right behind the train station but in a quiet neighborhood. Also walking distance to the bus stop. I didn’t have the chance to meet him,(hopefully next time when I’m in Geneva) but he gave really detailed instructions via messages and he is very warm and kind. I had a nice time exploring Geneva and a few other towns around it. Recommend Isi ‘s place!

Location is literally a stone’s throw away from the Geneva train station (very convenient to catch train /buses & access to food stores/supermarkets). There is no lift in the old building though. The street/station/whatever noise was not a problem to us as we were often too tired when returning to the apartment in the evening.
Upon arrival at the Geneva airport, we followed Isi’s tips & got the free train tickets to travel to Geneva train station. Isi’s lovely wife and kids also provided local tips from time to time, and made us feel very welcome throughout our stay. We didn’t cook in the kitchen. We were allowed to use the washer to clean our clothes (really appreciate this). Despite we only met Isi in person on the final evening of our stay, his communication via Airbnb messaging was very prompt. Thank you so much Isi for being such a wonderful host!

The flat is wery well located and Isi answers super quickly. The flatmate is very kind. The room is warm and equipped for basic needs. New and cofortable bed. The kitchen and the bathroom are not well organised and not well cleaned.

Isi and his family are very friendly, welcoming and helpful.
Great flexibility for check-in, check-out and any arrangement.
Cosy room, well equipped apartment and use of all services.
Great and connected location, close to the station and to all main public transports.
Will come back again for sure!
The host is very nice and hospitable. The place is extremely convenient - a couple of minutes from the railway station, near to the city centre.
El lugar esta muy cerca del centro alado de la estación de tren y eso favorece todo el viaje. El lugar es acogedor. El anfitrión es amable y atento a todas las dudas y consultas.

Izi wad really communicative and available on email although I did not have the opportunity to meet him . Downside : (1) there is no lift to the 3-4ty floor and (2)  bedsheets and towels were clean but over used ! Would surely  recommend  for a night stay close to the station / airport , it s extremely convenient and apparently really good value for money for Geneva standards !

Modest and efficient room near the train station so convenient factor is high and the bed is comfortable and the place is also quiet in spite of being so close to the station.
The host did not appear to live there and the other room was let out to another guest who we shared the bathroom with. This wasn’t a problem however we thought we would be staying with a local vs. in a multiple room Airbnb. There is only the bedroom so no living room but we were out and about in Geneva during our weekend so this was okay and the room is spacious and has a small loveseat and a desk area.
It is an older apartment and a bit run down but clean enough and comfortable enough for a short stay if you are looking for a lower priced alternative in costly Geneva. If you just need an affordable place to rest your head for a few days then this works well. If you want to feel hosted in a place with some charm and ambiance, keep looking.

We really enjoyed our stay there. Jean and Xuong are very nice and gentle and made us feel like at home. The place is tidy and clean and with everything we needed. We would really recommend this place to our friends who will go to Geneva.

Ein schöner, großer Raum und ein ähnlich geräumiges, großzügiges Badezimmer. Die Toilette jedoch ist auf dem Gang.
Die Gastfreundschaft ist überaus herzlich und – vielleicht das beste an dieser Unterkunft – die Lage im Zentrum zwischen Seeufer und Hauptbahnhof ist einfach ideal.

Superbe séjour avec 2 adorables personnes.
Merci encore pour le kafé vietnamien;)
À bientôt
Karine, Mounir et Jasmine

We really enjoyed our stay with Jean-Philippe and Xuong in Geneva. They were very friendly hosts and very easy to be around. We were greeted with drinks and biscuits and a nice chat to get to know each other. Jean-Philippe showed us our room for the night. The room was very clean and of a high standard. We would highly recommend a stay with these hosts and wish that we had had more time to investigate the city.

A wonderful spacious apartment with 2 wonderful hosts.  Jean-Philippe & Xuong are kind and considerate hosts.  We were immediately made to feel welcome from the moment we stepped into their home.  Would definitely stay there again.

Nous avons passé un très bon séjour chez Jean-Philippe et Xuong.
Leur appartement est très proche de la gare et du lac, facile à trouver en arrivant à Genève.
La chambre et la salle de bains étaient grandes et propres.
这家的主人非常热情好客 主动为客人提供旅游信息，
住房宽畅干净,
距离日内瓦火车站和汽车总站都不到5分钟步行，公交方便, 餐厅商场很多，

Jean-Philippe made us feel so welcomed.  The place is classy, nicely decorated, and as beautiful as the photos.  The building is in an excellent location, with great restaurants on that street.  We had a very good time at their place!

We've been there for a weekend and didn't plan anything. Jean-Phillipe and Xuong were very friendly, helpful with hints what we could do in Geneva and so funny. We' ve had so much fun! The appartment is in a perfect location in the middle of the city, so each attraction is only 5-15 min walk away. We thank you for such a wonderful stay and are looking forward to meeting you again.

Notre séjour chez Jean Philippe et Xuong a été très agréable. Excellent accueil, cuisine à disposition, très belle chambre spacieuse et confortable, magnifique salle de bains. Ils sont aux petits soins avec leurs hôtes. Appartement proche de la gare, du lac et du centre historique. Très belle adresse. Merci à tous les deux.

I thoroughly enjoyed my stay with Jean-Phillippe and Xuong. They were very welcoming and hospitable. The room was comfortable and clean, the Jacuzzi bath fantastic! If you are staying for longer than a few nights ask for extra hangers - they were very accommodating to any request I made. It’s a great location, close to the train station and the lake with good places to eat nearby whilst being quiet. I’d stay there again.
Thankyou

J'ai été reçu par des hôtes très sympathiques et très attentionnés.

La chambre et la salle de bains étaient parfaites et nous ont offert tout le confort souhaité. Merci à tous les deux pour votre gentillesse. Bonne continuation ;-)

Phillipe and Xuong were excellent hosts for my single night visit to Geneva. Upon arrival, Phillipe provided a very in depth and thorough briefing on things to see, places to visit, and places to eat within the city. To make it even better, I was provided an audio self tour device and map which I used to explore the city. Great touch! The room I stayed in was large and perfect for one or two guests. Very clean and well maintained. The location of the apartment is within two blocks from the train station and two blocks from Lake Geneva...can't get much better than that.
I would definitely recommend this accommodation for anybody on a short stay in Geneva.
Thank you!

Pasamos una semana estupenda en casa de Philippe. El apartamento está muy bien ubicado en el corazón del casco antiguo de Ginebra y queda cerca de distintas líneas de transporte público, supermercados y restaurantes. Viendo las fotos os podéis hacer una buena idea de lo que vais a encontrar- un lugar limpio, acogedor y completamente equipado (wifi, Tv, calefacción, utensilios de cocina, secador, plancha, lavadora...). Además, Philippe es un anfitrión responsable, atento y resolutivo. Por tanto, recomendamos este apartamento a aquellos que quieran pasar unos días agradables en Ginebra.
-----
We spent a wonderful week at Philippe's place. The apartment is very well located in the heart of Geneva's old town and it is close to different public transport lines, supermarkets and restaurants. By seeing the pictures you can get a good idea of what you will find - a clean, cozy and well equipped place (wifi, Tv, heating, kitchen utensils, hair dryer, iron and washing machine...). Moreover, Philippe is a responsible, attentive and problem-solving oriented host. Thus, we totally recommend this apartment to those willing to spend a nice time in Geneva.
Great city central apartment in the old town of Geneva. I would highly recommend to friends and family.
Great place. 10 minute walk to central train station and maybe 30-40 minutes to UN. Worked well for my business trip. Would be a great base for tourism as well.

Philippe's apartment was exactly what we were looking for. Nested in the quiet and charming Vieille Ville, the apartment is spacious, modern, updated and equipped with the essentials. It is a 15 minute walk from most of the attractions. Would highly recommend!

This apartment has a beautiful atmosphere and is ideally located in the old town of Geneva! The layout is very well thought out and the rooms are full of light. The kitchen is well equipped and there is ample storage space. It was lovely to get to work at the main table overlooking the cobblestone streets! Highly recommended and would definitely return.

I had a fantastic three-week stay at Philippe's apartment! The apartment itself is roomy, includes lots of nice amenities (several English language news channels, new appliances, washer, iron and ironing board, closet space), and has a really comfortable and large bed.
As for the location, it's hard to beat. You're a short walk from the entirety of the old city, Parc des Bastions, many major bus and train lines, the lake, and the shopping district.
Plus, Philippe was a very accommodating and responsive host.
I would absolutely stay here again if business brings me back to Geneva.
A clean, modern apartment 5 minutes walk from the centre and the lake

We would stay here again in a heartbeat! Our train was late and Philippe was quite accommodating. He also offered to allow us to stay in the apartment a bit longer at the end instead of waiting at the train station. There is a cobblesone hill to get to the apartment but by the second day and sans luggage it was easy!!! Philippe has thought of everything! There was even a Swiss adapter we could use as the French ones do not work. The bus/train was very easy! Edwards down the hill has yummy sandwiches and there is a small grocery right there!! For two people it would be quite comfortable for an extended stay. There was even sugar/salt/ tea etc... the washer, iron , and fan all came in quite handy. Just all in all we had a fantastic time! Do not miss the tour of the UN and Nyon is a lovely little town with a wonderful castle museum just 15 min away by train!! if there were six stars I would have given it!!! Merci Phillippe!!!!!
The location was perfect for exploring the old town. Philippe was friendly and helpful upon our arrival.
Apartment was as advertised.  Close to public transit and reasonable price for a centrally located neighborhood.

I stayed in this studio for 5 weeks during the month of May and early June. Philippe is an excellent host and responds asap to calls and requests. The studio is very comfortable, bright, clean, well-equipped and in a fantastic part of Geneva. Internet works well.  It is more spacious than the photo shows. Everything is close by. I loved the old town. Central Geneva is just a minute's walk away. The studio is very close to public transport. The lake is very close as well.  It is simply a fantastic location. The only negative point are the late night or very early morning merry-makers-- as mentioned by others.   The old town is up a small hill. But there is a public elevator next to the library that takes you just a few meters from the flat. I would highly recommend staying here.

Fabulous location. Close to great restaurants, transport, supermarket and shopping.  Fabulous apartment. Have everything you could possibly need. Perfect size, everything inside was easy to use and little things had been thought of (maps, transport timetables, umbrellas, clothes rack). Highly recommend this place!

This is a very nice apartment in a lovely part of the city. The location is charming. I enjoyed staying here. I appreciated very much that Philippe made it possible for me to check in "after hours." The only other thing to say is that, in the warm weather, with the windows open, I could hear people outside the building in the middle of the night. Given the location, this is to be expected (possibly welcomed) and didn't bother me. I would be happy to stay here again.

Le logement est fort bien situé, très central pour quiconque souhaite visiter Genève. Le quartier est très joli et sympathique. La nuit, il faut dire que le bruit est constant avec des jeunes qui traînent dans les rues avoisinantes jusqu'aux petites heures du matin : nous avons dû fermer fenêtres et rideaux pour dormir. Sinon, c'est un lieu parfait pour un agréable séjour. Nous le recommandons chaleureusement !

Great location in the Old Town and very close to the city center with easy access to all you need, walking distance from the bus and the train station, all the sightseeing and nice restaurants. There are stairs to climb or a narrow cobblestone street uphill to reach the apartment, but if you prefer you can take the public elevator located in front of the library. The apartment has everything you need for a nice stay. Philippe is a great host and responded promptly to all my inquiries.
Philippe is a good host and very considerate.

Perfect for a trip to Geneva. We loved the location - in the beautiful old town. You need to go up a small hill and a flight of stairs, but for the beautiful location this didn't matter at all. Perfect location - 10 mins from everything. Flexible check in and check out was given due to no one arriving the next day. This allowed us to do more with our days. Slightly loud noise in the nights, but it was a festival weekend and that would have been the same in any other central location. Very comfortable with everything you could need for a short stay. Spotlessly clean and great wifi. Great value for Geneva. Thank you!
Très bel endroit dans la vieille ville de Genève.

My husband and I really enjoyed are stay. The location in old town was perfect. There were many restaurants, bars, and shopping nearby. The apartment also had everything we could have asked for. It was a good size. The bed was very comfortable and it was a huge plus to have a washer. There was also a kitchen which we really didn't use much, but we did enjoy having a coffee maker. The only minor complaint was that the club outside could be loud at times. There was only one night where it was particularly loud but for the most part we did not mind it. We would highly recommend this apartment .  We really enjoyed our stay.

The apartment is great, very comfortable (specially the bed) and you have everything you need. Sadly, we got some loud, drunk fights during several nights right outside our window. We started using the air conditioner which made a sound that helped neutralize the noise from outside. Overall, we had a pleasant stay and Philippe was very helpful and nice.
The apartment is indeed central located, walk distance to most tourist spota, and the room is nice and cozzy. Philippe is also super nice and prepared everything could be needed.

L'appartement est très agréable, propre, bien équipé et idéalement situé. Le quartier est animé mais nous n'avons pas été dérangé par le bruit à l'intérieur du logement.
Philippe a été très arrangeant concernant notre heure d'arrivée (tardive).
Nous avons passé un excellent séjour.
Just what we expected from the advert. Furnished just enough for all our needs. Perfect location with near access to everything

Philippes place is absolutely perfect for trip to Geneva! The best location - with walking distance to everything you want to see. We enjoyed the local Italian restaurants, the friendly people in the neighborhood (and the city in general), and the city's beautiful parks, lake promenades and mountain views. Whenever people will ask for tips to Geneva, we'll point them right in Philippe's direction. Not only is this home perfectly clean and fully provided with everything you need for a stay in the city - Philippe is also an extraordinary, friendly, helpful and flexible host. Thank you so much :)

This is an excellent place to stay in Geneva. It is really well located and it is an extremely pleasant space. It is even nicer than it looks in the photos, especially the bathroom and kitchen. I really appreciated the washing machine and the coffee machine - all the necessities! a comfortable bed with nice bedsheets and towels. Communication was great and check in and check out were very easy.
Another successful stay - thank you Philippe.

A lovely flatlet, well equipped in a great part of the city - the old town is quaint and special. We really enjoyed our stay and were very comfortable and warm. It's within easy walking distance of the centre but there are plenty of trams close by too. A bit hilly to get there but it's worth it.

The house is very well located near to the city center. Very close to public transport, the lake, and everything you have to visit in Geneva.
The apartment is very well equipped, the kitchen is small but smart! You can enjoy your stay in Geneva in Philippe’s apartment.
Another great stay in Geneva !

Easy access to everywhere. Local to shops and restaurants / Bars. But tucked away from the hustle and bustle. Great location. I little street noise but to be expected in such a good area.
Philippe very accommodating. Great host.

Prachtig gelegen in het oude centrum. Goede voorzieningen. Openbaar vervoer op loopafstand. Erg aangenaam toeven. In het weekend veel lawaai van uitgaanspubliek. Neem vooral oordoppen mee. Verhuurder reageert  snel op vragen.
The appartment of Philippe is great, it is cosy and got everything you need.  Location is great. Communication very good. I absolutely recomment this appartment.

Great location! Perfect to explore the beautiful old town and we enjoyed the lively Italian pizzeria across the road on our first and last nights there! Easy to walk into Geneva centre and to public transport.
Amenities and facilities were all good condition and clean. Shower and bath were great. Kitchen is small but perfect with everything you need. Bed was very comfortable (important as I had a full marathon to run in the morning!) and comfortable sitting area.
The only thing is the noise from local disco clubs at night, so if you have your windows open you may need ear plugs to sleep well, or a fan to keep cool at night. It’s a great location for restaurants and bars etc but if you want an early night the noise may keep you up while you try to sleep with the windows open.
Otherwise we really enjoyed it and would definitely stay again!
Nice apartment in the old city and close to the city centre. Philippe was flexible and easy to deal with. Lots of bars and good restaurants in the area.

Très bon séjour dans le logement de Philippe . Le logement est situé dans le coeur historique de la ville. A quelques mètres on peut s'installer à la terrasse d'un petit restaurant ou d'un café. L'appartement est très agréable et fonctionnel. Philippe a répondu à toutes nos questions et nous à conseiller avant notre voyage. Encore merci pour ce séjour !

This apartment is gorgeous— it is small but has everything you need. It is especially lovely to have a separate sitting area, and such a deep tub! It is spotlessly clean and also feels recently (and sensitively) renovated. The street outside can get a bit noisy on weekends, but closing the windows blocks out a remarkable amount of noise. I would definitely stay again.

We we're in Geneva for a work trip and could not have found a more perfect place. The apartment is extremely comfortable and equipped with everything you could possibly need, from coffee to laundry and ironing facilities. The location is amazing. Philippe was also extremely responsive.

Pros: great location, clean, washing machine, fast wifi.
Cons: great location means its in the middle of the night action. Bring ear plugs if you are not a night owl and its no problem.
Definitely stay here if you’re in geneve

The stay at Philippe’s apartment was really enjoyable! The location is great and it has everything you need. I recommend it if you are in Geneve for a short time and you want to make the most out of your stay! The only but is that we were three hosts and there were only two towels. I highly recomend it!
Tout était parfait pour ce séjour : logement très bien situé, parfaitement propre, avec tous les équipements nécessaires pour profiter pleinement du séjour. Literie très confortable.

Appreciated all things that JP& Xuong did for us. Really nice place, 5mins walk from the train station, walking distance to the lake. JP & Xuong are very hospitable and it feel like home when u are in this place. Will definitely recommend this place to all my friends who travel to Geneva.

一次伟大的体验，Jean-Philippe & Xuong都是慷慨风趣的主人。他们像我们详细介绍了日内瓦的景点和注意事项，我们也因此玩的很开心。我们后来才发现Xuong的中文非常好，早知就不说这么久英文了。房屋设施非常棒，在这里住宿也很舒适，甚至还有按摩浴缸，真开心。我们居住的厦门，与日内瓦有很多地方很相似，我故意拍了一些相似的照片，我的朋友们都说你怎么这么快回厦门了，lol。不过比起快被几百万游客弄沉的厦门岛，日内瓦要好多了。享受在日内瓦的一切吧，感谢Jean-Philippe & Xuong。

Very nice and clean place. Quite convinent to walk to railway station (<5mins walk) and to the lake (also 5 mins walk), and to the supermarket (also 4 mins walk to Manor).

Be allowed to use everything in the house, well...they do have everything prepared for us, even a city tour map with detailed suggestion... Cool guys, thank you!

Even though we arrived much later than expected, Jean-Philippe was extremely accommodating and so friendly greeting us after a long day of travel! He gave us a lovely welcome to city and provided a great restaurant suggestion. The room was perfectly clean and had every amenities that could be needed, including outlets right next to the bed and a great bathroom. The location could not have been more perfect, easy to get to from the train station and a super short walk right to the water and activities. We only regret that we only had one night in Geneva and couldn't have spent more time in the room and the city. We would love to return to stay here if we are back in Geneva.
Une réception chaleureuse du couple Jean-Philippe & Xuang j'ai occupé la grande chambre dans un très bel appartement super bien localisé à 2 minutes de la gare.  A recommander sans hésitation.

Très bon accueil et de bons conseils pour visiter la ville...
La chambre est calme, très bien située
A recommander!

Jean -Philippe et Xuong sont très acceuillants, très disponibles, ils trouvent toujours et rapidement là meilleure solution pour vous aider et faciliter votre séjour. Des conditions parfaites, très propre, ça donne envie de revenir !

Friendly greeting, elegant bathroom- no toilet.
I loved the 15 English channels on TV box.Entry and codes could be simplified, copies for both guests.
We loved it.

Philippe was a friendly and charming host who made me feel at home straight away. The bed and room are very comfortable and the apartment is very conveniently located close to the train station, the lake and not far to the old town.

Upon booking our trip, both Jean-Philippe and Xuong we're very helpful with providing all the necessary information that we needed prior to arriving in Geneva. The instructions to their place was very clear and easy to follow. It was great to know that we were 5 mins away from the train station and was close to restaurants and stores.
We were given a very warm welcome and our questions we're always answered if we had any. We decided to stay one more night in Geneva and luckily they were able to accommodate us.
We felt at home and very comfortable with Jean-Philippe and Xuong and would highly recommend to anyone visiting Geneva to give them a shot.
We were warming greeted and given directions for the main regions of Geneva. They were very gracious throughout the visit.

It was an awesome experience! We received warm hospitality and a lot of friend advices. They gave us directions for our sightseeing trips and helped us as much as they can to have a great time in Geneva. The apartment was very clean and the bathroom was lovely. I surely recommend this place ! We had an amazing time!

Philippe and Xuong were great hosts! They briefed me up with all the necessary details on my arrival. I had a pleasant stay! I would recommend staying here.

Great hosts and great place to stay in Geneva. It is close to the train station and in the center of Geneva.

We were made very welcome and oriented both to the facilities and to Geneva. The description of facilities was spot on. Our stay was perfect. The room and bathroom was bright, airy and clean and well maintained.Thankyou
Lovely room, very responsive host. Recommended.

Jean-Philippe and Zuong were the most gracious hosts. They were very communicative via both text and email prior to my arrival. As soon as we walked through their door, JP took the time to show me around the flat, and then give me a personal orientation of where we were in Geneva. The recommended to restaurants for me to try for dinner and their recommendations did not disappoint. While I was in Geneva, some news reports came in about some potential terrorist threats from ISIS/DASH. JP shared the news with me and gave me some advice as I headed to the train station. Absolutely top-notch care. I highly recommend staying with Jean-Philippe and Xuong.
The room is just as in the picture. Really cozy and clean. Location is very convenient and hosts are very helpful and friendly. I recommend.

Philippe and Xuong could not have been better hosts. We were given really useful information before and during our visit and maps to help us explore the city. There is an audio guide too if you want to use it. Our room was big, with a huge bathroom and so cosy and warm.
I had an excellent stay! The room is clean and comfortable, with plenty of space.

Overall a good stay. Room was good and well designed, with bathroom attached but without toilet.
Jean-Philippe was very kind and helped us around town, and the room is located in the center, and also easy to get to the airport from.
Unfortunately, during the night extremely noisy neighbours kept us up from 1 till 3am, which left us grumpy the next morning for the flight, but we consider this bad luck.

Lovely room with ensuite shower room, and shared toilet. Geneva tour and Nespresso was a hit - thank you. Perfect place for central accommodation if you just looking to rest your head.
I feel it's also important to add, we were a little surprised to displace the hosts from their own bedroom into the living room.
The room was clean and spacious, as well as well located. Furthermore, the hosts were pleasant and welcoming. Highly recommended!
A lovely room hosted by a master of numbers and facts of any kind!
It is really really good. Nice！ perfect！

Awesome!  What a perfect Airbnb experience.  Jean-Philippe was so helpful (thanks for the audio tour--that was really grand!) ad the room was also perfect.  The location near the train station meant I could walk to meetings at the UN and also walk to the Old City or to the Lake with ease.

JP and Xuong made us feel very welcome, and were excellent hosts. We were given a great amount of information upon arrival about Geneva which really enriched our stay. Would definitely recommend staying here, room was large and very spacious bathroom.
Thanks for a great stay!

The room was wonderful, perfectly clean and quite spacious. It was located in a great area of Geneva, quite central and near a ton of restaurants and shops. I would definitely recommend this apartment!!

JPh&X were extremely welcoming and their home is beautiful. Very clean and ample room in the bedroom and bathroom they allocated us. The location is perfect for exploring Geneva and they even gave us a walking guide and recommended excellent places for food and coffee. It is definitely an Airbnb I'd go back to. Highly recommend!

Very nice roof top apartment, central, very close to the central station.
Excellent restaurants near by. Lake, United Nations, Congress Center in walking distance. I just met with Xuong, he is very kind and helpful.
I enjoyed my stay and hope that the next time I am in Geneva I can stay in their apartment again.
Very comfortable room with welcoming hosts! Recommend! A*
Hosts were really good and there to greet us, location was great and easy to find as directions were very accurate.

This was our first Airbnb experience and we will definitely use Airbnb again. The apartment was very clean and the hosts friendly, we were left to come and go as we pleased and never felt that we were interfering in their life style, overall a very pleasant experience that we would recommend.
Gospodarz bardzo przyjazny, świetna lokalizacja, bardzo przytulny i czysty pokój. Zdecydowanie polecam!
Great location, great hosts. The audio tour that they provided was great as were their recommendations for places to eat. Would stay here again.

Jean-Philippe was waiting for me when I arrived. He was so helpful in getting me acquainted with recommendations for restaurants, transportation, and site seeing. The listing is as described and very nice, clean, etc.... The location is amazing within walking distance to most attractions. If I'm in Geneva again, I would certainly not hesitate to state here again. Both Jean-Philippe and Xuong were wonderful hosts.

Fantastic room and really nice bathroom, at the top floor of a building in the heart of Geneva, steps only from the train station.
We stayed for five nights at this location and appreciated the comfort of that room.
We were warmly welcomed by Jean-Philippe who described the city, where to go and provided audio guides (!!). During our stay they remained discreet, but helpful when we needed something.

We were made to feel extremely welcome by Jean-Philippe and Xuong. The apartment was spotlessly clean, and the room and bed were lovely and large. We had our own ensuite bathroom (with a jacuzzi!). Xuong was even kind enough to help with our laundry. Thank you both for a lovely stay in Geneva!
Merci encore pour votre acceuil. La petite attention pour les visites etait vraiment sympa. Idealement situé et respect de l'intimité.  Parfait.
This was my second time staying with JP and Xuong. I really enjoyed my stay - JP and Xuong are just lovely! The room was perfect, location perfect - I couldn't wish for more!

My wife and I stayed in Jean-Phillippe and Xuong's attic room for a few days before my wife's conference started. The room was spacious, with a large attached bathroom with a jacuzzi bath big enough for two!

The location is wonderfully located, being just a few minute walk from the train station, and easy to find. You are within easy striking distance of both old town, as well as all of the tram and train lines for exploring further abroad.

Xuong was an excellent host, and got us setup with an audio walking guide to the city that was one of the highlights of our experience. Unfortunately we did not have a chance to meet Jean-Philippe as he was working during our visit and our schedules never lined up.

I would easily recommend this listing to my friends and fellow travellers.
This was a lovely place to stay in Geneva, and Jean-Philippe and Xuong were good hosts. The room is very nice and very well located. I have no complaints!
Nice and helpful hosts, superb room and excellent locality. Honestly, it was pleasure to stay here and I'd definitely come back again! ;-)

Buena atención de los anfitriones. Situado en un excelente sitio, tranquilo y muy cerca de la Estación. No muy clara la descripción del apartamento. No sabíamos que había que compartirlo. Por lo demás todo bien.

Room is big and cosy. Our flight was delayed but Xuong was at home to welcome us. We have a private bath ensuite the room, toilet is a common toilet by the Main door and it feels like it's just us using it. Xuong was very helpful in sharing the places to visit. Both hosts Philippe and Xuong are always smiling whenever we bumped into them and always friendly. No wonder they are the top host in AirBnB!

We enjoyed an excellent stay, the location is superb, a 5 minute walk from the train station and lake, lots of restaurants nearby. The room was great, clean with a comfortable bed. Our hosts provided us with a map and digital tour guide which was a fantastic way to see the city.

The rooms were very comfortable & nicely decorated. Very convenient to all sights. We walked to United Nations complex. MANOR Mall within blocks, good food, lovely terrace. Our hosts were so helpful and pleasant. On a 10 point scale they earned a 10+.
Accueil parfait, chambre parfaite, position géographique parfaite et hôte parfait. On reviendra ! Merci beaucoup !

Alles tiptop! Wohnung hat alle Annehmlichkeiten, die man für einen kurzen Trip braucht. Lage ist perfekt in der Altstadt mit etlichen Restaurants in der Nähe.
Philippe's apartment is very well located in the historical center of Geneva and near to public transports. The apartment is very cozy and perfectly clean, I would defenitely book it again.
Wonderful, cozy place in the heart of the city. Fully equipped and exceptionally clean. Thanks for making our stay in Geneve a great experience for our family.
Recommendable 100%. You have all you need there. Excelent ubication!!

Philippe’s apartment was perfect for our stay in Geneva.
