Absolutely perfect space and host. Would recommend every time.
Comfortable short stay in the middle of the old town, charming building with character, effective communication with the host.

Delightful space in the heart of Old Town, exactly as it is depicted in the listing. It’s walking distance to all the Old Town sights and famous restaurants, but also near a few hidden gems if you want to feel like a local for a few days. I stayed there alone between two longer term rentals, but it would be perfect for a couple or a few close friends for a weekend or more. Philippe was quick to respond to the few questions I had during my stay. All in all, a wonderful location that I highly recommend.
Philippe’s place is perfect. Very clean and in a good location. Was very happy with my stay and would stay again.

This is a wonderful apartment right in the centre of the old town. My husband and I used to live in Geneva and always dreamed about staying right in the old town... this apartment is exactly that. Philippe is a great host - he responded quickly to all my queries. The apartment is clean, modern and has all the necessary amenities. We will certainly try to book this again when we return.
Great location, walkable to many locations, great restaurants in neighborhood. And yes, there is party noise on Friday and Saturday nights, until 5-6am. Be prepared with earplugs!

We loved the location of this apartment! It’s close to many shops and restaurants in Old Town. Everything was extremely clean and tidy, and the photos accurately depict the space. As other reviewers have referenced, there can be noise late at night on the street below, but we brought ear plugs and that helped. We would definitely stay here again if we come back to Geneva!

Philippe’s place is in the center of downtown Geneva. The apartment was clean and cozy and was equipped with all the basics. I arrived in the early morning, and he went above and beyond to arrange a super early check-in. Communication couldn’t be any quicker/easier.

It's a great space, in an excellent location.  There are great dining options all around and everything is close by.  There is a night club on the same street, but we did not find the club noise to be a problem at all.  We will definitely stay here again in the future!
We had a fantastic experience, we had everything  we needed and expected. Thank you!
Very central location and in a pretty square in the old town.  A 10 minute walk from train station (you could take tram and walk last 100m if you wish).  Picturesque and convenient.
Cozy and tidy apartment in a great location.

Great location! Puts you right into the center of old town with easy access to bars and restaurants, the cathedral, and many other cool stops. If you are new to Geneva, it’s a perfect place to stay and feel like you can access it all. We also found free street parking, which was helpful! Philippe was always quick to respond, too!

Philippe’s home was an absolute treasure in the heart of the old town. We had the most beautiful stay and the apartment was very accommodating to any need you might possibly have. He has thought about every single slight touch and provides you with the best experience you could possibly have. I would definitely stay again!

Excellent apartment in a great location, close to the lake and the main train station, with plenty of bus stops close by. There is even a public  elevator which we can use as the apartment is a bit of a climb up. Facilities were all great with everything needed for a family stay.
Great flat and location !
We had very nice time at Philippe’s apartment in the middle of the lively an old town of Geneva. A lot of nice restaurants and bars are around.

The accommodation is well located, clean and nice. Phillipe communicated well and was prompt/clear with check in instruction. As other reviews have mentioned the night club outside is VERY loud. You may have a tough time sleeping if you do not use ear plugs.

This is not the first time we have been staying in Philipp's apartments. We are very pleased with the cleanliness, convenience of housing, the well-thought-out household details. Philippe is always in touch. Perfect location.
Thank you for the great stay. Excellently situated. Very close to Museum, park and a delicious pizza restaurant. We enjoyed exploring the old town from this position. Perfect.
Lovely little apartment, ideal location for our stay. Can be a bit lively outside at night but no problem with the windows shut.

Apartment was located in a beautiful part of the city, right next to a wonderful cathedral and an excellent restaurant called the Hôtel Les Armures where we ended up eating every night. Philip was very accommodating and allowed us to check-in earlier and lent us a travel adaptor because we forgot ours. Overall the apartment was very clean, modern and had everything required. The only slight negative was that the shower gel/shampoo wasn't very foamy so we quickly used it all up. I would recommend bringing your own or buying some from the shops just around the corner.

Very nice place.  Located in the center of the Geneva city, attractive old town while very close to tram  and bus station, you can also easily walk to central station. Next to main shopping street, beautiful park is also in walking distance. No elevator, so you need to pull up your suitcase but Philippe was kindly waiting for us and help carrying our suitcase. He explained everything we need like how to use wash machine, TV etc. Very quick response for our questions. Highly recommended. (as noted by owner and other reviewers, the bar across the street is open until early morning and bit noisy, so not recommended for noise sensitive person.)
Cool apartment in the very heart of old town, very central, cozy, convenient navigation to all sights and transport.
We especially loved the location
Nous avons passés un excellent séjour à Genève dans ce super air bnb ! Le fait que tous les centres d'intérêts soit à proximité est vraiment un plus ! Allez y les yeux fermés !
The flat was great, couldn't wish for a better location. It was well equipped and very clean. Philippe was a very accommodating host.

This place was really nice. Philippe was a great host. He replied to all my messages straight away. One reason we chose this place is that we have an 8 month old child, and he provided a travel cot in the apartment for us which made life easier. I really enjoy a coffee everyday, so I put the Nespresso machine to good use. If we are passing through Geneva again, we will definitely look at staying here again.

Philippe and Elzbieta’s hospitality and communications are outstanding.
The accomodation are perfectly fit for 3 of us.
Those made our stay in Geneva a wonderful experience. Thanks a lot guys!
Great location! The pizza place across the alley is a fun place to hang out! Parking is difficult.

L’appartamento si trova in pieno centro storico, nella via dove è ubicato l’immobile ci sono due ristoranti e una discoteca. Come si gira l’angolo sono presenti parrucchieri negozietti e market dove poter fare la spesa. La zona rimane comunque silenziosa e molto sicura in quanto è spesso vigilata dalla polizia che esegue ronde come nel resto della città. La casa è dotata di tutto, l’abbiamo trovata esattamente identica all’annuncio. Molto funzionale e pratica oltre che pulita e comoda. Si trova al secondo piano, l’ascensore non è presente ma si tratta di fare 10 scalini in tutto. Noi avevamo due valigie più una bambina di 7 mesi e non è stato affatto faticoso. La casa è riscaldata 24 ore su 24 da dei termosifoni condominiali, la temperatura era perfetta. Abbiamo apprezzato molto il fatto che ci abbia messo a disposizione un lettino per la bambina (a pagamento). All’interno dell’appartamento ci sono anche tante cartine e opuscoli sulla città. Ottimo il check-in e out. Facile veloce.

Gerne wieder. Wir waren zu 4. über Silvester in Genf. Die Lager war der Hammer! 3 Minuten zu Fuß und man konnte alles erreichen. Zentraler gehts nicht !!!
Die Wohnung hatte alles an Ausstattung was man brauchte. Die Kommunikation zum Gastgeber war auch top. Schnelle Antworten per Airbnb Nachrichten !
Perfect place to be, great location.
Very good location and very nice studio. I will come back. Many thanks
A great and really affordable place, a must

The appartment is located right in the center of geneva‘s old town so tha location is really great. And it is very nicely furnished and has everything you need. Check in was also super easy, I would definitely stay here again.
A cozy place in a great location. The hosts were helpful and responsive to our needs. Would definitely stay again!
Accueil très agréable. Localisation idéale en vieille ville. Appartement lumineux et bien équipé.
Appartement au top, super bien équipé et agréable ! Je recommande!
Très propre et confortable avec excellent emplacement.
Small and clean place in a perfect location. It is downtown, so expect a loud night. Other than that, all good and as expected.
Philippe's place is perfectly located in the old centre of the city and has everything needed for a stay in Geneva. Great communication as well. I hope to be back someday.
Logement conforme à la description, bien situé et confortable.

Great studio apartment in the middle of the old part of town. Fully equipped and with a fantastic host. The streets do get a little noisy during the weekend, but it is fine once you close the windows. Recommended.
L'appartement est central et bien situé. Philippe est très réactif dans les échanges, et l'arrivée autonome est très pratique ! Le logement est agréable et bien équipé. Séjour agréable !

Well located apartment in Old Town, 2 minutes walk to tram. Supermarket, restaurant and coffee shop nearby. Philippe was attentive and responsive. Requested extra duvet and received almost immediately. Highly recommended.
Philippe réagit rapidement à toute question ou problème.
Really cosy one bedroom, and beautiful location. perfect for a short stay in town
Great studio! And nice area!
Great location!

This stay was great! I recommend communicating before you come to the country, that was my only mistake (but it was my mistake). The response time was quick though so it was no issue. I loved the location and the place was so cute and had everything I needed! I very much recommend this stay.

We stayed from Wednesday to Friday. We liked that the eateries below added some liveliness and this chattering was greatly reduced once windows were closed. It also felt safer with the alfresco diners around.

Perfect stay, little bit noisy on the weekends because there is a club next door.
Location is Great, everything you need is nearby, would come again at any time
Great stay!

Wonderful couple and hosts! Very friendly, helpful, and polite. The room and home was decorative and comfortable. The audio tour was informative and interesting, just another attentive addition to the host commitment to the enjoyment of our trip. We would stay again. Thank you for your hospitality .

Estancia muy agradable en general, la casa está muy bien situada para descubrir la ciudad. Los anfitriones son muy amables y te hacen sentir en Ginebra como si estuvieses en casa. La información turística facilitada está genial para poder descubrir la ciudad por tu cuenta.

Los anfitriones nos hicieron sentir como en casa y respondieron a todo lo que necesitábamos. El lugar es tal como se muestra en las fotos. Las comodidades, excelentes. El barrio muy cómodo, todo a nuestro alcance.
Nous avons passé un séjour extra. La gentillesse de Jean-Philippe et Xuong, le comfort de la chambre et le lieu étant situé tout près du lac de Genève en font une proposition à recommander.
I was greeted on arrival, quite late at night and given simple, friendly and useful instructions. I was attending a conference and spent only sleep-time in my room.

This is a lovely room with its own luxurious bathroom.
I was working in Geneva and a hectic schedule meant that I barely had a chance to speak to my hosts at all- Something that I regret as they were both charming and extremely helpful.

We enjoyed our stay. Philip explained to us evething we need to know, they even provided us with an audio guide with map. The location is perfect (5mins walk to the lake or train station, 3mins to the bus station) -- would definately recommand.

Amazing Hosts and Listing!

The listing is just as described: clean and spacious attic room, with a hard futon (but very comfy!), large screen TV and a Jacuzzi.
Apart from that, Jean-Phillip and Xuong were super helpful with great tips about sight-seeing, maps, train tickets discounts and more. They were very friendly and nice, answered all our questions with a smile and made us feel home.

The location is great, 3-4 minutes walk from the train station, major bus hub and the lake. We highly recommend this listing !

Xuong was there to meet us and gave us a thorough explanation of the apartment and along with a map supplied us with an audio guide to the city, which was very informative and useful. Jean-Philippe was a mine of information and told us several really interesting historical anecdotes about the city and some of its eccentric residents. Several of them bequeathed large tracts of land to the city on a number of interesting conditions. Ask Jean-Philippe for the intriguing details.
The room was beautiful with an ensuite and an excellent desk and chair, important for me as I work while I am away. Internet connection was excellent.
Very central location, big & clean room, good directions provided by the hosts prior to arriving.

This was our first BnB experience & we won't be repeating it, I don't think. Our hosts were lovely and accommdation close to everything but I felt we were intruding into a person's life, like burglars who had broken into someone's house. I think you have to have a certain temperament to enjoy staying in the home of someone you don't know with their personal pssessions everywhere.  If you do, then you will enjoy this accommodation I am sure. For me, I think we will stick to hotels in future, where everything is sanatised and you don't need to walk through someone's dining room to go to the loo.

Jean-Philippe war sehr freundlich und hilfsbereit. Das Zimmer unter der Dachschräge mit angrenzendem, privaten Badezimmer ist super. Das Bett ist wirklich bequem auch wenn es ein Futon ist. Es sind kaum 5 Minuten an den See und vielleicht 10 zum Schwimmbad, was bei dem heißen Wetter eine echte Wohltat war.
Insgesamt ein Ort zu Wohlfühlen, Mitten im Multikulti.
Danke Jean-Philippe!

I had a great, if abbreviated stay at Philippe and Xuongs place. They were flexible enough to meet me at a different time as my flight was delayed by a day. They provided maps and good detail of the city to get me oriented.  Really nice place in a central location, directions to and from the airport were really easy to follow.
Welcomed by a friendly host after following meticulous direction from the train station (gate). Greatly enjoyed the space. Clean, nice space and wonderful hosts.

Great room, very spacious! Close to the lake and all the sights we wanted to see. Jean-Phillippe and Xuong were very friendly and even had walking tours with an audio guide all set up for us. Highly recommend!

The apartment was clean, comfortable and well furnished + the location was perfect, right in the center of the city. Xuong and Jean-Phillippe were friendly and went the extra mile to help us out which made our stay in Geneva a great one.

We very much enjoyed our stay with Jean-Philippe and Xuong, who did everything possible to prepare the room and make our stay successful. We were given full details of the tourist attractions and how to get to them and even had the use of audio tours with the compliments of our hosts. The room was spacious and extremely clean and comfortable, as was the bathroom and we could have had a spa bath if we had wanted. The location is very easily located from the train station and very close to all of the features of Geneva.

We had an amazing time in Geneva and will be back for sure! The apartment was in a great location, walking distance to everything you could want. Since it was our first time in Switzerland we were very appreciative of the map and specific suggestions Philippe gave us when we arrived.

We had a lovely time with Jean-Philippe  and Xuong . They we very helpful and accomodating for all our needs. The accomodation is very comfortable and very close to the city and train station. Thank you for your  hospitality it was a very enjoyable time

Our stay was short but absolutely perfect! Geneva is such a great city and Jean-Philippe and Xuong were both so welcoming and helpful. The place is beautiful and the bathroom is so clean and well equipped. The shower has perfect water pressure. They gave us an audio tour to do through the city and it was so fun. The location is PERFECT - so close to everything and to transit. Thanks for everything - highly recommend.

This was our first Airbnb experience and it was great! The hosts responded very quickly to our inquiries with very accurate directions to their place. They were helpful with suggestions about things to do and see in Geneva.
The place was clean, the bed was comfortable and it was right in the middle of the city- close to transport.

We had an enjoyable stay at Jean-Philippe and Xuong's place. They were both excellent hosts and nothing was too much trouble for them. There was a problem with the lift when we arrived which took a day and a half to fix. The apartment is on the 5th floor and 104 steps ( yes- we did count them) and was getting a bit much for a couple in their lates sixties but to the boy's credit the pushed the lift company to fix it.
The location was perfect for us- 5 minutes to the station, and about the same to the lake and the Old Town. There are numerous restaurants on the surrounding street and the neighbourhood seemed very safe.
We did not realise ( our fault) that it is a shared apartment but our hosts were not intrusive. I would definitely recommend this apartment (which has a lot of character)

Very central location, walking distance from train station. Philippe and Xu were very helpful directing us to things to see in Geneva. Xu speaks Chinese which was great for my wife who is Chinese. Access is a little complicated but suppose necessary in the city.

Jean-Philippe & Xuong have a wonderful place, very nicely decorated, clean, very central and convenient and quiet - very important for a tired business traveler :-) Xuong has been an extraordinary host, communicated very well through the process and was very welcoming, polite and kind. I'm sorry I couldn't interact more with the both since working until late and traveling in and out of Geneva during the day.
Thank you very much and wishing you many more great AirBnB experiences!

Arrival was incredibly easy - Jean-Phillippe let us know location and security info prior to arrival. Location was very central and that allowed us to do much sight seeing, especially as he'd provided a map and plenty of info at the start! The large bath was refreshing at the end of the day. Bed is a bit overly firm but good size. Loved having a good hair dryer and access to the fridge to store some food items. Manor was just down the block and we had some great food there as well as at the recommended Thai restaurant! Thank-you!

Merci à Jean-Philippe & Xuong pour leur accueil, Nos Hôtes sont d'une gentillesse infinie, c'est de loin le meilleur appartement de Genève pour séjourner à deux. Toujours disponible pour rendre ses visiteurs à l'aise et profiter un maximum du séjour. Logement très agréable au centre de Genève, conforme en tout point au descriptif. L'ascenseur a été très apprécié. L'équipement disponible permet un séjour confortable. Nous recommandons vivement ce logement. Tout fut parfait et l appartement est très spacieux et confortable. Merci pour tout. Tonny & Sophie
Tutto perfetto, ottima accoglienza. L appartamento fantastico ed anche la posizione.

Jean-Philippe et Xuong habitent un appartement proche de la gare et à 10 mn à pied du lac et de la vieille ville.
2 nuits passées dans une grande et belle chambre sous les toits.
Grand lit avec un matelas ferme. De beaux tapis et un ameublement asiatique en laqué rouge avec lumière tamisée permet de dormir en toute tranquillité et calme.
Très grande salle de bain avec jacuzzi et douche avec la chambre.
Jean-Philippe et Xuong sont des garçons très accueillants et plein d'attention dans le respect de la vie des hôtes. On se sent bien chez eux. L'après midi du dernier jour, nous avons pu laisser nos bagages en toute confiance et les récupérer quand on voulait car nous avions gardé les clés de leur appartement.
Une excellente adresse à garder pour un futur voyage à Genève.
The apartment is in an amazing location. We had a great stay and I would recommend it highly.
Great location!!! Philippe responded to all of my questions very fast. It was a bit hot in the apartment, but Philippe brought us another fan. Thanks!
There is a disco downstairs. Otherwise everything was great and the host is flexible, I would definitely come back here!

We had a great stay at Philippe's apartment.  It is a small apartment right in the historic center of Geneve.  Close to great restaurants, cafe's bars and St. Peters Cathedral.  The Bed was very comfortable, and he left out sheets for my daughter to use sofa bed, which was also very comfortable.  Very Clean apartment and easy instructions for check in.  Thank you!!
The location is perfect
Muy bien ubicado, anfitrión muy atento, limpio
Location is perfect, a short walk to almost anything.  Flat is nice and cozy but has all that is needed.  If windows are open, it’s a tad noisy at night.

Out stay at Philippe's apartment was great. The flat is in the very city center. Everything you could need was nearby. Even though it was very hot outside, inside the flat was kept very cool. The noises outside can be a bit loud on some days. The flat has everything you can need as well, very nice decorations, modern.

We stayed with my family for two days. Philippe's house has a great, central location in downtown Geneva, everything we needed was in walking distance. The studio had everything we needed including a very well-equipped kitchen. I would stay in Philippe's studio with no hesitation next time I am in Geneva.

The place is located in the heart of Geneva- the old town: and if you just go down the slope you get into the nice shopping street and the lake. The host is very responsive anytime I needed a help. The room is nice and the small kitchen is well equipped. It's somewhat in the noisy area (restaurants, club, etc), but if you are a tourist, probably it's not a big deal, and also if you close the windows, the problem would disappear. Nice Italian restaurants and an authentic Swiss restaurant just next to the apartment.
This is a lovely apartment,very central with everything you need. Would certainly visit again

Appartement très bien situé, en plein cœur de la vieille ville de Genève, à quelques centaines de mètres du lac, magasins et restaurants. très propre et confortable. Philippe a été très réactif et amical. je recommande.

Super logement bien équipé, très cosy et douillet. Ménage irréprochable.
Arrivée et départ autonome en toute simplicité.
Le logement est très bien situé dans une petite rue pavée.
Propriétaire à l’écoute et réactif aux demandes.
Rien à dire, merci

Everything was wonderful. The place was nice and clean. Close to everything and a safe neighborhood . We were able to leave our luggage for a bit after check out which was very convenient. Definitely would stay there again.
Nice apartment in a great location!
Zentrale, saubere Wohnung. Museen sind alle zu Fuss gut erreichbar. Philippe ist ein guter Gastgeber. Wir haben uns wohlgefühlt.
Tout nickel sauf attention il faut changer l’ampoule de la chambre c’est assez désagréable
It was very easy to access and perfectly placed in the old city.  We were happy he could take us on short notice.
My stay with Philippe was amazing!

Great place at a great location! It is very easy to find and the area is beautiful and very walkable. It is very close to public transportation and very close to the lake. Since the place is located in the old town, there are stores, restaurants and bars all around! They are delicious but some nights are noisy.
Amazing host and place! Thank you Philippe
Cute place in an outstanding central location in Old Town. Would stay here again!
We enjoyed staying in the charming Old neighborhood of Geneva. It was fun to explore the narrow streets and sights.
Appartement ben équipé. Même une machine à laver. Rien à dire. Très bien situé plein centre de la vieille ville. Hôte très réactif. Un plaisir
Très bien situé
Great value in a central location in Geneva.  We were very happy with our stay.  Comfortable bed, good space, though a bit loud with the nightclub and restaurant outside but was expected.

Fantastic location, just 3mins walk from the nearest tram stop. Wonderful food options and grocery market around and easily accessible to main central area of Geneva.
Only downside was the noise from the restaurants below but can easily be avoided with closing the windows tight.
The place was a very nice place to stay. It is near a nightclub, which was loud at night.
Awesome place! The location was perfect with lots to walk to and great restaurants nearby. It was a little noisy at night but was fine with the windows closed. Highly recommend!
The apartment is much smaller than expected. It only has 1 double bed and a sofa

What a fun & comfortable stay! We loved the location! Great Wi-Fi, very comfortable bed, great coffee maker and it’s fun to be right in the middle of everything. It is on the 2nd floor & close to local restaurants. There are sounds (noises) but it’s part of living in the area so we don’t mind. We totally recommend and would stay again at Philippe’s apartment if we go back back to Genève.
This was a great find. Lots of room and good central location to explore the different areas of geneva
Loved the location! Phillipe was very responsive and flexible. Great stay!
Studio propre et parfaitement situé

Phillipe foi muito solícito! O check in também foi fácil, e a localização boa !
Porém o apartamento deixou a desejar em alguns pontos, ele fica no segundo andar com uma escada enorme em espiral, não estava na descrição … estávamos com malas pesadas o acesso não foi fácil !
Além disso a porta da entrada do prédio fica aberta para qualquer pessoa acessar, e tem uma fechadura enorme na parte de dentro do apartamento.
Não senti que o anfitrião pensou em acomodar bem seus hóspedes, somente muito o básico do básico ! Era apenas um travesseiro muito pequeno e desconfortável para cada um ! O Sofa cama da terceira pessoa não tinha um lençol que pegava a cama toda, apenas meia cama , o que é uma coisa muito básica!!!
Coisas simples que poderiam ser melhoradas !
O chão da cozinha e banheiro também precisavam de uma boa limpeza !
Sempre elogio aibnbs que me hospedo, mas esse realmente deixou a desejar em alguns pontos !

Great stay in Philippe's space. He was very responsive with questions we had. Self check-in and out allowed us flexibility for arrival and departure. Walkable from the train station with multiple restaurants, coffee shops, and stores in the area. Could be a bit toasty at night in the summer, but the provided fan was helpful and multiple windows let in a nice breeze in the evening, so it was perfect. There are restaurants and bars in the area that may be noisy at night with the windows open, but it wasn't a bother for us at all and we enjoyed the lively area! Very clean overall as well. Really enjoyed our stay here and would recommend - thank you, Philippe.
Loved the location of this apartment, right in the centre of the gorgeous old town.  Will definitely return.

Responsive and accommodating host, good central location well served by public transportation, comfortable apartment (good bed). It was quite noisy at night sometimes, but that was clearly mentioned in the description of the apartment, so we were aware when booking.
Neat small studio with everything you need for a stay close to downtown Geneva
Great location in the heart of old town. many great restaurants and bars close by!

nice location within walking distance of transit hub and lots of places to eat. we were there Sunday through Wednesday so it wasn't too loud on the street, although it's not on a quiet back road. was pretty hot in the place (mid July) but otherwise a lovely stay

logement très bien situé près de tout.
literies excellentes.
il faut fermer les fenêtres la nuit car la rue est très bruyante à cause de la boîte de nuit.
Place was amazing and hosts were perfect.
入住很方便，位置超级棒，附近买名表的地方很多，感谢！
Very neat,compact and central.Quite noisy outside on Saturday due to nearby club-suggest earplugs.

Les plus:
- Bel endroit en pleine vieille ville de Genève
- Ancienne tour bien restaurée
- A du cachet
- Chouette studio pour 3-4 personnes (tous doivent dormir dans la même chambre, également salle à manger et salon)
- Hôte très réactif et sympathique
- Arrivée facile.
Les moins:
- La nuit bruyant car rue piétonne avec cafés et restaurants fermant tard. Avec les fenêtres fermées, ça va bien, mais quand il fait chaud, c'est problématique (petit ventilateur à disposition).
- Pas d'accessibilité en voiture. Le parking sous-terrain Saint-Antoine (CHF 24/24h), à 15 min. à pied est une bonne alternative à prix correct. Cependant attention, la moitié du chemin à pied est pavé, donc attention aux valises à roulettes.
Merci pour tout Philippe ! Nous avons passé 2 jours très chouette dans votre demeure !
Meilleures salutations et à une prochaine !

Le logement est conforme à la description. Le studio est très bien situé pour visiter Genève à pied et/ou en transport en commun. Il est bien équipé, la literie est top, y compris le canapé lit.
Il est dans un quartier très vivant : de jour comme de nuit. Il y a beaucoup de bruit la nuit (restos, bars, boîte de nuit…) On ne le choisira pas pour sa quiétude mais pour son emplacement et ses équipements

Great apartment right at the beginning of Old Town. The place is spotless and outfitted with everything I needed, small but nice and clean kitchen with Nespresso machine, microwave, fridge and a stove. Bathroom was very clean too with a washing machine in it. There is a drying rack and an iron in the hallway closet which came in very handy. Plenty of storage for clothes too. Even though it was hot out when I was there the apartment stayed cool.
Location was great, two minutes to the lake, tram stops and the main shopping street of Geneva. There is a small grocery store (Coop) a minute away. The only things to consider are - you have to go up a small hill to get to the place which might be a problem for older people or someone with health issues. And the other thing is there are two restaurants on the side of the building and you can hear the patrons. That is easily remedied if you close the windows since they're very well insulated.
I recommend and would definitely book again.
Top Kommunikation. Top Lage.
Beautiful Airbnb, very clean and well equipped with everything we needed for our stay. Great location, walking distance from the centre in a very charming part of town.

This location can’t be beat - convenient and lots of charm. Philippe has made the most of the space and it was comfortable for our family of four. Despite high summer temps the fans were enough to keep us cool. The one drawback was the noise - being on the second floor and keeping windows open, there was a lot of street noise late into the night (2am on a Thurs and Fri). All in all though, a great place to stay to get to enjoy Geneva, especially the old town.
We loved this little place! It was perfect for two nights in Geneva. Can’t beat the location, very comfy bed, and really well-equipped!
Everything was perfect. Definitely we'll go back

Amazing location, cute place, very responsive host. It’s tiny, but it worked for two adults and two kids for two nights as a base for exploring the city. The restaurant downstairs is amazing, and the street does get noisy with people, but the host provided earplugs, we turned on fans, and closed the windows, and we had no trouble sleeping.
Kommer helt sikkert tilbage. Perfekt beliggenhed og super god vært.
The location of the place is absolutely phenomenal, it’s close to a lot of the sights to see in Geneva. Very beautiful area too.
房间很干净，床很舒服

Très joli studio, emplacement idéal, j’y suis restée trois semaines pour travailler à l’opéra c’était idéal!

Lovely apartment and lovely hosts.
Very clean and spacious. It's quiet to sleep at night. Big bed with firm mattress.
The little dog is super cute and friendly.
I enjoyed the jacuzzi very much :)
Would definitely recommend booking this place.
It's in a safe and secure area and conveniently located.
Appartement au top ! Hotes très agréables, disponibles tout en respectant l'intimité de leurs invités ! Le airbnb idéal !

My third airbnb experience and I am not sure what to think of it, I felt so awkward as a guest this time. Prior to arrival hosts were more concerned about having exact time of arrival (more than one month ahead) than trying to make a connection with a stranger who is going to spend time at their house (and paying for it). Location was just perfect, room having fancy comforts (but toilet, which is outside the room), on private attic floor, with desk, jacuzzi and immaculate cleanliness. I only saw one of the hosts, briefly when checking in, as he kindly gave me a tour guide and some restaurant tips, after which they basically avoided contact with me. I wasn't offered access to kitchen/lounge contrary to what's advertised. Opposite my room was this curtain, I guess hosts were behind it judging from TV noise or upstairs. I checked out as instructed and sent a message, they didn't reply. I felt like an intruder at a stranger's fancy place. Nevertheless I managed to get some work done and sleep well in the fancy room and enjoy Geneva.

Our stay with Jean-Philippe & Xuong was a great success as it was our first experience with airbnb.  It was an outstanding location and easy walking distance from the train station and to the lake. Directions and instructions with the guys was clear and precise.  They greeted us and gave us all the local information we needed as well as respected our privacy.  The room was a good size with a generous bathroom which included a huge spa bath. Toilet was separate outside the room near the entance.  Probably the down side for us was the very firm bed and too soft pillows.  A new shower curtin would also improve the shower. Over all welcoming, warm and clean. Loved our stay in Geneva.
Very clean and quiet place.
Great people & great place. 5 stars!

its very nice staying in Jean-Philippe&Xiong's house.xiong is very kind and patient.
the house is perfect，thx.
Happy new year

Located in the centre of Geneva, Jean-Phillipe & Xuong's place is the perfect place to explore the city from! Jean-Phillipe and Xuong were fantastic hosts and will make sure that you get to experience the best of Geneva! Highly recommended!

This was by far the best airbnb experience we have ever had! My partner and I stayed two nights here, and Jean-Philippe made us feel completely at home. He provided an audio tour guide for the city, along with maps and fantastic recommendations for activities, food, drinks and transport. The room itself was fantastic, with everything we could have wanted and more (spa bath!!). The little puppy was an adorable addition to our stay as well. I cannot recommend Jean-Phillip and Xuong's place highly enough!

This was my first time booking a private room AirBnB and I must say it was a pleasant experience. While Xuong and Jean-Philipe were very accommodating and outgoing hosts, they also respect privacy well. The location is very central and close by a major transit hub. Communication: They were so easy to contact and readily responding to their airbnb messaging well before arrival and throughout our stay. I would like to say that we had a wonderful time while staying at Mauricio’s apartment. Unfortunately, I cannot say this as we never got to stay in Mauricio’s apartment.
We knew we would be in Geneva in July way back in February, and so we chose our accommodation well in advance with location and price in mind. Mauricio had some excellent reviews, the place looked gorgeous, it was in a perfect location for us and the price was very reasonable. We therefore booked the apartment on the spot and looked forward to our time in Geneva.
We had a change to our trip, and decided to spend a few days in Montreaux before coming to Geneva. This clashed with our stay in Geneva, and so I contacted Mauricio 4 days before our planned check-in to see if we could check one day late with no change to the financial arrangement. I also offered to be at the apartment on the agreed date if the one-day late check in was not suitable. To his credit, Mauricio agreed to let us check in one day later.
About 4 hours before we were due to check in, we got a message from Airbnb stating that the apartment reservation was cancelled. After some frantic messaging, we found out Mauricio’s planned contact to allow us access to the apartment cancelled that morning, and so he cancelled our reservation. He contacted Airbnb, who emailed us with alternate bookings. However, none were in a great location. While we could have accepted the location downgrade, none had the option to book on the spot. This meant we were up the proverbial creek with no paddle with having to wait for 24 hours for a response, with no guarantee that we could stay, and the prospect of what to do in a foreign city with no accommodation for at least one night.
In desperation, we ultimately found accommodation through an alternate booking site. While we ended paying more than twice what we originally budgeted, we were lucky as many of the bookings were asking for thousands of dollars for just one night, and we were in Geneva for 3 nights.
The whole experience has left a sour taste in our mouths. The fact that you can show up in a foreign city and have your accommodation cancelled at such short notice is frightening. Mauricio did apologise for the ‘inconvenience’, but an apology does not get you out of the disaster we were facing.
Airbnb has refunded our payment for Mauricio’s apartment and offered us a $AU200 voucher, valid for 12 months, which we can put towards our next Airbnb booking. At this stage, I don’t think I will be taking up this offer after the horror we experienced in Geneva.

Ioan's place in Geneva is a true gem!! We stayed for a week and felt right at home upon arrival (and even prior to arrival, as Ioan communicated so wonderfully and was very proactive in making sure we had everything we needed to make our stay comfortable). The apartment is large, beautifully furnished, full of light, and has everything you could possibly need during your stay (and then some). We prefer to cook most of our own meals and the kitchen was fully kitted out, clean, and easy to use.
Bathrooms were squeaky clean and we loved having a tub for the childrens' baths. The blinds on the large windows made sleeping easy as they blocked light out, and in the day the windows and balcony doors were left open to let in the beautiful breezes off the lake. The area is superb, right on the lake next to the Jet d'Eau, but still extremely quiet, peaceful, and relaxing.
And Ioan is the most gracious, friendly, and welcoming host, we could not have asked for a better person to host us!!
Perfect location close to lake and baby beach/park which was great for the children.

Ioan was a wonderful host, very pro-active and responsive with his communication. We stayed in the apartment for a week while visiting our daughter who was studying abroad in Geneva. It is a perfect location - 1/2 block from the lake, 1/2 block from bus station, countless restaurants, cafes, stores, and markets within 2-3 blocks. The transportation system in Geneva is world-class and it was so easy to get around - a 15 minute bus ride to the train station, from which we took several great day trips around Lake Geneva.
The apartment has wonderful old-world European charm. High ceilings, big windows, and a lovely balcony with a view of the lake. The kitchen is small, but has everything you need - we cooked dinner several evenings - and the expresso/coffee maker was heaven in the morning. The unit has amenities not usually found in European apartments - a washer AND a dryer, and a dishwasher.
Great owners, great charm, great location, great value.
Thank you very much
beautiful flat and amazing location in Geneva!

Ioan and Donna’s place was lovely. It’s in an unbeatable location that allows you to walk to plenty of restaurants, grocery stores, shops and the lake. It was spotless and well stocked. The main balcony off the living room had beautiful views of the lake and was great to sit out on while having a coffee or cocktail. The place is also well furnished and offers lots of comfortable seating and lounging. It’s also very tastefully decorated. In addition to that, Ioan and Donna were very welcoming and responsive. We’d definitely stay there again and recommend it without reservation.

Our family enjoyed our stay at Loan's place. It was a beautiful well kept place. It was a good location close to the water.  Nice cafes and restaurants a short walk away. We enjoyed the balcony every night we were there!!

We had a great stay at Ioan’s place in Geneva! The apartment is very well located and walkable to most tourist sights. Great cofffee shops and restaurants are also close.
Ioan is a great host and very communicative.
The space was very well appointed with plenty of supplies. The home felt cozy and was a great space for our group to stay. Would stay here again without hesitation of returning to Geneva.

Excellent location in Geneva. Close to everything we wanted by walking.
Felt very safe. Loved the balcony.
Unbelievable location, perfect for all the Lac Leman activities. So much fun and convenience for our whole family. Ioan was a gracious and accommodating host. À bientôt!

Couldn't have asked for a more perfect stay. Ioan was an outstanding host and his property is ideal - perfect location, spacious and everything you could possibly need.
Our family had a great stay and I couldn't recommend Ioan and his property highly enough.

The apartment was beautiful, in a lovely old building and with all mod cons, in a fantastic location next to the lake and near a lovely park, and Ioan was a delightful host, very responsive and kind. There are lots of restaurants and shops in the area, and transport around Geneva, including to and from the airport is easy. I stayed with two colleagues and we took the mouettes (yellow boats) to get across the lake on our daily commute, which was fun.
It is a very nice large studio, well equipped, in a quiet area. The one negative thing would be that it does not have internet/wifi, which nowadays is something people would wish to have.

Appartamento spazioso molto vicino alla Fiera (circa 15min).
I mobili e gli accessori sono piuttosto spartani, ma per un soggiorno breve vanno bene. Riscaldamento ok, quindi il confort d'inverno è ottimo. Mauro molto disponibile e flessibile alle nostre esigenze.

Due note negative che sono due suggerimenti per Mauro. Nell'appartamento mancavano bagno schiuma e shampoo, nonchè l'asciugacapelli. Considerato il loro basso costo è incredibile che non fossero disponibili.

I stayed at Mauro's apartment for the first couple-and-a-half weeks of a fellowship at a UN organization and was very, very happy with my experience. The studio is large, has great light, and is located within a short walk from the various UN organizations. It's also close to public transportation and a little shopping center with a grocery store, pharmacy, post office, and liquor store. And there's a great fondue place nearby, too. Plus, Mauro is an excellent host! He's really friendly and was very attentive to my needs. He had the apartment stocked with juices, jams, coffee, and some different breakfast foods, and even went to the trouble of setting up a wifi Internet connection during my stay!

Mauro is an incredible host. I accidently booked my room for the wrong dates, yet he picked me up from the airport and accommodated me as best he could. He was in constant contact, even when I called him at 6am! His place is very comfortable and it is a luxury to have a full private apartment in Geneva, especially at that price. Not only will I stay again, I am recommending his apartment to my office to use for work related visits. Thank you Mauro!
Perfetto alloggio, perfetta posizione geo, perfetto padrone di casa.

Mauro is a very good host. He made an extra effort to ensure I had a comfortable stay. He even offered to drop me at the airport.
The apartment is as described. It is clean and basic. The location could not be better for meetings at the UN or ILO. It was a 5 minute walk.

Mauro is an excellent host, I really appreciated that he went out of the way to make sure I had everything. He is very understanding and communicated everything clearly before my arrival. The apartment is very well located and is in excellent conditions. Internet reception is excellent throughout the studio.
Host was always in contact and checking everything was ok. Apartment is simple but has all you need for a short trip. Location excellent for the international community in particular.

Mauro was exceptionally welcoming and supportive during our stay.  The apartment is very well positioned for the UN organisations and is very clean, tidy and organised.  Thanks Mauro for the very warm welcome to the city and for hosting us.  Highly recommended.

Mauro left me the information I needed, as well as keys, etc, and contacted me when I arrived. The apartment is a walking distance from international organisations. It is basic but has everything I needed in order to make my stay comfortable.

The studio was much bigger than I expected (bigger than most 2-bed flats in London), and was very well-equipped. It's just a 10 minute walk to the OMS/WHO UN building, a 5 minute walk to the number 5 bus stop which takes you to the airport in 10 minutes, and there is a good migros grocery store nearby. Mauro was a great host; very helpful and flexible when I had to bring my check-in time forward by a few hours. Thoroughly recommended.
The apartment is really big with beautiful large windows overlooking a grass area. It's close to supermarket and about 15 min walk to the centre. All in all this is excellent value. Thank you Mauro.

Very convenient and well located flat. 10 minutes by bus from the airport and same distance to the main railway station. Also 10 minutes on foot from the UN.
The flat is simple, but it has everything you need and it's a real separate flat. On top of that, Mauro is the perfect host. Helpful and discreet. I'll be back!
Clean and spacious place. Just right for my needs. Easy to get there with the bus from the airport and close to UN.

I had one night in Mauro's flat and it was ideal. It was easy to find, a short walk from the WHO, and it was very clean, spacious and comfy. Whilst I didn't meet Mauro (all was arrange on text) he was very easy to get on touch with and he checked up on me to make sure I had everything I needed. My first air BnB experience and a very good intro!  Thanks a lot Mauro
Tutto perfetto. Appartamento impeccabile, zona tranquilla ma molto comoda vicino alle Agenzie ONU. Padrone di casa preciso e affidabile. Consigliatissimo!
I booked this apartment for colleagues of mine - they have nothing but compliments and told of a wonderful stay.

Seconda volta ospite di Mauro e ancira una volta si e' trattato di un esperienza perfetta. Ospite impeccabile, appartamento ordinato, pulito, molto accogliente ed estremamente ben collegato con il resto della citta in particolare gli Uffici dell'ONU.

Mauro's apartment was exactly what I was looking for. The apartment is very comfortable (sometimes a bit chilly in the evenings, but Mauro has provided extra blankets and throws) and is in an ideal location for reaching UN offices and the airport. Mauro was also very quick to respond and check in now and again to make sure things were fine.

This is a very nice apartment and Mauro is an excellent host. Mauro answered my inquiries promptly and helped me arrange for an early morning taxi to the airport. He provided me with water, coffee, and other basic amenities.

The pictures present the apartment well; it was a very comfortable place to stay. The kitchen is well-equipped, the bed is comfortable, and the internet is strong and fast. The TV includes a variety of channels in different languages; something for most everyone. The apartment is safe and secure. It is in a good location to get downtown or to the UN offices; reasonable walking distance to both areas and on a primary bus route. There are two grocery stores nearby.

I recommend the apartment highly and would hope to stay here again.

Excelente ubicación, muy cerca de Place de Nations, y muy comunicada con transporte publico. La linea 5, a 3 minutos caminando, conecta con el aeroporto y con la ciudad!
El departamento es luminoso, cómodo y limpio.
Acojedora la cocineta, y excelente la maquinita de café Nespresso lista con sus capsulitas para el café de la mañana!
Mauro mandó un mail luego luego para saber si había llegado bien! Super recomendable, sobre todo para quien tenga reuniones de trabajo en Naciones Unidas, OMS, etc.

I finally met him on last day of my visit in Geneva, he was warm and positive person. His flat was neat, clean and cozy, has a big window that could enjoy beautiful blue sky of Geneva. Mauro was  incredibly kind and made sure to return my calls or text messages immediately. The place is exactly as it seems and is a great value for money. Mauro  even had an iron so I could get rid of all the wrinkles in my shirt before my interview. Thanks.

My friends and I stayed 2 days at Mauro's last week for visiting the Motor Show and we couldn't have been happier about our first experience with airbnb. The flat is well located for travelling around the city as well thanks to the public transport links nearby.
Mauro was an incredible host and it's a shame that we didn't manage to meet him in person. He always answered me back within a couple of hours max and gave us suggestions on places to visit too. I'd definitely recommend booking a stay at his place if you're on a budget but still looking for a comfortable solution.

Mauro's studio was great, spacious and very well equipped (including a Nepresso machine and milk for coffee!).  The location was perfect for me, walking distance to the ILO and other UN agencies, as well as to supermarkets. Mauro was also very helpful when I had questions or needed anything.
All went well! Good place and good location. I certainly recommend to anyone going to UN !
Great flat. Perfect location. Mauro is super communicative and made everything easy. A great host.
It was my first visit to Geneva and my first experience with BNB. Thank you Mauro it was greate. If I visit Geneva again I will rent you studio again.
can't comment much because we never met the host, he left the  key for us in the letterbox.

I had a very pleasant stay at Mauro's flat which is perfectly located if you need to be near any of the UN buildings. Mauro responded promptly to all messages and was very helpful. The flat is also very spacious, has plenty of natural light and is comfortable. All in all, I would highly recommend it!

Mauro's place is perfectly located for someone who has to visit daily WHO, ILO, UNAIDS and few other UN offices. There is a small but well supplied shopping centre about 200 metres away and you find always a taxi stationed there.
Altogether mine was a positive experience and I would certainly recommend the place to my friends.

This is a clean, bright and especially well situated flat for anyone requiring proximity to the UN. There is a double bed and the sofa is very comfortable for sleeping too should it be needed. There is also the convenience of self-catering and some key staples in place for the guests' use in the kitchen and in the bathroom. I will be requesting to stay there again.
Very nice place in quiet residential surroundings and great location for UN. Would definitely stay again.

This apartment was perfect for my trip - 15 min walk from the WHO/UN organisations, supermarket nearby, it is a bright and clean apartment in a quiet neighbourhood. Mauro was very communicative and helpful, although we did not meet in person. I would highly recommend it and would certainly stay again if I had reason to be in that part of town.

Mauro was very friendly and accommodating. The studio is perfect for one or two persons and it's in a very nice area. It's about 10 min walking to UN,WHO and other international organizations , there's a supermarket near by in case you need something and it's very quiet. I love how quiet and safe it is.

For the one night I stayed at Mauro's everything was perfect. The house, at walking distance from the Palais des Nations of the United Nations, was beautiful, comfortabel and clean. I could easily find my way around the house.
Great place to stay - and for more than one night
Perfect host

Very Nice place, comfy and well located.
Mauro was very easy to reach, and very helpful all the way before and during the stay.
I would recommend you to stay there without a doubt !
Appartement très tranquille et bien situé à 15 minutes à pied du Palais des Nations et proche de commerces.

Mauro's flat was great - it had everything I needed for my short stay in Geneva. It was very close to both the airport and a short walk the UN agency where I had my meetings.     There was a coop grocery story on the way to/from work, which was terrific.  I would recommend this place to anyone needing a quiet place to stay for a work trip.The studio apartment was spacious and clean.   Great stay overall!

The apartment was just perfect. Clean, spacious, quiet, and lots nice little touches from Mauro with coffee, soap etc in case I needed it.

It's only 10 minutes walk from the UN and a very easy bus ride from the airport.
Very nice host, Mauro is more than welcoming! Nice flat, too big for me alone haha but really a pleasant experience!

I had a very good experience with Mauro, the studio was exactly what I was looking for, clean, warm and very close to UN area.
Highly recommended.

Mauro's apartment was a perfect location up the hill from the UN.  It was clean and included several nice touches like coffee and milk. I hope to visit again!

Mauricio’s home was well located to the lake and train station. A 10 minute nice walk to the old town and close to all the well known shops.
Mauricio checked in with us on several occasions to make sure we had settled and if we needed anything. I would recommend his home.

Great place to stay in Geneva. Very close to Geneva Station and conveniently located a short walk away from both Old Town and Palais des Nations. Mauricio was always quick to answer any questions and was very friendly. Highly recommend

Mauricio est un hôte attentionné qui se soucie de vous proposer un logement propre et soigné. L'entrée dans les lieux est très facile et autonome. L'appartement est calme et bien situé, proche des attractions touristiques.
We had an excellent stay at Mauricio’s place. It is close to the train station and is very walkable. Everything was organized and clean. Highly recommend.

The flat is perfectly located. In the middle of the Pâquis area, walking distance to everything, but facing the inside of the courtyard, so it is very peaceful. The windows are big and bright and the flat is tastefully decorated with nice artwork and real plants. It feels more like a home. The mattress was also very comfortable, so we enjoyed resting as much as working here. The only thing we didn’t like was that there seemed to be cigarette smoke from the other flats coming from the vent in the bathroom. It would be great if the vent could close and open for ventilation when you need to take a shower. But this was a minor issue and other than that we really enjoyed our stay here. Mauricio was also very communicative, responsive and proactive with clear instructions and made sure everything went smoothly.
Super Aufenthalt, gute Lage, alles sauber und einwandfreie Kommunikation.
Great location close to the train station and the lake.

As shown, but tiny, a studio. the “sofa bed” was ok for a child. Nice decor. 5th floor quiet. Elevator worked well. large smart TV on swivel allows viewing from bed. Bathroom nice tub and shower. Area had lots of shops, supermarket for food, and didn’t feel unsafe.
Annoyances: Kitchen was functional but: 1) two Teflon frying pans both terribly scratched (toxic) - should be thrown out, would cost very little to replace; 2) coffee pod machine leaked water on counter when I used it; 3) there was a sugar dispenser, but it was full of salt and ruined my coffee.
Concern: host did not not provide the Geneva tourist free transport card, which covers all local transport for you stay and is required by published Airbnb hosting rules. without it you have to buy expensive daily passes for each

Great location, close to the central train station. Agreed with prior reviews about women on the street - they are definitely there but if you don’t bother them they won’t bother you. Apartment felt secure and overall we enjoyed our stay.

The place was as described and clean but had a lingering smell of smoke. Very nice space, easy to find, close to the train station.             Great fondue place near by that we would highly recommend, Auberge de Savièse.  Make a reservation.

Fantastic flat in a great location. The flat has everything we need and we particularly enjoyed having a bath, large TV, and washing machine and dryer after a week of skiing. André was very accommodating and helpful.

Mauricio was respectful and responsive. He patiently listened to my recommendations about heating. I had a great experience. The dwelling is well kept and everything worked. I recommend this place for a stay in the Geneva city centre. Super appart et très bien situé proche de la gare! Tout le nécessaire à proximité et hôte très flexible et amical!
nous reviendrons probablement !! :)
Très bon propriétaire, réponse rapide, appartement bien situé, recommander cette annonce

If you are looking for a small studio apt, it’s good one.

Very nice clean place in a very central location. Host was responsive and clear with instructions.

muchas gracias por su amabilidad.

My husband and I loved staying here! Geneva is a beautiful city and this Airbnb puts you in walking distance of so many attractions! We had a small issue with the power but Mauricio resolved it so quickly and easily. He was extremely responsive and knowledgeable! We definitely recommend :)

byliśmy bardzo zadowoleni z pobytu. mieszkanie jest bardzo blisko dworca kolejowego, kilka minut spacerem od jeziora Genewskiego. W pobliżu jest dużo sklepów i restauracji. Обязательно порекомендую своим друзьям и коллегам, планирующим визит в Женеву.

The flat is very nice and ideally located for anyone who is visiting the UN or the CICG (conference centre), as both are just a 15 minute walk away. Mauro is a friendly and helpful host.

I had a lovely time in Mauro's flat! I was there for 4 nights, and I found the entire experience delightful. Mauro gave great directions for getting there. It's an easy bus ride from the airport, and it's a short walk to the International Red Cross headquarters where I was working. For a minute when I arrived, I got nervous because it's a big complex of large apartment buildings and parking lots, so I thought it might be too car-centered for my taste, but it turned out to be super easy to get around, especially once I figured out that there were shortcuts out of the apartment complex (stairways through the parking lots out to the street). There are two bus lines that come nearby that can take you to the city center in 15 minutes - and the Geneva bus system works like a dream. And the area of Petit Saconnex turned out to be charming. There is lots of green space and a bio market on the way from Mauro's apartment to the little square where you can find a cute church, a boulangerie, and Cafe du Soleil [great brasserie, nicest people ever, fondue, fresh asparagus dishes, Swiss wines, idyllic terrace]. There is also a grocery store very nearby and Chez Ma Cousin where you can get reasonably priced (for Geneva) takeaway roasted chicken.
The apartment itself was as pictured - simple, but comfortable with lots of natural light. The kitchen is small and might not be suitable for cooking large meals, but who would want to do that?

Thank you for your kind hospitality Luciana.

Un petit appartement charmant, pas traversant, dans un quartier populaire et central de Genève. Luciana est très arrangeante et serviable.

The host has thoughtfully equipped the apartment with everything needed for cooking, daily living, and remote work. The tasteful decorations, attention to detail, and prompt, friendly responses to questions reflect a high level of care and hospitality.

The apartment is very central and close to amenities and transport links, but in quiet residential area surrounded by parks.

Highly recommended - we will certainly try to stay again if we return to Geneva.

The apartment of Caroline is wonderful – spacious and elegant, warm and cozy. I traveled with my family and my kids felt great there. We really enjoyed staying at Caroline’s place. The garden was wonderful for our toddler and the location of the apartment was really convenient.
Caroline and her home are lovely!

The apartment itself had everything that was needed.

We stayed here for 5 weeks. The house was well equipped, it was 100% in line with the photos, we found everything we needed for daily life. It is next to bus stop, easy to reach the center, has supermarkets around. The private garden was lovely with a direct reach to children playground. I strongly recommend this apartment if you have children.
Caroline was helpful with friendly welcome and reachable easily. Only thing that I didn’t like is to have visitors in the house during our stay (2 times) who wanted to see the house before renting - but I could understand and I was informed timely before the visits.

This is a great place to stay with everything you need. Easy to get to the lake, old center and UN. Good transport links and many services. The host is responsive and considerate. It is quiet and set up for work from home. Car park space has a recommended.

Philippe es très cordiale.

Welcome was fine, the host helped me figure out the quickest route to the airport (only 25 min).

Habitación confortable, buena localización y anfitriones amables. Buena experiencia.

Even though I arrived late at night and the neighborhood was dark, the apartment was easy to spot! I didn't get to see Bianca in person, but it was a great place to stay location and price-wise. Good for a quick stay!
Easy and nice stay in Geneva. Recommended for anyone looking to rent a room ;)
Staying at Bianca's was awesome. The place was very cozy. She provided me with all the information needed about sightseeing and public transportation in Geneva. I highly recommend it!
Nice, compact room. Bianca was fast in responding. Close to transport. Perfect for short stays.
Very good.
Cosy room right in the hearth of Geneva. Gare Cornavin is only a few minutes walk. The place is clean and the hosts are very friendly. I would definitely recommend Bianca's place!
I only spent one night at Bianca's but everything was as advertised so I was very happy. Great location near the central train station.

I didn't stay at Biancas place myself, I booked for a friend who stayed there one night and everything went well! Thank you!

The room is spacious and we'll furnished. I didn't find the bed particularly comfortable. A little too soft. The location is perfect. You can walk everywhere and there are lots of shops within a couple hundred meters.

Bon accueil par Bianca et son frere, bien qu'ils restent tres discrets le reste du temps; La chambre était tres bien, au calme. Le reste de l'appartement etait tres propre.

Bon accueil de Bianca, tout s’est bien passé. Everything went well at Bianca’s. She and her brother are very quiet and discreet as above-mentioned. The open door policy is also true, although I locked it at night before going to bed. Things were just as advertised. Bianca communicated very well with me in the short interactions we had for my one-night stay; I was there for a conference. She also shared all useful information prior to my arrival in Geneva including directions and tramway itinerary. Her entire place was very clean, and my bedroom was almost the same but not quite. I would do it again and I would also recommend it.

The room was perfect for what I needed. Also the apartment was quite well located with plenty of local supermarkets and other shops nearby, transport connections around the corner and only 15 mins walk to the city centre. Would recommend for a break in Geneva.

Stayed there several times and always everything was good. Clean room, good location.

Really nice !

Parfait, je recommande ! Chambre, appartement impeccables et hôte discret.

logement bien situe par rapport aux transports publics et aux differentes comodites.

Close to Cornavin Train station, and the room is clean and comfortable.
I recommend Bianca's place to any traveler.

bianca e il compagno sono gentili e anche se parlano solo francese cercano di comunicare e metterti a tuo agio. la stanza è confortevole

Apartamento está em uma zona residencial bem conectada com a ONU, lago e centro - 15 min de cada um. O proprietário vive com sua filha no apartamento e é reservado, mas ajuda no que precisar.

Appartement placé dans un quartier calme et sympathique. Accueil chaleureux et respectueux de l'intimité du voyageur. Je recommande vivement ce logement, spécialement pour des individus qui ne connaissent pas bien la ville!
Séjour de qualité. Je conseille le logement de Bianca pour les voyageurs qui ne connaissent pas Genève! ( placé juste à côté de la gare, wifi fonctionnel, accueil chaleureux.)
Phillipe was professional and responsive. Although we arrived late he welcomed us well and checked us in

Excelente, mostró mucha atención y fue muy amable, buen lugar cerca del aeropuerto!!

Staying at Philippe’s was great. Was nice and cozy. It’s very close to the airport which makes the location perfect.

tutto molto bene, philippe molto gentile e rapido nelle comunicazioni, appartamento solo un po’ in disordine

Notre séjour chez Philippe s’est très  bien passé. Nous avons été très bien accueillis. Chambre conforme à l ́annonce.
