Xavier's place will exceed your expectations, it is well located, well furnished and is beautifully decorated. The apartment was much larger than I was expecting also, the pictures cannot show how lovely and spacious it is.

An absolutely  beautiful place decorated with the taste and detail of a collector. Excellent lighting, spotlessly clean, pleasant aromas, even a Christmas tree! Very well equipped and in a convenient location only a few hundred meters from the train station, and many nice restaurants in the area. Communication was easy and responsive through WhatsApp. I would definitely stay here again.

Xavier's place is simply gorgeous. One of the better places I have stayed. It is clearly a home and it wonderfully put together. Very stylish. I wish I had these interior decorating skills.
The place is well located to the tram and a simple train ride in from the airport. Surrounded by restaurants. Easy walk across the water into the central city.
As a penthouse apartment, plenty of light through the windows and very comfortable.
It would not be possible for me to recommend this place highly enough.
I had a great stay! Absolutely loved the taste of my host! Communication has been easy and lovely as well.

I had a perfect experience, from the booking, arrival, stay and check out. Xavier's apartment is beautiful, clean, and peaceful. Very conveniently located. Xavier was a wonderful, kind and generous host, providing everything I needed. I highly recommend a visit to Xavier's place.
Best Airbnb I've ever seen in Geneva. A really homey, comfortable, elegant, and lovely space with everyone you could ask for. High quality linens, toiletries etc. Strongly recommend.

Xavier’s apartment is a gem. Perfect location for meeting or to explore Geneva. The apartment is beautifully and carefully decorated, wonderful amenities, super responsive host and has everything one could need. Beautiful views and light and a perfect setup.  One of my best Airbnb ever!

This is a BRILLIANT apartment. I stayed there for six nights and could have stayed six months.
The place is so beautiful but peaceful too, “at home”. I felt very comfortable very quickly. It’s close to everything but not too noisy. With windows on two sides you get great cross-breeze and it’s an incredible design.
The restaurants underneath are surprisingly good - I ate at three of them (Vietnamese; Chinese;Indian ) and each time was pleasantly surprised at how good they were.
Super close to station, supermarkets close by. It had a cool “locals” vibe to it. Not sterile but I never felt remotely unsafe.
Javier is an angel. Super clear, super responsive.
The apartment has everything. More than any other place, I felt privileged to rent it as it’s got Javier’s soul in it.
I would return in an instant. Wonderful wonderful wonderful place

I would confidently bet there's no other place like Xavier's in Geneva. The moment you enter the place, suddenly you forget the hustle-n-bustle of life outside and are transported to something heavenly in an instant. If zen, peacefulness, mindfulness, neatness, and comfort is your thing, Xavier's is all about that. The place is full of character as in the descriptions and entertains both the eyes and mind. You are not just staying at a place, you are living it. Xavier is a wonderful host- friendly, fun, and super responsive, andmakes your journey to the city already a pleasant one. I am only grateful for this superb Airbnb experience. Would happily return!

Excelente pareja de anfitriones... me sentí en casa.
La ubicacion perfecta para vistar Ginebra y para combinacines de bus(la parada esta a 150 metros escasos).

Muy recomendable,incluso por el precio.

C'était un grand plaisir de rester chez Faes. C'est un couple absolument adorable! Je me suis sentie vraiment bienvenue!
Merci beaucoup pour votre gentillesse et votre aide :)
À très bientôt !

My roommate and I took some tickets to Geneva spontaneously for a weekend but we couldn't find a place to stay until the morning we left. Fortunately, Faes left us a message less than an hour after we submitted the request to tell us that he and his girlfriend would host us for the night! It was really nice of them to accept our last-minute reservation, and also both are really kind people! They gave us some pieces of advice to get around in the city and what to see. They have a view of the Jet d'Eau, and if you are lucky enough, you can even see a rainbow from the window while you are eating the delicious breakfast they made. Their apartment is also in a nice neighborhood with a lot of restaurants and bars and it's only a 5-minute walk from Geneva lake or a shopping mall.
We would definitely come back to Geneva at their place!

A very warm and friendly welcome. I felt at home.
Thank you, Faes , thank you Anna !

Such a nice couple to stay with! They were very sweet people who made me feel welcome in Geneva. They cooked traditional swiss food and seemed enthusiastic about helping me learn what swiss culture is all about. They gave great direction to the apartment and were more than willing to help provide me with anything I needed while I was there. Great couple!!

Had a very good stay.  I needed an early check in and Faes was extremely helpful in accommodating that.  They even woke up early to make sure I woke up when I intended and fix breakfast.  Things to be aware of - that it is an efficiency apartment and while I'm sure it's large by Geneva standards if you're used to US sizes it's more moderate.  There is a screen so that you're not staring at them as you try to go to sleep.  The futon was large and comfortable to me.  This stay fit my needs exactly.

Un lugar bueno para quedarse el fin de semana. Ubicado en el puro centro de la ciudad (muy buena locación) Las camas son cómodas, el apartamento limpio y ordenado y los anfitriones muy atentos a la comodidad de los hospedados. Me pareció una buena experiencia aunque sea un cuarto compartido con los anfitriones. Son muy respetuosos y están a tu disposición.

Awesome couple, provided clean towels and sheets. Went the extra mile and provided breakfast and warm clothes. Very welcoming. Comfortable bed and great experience/location. Small apartment, but perfect for a short trip to Geneva!

Bon accueil ,bon lit, couple très sympathique et discret.
Bon endroit pour une nuit sur Genève à un prix raisonnable.
Très bien desservie pour l aéroport et la gare.
Faes and his girl friend are friendly. They told us much about traveling in Geneva and Montreux, really helpful. We enjoy the stay ~ The location is near the city center

My partner and I stayed with faes and his girlfriend for 2 nights. They are a lovely couple who go that extra mile to make you feel welcomed and comfortable during your stay. Very clean and provided us with clean towels and a lovely breakfast both mornings.
Faes was also very flexible regarding checking in.
The apartment is close to the city centre.
Perfect for a night or two in Geneva of you're comfortable with sleeping in the same room as your hosts.
Thank you faes.

My friend and I spent one night in Geneva in Faes and Anna's flat. It was a great experience, they are really nice people and the place is really clean. And the location of the flat is also nice,it is close to the old town and there is supermarket just 5 minutes away. Highly recommended.

The location is quite good: near the train station and also shopping street!!! The couple is really nice to us!!! They help us figure out the wifi problem and also offer to makes us some food!!   Also the sleeping sofa is quite comfortable. we really enjoy our stay here and highly recommend this place to everyone:)

J'ai passé une nuit au domicile de Faes et Anna , le canapé - lit est très correct . une expérience que je renouvellerai sans hésiter en pareil circonstance . Ce couple charmant vous reçoit et partagent avec vous leurs connaissances sur cette belle ville de Genève . Ils se plieront en 4 pour rendre votre séjour agréable dans un climat amical et chaleureux . A recommander sans hésitation . Merci à vous deux .

we spent two nights in Faes' house. It was really an unforgettable experience!!! This couple did everything they could to help us and treated us extremely well!!  I sincerely hope that those who travel to Geneva should really consider spending your time in this couple's room!!!

It was my first time in Geneva so was a bit daunted about safety and getting around. However before I even arrived Faes was giving me all the advice and reassurance I needed. They were kind enough to meet me at the bus stop when I arrived in the pouring rain. Both are lovely and warm and make you feel immediately comfortable. Anna is a great cook and it was really nice to have dinner with them in the evening after being so tired. I was apprehensive it would be a small place but there is a screen and you get a good amount of privacy. I actually learnt a lot about geneva from them and they always willing to assist you. I would definitely stay again on another visit.

When we arrive early, Anna happened to see us downstairs. She asked whether we were the ones going to stay in their place. We felt so warm because that day was rainy and we wanted to go inside the apartment so bad. During our stay, they made us feel very comfortable like we were home and treat us some snack.
After Faes came back home, we chatted a little and had a great time.
We like it there. The sofa bed was comfortable then I expected!

When I arrived Faes and his girlfriend were very welcoming and excited to have me. Their positive and bright attitude towards guest is something very welcoming. They were very gracious and would teach me about where to visit in Geneva (also made sure I don't get lost and remember where to go :D).
The apartment is nicely located near the center of the city AND the lake which means you can get to both of them very easily. In fact if you want a walk after a nice Fondue dinner at home made by Faes, you can take a walk to the lake which takes 6 - 8 minutes by walk.
Also, Faes has recently introduced a special Fondue dinner (15 Franc per person) if you are interested in Swiss fondue but are afraid of the high prices in the restaurants. I highly recommend trying it and be sure to have it warm tea.
10/10 would recommend this apartment because it is conveniently located in the city and near the lake and Faes and his girlfriend is just a pleasant company to be with if you are on a long trip.
The place was clean and our hosts were kind. There isnt alot of privacy.

Les deux jours passé chez Faes fut très agréable ils nous ont acueilli très chaleureusement le logement n'est pas tres grand mais nous nous sentions comme chez nous je vous les recommande le logement est aussi très bien situé  dans genève il est près de tous nous n'avons pas eux besoin de prendre le transport en comun :)
Nice couples! They are so kind and helpful. choose them! You will like it!

Faes was really kind with us, we stayed for only one night, but the shared room is really comfortable and well located. He prepared a breakfast for just 4 CHF each. We would come back again, and we recommend it.

Faces and his girlfriend were very welcoming and accommodating. They welcomed us into their apartment at late notice, despite us arriving in Geneva fairly late in the evening! They offered us a drink, and made us feel comfortable and welcome. Thanks! :)

The location was convenient, which was not far away from bus stop and there were supermarkets nearby. The room was not big but really lovely and clean. We slept on the comfortable sofa bed just beside their bed, with a screen as separation. Faes was really welcoming and helpful. He provided Swiss cheese fondue and breakfast for us at cheap price. Though we just stayed for one night, Faes and us shared a great time in chatting about our cultures and learning languages! Thanks for the warm stay! :)

Faes and his girlfriend lives in a beautiful neighborhood! It's an easy 5-7 minute walk to the lake and you can even see the Jet from the apartment. Though my friends and I spent very little time in the apartment, Faes was very accommodating and friendly. The room is shared with a divider in between, but my friends and I had no problem. Great first stay at an airbnb!

The position was good (supermarkets in the nearby, in the city center, a park just around the corner...).
The apartment was small, but Faes is very kind polite and you can have your rest.

Good location which was about 15-20mins walk to the city centre, and also probably one of the cheapest options for accommodation that you can get in Geneva. The shared living space and kitchen were kinda small, but Faes and his girlfriend were very accommodating and did their best to make our stay comfortable.
Recommended if you're travelling on a budget, and do not mind sleeping in shared spaces. Their 5franc breakfast was decent too, considering that most breakfast options in Geneva cost much more.

A very friendly couple who are respectful and nice. We had a pleasant time staying with them. Their neighborhood is very nice and central; you can get to any area of the city very easily. Although their space is small and shared, it is cozy. I recommend!

Faes is a very kind person and was a wonderful host. He was very accommodating and friendly. The shared space was clean and cozy, and was located just a short walk from the Old Town or the jet d'eau. Great location, host, and space.

My friends and I had a great experience spending a night at Faes' apartment. The location was great, a short walk to the lake and under 10 minute bus ride from the Geneva train station. Faes was extremely friendly and accommodating. Would definitely stay here again!

The hosts are very nice and friendly. The room is clean and the bed is comfortable. If you sleep very late, you may need to keep your voice down as it could disturb the host's sleeping time. Other than that, I would recommend staying at this place! = ]

My sister and I recently had a lovely stay with Faes and his girlfriend. Both were nice and incredibly easy to get along with. It was overall a great experience as the apartment was conveniently located close to the jet d'eau which we visited.

Thank you again for having us. If I return to Geneva some day I will be sure to stay with you both again! :)

This was my first experience with airbnb and it was a great one thanks to Faes and Anna! They were the kindest hosts and very helpful with giving my friend and I advice of what to do in Geneva. The location of their apartment is fantastic! They got back to me right away when I would message them. I would definitely recommend staying with them!

Faes and Anna are very kind and welcoming. The house is small, but my
two cousins and I never felt uncomfortable. The location is also great,
close to everything and you can see the fountain from their kitchen window.
Also, we forgot a bag at the apartment and Faes was very helpful and mailed
it to the States for us. I would definitely recommend staying in this
apartment.

It was a joy to love with Faes! They were a very sweet couple and assisted whenever needed, such as finding the best transportation to the airport and such. Their apartment was small (so I think the best and most comfortable would be for 2ppl, but 3 worked out just as well), but the bed is comfortable and the place is very clean and comfy!

Geneva is a beautiful but expensive city. If you want to make it affordable, staying with Faes and Anna is a great way to go. Just a few blocks from the Jet D'eau, their apartment is ideally located (you can see it out their window!) They are both so nice and friendly and had many helpful suggestions. The wifi signal is strong which has been rare in our travels in Switzerland and France.  Thanks Faes and Anna!

Me ha gustado mucho alojarme con Faes y su novia, han sido muy amables y considerados.
A pesar de que es un cuarto es compartido, se tiene mucha libertad y privacidad.
La ubicación es genial, muy cerca del lago.
Faes was a great host and accommodated my late check in timing. It is a pity I had to leave early the next morning! The apartment has a nice view of the jet!

If you are looking for a budget accomodation in Geneva and do not mind to have the shared room with host, I would suggest you to Faes house, the location is good, it takes 20 mins to the station by foot which is quite convenient to us.

Faes and Anna were very kind; communication was very prompt and easy. Anna was very kind to serve us tea and cake, and provided good information about Geneva. If you don't mind sharing a room with them both, this is the ideal pace for you as it is conveniently located and is considerably reasonably priced for Geneva. Thanks Faes and Anna!

My cousin and I just loved this place and especially the hosts. They are wonderful people who are extremely kind, helpful, accommodating, amazing, etc. etc. The location of the apartment is perfect, walking distance to pretty much everything. We have no complaints. Much love and many thanks to the hosts

Faes and his girlfriend were very kind with me and I was very lucky to have this couple as a guest house. I felt like home! Everything was ready for me when I arrived....just on time to watch the world cup match Germany v. Brazil ! Unforgettable ! I truly recommend to book this place for a visit in Geneva. Furthermore, the area was nice and safe. Just love it!
The one shared room is a bit right for 3 people, especially if you have a lot of luggage, but the location was great and the hosts were kind and helpful!

It is an very good experience to live in this apartment for 8 months. I am an intern in United Nations and start to live here since September 2014. I feel comfortable and convenient to live here.

Location:
It is convenient to go everywhere on foot (1 min to bus stop 31 December, gym, and post office, 3 min to supermarket, 5 min to lake, 10 min to go shopping). Here is an amazing Chinese restaurant which is 100 meters from the apartment.

Environment:
The apartment locate in residential area. Therefore it is really quiet and safe. Meanwhile the neighbors are also quiet so that I can not hear any noise. Besides that, the view outside is good. I can see the fountain which is the symbol of Geneva.

In addition, the host Ana is a very nice lady. She is warm and happy to help me whenever I have problems. And she rarely live here. I meet her one or two times a week. So normally I have the whole apartment. She informs me a day in advance before she comes to the apartment so I didn't get any ''surprise'' from her.

All in all, it is a very good apartment for ladies who work in Geneva.

我联合国实习，从实习开始在这儿住了八个月。房子很不错。
地理位置很好。因为是居民区，所以很安全且安静，基础设施完善，生活很方便。从这儿走路一分钟到公车站，邮局和健身房，三分钟到超市，五分钟到湖边，十分钟到购物的地方。大概一百米的地方有个中餐馆，强烈推荐。

周边环境也很棒。因为是居民区，所以很安全且安静。邻居也很安静，不开party，基本感觉不到他们的存在。房间外面的景色很棒，可以看到日内瓦的标志－－喷泉，以及远处的山。

另外，房东Ana人超好，特别热情而且热心。虽然租房子时候说要和她同住，但是她基本不在这住。每个月大概会来一到两次，每次一到两天。所以觉得这个价格租一个独立的公寓很合适。

总之这个公寓很适合来日内瓦实习的女生们，位置方便安全价格也不贵。强烈推荐。
Highly recommended!

Location
The apartment is very accessible to go everywhere by bus. It just 10 min by bus no.9 to Cornavin station without change. You can go supermarket or pharmacy in 2 min by walk. Additionally, you can go "Lac Leman" in 5 min by walk.

Room
The room is very clean. All equipments are good condition. There has cooking utensils and dishes, so you can cook easily. There also has dish washer, it is very convinient. Additionally, you can see "jet d'eau" from the big window. It is very nice scenery.

Others
Ana is very nice woman. She comes back the apartment 3-4 days per month. We have a great time. Sometimes we have dinner and walk around the lake together. Faes is also very kind person. He is so helpful.




立地
街の中心部に位置しており、交通アクセスは良好です。コルナバン駅から、9番のバスに乗れば、乗り換えなしで約１0分で到着します。アパートの徒歩圏内に、スーパーや薬局もあり、生活に不自由することはありません。
また、徒歩５分でジュネーブの名所であるレマン湖に行くことができ、気軽に散歩を楽しめます。

部屋
掃除が行き届いており、非常に清潔です。部屋の設備に不備もありません。食器や調理用具もそろっており、料理しやすい環境です。また、食器洗浄機があり、便利でした。部屋には、大きな窓があり、ジュネーブ名物jet d'eauを望むことができます。

その他
月に3－4日帰ってくるアナは、とても優しくて親切な人です。時々、一緒に夕食を食べたり、散歩したりしました。一緒に住んでいた時間は、とても楽しい思い出です。また、Faesもとても優しい方でした。

My stay in this apartment was great! Faes and Ana were very helpful, accommodating, and responsive. The apartment itself is a good size, clean, and very centrally located. It's also very nice to look out of your window and see the Jet d'Eau! Would definitely recommend staying here.
Again - Faes´s place is great!

Faes´ place was great! I would stay here again. The neighbourhood is really nice, quiet and by the lake. The apartment is close to public transport. Faes and his girlfriend where sweet, and easy to get a hold on if I had any questions.

I enjoy my stay at Faes' apartment. He and his girlfriend are very nice people. They do their best to make sure my stay is comfortable. Faes replies to my messages quickly. The neighborhood is quite and safe. I would recommend Faes' apartment and this couple.

Les photos sont fidèles à la réalité.
L' appartement est superbe. Tout est prévu pour qu’on s’y sente bien.

Christine est très accueillante. Nous avons beaucoup apprécié le soin avec lequel elle nous reçu a dans son appartement.

On recommande cette location.
I stayed with Raphael and Bianca for the second time so this speaks for itself.
很完美
Nice place that I would recommend for sure. Nice and cooperative host
Chambre et parties communes très propres. emplacement idéal à 12 minutes de l'aéroport en bus.

Extremely poor communication. Very small room. Extreme problems with door lock. Had a coffee maker in the kitchen and I was rationed one coffee pod for my stay…. Coffee maker didn’t work.
Was the low point of my European holiday.
Nothing to add
Logement propre, à proximité des transports en commun. L’accès à une cuisine est pratique, un réel point positif.

If you are looking for a no fuss place close to the city attractions for a night or two then this is just the place for you!
I had some issues-
A) the room was tidy but I think it hadn’t been aired in a while, I get allergy (a cold) if a room is dusty and I still recovering with a stuffy nose!
B) This is just my personal take: the hosts keep sending “rules” of the house with a lot of their messages. I think once or twice is okay but the constant reminder makes you feel unwelcome. Also all the post it notes on stove, fridge, cupboards etc with “do not use” also creates an unwelcome vibe
C) You cannot use the stove to cook! But there is a microwave so that might be okay for some people
All these are relatively minor things ( apart from the need for airing the room may be). I guess it’s not the place if you want a home like or a cozy experience but if you are looking for cheap well located no fuss place- go for it!
Everything was OK. Position excellent, extremely close to tram station.
Great experience. Clean and comfortable.
I was very satisfied with my stay, would consider staying in the same place the next time too.

Raphael y Bianca me brindaron instrucciones claras para la llegada a su alojamiento. El lugar estaba limpio y ordenado. La habitación coincide totalmente con el anuncio. La ubicación es buena para llegar rápidamente a la zona céntrica de la ciudad y ayuda mucho la tarjeta de transporte que incluyen gratuitamente. Volvería a alojarme con ellos.

Logement idéalement situé, et un hôte réactif qui seras réponde à vos demandes !
Je recommande
Raphael and Bianca are great hosts. Timely communication and able to assist when they can. Happy with the flexible early check in and dor the transport card. Had a great stay.
Nice room, near the city Center and the train station
感觉还可以 交通很便利，坐公共交通就可以直接到达。公寓也十分醒目，易于找到。房间大小挺合适的，也很安静，洗浴设施什么的很齐全，我非常高兴能够在这里度过一个愉快的圣诞假期。
Was a wonderful evening in Geneva thanks to the team, and thoughtful approach which made this a top choice.
Merci à Raphael et Bianca pour leurs instructions très claires et la flexibilité d’entrée/sortie. La chambre est très propre et l’appartement très bien situé
It is good
great
Thank you for hosting me

Fiquei apenas uma noite mas o apartamento era limpo, fácil de encontrar, com ótimo checkin, e uma localização privilegiada, próximo a tudo e com estação de transporte perto. A comunicação com anfitrião correu muito bem. Apenas senti falta de um espaço para deixar a bolsa enquanto não era possível o checkin (acaba sendo uma prática comum entre airbnbs que recebem viajantes mochileiros). Mas a noite foi ótima, roupa de cama e cama muito bons. Recomendo e com certeza voltaria a ficar hospedada.
Good value for money stay
Fantastic location and especially good if you have an early flight as it's only 15-20 minutes from the airport by public transport. Very clean inside and felt secure.
Good place to stay. Close to train station and clean, organized rooms. Good communication provided by hosts.
Everything was okay
Great location. Supermarket/restaurants nearby

Nice, calm, and clean.. basics are provided.
Just one thing you may notice: some of the furniture needs fixing :)
Otherwise all good, and compared to price m. I would book again
It was a great stay and a perfect walking distance to pretty much anywhere I wanted to go. I would highly recommend staying here.
Great place if you just need a place to sleep for a few days in geneva.

I had an amazing experience at this Airbnb in Geneva! The apartment was beautifully designed, clean, and equipped with everything I needed for a comfortable stay. The location was perfect—just a short walk from the lake and close to public transport, making it easy to explore the city.
I particularly appreciated the little touches, like fresh towels and coffee provided for guests.
I highly recommend this place for anyone visiting Geneva.
Comfortable room in excellent position. Public transportation card is absolutely useful to move in the Geneva area. Communications via AirBnb extremely fast. Recommended.

El cuarto es sencillo pero cómodo, con una cama confortable y un escritorio. Baño compartido como anunciado, limpio y todo muy bien.
El día que me quede hacia mucho calor y el cuarto parecía un horno. Tenía un ventilador pero no A/C. Las ventanas ño tienen cortinas, solo un “blinder” que no dejaba el aire dejar entrar por la noche, por lo que podría ser un buen adición tener unos cortinas..
Apartment super clean, good localization, quick answer! Recommend it!
Good value for money and well connected. The room and the bathrooms were clean.
Una estancia muy agradable, bastante pacífica y cómoda.
とても清潔で、居心地が良かったです！Geneveに滞在する方にはおすすめです。
Nice

The place is in very central. The room might be really hot during the summer. Since they don't have AC you need to sleep while the vantilator is on which is really loud. I never met any of the land lords that in the profile. They're not living in the apartment. Overall very central place, it's an old building and the apartment is also quite old.
le logement est proche du centre ville et de la gare aussi beaucoup des moyens du transport pour profiter de la ville merveilleuse de Genève.

Estupenda experiencia. Me facilitaron la tarjeta de transporte y en pocos minutos estás en el lago con el transporte público, que justo pasa por delante de la casa. El baño está genial, un sitio tranquilo ideal para poder descansar de un día de turismo. Gracias!

Todo fue muy fácil, desde encontrar el apartamento hasta hablar con la señora.
Creo que es un edificio con muy poco aislamiento por lo que se escucha mucho a los vecinos. A mí me tomó algo de tiempo dormirme. Por lo demás, estuvo bien, solo fui a dormir.
No puedo hacer comentarios con respecto a la cocina porque ni sé cómo era.
El baño estaba bastante limpio.

Excelente estancia. La cercanía a la estación del tranvía y al centro de la ciudad fue excelente. Es fácil llegar y te aprendes el camino al centro el primer día. El cuarto es perfecto para llegar a dormir y tengo que decir que el colchón y la almohada son muy cómodos.
Chambre en parfait état, et logement très bien chauffé. Ambiance tranquille avec les autres voyageurs. Cuisine un peu vieillissante, mais fonctionnelle.
Vraiment très bien comme d’habitude
Logement confortable, calme et proche de toutes les commoditès. merci !

host incredibili, molto educati, professionali e incredibilmente precisi. Tutte le indicazioni fornite sono state chiare, trasparenti e utili. L'esperienza di check in è stata intuitiva e semplice. La descrizione corrispondeva a quanto riportato nell'annuncio. Camera e bagno trovati molto puliti. Segnalo anche che mi è stata data la Geneva Transport Card che ha facilitato la mia esperienza in città

Logement correspond à la description et aux photos, calme et paisible, bon emplacement par rapport aux transports en communs, propriété au top. J’ai passé un bon séjour, recommandé pour un séjour reposant. Merci pour cet endroit agréable
Responsive hosts. Located near several facilities. Had a nice stay. 😄

Christine’s flat truly exceeded my expectations. As a regular in Geneva I have had many opportunities to stay in various Airbnb’s. This recent experience was my first time staying in Christine’s apartment and it won’t be my last. This was without question the most comfortable stay I’ve had in an Airbnb. The apartment is centrally located between Rive and Eaux-Vives, the best part of the city to stay in whether a tourist or here on business. The surrounding area is populated with restaurants, shopping, banks and an amazing farmers market in Wednesday’s and Saturday’s just one block away. You also have easy access to practically every bus line in the city.
Prior to my arrival in Geneva Christine was absolutely wonderful in making sure everything was prepared and communicating to make sure all requests/needs were met. Instructions were easy to follow and any questions were answered in a very timely manner. Access was very simple even tho Christine was out of town when I arrived in Geneva, all thanks to the thought put into the instructions provided. Once I accessed the unit I was so impressed to see how much time and effort was put into the space. The unit is organized, clean, and completely updated with new appliances and an HVAC system. I had all the necessary items to cook, make coffee, and store groceries. There is a modern stove, dishwasher, refrigerator and appliances to go with it. As you enter the living area you have a comfortable sofa, chair and flat screen TV with adjacent instructions to set up internet (which was a very good speed). Next to the living room you have a lovely terrace to enjoy morning coffee or that crisp fresh Swiss air. The master bedroom is spacious with the most comfortable bed I’ve slept on in an Airbnb. The second bedroom had a single bed and while the bedroom was smaller it still serves its purpose (note that I did not use this bedroom). The beds were professionally made unlike many of the experiences I’ve had in the past with Airbnb and resembled that of a 5 star hotel. The rooms were quiet at night and dark providing for deep and comfortable sleep.
The bathroom was comfortable and shower had great water pressure. All basic amenities were included and the towels were larger than standard. There is also a really nice warming rack you can turn on to heat your towels before hopping into the shower. Once you’re ready to replace towels there is a new washer/dryer with ample space to get towels and clothing cleaned.
All in all, this was simply a fantastic stay. Now I just have to finalize dates for my next trip to Geneva so I can make sure to book Christines place again!

Очень хорошая, просторная квартира. Отличное месторасположение непосредственно в центре города. Замечательная хозяйка. Все вопросы быстро решались. Спасибо за  гостеприимство.

Квартира находится недалеко от аэропорта и старого города в очень удобном расположении, тк рядом есть как автобусные так и трамвайные остановки. Недалеко есть отличный ТЦ «COOP city” , с огромным супермаркетом и хорошим фуд-кортом.  Сама квартира находится на 5м этаже и обустроена полностью, чтобы комфортно себя чувствовать.  Хозяйка всячески помогала советами и всегда была на связи. Рекомендую.
The apartment is really cute and super well located. The communication with Lena was really easy. I strongly recommend.

Lena’s place was absolutely wonderful I highly recommend it. The location is perfect and flat is beautiful I will miss it!! Thank you also Lena for the warm welcome and instructions upon my arrival, I will gladly stay again!
Lena’s apartment is a great place to stay, in a perfect location. Highly recommended!
Agréable séjour chez Lena, logement idéalement située au cœur de la ville, spacieux confortable et calme. Parfait pour découvrir la ville de Genève. Merci à Lena pour son accueil.

Séjour au top !
Léna est très accueillante et disponible, l’appartement est idéalement situé et très agréable à vivre avec beaucoup d’espace.
Je ne peux que le recommander 👍🏻

Geräumige Wohnung in 19.-Jhd.-Bau mitten im Zentrum von Genf in kurzer Distanz zur Altstadt. Gut ausgestattete Küche, abgesehen von gelegentlichem Partylärm war es ruhig und wir haben gut geschlafen. Alles zu Fuss oder mit kurzen ÖV-Fahrten erreichbar. Auto wegen chronischem Stau komplizierter, aber mit Tages-Macarons in Aussenquartieren (20 Fr.) und 90-Min.-Parkplätzen vor dem Haus mit Parking-Apps machbar. Wir hatten einen schönen, erlebnisreichen Aufenthalt, den wir mit einem Bad im Lac Léman abschlossen.
Nice little appartement in the center of Geneva. Convenient for shopping, close to the lake and other things to see and do in the city. Lena was a great host with easy communication

I couldn’t have asked for a better experience in Geneva. The apartment is in a great location, it gives off a genuine Geneva vibe and Lena is the best host. She was super accommodating towards our needs, which really made our long trip easier. We stayed for five days, but the apartment is large enough to where you wouldn’t feel cramped on longer stays. I’d recommend this place to anybody traveling to Geneva.
Very comfortable, great location, excellently equipped and friendly host!

Lena’s flat is cozy, spacious with lots of light, and perfectly situated in the city center. It has everything you could need for a short or long stay. She is such a communicative and kind host—honestly, I can’t imagine a better place to stay in Geneva. Thank you Lena!!!

Excellent location, very comfortable and nice flat, and Lena is a terrific host. Everything was perfect for me and the fact that the flat is on 4th floor means it is quiet at night to sleep properly. I would definitely stay here again on the next visits to Geneva.

Perfectly located, nice apartment. Uncomplicated, direct communication with Lena. The apartment is very close to the lake and the old town, some good restaurants, and bar just in walking distance. Perfect choice to explore Geneva.

Lena is a great host! She communicated timely with details and provided support during our stay. Apartment is charming, clean and located in the great area. We enjoyed our stay and definitely will come back again. We recommend this place!
Fabulous place. It was delightful to spend time in such a graceful building and. comfortable apartment. The location is brilliant.
Lena’s place is great! Very attractive and central location. The apartment is spacious and well-equipped. Would certainly recommend!

We loved our stay at Lena's. The apartment is conveniently located to pretty much everything you'd want to see. It was very clean and comfortable and just as advertised. Lena was very helpful, showing us around when we arrived and giving us a lot of helpful suggestions about dining and other things. I'd definitely stay here again.

Wonderfully situated if you want to be centrally located on the left bank of Geneva. One can get by foot to most places in the center in a matter of minutes. Only issue we had is that there’s no elevator and we had to cart up big heavy suitcases 4 floors up.
Maximum satisfied with this stay, Lena is a great host and  I can warmly recommend this apartment located in city center, but quiet and very comfortable!

Cute little apartment, in a great location: short walking distance to everything. However this also means that sleeping with open windows in the summer is difficult as it can get noisy during the night. It is not worse than whit is to be expected in the city, just be aware.
Appartement idéalement placé! Au centre ville, entre le lac et la vieille ville. Appartement spacieux et agréable pour y passer des vacances.
Everything was perfect- communication with Elena was great and the apartment is very nice, spacious and located in a perfect spot! Thank you for everything!

I’ve stayed in Lena’s apartment twice now and both times have been spectacular. The space is clean, bright, and very homey, as well as being centrally located. It also has everything you need for a long stay (both times I was there 6 weeks). Lena is also a kind, responsive host, always there if you need anything. Thank you Lena!!
Fantastic location. Very charming apartment. Great host. I would definitely book again.

Great apt and wonderful host! The location of this apartment is perfect. The bus station is very close and the train station is about 15 mins walk if you don’t want to take the bus. There are many walkable restaurants and attractions too. The place was spotless and had everything you might need. Lena was very helpful and responsive. Highly recommend!

Absolute favorite of all the Airbnb’s I’ve stayed in near or in Geneva’s Old Town. Felt like a real home, beautiful, spacious, fully equipped and well-stocked kitchen, large living-room. Would be a perfect place for an extended stay.
As central as you can get, one block from Rive. We were there during a cold spell in December and the heating was warm and lovely.
Lena was very friendly and accommodating and I look forward to staying with her again next time I’m in town.
Note: was not an issue for us at all, but it’s on the 4th floor and there is no elevator.
Very spacious apartment in the centre of Geneva! Nice host and good neighborhood! I would like to stay there again.
Great place and great host.  I will definitely come back. Thank you, Lena!

The place is centrally located and is a walking distance from almost all the attractions in Geneva. Lena is very friendly and responsive and has been very easy to reach. The place itself is cozy and clean and has all one needs.

Lena's flat is in an old-style Geneva build. It's clean, functional and quiet, with a large, well-equipped kitchen and a good-sized living room. Communication with Lena was smooth and clear. It was just the environment and service I needed for an intensive working week in the city.

Appartement plein centre de Genève avec chambre donnant sur l'arrière, très calme. Au 4eme étage sans ascenseur, pas de problème si on est en forme. Des boutiques, commerces et restaurants tout proches.
Lena est très accueillante et très réactive. Nous n'avons eu aucun souci dans cet appartement chaleureux et agréable. Tout s'est très bien passé et si nous revenons à Genève, nous espérons bien revenir chez Lena.

Ich habe die Wohnung für meine Eltern gemietet, die beruflich in Genf waren. Die Wohnung liegt sehr zentral, die Innenstadt ist zu Fuss gut erreichbar, und die Wohnung ist gut an den öffentlichen Verkehr angebunden. Es war sauber und ruhig, meine Eltern haben sich sehr wohl gefühlt. Lena war immer gut erreichbar, äusserst freundlich und entgegenkommend, und hat meine Eltern persönlich empfangen. Sie hat alles in ihrer Wohnung zur Benützung angeboten, inklusive Lebensmittel, und war äusserst gastfreundlich. Meine Eltern kommen gerne wieder, vielen Dank Lena!

Perfect apartment in the heart of Geneva.
Thank you for hosting us and looking forward to coming back in the future!
We stayed at Lena's place for four nights and had a wonderful time exploring Geneva. The apartment is very centrally located, and we were able to venture out by foot to see other areas.
I enjoyed my stay  at Lena's place. location near the lake is excellent.  All perfect!

We loved staying at Lena’s place for four nights of our vacation! The apartment is in a fantastic central location, so we could walk or take public transit everywhere. The apartment felt like home and we enjoyed the spaciousness! Lena was an excellent host, making us feel welcome and provided us with some excellent insight for enjoying Geneva.

Great value for price! The location is perfect. It's in the center of it all. Elena is a lovely person and a great host. She was always one text away when I needed her. She also did a great job in the description of the property on Airbnb, so what you see is what you get.

Enjoyed excellent accommodations at Lena’s apartment.  The location was ideal, the rooms were very clean and had everything we needed. Lena was very responsive to  questions. It was overall a great experience and I highly recommend staying here.

Amazing location, nice and spacious, welcoming kitchen - we loved staying at Lena’s Geneva apartment. Everything was walkable, especially the beautiful old town. Do be aware of the climb, though, if you might have a hard time getting your suitcase up four flights of stairs : )

The hotel is a really amazing location downtown next the main shopping spree in Geneva, with a great view. The proximity to tram stops is unique, being very close to Bel-Air, meaning that getting to and from the airport requires no changes (busses #5 and #10 go direct). The breakfasts were excellent and delivered to our door at a pre agreed to time. Christine was also extremely accommodating and helped us with our unfortunately changing schedule. The apartment that we stayed in the first few nights on the 7th floor was really fantastic, with great beds, two very nice rooms, and a living room perfect for for a small celebration.

We are considering staying at this hotel the next time we have to visit Geneva.

This private apartment atop the Hotel Central is a great choice for a small group (3-4). Easy breezy location and check in. Looks like the photos. The space is basic but very clean and comfortable. Christine and her multilingual staff are all accommodating and professional. They put a cot in to serve as a fourth bed before I even thought to ask! Will hope to return on my next trip through..

Joli appartement et très bien placé , La propriétaire Christine est super sympa.Situation idéale au centre de Genève.Accueil fantastique et  personnel sympathique.Petit déjeuner inclus et propreté de l'appartement.Excellent Rapport qualité-prix. Merci et à très bientôt pour notre prochaine visite.

The apartment is in the perfect location, literally a few minutes walk from the Lake and right behind one of the main shopping streets. It's the perfect spot from which to explore Geneva. The flat itself is spacious, clean and comfortable and I would definitely stay again if visiting Geneva
A gorgeous apartment in a perfect location. Great breakfast brought to the room, friendly and attentive service. Definitely recommend.

Good communication prior to arrival. Very considerate staff made our room available early in the morning. Rooms look just like the pictures. Excellent location near everything. Nice having an elevator after climbing stairs everywhere else in Europe. Great value for family of four.

The apartment was just as described. The location was perfect - very centrally located. Very clean and well-stocked.  The breakfast arrives like Swiss clock-work!  It showed up precisely at 9.00am everyday.  They provided us with a hair dyer, which was great.  Fans in all the rooms, which were needed and appreciated since like most buildings in Europe, no A/C.

Christine promptly replies to all inqueries and was very helpful. The flat itself looks exactly as shown in the photos. Beds are comfy and the towels are extremely fluffy. Do note that breakfast is delivered to your room. Check in is easy through the Central Hotel Lobby and travel passes to use public transit within Geneva is provided free of charge. The location of the flat cannot be more central to all shopping and tourist areas you would want to visit (or shop for watches; possibly a bad thing). Most hotels in the area are approximately 400 a night per room, so this is a steal at 400 for two rooms. I would definitely stay here again.

Well organised reception, - and we liked the place, very well located. If someone wants to explore the city,  the perfect place to be. Walking distance for almost everything. The tips from Christine were most welcome and

Christine and her staff were easy to work with and very helpful.

When I first moved in, the room smelled a bit of cigarette smoke. I asked to be transferred to a different room, but the manager said they could not do that and sent a maid with an air freshener spray. This helped a bit but didn't really solve the problem completely.

Part way through my stay I began to notice a very bad smell (much worse than cigarette smoke). The hotel management came to the room and agreed it was intolerable. They relocated me to another room and compensated me monetarily for my trouble. I appreciated that gesture very much but I would have liked the same accommodation when I first moved in and noticed the smell of cigarette smoke.

Our family of four (parents and two teenagers) had a great stay at Christine's 3-bedroom apartment in the old town of Geneva.   This apartment was everything we expected it to be:  clean, comfortable, and very well-located.   We could walk to everything, or we used the included public-transportation pass to get around town.   The breakfast was a bonus:  fresh rolls and coffee/hot chocolate every morning at 8 am.   Christine was a great host, giving us suggestions for activities and making us feel welcome.  We would definitely recommend it again!
Nice stay, thanks !

The apartment is very specious, clean and functional. The kitchen is equipped with everything one would need, not very new but practical . Christine is very helpful and nice and go extra mile to accommodate the guest. She replies to email promptly.
The apartment location cannot be more perfect, right in a middle of the city with everything nearby (market, groceries, etc.).
The only thing is that there is an extensive renovation going on right outside of the building, which starts at 7 in a morning, it was very noisy.
Again, the apartment itself is exactly as advertised
Apartment was clean and spacious, and very central.  Beds comfortable, and kitchen well equipped.  Breakfast was an added bonus.  Christine and her staff were efficient and helpful.

We really enjoyed our stay. Great location, lovely little suite a perfect for friends catching up with each other as well as seeing Geneva. The travel passes for zone 10 we really useful. The Rowell and breakfast service lovely. Thank you.
Все очень мило и удобно. Как и в прошлый раз.

Christine a été parfaite, tout était bien expliqué avant notre arrivée, nous avons été super bien reçu.
A très bientôt,
Wonderful Flat, clean. Very pleasant service. I recommend it :)!

The room was very nice. Good location, welcoming staff, and an easy arrival. The hotel provided a timely breakfast to our rooms and we had no issues whatsoever. I'd recommend this listing to anyone looking to stay in Geneva! Great spot.

This was an amazing stay! I was shocked by the value of the accommodation in such an expensive city.  The 2 bedroom flat was well equipped, very clean, included maid service and breakfast, and was in the most amazing of locations.  It was also quiet, and the beds were very comfortable.  The bonus of having a hotel staff to assist with questions and suggestions cannot be understated. I am a very picky person when it comes to where I stay, and I am usually never this satisfied.  I would eagerly recommend this to others.

I spent 10 days with my parents in apartment 9 of the Hotel Central. The accommodations were simple, but very clean and well maintained.  From our initial inquiries to booking, through our stay and all the way through our departure Christmas Eve, Christine was an impeccable host.  Likewise, her staff was courteous and genuinely cared about taking care of us.  The apartment was located near the middle of the old city which provided lively night life as well as fantastic dining.  Christine was always ready with recommendations.  We also appreciated the coffee and light breakfast in the mornings and the complimentary rail pass simplified our travel throughout Geneva.

Had a wonderful time in Geneva, beautiful city!!  This apartment is in the PERFECT location!  Very clean, very comfortable, very spacious for our family of four adults.  The host instructions were great, we had no problems whatsoever.  We would highly recommend both the city and this apartment!!

Apartment was excellent and as described. Super easy to get to from the airport, and the free public transport travel cards were a bonus. Christine and staff were very friendly and accommodating. Would recommend.

Great place! Highly recommend! It's really in the heart of the city! On the middle of the shops a step from the old town and a couple of minutes walk to the train station! It's also surprisingly quiet! The apartment was clean and comfortable just as pictured. The best part is that it's part of a hotel so you get hotel service as well and it was all great! Would stay there again for sure!

Very nice flat, which is part of the Hotel Centrale, but feels very homely, clean and tidy with beautiful views of the mountains. A good central location with easy walking distance of the main train station, Lake Geneva and the Old Town - but you also get given a free local travel card for the duration of your stay. With plenty of options to eat and shop locally  this is the perfect spot for visiting Geneva. The welcome at the reception desk was really friendly, with lots of helpful information. The breakfast brought to the room was a great bonus too. Would definitely stay again on a return visit.
Very clean and user freindly. Will definitely be booking this again as the location is really convenient. The hotel personnel were very hospitable. Thank you!
Great apartment and a lovely stay. Thank you!
Great apartment and a lovely stay. Thank you!
The host gave good advice on directions and travel to the hotel. The staff were helpful and welcoming. The surrounding area was safe and a nice part of the old town.

The staff was very helpful and welcoming. We didn't use the bus cards because of our itinerary but thought that it was a nice benefit. The apartment we had was very spacious and comfortable.  We requested down pillows and they kindly accommodated us.  It was very nice to have the continental breakfast and maid service - kind of a hybrid hotel/apartment experience.  The location is really great - just up the hill from the main shopping area and close to the lake.  There are two supermarkets almost across the street.  Brasserie Lipp is literally across the street and the old city is very close by.

We are a family with two kids in primary school, and we spent a wonderful week in apartment 44 -- it was perfect for us. As other reviewers have mentioned, the apartment is associated with Hotel Central, which means there is daily maid service and light breakfast in the morning. The front desk staff is happy to answer questions, provide advice and solve problems.

On several evenings, we purchased groceries and cooked dinner in the apartment. This is a great way to reduce the cost of staying in Geneva because eating out can be expensive. We found that the kitchen had most of the things we needed to cook dinner. One thing we did need was a cork puller, and the front desk fortunately had one they could loan us. We wished there had been a small sharp knife for paring vegetables, but we used the large knife that was there instead. Remember to buy paper towels and napkins for your visit.

Like all hotels in Geneva, you get a transit card to use during your stay that works on the busses, trains, trams and water taxis. We made good use of the transit card during our stay. The apartment is located right in the heart of the city. It is on the south side of the river (Rive Gauche) just at the bottom of the hill for the Old Town (Vielle Ville). It was only a couple minutes walk from the #10 bus stop Bel-Aire Cite to the hotel, and there is an elevator to get to the hotel reception on the 6th floor. There are many excellent stores and restaurants nearby and it is an easy walk to many of the top sites in central Geneva -- for example, the St Pierre Cathedral, Maison Tavel, Armory, Jet D'Eau, English Garden, Flower Clock and Mont Blanc bridge.

Like many boutique hotels in Europe, each room has its own character. Ours was on the top floor (one set of stairs to go up after the elevator), and the original roof beams and vaulted ceilings are visible.

There is a clothes washer/dryer in the apartment, and it works just like all the other ones I have seen in Europe -- which is to say that the dryer gets most of the water out of the clothes, but you will still need to hang clothes overnight on a rack to finish drying.

The beds seemed a little hard to us -- we're used to a softer mattress at home so it took a while to get used to it, and we wished they provided more pillows on the beds (they provide one pillow per person - we requested and received additional pillows). We also wished there was a coffee maker -- there is a teakettle, but nothing for coffee. So we purchased an inexpensive french press for our own use and left it behind.

All in all, a great place in a phenomenal location that we would highly recommend.
房间很大，设施也很齐全。重要的是位置非常的好。就在老城区里面。床很舒适，一躺下就睡着了。晚上也完全没有任何噪音。总之，非常满意。

We used Christine's apartment for a recent business stay in Geneva for an industry event in Palexpo. The feedback was wonderful- Christine was super welcoming and friendly. The apartment itself was very comfortable, clean and central to everything. The bus network to our daily destination was very close by, so made getting to and from the exhibition hall really convenient and hassle free.

We were delivered breakfast every morning, which was a real treat!

I can't recommend this place enough. It serves as a home away from home and trumps a hotel in this expensive city anytime.

We had the most wonderful time at Christine's place in Geneva. The apartment is part of the Hotel Central which gave us peace of mind when deciding and during our stay. The staff was wonderful and very accommodating. The apartment was very clean and was cleaned every day for us. Just like the pictures show the apartment has an old world feeling to it which gave a special feel to our trip. All the utensils and appliances work well and are very clean. We cooked every day for dinner and everything worked well. The location was perfect for us. We walked the old city streets every day and it was fun to find nice little corners and restaurants/cafes on every street. There is a grocery store not even 5 minutes away which was very important for us traveling with young kids.
Overall a great experience!

Christine gave very good directions as it could be a bit confusing finding the place.  The flat was as advertised and we were pleased.  It is located in the heart of Geneva with easy walking in the downtown area.  No car is needed.

We were looking do a nice experience for our quick trip to Geneva, and this turned out to be a great choice!  Spacious, well furnished, with a nice kitchen and dishwasher.  The daily maid service made life here really pleasant!  The location is perfect. Close to both the older parts of Geneva and the Lake!  Highly recommended!
We loved it, the apartment was perfect. Breakfast was great, and the staff were very helpful.

Christine was very helpful in providing specific instructions to find the apartment, and she met us upon arrival with a friendly and helpful welcome providing the information we needed for our activities the next day.  The apartment was lovely, exactly as pictured in the posting and perfect for our needs. Clean, very centrally and conveniently located with easy access to public transport, and the added hotel services (e.g. breakfast) were a really nice feature.  My sons and I wished we could stay more than the one night!  We would definitely stay here again should our travels bring us back to Geneva.

Merci Christine! L'appartement etait parfait pour les enfants et nous. Les filles de 8 et 6 ans se sentaient chez elles et notre fils de in an avait l'espace de marcher sans danger, c etait très agréable. Le petit déjeuner très bien et tout ce qu'on a besoin est dans l appartement. Le wifi fonctionne très bien.

Tutto perfetto !!! Christine adorabile si è fatta in 4 per poter sopperire al fatto che ci fossero dei giorni di festa. Sempre in contatto e con dettagliate info su come entrare nell'apt e come utilizzare la struttura.
Biglietti mezzi pubblici gratuiti per me e i miei 3 figli. Ogni giorno facevano le pulizie quando noi uscivamo. Posizione dell'apt fantastica esattamente a 3 mn a piedi dalla vecchia città e a 1 mn dai negozi/locali e lago. L'apt molto comodo e pieno di confort.
I miei figli hanno adorato questi giorni a Ginevra ed io con loro !

This apartment was perfectly located in Geneva.  Christine and her associates were so welcoming from the minute we arrived (early) and helped with some restaurant recommendations and also some other local matters.  Two large bedrooms and spacious apartment.  The breakfast that was delivered every morning was a nice touch - since the apartment is tied into their hotel options in the lower floors.  Easy to change the times too.  Plus fresh towels daily, and light maid service were wonderful.  Full kitchen.  Reasonable quality furnishing, and beds were comfortable.  Have nothing but good things to say about this apartment and the people who we worked with on our stay.  Highly recommend it.  I suppose the only thing I can call out is a small portion of the kitchen floor was possibly warped (and rolled) a bit.  Nothing a reasonable person can't deal with.  We are looking forward to seeing Christine again in Geneva or perhaps in Philadelphia when she visits.  Would definitely recommend this Air BNB.

My daughter and I really enjoyed our stay! The apartment has a wonderful location in Geneva's center with nice restaurants around and a great coffee/bakery directly outside the door. The apartment is large, beautiful, and well-maintained. There are a refreshing amount of windows letting a pleasant breeze through.
Because of our rather extended stay, it was nice to cook occasionally, and the kitchen is well stocked with all the necessities for making a meal.
Lena is a great host. She is very welcoming and attentive. Highly recommend!
Very good comunication, clean and wonderfull apartament in the city center. Higth recomended
