Très bien

Lena’s place is very conveniently located in a great area close to public transport. Honestly it was perfect for my needs. The place was fully equipped with all the things you need to cook and clean (and more!). It is somebody’s place as opposed to a flat just for renting so it has a personal touch. It was also quite silent no noise from the street  (but the old buildings have poor sound isolation so you may hear the neighbours at times, this is quite common in Geneva). I would definitely recommend the place and rebook here when I have long stays in Geneva and want to feel at home. I also appreciate Lena’s accessibility, she has been very responsive. I also appreciate the flexible cancellation policy (quite rare in gva), given that I booked a few months in advance. As mentioned in the listing, there is no elevator so be mindful of that when you pack :) . Have a good stay !
Lena war sehr freundlich und hilfsbereit und hat immer sofort geantwortet. Die Wohnung ist sehr gemütlich. Sehr empfehlenswert!

Très beau logement dans lequel on se sent bien. Bien équipé, confortable, propre et fonctionnel. Décoré avec goût.
Très bonne localisation.
Great location for a well-equipped appartment.

Lena's flat is in an ideal position to explore Geneva, right in the heart of the city and close to the lovely old town area. Shops, restaurants, bars, public transport are outside your door. The flat itself is spacious, warm and bright, but the fit-out is quite old and amenities (i.e. kitchen, bathroom) quite basic. It was excellent to have a good washing machine and clothes dried easily in the flat on the rack provided.
We spent a week in Geneva and Lena's flat was a good base for us to explore from.

Can’t beat this location! The flat is great space. Lena made check in and check out very easy and was very communicative. I had everything I needed. I did not cook or use the kitchen so I can’t speak to that, but everything else was great!
Very convenient location close to public transit and easily walkable to Old Town Geneva. The apartment is clean and comfortable. Lena is a flexible and very responsive host.

Léna est une excellente hôte qui organise votre arrivée dan le meilleures conditions.
Son appartement est d’une grande propreté ce qui le rend très agréable.
À bientôt !
Alexandre
Lena's place is very beautiful and clean. excellent location. Lena was friendly and responsive. highly recommended.

Location is unbeatable between Lake and Old Town just a 5 minute walk to each. Right in  the heart of shopping with many restaurants. Also very quiet since street is pedestrian only. But that made arriving to drop off luggage a little more challenging but manageable if you make a right into the neighborhood from Rue de l’Italie. It’s on 4th floor with no elevator so keep that in mind. Elena was extremely responsive getting back to me immediately if I had a question. Very helpful and friendly as well. Highly recommended and I would stay there again. Thank you Elana.

Lena is a super host in my opinion. She was always responsive and clearly communicated with me during our stay. She was flexible when flight plans changed and went out her way to help me resolve the return of some items I left behind during a hectic morning of rebooked flights and unexpected travel changes. Her space is a great location and has everything needed for a home away from home. Close to public transit AND walkable to most attractions in Geneva.
Fantastic apartment in central Geneva.

I had the good fortune to be able to stay in this wonderful apartment for two weeks in Geneva. It is a charming old style building and apartment with a cozy home feel, which makes you feel like you are staying with a relative. Lena is an incredible hostess, she is the most responsive and helpful airbnb hostess I’ve ever communicated with. The place is even bigger and nicer than it appears in pictures, and the neighbourhood is fantastic. The apartment has a good energy overall. If you don’t mind a fourth floor walk up, this is your ideal home away from home in Geneva!
Great place. Lena answering is always spot on. Nothing to say very comfortable, everything is in the house for you to enjoy it.

Lena was so friendly, helpful and responsive. Her place was beautiful and looked just like the pictures. An old beautiful building. It was in a great location right next to wonderful restaurants and the best shopping district. It was only a 20 minute walk from the train station and you can see the jet on your way to the apartment. Great place to stay and no negatives at all. Would definitely stay here again.

Appartement charmant, dans un immeuble ancien, à proximité du vieux Genève et des commerces. Parfait pour un couple; vous vivrez dans l'univers personnel de Lena. Bon à savoir : au quatrième étage, sans ascenseur. Rangement et propreté améliorables.
Very nice stay , perfect location, and very responsive host. Highly recommend!
Ich habe die Wohnung für meine Eltern gebucht. Sie waren sehr zufrieden. Die Kommunikation mit Lena hat sehr gut funktioniert. In der Wohnung war alles vorhanden, was man braucht, und sie war sauber.
Would definitely come back. Beautifully located. Very friendly and helpful host. One of the few great airbnbs in Geneva

The apartment was spacious, clean and comfortable. we had a great 4 night stay. Easy walking to old town area, many parks and plenty of cafes and restaurants. Short team or bus ride from train station. Comfortable bed. Four flights of stairs as explained. Great kitchen with everything you need. Good sized living room. Would stay here again.

The appartment is even spacier than it looks on the photo's. Location is perfect, only a few minutes from the old town and the lake. Bus and tram lines around the corner. Lena is very helpful and quick to respond. Highly recommended!

L' appartement de Léna est bien situé entre la vieille ville et le lac. Le logement est très bien équipé et confortable. La chambre est calme. Tout est disponible à proximité : commerces, restaurants, activités sur le lac, transports en commun. Genève est une ville à visiter.

Cozy, comfortable apartment near the Eaux-Vives neighborhood, just as described in the listing. The building is quiet and the kitchen is well equipped with pots, pans, and utensils for cooking at home, along with a hot water kettle and coffee maker. The internet was reliable, the bed was comfortable, and the bathroom came stocked with shampoo and body wash. We also appreciated having a washing machine and drying rack, which made it easy to do a few loads of laundry during our stay. Check-in was straightforward, and the host was responsive and helpful throughout our visit.

Our stay was wonderful. The beautiful flat is in an incredible location with all of Geneva easily accessible. Lena was incredibly responsive and the flat itself was impeccably clean and well furnished. We look forward to our next visit!
Lena was a great host. Beautiful place, beautiful location, wonderful experience.
Nice spacious stay in an apartment. Large living room and kitchen space. Great location. Good wifi. As noted it is 4-5 flights of stairs.

Great place in a very convenient location near Rive/Metropole. It's a large and comfortable place, and the kitchen was well-stocked. Everything was as described. The bedroom was particularly quiet despite the central location.
This was my third stay at Lena’s apartment and each time has been wonderful. She’s a fantastic host - very communicative - and the apartment is always clean and cozy. I highly recommend it!

Meine Eltern wohnten während einer Geschäftsreise eine Woche bei Lena. Auch diesmal war der Aufenthalt sehr angenehm. Die Wohnung war sehr sauber und gut vorbereitet, die Übergabe hat perfekt geklappt, die Kommunikation funktionierte gut und zügig. Sie kommen gerne wieder.

We loved staying in this beautiful apartment from the early 20th century. It’s located in a major shopping district just a stone’s throw away from Lake Geneva and the old town. It was also easy to get to the train station from there. The apartment is roomy and comfortable, with lots of period detail. It was also great having a washing machine and a homey kitchen.

I loved staying at Lena's place. The apartment is spacious and has everything you need for a two week work-related stay, such as a washing machine and well equipped kitchen. The apartment is conveniently located, within walking distance of the lake and the city centre and there is a direct bus to the UN. There are cute bars and restaurants around, but the apartment is very quiet at night. You do have to climb the stairs up to the fifth floor to reach the apartment  which can be a bit of a challenge if you have a heavy suitcase, but at least you only have to do it once and Lena proactively reached out to confirm whether I was aware of this right after I booked the apartment. Lena was always very responsive, making I had everything I need. Recommended both for a work-related stay or a holiday!

The fat has perfect location: walking distance to train station and shopping center, easy access to the attractions; the flat has all the amenities which is very helpful for families; rooms are clean and big, they are facing the train station but if you close the windows you won't hear any noise. Van was very nice and made us feel very welcome, explaining everything we need, directions. The check-in check out time is flexible, thanks Van!

La estancia en el apartamento fue perfecta, todo muy bien equipado
al lado de la estación, sin problemas de ruido
la coordinación con Van (el anfitrion) fue óptima, procurando que tuvieramos todo lo necesario. Muy amable, asegurandose en todo momento que estuvieramos atendidos, muy probablemente repetiremos. recomendable!

La descrizione dell'appartamento era corrispondente al vero, anzi era al di sopra delle aspettative. L'accoglienza di Van Tran è stata molto utile e l'host si è dimostrato molto disponibile e attento alle nostre esigenze. La posizione dell'appartamento è molto buona e il quartiere è centrale, ben collegato con il resto della città e sicuro.
The apartment is very nice, clean, spacious and very close to the train station. Van is very kind, he let us stayed until 5pm just before the next client arrived. Thanks Van.

Everything was as expected , or better. Van was a concerned and gracious host, who made finding his apartment, and getting around town easy. I would definitely recommend renting his apartment as he made us feel very welcome.
Great apartment.  Very Clean and convenient.  Van is an excellent host and took great care in making our visit to Geneva outstanding.

Van made us all very welcome. The apartment is warm and comfortable with parks for kids nearby.
The apartment is in a truly excellent location in terms of seeing the sights and accessing the railway station.

Van nous a accueilli très chaleureusement et s'est révélé être un hôte très sympathique et attentionné. Je conseille à tout le monde de profiter de cet appartement proposé par Van et de bénéficier de l'accueil magnifique de Van.
Il est certain que je reviendrais chez lui si un besoin d'appartement sur Genève se fait sentir de ma part.

The apartment was clean, very well-equiped, and centrally located. Its is a 3-minute walk to the Cornavin train station and less than 10 minutes to the Lake.
Van was very available and ready to help.
位置离火车站很近，设施齐全，房东很热情！ très près de la station,bonne équipement!
Très bien situe, tres calme, grande et très bien équipée.

Van is an excellent host. He is very helpful and friendly and responding quickly to any question before and during your stay. The appartement is extremly clean and very specious. It has two bathrooms, which is nice when there are more guests. 6 people fit in very well. The location close to the central train station is very comfortable. You can reach the old city and the lake in walking distance. I would go back anytime!
The apartment was wonderful - clean, spacious and so central! Van himself was lovely and very helpful. We would definitely recommend this place and host, and hope to stay here again!

The apartment was clean and tidy. An upper apartment, it had good light and a few wide windows that offered decent street views.

Appointed with plates, cups, silverware, stove, refrigerator, coffee maker and more, the apartment was a good basecamp for work. Wifi was snappy, but did struggle from time to time with streaming.

Conveniently located in old town close to shops, groceries and restaurants. Nicely priced for size and feel. Will definitely return.

The reception team was very nice; the apartment is just as seen on the photos; great location next to the main streets and lake. you can get free public transportation vouchers that are very helpfull . parking is quite expensive so the best way is to park your car at the train station (don't forget to ask for the parking discount voucher at the hotel). although it is an apartment to get a small nice breakfast. overall very nice experiance.
Superb location in the city center of Geneva. Clean and cozy, what we all really need to get from travelling. Not much else to say. Highly suggested !

Christine and her staff made us feel very welcome.  The apartment was just as pictured and very comfortable.  We found the kitchen and laundry to be useful and the morning breakfast service was a lovely treat.  The location was very convenient both for walking and for using public transportation.  We would stay there again and do not hesitate to recommend it.

A huge thank you to Christine for letting us stay in this wonderful apartment. We arrived to a welcoming receptionist who helped us with all our questions about the city. The apartment itself did not disappoint and was stunning and in a perfect location. Couldn't have asked for much more as we watched the euros on the TV then went to a few local bars around the city. Great stay all around. 5 stars

Lovely location in the historic section of Geneva with shops, restaurants, etc. nearby. Clean, spacious, comfortable beds and well appointed. Very nice to have breakfast served in the room each morning. We would definitely stay here again.
The apartment was spacious, clean and tidy - the breakfast was a welcomed bonus. Check in was easy as it is with the hotel reception and it is situated in a great location
Fantastic space and location, great service by hotel staff, free public transport, this place is a dream come true!
this is a professional hotel service with a home feeling. The apartment is in the central of Geneva. It is fully equipped and decor is lovely. And don't mention they give us complimentary breakfast!

The location is in the center, easy to go anywhere. The breakfast is the bread and a drink( juice tea cafe hot chocolate). 1 bathroom, 2 bedroom.
However some device are not working, they will need to replace some new one. Like hoods and boiler.
Clean, nice stuff, fine cook place.
This is more like a hotel.

Had a great stay with Christine. The location was fabulous - in the Old City of Geneva and right next to the best shops & easy to public transport too. The staff were very friendly and helpful. Daily cleaning, a continental breakfast & fresh towels were appreciated - unusual treat for an Airbnb! The apartment was relatively spacious, and books/dvds were available at reception. The only things that were difficult during our stay - no air-conditioning so very warm in mid-summer, lack of dark curtains meant early wake-ups, noise due to construction & late-night party-goers (city-centre) and a few minor maintenance issues. Very good visit to Geneva - thank you.

We had a great stay at the apartment - all was as described. Good location, clean and well equipped. Christine was really helpful - both answering questions prior to arrival and on check-in. The apartment was rather hot in August and there was no AC - fans were provided and we just about stayed cool enough. I imagine this wouldn't be a problem for most of the year.
Great host - very quick and easy communication. Accomodation is great, located very conveniently in the center of Geneva

Équipe très sympathique! Appartement magnifiquement situé et très confortable!
Très bon choix!!
The host and staff at reception are friendly and welcoming. Location is great. Good fit for a family to spend several days in Geneva.

We loved the apartment in Geneva. It was a great location between the old part of Geneva and the shopping district. The pictures are an accurate representation of the apartment (beautiful!). It was plenty big enough for my husband and I and our two teenage sons. The included breakfast was a nice touch and meant we didn't have to rush out in the morning to feed our two ravenous teenagers! Christine and her staff were helpful and friendly.
Great location and good communication throughout the process of booking and during the stay. Perfect for my colleagues who stayed here during their stay for work.
Great facility, great location, great service,

This apartment is fantastic. It looks just like the pictures--big with lots of natural light. Being on the top floor, it's also very quiet. Has a washing/drying machine, which was handy for a long stay. And the location couldn't be better, great neighborhood that's about a 10 minute walk to just about anywhere you'd want to go.

Christine was very accommodating during booking, got back to me right away and helped figure out a scheduling conflict. And the staff at Hotel Central are excellent as well, friendly and very helpful.
Great location, very clean and spacious.

The apartment is very well located for sightseeing, shopping and dining.  Excellent communication, comfortable beds, and even breakfast delivered to your room.  Was an ideal apartment for our family and our children loved their room.  Would stay again, thanks Christine!
Fantastic apartment. Just as described. Reception staff really friendly and helpful. Lovely to get breakfast delivered! 😀

There were three of us and we arrived at different times but the first to arrive was allowed to check in early and wait for us to arrive. The staff at Hotel Central are extremely friendly and helpful, they couldn't do enough to help us and make us feel extremely welcome.
The apartment is great. It is well equipped and comfortable - we travelled in the winter so the apartment was cosy and warm. It was so lovely to come back in the evening and just slouch around - have a bite to eat. In the morning breakfast was delivered at our preferred time which was an added bonus.
I cannot recommend this apartment enough as it is such lovely place to stay but it is also right in the centre of Geneva - on the doorstep of the old town and right beside the all the lovely shops. We were thrilled with he location and will definitely be back next time we are visiting the area.

The apartment is situated perfectly for access to the lovely old part of town, the lake and great restaurants. Transport to and from here was easy.  The apartment was very clean and serviced daily which was lovely. Christine is a good communicator, she is easy to reach and keeps in touch. I would highly recommend this apartment for a great stay in Geneva.
Nice and clean apartment and great neighborhood. We enjoyed our stay. Christine was very helpful.

Ravie d'avoir séjourné dans ce superbe appartement lors de notre voyage d'affaire.
le petit déjeuner est servit dans l'appartement. C'est un plus pour les gens pressés.
Je vous le conseille vivement

Appartement très sympathique et confortable. Belle vue sur la vieille ville et le jura au loin. Le petit déjeuner servi est très sympathique.
Seule "ombre": une lancinante odeur d'eau usée
Merci pour l'accueil et la disponibilité
Absolutely great. Very friendly staff, clean comfortable rooms, incredible location. Highly recommend.

Fantastic location, lovely comfortable flat which looks just like the photos, easy check-in and check-out, continental breakfast included was spot on, very good communications, very good and comfortable night's sleep.
Will definitely remember for my next trip to Geneva!
This is a great location with great service.

Fantastic appartement in the best neighbourhood - A few streets to all the best attractions and restaurants. Large and well furnished.
Added service of the hotel is much appreciated with breakfast served each morning.
Highly recommend for couple, friends and family. We stayed with our two Kids and was perfect. Felt just like the kind of place we would love to rent full time.
Grosszügige Wohnung in angenehmen Räumen. Unkomplizierte Abwicklung.

L'appartement est grand, très bien agencé et très propre. Nous étions 5 et nous ne nous somme pas gênés.
Il situé idéalement proche du centre à quelques minutes de marche du jet d'eau et de l'ONU.
Van est un hôte très accueillant, soucieux de notre confort. Il nous a notamment renseigne sur les points d'intérêts du secteur et à été disponible pour répondre à nos questions. Je vous recommande cet appartement.

Amazing location to train station and geneva lake/downtown! Very very clean. Van was an extremely accommodating host. All very easy!
Thank you :)
Excellent flat, light and airy with a balcony next to the station and the centre of Geneva and the lake

Van was super organized and provided us with a comprehensive information package prior to our stay. He also checked in with us during our stay to make sure that everything was going well. There was a bit of confusion when we arrived as it was a holiday and we had some difficulty finding the key, but Van got it all sorted out. The apartment is in a good location for getting around town, generally well equipped and a very good size - even for our party of 8. I would recommend this property to others.
Appartamento un po' piccolo per 8 persone. Alcune cose non funzionavano, ma Van è stato molto molto collaborativo.

Very good location, next to the train station, but were not disturbed by trains at all. The flat is walking distance to the lake.
The flat was clean and bright, with all the facilities needed.
Van provided us with lots of detailed information before our arrival which we found really useful.
Overall we had a fantastic stay.

The place was as described and pictured, very comfortable.
A young lady welcomed us, the welcome and the departure was very easy, no problem.
The place is well located, close to the train station.
We had a good time, thank you!
Logement propre et spacieux. Van a toujours été disponible pour répondre à nos questions. L'emplacement est idéal à deux pas de la gare et des ses quartiers colorés. Merci beaucoup.

I never had a chance to meet Van in person. But he was in touch with me all the time via the Airbnb messaging app, before and during the stay.

Van's apartment is as advertised. It is in good condition and very clean. Everything works as it should. His house manual is also quite detailed and very helpful. I felt totally safe staying here for the week. The building's elevator is also quite new and not the very small and narrow type. There should be no worry.

The location offers ultimate convenience for someone like me who depends on SBB and TPG services. It is just a few steps away to Geneva's main station (Cornavin) and from there you can take anything to anywhere.

Do not be concerned about noises from the station. You don't hear them most of the time. Even with the bedroom windows open, all you hear sometimes is train arrival or random announcements. There is no such noise to interrupt your sleep.

I will consider staying here again on my next visit to Geneva.

Nous y avons sejourne 2 jours. L'appartement est tres bien place, a un jet de pierre de la gare (direct depuis l'aeroport) avec le centre de Geneve a quelques minutes de marche. Il est tres spacieux et conforme a la description. Van, notre hote, a ete tres disponible pour accommoder nos requetes (check in/out souples) . La cafetiere a disposition etait egalement une delicate attention. Bref, un sejour agreable dans un appartement fonctionnel et idealement place.

Flat is spacious, excellent location near the train station, all needs are available next to the flat (supermarket, restaurants, pharmacy, bakery, ...) car parking is available near the flat,
Even if the train station is next to the flat, the acoustic of the flat is good and you don't hear noises from outside.
It is a lovely clean place to stay very easy to get to and van sent good instructions on how to find the flat and he was very helpful. I would definitely stay again

The neighborhood was somewhat industrial, but the proximity to the train station was very helpful and convenient. This helped us because we were in transit through the city, and we used the trains.
If all the carpets were removed, the apartment would feel cleaner and more fresh because the wooden floors are nice. The carpets were of very thin material not very suitable or substantial for large area rugs where people walk, and the carpets were stained and not vacuumed. Because of this, the apartment did not feel welcoming. The towels were old, but they were clean. There were no bathroom amenities provided. We could walk easily to the city and the lake.

Pros: Apt is very close to the train station and easy to walk to. Van wasn't around but the key was easy to get. The apt was clean and spacious. Plenty of towels. Huge TV and DVD (although somebody must have stolen the copy of Batman as only the case was there). Kitchen was plenty big although we didn't use it. Van left all instructions needed to use the appliances, in english, so we could actually read it. The clothes washer worked fine. Beds were comfortable and big enough. Large patio looking out over an artists community or refugee camp, we couldn't tell which.

Cons: This is nothing to take away from the apartment or Van which were great. This is solely based on location. The apt is in a diverse neighborhood. I wouldn't call it a bad area of town compared to some big cities, I mean this is Geneva... But Its definitely not in the high finance, Ferrari and Bentley side of the Lake. This is reflected in the price. If you look on the fountain side where all the fancy shops are the prices are at least double. We didn't in any way feel unsafe but it wasn't exactly the Geneva we pictured in our minds. You get the mindless honking and yelling you would expect for a place downtown right beside the main train station. Fortunately its only a 10 minute walk to the other side and plenty of Rolex and Louis Vuitton we cant afford!!.

Only other con is like most places in Europe there is no AC so the windows need to be open at night. Unfortunately you should be a heavy sleeper as the train switching station is right beside the bedrooms so you get the squeak and creak of trains starting at 4am.

Van and his team were really friendly and communicative before check in and after check out. The house was big enough and very comfortable! It is just 3 mins walk away from the station. This property is recommended.
The place was exactly as Van described, he answered all the questions I made, gave US recommendations for our trip. Great location and a place easy to find.

We loved the walkability of this location! Van's apartment is perfect for travelers-by-train who have planned a short-time stay. Only drawback is the noise of the trains as they come screeching to a halt which begins VERY EARLY in the wee hours of the morning. Nevertheless, the three-minute walk from the station was seamless and easy and for a quick turnaround stay like ours, it was an ideal choice.
It was a great experience!!! Totally recommended!!
Very clean and comfortable place

Vanさん非常に対応が細やかな方です。非常に良心的な方でサポート体制も万全です。

駅直結と言っても良い程の駅近物件。ジュネーブに入ってくる鉄道を部屋の窓から見れたのが印象的です。鉄道ファンには価値ある物件。内装もよく手入れされており、綺麗な物件でなに不自由なくゆっつくりと過ごすことができました。

ジュネーブでの滞在期間が一日とあって市内観光があまりできなかったのが残念です。
Very convenient because it is very close to the station. The apartment is spacious, clean, and modern. Very recommended for a short stay in Geneva!
Great stay- wonderful location and very clean. Host was very responsive.

This was my first experience with airbnb. I think that Van was amazing. I cannot stress enough how helpful he was. He was also extremely responsive with all of my questions. This place was also perfectly located across from the train station and a 10 minute walk to the big fountain on lake Geneva. I highly recommend this place.

Very excellent location, excellent services and perfect and haste free stay for 10 peoples. Van is really good to make sure we will fully enjoy there and feel like homely! Highly recommendable! You will not able to get cheap apartment like this in Geneva.
Van is a very nice host. Though we didn't meet, he made everything clearly and fluently. And I really appreciated for Van's great patience to my inquiry about my trip.
Great big clean flat very convenient location. Communication with the host was easy and responses were quick   Very good value for money. All in all a teriffic experience.  Thank you Van!

My host did everything in his power to make my visit as pleasant as possible.  He was conscientious and very responsive to minor problems as they arose.  Although the apartment is very close to the train station, noise was not a significant problem.  I recommend this flat.  It was good value for the money.

This is a very convenient location for exploring Geneva and accessing the railway with a super responsive host in Van. He has a great eye for detail with almost everything nailed down in his detailed pdf instructions. Very little is left to chance and in the hot weather the fans provided in each room brought relief. Geneva Roule is close by where free city bikes could be hired for 4 hours. The only slight negative could be the loud music which is played till about 3 am on Saturday night in the building behind. However did not inconvenience us as we arrived around 1 in the morning on saturday
Good location, nice apartment

We were met at the property, instructions for use of the place and the equipment were clear. It was very conveniently located. The air bed wasn't the most comfortable, maybe a fold down bed would be better? The other furniture was great. All very clean and pleasant apartment. Thank you.

Van was extremely responsive about coordinating the check-in and we accessed the apartment seamlessly upon arrival. Perfect location near the train station and 10 minute walk to Lake Geneva. The flat was exactly as pictured, clean, wifi, linens, etc. Highly recommend!

Van sent detailed information in advance about access to the apt and amenities. Our arrival was delayed, and we had to request two additional nights because the car we were supposed to pick up wasn't ready. Van just rolled with all of it. He was polite and easily accessible. The apt is very nice. It's in a neighborhood where there are lots of students and musicians and parks. It is near the train station, where they have good food and drink available at all hours. A good grocery store there, too. It is an easy walk to Lac Léman and the Jet d'eau.
Van's place is great in all aspects, and if I ever come back to Geneva, I now know where to stay.

Although we did not meet in person, Van was a great host. His communication was excellent, and he was very accomodating with our uncertain time schedule, being very flexible with late check in as well as late check out options.
The apartment was comfortable for two couples, and the location could not be more convenient to the main train station.
The host was polite and helpfull in every way possible and provided information in every way necessary.  Very positive!
Excellent location and apartment!
Great location. Super quite place. Awesome communication. Very convenient.

It is a well-located spacious apartment, close to the centre and  supermarkets. Great for those who travel with a family. The host responded fast to any requests and allowed us to leave out suitcases on the day of departure for some time without extra charge.
Van was an amazing host. Very organised and check in and out was very easy!

Van nous a très bien reçu. toujours joignable, réponds rapidement.
Il nous a envoyé des infos sur Genève pour préparer notre séjour.
L'appartement correspond exactement aux descriptions.
Idéalement placé car très central.

Van is a very communicative and gentle host! The Situation of the flat very close to the Train Station is perfect and though it is very quiet because of the good Isolation. We were a Party of 8 and the flat was spacious enough. Very fast communication and a very helpful host, would recommend him to my friends.

Van was very helpful during our stay in Geneva.  He provided a packet full of useful information on manuals for the building. Check in and check out was relaxed and the flat was very accommodating for my 7 guests and I. The flat is very close to everything (2 minute walk to the train station). I would highly recommend staying in any of Van's BnBs

Very nice flat with modern furniture and good access to the train station!
Thanks for hospitality !

Super appartement, très grand et très propre. Nous étions un groupe de 8 personnes et nous nous sommes tous sentis très à l'aise dans l'appartement. De plus, Van nous a fourni des informations très détaillées sur l'appartement et sur la ville de Genève avant notre arrivée, ce qui nous a beaucoup aidés !
L'appartement est idéalement situé. En effet, il est à 2 pas de la gare, qui elle-même se trouve à moins de 10min de l'aéroport, ce qui est très pratique pour des voyageurs ! On y trouve un nombre important de boutiques et de restaurants tout autour.
Je recommande vivement cet appartement pour les grands groupes !
Central and comfortable apartment

Very central location. Safe feeling neighborhood and walkable to many attractions. They were great orienting us to the area on arrival. Day pass for transit included. We'd stay there again.
Beautiful apartment in convenient location
非常值得推荐！

Christine was very helpful and very flexible when we unexpectantly had one more friend join or group. Her staff brought us an additional bed as well as breakfast in the morning! The flat is very clean, very central and was a fabulous stay.
Great place in the very heart of Geneva. Modern, clean, air-conditioned and with breakfast service - what else do you want?!? Highly recommended!
Great location. A short walk to the lake and old part of city. Air conditioning was a much welcome and needed feature as it was very warm during our visit. Breakfast each morning was a nice extra.
This is a great place for a family to use as "home-base" during a visit to Geneva.
VERY NICE apartment , very convenient.  Close to everything. The internet is super fast.  Everything is perfect. Highly recommended,

The Apartment was great and as expected. Not only do you get to stay in a great apartment, but you get daily housekeeping including new towels, breakfast, and free public transportation passes. I would stay here again.

Logement très bien placé, très calme et lumineux. Le petit déjeuner inclus et livré devant la porte est très apprécié. Le wifi est rapide. Possibilité de se garer au parking mont-blanc car aucune possibilité de se garer plus de 30 minutes dans le quartier. Christine a été très réactive et gentille dans nos échanges de mails. Gros bémols cependant pour les canapés, ils étaient sales et pleins de miettes de pain. Les rideaux électriques ne sont pas très opaques pour les personnes sensibles à la lumière. Un séjour très apprécié tout de même.
The location is just perfect!  The air conditioning and breakfast are nice extras!  We could even see the fireworks from the festival at the lake from the window.
A great appartement so close to the most beutiful part of town. Friendly and helpful staff- great breakfast.

Wonderful apartment conveniently located in the heart of Geneva, close to major attractions of the city. Nearby options for food, shopping, sightseeing etc are countless. Breakfast served in the apartment every morning was really nice! The apartment itself was super clean upon our arrival, and the kitchen comes fully equipped + washer/dryer, too. Check-in was easy and communication with Christine was great. Definitely recommend this apartment!
SUper convenient - enjoyable comfortable place to stay

The apartment is located in the old city which is the best location for tourists. The bedrooms are spacious, the bed and linens are comfortables and the kitchen is well equiped. The infant crib was great, spacious and clean. Everything was ready for us at our arrival. The communication with Christine is efficient. Christine is a great host and understands well our needs. Thank you for this wonderful stay! Absolutely the best place to be in Geneva!

This is my second time staying at Christine's and I doubt it will be the last. The flat is incredibly well located on the edge of the Old Town, and very close to public transportation (trams and buses), restaurants, shops and the lake.  Communications are very good, check-in and check-out very easy, the breakfast is very good and convenient, very comfortable beds and a strong shower.  There were three of us and the flat is big enough to be very comfortable for three, we didn't feel we were tripping over each other. Once again a very good experience!

We booked two of Christine's apartments for our group of 8. They worked perfectly - directly across the hall from each other, they both had nice living room areas we could all easily be together. The air conditioner was a nice bonus, too. We really appreciated having breakfast brought to the room as well! The location is very central and made getting to the airport a breeze with the free public transport passes.

Appartement extrêmement bien situé dans le coeur de Genève.
Propre, tranquille avec en plus, petit déjeuner servi à la chambre et service de femme de chambre inclus. La carte des transport publics de Genève est offerte gratuitement à tous les locataires, ce qui est un plus.

Great apartment in the heart of the Old City. Price value really good for Geneve.
I totally recommend it.

Hotel Central Geneva

This is a large unit in a hotel located in the old town of Geneva. There are three bedrooms, one of which is a conventional “master bedroom” with a double bed and two of which are identical rooms with two single beds each. The bedrooms are quite spare with little decoration or artwork. The large living room is quite comfortable with a large screen TV. The kitchen is useful. The dining table could accommodate 8 diners. There is one large bathroom and another smaller ¾ bath off the main entrance area. The large bathroom is at the opposite end of the apartment from the master bedroom. The two small bedrooms have outside doors that open onto a narrow deck providing views of the area. There is a large roof window between the dining table and living room that does not open (which was a bit unpleasant given the warm days – there is no AC).

For frequent users of Airbnb who look for a “home away from home,” as I am, this unit is a great disappointment. The hotel is two star, in my judgment, with a creaky elevator for access, old and worn stairs, and definitely unattractive room décor. The hotel has no parking which ended up costing us a lot of money.

I can understand the generally positive reviews because this unit would be perfect for a large family looking for a good location and wanting to save on overall costs – get one hotel room to accommodate up to 6 (or more) people and save money by preparing your own meals. But if you are looking for a homey, comfortable and attractive place to stay in Geneva, this is definitely not your choice.

To say that we were disappointed with the condition of this flat is an understatement. We were pleased with the location and the instructions regarding information pertinent to the flat, but dealing with a roach infestation all week was very disappointing. Here is a summary of the impact this roach issue had on our vacation. First, we had to take time out to go and purchase roach spray and treat the apartment every day. This involved spraying the flat every night and then waking up to pick up dead roaches every morning. In addition to the dead roaches that we had to clean up, every day we also had to kill 2-3 roaches that were still alive. We do not feel that the roaches were babies. Many of the roaches were 3/4 to 1 inch in length.. One morning as one of us sat on the toilet a roach fell on her foot. I cannot describe how upset this made her. Because of the required spraying, we had to smell roach spray all week. I can't imagine that is healthy and it certainly wasn't pleasant. Due to the roach problem, we had to eat every meal out at restaurants. We were planning to eat dinner out twice during the time that we were in Geneva, but because of the disgusting condition of the flat we were forced to eat every single meal out. Since Geneva is extremely expensive, this was a heavy financial burden. The one time that we tried to eat in the flat after we purchased food from Manor, we went to sit down at the table and a roach crawled across the tablecloth. From that point on I could not in good conscience have my wife and children eat in such unsanitary conditions.
In general the apartment was not clean. It was dusty and visibly dirty. The toilets had urine lines running down the outside of the toilets which caused the bathrooms to smell like urine. The shower held water when you showered. By the time we were done showering we were standing in six inches of water. Van did send someone to pour chemicals down the drain. This helped but didn't resolve the problem completely.
If you have rented this flat make sure that Van has treated the place professionally and he has verified for himself that there are no more roaches. I would hate for someone else to have to experience what we went through.

There are several shops and restaurants nearby and the train station is a short 8 minute walk away.  I highly recommend staying here if in Geneva as the added bonus of being part of a staffed residence makes the stay that much easier and more pleasant.

Emplacement exceptionnel : proximité
gare ferroviaire ; lac ; gare routière ; navette bateaux « mouettes »…Calme total. Propreté irréprochable. Nespresso et bouteilles d’eau à volonté. Disponibilité à l’accueil. THE PLACE TO BE
Great location, high quality apartments with everything you need!

Beautiful apartment.
Priced on the higher side, but for good reason. Worth every penny.
Will definitely stay again.

It was absolute perfection! As the mother of two college-aged daughters, their safety and care while traveling alone in Geneva was paramount so, although at first glance the price seemed a tad indulgent, in retrospect it was the best money I've ever spent. On top of the personalized attention, special shout out to Jonathan!, the apartment offered everything they ever dreamed of needing, including DAILY laundry service! (Don't get any ideas, girls . . .) Bottom line: Run, don't walk, to the Swiss Luxury Apartments on your next trip to Geneva.

Couldn’t fault this apartment: perfect location close to all the major high end hotels and yet only five minutes walk from the train station. The apartment looks exactly as the photographs and is spotlessly clean with all the bathroom and catering items you would need plus lots of classy extras you wouldn’t normally expect. The concierge was so friendly and helpful and we thoroughly recommend Chez Piaf restaurant with its own speakeasy which we wouldn’t have found without his local knowledge
Lovely place to stay while in Geneva. Comfortable, welcoming, super clean. I highly recommend this luxurious stay.
Excellent service. C’est le gros point fort de cet établissement. Merci encore.
Great apartments with 5 star hotel service from reception. Definitely recommend!

Martin and the Swiss Luxury Apartments team were great. Very nice and provided excellent check-in and service throughout the stay. The apartment was very clean and exactly as advertised. Would stay again.
离火车站步行距离7-8分钟，地理位置好的，就算拿着行李也不算累，步行可以到达广场，可以很惬意喝个咖啡。公寓的服务非常好，员工非常热情，公寓楼下有餐吧可以吃小零食喝咖啡，公寓内部配置合理的（不过我们这次没有做饭）。唯独小遗憾就是一楼房间的窗户不太好关，我们晚上玩回去太晚了就放弃尝试所以早上也是比较早被太阳叫醒。服务很好，下次有机会还会再来。

Este apartamento es muy cómodo, desde que llegamos en recepción tuvimos un trato excelente por parte del personal, no dió toda una explicación detallada de la habitación.
También nos dió recomendaciones de tours, restaurantes, actividades, etc.
Probamos varias de sus sugerencias de restaurantes y todas fueron deliciosas.
Nos hizo sentir muy felices el lugar y la atención.
Martín siempre resolvió nuestras dudas y fue muy amable

We were initially a little hesitant to book this property because of the higher price, but glad we did. This was one of the best Airbnb properties we have ever stayed in. Everything was too notch and included complimentary coffee, laundry service, etc. The location is convenient with easy access to the lake, shopping, restaurants, etc. Last, but certainly not least, the concierge Bastien was truly outstanding!

Such a wonderful appartment. Everyone was so friendly, helpful and attentive. They thought of things we did not even know we needed like arranging a ride from the airport for us. Great restaurant and activity recommendations! Walkable location. Would definitely stay again. Thank you for a wonderful stay!

SLA was a wonderful home away from home. I traveled with my teenage son and also worked remotely for part of the trip. The location is great — close to Gare Cornavin and the lake. Many good restaurants nearby.
My son was able to navigate the area seamlessly and the apartment provided a great home base for my work. Great water pressure and linens. Occasional noise at night, but I am a light sleeper.
Also, the staff (and particularly Bastian) were very accommodating with many great suggestions.
A bit pricey compared to other options, but I have no regrets and I would definitely stay again.
位置非常方便，各方面可以
Awesome stay.

The staff at the lobby desk were friendly and accommodating, which enhanced our stay.
Super comfy bed was wonderful. Highly recommended.

This place was incredible! The location is amazing and it allows you to walk to everything in the city. The host is very responsive and accommodating. We were foreigners to the area, so we were a little nervous about the logistics. However, the host was very proactive and willing to help assist us with our needs and requests (which were extensive at times). As a result we felt right at home! We will never stay anywhere else in Geneva.
Perfectly clean, very good located with a lot of amenities! Well done guys! Our stay was a pleasure!
Nice amenities with very comfortable beds.  My family enjoyed the stay.
The apartment was amazing and just what we needed for a couple nights in Geneva.

Very luxurious, fantastic service. we felt very well looked after.
The apartment had everything you could possibly need plus more!
Perfectly situated for exploring Geneva
The apartment was beautiful and the VR / PlayStation was a nice surprise for our kids. Martin was very responsive and helpful before and during our stay.
Amazing place!! highly recommend 10/10. This place exceeded my expectations. I would 1000% stay here again. THANK YOU!!

We only were able to stay one night but the team made us feel right at home. We were greeted with water and tea, and offered a selection of Swiss treats. The staff were all super friendly and helpful. The beds were comfortable - even the sofa bed the kids slept on. The breakfast was great and location very central. If you’re looking for an easy location to stay in Geneva with attentive service and comfortable room, stay here. It’s luxury. Well worth it.

Great communication, location, facilities. Amenities, free beverages and the laundry for free is the top unexpected benefit :) the only thing is that the apt feels like an apt made to rent, I usually stay at Airbnb’s to have that home feeling, but it didn’t compromise the good experience !
we had a wonderful stay at Martin's place. The place was spacious and clean and the staff were awesome. We can't recommend enough!
Estadia curta mas maravilhosa! Localização perfeita entre a estação de trem e o lago. Amamos!
I would recommend Swiss Luxury apartments for anyone visiting Geneva, especially if you have children. I traveled with my 7 month old baby and it was perfect. Thank you for a great stay !
Felt just like home, very clean appartment and easy check-in and out.
Lovely stay!
Great location, very comfy bed and the most amazing pillows. Pricey, but what in Geneva isn’t? Superb service from the staff and great apartment overall.
Perfecto

Family of 4 had a great one night stay at this airbnb.
The location was unbeatable, walking distance to the lake and nice restaurants.
We were well looked after by Bastien with lots of recommendations for the kids.
Highly recommend this airbnb and we will definitely be back next time we come through Geneva.
Absolutely wonderful apartment, modern, great light, location, and people. Everything was wonderful. Thank you so much!

Great place. Loved the service & location.
Just keep in mind if you arrive with a car there is no parking - and if the car is higher than 1.90, then most public parking in the area won’t work either

Great location and close to everything. Very attentive service, room was spotless with many amenities. The welcome snacks were loved by the kids. They even provided ps4 for entertainment.
Would stay again if were back in Geneva

The apartment is beautiful, ultra-modern, and spotless.  The bed is comfortable.  The shower is amazing and there is a generous supply of towels, luxury soaps, shampoo, and lotions.  Wifi is strong.  The apartment is located in the "Swiss Luxury Apartments" building.  The building is operated like a luxury hotel with a reception, concierge, etc.  The building manager (Bastien) is amazing.  He unloaded our luggage, checked us in, and walked us through the apartment to become familiarized.  Bastien provided restaurant suggestions.  He is always available via text to answer any questions, provide ice, provide wine, and he even made dinner reservations for us.  You will have the best of both worlds here -- the privacy/space of an apartment along with the amenities of a luxury hotel.  You will love it here.

Well located close to the centre and close to the lake. The apartment was spacious and clean and prepared for our stay with 2 kids. The reception was friendly and helpful with question we had about places for dinner. Definitely worth and would stay again if I am back in Geneva.

The apartment was as shown in the photos, very spacious, bright and airy. It's well located in the centre of town, with easy access on foot, by tram and bus to points of interest. The apartment was spotless and being part of a hotel, is cleaned every day; I was pleasantly surprised to find that breakfast is delivered to each apartment at a time of your choice.
Christine and her team are very friendly, helpful and responsive. The entire process of booking, confirming, paying and locating the apartment was very smooth and their was never any anxiety about that.
The only slight negative was that being in the city centre it could be a bit noisy at night.

We stayed here while on a business trip and were very satisfied with the place and service. Apartment is spacious, clean, has a lot of light and is very well located in the centre ville.
As described, the apartment is part of the Hotel Central which is very convenient as it is serviced every day. Staff was very friendly and helpful.
Highly recommend and will definitely come back for next stay in Geneva.
Sehr schöne, saubere Wohnung an zentraler Lage.

Great apartment in the center of Geneva, very convenient as walking distance from retail, restaurant, the lake and the old town. Last floor with a nice balcony, just a bit warmed (as under the roof) but ok thanks to the air conditioning. Service is great and very smooth thanks to the hotel in the same building.

The apartment was just amazing. We all enjoyed in it. It was spacious, fully equipped and very clean. It looks even better than in pictures!
The location is perfect and there's everything nearby.
Christine and all the staff that work in Hotel Cetral were extremely nice and helpful. Definitely, if we went to Geneva again, we'd look for this apartment! :)

Super belle place... Super localisation. Plein centre de l action.
Nous avons apprécié notre séjour... Surtout le petit déjeuner chaque matin, livré à notre porte chaque matin... :)

Кристин очень  милая и заботливая хозяйка. В апартаментах всегда чисто и убрано, помещения светлые, теплые. Все  по-домашнему. Гостиница расположена очень удобно, близко и до музеев, и, конечно, до магазинов. Прямо напротив продуктовый Coops, все всегда свежее. Я был с семьей, по возможности буду и дальше останавливаться у Кристин. Иногда и правда можно почувствовать себя добрым Карлсоном, живущим на крыше.

Superbly located and consistent with the images provided.  It was delightful to have beds made, apartment cleaned and breakfast delivered every morning.  It was also easy to navigate Geneva from the apartment.  Angelina was helpful when we checked in and out.  Thanks.
L'accueil était parfait, tout a été comme prévu et l'appartement plus que agréable et très bien placé.
Very good
Perfect, clean, good communication all you want in a good AirBnB
appartement très agréable et service hôtel inattendu. merci

It was very easy to check in to the apartment as it's part of a hotel. The man who checked us in even helped us get our luggage up to our room. There is a lift to reception then one flight of stairs to the apartment. The apartment was clean and spacious. Breakfast provided was very nice. Christine was very responsive and kind throughout the whole process. We would stay here again.
Casa molto bella e confortevole. Posizione centralissima, tutti i comforts, trattamento con colazione e tutti i servizi. Bellissima esperienza per la mia famiglia.
This apartment was perfect for our one night stay. Everything was clean and presented well. The apartment is beautiful and well located. Will stay here next time I find myself in Geneva!
Accueil exemplaire!
Christine's place is as described. It's very convenience. Great place to stay

Great place to land!  It’s close to old Town.  What was really great was that you can check in early or at least store your luggage.  The staff was super helpful!  I would definitely recommend this apartment!
The apartment was lovely, the staff very friendly and the location was only a short walk to the lake and other popular sites. Highly recommend!
It was a perfect day spent in Geneva, good space, great host and perfect location . Thank you for everything!
Bastien on reception was exceptional

My family of 4 really enjoyed our stay at this apartment.
First off, the location was superb. It is located 2 minutes from the lake which is an ideal location for walks, runs and to see the beauty of the city. More importantly, it is where the famous Noël au Quai Christmas Market is located making the area very festive! Plus, it is close to countless restaurants so you'll never go hungry.
The apartment itself was spacious and came with top notch appliances including a free photo printer! (I've never seen that offered before.) Everything worked seamlessly, and made staying in both comfortable and a breeze.
It also had 2 TVs one of which was gigantic - that kept the kids busy. Wifi was solid throughout as well.
The staff were just as amazing. Bastien, in particular, was very helpful and courteous. He was not selfish with recommendations or his time, and did his best to help us feel welcomed and at home.
Overall, this was a great place to stay. We'll definitely come back!

This was our second stay at Martin's place (Swiss Luxury Apartments). Like before, the apartment was top notch. This time, we had a VR headset in addition to the photo printer included! Alas, we didn't have time to use the VR headset as we were too busy enjoying the sights and sounds in Geneva.
Location-wise, it's hard to beat. It is within 10-15 minutes walk from the Geneva Train Station (Geneva Cornavin), and that's with us lugging our suitcases. It's also under 5 minutes to the lakeside making it super convenient and accessible. From the apartment, we walked to the Old Town and even as far as Plainpalais without issue.
There are also numerous restaurants nearby including Thai Boky and Thai Times which offer great Thai food.
The apartment is spacious, with enough space for our family of 4. It was clean and well-equipped. The bundled laundry service and free flow of coffee, tea and drinks in the lobby were great added bonuses.
Overall, highly recommended!

Amazing staff, efficient process and thoughtful details.   We were passing through Geneva from Paris and on our way to Vienna and found our stay here to be quite pleasant.  The bed was comfortable, the room was intelligently laid out and equipped with fun technology.  It was impeccably clean and smelled amazing.  Recommended.

The Swiss luxury apartments are a wonderful choice for staying in the heart of the city. Martin’s apartment is super clean and has all the amenities that you need.
The staff at the location are also amazingly helpful, especially Bastian.
Thank you Martin for a wonderful stay in Geneva - really a beautiful place!

Great location. Friendly staff. Attention to detail. Great linen. Wonderful shower. Lots of complementary treats.
We will definitely stay again!
Great location. Great service. Great restaurants within a short walk distance. We liked the cleanliness and comfort of the rooms. Martin is a wonderful host. We will stay again.

The apartment is lovely with high ceilings and large windows. It's a 2 minute walk to the lake and everything is in easy reach. We walked almost everywhere. While we didn't use them, the rental also has fun things like a photo printer and a virtual reality set. Overall great experience. Highly recommend! There's also a reception area with a receptionist to check you in or answer any questions during business hours. Lovely set up overall.
Great space in an excellent central location. Hotel like conditions with reception, key cards, and laundry included. Martin was proactive with communication and we needed little.
The stay at Mark's was perfect, very nice studio in a very quiet neighbourhood. The best was the location, very well and fast communication to the centre with the tranv

Clean, convenient and comfortable.
I enjoyed my stay and will be back .
George

I was made welcome from day 1, with Marc's friend who kindly assisted me in getting luggage to apartment and also driving me to shops before they closed. Very convenient location to my commute to the UN and also around town. Highly recommend. Marc is a great host.

Marc war sehr hilfsbereit und spontan. Ich durfte im Nachhinein noch einen Tag länger buchen und das war für ihn gar kein Problem. Die Kommunikation war super und die Antworten kamen immer sehr schnell. Zudem haben wir noch eine Flasche Wein als Willkommensgeschenk erhalten, mit dem wir gleich unseren ersten Abend eingeläutet haben.
Stayed here before and will stay again! Very convenient to work.

We thoroughly enjoyed our stay in Marc's studio. The accommodation is comfortable and well equipped. Downtown Geneva is very accessible on the tram. For us, this studio was the perfect place to stay and I hope we can visit again.

Mr. Marc was very considerable and I feel really welcoming. The room is so nice and well equipped! The transportation is convenient and there have few restaurants and Migors close to the apartment. Everything is perfect!

Everything was great except busy street. At night it may be
noisy, especially in hot weather when you'd like to have window open.
For people visiting CERN the location is perfect (half an hour walk
thru parks and fields). Also, the espresso machine is a bonus!

Marc's place is in a very nice part of Geneva and convenient to public transportation that will take you anywhere. The modest studio apartment has everything 1 or 2 people could need. The check in was flawless and there was plenty of important information provided.

Ci siamo trovati molto bene nell'appartamento di Marc a Meyrin! Un appartamento piccolo ma confortevole e fornito di tutto. Marc è stato molto disponibile, ci ha messi in contatto con il portiere del palazzo il quale ci ha ospitato ed è stato a disposizione per qualsiasi problema (abbiamo avuto un piccolo problema con i fornelli della cucina e dopo 15 minuti è stato risolto dal portiere che è venuto ad aiutarci). La posizione è molto comoda sia per arrivare al CERN (20 minuti a piedi oppure solo qualche fermata di tram) che per arrivare a Ginevra centro. Abbiamo passato anche qualche ora in piscina, molto carina!
Marc's place is wonderful and quite close to getting into public transport. The neighborhood is quite calm.

L'appartement est coquet, lumineux et plus que bien équipé. Il y a tout, et même plus que ce à quoi je m'attendais. J'ai trouvé une bouteille de vin de bienvenue dans le frigo. (merci !) Lit très confortable (sauf l'oreiller orthopédique, trop haut pour moi, mais j'ai pris un autre coussin à disposition sur le lit et c'était très bien). Assez bien de circulation sur la route, mais pas trop gênant. On n'entend pas les avions, ce qui est vraiment un plus, étant donné la proximité avec l'aéroport. Au niveau communications et emplacement, c'est parfait. Il y a tout à proximité sans devoir prendre la voiture.  Seul bémol : le parking est très difficile. Il y a quelques places pour les visiteurs devant l'immeuble, mais faut arriver au bon moment et ne plus toucher à sa voiture jusqu'au départ. Sinon, on se ramasse une amende (ce qui m'est arrivé, hélas !).
Nice place quiet neighbourhood. Good connection with tram and short way to foodstore. Close to Cern and easy connection to City center.
Nice clean studio in a quiet neighbourhood, close to CERN.

J'ai passé un séjour d'un mois très agréable dans l'appartement de Marc. Je travaillais au CERN et pouvais prendre le tram 18 situé à 6-7 minutes à pieds, même si j'ai principalement utilisé un vélo pour m'y rendre (<15 minutes en vélo et parking à vélo en face de l'immeuble). L'appartement était très propre et bien équipé. Pas de four mais une cuisinette avec tout les ustensiles nécessaires. Pas de machine à laver, mais une laverie à proximité. Voisins un peu bruyants le matin pour cause de travaux, mais cela ne m'a pas dérangé outre mesure. Vraiment très satisfaite!
A very comfortable and quiet studio, close to shops and excellent tram and bus service to Centre of Geneva and the airport. Marc is a great host!

Nice and quite little studio. Conveniently located near public transport. Only issue I had was the wifi but we tracked that down to maybe an issue with the Internet provider. Marc was very helpful and responsive in trying to track things down.

Very cosy, quiet, full-equipped studio, close to tram-stations and shopping center. Internet is available:) Marc is very polite and sympathetic host. Studio is ideal for one traveler. Highly recommend.
Marc, wish you all the best, and thanks for good accommodation!

I stayed at Marc's for a few days, as i had some business nearby. In that sense, the location was great for me. It is 9 tram stops from Geneve Main Train Station and not far from the airport. very small, basic room but it has pretty much everything you need.
Nice studio in a nice neighborhood, easy access to CERN and tram.
Excellent value and very convenient for CERN and centre of Geneva!

Marc's studio is great for one or two people wanting to explore Geneva.  It is located very close (~150m) to a tram/bus stop, which makes getting around town very easy.  There is also a shopping center nearby (~200m) with several grocery stores, restaurants, and other shops.  It takes ~20-30 minutes to ride the 14 tram downtown, and ~10-15 minutes to get to CERN by way of the 18 tram (of course, these times are dependent upon the running schedule of the trams).  I was visiting for work at CERN, and found the location perfect.  Marc is a fantastic host, and I will certainly stay here again the next time I am in Geneva.

I had a brilliant time in this studio - it is very well-equipped, with some condiments and basic ingredients already in the kitchen, every imaginable piece of kitchen equipment, and overall it was a very comfortable and secure place to stay. There was also a bottle of wine waiting in the fridge when I arrived which was a very nice touch after a long journey! The bed and sofa were very comfortable, and the bathroom was clean and spacious. The building and neighbours were also very quiet, and the building is very secure. There is a booklet of useful information about the area provided, along with a collection of maps and leaflets giving suggestions for things to do.
It is very practically located a couple of minutes from several supermarkets and a tram stop, and is only a short tram journey into the centre of Geneva, so if you're commuting the journey is short and easy. Overall, I would very heartily recommend Marc's studio for people visiting, working, or as a base for a few weeks if you've just moved to Geneva. It is in fact such a comfortable and homely flat you will probably be sorry to have to leave!
It has a great location in Meyrin. Very close to bus station and shopping mall. Great place to stay in Geneva.
n

El apartamento es pequeño pero está bien aprovechado. El baño es grande y limpio. Cuenta con cosas imprescindibles como gel y champú además de secador de pelo y toallas. La zona es tranquila y tiene un supermercado a cinco minutos. Además cuenta con dos líneas de tranvía cerca.

The flat is in a quiet residential area, ideally situated for visiting Geneva.
