There is also quite a large shopping centre close by, with (among other things), supermarkets, restaurants, and a post office.
The flat itself is bright, and very comfortable, with lots of nice little touches to make you feel at home. The cupboards are well stocked with crockery and cutlery etc., as well as various condiments and things you might need. The complimentary bottle of wine was very welcome! The coffee machine made very good coffee, once I'd studied the instruction manual for a bit...
Wifi is included, as is a television showing a wide range of cable channels. This was our first experience of airbnb, and we enjoyed our stay so much we would love to visit again. Thank you Marc.
Marc’s place is quiet,  clean and extremely well located for visiting both CERN and Geneva. Marc is an excellent host who is easy to communicate with.
I had a very pleasant stay.

Marc is a really good host and helpful. He also leaves food. So.. ;)
You may find the studio a lil' small but overall it was good.
Great location right next to excellent public transportation and shops.  An added bonus, if you are there in summer, is the pool in the private property behind the building!
3 minutes from public transportation, 5 minutes from shops with everything needed during your stay!

At Marc's apartment you can find everything for cooking and a comfortable stay for one or two people. The apartment is located in a clean and neat building with a private pool! Placed near a public transport stop with easy access to CERN and the city center.
A pleasant surprise was that the owner left for us a bottle of wine! Thanks a lot!

It was a nice app with a great location. The old town , the lake , the famous fountain ... Everything is walkable. The app is also well decorated and furnished, like its style very much. Only one disadvantage is that it was a little bit hot when we arrived cause we stayed on the top floor but the problem was soon settled once we found the air conditioning and fans... The breakfast was also very good! Recommend it!
Easy check-in, nice apartment in a really nice area and walking distance to shops, restaurants and the lake.

After a very long day flying in from California, we were met with space and charm at Hotel Central.  This rental is on the 7th floor and has spectacular views off of the balcony. It is located within walking distance of Lake Geneva and other stunning sites.  The staff onsite was very helpful and  breakfast was brought to our room in the morning.  The coffee was delicious, which removed the need for us to find a local café for our morning coffee. The only negative was we only had time in our schedule to stay for one evening, instead of several. We wish we could have stayed longer and enjoyed the accommodations and offerings of Geneva.

Excellent appartement, très bien situé dans le Genève historique et à deux pas de la plus grande artère commerciale. Appartement avec beaucoup de cachet avec ses plafonds dans les poutres en nous sont visible. A recommandé.

Christine and her staff are just wonderful. Every request was granted. They are just so helpful, whether its directions, recommendations or more coffee!
Free travel passes were greatly appreciated for the public transport.
The apartment was even better than pictured. I wouldn't change a thing.
And there couldn't be a better location. The lake is a few blocks away and trams, buses are at the doorstep.
Right in the midst of great restaurants, shopping, bars.
This was the place we were really looking for and we enjoyed it very much.

The place is nice and comfortable, it is central and located in a good spot. The sofa and some other furniture should be renovated, hosts should indicate that the elevator does not reach the apartment.
Lovely apartment with perfect location in Geneva city center. Christine is warmhearted and always willing to provide help for us. Strongly recommended for anyone who would like to travel to Geneva.
the service is very good. the location is great in the center of the old town: shopping and restaurants. the apartment is clean. recommanded.

Christine's lovely apartment was perfect for our stay. It is spacious, bright, clean, and has all the comforts of home. The breakfast delivered to our door every morning was a lovely addition! The location can't be beat! We would definitely recommend it!
Lovely place and we will be back. Thanks so much for having us.
The apartment is beautiful and huge. Check in and everything was very fast and smooth. The beds were great and Christine was very accommodating. Breakfast was very nice as well.

While we never met Christine, the Hotel Central staff were very welcoming and the place was perfect. It is right by the main shopping area in Geneva. As I grew up in this town, I was even more impressed about the proximity to my favorite restaurant Chez Lipp and the ease to jump on a tram to my mother's in Carouge.
The apartment is really well located, it is big enough for 3-4 people and to host a dinner party thanks to a 6-seating table. The views are fab too.

We had a very nice stay at this flat. There is plenty of space for 3-4 people, there is even a balcony with a view to the snowed mountains in the back. Location is tops, close to everything. Highly recommended!
Fantastic, modern apartment, very central location in the old city, and extremely easy access due to its affiliation with a hotel; feels as easy as a hotel check-in, but with better accommodation!

This was a fantastic apartment. Brilliant location. Clean and very comfortable. Gorgeous views from the windows. Added bonus of coffee and croissants every morning as well as the free wifi. I cannot find fault.
Wonderful stay and location

Tout était parfait :
Christine et son accueil, l'appartement et son confort...
Merci pour tout.

Christine was fantastic even though she was abroad during the booking process and during our stay.   The apartment is above a small hotel practically next door to the Conference Centre, the old city, the lake and everything really.  The apartment itself is clean and spacious with the most amazing oak beams and is nicely furnished.  There are lovely rooftop, mountain and sky views from the windows.  The hotel reception staff dealt with check-in and check-out in the most friendly helpful and welcoming manner.  We very much enjoyed our stay.
The apartment is very centrally located and nicely furnished. Its a pity our stay was so short. I will definitely look to stay there again if I'm in Geneva.
Its a very nice apartament. Well located and charmfull. I didnt meet Christine but a very gentle guy welcomed us and brought us the breakfast. I recomend!
Convenient location. As described. Close to major attractions / parking. The breakfast added a nice touch. Thank you!

We had a wonderful visit to the apartment. Christine was a fabulous host. She welcomed us and looked after our every need. She went above and beyond on several occasions, including arranging for a package delivery and pickup at the apartment. The apartment is in the perfect location, right in the center of Geneva and near the old town. It is beautifully furnished. It became quite warm during our stay, but before we had even asked, Christine arranged for fans to be brought to the room. We are very thankful to her as a host and highly recommend her.
The location is very good and just locate in shopping area. We walked to all places during Our stay. The apartment is excellent for family with children. The space is big enough and view is good.
Excellent

Our Geneva apartment was quite large, clean and comfortable. The staff in the Hotel Central's reception were very friendly and helpful. We appreciated having a light breakfast delivered to our apartment each morning. The location was great - very close to public transit, which was super easy (and free, with cards provided by hotel). Only negative - we had rain one night and had to keep windows closed, which made the apartment quite hot, even with provided fans. Nonetheless, I would stay here again and would recommend this apartment.

A lovely two bed apartment, which is really spacious. Perfect for our family which is me, my husband and two 15 year old boys. Internally the apartment has everything you would want, it is well equipped, nicely decorated and lovely and clean. The beds were big and very comfortable and we had good night's sleep. You can see mountains in the distance from the balcony above the skyline of Geneva. Location for us was great, we could walk pretty much anywhere and were given the free Geneva transport card on arrival, which meant it cost us nothing to travel around. travel from the airport was free as you can get a free ticket in baggage claim. The apartment is also close to the old town which was nice to walk around and see the sights. Christine and all the staff are lovely and very helpful, so we wouldn't hesitate to come back here again! Thanks for a lovely stay :)
A wonderful weekend in Geneva. The apartment was perfect with everything we needed. Perfect location for exploring the lake and the old town. Reception was very helpful.
The apartment was exactly what we were looking for, plenty of space and in a great location.

Christine was very friendly and helpful and we thoroughly enjoyed our stay in Geneva. The apartment was very comfortable and in a great location near shopping and Lake Geneva. I'd recommend that anyone visiting Geneva considers staying with Christine.
Wonderful place, the location is incredible and the appartment is out of this world especially considering the price.  Had a great time.

Great serviced apartment in the city center, easy access to all key sites. The apartment was very clean, easy to find, and check-in was easy. Christine was easy to communicate with during this process as well. Highly recommend!

The apartment was in a great location. Because of the location, it's not for those who like to retire early or sleep late. The city went to sleep late and woke up early and so will you! The apartment was well furnished and the reception desk was very professional and helpful. Continental breakfast was really nice! We only had two complaints, the apartment had a constant off-putting smell and the bathroom floor next to the shower appears as though it's rotted and you could fall through at any moment. Everything you need is in walking distance, so choose this apartment for the location.

This is a great place to book in Geneva - excellent value for money in a very expensive city! We were there for work so the extra space of dining room and living room gave us plenty of space in which to meet with colleagues. I would highly recommend this apartment for a stay in Geneva. The location is also excellent and convenient to public transportation which makes traveling around the city easy and to/from the airport a breeze.

Appartement hôtel génial.  Une superbe vue et extrêmement central à Genève.  On a même réussi à dîner tard... Très tard.  Très calme et un petit déjeuner comme à la maison.  Merci et bon séjour aussi à vous.  Georges

Christine's apartment right in the heart of Geneva is a great place to stay to explore the city and get around . The apartment is beautiful and spacious with all the amenities needed.

Check-in was as easy as a hotel (because it is like a hotel) and the inclusive continental breakfast was a nice plus for us and the kids.
Lovely and very-well equipped modern appartment. Friendly staff. Small breakfast served in the room. Located in the old city of Geneva. Suitable for both business as holiday trips.
This is a gorgeous suite and the view is incredible!

Lovely apartment in a great location in Old Town Geneva. Well appointed, modern and clean - we enjoyed our stay and Christine was an excellent host.
Check in was very easy at the hotel lobby, we had a lovely breakfast and the walk up one flight of stairs was very easy from the lobby on 6th floor. Incredible views and modern furnishing made this a delightful stay.
The hotel/apartment was close to shopping and the old town sights, and was surprisingly close to everything. We'll definitely stay here again.

This apartment was an amazing place to tour Geneva and surrounding areas.  Proximity to groceries, great shopping, historic district, the lake and restaurants was perfect.  It was so nice to come back to a place every evening where we could stretch out and relax.  This place is perfect for a family of four with room to spare.  We did not use the kitchen facilities but I know if we needed to the kitchen was well equipped.  It really was like staying at a hotel with more privacy and daily cleaning service.  Croissants and coffee brought to your room every morning.  People at the front desk were helpful and friendly.  Thank you for a great stay.
Second time staying at Christine's place. Great location and enjoyed our stay. Thanks!

Great location and great space. Even nicer than it looks, and there are two very good restaurants right downstairs. The staff are very accommodating and friendly. The room smelled a bit strange, but not a problem as there were plenty of windows to open. Definitely would recommend to a family.
Very convenient location! Lovely host

This was by far the best AirBnB I've every stayed in!  The apartment was perfect, with great beds, wonderful living space and strong internet (travel with 2 teenagers and you will realize how important this was :) ). The location is a 3 minute walk to the center of Geneva and 5 minutes to Old Geneva.  It couldn't have been in a better location.  In addition, the location also has reception and other amenities, so you get the best of both having a great apartment AND a great hotel.  Can't say enough about the place.  The pictures didn't do the apartment justice, it was better than pictured!
The directions were very accurate, the apartment was spacious and Christine was very helpful when we checked in. The breakfast was a nice touch!

Christine's apartment in Geneva is absolutely perfect for a multi-night stay.  The location is ideal - just excellent for exploring the most beautiful parts of the city on foot, but also with easy access to a reasonable parking lot.  The apartment itself is very comfortable, spacious, very clean, and has the added convenience of being affiliated with a hotel for easy check-in and a great continental breakfast.  Exceeded our expectations in every way.   We loved our stay here, fell in love with Geneva on the whole, and can't wait to come back!  Thank you, Christine!
Lovely apartment in a super central location with great cafe culture, fab transport connections. Comfy beds,  very nice ambience. Would highly recommend!

The apartment was very comfortable and as advertised. We were also nicely surprised that breakfast was delivered to us each day. Everyone working in the associated hotel was very helpful and friendly.

Great location. Clean apartment. Check in was very easy and we were able to get into the apartment early. Communication with Christine was good. There was air conditioning in each room, which was appreciated. We needed more towels and reception was able to help with that. Overall, we were very happy with this place.

Lovely, open apartment with lots of light, good amenities, clean, quiet, and friendly and helpful staff. The layout of the apartment is good, with the two bedrooms every-so-slightly apart from the main living area. The small kitchen was very useful, as was the dining area.
The location is very central and an easy 5-minute walk (if that) to the lake. Lots of shops and restaurants nearby, including two Italian restaurants in the bottom floor of the building and a boulangerie across the street.
If you're driving, parking is an issue. There's short-term parking (as in, 30 mins to hours) in the immediately blocks around, but for longer than that the most convenient is the Mont Blanc parking, which gets very expensive quickly.
We found the apartment to be exactly what we needed and very much enjoyed staying there. Would highly recommend.

The flat was excellent. Perfect location and easy access to the old town, shops and many restaurants right under you. Staff is very friendly and helpful! Breakfast every morning and daily cleaning, like you are staying in a hotel. You even get a free transport card which was very helpful. Flat was very good and clean, I think worth what you pay.

This was a great place and close to everything. Checking in went smoothly and our host even spoke English.  There was AC and the continental breakfast was a plus, along with the transit passes for the tram,yellow boats, and buses.  Christine's place is a must if you are going to visit Geneva.

The location could not be better!! Right along the border of Old Town, and within easy walking distance of the waterfront, you could not be in a better, more central location than this roomy, comfortable apartment. The beds were extremely comfortable and the A/C was also greatly appreciated since temperatures reached 93 degrees during our weekend visit to Geneva.
Great experience!

Christine's place is in a perfect location.  The apartment is exactly what you see in the pictures. It was very noisy the Saturday night we arrived noise continued until about 4 a.m.  This is a great bargain for Geneva.

Spacious, well-equipped apartment, perfectly located between the old town and the lake. We were very glad of the newly-installed air conditioning. All our communication with Christine was answered swiftly and helpfully. Reception staff are friendly and professional. Breakfast is delivered to the apartment every morning; the apartment is cleaned daily and fresh towels left every day.
We enjoyed our stay and would recommend it.
Tolle location. Sehr zentral. Super Empfang mit alle notwendigen Informationen im voraus. Klima funktioniert gut. Auch im Sommer als Dachwohnung zu empfehlen.
Wonederful airy apartment in the best part of town!
Great location, clean rooms and nice breakfast every day! Christine and all who work there are friendly and helpful.

The apartment is light and airy, part of a hotel. This means you don't only enjoy a flat perfectly located in the middle of Geneva, but you also have a daily cleaning, a continental breakfast and a bus pass - they were all much appreciated.
We hope to come back soon!
Nice apartment but not good for some one have heavy bags
Très joli grand appart. au centre ville de Genève, vraiment pratique. Merci.

Great location and a neat space! A lot of history in the neighborhood and walking distance to everything! Don't bring a car, just take advantage of the central location.
The included breakfast was a great touch at no extra cost!
fantastic place in great location to see Genevre!
Very nice apartment in a great location with easy hotel check-in.  Clean and quiet with many amenities and a nice balcony.
Great apartment in a great location!

Great central location with nice views and lots of space. Christine was very responsive with communications and helped us work out some extra details.
It was a perfect space for our family of four.
房间设施基本齐全，但床比较小，打开门有一股不太好的味道，沙发比较脏。

This is one of the nicest Airbnb’s we’ve had. I stayed here with my family for 4 days. The service is accurate and friendly, Christine was very communicative and helpful, and the apartment was beyond nice. It was spacious, the bedrooms very comfortable and the breakfast was basic, but sufficient and good. The location is perfect. It is located in one of the nicest areas of Geneva, close to public transportation, shopping streets and the beautiful old centre. I would definitely recommend this accommodation to everyone who visits Geneva!

Fantastique appt en plein centre de geneve. Christine est tres acceillante et a ete au petit soins avec nous pour que nous nous sentions chez nous. appt spacieux tres bien equipé, le confort d'un 5☆. on reviendra
It is very clean and nice apartment in the centre of Geneve with nice look of roofs. It is in the hotel. I wish there were lights under the table and sofa.
Amazing location, walking distance of everything with great Italian restaurant next door!

Staying at Christine's place was wonderful. Check-in was a breeze with reception staff and the space was both clean and stylish. The view from the balcony was great (love being able to see the mountains!). The apartment is centrally located in what appears to be a shopping district (though I'd take the bus a bit further east for more affordable restaurants) and travel to anywhere in the city was very easy with public transport (especially with the transit cards). Christine was also very responsive. We had a small problem with a buzzing noise coming from the air conditioner and she did all she could to address the problem. This was the most expensive AirBnB we stayed at during our trip across Europe, but I think it was well worth it. I'd recommend it to friends and if I ever come back to Geneva, I'd love to stay here again.
Accueil et appartement très agréable. Un peu de bruit le matin (camion poubelle) sinon le reste de la nuit et du séjour était parfait. Nous reviendrons !

The apartment is in a premier location in Geneva’s old town, surrounded by shopping and restaurants. Tram lines and buses are just a block away. Being a part of the hotel, the apartment benefits from daily cleanings and a free (very simple) breakfast in room.
all ok
отличное жилье по приемлемым ценам. Расположение удачное - рядом супермаркет и общественный транспорт. Хозяин пошел на встречу и разрешил заселиться с самого утра!
Very close to public transformations, very hospital owner, well prepared home
Clean, comfortable flat. As advertised.

Es un gran lugar para alojar, a 5 minutos del transporte público y del supermercado. A pesar de estar cerca del aeropuerto, los aviones se escuchan muy poco durante el día y durante la noche no hay vuelos por lo que no es un problema. Marc muy amable, nos dejo un vino de cortesía y cosas básicas (como jabón, papel higiénico, etc). El lugar estaba muy limpio y es muy acogedor, lo necesario para tener una gran estadía en ginebra! El barrio es tranquilo y la gente muy amable.
A comfortable and conveniently located studio apartment, perfect for a couple or a single person. There are frequent trams to CERN and to  centre of Geneva. Marc is a very responsive host!
Felt very warm and homily at Marc’s place
Exceptionally well located with easy access to both bus and train lines. Very close to airport and CERN. Homey and compact with a lived in feel. Overlooks a quiet street, groceries nearby.
Nice place that is close to wonderful city tram and nice shopping center for the basics
Perfect place to live for a stay at CERN.
studio bien situé, bien équipé et bon accueil.

Logement très fonctionnel (conforme à l’annonce), paisible, avec des voisins agréables. Logement très proche des bus/tramway pour se rendre en 15’ au centre de Genève. Proche d’un centre commercial. Accueil sympathique et réactif de la part de Marc.

Marc was very kind and helpful, as I arrived on a date when it was difficult doing the check-in. I already knew Meyrin,  so it was not difficult to find the place, anyway it is located very close to the tram stop which arrives to the center of Geneva, and it is also very close to Meyrin shopping center were there are shops supermarket bars and restaurants.  The apartment is small but it has everything you need you can find a coffee maker with the tool for making cappuccinos, and also the fondue maker set, everything is perfect. It is ideal for a solo traveller or a couple  The bathroom has a bathtube. The price is reasonably good to be in Geneva, and if I need it in the future I will try to book it as my first choice.

Hôte a recommander+++
A distance il s'assure que tout se passe bien pour vous tout au long de votre séjour
Et est prêt à intervenir a tout moment pour votre confort
Merci Marc pour cette réactivité
Michèle
Tout près de Genève grâce au tramway, appartement calme dans un residence paisible. Balades agréables possibles autour du logement.
Excelente ubicación y barrio muy tranquilo. El patio interior del edifico es preciosos y muy agradable. Marc siempre fue muy atento y rápido en contestar. Lugar muy recomendable.
Great modern apartment in good location for Carouge. Very comfortable and spacious.
un ottimo appartamento ampio luminoso panoramico e arredato di nuovo. eccellente!

Logement conforme à l'annonce. Confortable et pratique.
Situé idéalement ( transport en commun, quartier).

The appartment is brand new, spacious and well equiped with all required facilities. Perfect for one person or a couple. Not in the city center however quiet andvery close to public transportation ( lines 12 & 18 ). The WiFi is good and strong but requires installatin improvement. Great and very supporting Host. Definetly will come again.
Lovely spacious apartment, stylish and new.

Marina's place is super modern and clean. Wide screen TV, WIFI all wok very well. There are several underground parking places for visitors. There are two major tram lines 12/18 making it easily to go to city center.
Thank you Marina. We enjoyed our stay a lot!
Marina è stata precisa e gentilissima. Appartamento moderno e arredato con tutti i comfort. Sicuramente in futuro contatterò nuovamente Marina per il prossimo viaggio.

Nous sommes très contents de l'hospitalité de Marina. Elle est très gentille et toutes les indications qu'elle nous a données ont été parfaites.
L'appartement était prope et bien qu'il ne se trouve pas au centre de Genève, il y a près un arrêt de tramway. Tout parfait!!!
Un appartement très bien situé à deux pas du centre de Geneve en tram .
We had a lovely weekend, Marina's place is superb, would definitely recommend.

Lovely comfortable modern flat with a great balcony giving a view over woodland to one side with some city view also; the apartment was very clean and tidy, kitchen and bathroom spotless. All arrangements with Marina were very easy and replies to communications very prompt, polite and friendly. The flat is a perfect base for any trip to Geneva, just next to a tramstop from which it is just a few minutes into the city centre. Carouge is a lovely area with good shops, cafes and marketplace. Highly recommended.

Great place! Newly built (which is rare for Geneva), nice, clean, spacious, decorated with taste. All amenities present. Close to public transport though a bit far from Geneva center. Very comfortable and pleasant stay overall. Too bad it was not available for another week or two, we would have loved to stay longer.
Big thanks to the host - Marina - great place to live!

This is a large, very pleasant apartment in what is a surprisingly good location (it seems from a map as if it's very far out, but it's easy to get to, and in Carouge which is full of nice and convenient shops and restaurants). Check in was easy and communication with Marina was very good. The one real problem we had (which we understand was temporary) was the lack of a good way to make coffee. In general, the kitchen is not super well-equipped, but we understand this is a new place and presumably will improve. There's a playground in the complex which our child enjoyed. It was a very nice place for a short stay.
Description correspondant exactement à la réalité. Emplacement parfait dans Carouge. Séjour idéal pour nous
I highly recommend this place it's not far away from the city, the place feels very home like and it's very clean. Marina is also a great host.

The flat is everything we wanted for; clean, well communicated, great views and modern.
Marina was very responsive and put us at ease from the beginning, we highly recommend her place.

Great flat, clean,spacious and well decorated. Close to public transportations and 10 mins from city center.
For sure recommended for both short or long stays. Marina is also super nice and helpful quickly replying to any question.

Modern apartment close to train line so good access
Wish I had more days to explore Carouge district
Marina’s place is lovely, we hope to return to her place soon.

Spacious accommodation and a very helpful host
Apartment has everything you need and is well situated - easy short walk to Carouge which has lots of bars and restaurants (albeit expensive as is Switzerland generally) also very close to an excellent tram service into central Geneva
Parking on site is real bonus
Would certainly recommend

Marina’s apartment is large, spacious, stylish, clean, has all amenities that you could need, and is really well located - beautiful and lively Carouge is a short walk away, and the tram links to the centre of Geneva are close, convenient and frequent. I loved my time there.
Marina is very easy to deal with, friendly and helpful - a really charming host. I can strongly recommend this apartment, whether for a short or long stay, and whether for business (as in my case) or holiday.
Great apartement, willing to stay again

The flat was very spacious and better than we expected. The place is within close access to public transport. We had a very comfortable stay at Marina's place. She was a very good host and easily accessible.

Marina is a great host, and was reachable within sec's despite being out of country. Her apartment is beautiful with great views of the woods and lots of balconies in a very nice new residential complex. The apartment 5th floor and is fully equipped (dishwasher, W&Dryer, Oven, Iron, TV, American Coffee , Kettle,.... )  and all kind of detergents hat you can think off) and is very bright and comfy. I highly recommend to others.

Marina’s place is a very nice apartment with everything to enjoy our stay.
If I come back to Geneva, I’m sure i will book again this appartment! Thanks marina!
Amazing, spacious apartment located in the adorable Carouge. Very close to the tram line which takes you directly to Geneva center and the train station. Highly recommend!

J’ai passé 2 mois dans l’appartement de Marina qui se sont parfaitement bien déroulés. L’appartement de cet immeuble moderne rend mieux qu’en photo, le grand balcon et la vue sont très agréables et la communication avec Marina était parfaite.
Tout est conforme aux images. L'appartement ne manque de rien et il est tres bien situé et tres proche du centre de Carouge
Marina’s apartment was beautiful - very comfortable for our extended stay. Communication was seamless.
Apartamento limpio, espacioso, bien situado y propietaria atenta y servicial. Sin duda, lo recomiendo.

We spent nearly 2 months in Pilar's place while settling in to a new city and job. It was the perfect home away from home. The unit itself is spacious, very bright and cosy. It is well-equipped with anything you possibly need and public transport and shopping just around the corner.  Would recommend the place to my friends and family anytime.

Pilar est une hôte accueillante et très agréable. Elle est arrangeante et a de charmantes attentions. Son appartement est conforme aux photos : bien décoré, confortable et très agréable à vivre. L'immeuble est neuf et très bien tenu. Je recommande donc sans hésitation Pilar et son bel appartement à Genève.

Je suis venu plusieurs fois chez Pilar. Son appartement est impeccable, propre, soigné et très bien aménagé. Pilar est de plus une personne charmante avec beaucoup d'attentions. Je recommande vivement.
Je viens souvent chez Pilar. Comme d'habitude, Pilar fut charmante, accueillante et ponctuelle et son appartement est vraiment confortable, apaisant et serein. Je recommande chaleureusement.
Great place to stay! Exactly as advertised!! Clean, great location, and a very nice apartment especially if you want something other than a stiudio. Would highly recommend!!

I stayed In Pilars flat for one week and enjoyed everything about it. She was not there which was satisfactory as i do not like sharing. The flat Is net and clean, spacious enough for up to two people, and equipped so you Can feel home. The interiour decoration is personal and beautiful. Public transport is uncreadibly close. I would strongly recommand it to even those not yet familiar with the airbnb concept. It was Also my First experience but a positive one.
Thanks you Pilar
Great place to stay in Geneva.
Pilar fue muy amable y atenta. El departamento es hermoso, a una cuadra del Río. Con la red de transporte público de Ginebra me moví cómoda por la ciudad. Así que muy recomendable opción!

Un appartement très chaleureux, très bien décoré, on s'y sent comme chez nous !
Merci à Pilar pour ce superbe appartement.

Easy place to find. It is practically in the center of town. I brought four friends and it was super comfortable for all of us. Everyone had their own rooms and bathrooms. Hotel reception is super helpful. Overall a great place.
The apartment is clean, cozy and comfortable. Unfortunately there was a problem with check-out time, but Sylvie and Laurent have already fixed it.

A very clean and nice apartment in a great location. It is close to buses and a large train station, making it very easy to get around. They provide cleaning services every couple days and the check in and check out process is very convenient and quick. Staff was responsive and nice. Would definitely stay there again.

Apartment is huge and excellent for groups of 4 and above. Plenty of space and a decent kitchen too.

Would surely book it again when Im next in Geneva.

Overall a very comfortable stay.

Perfect space for our family of 4.
Loved having breakfast delivered to our room each morning.
Centrally located to easily explore Geneva!

Very clean, spacious and stylish place. We were four people and it was quite big enough. The best service for us was breakfast in the room. The lady brought breads and drinks to the room in the morning. We will definitely use this place again next time.
Super great space, perfect for a family of 4. Great location within walking distance of everything. Hard to find parking though. Even had AC which was a plus, definitely would go back, loved it!

We had a fabulous stay. Great little outside balcony overlooking the roof tops towards the mountains.
Can be very noisy at night depending what is going on outside (we were staying during World Cup 2018).

My trekking buddies and I stayed at this place as part of a longer trip. Location is great, and the place was sunny, clean, well decorated and spacious. I would absolutely recommend this place to anyone.

A very spacious air conditioned apartment in the heart of the old town; extremely central..... with this in mind it is on restricted 30 mins parking.  For anything longer, you need to park in the Mont Blanc underground car park which is a 10 minute walk away and very expensive for long term parking.

Beautiful, spacious apartment in Geneva.  Perfect location - close to the lake, old town, and tons of shopping and restaurants.  The check-in process was very smooth.  It was also a nice touch to have a continental breakfast delivered to the apartment every morning.  Would highly recommend Christine’s place.
Great location, great space with invaluable aircon - we were there in 35 degree temp's! Breakfast great and front desk check in perfect.
This is a great location and a very welcoming team. The apartment was spacious, super clean and pretty cool in the heart of the old town. We would definitely return!
We had a lovely stay at Christine's. Fantastic location. Great terrace. Clean space with lots of light.

This place is super! You can see afar from the balcony! The view is so nice especially at sunset！！！The place is very convenient!Christine is very nice and hotel staff is also very friendly!
I would highly recommend you this place.

Great place to stay in Geneva! Clean and cosy, breakfast was fresh and delis he’s, very comfortable beds,owner was very helpful and responsive
Highly recommend this place for 2 families or family with kids
Great location, clean and comfortable and with a great view of the city!
Apartment was great and as pictured. Staff were very helpful and friendly. Would stay there again.
Very nice and kind host. Location of the apartment is very nice. We enjoy our stay and trip!
Christines place was excellent. Really top top location, right in the middle of the best part of the city and an unexpected penthouse to boot. Check in was super easy, 5 stars all round!
Nice place, good view

We loved apartment 43! Exactly what we needed after our long flights - nice clean comfortable space to unwind. Hotel staff were all super helpful and friendly! Comfortable beds! Had everything we could have wanted! Continental breakfast included!

Pros: cleanliness, good amenities, ease of access, friendly staff, spacious rooms, perfect location for business and sightseeing.
Cons: this is a hotel suite rather than a true Airbnb, if that makes a difference for you. Also, in spite of the rooms being on the 7th floor, when the local drunks (who'd have thought Geneva had any?) decide to settle their disputes in the passages below, at 2 in the morning, you might have trouble sleeping. Not that the hotel can do anything about it, of course, but still - a note for future travelers.
We come back soon
Great flat, perfect location
The apartment is excellent- very clean and comfortable. Good location in the old part of town.

Sylvie and Laurent are the perfect hosts and their apartment was just as described. Well located in the centre of Geneva and close to all amenities. It make the perfect base for a stay in Geneva, we would recommend this for a great stay here.
Sylvie was a great host - the apartment was as described and we enjoyed our stay there!

The place was great. Was staying there for a business trip with 3 colleagues. We needed to save on costs as hotels in Geneva are quite expensive. The rooms are all very private and it's basically like having 3 separate units entirely. Great location too.

L'appartamento è molto ampio e ben strutturato (in realtà sono tre mini appartamenti collegati): noi eravamo in sette ed è stato perfetto, sia per stare tutti assieme che per avere i propri momenti solitari.
L'arredo è piacevole e ci si sente ben accolti. La wi-fi funziona bene, anche se bisogna continuamente riloggarsi. Non abbiamo incontrato i proprietari che erano fuori città ma una ragazza molto gentile che ci ha permesso di accedere. L'appartamento è in realtà parte di un albergo che al momento della nostra visita era chiuso. Ottima la riduzione di prezzo per il parcheggio convenzionato. Nel complesso ottimo soggiorno, da consigliare se si è in gruppo.
Appartement tres pratique pour plusieurs personnes dans le centre de Geneve a 5 minutes de la gare. Je reviendrai!

Alles war in Ordnung, sehr schöne Wohnung. Wir kommen gerne wieder. Das Frühstück, dass man dazu buchen kann ist leider etwas mager.

Viele Grüße,
Amin

Appartement vraiment spacieux et confortable, calme, très bien équipé et surtout parfaitement situé, à quelques minutes de marche de la gare centrale. Le menage a été plus long que prévu à cause du groupe qui nous précédait, mais nous avons été très bien accueillis par les hôtes vraiment sympathiques qui ont tout fait pour nous mettre à l'aise et nous faire oublier ce malheureux évènement.

The premises are not configured as one apartment but rather comprise three independent  en suite units with a common entry, the whole managed as an extension, one floor below, of a small hotel.  One checks in at the hotel reception and receives hotel style keys. Very comfortable, clean and well equipped units but also subject to a lot of noise from the evangelical church one floor below. Perhaps because it was Easter weekend...

This is our second time staying at the apartment manage by Laurent and had another great experience there. Good value, location, and space within the apt. Laurent is also quite flexible and helped us when we had to delay our stay for a week.
5/5 for the location.

One small thing to consider, if you are staying in the apt during the day on a Sunday, just be aware that there is a church next door and you may hear their singing.

This apartment was fabulous. Spacious with a flexible layout. The location is excellent. So close to everything. We loved our stay. The process was easy and extremely positive and great communication from Sylvie. The only small hiccup was that the room was not ready at check in time when we arrived as the previous occupants had checked out late. However, it was not too long and they did allow us to keep out bags in the apartment for a little while at the end of our stay which was very helpful with our flight timing.
Merci, super accueil !

The location is simply amazing, what a chance to have stayed there !! The flat was clean and was as described. The television worked perfectly.
The internet can get a little tricky because it disapears sometimes.
It wasn't an issue, but we almost didnt find the 3rd small room, so maybe could someone would have showed is around at first?
But is was funny discovering the big flat!
Thank you again!!

Sylvie  was a great host, and always responded quickly to any requests or questions we had.  The apartment was exactly as advertised, and very comfortable for our group of four business travelers.   We each had private bedrooms, and shared kitchen and a living room.  For a family, or a group of friends, you could easily add three additional people to the apartment. Everything was quite nice. The location was minutes from the lake and minutes from the main train station. You could not ask for a better location in Geneva.

As advertised.  Great location.  One can walk from the train.  One block from the lake.  4 big beds.  All very comfortable with nice sheets and pillows.  Good light.  Clean.  We enjoyed it greatly.

City Center apartment perfect for a family, everything want smoothly. I would definitely recomend it. It is just in front of the bus station and 2 min to the train station which makes it so convenient to explore. We will come back!

Let us begin by saying we like AirBnBs. But this one was the first one that made us pine for a hotel.
The apartment was as depicted — but we arrived in the grip of a brutal heatwave, which our host acknowledged. He also knew the place has no air conditioning, no cross ventilation, and only one fan. But did it occur to our host to provide a second one, even though he knew we’d be sleeping in separate rooms?
We like to imagine the Golden Rule applies to AirBnB hosts. If Philippe doesn’t want to sleep in a room hot enough for Bikram yoga, then don’t make us do it.
Maybe we shouldn’t have been surprised. Upon arrival, after 16 hours of travel, including delays and a painful shin injury at the airport, our host griped and scolded us for inconveniencing him. Awesome.
He didn’t seem to know about the controls for the stove, “forgot” to tell us about the washing machine in the room, and provided none of the basics you need to cook. Not even salt and pepper.
We have used AirBnBs at least half a dozen times before — domestic and international. But after our experience with Philippe, we bailed and spent the next leg of our trip in a hotel.
How this guy got to be a “super host,” we’ll never know.

You sometimes get noise from people yelling/talking as they smoke outside, but I think for the most part it's fairly quiet if the windows are closed.

Another uncomfortable encounter was when I came back from work, and I went to the kitchen to wash my lunch container. Aline's mother was in there cooking, and I made sure to be out of her way. This was by far my worst airbnb experience to date. It was a series of issues from the start. We asked to cancel, albeit late but both my colleague and I were quite unwell from travelling for business for the past 4 weeks and hoped the host would find some flexibility. No chance. We were still going to be charged full rate so we decided to go. As well, the host asked us to tell any neighbours we were friends and not that this was an airbnb rental which I didn't feel comfortable doing. Arrived and it was freezing cold outside and there was no explanation which building it was, just #3. Well all the apartments are #3. This one happened to be 3E (important to note because there are numerous buildings within the complex). I had to message to find out what building while waiting for response in the dark and the cold. Then when we went to retrieve the key there was no key inside. Messaged again and had to wait for a response. Then someone called and didn't believe us that there was no key. We had to wait further for someone to show up (keep in mind we're both incredible ill and I'm trying to not end up with pneumonia). Once the person arrived and realised that, yes, there really was no key we had to wait for another key to be brought. Once inside the place the issues continued - it is a centralized heated building so there's no way to increase the heat and it was cool/cold the entire time. There's only 1 blanket and 1 pillow per bed so we ended up wearing jackets, toques and doubled up on socks just to try to keep warm. As well, there was zero hot water the entire first evening. The next day at least the hot water came back on. The only explanation that was given was that 1) maybe a lot of other people in the building used hot water recently (doubtful because it was cold all night), or 2) that the building had some maintenance and the hot water was shut off and hadn't reheated. As well, when we asked for extra blankets we were told no. The next issue was when we went to load dishes in the dishwasher it was full of stagnant and rank smelling water - I didn't want to run it in case it flooded on the floor so I messaged with this new issue and was told a plumber would be called and then never heard anything back the entire rest of the trip. Poor communication on the part of the host - there should have been some level of resolution or communication as to what was happening. In addition, the washing machine also leaked water when we tried to do a load of laundry. After multiple issues and a host that went silent needless to say I was not impressed at all. To top it off...

The TV was big, Internet was fast. The location was convenient, right next to the central station (Gare Cornavin) with easy transport access, including to the airport. In the same street, there was a lovely tapas restaurant (Ole Ole) and a delicious Lebanese (Chez Sami). There is a gym with sauna nearby (Silhoutte - you can pay as you go) and small corners shops all around open late. In addition, there is a big modern shopping mall right around the corner (Centre commercial Les Cygnes) with a supermarket, and many stores and a cafe. Great apartment in an excellent location close to Cornavin train station, the lake and a wide range of restaurants and bars. Easy self check in process and Ben the host was super responsive and helpful. Would recommend!

Great base, perfectly located in lively Pâquis. Everything I needed to live comfortably for a week of work. It's an older building, so ventilation during a heatwave was a bit of an issue. El apartamento está en una ubicación inmejorable. A 5 minutos caminando desde la estación de tren. Cómodo y con todo lo necesario, cuenta de cocina completa, baño y habitación amplia con cama de dos plazas. La llegada fue muy fácil y la comunicación también. Gracias!
Very nice place, with everything you need and centrally located
L’appartement proposé par Ben est très pratique, juste à côté de la gare. Le logement est propre et Ben est un hôte tres réactif, je recommande !

The location is Great! Just two minutes away from the central station. I had to shorten my stay, and Ben was so kind to accept my full refund for the remaining days. I recommend his flat to everyone.

The place is very well located, 2 minutes away from the train station, very close to the lake, restaurants, and supermarkets. It’s not big, so it’s ideal for people travelling alone. Ben was also easy to communicate with and both check in and check out were easy.

The apartment is located 5 minutes from the train station, which ensures quick communication with the airport, as well as ease of exploring the city. I really liked Ben's apartment, I felt good in it. The place is clean and comfortable. I suggest providing guests with an electric kettle. The only inconvenience was a lot of noise coming from the street and nearby restaurants, which made it difficult to sleep, I had to close the windows, which in turn caused high temperatures. Ben communicated immediately and friendly. I recommend the apartment due to its location in the center.

Mon séjour chez Ben s’est très bien déroulé je recommande ce logement à proximité du centre et des attractions. Ben était très réceptif et le logement correspondait à la description ainsi qu’aux photos
Centrally located, close to the train station so easy to get to wherever you want. A nice walk to the lake and plenty to do nearby. A good value for a short stay.
Apesar de ser um apartamento, aparentemente com alguns anos, está bem conservado e bem localizado. Para além disso, a comunicação com o Ben foi fácil. Recomendo!
Ben’s place is perfect for both short and long stays. Ideally located with lots to do nearby.

Very convenient location and nice flat. I will book it again once I will return to Geneva.

Todos los comentarios hacia este anfitrión. Son reales. Se quedaron cortos en lo que a él se refiere.
Es una persona espectacular. He estado en varios apartamentos por esa zona y no tengo quejas de ninguno pero si a elegir me pusieran diría que repetiría con este anfitrión. It was a real pleasure to stay at Ben’s place - it is as described, in a good location in terms of transit, groceries and restaurants. Ben made check in and check out very easy, and was always just a chat away.
Everything was on point. Ben is a great host.
Ben was super nice, communicative and helpful, even when I had to unexpectedly extend my stay. The location is perfect, so central, yet surprisingly quiet for being so central. Absolutely great!

It was a great experience! The location is excellent, just a few minutes from Cornavin Station and a short walk to the lake and everything nearby. But the highlight of it all was Ben. Bella esperienza , Il Signor Ben davvero molto accogliente e simpatico , da proporre ad  amici e parenti .

Ben was a great host and provided all the information necessary for a smooth check-in. The studio was very clean, and had all of the amenities I needed for my visit. The place is close to the train station easy walking around. Plenty of restaurants and close to the lake.

Although the building is old, it has a fully functional elevator and all other amenities.  The best thing is it's excellent location, very central,  right next to the station,  and close to the lake . I was very comfortable in the studio apartment.
Perfect location, and the host was incredibly helpful throughout my stay. Would definitely recommend.
I spent 9 days in Geneva on a business mission. The studio was perfect for my purpose. Christine was a kind and helpfull host. I would not hesitate using the studio again.
One of the top airbnb experiences I have had. Lara was super friendly and helpful, and the communication was very efficient. Stylish and sparkling clean apartment. I would definitely come back!
Manuella’s place is in centrally located, beautifully furnished and she is a helpful and accommodating host.
Gorgeous apartment, stylishly furnished! Great host and location, highly recommended

As always, a perfect stay in Geneva that exceeded all expectations. Lara is a wonderful host, her apartment is immaculate and beautifully furnished, and the location could not be better to explore the city and take advantage of all the cultural and culinary experiences it has to offer.

Lara’s flat is very big and super clean. The room has everything needed. When you wanna take a shower you have to consider that it’s rather a bath tube than a shower, there is no curtain. Lara is friendly and very quiet.
Fantastic apartment and all good!
Very clean room and house in general. I would recommend it! Lara was very willing to help you out with tips etc.
Great place, great host, great location!
This is my second stay at Lara’s place and if possible I’d rate it 6 stars. Lara is a wonderful host, her place is amazing and extremely clean and organised. Thanks Lara for your hospitality!

Lara was a super nice host, very flexible on our check in and out. Lara met us at restaurant outside the entrance and showed us the beautiful apartment.
The apartment is large and so is the bedroom. We had a short 2 day stay and ate out, so we didn't use the kitchen.
Lara had some waters and chocolates as welcome gift, ( hint , save your water bottle as you walk, many many fountains with clean delicious water to drink )
The location was very central with many things to do and super close to the tram line, this is great for getting around, you can hear the trams also. If light sleeper, consider some noise cancelling device.
The apartment has a lift, so moving luggage was easy. The bathroom is shared as stated in the listing, this was not an issue for us in anyway
We are airbnb hosts also and found Lara to be a great host and look forward to our next visit to Geneva and staying at her place.

Rien à redire.
Superbe appartement, très bon emplacement et accueil très sympathique.
I highly recommend this apartment to anyone—I had a fantastic time in this beautiful space! Lara was a wonderful host!

Tout s'est bien passé lors de mon séjour chez Lara. L'appartement est très bien situé, proche de tous commerces et transports publics, la chambre est spacieuse et l'appartement est toujours très propre et agréable. Lara est accueillante et a été réactive à mes messages. Je recommande pour un séjour de courte ou plus longue durée.

Lara is a great host and we have stayed with her throughout several years now. Her place is impeccable, location is perfect and we so highly recommend it that we have came back ourselves several times. Thanks Lara for being the best host!

Lara est une hôte très accueillante.

Beautiful apartment, with a wonderful host. I can definitely recommend this place if you want to stay in Geneva for some time.
The apartment was beautifully appointed and spotless. The location was perfect - close to everything in Geneva. The bed was very comfortable. Internet was great too!
Appartement très agréable, très bien placé et idéal pour quelques jours à Genève ! Lara est agréable et très accueillante

The flat was really beautiful, spatious, centrally located, and very well-maintained. Beautiful, authentic and tasteful place to lay your head down. Right in the city center so you feel the city outside but it doesn't enter in a disturbing way. Lara is friendly and very discrete. Perfect.

Me encantó el departamento! Y el barrio es súper entretenido. Fue un placer y agrado alojarme donde Lara, una excelente anfitriona. Siempre muy atenta y responde rápidamente a los mensajes. El departamento es excelente, muy bien equipado y sumamente cómodo. Me sentí como en casa, definitivamente un lugar para volver si vuelvo a venir a ginebra. Muchas gracias Lara por la hospitalidad y haberme hecho sentir como en casa!

Lara ist eine Top-Gastgeberin: diskret, unglaublich freundlich und im Umgang absolut unkompliziert. Man fühlt sich sofort willkommen und bestens aufgehoben. Die Wohnung selbst ist eine Wohltat für die Augen. Wer den Charme von Altbauten liebt, wird hier begeistert sein. Die Einrichtung ist luxuriös, geschmackvoll und durchdacht – eine Ästhetik, die Ruhe ausstrahlt. Besonders hervorzuheben ist die Lage: mitten im lebendigen Plainpalais mit exzellenter Anbindung an den ÖV. Preis und Leistung stehen für Genfer Verhältnisse in einem hervorragenden Verhältnis. Wer eine stilvolle Unterkunft bei einer zuvorkommenden Gastgeberin sucht, ist hier goldrichtig. Ich komme sehr gerne wieder!

I felt very comfortable and the room is really lovely, there is a desk to work and a cupboard to hang up clothes.
The space is beautifully designed and very comfortable.
I was there for two weeks during a very busy work trip and always felt welcome.
The location is fantastic - lots of good food nearby and an amazing market over the weekends. It’s super well connected with 5 different tram lines within a few minutes walk.

Lara was incredibly flexible, discreet, and gracious. This was my first time staying in a shared flat using Airbnb, but the space was still very private and comfortable. Lara’s apartment is also beautifully decorated and clean. A great, convenient place to stay in Geneva.

J'ai partagé un mois dans le logement de Lucia. C'est une personne charmante et à l'écoute de ses hôtes. Vous êtes reçu dans un cadre chaleureux proche du centre ville de Genève.
La chambre et l'appartement de standing sont à l'image de Lucia.
Thanks Lucia, you have been a great host. Everything has been fine and I enjoyed talking to you. I highly recommend staying at your place.

I stayed with Lucia for a month while I was an intern in Geneva and it felt like home to me. When I first came to Lucia's place, I was welcomed with fresh fruit and a warm smile which was comforting when coming to a foreign country alone for the first time. She went out of her way to help me with anything I needed and we always had great conversations in the morning before I left. Anyone I meet that is going to Geneva I will recommend to stay with Lucia. She is an amazing woman and I will definitely come back to stay with her in the future!

Lucy is a wonderful host, it was nice talking with her and I loved her attentions for examples she prepared my room with water, fruits and cookies. The room is nice, clean and comfortable and the fact that breakfast is included in the daily fee has been really appreciated. The position of the flat is very convenient for who works at the UN or wants sightseeing, and 4 tram stops from Gare Cornavin. I will stay again at her place the next business time in Geneva. Highly recommended! Luca

Lucia a tout naturellement le sens de l'accueil. Malgré une arrivée tardive a cause d'un vol retardé, elle a su être compréhensive et être présente pour mon arrivée. La qualité de l'hébergement, son écoute et ses conseils m'ont permit de me sentir à l'aise et comme chez moi.
Je recommande fortement son logement et vous invite à prendre de votre temps pour découvrir cette magnifique personne. Merci pour tout Lucia et très bientôt.

This is a very nice family 'condo' with private bnb amenities (separate shower; toilet; and 2 guest rooms) on one side of the 9th floor facility. The individual bedrooms are equipped with king size beds, double closet and drawers, a love-seat, and a small work table and chair. Free WiFi is included and it works well.
The kitchen is well equipped and guests enjoy their own fridge and complete access to all small appliances, dishes and utensils. The host provides fresh fruit, fruit juices, cereals, yogart, and bread for toast along with a modern coffee maker.
You can purchase your own food-likes (or toiletries you forgot to bring) nearby at the CoOp store. There is a number of restaurants nearby as well as some sports-bars. It's a quiet, safe neighborhood were everyone greets you with a 'good day' or 'good evening' .
This bnb is located approximately 15 minutes from the airport and 15 minutes from the central station in town accessible via the local transportation system.

I felt great at Lucia's. She has a lovely flat with 2 spacious guest rooms with their own bathroom. It is located in a nice and quiet area, close to the UN (15mins) and the Central Station (10mins).
Lucia provided us with healthy breakfast every morning: fresh fruits, yogurt, toast and juice.
Most importantly, Lucia and her family are wonderful and made me feel like home.

El departamento impecable y decorado de muy buen gusto, combinado con una atmósfera relajada y natural proporcionada por Lucia y su familia hacen de esto, más que una estadía, ¡es una experiencia mucho más allá de grata! Fui por trabajo pero al momento de llegar era verdaderamente como llegar a casa o levantarme en casa. Buena compañía y conversación. Un surtido de ammenities y atenciones de parte de Lucia de primera calidad. ¡Gracias por esta excelente experiencia Lucia! ...Definitivamente a repetirse.
It was the second time I stayed at Lucia's and it was again extremely nice. The apartment was again perfect, exactly as I left it and Lucia warmly welcomed me back. Strongly recommend it
Como siempre, Lucía hace de cada momento una especial al estar en su hogar. Esta fue mi segunda estadía con Lucía y fue como volver a casa. ¡Muy a gusto!

I spent one month in the apartment and I had a wonderful experience. One of the best parts is getting to know Lucia and her family, who warmly welcomed me and made me feel at home. We even had a fun dinner party and cooked together (Lucia is a fantastic chef!). She is always available for tips on Geneva or if you need anything.

The room is comfortable with lots of light and plenty of space for storage. There is a nice couch for reading or relaxing and a desk to get some work done. The guest rooms are in a separate part of the apartment, so it is very quiet and private. The bathroom and shower are also nice, and I got used to the separate shower and WC. You have access to all amenities in the apartment, including full use of the kitchen, balcony, and living room. Lucia provides all the kitchen equipment you need and the breakfast food is always stocked and delicious. The apartment is kept perfectly clean, but you should expect to contribute to chores when you have used public areas like the kitchen.

The apartment is also very well located, with grocery stores right nearby and less than 5 minutes from a tram stop that will take you to the main train station or CERN directly, within walking distance to the Lake, the UN and all other sights. It's also very close to Geneva's hidden gem, Jonction.

The very few cons I would list are that the Wi-Fi is not particularly strong especially in my room, which was in the back. There is laundry, but only available at very particular times that were inconvenient for me. I would also say that the price is a bit expensive for what I've seen at other places. But these are very minor concerns compared to an overall positive experience.

Thank you so much Lucia!

Having just moved to Geneva, I stayed with Lucia for 2 months before finding my own place. Lucia was happy to help with the various formalities of relocating, which made the move a lot easier. The apartment is as described and is very well-kept. I will be recommending to friends and family when they visit! Many thanks and I'm sure I'll see you around!
Lovely home. Great host and spectacular location.
Lucia is lovely, communicative and flexible, and her apartment clean and well organized! Thank you!

I stayed at Lucia's for the second time. Her place is as clean and well organized as it was when I stayed the last time. Our exchanges were always warm and pleasant. Both she and her daughter were helpful and responsive to my questions. There was always a good balance of friendliness and respect of privacy. An extra point that I didn't mention the last time was that the bed is comfortable! Now that I have more experience with AirBnB, I also appreciate the attention that she puts on small details that matter: a box of tissues next to the bed, a variety of shampoos to use, a carafe of water on your desk, the fruits that she leaves in the bedroom to welcome you.. She was so sweet to give me a bottle of wine to enjoy at Christmas :-) Thanks, Lucia for another great stay.

L'appartement est dans une très bonne situation, il est facile à trouver, près de tous les transports du commun, et surtout près de l'aéroport et la gare. J'ai passé onze nuits chez Lucia dans la chambre la plus grande et elle me prépare déjà l'alimentation du petit-déjeuner avant mon arrivée. Et j'ai même goûté la cuisine de Lucia, génial aussi! J'ai passé un très bon séjour avec elle et sa fille. L'appartement est super propre, la chambre, la cuisine, la salle de bain et la toilette. On discute beaucoup sur pleins de sujets, en tout cas c'est un très bon moment! Merci beaucoup!
This was a great place to stay during my first week in Geneva. Christine was organised and the studio comfortable, and fairly quiet. I would definitely recommend it.
Perfect place to get around in Geneva. very clean , spacious and totally comfortable

Christine was a wonderful host! Upon my arrival, she met me at the studio to personally ensure I was acquainted with the apartment, building, and surrounding area. She was always available via text, and she promptly responded to/addressed any questions or concerns.
The studio is in an excellent location, and the description is very accurate. Multiple restaurants, bus stops, and grocery stores within 2-5 minutes walking distance! The lake and jet d'eau are also an easy 5-10 minute walk away.
I had a wonderful experience and would stay here again!

Lovely little studio in downtown. All was perfect.
Christine was very Kind.
Grazie

Great host and great place
Excellent Location! Kitchen very well equiped but Not Practicle. Christine is a pro-active host.

Christine's place is near the lake, and very well located (access to bus, tram, and near la Gare). It eased my transiton into settling in into Geneva, and the studio is perfect for one person (it has all you need). It is exceptionally clean, and the communication with Christine was great. I really recommend it, especially if you are new to Geneva.
A small, but quite cosy apartment. Suitable for short and long term stays. Christine is a lovely host, I enjoyed my stay.

Nice studio in a perfect location. Communication with Christine was very smooth and she’s very easy-going person. Apartment was very clean with all things you might need during your stay. The only thing that I didn’t like is very uncomfortable sofa bed.

Christine's place is in the perfect location. Walking distance from the center, the lake, and even the train station. Quiet neighborhood with many shops and restaurants nearby. I definitely recommend.

The studio is very well located, and has all the necessary ammenities. I spent two months there and I could not ask for more. Very quiet place, because the room is not directly facing the main road.The bed is huge and super comfortable. The kitchen is small, but very well equiped. The bathroom is really nice, and has a awesome bathtub. Once a week a cleaning lady comes by to make the place impecable! Christine is a great host. Very responsive and nice. Truly recommend the studio!

If you're looking for a perfectly-located, quiet, and comfortable place to stay in Geneva, this is it! This little studio is located on a small off-street so it is quiet and private. It is located above an (excellent) italian restaurant and is steps away from the Terrassière tram station, and it is in the vicinity of several other big bus/tram stops  that go all over Geneva. The building is quiet and the neighbors are friendly. The bed is large and comfortable, which is surprising for a pull-out sofa bed. This little studio has a surprising amount of storage space which makes it nice for long stays. The kitchen is small but well-equipped, with everything you might need : utensiles, plates, glasses, microwave, toaster oven. Christine was a lovely, flexible, and understanding host that responded to all of my questions and concerns within minutes. I would definitely stay here again and  I would recommend this studio to anyone.

Christine is a perfect and kind host. Always trying to please her guests. Communication with her was supersmooth. During my longer term stay (several months) I really enjoyed this place due to perfect location (jet d´eau just few minutes of walk distance, groceries up to 5 minutes walk). I would definitely recommend Christine and her husband as perfect hosts. Thank you Christine!
Nice studio
Great place for a professional looking for a short term unit. The place offers everything you need for day-to-day life and is placed in the heart of Geneva (restaurants, transportation)

I highly recommend this apartment! Perfect location with many options of restaurants, bars, cafes and markets around. All this very close to the apartment. Also, there are many options of buses and trams around the apartment. Very easy! The Geneva Lake is less than 10 minutes walking; the University of Geneva is 10 minutes walking. Communication with Christine was great. Always responded quickly and with clear guidelines besides being very friendly. The apartment is exactly as the photos show. Very equipped kitchen. New apartment. It is ideal for those who want to know Geneva or are in Geneva to work. I was there for 1 month and I staying there really improved my time in the city.

Mon séjour dans le logement de Christine s’est bien déroulé. Christine est très réactive et son bien correspond parfaitement à l’annonce et reste confortable pour des séjours de quelques mois. Je n’hésiterai pas à faire appel à elle lors de futurs déplacements à Genève.

Ce fut un plaisir de loger dans l’appartement de Christine. Idéalement, bien situé, bien entretenu et très bien équipé.
Christine a toujours été très réactive. Nous reviendrons avec plaisir!
很棒！

Christine’s place is amazing and in a perfect location where you can walk into the heart of Geneva. She was very responsive to any inquiries that I had and was very helpful. Thank you Christine for hosting me!

I had a great stay at this place. Christine Laure was a helpful and communicative host. The place is very well equipped including washer and dryer, hairdryer, clothes hanger and iron, which was a big plus for a longer stay.
The apartment was off the main street so quiet at night, but still in a very central location close to shops and transport. The apartment was also more spacious than I expected.
Overall a very pleasant stay and good value for Geneva.
Hôte professionnelle proposant un logement en plein centre de Genève tout équipé. Recommande fortement.

Christine was very helpful in the moments that I needed which were very few. She gave me solutions in no time and was always willing to help. The place was comfortable and cozy, easy access to the street and walkable distance from the city centre and the lake. The location was actually excelent, even the public transport was accesible.
The only problem I had, which was very specific to me was the kitchen space. I stayed for a month and needed to cook lunch and dinner and the counter space is very limited so cutting meat and veggies was pretty hard and uncomfortable because I needed to cut either in very limited space or in the dining table which was pretty low. But other than that the place was incredible and the host was super friendly and helpful.

Christine’s place is perfectly set up for a long stay, and situated in an ideal location, making it very easy to get around Geneva, either by public transport or on foot. The bed is comfortable and the apartment is more spacious than it looked in the photos.  It was easy to work in the apartment when I needed to. There is plenty of storage space and the kitchen, though small, is well-equipped. I had a great 2-month stay, and recommended the place to my friends.

Unbeatable place -- best value for money found in Geneva so far. Outstanding location in the middle of the lively university-area of Plainpalais, but in a quiet side street that makes sleeping very silent. Plenty of bright natural light. Excellent for short stays of solo travellers and young couples.
Communication was outstanding with Sophie-Marie, who went out of her way in keeping me updated on the check in instructions despite a serious inconvenience that occurred to her just a couple of days my check in. She was also very accommodating regarding my request of late check in.
The apartment itself is as described, small but cute and functional. I found it clean and wifi worked very well. The sofa-bed where I slept is a bit tired but still was good enough for me. I did not use the kitchen but it looks okay for one or two people. I use to go frequently in Geneva and this is so far my favourite option.

The biggest advantage of this studio is the price-quality ratio. You will get what you see on the pictures: not very modern and clean apartment, but still a nice place to stay. The studio is located in the city center on a quiet street with many restaurants and shops nearby. The host was very attentive and always ready to help, and I am very thankful to Sophie and her husband Henry for this stay!
Great place, exactly what I expected. It's very practical and the host is amazing, I'll more than certainly be back.

Great Host in a central location of Geneva. 10 min walk from the old City and not much more from the lake.
The location itself is right at the door of the tourist point of interests. Flat is very nice in a calm street with a very communicative owner. Ideal for young couple or solo Traveller. Sophie is a great person if you need help to kick start your tour in Geneva.
Basic apartment in the lovely Plainpalais area of Geneva.  Communication with Sophie-Marguerite was very efficient and the check-in went very smoothly.

Very good location in the center of Geneva! Just 10 minutes by tram from the railway station "Genève Cornavin". Smooth communication with Sophie-Marguerite by mobile phone. Room was clean and functional.  Would be perfect if the sofa-bed renewed.
Well-located studio and a very responsive host.

This studio is decent for short stays, the host is responsive and the location is great with lots of shops, bars, markets, transport options etc nearby.  The sofa bed is new but very hard so this may be an issue for people who like softer beds. The two biggest downsides in staying there for a few weeks were the kitchen, which if you want to cook is very small and missing some essentials, and the level of cleanliness (the studio would seriously benefit from a really deep clean by professionals). To use the washing machine in the building you need to buy a prepaid card so if you're not staying long it doesn't make sense, but there is a good laundromat a few minutes walk away.

C'est une excellente adresse. L'appartement est au 4e étage avec ascenseur. Il est très facile à trouver grâce aux indications de Sophie et aux instructions sur l'annonce. L'appartement est petit mais très fonctionnel.  C'est un très bon rapport qualité. Le quartier est animé et l'appartement est quand même au calme. I stayed at Lucia’s place for almost 3 months (84 nights); my general conclusion would be that her place is a good one for short-term stays, but not as good for long-term stays as there are many restrictions. There are few things that people should bear on mind when booking her room for longer terms. Here I list + vs. -
PLUSES (+):
PLACE: clean place, with cleaning service included. Cleaning lady was very freindly and respectful. Bedsheets and towels were provided as promised. Breakfast was also included (for “buts” please see below).
FLEXIBILITY: Host showed some degree of flexibility in problematic situations (please see “other notes”).
MINUSES (-):
BREAKFAST: quite a monotonic & non-diverse & not very nutritious to my taste. It included yogurt, cereals, coffee/tea, bread, jam and butter. Yogurt was also same each day (until I asked for a change).
WI-FI: Extremely poor connection in the room. Additional unpleasant experience for me was that she didn’t do anything to improve the connection despite the fact I mentioned and complained several times.
LAUNDRY: Prior booking the place, I asked if there was a laundry available, and was told that yes. However, it wasn’t mentioned that laundry is actually available only on Wednesdays mornings. For someone who isn’t there for a holiday, and has a work/study obligations, this only option isn’t very good one. My disappointment was that she didn’t inform beforehand. The positive thing in this situation was the compromise of using her washing machine, but still with restrictions which were: using the washing machine every second week, only on Sunday mornings, and no more than one machine, and only if it was full; or two machines if drier isn’t used.
GUESTS: There is an additional charge if you want a friend/spouse/partner to stay over. The price is 30 € per person per night.
OTHER NOTES:
COMPENSATION: In order to compensate for the restrictions described above, I was allowed to have two friends on a same weekend for two nights free of charge (compensation of 120 €; for comparison: my total costs for renting her place were 4864,69 € for 84 nights).
CONCLUSION: Host’s overall approach wasn’t welcoming. Price is too high for the services she provides (or doesn’t provide). With all those restrictions, the room should be far cheaper.
I wouldn’t recommend the place for long-term stays. Based on my experience, longest period for stay without any problems/complications would be mostly a month.
Please have also on mind that Geneva isn’t a big city, so distance wouldn’t be a problem no matter where one stays.
I hope this review will help and guide people in choosing their accommodation. My aim is fair prices, fair accommodation, fair treatment for all parts involved.
Respectfully,
Jasmina

This cause a problem for Philippe, as he had a cleaner ready to come is exactly at 9am to get the place ready for the next guest at 12pm. He made it clear to me in phone calls and texts that this was a major problem for him and I apologized. It was really not my intention to cause such a problem for the host.
I recommend Philippe's flat if you are in Geneva in the winter time, and perhaps for holiday and not for business.

Great

Great location, very clean and modern apartment in the heart of the Old Town! We didn't meet Marc but his colleague Ms Prost was very welcoming and friendly. We thoroughly enjoyed our stay here! Check-in and check-out was hassle free. Everything was organized well by Andrea. Apartment is in a convenient place close to public transport and shops.

It was simply wonderful staying at Andrea's place. After a long week of meetings and conference rooms, I was delighted to arrive at his calm, welcoming and spacious apartment to de-stress. Andrea was very helpful in enabling us to stay at his apartment at short notice when there was a problem with another location. Andrea is a perfect host, always available and gentle! He's house is big, with a perfect position close to the city center and it's clean and comfortable! I would highly recommend this accomodation to anyone wants to spend some times in Geveve!

We found the apartment really nice and in a good nighboorhood - close to city center, transport and the lake. The apartment is nice and cosy with all necessary facilities. Easy to get the key and Andrea responded very fast to our late booking and our other inquiries.
Will definitely recommend the place to others :)
Andrea a été un hôte parfait, la maison était agréable et l'emplacement comportait de nombreuses commodities. Bon séjour en somme.

We live in Geneva and we couldn't welcome the visitors so we turned to airbnb and were happy to stumble upon Andrea's add.

Thanks Andrea

Amazing stay! Andrea is very kind and a perfect host!

Place was exactly as pictured - really convenient location and comfortable place to stay with all the essentials you need in an apartment.  Getting into the space, etc. was easy and flexible as well!  Highly recommend it as an affordable, well-located space to stay in Geneva.

The apartment was spacious and everything was prepared as was promised.
