Le séjour que nous avons fait à Genève était très satisfaisant. L'appartement est t'es bien situé, et spacieux. Notre hôte n'était pas là donc nous ne pouvons que dire qu'il était très bien organisé et disponible en tout temps.

This was my second time at this apartment. The location is great for me. And Andrew is easy to work with.

Good location,calm at night,worth it.

Nice and romantic place to stay. Nearly no car is driving in the area, so this is a very quiet location. Communication with Marc was very easy and everything went fine though I didn't see anyone! Thanks Marc

Thank you, Marc! I had a wonderful stay in your beautiful suite, which was very comfortable, peaceful and easy to navigate! The location is amazing, right in the middle of the stunning old town. I would definitely book to stay here, next time! Thank you :-)
Bel emplacement
Un très joli lieu au coeur de la vieille ville. J'ai passé un séjour très agréable, de la réservation en passant par l'accueil, tout s'est passé parfaitement.

In a simple word the flat is PERFECT!
Central position, clean an gorgeous flat. Perfect service.
Great place to stay in the center of the old town

My stay was a last minute addition of a few days to the end of a work trip. The location is picturesque beyond compare, directly opposite the cathedral in the old town. The apartment is compact but quite stylishly furnished and offers everything you may need for a short stay. Good value for money too compared to hotels nearby. I loved the Studio! It's location is great. You need to take into consideration the it's on top of a hill.
Any time again!
I spent three days in Geneva for the first time, it was an exceptional stay! This place is historic, convenient, clean and comfortable! Recommend to anyone.
Very exclusive location in Geneva with a lot of nice Restaurants in walking distance. Very well kept flat and nice interiour.

Our stay exceeded expectations - the location by the Cathedral in the old town is second to none, and the apartment was perfect - spacious, clean and with excellent amenities. Marc's place was 90% and I am a bit of a perfectionist and an experienced AirBnB host myself so perhaps I have been a bit harsh with my comments. Please do not anything I say put you off as I suspect this place is pretty good as Geneva is a really expensive city

Oh my! What an absolute gem we found in Marc's beautiful apartment. By far our favorite Airbnb find yet. Idyllic location and ambiance, and perfectly appointed space. Lots of old town listings boast a "cathedral view", but this is the best view you can get!! Can't wait to come back!

Great location. Just in front of the fantastic Cathedral. Description of the accomodation perfect. Great flexibility and availabiliy from Marc.

Marc was fantastic- very helpful and accommodating. Communication is okay, Marc doesn't respond as fast as other Airbnb hosts I've dealt with, but he responds.

The place is absolutely wonderful ! I would recommend it to everybody. The place itself is tidy and has all the basic amenities one would need. The wifi signal is good too. There's 1 queen bed in the living room and a double bunk bed in the bedroom. The kitchen is equipped with utensils and some seasonings. Overall, this place is a good place to stay.

Clean and good location but the listing is very misleading. It says there is two bedrooms but really one of the bedrooms is the living room where a double bed takes up most of the room. We had to sit on the bed to eat. The green couch in the pictures in the second "bedroom" is actually a bunk bed which takes up most of the space in that room as well. The shower in the bathroom was really nice and was the best part of the apartment -- the shower head changes colour based on the temperature of the water.

The place is in a lovely location.. Right at the cathedral in the old town.. Lots of restaurants around. The place is very nice, clean and comfortable. The communication was clear and regular. No problems at all.

Andrew's house was exquisite. Well located and made us feel like a local instantly. He was also very generous with his kitchen which had a world class collection of tea and coffee! This apartment is great for a few days in Geneva! The location could not be better - you are literally steps from the St. Pierre Cathedral and its accompanying excavation site as well as the museum of the reformation. In fact, we were so close at the museum that our phones unintentionally connected back to the apartment's wifi network! The lake is also close by within only about a five minute walking distance, and several trams stop very close to the apartment that can take you to other parts of the city. We could not have stayed at any better place! The building has a very unique feel as it has stone walls and floors in the foyer and is in the heart of the old city. The apartment is a bit tight for four adults (as another review stated, the main room holds the double/queen bed which takes up much of the space, and the second bedroom that looks like a couch in the picture pulls out into the bunk beds and is also a bit small). However, we were easily able to make this work even with large suitcases. Check-in and check-out were easy, as was communicating with Marc in the days leading up to the trip. Overall, I would enthusiastically recommend this apartment, and we would definitely stay here again if we return to Geneva.
We loved the beauty of the old town and close access to shopping areas.

Really nice flat with all you need.

Great location! Right in center of old town, near St Pierre cathedral. I was able to walk to the lake. Bus and trams stops are nearby. Nice, clean apt.

Marc responded immediately to my initial, last minute request to book and to additional requests during our stay. After a couple of nights we needed more supplies and they were provided within the hour. The apartment is cozy, clean, and had plenty of shelves to unpack and feel at home. The location is right in the middle of Old Town directly across from the entrance to St. Peter's Cathedral. We walked everywhere - to the lake, Manor and Globus grocery stores, the train station, museums, and restaurants. The sightseeing train stops in front of the apartment - a very convenient place to hop on! The washer/dryer unit, friendly housekeeping service, and location made it just perfect for our last few nights in Geneva. FYI: The Cathedral bells ring on the hour, EVERY hour, and the younger late night crowd can be loud especially when you need the windows open to keep cool in the summer. We didn't mind the noise - it's unique to Old Town and the price you pay for such a prime location. I recommend paying the few extra CHF to climb the tower for a glimpse of the bells and incredible views of Geneva . . . you'll appreciate the sound of the bells after your visit!
Very nice apartment, and great location. All essentials were provided and easy and smooth checkin process.

Marc was a great communicator from the start of the process, answering all my questions within minutes. Everything in the apartment was as described and as shown in the photos – there were even some chilled juices in the fridge, and coffee/teas and sweet treats in the kitchen, which were very welcome after a hot journey. Marc had also arranged for an air conditioning unit which we didn't ask for but which again was very welcome. Location was perfect, overlooking the pretty cathedral square, a few minutes' walk to the main shopping area (including food shops such as the Co-op and Migros, so very handy), excellent TPG (bus/tram/boat/train) connections, lots of restaurants and the lake. Cathedral bells are not a problem despite what others have said – not loud at all, in fact they add ambience. The area felt very safe, even at night, and the apartment building is very secure – outer door, inner door, lift and then apartment door (multi-locked) – and surprisingly quiet for a city centre. Comfy beds, nice seating area for breakfast, well-equipped kitchen and very clean bath/shower room. We also bumped into several of the other residents in the building who were very friendly (as everyone seemed to be in Geneva). Travel tip… collect your free bus/train ticket at Geneva airport arrivals, catch the no. 10 bus to Molard or the no. 5 to Place de Neuve (25 minutes) and walk the 5 minutes to the apartment. The old town is a little hilly but that's a large part of its charm. You can also catch a train which takes about 10 minutes to get to Cornavin, but then you'd have to get a short bus connection or take a longer walk. You can buy Geneva Passes at the airport which also cover you for free public transport and lots of other stuff – our passes easily paid for themselves. To summarise – ideal apartment for three; clean, comfortable, secure, quiet. Everything is walkable. Great public transport to/from the airport and other excursions. Overall Marc's place was perfect for us and highly recommended – we'll probably be back for a longer stay. Thanks Marc!

We would most highly recommend staying here. We especially loved the location. Being in Old Town Geneva was a highlight of out trip. Wonderful atmosphere, great restaurants and interesting sights. I guarantee you will have a great experience at Gabriela's apartment!
1. Introduction
Let me first introduce myself. I am a Japanese person who has been working for an international organization in Geneva since May.
I stayed in Gabriela's apartment for about 40 days until I found a place to settle down in Geneva.
2. Private room
The room is about 17 square meters in size, which is plenty of space. There is a wardrobe and plenty of storage shelves, making it ideal for long-term stays.
The large queen-size bed has a firm mattress for a comfortable night's sleep. Clean, ironed sheets and pillowcases can be changed once a week.
There are teleworking desks and chairs available, and I had several online meetings and did not encounter any problems with the internet connection.
3. Common areas
As described under "Amenities and Facilities."
Gabriela is a neat and clean person, and the entire apartment, not just the private rooms, are always kept clean.
The bathrooms are very spacious and the shower temperature and water pressure are perfect.
The kitchen is fully equipped with all utensils and you can use part of the refrigerator and freezer, so you can enjoy cooking at your leisure every day.
Many plants are placed on the veranda, and you can also enjoy resting and relaxing while admiring the beautiful trees.
Privacy is also completely maintained. I had no past experience renting a private room type on Airbnb, so I was initially looking for a whole room to rent out. Also, some of you may not want to interact with the hosts too much. But don't worry. The private rooms can be locked and the hosts are very considerate of your privacy and will not intervene unless you speak to them. I understand that there is a lot of anxiety when you stay in Geneva for the first time because of all the things you don't know. I would rather stay in a private room because the host will give you a lot of information about life in Geneva.
4.Surroundings
"Bellevue" is a quiet residential area with a rich natural environment. Every morning you can wake up to the beautiful chirping of birds. Except for the sound of airplanes, there is very little noise from neighbors or cars.
During my property search, I previewed almost all areas of Geneva (Lancy, Meyrin, Cornavin, Aux-Vives, Chêne-Bourg, Champel,Onex, Grand-Saconnex, Vernier, Versoix, Cologny, Collex-Bossy...etc) and I thought Bellevue was the number one area. However, because it is such a popular area that even the locals are attracted to it, rents are very high if you want to sign a contract for your own apartment. Despite this, the cost of staying at Madame Gabriela's apartment is very cheap and conscientious. Before booking this apartment, I looked for an apartment in a central location, such as near the Cornavin station, but I found the rooms to be small and noisy for the high price. I chose Bellevue for my stay and it was a great decision.
5. Access
The nearest Bus stop (Bellevue GE, Valavran) is about a 10 minute walk. You will pass through a large park (green field), so there is no traffic at all.
The nearest Train Station (Genthod-Bellevue) is about an 8 minute walk. You will pass through a tunnel of trees and a path in the woods with a small stream running through it. It is as if a trekking course has suddenly appeared in a residential area. The path is well maintained, and I envy the fact that residents here can take this route to the station every day.
I really enjoy the route to the bus stop and station. The fresh breeze and the sound of the leaves rustling in the trees give me a sense of peace.
Below are the main means of access
-From the airport to the apartment: bus No. 50 (no transfers)
*In my case, I took a taxi from the airport because I had four suitcases on the first day of check-in, and I remember it cost about 25 francs.
-From the apartment to international organizations (UN, WHO, ILO, TIU, etc.): bus No.20 (no transfers)
-From the apartment to the Cornavin train station: bus No.20 (no transfers) or train (usually you can get there by taking a train going south).
6. Host
Gabriela used to work for an international organization, so she has a lot of knowledge about international organizations. She also combines a lot of education and knowledge.
She is very attentive and always gave me a warm welcome and was always willing to help me.
She was also very kind to me, knowing that I was having a hard time finding a property and trying to accommodate my schedule.
Her wonderful personality made my stay an enjoyable one.
7. Others
It is very difficult to list any disadvantages of this apartment.
The only thing I can mention is that there is no supermarket nearby?
However, Geneva has a well-developed transportation network, and with a commuter pass, you can easily access supermarkets, so in my case, I had no problems.
8. Conclusion
When I was a high school student, I did a one-month homestay in Australia and had a wonderful experience.
Staying in Gabriela's apartment brought back those good old memories.
It was like being at home with a family and I had a comfortable 40 days.
I would definitely recommend everyone to stay in this lovely apartment.
Thank you so much for everything!

The rooms are spacious, clean and the kitchen is well-equiped. The WiFi was very stable and fast. Finally, Pedro was very responsive.  Would definitely come here again.

This was my first experience using Air BNB and I could not have been more thrilled with 1) the timely communication and help Pedro provided, and 2) the apartment! The location is unbeatable. The space was more than I had anticipated and was very welcoming. Pedro had maps and restaurants available for us, all of which was extremely useful. Outstanding overall. Thank you, Pedro!
The apartment is really nice, the pictures matches with the place and the neiborhood is great. You can do everything by foot, so close to manu places.

The apartment was great as my home, all you need is around the place, moreover Geneva lake is a few meter walking .
I enjoy the stay and I recommend it.

Pedro made our stay in Geneva very easy. He was always available to exchange messages and the apartment was exactly as described. We found it clean and tidy with everything working as expected. Thanks, Pedro.

Before arriving, Pierre provided useful information about transportation and how to get to his loft. Once we arrived to the loft, we met with Pierre and he provided us with booklets and maps. Very nice guy and very nice apart ment with a spectacular view of Geneva.

To be short, then everything is the best!

Мое пребывание в квартире Pierre было восхитительным. Хозяина не видел, но в переписке он был очень вежлив и обходителен, описал все очень подробно, отвечал на мои вопросы.

Квартира очень просторная для Женевы. Находится на крыше 7-ми этажного дома, огромные окна с двумя террасами выходят на две стороны. Получается великолепный обзор города. Видно все окрестные горы (даже Мон-Блан), фонтан.

Недалеко от дома, через дорогу от подъезда, есть магазин Denner. В квартале южнее есть Migros. Остановка общественного транспорта (Canonniere, автобус 8) буквально в двух шагах от подъезда. Недалеко останавливается автобус 5, на котором можно быстро добраться до аэропорта. В квартале южнее есть остановка других автобусов и трамваев. Я предпочитал ходить пешком. От дома до вокзала можно дойти за 10-15 мину, причем можно выбрать путь целиком через парки.

В квартире я нашел все, что мне нужно было для комфортного пребывания. На кухне есть холодильник, плита, микроволновка, посуда, специи и пр. Единственно, не нашел чайника, но микроволновка мне его заменила. Широкая кровать с удобным матрасом. В гостиной удобные диваны и кресла. Закрыться от яркого солнца можно автоматическими рольставнями.

Yes, the host made us feel welcome, poured us glasses of water, and showed us around the flat. You can catch the bus right downstairs and the train station is 10-minute walk. There's a charming coffee shop right around the corner.
Great place, central location, lovely airy apartment.

Pierre's place is perfect! It's exactly as beautiful as the photos suggest and it has plenty of room for relaxing, dining, etc.
It's quiet because it's at the top of the building and it gets gorgeous sunlight all day with huge windows on both sides.
Close to the UN buildings and great public transport connections to others places of interest in Geneva.
Pierre was super easy to communicate with, access was simple - I was even left some dinner for my first night.
Very highly recommended!!
Excellent appartement et endroit. Propre et bien aménagé. Parfaite arrivée avec toutes les indications fournies! J'espère pouvoir retourner
We had a very pleasant stay at the lovely appartment of Pierre. It has a nice location and Pierre is wonderfull host.
The apartment was just as promised. This is a wonderful place.

Pierre’s place is conveniently located, next to Denner supermarket, walking distance from Gare Cornavin station, and few bus stops from United Nations and WHO. The apartment is very clean and nice. He’s also very helpful during our stay. We are very satisfied. Highly recommended.

Pierre is an amazing host! The location of the apartment is unbeatable with supermarket, main Cornavin station and the UN venue close by and walkable. We appreciate the comfort and the coziness the apartment has to offer during our work trip. Thanks for the great experiences :)
Tout était parfait, appartement impeccable, deux magnifiques terrasses et hôte très prévenant, réactif et attentionné. C'est avec plaisir que nous reviendrons dans cet appartement.

The apartment is located on the top floor of the building. On both sides is a large balcony with sliding doors. The apartment has everything you need for your stay. It has a lot of space, a sitting area and a dining room table, separate kitchen and bedroom, bathroom and an additional separate toilet. The wifi is fast and the location excellent to reach the city centre and the UN easily. Buses in different directions stop in front of the building and around the corder. The only thing that we found less comfortable was the bed. The mattress  is quite thin and the bed frame not so sturdy. Other than that I highly recommend to stay here.

Bright & spacious indeed!  A clean, fantastic flat with all amenities necessary for a home-like stay in Geneva.  Further, it's central location makes most of Geneva accessable by foot, if not by bus.  And while I was not there in warmer weather, I would imagine that the two (yes, TWO!) patios would provide hours of enjoyment. Pierre was a wonderful host - I would highly recommend this place.
Pierre’s apartment is very nice! Great location, spacious and super comfortable. I highly recommend staying there.
I really enjoyed the space, especially the rooftop terrace.

Pierre's apartment is bright, well furnished, spacious and properly maintained . The two balconies offered a great spot to relax after a hectic day. Pierre was always helpful and responsive to queries and provided very clear instructions. I appreciated being able to check in early.
Unfortunately without a fan in the middle of a heatwave, it was very difficult to have restful sleep (despite all recommended measures for cross ventilation, avoiding heat trap etc) The bedroom is West facing and got the brunt of the afternoon sun. I suggest having a misting fan available for guests especially during this extraordinary period of extreme heat.. A minor suggestion too is to have a small shelf and space for hanging clothes for guests staying more than 3 days so personal articles can better organised.
Thank you Pierre for being attentive to all my needs and queries !
a very nice place with two balconies and everything you need. very close to a bus and a tram stations, and the central train station is in 15 minutes walking. would definitely recommend.

Traveled for business. No space to hang clothes, but that wasn’t a big issue for me. It was cozy, very nice, and everything I needed. Lots of sunlight. Great spot to work from during the day as well. Would stay again!

Great central place in Genève but no value for money. You are babysitting the home of someone on holiday who doesn’t even leave space for your clothes to hang! The bed is smelly and the place is full of their stuff. A hotel would have been better

Sandrine’s apartment is super clean! Located at a quiet neighborhood but very convenient.  restaurants, bars, cafes and supermarkets ( 3 of them)  are all nearby. The kitchen is well equipped.  Our kids enjoyed the toys provided at the playroom. It is a great experience to stay at Sandrine’s place. Highly recommended for the family with kids!

Incredible location!  We could walk everywhere - close to train station, lake and other sights. There was a lift to get to the second floor so we didn’t have to carry our luggage. Sandrine responded to all our inquiries and someone was there to meet us upon arrival. The apartment was spacious and had beautiful artwork and other touches. There was no air conditioning but fans were provided and the beds were very comfortable. We loved our stay there.

great location near Geneva Cornavin.  Easy walk to the lake and old town Geneva.  Very fast response from host.  The place is very nicely decorated.   Check in was easy with host greeting at the same location.

We loved Sandrine’s home! Full of beautiful art work and located at an easy walking distance from the train station and the water front. Awesome for kids as there are bunk beds and a play room. We also loved Remo Pizza across the street and the Coop grocery store is an easy walking distance away.

I had a wonderful time staying at Med's. The apartment was very clean, close to the city center and situated right along the river. Med was also very friendly and helpful. He told me everything I needed to know about the neighborhood and left me with a long list of exciting places to see in Geneva. I got a lot more than I expected and I highly recommend Med's place to anyone visiting Geneva for short or long periods. I definitely plan on staying here if I'm ever in town again.
I had a great experience at Med's flat. It is well located, view on the river with small balcony oriented south. The tramway stops are close. He was very kind and always available for any request.

My family and I stayed at Meds' apartment in Carouge for a month while searching for a new home. We were moving to Geneva from New Jersey. His apartment comfortably accommodated four people as he had 2 bedrooms. His apartment is fully equipped with a washer/dryer, dishwasher, linens, towels, plates, pans, and a great wifi. The neighborhood is very safe, convenient, and close to the City Center with several tram options close to the apartment. The apartment is very clean. Most of all, our host was the best! He is so responsive and generous and ensured that we were enjoying our stay. I would highly recommend his apartment to anyone planning to stay in Geneva.

Med is a very considerate host. He answers emails and calls promptly and took great care to ensure that I was comfortable.

The apartment itself is in an excellent location-with a gorgeous tree lined view over the River Arve, a two minute walk from the charming neighbourhood of Carouge and a few minutes from various tram and bus connections. Med has equipped the flat very well, including an espresso machine and beautiful tapestries.

I would highly recommend the apartment and the host, especially for travellers who have a long stay in Geneva. It is excellent value for the price and is not only comfortable but in a rare location.

Med is a very nice guy, even he only writes in French, but there's always a google translate. Actually, his spoken English is very good. His apartment was perfect for me and my husband, we had everything we needed.  The location is great too, easy to get around, nicely located by the lake, we even walked to many places without any hassle.

Commentaire de Catherine, mère d'Anne-Laurence: Med est fort complaisant et a à cœur d'offrir à son hôte un excellent accueil et de lui assurer une ambiance chaleureuse dans son appartement .
Appartement calme, fort bien situé, bien desservi et doté d'une vue agréable. Propre. Confortable.
Everything was perfect. Med is very nice and reliable. Immediate responses. Locacation and appartment perfect for my purposes.

Absolutely perfect apartment in a quiet, comfortable, and accessible area of Geneva! Next to a gorgeous river with several restaurants within a five minute walk. The neighborhood of Carouge is just across the river, with even more bars, cafes, jazz clubs and brunch spots. Really a rare and valuable find in Geneva! I absolutely recommend staying here if you can!

Med is an amazing host, and the apartment is even better! Not only was the apartment exactly as described, including all the essentials for a long term stay (kitchen utensils and appliances, sheets, towels, washing machine, clothes drying rack, etc) but the neighborhood is amazing! The proximity to the river is fabulous, there's a wonderful little bakery just behind the apartment, as well as a small "convenience" store that is open late and on Sundays, and has a comprehensive array of food and household products.

This is a truly rare and lovely find in Geneva, and you'll be lucky if you can get it!

Med's place provides an excellent taste of one of the best areas in Geneva while being comfortable, clean, and complete with all of the amenities that one would want for a long-term stay. I have stayed in and around Geneva for many years and can honestly say that this is one of the best places you could get in the city.
Perfect location, really nice host and best value for money I've ever seen in Geneva!

I stayed in the apartment for a month for work. Med was really responsive and met me on arrival, he is very welcoming. The only downside was the internet being somewhat unreliable. Med did his best to fix it but the signal is the problem. I could use it but not at certain times. If you need fast reliable internet especially at night then know this can be an issue. There are plenty of cafes nearby with good wifi if needed. It is across the road from the river and the little balcony was a great place to sit. The afternoon sun streams into the apartment which I loved.

I had a great time staying at Med's place in Geneva! The flat looked even better than the pictures (bathroom is newly renovated) and the view from the balcony is wonderful! This is a fantastic space whether you're in town for work or vacation. Great location near planpalais  with a 24/7 boulangerie just across the street! Which is unheard of in Geneva. close to tram lines and the space is clean and spacious with all the amenities you might need. Med is a superb host, very kind and responsive and went out of his way to give me tips about the city,  accommodate my check in time and answer any questions that I had! Would totally recommend it and stay here again! Thanks a lot Med.

Astonishingly beautiful apartment. Perfect location and the best value I have yet to see in Geneva. I have probably spent around a year in various Airbnb‘s during my work in Geneva and this was by far the best. Book it!
Lovely hosts, great location, wonderful apartment. I highly recommend.

Michiel is an incredibly hospitable host and I really recommend staying with him. If you are looking for long term, or to do a lot of cooking, or will need to be regularly living in the apartment, it may not have everything you'd need or expect.  The location is superb - near lots of bus lines and the river - and Michiel was very accommodating.
Great place. Great location. Great host. Go for it !
Great location.  So near the business district and near great bars and restaurants.

Michiel’s place is very charming and quiet. It is a central location. There are many restaurants and bars in the area. You can walk and discover. I would recommend this place for a great moment in Geneva.
The location of the place and the apartment itself are perfect! Highly recommend Michiel as a host!
Great location and Michiel is a friendly and helpful host.

We loved staying at Michiel’s Home.  He was there to greet us which made checking in super easy and relaxing.   Excellent communication before checking in and extremely responsive when we were there.  The home is spacious,  very comfortable and a great  location- lots of restaurants, bars and public transportation.  We hope to stay there again soon.
The place is very good located! Michel was nice to waiting me for check in! The flat is bigger than I expected! The flat need a little lightning upgrade! I will stay there again.

Le collaborateur qui a logé dans l'appartement a été ravi de son séjour de plusieurs semaines chez Michiel. La communication avec l'hôte a été très fluide et simple et son accueil très chaleureux. L'appartement est très beau et parfaitement situé dans Genève. Nous le recommandons vivement!

Wonderful stay at this lovely apartment for 1 week. The location is perfect and very well located to everything you would like to see in Geneva. Michiel was very accommodating for an early check-in and lots of restaurant recommendations. Lovely, well designed and extremely clean apartment. The bed is also extremely comfortable. Highly recommend.
Great location.

Great host super location walking distance to everything very clean great contact with Michiel we were travelling with a 2 year old and we had all we could ask for. Apartment is really spacious and sunny with a big well equiped kitchen in a very safe central area. Public transport to airport and train station just 2 blocks away or even walking distance. It just ended up to be a great choice.

Great location close to the outdoor market, grocery stores, and very easy to take public transportation.  The apartment is exactly as advertised and very clean. Michiel was very responsive and helpful.
Great communication with Michiel during our month stay. Lovely apartment and super well located. Warning to elderly guests as there is no lift and it’s 3 floor walk up.

The flat is ideal for staying in Geneva with easy access to the Old Town by foot and public transport is just round the corner to get anywhere you need to. It is in a student part of town so it can be noisy in the evenings, but it means there is no shortage of good bars and restaurants in the area to enjoy. Michiel is a great host and will be quick to support you with any questions you have!

Hanan was a very kind and welcoming host, when I stayed at her and her husband's place for one night. I liked the place a lot, the room was clean and comfortable and a very good choice for someone looking for a quiet and affordable place to stay in Geneva. Hanan's place is about half an hour bus ride away from the city center and can be reached effortless with public transport. I would love to stay again at the place and highly recommend it to any Geneva-traveler!
Accueil très chaleureux, chambre très confortable, hôte très sympa, je recommande à 100%

Hanan and her husband are very nice and welcoming people. The room is enough big, clean and quiet. TV and wifi work properly. I felt very soon among members of my family. I'll go back there with pleasure. Thank you Hanan and Magdi!

Hanna is friendly and willing to help me. The location is not near the city center but it's convenient to travel to the center by transportation. I lived in a single room in her apartment with her husband and her. It's on the sixth floor with an elevator. A little problem is that I couldn't lock the door. Anyway, it's a good choice under a tight budget.
Hannan is a nice person,helpful and kind,recomend this accommodation

Ottima sistemazione, famiglia molto tranquilla, esperienza decisamente positiva.
Super maison, famille très calme, expérience très positive.
Great accommodation, very quiet family, very positive experience.

I was the first time in Geneva and have felt very well at Hanan and her family. It's all very clean and tidy and Hanan and her husband are very helpful hosts. It´s only a short way to the next bus stop and not far to the city center. When I am next time in Geneva it may well be that I will stay again at Hanan. Highly recommended. Thank you very much.

Hanan was a fantastic host - she went above and beyond to make me feel at home. She went out of her way to show me the nearby bus stop and supermarket so I would not have trouble finding them the next say. She invited me to join her and her family for dinner and introduced me to real swiss cheese.
Hanan et toute sa famille ont été très accueillant et chaleureux pendant tout le séjour. un hôte exceptionnel. j'y retrounerai les yeux fermés et avec beaucoup de plaisir.

Hanan and her husband Magdi were the most fantastic hosts and went above and beyond what is normal for an airbnb rent. They made me feel at home in their beautiful apartment, I had access to everything I needed (kitchen/bathroom/bedroom). I tasted some of their delicious Egyptian and Swiss cuisine! It worked perfectly because I was in Geneva for one month working at the university from 9am-7pm. The bus to university (Sciences II, quai Ernest something) took 20 mins at rush hour, 15 mins before 8am, really quick! (it's probably only a 30 min but I never did it) and other trams and buses into town were 5 mins away. The public transport system in Geneva is great during the day, and not too expensive. After 9-10pm you have to plan in advance when to take the bus, or wait for 20 minutes (that's a long wait of a Londoner). The apartment is close to supermarkets, pharmacies, a beautiful wood to go jogging in (Evaux), and a view of the mountains from the balcony!
You will not be in the apartment on your own, Hanan, Magdi and their daughter are often around (in the apt.) in the evenings, so no partying without them being included!
I will miss them all and Geneva dearly!
Hanan was a wonderful host and I felt part of the family and I can only recommend Hanan as a perfect example what Airbnb is.
This was great place and people to stay with. The room was nice and comfortable. Totally recommend this room for 1 person visiting ginevra.

An absolutely wonderful place to stay if you're travelling by yourself and looking to roam Geneva. I got to enjoy amazing dinners with her family on most nights, and Hanan also helped me figure out the local transport system. The surrounding area is beautiful and Hanan's apartment has some great views of the area. Overall, a fantastic Airbnb experience - highly recommended.

Hanan and Magdi are amazing host. In the short period that I spend with them I felt like at home. I tried amazing food and get all the help that I need to move in the city. If you have to spend a short period (and not only) in Geneva, this is the perfect place where stay.

I had to come back to geneva one day after that i left. Due to the wondrrful experience of my first visit, i chose to go back at Hanan and Magdi place. They have been very kind and helpful and treated me like family. If I will need a place in Geneva, I know where try first.
Great place, great host! The app is tidy and clean, Hanan is very hospitable host. Very satisfied with my stay

Hanan et son mari mon accueilli chaleureusement dans leur appartement, me faisant sentir comme à la maison. Je recommande vivement, vous ne le regretterez pas. Quant à moi j'y retournerai sans aucune hésitation.

Perfect place to stay In Geneva. Hanan and her husband are amazing hosts. Their place is beautiful and very comfortable. They were very helpful and made by travel very easy, I recommend 100% staying with them.

Correspond parfaitement à la description. Petite chambre agréable avec un grand bureau.
C'est parfait si on veut travailler. Hanan est une super hôte, très gentille et accueillante. Très contente d'avoir pu partager et échanger avec eux. Mon séjour n'aurait pas pu être mieux !

It was a perfect place that I would recommend to everyone.  It was a very beautiful, pleasant and very clean room. The lady of the house, Hanan, was very kind and a very good person.  I felt like I was in my own home.

Had a memorable 1-month stay with Hanan and her family, who are among the best people you can find in Geneva. They did everything possible to make me feel at home and provided much needed support during my first weeks in Switzerland. If you are looking for a calm place for a comfortable stay, a warm and welcoming family atmosphere and delicious meals, rest assured that you have found the right listing.
If I had to choose again, I would choose the same place. Can't say more than that.

Great place to stay in Geneva, worth the price paying.
Location amazing very close to the river and natural park.
Very flexible host and overall great experience.
Will be back when in Geneva
Hanan is an incredibly warm and welcoming host, I would not hesitate to stay again! Highly recommend

I highly recommend staying here. Ms Hanan is an absolute gem and is such a great host. She is extremely responsive and wants to get to know you. I especially enjoyed getting to know her over breakfast in her beautiful apartment.
One of the things I was initially concerned about was how she does not have many recent reviews. However, she recently reopened her Airbnb to host after COVID and a few renovations.
It is perfect! One of the best homestays I have ever stayed in!

Hannan ist eine sehr nette Person, das Zimmer ist sehr gemütlich.
Hellhörige Wände, man hört auch die Nachbarn oder späte Besuche.

The place to stay in Geneva especially as a female.
Hanan made my stay worthwhile in Geneva.
She was very accommodating and felt like a second mother to me.
She offered me life advice that I asked for, and was always up for a conversation with me. She was also responsive in sharing her experiences and answering all questions.
The whole space is very clean and tidy.
We checked in earlier which was very nice of Hanan. I’d definitely book this place if I am to visit again or refer my family & friends! Thank you so much Hanan.

The room in Onex is an extremely decent place to stay whether for work,vacation or visiting.The accessibility to all modes of transport is a plus as it makes traversing the town very easy.All amenities are equally near making it ideal for any traveler.
The house is spotlessly clean,airy and homely. The home is organized and has everything needed to make one feel instantly at home.Her rooms and bedding are effortlessly co-ordinated. Her bathroom is clean and a shower at the beginning and the end of the day was all i could i look forward to all day. The kitchen was open to me and i enjoyed delicious home cooked meal from our lovely host filled with endless laughter.
The host was really friendly and accommodating. Her aura made my stay unforggetable. I would definitely recommend this house to any traveller.

I had a wonderful stay in Onex, Geneva! The place was exactly as describe clean, cozy, and very comfortable. The location was well-connected, which made it easy to get around. Communication with the host was excellent; they were kind, responsive, and very helpful throughout my stay. I felt very welcomed and safe, and I’m truly grateful for such a great experience. Highly recommend this Airbnb to anyone visiting Geneva.
Thank you so much!

EXCEPTIONNELLE : C'est le mot pour décrire Hanan !
Toujours présente, tellement attentionnée et bienveillante, elle m'a traitée comme sa propre fille, ce qui m'a profondément touchée. Nous avons bien ri et partagé de très beaux moments ensemble, j'en garderai des souvenirs à vie.
L'appartement était impeccable, d'une propreté irréprochable, parfaitement confortable et accueillant, je m'y suis sentie immédiatement à l'aise. Grâce à elle, je repars avec de magnifiques souvenirs. Je recommande Hanan les yeux fermés !
Quite place and amazing person. Great conversations. Very friendly host. Everthing was always clean. Overall It was an amazing stay.

Staying at Hanan's house was a real pleasure, Hanan is a very open-hearted, kind and always ready to help.
She does everything possible to make you feel at home.
She was caring like an older sister and it was very pleasant and relaxing at Hanan's house, I will definitely recommend it and visit again.
Best regards!
Super close to the train station and incredibly easy to get to from the airport. Very pleasant, English speaking staff. Room was nice and had an incredible view of Geneva.
Great location and great hotel! Service was great and the front desk attendant was very I geomatics and informational! 11/10 times I would book this place again.
Just opp the train station, best location. Not a new building, but everything is very clean! I am happy with this selection! Worth the $$$$$.

这家酒店非常棒，前台小哥们也都很热情，还送了日内瓦交通卡，酒店的位置也很赞，交通方便，就在日内瓦cornavin火车站正对面。我和朋友都非常满意。
Cet hôtel est très bien. C'est très proche de la gare Genève Cornavin, juste en face. Les messieurs à l'accueil sont gentils. Moi et mon amie sont passées un bon moment à Genève. Si je revisite Genève encore, je vais le réserver. 😄
Great location , clean and comfortable! Thanks Mike!!
位置很好，服务热情。推荐

chambre en plein centre ville avec vue sur les toits et le jet d'eau, télévision avec des nombreuses chaines, petit déjeuner et tout le confort qu'on peut éspérer. Sur la place de la gare mais pas bruyant pour autant. Hote acceuillant et arrangeant.

A great option for Geneva. It most ways it was a typical hotel room for the Cornavin neighborhood-- practical interior, a bit dated, but clean and neat. What makes this a great choice, however, is that the room was much bigger than most of the other rooms I've stayed at in the area. There was enough space for yoga/stretches in the room and the bathroom had good counter space and ample room in the shower! Also, despite the fact that my room overlooked a busy street, it was very quiet. Note that there is no AC in the room (as far as I could tell) but a fan was provided and that was fine for me.
The location is fantastic, but it is warm during summer.

非常方便的地理位置～火车站正对面
服务也非常到位，房间全是欧洲酒店里面积比较大的了，而且提供入住期间的交通卡，船卡
역 바로 앞에 숙소가 있어서 좋았습니다! 직원분들도 완전 친절하셨음!! 굿이에용

Bonne surprise : petit déjeuner inclu ainsi qu'une carte de transport par personne permettant d'utiliser les transport en commun de Geneve sur tout le séjour (4 jours)
Quartier de la gare actif et un peu bruyant si vous ouvrez les fenêtres.
Vous êtes à une douzaine de minutes du lac et à 2 pas des transports en commun qui desservent l'ensemble de la ville.

L'hôtel est tout en face du gare. Vous le verrez tant que vous sortirez du gare. C vraiment très pratique. Les agents sont  accueillants et sympa. Le petit déjeuner nous avons plu. J'aimais surtout leur offre du titre de transport urbain, cette carte facilitait bcp notre visite.
Great place, everything was ok!

This place is exceptional. Great service, the best location, clean comfortable room, transport card provided with prompt and professional staff. This is superb place and value for money. I will definitely be staying here again, thanks Mike.

Michael’s place is spacious, well decorated and had everything we needed. The location is right by two tram stops and within walking distance of all the great tourists attractions. Would definitely stay again!

The flat is very clean and spacious. It is in a lively neighborhood with bars and restaurants. Surprisingly, it is fairly quiet during the night.
The flat is in walking distance to the shops and the old town. There is everything you need in the flat.
I recommend this place and the host is very nice.
Michiel’s apartment is ideally located , close to all amenities. It is well equipped and super clean. Michiel is a great host - I would definitely recommend.

Michiel's apartment is very cosy, spacious and great value for money. A perfect place for longer stays. The apartment was sparkling clean when I arrived, which I really appreciated. Plainpalais is a great area. Communication with Michiel was extremely easy - he responds almost instantly to messages and was always available to help out. I stayed in two places in Geneva and this was definitely my favourite.
Super cozy and clean. Great location. Michiel is absolutely responsive. I would go back!
Lovely place. Great vibe. Host was really accomodating.
Cozy flat in a great neighborhood.

We asked minutes after check in for a fan to be made available as the apartment was south facing (sun all day long) and the room temp was 90+.  For three nights we did not hear back from the owner, and for three nights we have to "nap" in the lobby on the chairs due to the apartment having no air flow to cool it down. I can't even begin to explain how much I love this place, and how much I appreciated Irene's hospitality.
I've lived all over the world and travelled through hundreds of communities, staying with families, friends, hotels, hostels and everything in between, and I have met all kinds of interesting and friendly people along the way. Some of the places and people will always have a special place in my heart. Irene's place has jumped straight to one of my favourite places in the world!!
The room:
It's really a large studio apartment, with its own entrance and front door, private bathroom and really brilliantly designed layout creating a kitchen/working space, living room and bedroom. The whole place is beautifully decorated with fresh clean colours, wooden floors, crisp fresh linen and beautiful lighting throughout. It feels like a boutique luxury hotel. It's spotlessly clean and has all the finishing touches - hotel toiletries, towels, tea and coffee facilities, breakfast cereal, fridge, magazines etc etc. Everything you could possibly need!
The room is huge and has plenty of space to work, relax etc - you could really stay there for a long time and never feel cramped. It's suitable for couples or a young family - I stayed alone so it was huge for me!
You can arrive at any time as there is a key safe with a code to let yourself in, and Irene will leave a lovely welcome note for when you arrive - so nice! I arrived very late at night and I was so happy to find the room all warm and cosy waiting for me :-) The whole place is also really quiet - it's in a residential area and is well insulated with double glazing windows, so it's like a quiet cosy retreat inside!
The location is also brilliant, as there is a bus stop just a few hundred metres away on the main road, which takes you into central Geneva really easily. There is also a cafe/restaurant very close by (I didn't go but it has good reviews) and a huge shopping mall a few minutes drive away or a short trip on the bus. Getting there from the airport is very simple, and finding the place is easy because Irene sends detailed and very clear helpful instructions with photos so you know you are at the right place!
The hosts:
I was unfortunately very busy at a conference so I didn't get to meet Irene and her family until my last night, but I'm already booked in to stay again so I hope to speak with them more next time. Irene is absolutely wonderful - she is so caring, friendly, welcoming and helpful. You can tell she's one of life's good people who always looks out for others and is so thoughtful. From the moment of booking until after I left, she kept in regular communication and answered any questions promptly and with detailed clear information. She has thought of everything, from maps and restaurant reviews to welcome notes and text messages, to make your stay a wonderful, easy and welcoming experience. Irene's husband is also lovely, and so helpful; they even lent me a woolly hat as it was freezing cold outside! On my last night I got back late from my conference and Irene and her husband helped me to sort out food - even driving me to the shopping mall nearby to get dinner!! They went above and beyond to make sure I was comfortable and I am so grateful to them both. I am really looking forward to coming back to Geneva to see them again and hopefully spend some more time chatting with them.
Overall, I cannot recommend this place enough. The location, room and amenities are fantastic but the hosts really make it the best place to stay in the city. This should really be the example for Air BnB that all other apartments should aspire towards!

I was looking for a small and convenient place in Geneva from where my teenage son and I could visit CERN and also explore the city. The studio is lovely with a fantastic walk-in shower which was needed during the record heat we experienced. There’s a beautiful ancient apple tree just outside and the area seems really unique. Because it’s semi-basement it kept cool once we closed the blinds and most windows while we were out during the day. It was a really good size for the two of us and we managed fine without a kitchen area for our short trip.
It’s around five minutes walk to the brand new Lèman Express Station which will take you to Geneva station in around seven minutes. We also used it to travel to Chamonix via the Mont Blanc Express. At Chamonix you can get the cable car to the peak of Aiguille du Midi in the French Alps. This was an amazing experience and we were able to do the whole trip comfortably in a day. Make sure to book the cable car advance because it’s very popular. For CERN you need to queue on the day for individual tours but it’s well worth it if you’re interested in physics and research. You need to register one hour in advance for the tours which run every half hour or so. Check the web site in advance for details.
