Leider hat die Tür im Gemeinschafts WC schlecht funktioniert und das Haus ist hellhörig, sodass es ziemlich viel Lärm gab, auch in der Nacht, was allerdings vor allem an anderen Gästen lag. Vorsorglich hat Sandro mich vorsorglich mit Ohrstöpseln versorgt.

Sandro was a very welcoming host. He introduced me to the others in the home and showed me where everything was. The home is surrounded by trees and greenery and is so peaceful. But it is also only one block away from the tram, grocery store and restaurant. I recommend anyone wanting to visit Lancy to stay with Sandro.

Sandro has this Jungle crusted Garden house built a hundred years ago surrounded by a forest in the midst of a modern city of concrete sort of an oasis of nature in the midst of skyscrapers !!……a totally original experience !….you have to see it to beleive it!…

If you are fine with sharing kitchen and bathroom with others, this is the place to go in Geneva. An oldfashioned house in an oasis of a little park, quiet, a balcony for your own use, looking into the trees. Sandro being gently polite and not obtrusive at all. Friendly other people you can join on a wine in the garden or in the huge lounge - or just be by yourself. And there is the occasional visit of the cutest cat ever, living there, too.
I cannot overemphazise how nice it was, and I will certainly recommend Sandro's place to everbody who has or can develop some student travel attitude, regardless of age [being 58 myself ;)] .

Sandro was easy to communicate with and allowed flexible check in which I really appreciated!
Room was clean and simple. A great night stay.

Sandro est très arrangeant et très sympathique, quelle belle rencontre,le cadre verdoyant est idyllique,ce fut une belle surprise en tout point,les autres locataires ont été la cerise sur le gâteau,tous agréables et positifs, l'énergie du lieu et de ces hôtes était une parenthèse enchanteresse ...je reviendrai avec grand plaisir...
Sandro is a nice host that always help me a lot during my stay. And he offers all the help I needed
Sandro ging super und unkompliziert auf meine Anliegen ein. Ich konnte mein Fahrrad über Nacht in der Garage parken.

War nur eine Nacht da, mit dem Auto. Mit der Tram ist man schnell in Genf. Schöner wilder Garten. Sehr ruhig. Mein Navi konnte das Haus nicht finden, aber Sandro hat mich angerufen und abgeholt. Habe einige Mitbewohner kennengelernt, das war sehr nett, offen und herzlich. Alles sehr entspannt.  Ich komme gerne wieder.
Fantastic location. Sandro is very welcoming. Would recommend.

Grande maison avec un grand jardin,  près de la ligne du tram qui amène rapidement en centre ville et à la gare. les chambres et les salles de bain sont très propres et Sandro est accueillant et disponible. je conseille !

Sandro was a very lovely and friendly host. Despite my limited French, he made me feel at home and communicated effectively. The house was beautifully rustic and provided a quiet and relaxed station after a day of hectic site seeing. I could not recommend it more!
Muito bos a estadia.

Die Unterkunft ist ideal gelegen – gut erreichbar, aber dennoch sehr privat. Sie verfügt über einen grossen Garten, umgeben von Bäumen und viel Grün. Mir gefällt der Altbau-Stil sehr, die Zimmer sind geräumig und haben jeweils einen eigenen Balkon. Das Zusammenleben im Haus war angenehm, ich habe mich sofort wie zuhause gefühlt. Einkaufsmöglichkeiten sind nur wenige Meter entfernt. Ich kann die Unterkunft nur wärmstens weiterempfehlen!
beautiful house/garden/room/balconie. easy reachable from the trainstation and friendly residents. good and easy communication with Sandro

Ringrazio Sandro per la disponibilità
L’alloggio è stato abbastanza comodo, ben collegato e ben servito
Avere bagno e doccia separati non mi piace moltissimo, ma è una soluzione molto comune
Maison pleine de vie où cohabitent des colocataires de tous horizons. Sandro est très accueillant et la chambre propre.

Gute Unterkunft, sehr netter Gastgeber, sehr sauberes Zimmer. Zu Fuss gut erreichbar mit Tram oder Bus. Gemeinsam genutztes Bad, Unterkunft bewohnt von mehreren Personen.
Würde wieder dort schlafen.

Sandro est un hôte très accueillant et amical. Le lieu est collectif et les autres personnes présentes étaient très discrètes mais aussi ouvertes à l'échange. C'est un logement agréable avec un très beau jardin et on s'y sent comme à la maison. Nous recommandons chaleureusement.
Le sentiment d'être à la campagne et chez soi mais tout en étant en ville. Les transports en commun sont tout près. Agréable séjour grâce à un hôte formidable et disponible. Excellent endroit!
Un sitio agradable y cómodo, el espacio era tranquilo y reconfortante
Bonjour Sandro, comme par le passé, j'ai eu beaucoup de plaisir à revenir. Après une longue journée, juste ce qu'il me fallait, top! Merci, belles fêtes et une joyeuse nouvelle année.

Thank you Sandro! I booked this place for my brother. He enjoyed it very much and enjoyed the company of other tenants at Sandro’s house.
Sandro stayed up past 1AM to welcome us.
Many thanks for your warm welcoming and your hospitality.
A deux pas de Genève, cette étape chez Sandro fût agréable dans une ambiance décontractée style « discussion autour du feu- auberge espagnole ».
Sandro war ein sehr freundlicher und zuvorkommender Gastgeber. Die Räume waren zweckmässig und vernünftig ausgestattet. Es fehlte uns an nichts. WLAN als Goodie vorhanden.
Easy to get in easily, Spend a good night , nearby restaurants cafe and market . Shared breakfast with Sandro, he offered a cafe.

Bon rapport qualité prix pour cette chambre.
Très bon accueil de Sandro
Endroit calme
Belle chambre avec balcon
Alles hat sehr gut gepasst, Sandro war sehr nett - Vielen Dank!

La chambre se trouve dans une grande maison qui héberge d’autres locataires avec lesquels on entre en contact facilement
Sandro est toujours disponible pour converser ou donner des indications utiles, il a un vrai sens de l’hospitalité.
Il met à disposition une cuisine et quelques ingrédients ainsi qu’un salon
Il est aussi possible de s’installer dans le jardin
Sandro est très sympathique et pas avare en conseils pour le séjour. Maison ancienne dans son jus.

Un séjour très agréable, dans un environnement particulièrement apaisant . Sandro est un hôte authentique et très sympathique.   Proche des transports, le centre ville est facile d'accès. Je recommande.
Une auberge espagnole fort sympathique
A great place to stay and connect with other travelers :) I enjoyed the night I spent here before a flight the next day.

La maison de Sandro est une grande maison ancienne,dans un grand jardin exubérant,un véritable îlot de calme, entouré d'immeubles qu'on oublie vite. Ma chambre était vaste,propre,la literie très bonne,le balcon face au jardin reposant. Les sanitaires communs propres et accessibles.
Petit plus appréciable :un petit-déjeuner simple(pain-confiture-café) est offert avec la location.
Cette maison respire la "coolitude" grâce à Sandro,qui est un hôte sympa, zen et cool, très accueillant et tolérant. Ce ne sont pas ses locataires de tous âges et origines qui me contrediront !
En résumé j'ai passé un excellent weekend à la casa de Sandro !

Accueil très agréable de Sandro. Informations (notamment pour arriver) très claires. Réponses aux questions (avant le séjour) toujours très rapides.
Je ne pouvais arriver que très tôt ou très tard, Sandro a été très arrangeant pour mon heure d'arrivée.
Un séjour parfait avec une honte d'une gentillesse et une discrétion remarquable.

Perfect stay -- the place was just as advertised, a nice, clean, quiet apartment.  All the essentials were there, and it's in a nice location near a few restaurants (the Vietnamese and Eritrean ones were good) and very close to the tram line.  Kwene (Neema's sister) welcomed me in and showed me the apartment and was very kind and helpful!  Strongly recommend....

Neema mi ha offerto un'accoglienza completa, sempre disponibile a risolvere ogni mia necessita'. L'appartamento si trova in una zona molto ben servita dai mezzi, a 10 minuti a piedi dal centro storico e a 5 minuti da Plainpalais. La camera e' molto grande e pulita, così' come il resto della casa.
Consiglio vivamente di soggiornare qui! (almeno io al mio ritorno a Ginevra lo faro')
Neema was a great host!
Neema is awesome and the room is cozy.  would definitely stay if I come back to Geneva

Neema was a lovely host. Everything was exactly as she said it would be and access was simple. The room was comfortable, a good temperature and the bed was great (nice linens!) the bathroom was super clean. I would recommend Neema and her apartment.
Good place to stay in Geneva!
Une belle chambre dans un appartement très bien situé. Je me suis senti parfaitement en sécurité !
Fast and efficient communication with Neema. The place is a bit oldish but sparkling clean.

Appartement au premier étage. Équipements très anciens, mais propres. J’étais seul dans le logement. La salle de bains est bien, mais date probablement des années 1950.
Le lit était bien, literie moderne. La chambre aussi très ancienne.
J’ai reçu des instructions, digicode, clef dans la boîte à lait, qu’elle chambre… c’était parfait.
Le rapport qualité prix est très bon pour Genève.

We didn´t have the luck to meet Philippe because of our agenda. He visited the house while we were shopping on our day of arrival and our kids were enjoying the pool (he explained everything to them). Nevertheless, he responded to every request immediately. We highly recommend him.
Positive host and the place is very nice and the house very clean and the area is so nice
Great experience. Very kind host

Very lovely house, suitable for young children as the owners also have young children. Only thing is there is on site parking which we knew beforehand and we were told it is ok to park on the street opposite, but ended up getting a ticket.

Ludovica is a great host in Geneva. She speaks French, English and Italian and can show you everything about the city and the surroundings!
Nevertheless she a one of a kind person and her dog is nice and calm!
The room is big clean and very comfy. Most importantly it faces the inside of the building so it is very silent.
The apartment is located in the very center and you can hangout by walking anywhere! Plus just in 4/5 mins walk you can access to all the busses to go to the UN buildings. Best location ever!!
I highly recommend to spend a short or a long period at Ludovica's. Bring her respect and follow her few rules to live the best stay in Geneva

J'ai passé un séjour très agréable chez Ludovica. Plus qu'un logement, c'est une rencontre! On se côtoie dans l'appartement en toute liberté d'aller et venir, et dans le plus grand respect du sommeil, du rythme et de l'intimité de chacun. Parfois, un moment de partage s'improvise autour de la table de la cuisine et on se détend en toute convivialité.
Par ailleurs, Ludovica connaît très bien Genève et son quartier (très sympa) et n'hésite pas à partager les bonnes adresses!

La chambre est spacieuse et proper.  Le wifi fonctionne parfaitement. L’appartement est idéalement situé au centre ville. Ludovica est discrete mais efficace si besoin (Ludovica -  merci beaucoup pour pique-nique!). Je recommande ce logement au visiteur de Geneve.
I had a amazing time here and it was all because of Ludovica. She was an amazing host and wonderful person

Nette kleine Bude mitten in der historischen Altstadt - sehr freundliche und flexible Vermieterin. Wir haben ruhig geschlafen. Alles ist gut beschrieben und vorbereitet: Kaffee / Tee, Handtücher, WLAN, Ausgeh-Tipps. Der Schreibtisch ist klein, aber man kommt ja i.d.R nicht zum Arbeiten ;-)
Super Tipp von der Gastgeberin Wenige Schritte entfernt gibt es eine Tiefgarage, dann muss man nicht zigmal um den Block fahren.
Rundherum eine gute Erfahrung!

Mila est très flexible concernant les arrivées et départs et cela fut pour nous très agréable.
L’appartement bénéficie d’un super emplacement et est extrêmement propre.
Les bruits provenant de la rue sont parfois dérangeants et la literie n’est pas de très bonne qualité, mais nous avons passé un agréable séjour chez Mila.
Très gentilles attentions avec bières et café à disposition etc. Très propre et excellente communication. Logement très bien situé pour visiter et sortir helas un peu bruyant le soir
Mila is superb
Cozy place, central location,  beautifulsurroundings. Mila is a responsive and helpful host.
Très bon emplacement en Vielle-Ville, studio sympa pour passer un week-end en toute tranquillité.

Je n' est pas été déçu trés jolie appartement fonctionnel au calme dans un immeuble avec beaucoup de cachet. A proximité de tout. Le quartier de la vielle ville avec ses rue piétonnes et génial !!!! Je reviendrai ....
C' est le deuxième fois que je viens et toujours aussi satisfaite !!!

Mila is a responsive, helpful, and all around fantastic host. I found the flat to be very comfortable and perfectly situated in the heart of Old Town, giving easy access to some of the best things Geneva has to offer. Would absolutely recommend.

Mila was a very accommodating host. She was prompt in her replies as we traveled to Geneva, and she also made sure to leave clear instructions on how to do things, as well as recommendations for things to do nearby. The flat was clean, just as advertised, and in a GREAT location. Highly recommend.
Appartement niquel pour un séjour très agréable! Mia est réactive, et arrangeante pour la remise des clés. Je recommande à 100%

Mila was an amazing host. She was always really helpful and she would respond immediately if I had any issues. The studio was very clean and welcoming. It’s right in the center of the old town area in Geneva, so it was really easy to get there and also explore the city. It is a small space, but still really comfortable for 1-2 people.
I would highly recommend!
Mila is superb , extremely beautiful house, suberb bakery just downstairs, home is walking distance to couple of bars , bus stand is 5 mins walk , overall we loved staying at Mila apartment

Excellente localisation. Boulangerie en dessous, Petit supermarché a 50 Mètres pour des fruits et légumes. Mila est un hôte très prévenante et flexible avec ses invités .
Pas bruyant et suffisant pour une halte en plein centre de la vieille ville de Genève
A very nice tiny appartment - perfect to discover Geneva!
Très bon séjour chez Mila. Nous recommandons.

Small but clean and comfortable place. Reasonably comfortable bed and good wifi, work area, kitchenette and shower room. Very well located in the charming old town area of Geneva. Not too noisy at this time of year.
super appartement très bien situé et très propre. Mila est très sympa et disponible. je recommande cet appartement pour 1 ou 2 personnes.

This is a great value.  The location is amazing.  It was as described.  The host was great to communicate with: very responsive on chat, met me at the place on time, had notes around to remind of things, made other little touches to make a guest feel welcome, had method to return key without needing to meet up, etc.
Accueil parfait. Studio très bien placé.
Schöne kleine Wohnung in der Altstadt. Bett ist ein bisschen in die Jahre gekommen, ansonsten gibt es alles was man braucht. Mila ist eine sehr nette und bemühte Gastgeberin.
Great place and excellent host!
Mila’s apartment is in a perfect location to explore Geneva by foot. Mila was easy to communicate with and met me to assist with check in and show me around the apartment.
This is a great wee flat in an excellent location. Very easy to reach with public transport. Everything you need for a short stay. Mila is lovely and helpful.
Mila is very friendly and explained everything very well. The stay is very cute and good located.
Clean 1st floor studio in central charming neighborhood. Host provided nice extra touches such as beverages, coffee and snack food. Recommended.
I had a great stay at Mila's place. It was exactly as advertised. Mila was super welcoming and I felt very much at home. The location really is fantastic, right in the middle of Geneva's old town.

Appartement tout à fait accueillant dans la vieille ville historique touristique, sur une petit colline.
Très propre.
It is absolutely wonderful!  The apartment has everything you need and is steps away from a plaza in the old part of Geneva that is full of cafes and restaurants.  Highly recommend!

Très bonne communications
Je recommande
Cozy space with all the basics you need and an extremely responsive host!
Great place! It was perfect for two people and Mila was such a nice host! Very close to great restaurants and activities. I would recommend it!

Logement bien situé et propre.
Bonne communication avec Mila qui a été arrangeante sur nos horaires.

I stayed with a friend at Mila's house for a couple of night and the place was just perfect. it is very central, just a short walk from the station. Mila was waiting for us at the accomodation and gave us a lot of useful tips and showed us around.

The studio was very well located and was a great place to stay. The apartment itself was a good size and has all the amenities you would need. Mila gave very clear instructions on check in and was easy to contact, she was very accommodating to our flight being delayed and therefore check in being later than expected, which was very kind of her.
Great appartement in the center of Genève. It had everything you could need, and the location was very good and easy to access. I will definitely recommend it!

Excellent rapport qualité-prix et idéal pour une ou deux nuit.
Quartier animé

The apartment is in old town, very close to all the interesting places to visit while you are in Geneva. And it is right next to the underground parking garage! We had a car, so it was very convenient, easy to find. Apartment is clean, quiet and comfortable,. Mile can speak several languages, she was very kind and helpful!
Such a quaint little apartment in the heart of the old town in Geneva!
Gregreat location, esp if yu need to catch the bus to the airport. Mila was great with communication. Thanks!
Great host, would love to come back again!

Mila was able to facilitate booking with short notice (two days before arriving in Geneva). Mila was excellent with communication and even provided her phone number for emergency or any other questions (did not need to use). kitchen was small but had everything we needed. We were able to cook light meals like chicken and pasta. Mila provided coffee and chocolate, which was very nice.
Clémence was very welcoming and flexible. The flat was great - just as described! Great location. Would definitely stay there again!

Clemence was a wonderful host. She was very welcoming and accommodating both during my mom's arrival and departure.  My mom had a great time in Geneva and a large part of it was because of the clean, comfortable, and centrally located flat that she stayed in. We highly recommend this apartment and Clemence as a host!

The appartment is just as cute as on the pictures. The area is a vibrant area with couple of hip bars and restaurants. Clémence welcomed me really relaxed. Checkin / checkout went pretty smoothly. Netflix account is definitely a plus.
Thanks for the nice time.

Clémence was very nice, welcoming and accommodating to our arrival schedule. Very clean and new flat in character building. Lots of restaurants and night life in the immediate area. Parking in area was very challenging. Great accommodation for adults.
Thank you for having us.

Fantastic host! Clemence was always readily available to help or give guidance. The flat was very clean and well kept. Nice kitchen space, hot  shower, lots of light, and a comfy bed. It was in a great location downtown. It's on the third floor above a popular bar (Yvette) but with the windows closed I didn't notice any noise at night. Highly recommend and would def stay there again.

I stayed at Clemence's airbnb for a long business trip and it was exactly what I was looking for. The location was great, with proximity to Geneva public transportation, and it was still easy to walk to most places in the city. The apartment was exactly as pictured and really clean. Finally Clemence herself was very friendly, communicative, and helpful. I would highly recommend this flat to others and would certainly stay here again!
Great location. Good communication with Host. Very nice apt and value for money. Definitely recommended!

This is a lovely little apartment located on the top floor of an apartment building on the funkiest street in Eaux-Vives. The location is superb, with the apartment being above a bar, between two other bars and across the street from a bar. A supermarket is 3 minutes walk away, there are great restaurants in every direction and nearby are several public transport stops with connections to most of the city.
The apartment itself is small and what you see is what you get. With that said, Clemence has managed to somehow squeeze in a washing machine, drying rack and ironing board which makes the place very well equipped for even a longer stay.
Clemence was a wonderful host and could not have been more accommodating or welcoming.
Very clean and safe. Convenient to stores, restaurants and transportation

Clemence is an incredible hostess. Always available, happy disposition and very kind. She even offered to go to the pharmacy for me when I was struck down with Flu! Clemence’s apartment is sweet, compact and homey — it was perfect for my three-week stay in Geneva. It’s near all the amenities, including at least 4 great bars, though light sleepers may be disturbed by the noise Thursday-Saturday. It’s near transport links, the jet d’eau, supermarket. Best feature of all: The incredible shower! Hot and powerful 😊 Thank you, Clemence!! I’ll definitely be back

Location: excellent location close to everything: shops, buses, gym, bars, touristy places, work. If you are a social person this is the place for you, there are 3 popular bars right on the street. If not it might be a con because it does get really noisy most nights.
Space: clean and well maintained. Modern finish and the additional touch of a cleaning lady once a week made it an excellent stay for me. It is a studio so if you are looking for big spaces this is not the place but Clemence provides everything one could possibly need in that space and makes it just perfect.
Host: warm and friendly lady who is easily accessible and very, very prompt and reactive with your needs. She is very thoughtful and even provided a few things in the fridge before my arrival because all the shops would have been closed when I arrived.
All in all, a very good Airbnb experience and I'd recommend this place to anyone. Thanks Clemence.

A nice, although small, apartment. Everything in the apartment is relatively new and working well. The only reason I cannot give 5 star is that the street is a somewhat noisy because of the bars in the street (quite unusual in Geneva). However, thick windows helped a lot. The host was very friendly although we did not interact much. I would definitely recommend.
Clemence is extremely kind landlord and the apartment is well located and clean
Super apartment, super location, super clean and super host!! Can’t ask for more from this place. Coming back in a couple of days for more super-ness!
Second stay... still awesome... still amazing... still fantastic! Thanks Clemence!

J’ai passé un excellent séjour dans l’appartement de Clémence qui est parfaitement situé au centre de Genève, dans un quartier animé avec des restaurants et bars vraiment sympas. L’appartement est décoré avec bon goût, cozy, parfaitement équipé et propre, le lit confortable. Super attentions comme des petits chocolats suisses ou abonnement Netflix qui font qu’on se sent rapidement comme à la maison ! Enfin la communication avec Clémence était facile et ses instructions très claires. Je recommande donc cet appartement à 200% !
Location was marvellous and you can walk everywhere!

Ludovica was kind, warm and welcoming. She was a gracious host who made me feel at home from Day 1. Companionship from her dog, Kunta, was a bonus. Her apartment was clean, well laid out and remarkably quiet given its central location. A stay here's well worth it!

Un bon séjour chez Ludovica qui est une femme charmante et très sociable, je recommande à tout le monde de venir loger chez elle si vous voulez vous sentir comme à la maison au centre de Genève pour un prix plus que compétitif ! Son chien est un amour !!! Tout était super : la chambre, la salle de bain ou encore la cuisine qui sont mis à disposition. À bientôt.

Minha estada foi a melhor possível. O apartamento é bem localizado, próximo à universidade e ao centro, com transporte, mercado e restaurantes no entorno. Ludovica é uma pessoa supersimpática e acessível, sempre pronta a ajudar. Além da Ludovica, seu cão tbm foi um anfitrião maravilhoso, sempre doce e simpático. O apartamento é ótimo, bem limpo e espaçoso, com um quarto bastante confortável. Recomendo sem hesitar.

Ludovica is a really really nice, funny and open - minded person. She always made sure I felt comfortable and helped me with questions about public transport etc.
The room is really quiet, so that you can even sleep with an open window and the house is close to public transport.
I can definitely recommend to stay here!
Ludovica was great with me. She is very friendly and has been helpful during my stay! The house is clean, cozy and comfortable.
My stay was very nice, Ludovica is very helpful and makes you feel at home. Would definitely recommend!

Ludovica è una padrona di casa piena di vita e di esperienze che ama condividere. Oltre al suo lavoro, ha tanti interessi che la tengono occupata. Ama in modo speciale la natura e gli animali, e ho particolarmente apprezzato le conversazioni avute con lei.
L'appartamento è accogliente, ben sistemato e pulito. E' ubicato in una zona silenziosa, e non si sentono rumori fastidiosi provenienti dall'esterno né nella camera che dà sulla strada, né tanto meno in quella che dà sul bellissimo cortile interno, ben curato e tranquillo. Inoltre, Ludovica mette a disposizione dei suoi ospiti anche l'uso della cucina, riducendo in tal modo i costi per il vitto.
L'alloggio è perfettamente collegato dai mezzi di trasporto con ogni zona di Ginevra, di cui in qualche minuto si possono raggiungere a piedi per la loro vicinanza tanti punti strategici, dall'università all'ospedale ad aree di svago e divertimento o di semplice acquisto di generi di prima necessità.
Grazie, Ludovica, per la tua accoglienza. Spero tanto che per il mio prossimo viaggio a Ginevra il tuo appartammento possa di nuovo ospitarmi.
E n z o

Hi, Ludovica is such a great host, the apartment is accessible, it is really easy to get transport from there, all the indications Ludovica gave me to arrive from the airport were really easy and accurate, the apartment is clean, she helped me a lot, I really felt comfortable at her house and welcome every day. I truly recommend her house and she as a host, I traveled alone from Colombia, I was a bit scared to be alone in this country but she made me feel secure and as my home :-)

Passei dias tranquilos e muito agradáveis na casa de Ludovica e recomendo a todos os viajantes.
O quarto é ainda melhor pessoalmente do que nas fotos: arejado, bem iluminado, silencioso, bem aquecido. O local é tão tranquilo que você até se esquece de que está no centro de Genebra, pertinho da praça Plainpalais, comércios, bares, restaurantes, museus etc. Além disso, os prédios principais da Universidade de Genebra ficam a apenas alguns minutinhos a pé. Para mim, que viajei para um evento universitário e estou terminando de redigir minha tese, esta hospedagem foi perfeita, pois eu tinha um espaço adequado para trabalhar e descansar.
O apartamento é bem organizado e muito agradável, com livre acesso à área comum (sala, banheiro, cozinha com todos os utensílios) e ainda tive a minha disposição um par de toalhas, uma comodidade a mais para quem quer viajar com menos peso.
O melhor de tudo: Ludovica me recebeu com enorme hospitalidade, alegria e o acolhimento de que eu precisava em um momento muito estressante da minha vida. Fui pra Genebra com a mente cheia de preocupações e voltei com uma amiga no coração.
Muito obrigada, Ludovica; mille mercis; grazie mille!
Espero você em Minas Gerais!
Wonderful stay.  Very close to the bus stop.  Lovely apartment.  Great location.  Fantastic host.
G

Ludovica is one really warm jost that made me feel like home and provided me with all I needed before I even asked for it! The house is in a perfect location, at the most artistic part of the town with all in walking distance. Definitely recommenndable
Very clean & quiet, and in a very convenient location. Ludovica is very helpful. I really enjoyed my stay. Would come back next time!! Definitely recommend, good value.
Great venue

I spent a work week in Geneva and looked for a place outside the usual hotels near the Cornavin station. I had an amazing long-term stay with Clemence. The apartment unit is cosy and perfect for 1-2 people for a short-term stay, and located in a neighborhood with a decent selection of good restaurants, cafes and bars.
The Jet d'Eau, Parc de la Grange and the newest beach/park in Geneva that's within 5, 10 and 20 minutes walking, respectively. Bus stops are everywhere around the area, which makes getting to/from places in Geneva incredibly easy.

Cons:
Apartment is on the 3rd floor so if you have heavy luggage and you’re travelling on your own, be prepared to walk up 3 flights of stairs (about 51 steps) - though luckily enough, I had a very kind man who helped me with my luggage up the stairs when I arrived.
There is a bedroom, a kitchen with dining table and a bathroom - there is no living room so unless you intend to cook, there is no more extra “living” space compared to a hotel room, though the washing machine is a bonus.
The bedroom has 2 single beds and if you are on your own, the beds are pushed together but easily separate with some movement. Mattresses are also very soft and bouncy.
Clèmence doesn’t really reach out to you and if you do message her, the response can be a few hours. Some people may like this hands-off approach and luckily I didn’t have any problems during my stay but I wonder how things would have turned out if I did.

I feel sorry I will be the first person not to give a nice review but I obviously didn’t get the same experience as other travellers. I can only confirm that Ludovica is nice, the location is great and the apartment is clean but the bedroom I got was not the one shown on the pictures. When I arrived I was told that a student was occupying the advertised bedroom so I got another room which was ok but adjacent to Ludovica’s bedroom, meaning in the middle of the wall, there was a closed wooden door hidden by a big bookcase. When I took a look underneath it,  I saw that there was a 2cm gap. So you can imagine how noisy it was to have this door instead of a full wall. Plus, as per the description, I thought smoking was allowed in the kitchen but Ludovica is a smoker and she smokes in her room... I am pregnant and very sensitive with smells and I can definitely tell that even if the apartment was ventilated, when you enter the apartment you can tell it’s a smoker’s place. I was worried about the smoke coming into my room but it was ok. When she coughed (and she did a lot), it was like she was in my bedroom. One night she had a friend over and at 10pm (after 4 hours hearing them chatting and I was waking up very early the next morning), I kindly asked if her friend could leave in the next 30minutes because it was like they were in my room talking and I couldn’t sleep. The next day I could tell Ludovica was a little angry at me when I really think I should be the one who could have been mad. The room I got was also on the street side so I could here all the trucks, cars and people talking loud at night... the room shown on pictures is at the opposite side of Ludovica’s room, separated by the hallway and giving on a private courtyard, very calm and peaceful... so I was really not happy about not getting the nice, quite, isolated room where you can hear the birds singing in the morning as described per other travellers... I suggest that Ludovica changes the pictures and the description of the room she is renting. I am sure my stay and our relationship would have been totally different if I would have had the right room. If you rent this place, make sure you are getting the one described and shown on pictures, on the private courtyard side!
