Clemence. Gracias! Que maravilloso haber estado en tu apartamento! El sitio es perfecto, independiente, muy bien ubicado, decorado con mucho gusto y con detalles muy bonitos, y supremamente funcional.
Si puedo regresar el año que viene, con seguridad reservaría el mismo lugar. Ademas, a mi esposa le encantó y se sintió muy feliz por la independencia y la comodidad. Y por los buenos detalles.
El apartamento lo tiene todo muy cerca: estacion de bus, supermercado, restaurantes y bares, para tomar una copa. Una papelería!
Además, Clemence es muy amable y estuvo dispuesta a ayudarme en todas las cosas que necesité. Incluso en la provision de servicio de limpieza. Muchas gracias de nuevo.
Califico con el mejor puntaje el lugar y a su anfitriona y repito que me quedaria nuevamente alli con mi esposa, si regresamos a Ginebra.
地点很棒，环境很好。房东热情友好。楼下有几个酒吧，如果是浅睡眠者建议关上百叶窗。

Clemence was very helpful from the beginning. She quickly sorted out a few minor issues I had with the internet connection and was very responsive. The flat is modern and beautiful, great for short stays in a vibrant neighbourhood of Eaux Vives. The only downside is the proximity to a number of bars that stay open until very late. However, windows in the flat are exceptionally well insulated, so I didn't have any problems falling asleep. Overall, very good.

I really enjoyed my 3-month stay at Clemence's apartment in Geneva. The apartment was recently renovated and exactly as described. I felt right at home :) The bed (and pillows) were super comfortable and the apartment was cleaned weekly. I had constant access to great wifi and watched netflix for free after work every night. The apartment is in a great location and I felt super safe as a female living alone. The apartment is above a bar but I never had any issues with noise and I am a light sleeper. There is not a washer and dryer in the apartment but there is a nice laundry mat 5 minutes away by foot. A quick 1-minute walk to the bus stop connects you to the old town and a 5-minute walk connects you to the lake. Clemence lives downstairs and was always available via Watsapp. The apartment is in such great condition that I only needed to contact her once when I accidentally blew a fuse. Overall, a great first Airbnb experience :)

My wife and I stayed for three days and Clémence was an excellent host. Always checking in making sure our stay was comfortable.. the home was extremely pleasant and well decorated and very clean.. I literally would love to live in this home.. we are happy with its location close to the water and old town and close to a verity of cafes and bars and restaurants.. we would definitely recommend this place to anyone looking to stay in Geneva.. there was even free English Netflix that was provided and a laminated paper with all the instructions for emergencies and WiFi etc... Clémence thought of everything ! Thank you and please stay here it's very comfortable and private and safe and fun!!

Clemence's place is very well appointed, fresh, bright, comfortable for my husband and myself. The apartment is an easy walk up to to the third floor.
The location is within walking distance to all sites, restaurants, and shopping and public transport. Cocktail bars are within close proximity.
We enjoyed our stay very much. Clemence is an excellent host. She took time from her day to accept our lost bag when it was delivered.

Very clean, very good location. Easy to check in / out
Thanks clémence
Je recommande les yeux fermés
Clément place is clean and accurate. Highly recommend

Clemence could not have been more helpful and kind to us during our stay. She was super responsive and went to great lengths to help us get settled. The apartment is compact but perfect - well-equipped, clean and perfectly located.
The apartment is very centrally located and great for those who want to enjoy the night life. Clean and host is great
Nice apartment, centrally located, very clean and a great host. I highly recommend this place.

Clémence was a really delightful host!  She responded immediately to any queries and was extremely helpful, especially at the end of my stay.  The apartment is very nice, but I guess for me the best thing was the LOCATION!  Eaux Vives is a great place to stay in Geneva and the apartment is surrounded by really fab bars and eateries!  Try next door ... Atelier Cocktail!  Fab staff!  All in all a wonderful stay!
Clemence was a thoughtful host, her apartment centrally located on a street with fun restaurants and bars, close to public transport, and immaculately kept.  Thank you for a wonderful stay in Geneva!

Appartement très agréable, bien aménagé et très bien situé !
Clémence est parfaitement disponible, souriante et bien discrète à la fois.
Le quartier est très animé le soir mais il me suffisait de fermer la fenêtre côté rue jusqu'à la fin de la soirée et ouvrir celle côté cour pour me sentir bien chez moi sans aucune gêne.
Je compte y retourner l'année prochaine...

Very stylish space that was super clean. However, the apartment is really small with only two windows that I felt a bit uncomfortable leaving the shades open on given one is internal to the building and the other faces the apartment across the street. I would stay again, because Clemence was very nice and helpful and the space is clean, but it was not the best value Airbnb I have stayed at in Geneva.
Amazing flat in the center of Geneva.

My husband and I stayed in Clémence’s apartment and it was just a perfect stay in Geneva. Centrally located in a great neighborhood, the apartment is very clean (!) and well-equipped. It is a good size for a couple on a weekend getaway. The only remark we had was the bed (two separate beds instead of 1 double bed) but other than that: a great stay! Thank you to the professional hosting by Clémence.
The apartment is nice and well equipped! Great location in the center of Genève. Clemence is very attentive and helpful host. I recommend it.
very nice stay highly recommend thank you
thank you for nice welcome and stay

The studio is well located, near public transportation and in walking distance from the old town. There are all sorts of shops and restaurants in the vicinity. The studio itself is tastefully decorated and furnished with everything one needs. The only drawback is that the street is a bit loud in the evening. Highly recommended.
Fantastic place in great location

If I ever come back to visit Geneva and Clemence still has this place listed on Airbnb I will organise my travel dates around it's availability. Absolutely lovely, clean, spacious, fantastic location, great internet, great kitchen. Close to public transport. Walk out of the building and straight onto a lively crowded street of bars and restaurants. But situated on the top level so the noise doesn't effect you at night. But besides all the above Clemence is a very accommodating and help full host. After some nightmare experiences she restored my faith in Airbnb. Ok, Ill stop blowing wind up this properties ass, you might start to think she paid me to write this. If you're going to Geneva and you're looking at this property. Book it.
I already wrote a review for this property.

Great stay at this lovely place. The host was wonderful and quick to respond to all of our questions. Anytime we needed something she made it happen right away!  The place is very conveniently located with many attractions close by. THANK YOU SO MUCH FOR A WONDERFUL STAY! We loved Geneva and can't wait to be back.

Проживание с 1 по 12 июля 2019.
Минусы
- очень шумно каждый вечер с 18.00 до 01.00( кроме воскресенья) под окнами спальни , так как 2 винных бара, один внизу под домом, и второй напротив , через улицу.
- сигаретный дым при открывании окна , вечерами, в вышеперечисленные дни и часы, никуда не деться((
- с 7.30 до 8.00 ежедневно разгрузка мусора со стеклом, очень шумно!
- нет лифта, 3 этаж, круговой подъем , спуск чемоданов труден.
- нет стиральной машины
- нет кондиционера
- нет обычных средств уборки для квартиры( тряпок, средств для ванной и пола, чтобы освежить квартиру при длительном нахождении)
Плюсы
- отличные звуконепроницаемые окна, можно закрывать окна от баров, но душно в июле(
- посудомойка и порошок для нее
- после ремонта
- отличное месторасположение, 15 минут пешком до Рив, и 15 минут до бесплатного пляжа. также секретный быстрый проход от остановок до квартиры, нашли мы сами)
- в 2 минутах аптека и супермаркет Мигро, рестораны.
Lovely stay. Quiet and peaceful despite being so close to the lake and Geneva center.

Clemence’s place was a great location close to the lake and nightlife. The apartment was clean and well appointed. Since it’s close to nightlife and restaurants be prepared for noise into the night during the warmer months, especially with the windows open for air.

Ludovica is a great host.
Her house is a great place to stay and enjoy the beautiful Genève. It is really well located, closes of everything. She is so flexible with your schedule.
Ludovica really knows how to make you feel as you were in your own home.
I love Genevè at Ludovica’s house. I’ll be back soon. I strongly recommend her space.

Ludovica é uma pessoa de coração enorme! Nunca me senti tão bem recebida. Como estava viajando sozinha a trabalho/estudo estava com um pouco de receio de ir pra um lugar estranho sem conhecer ninguém. Mas Ludovica fez eu me sentir como se eu estivesse em casa. Me ajudou em tudo que precisei, me ensinou onde fazer compras, me deu ótimas dicas, foi realmente muuuuito melhor do que esperada. Sem palavras para agradecê-la.

The place is a super comfortable room, with all the light and views to the street. Excellent bed. Good place to work with the laptop. The bus stops are meters away.  It was very easy to arrive from the airport with her advice.  Near many interesting museums. But the best is Ludovica herself !!   Nice and generous, I really feel at home. Hope to return soon
I have a very nice stay at Ludovica's. The space is very clean and tidy. The host is very responsive and helpful, making my stay very pleasant.
Ludovica’s apartment is situated very centrally and has a lovely spacious room. Highly recommend.

My son Tim had a great time while he spent three weeks in Geneva for an internship. Very warm welcome and superfriendly in atmosphere. Excellently located inmidst the University quarter. The bedroom has its own balcony and the room itself is cosy and comfortable. Many thanks for taking care of our "baby".

Ludovica est géniale, son accueil est très chaleureux. Elle est attentive aux besoins de ses hôtes, elle les respecte, elle partage des bonnes adresses autour de chez elle et dans la ville, elle essaie de t'aider par tous les moyens quand tu es en galère. En ce qui concerne l'appartement, il est dans un quartier très sympa avec de nombreuses possibilités pour se restaurer, prendre un café, se promener, pour ma part il était hyper bien placé par rapport à mon lieu de travail. On est dans le centre vivant de Genève mais pas bruyant, ce qui est un gros plus. La chambre et l'appartement sont très agréables, on peut cuisiner et partager si on le souhaite, on peut manger ensemble ou chacun.e dans sa chambre.
Je ne peux que vous recommander de faire l'expérience par vous-même.

I've been in a lot in airbnbs in Geneva and this was by far the best experience I've ever had. Ludovica takes great care of her home and everything is always very clean. It's a spacious room and you have everything you need and more. The location is very central but still relatively quiet.
The best part about her home was however Ludovica herself. I felt instantly at home and very welcome. She wants you to feel comfortable, asks about your day or how she could improve your stay, but also respects your privacy if you don't feel like talking. If this place is available, don't look any further! Thank you very much :)!

Fantastic flat, also Ludovica is very nice and helpful. The room is very comfortable with everything you need, ditto the kitchen and the space reserved for guests. The flat is super central and very convenient to go everywhere!

Ludo is amazing very welcoming host,  apartment is in very central location, super clean and quiet. Definitely coming back and I can recommend anyone who is looking for a private room in Geneva to stay at Ludovica’s apartment. From the first moment you’ll enter the property, you’ll feel just like at home!

Eine sehr nette Gastgeberin!
I enjoyed my stay in Ludovica’s apartment!
Grazie per il piacevole soggiorno!
Thank you Ludovica for the caring stay at your home. Everything worked well and she was very helpful in every turn. Many thanks!
Great location and the room was clean and comfortable! Ludovica was a great host, very warm and kind.

Hallo liebe Ludovica,
Thank you a million times over for your hospitality.
Thank you for doing everything you could to make me feel at home.
I did really enjoy your company and for taking care of me and giving me a lot of information in Geneva, it was very informative.
You deserve so much more than just a thank you.
Please accept my sincere thanks!
The room is spotlessly clean, cozy, bright, well equipped, comfortable and It is exactly the same as shown in the pictures. You have everything what you need. I am just so in love with the mirror, everytime I get up in the morning I always took a selfie on it. The place is within walking distances towards the downtown. You can also take a tram or bus, the bus station is just 2 Mins walking distances. I would highly recommend Ludovica as a great host and definitley I will come back soon.......!
Ludovica é uma pessoa incrível, passei 37 dias em sua casa e foram dias ótimos. O quarto é excelente, grande e ventilado. Obrigada Ludo!!!!!

Je recommande fortement ce logement, parfait pour un étudiant, l’appartement est idéalement situé, proche de tout et la chambre est très confortable.
Mais plus qu’une location rbnb, la touche d’humanité, la convivialité et la générosité de Ludovica ont rendu ce séjour très exceptionnel.
Ludovica est une personne formidable que nous espérons revoir prochainement
Good location and nice atmosphere

I stayed at Ludovica's place for 3mon and had a great time! Ludovica keeps the apartment very clean, and sharing the common spaces and the bathroom was never an issue(:
What stands out especially was the location - there are multiple tram and bus stops a short few minutes away on foot, and its possible to walk into the old town in 5-10min which is super convenient! In addition, there are a wide variety of great restaurants and bars easily within in walking distance as well. A washer and dryer are available to use in the basement of the apartment, and several grocery stores within half a kilometer make getting errands a breeze.
If you're looking for a temporary home in Geneva, both short or long-term, I can highly recommend this place!
My stay with Ludovica was lovely she makes you feel at home and is so kind and sweet! Thank you so much for the nice stay, wish you all the best!

Staying with Ludovica was one of the best decisions I have made in my life! I went to Geneva for a 4 month intership and found an amazing friend that I am sure I will keep for life! She is amazing, caring, and just perfect!
It felt like home.

I had a great midweek stay at Ludovica's. The room was impeccably clean and spacious. Ludovica provided any and all the amenities you could ever need (and more). She is a very sociable and knowledgeable host and genuinely enjoys having guests around.

My stay at Ludovicas apartment was nothing short of exceptional. It exceeded my expectations in every way, and I couldn't have asked for a more gracious and accommodating host. If you're looking for a memorable Airbnb experience in Geneva, don't hesitate to book this apartment. It's the perfect place to call home while exploring all that this beautiful city has to offer. I can't wait to return! Thank you, Ludo, for making my trip so special and for being an amazing human being that you are. Really happy to have known you.
Ludovica is a very kind host! I enjoyed the stay and want to come again.

Sono stata ospite di Ludovica per due mesi ed è stato un soggiorno splendido! L’appartamento è accogliente, pulitissimo, è comodo a tutti i servizi e in una posizione molto centrale. La camera è ampia, con un letto comodo, è uno spazio confortevole per rilassarsi e anche per lavorare. Ludovica mi ha fatto sentire subito a casa, è stata sempre molto disponibile, amichevole, pronta ad aiutarmi e attenta alle mie esigenze. Ho ricevuto ottimi consigli sia per le necessità pratiche della vita quotidiana (mezzi di trasporto, mercati…), sia per scoprire le bellezze della città. Spero di tornare molto presto a Ginevra per vivere di nuovo un’esperienza così bella, che consiglio vivamente a chiunque!

A very tidy and lovely Airbnb apartment equipped with everything you need.
A good bed and a nice bathroom.
Ludovica is a great host and there when you need her, Very nice and wants to share all she knows about the area. I had a great stay!
It was a clean apartment. She recommended fair priced places to eat and gave clear instructions as to where to go and what the rules of the house were. She's a delight.

Ludovica is a lovely welcoming host, who offers an ideal peaceful place to stay in Geneva. The flat is beautifully clean and well equipped for one's stay and is on a bus route. Also, the flat is well located for local restaurants, museums etc and is about fifteen minutes walk to the Lake.
I would certainly return to Ludovica's place again and warmly recommend it to others.

Ludovica è una bellissima persona che mi ha fatto sentire come in casa dal primo minuto. È gentilissima, discreta, ma sempre anche pronta per fare due chiacchiere. In casa tutto era pulitissimo e ordinato. Mi sono trovato veramente molto bene e ci tornerò sicuro. Grazie Ludovica!
I had a wonderful week at Ludovica's apartment. The room was spacious and had all the necessary things. Ludovica is a kind and friendly host and you will love her. Definitely recommend her place.

Very peaceful place. Close to everything. Ludovica is wonderful. She is very friendly, hospitality, helpful, and also a good chef. We are now friends. Highly recommend this place in Geneva. I’ll stay with her if I come back to Geneva. Thanks for hosting me!
Ludovica is a great host! it was a pleasure to stay at her place. The apartment is clean, the room provided is spacious and suitable for both short and long stays.

Je suis absolument ravie de mon séjour chez Ludovica (5 nuits).
Le logement est bien situé dans le quartier de Plainpalais. Appartement très fonctionnel avec un espace pour chacun permettant de s'isoler ou partager des moments conviviaux dans les espaces communs en fonction de l'humeur et des besoins de chacun·e.
La chambre est spacieuse, propre, très confortable avec de nombreux rangements, parfaite pour travailler ou se relaxer.
La plus belle surprise a été la rencontre avec Ludovica. Ce n'est pas toujours évident de loger chez une autre personne mais elle m'a accueillie et a su me mettre à l'aise dès les premiers instants. Nous avons partagé de bons repas entre discussions et fous rires et cela a participé à rendre mon séjour inoubliable.
Je reviendrai sans hésiter si l'occasion se présente.
Ich habe mich direkt wohlgefühlt und habe mit Ludovica viele schöne und lustige Momente erlebt und gleichzeitig wurde meine Privatsphäre zu 100% respektiert. Sehr empfehlenswert!

I had the best time in Geneva, as a solo female traveller Ludovika helped me with so much with how to get around, where to see and eat, we shared some special moments and I hope to return some day, great room, location and beautiful city, highly recommended
Ludovica è un'ottima padrona di casa. Oltre alla sua simpatia e gentilezza, è sempre disponibile per passare del tempo insieme, offrire aiuto e consigli. La casa è luminosa, sempre pulita e ordinata.

Ludovica is the best!! she’s very kind and fun. I stayed with her for a month, and I felt very lucky to meet her and talk with her about everything. Plus, she’s a great cook :) The house is very well located, with many places nearby. The room and the entire apartment are very comfortable and clean. It was an incredible stay 🥰

Ludovica’s place is great. The room is comfortable, great value, and it is very easy to walk to practically any part of the city from it. She also keeps it very clean which is great.
She made the stay feel like home and was extremely helpful, kind, and funny.
You will be sharing the amenities like kitchen and bathroom with her and perhaps another guest, and she does have some reasonable house rules that must be followed. Don’t expect a 5 star resort with a butler cleaning up after you.
Overall, I’d highly recommend staying here to feel like you live in the city!

部屋は広くて快適でしたが、隣の部屋や外の音がよく聞こえました。ルドビカさんは親切で、地元のおすすめの場所を教えてくれました。しかし、夕方(15時ごろ)に鍵が開けられずチャイムを押したら、寝ていたところだったようで怒られてしまいました。夜あまり遅くない時間(21時ごろ)に家に帰り、彼女が起きているか確認しようとした時も「私を起こすな」と怒られました。彼女が寝ているところを起こさないように気をつける必要があります。

The location, size of room, cleanliness, check in/and out were all really great, but most of all Ludovica is the gem and heart of the place. Staying with her felt like staying with a friend, and by the end of my stay, I really felt like I had known her for years instead of just a few days. She is incredibly generous and has great stories!
I would recommend this place for solo travelers who want a nice bed in a central location, and enjoy a bit of company in the home setting.
nickel

Me encantó la estancia en este alojamiento, Ludovica un encanto de persona, muy atenta y amable, disponible para lo que necesites, muy bien ubicado y de fácil acceso. Espero volver pronto a Ginebra y volverme a hospedar aquí.

Chez Ludovica on est vraiment chez soi: l'appartement est agréable, propre et très bien placé!
En plus Ludovica est accueillante, disponible et souriante.
Je conseille!

I loved staying with Ludovica, she's very friendly, attentive and makes you feel home right away. She made sure I was always comfortable and she's a nice person to hang out with!
The room was very clean, big enough for 1 person and the bed was comfy. The bathroom and shower were shared, but everything was always kept very clean.
The location was great, it's close to the centre of the city.
Ludovica really made an effort to make my stay the best, I can really recommend this place.

It was just perfect, Ludovica was so nice and i had a really great time with her. She really cares about your wellbeing during your stay. The only bad thing was that at night can be noisy and there’s people shouting sometimes. Overall, just perfect! I’ll definitely will be coming back!

Authentic, original Airbnb experience. Warm homestay in essence. Ludovica is a very welcoming person and a helpful host. When I first arrived at her place, I was exhausted. She made me a drink kindly, showed me the “not to miss” parts of the apartment, then understood when I went to bed. Got to know each other better and have a more thorough tour on the next day! The apartment is gorgeous - very private, modern, and minimalist without compromising on function or coming off too sterile. Internet works excellently and there are private bathroom, kitchen, and fridge spaces. Geneva is a brilliant city and I really enjoyed my stay.
Excellent host, definitely recommended for a stay in Geneva, very helpful and friendly. thank you!!

The room is a good size in this shared apartment. It is a three bedroom apartment and two of the rooms are rented out. Ludovica's son was also there one of the nights so there were four of us. The shared kitchen/dining is small but had the things I needed. Note there is no microwave or toaster and you can't eat in your room. Ludovica is friendly, helpful and accommodating, even sharing delicious food. For early June the bedroom was quite hot with no fan or A/C, there is a good window but it was noisy to leave it open due to normal city sounds.
The area felt safe for a solo female traveller, with buses and tram options within a 10 minute walk.
Ludovica is a nice woman. She was flexible with the check in and sat down with me to go over Geneva. She even offered for me to join her at one of her favorite places.

I highly recommend staying at Ludovica's place! The location is very central, easy to walk to the river Rhone as well as Carouge and Lake Geneva. Ludovica is very welcoming, was kind enough to cover my entrance fee for the Bains des Paquis when I did not have any cash on me, shared her food, provided an extra towel for swimming, and gave many tips for exploring Geneva. On my last night we went back to the Bains des Paquis and had dinner together with friends, it was a really lovely stay. The room that I stayed in was large enough to comfortably work remotely. There are many buses within a few blocks of walking and Cornavin station is also walkable. Overall, I cannot recommend her place enough.

Loved staying at Ludovica’s place, definitely a 10/10, very central in location, bus stop right outside the apartment. Ludovica was always very responsive and gave great recommendations for food and places to see. Everything was super comfortable and kitchen had all the stuff that made stay much more home-like. Would stay again next time i’m in Geneva for sure.

Je suis restée un mois chez Ludovica pour un stage à l'université. Mon séjour a été une expérience vraiment chouette. Dès mon arrivée, elle a tout fait pour que je me sente à l’aise et bien accueillie, avec sa bonne humeur, son aide précieuse et ses nombreuses attentions. J’ai particulièrement aimé les repas partagés et les petites douceurs locales et italiennes qu’elle m’a fait découvrir, qui ont rendu ce séjour encore plus chaleureux et mémorable.
La chambre était grande et confortable, tout était impeccable au niveau propreté, et l’appartement est idéalement situé pour profiter du quartier. Je repars avec de très beaux souvenirs et je recommande vivement ce logement et cette hôte exceptionnelle!
Merci infiniment, Ludovica! Tu as vraiment embelli mon séjour.
Thank you for your nice accommodation.

I had a wonderful stay at Ludovica’s place in Geneva. The room was spotless, comfortable, and exactly as described. Ludovica was an exceptionally kind and welcoming host who made me feel at home from the moment I arrived. The atmosphere was warm, friendly, and relaxing, making it easy to settle in after long days of exploring and working.
The location was convenient, the accommodation was very well maintained, and every detail reflected genuine care for guests. I would happily stay here again and highly recommend Ludovica’s place to anyone visiting Geneva. Thank you for such a lovely experience!
The apartment is very well located, spacious and super clean. I am very grateful to David for his availability and support during my stay.

Booked this place for my parents who came to visit so my main criteria was location - close to where I was - for which this place was ideal.
The appartment is as on the pictures, nice and clean and in a quiet area. It had the strict minimum (no soap, no dishwashing liquid etc..) while the stay was for a week.
One aspect that wasn't mentioned is that there is no elevator which for some might be a problem.
There seems to be a number of appartment managed in the same building so the contact with the host is slightly different from the usual Airbnb experience (more business) however all the information needed was available in one pager.
One aspect that we really didn't appreciate was the early check out at 9am that was not specified.

Very well located 3 minutes by walk both to Blanche and Augustine Tram stop!
Very clean! Besides the pictures, which are a little bit exaggerated in terms of outside views from the appartement , everything else went smoothly and were taken care of.
Great little studio, well furnished at a good location. The host was welcoming and flexible with my check out. I would definitely come back next time I'm in Geneva
Súper comfortable stay! It has everything you need.
The room is nice and very central located, would definitely go back again

A few work colleagues and I had a great stay at the Beautiful Villa when in Geneva for a conference.  Paul was an excellent host and did a great job communicating with us about all aspects of our stay.  The villa is very comfortable, brand new kitchen, great coffee (thanks Paul!), deck, pool, etc.  The shared spaces are a highlight -- nice living room, dining room, and deck -- with an emphasis on comfort.  The home is well located just a quick walk to the beautiful lake (and in a peaceful wooded neighborhood) and a 10-15 minute Uber to both the airport and fun tourist areas of Geneva. The bedrooms are comfortable -- nothing fancy, but clean, functional, and peaceful. Overall we really enjoyed our time!  Thanks again, Paul!
Clemence’s accommodation is perfect for a stay in Geneva, close to many points of interest, the local produce market, cafes and bars.  Great visit. Barry and Sue
Really nice place and great location for short trips in Geneva! I would definitely stay there again and Clemence is a great and responsive host!

The apartment is located right in the heart of the city and close to many bus stops which makes travelling around the city a breeze! Clemence was an absolutely amazing host who went to great lengths to make sure we had a comfortable stay. At one point during our stay we needed to get a document printed and instead of pointing us to a print house somewhere in the city, without hesitating, she printed it herself and brought it to us within 10 minutes of calling her. While the apartment building doesn’t have any elevators and the street can get a bit loud at night, it was very clean and comfortable! I would highly recommend this place to anyone coming to Geneva!

This is a great space that is clean, stylish and perfect for a single or couple. The bed was comfortable and it was great having a TV with Netflix for relaxing in the evening. The proximity to the lake was great, close to a grocery store and also plenty of places to eat out.  The only reason I would give it 4 stars and not 5 is just that it is a little bit loud in the evening with the bar downstairs. With the windows closed it was completely fine, but in the heat of summer I could see how this might be an issue for some (no A/C). There is a good fan for air flow and masking noise which is a nice touch.  Overall, I would still stay here again!

I had a fantastic and comfortable stay in Clemence’s Geneva apartment. I would highly recommend it, great location in a nice, lively neighborhood that doesn’t seem too touristy, generic or commercial. I would stay again!
Clémence flat is very convenient, clean and located in one of Genevas most cheerful neighborhoods, had a lovely time!

C’est mon deuxième séjour dans ce pied à terre au centre de Genève. D’une propreté et un chic exceptionnel combiné avec une hôtesse hors paire. On avait oublié des sous et Clémence à été d’une honnêteté exemplaire en appelant pour les rendre. Hautement recommandé.

This apartment is a wonderful place instead of a hotel room!
Close to the lake, fantastic transport nearby and good local restaurants close by as well.
Really comfy, king size bed, very clean with excellent appliances and fantastic shower!
We hope to be back very soon.

I loved my stay, the location is so central, only minutes to see the fountain and the lake, close to bars, restaurants and shopping. It was very quiet, but most of all it was stylish, so clean and every detail was taken care of. I cooked a lot and the kitchen was well equiped.
It exceeded my expectations and Clemence was an extremely good host. I would definitely stay again.

I cannot say anything but STAY HERE!! I have stayed at countless Airbnb’s, and Clémence was by far the best hostess I have come across. We got in late and she welcomed us to the apartment (with her adorable son!) and showed us all of the amenities and information that we needed. The location was easy to find and right above an amazingly cute cocktail bar! The location was unbeatable. 5 minutes walk from the water, a gorgeous park, and the city center. Clémence also provided a whole list of things to do in Geneva! (We highly recommend the chocolate tour)
In all, Clémence’s apartment was perfect in every way. We’ll be back!!

After being disappointed with our Airbnb in Paris, this was a welcomed change! Clémence was responsive, accommodating and most of all her flat was outstanding. The location was perfect and it was extremely clean.

Clémence est attentionnée et très serviable. L'appartement est très agréable de l'intérieur, propre et très bien situé! J'ai beaucoup apprécié mon séjour. Je recommande fortement cet appartement! Merci Clémence!

Clémence was the perfect host, very flexible and kind. The appartement is perfectly equiped, was very clean and decorated with taste. You re in the heart of Geneva, near the lake, plenty of cool bars and restaurants in walking distance, but one you close the windows it s calme and peaceful.
This place is so amazing! I love every bit of the apartment. The host is so nice and helpful. I would stay here again in a heartbeat!
Great place in the lovely district of Eaux-Vives!
Very good apartment, great and lively location, very clean and easy checkin. Would definitely go there again.
It was a great stay. The flat is so lovely and really in heart of the city. The host created great lists of recommendations which helps a lot. I highly recommend this place

Appartement cosy, très propre et calme situé dans le quartier très sympa des Eaux-Vives. Supermarchés et restaurants à proximité. Clémence est particulièrement réactive et l'entrée comme la sortie des lieux se sont faites très facilement. Idéal pour une personne pour un séjour de quelques semaines. Le Lac est à deux pas et la gare Cornavin est facilement accessible en bus, voire même à pieds (compter env. 25 minutes). Je ne manquerai pas d'y revenir lors d'un prochain séjour !

Magnifique experience! Je suis très reconnaissant pour l'hospitalité reçue par Clémence. L'appartement est très proche du centre. Très joli studio bien équipé, prope et joliment décoré.
Fortement recommandé pour les courts et longs séjours.

Nice cozy apartment in Eaux Vives close to the Jet d’eau!
Clean space and a responsive host! :)
Ce logement est tout simplement parfait! Très bien situé dans Genève,  dans un  joli immeuble, meublé avec beaucoup de goût et bien équipé. À recommander !
Great location and great host. Definitely recommend!
We had a great weekend stay here, great location with lots of restaurants and super walkable to everything

Όμορφο σπίτι,κεντρικό, πολύ καθαρό,πλήρως εξοπλισμένη κουζίνα, πεντακάθαρα κλινισκεπασματα,με γούστο διακοσμημένο, μέχρι και μπριζα υπήρχε ώστε να προσαρμόσω το σεσουάρ μου και αυτό με εντυπωσίασε.  Η ιδιοκτήτρια πολύ φιλική Το μπάνιο ήταν λίγο μικρό και εσωτερικού  χωρίς εξαερισμό και κάποια βράδια είχε θόρυβο από το μπαράκι που είναι από κάτω εάν δεν έκλεινε το παράθυρο. Επίσης δεν υπήρχε ασανσέρ και αυτό δεν αναφερόταν.
Eine sehr schön gelegene Wohnung in belebtem Viertel   in direkter Nähe zum See; sehr freundliche Gastgeberin; wunderbare Wohnung für zwei Personen.
Lovely flat in a fantastic location. Clear instructions from the host. Couldn't ask for more.
We loved staying here! The street gets quite loud at night, but it’s great if you’re wanting to grab a drink or hang out. Clémence was kind and communicated well! Would definitely stay here again.

Departamento muy bien ubicado con todo lo necesario para una estadía larga o corta cocina
Muy bien equipada todo muy bien recomendado

Nous avons passé un bon sejour. L'appartement est cosy, bien agencé située à 5mn du lac Leman. Toutefois, le logement est situé danns une rue tres passante en soirée, tres bruyantes en raison des nombreux bars/terrasses le soir entre 18h-2h00 du matin.

L’appartement de Clémence est très bien équipé, tout est neuf, tout à fait conforme aux photos. Il est bien situé, à quelques minutes à pieds de la place des Eaux-Vives. Vous passerez un séjour agréable dans cet appartement très bien décoré !
Clémence a par ailleurs fait preuve d’une très grande réactivité dès que nous avons cherché à la joindre pour partir à un horaire qui nous arrangeait. Nous recommandons l’appartement de Clémence pour un séjour à Geneva et n’hésiterons pas à y repasser
Fantastic location on one of the buzziest blocks in Eaux Vives. Apartment was just as described and very clean. Clemence was incredibly responsive. Would absolutely stay again!
It was great!
Perfect neighborhood, charming place , super responsive host.  A little noisy as clearly noted in the description but fine for us. Loved it.
Great space for one, super clean and modern. Indeed noisy at night but fan helped!
Very convenient, well situated, nice apartment.
A great place to stay.
Great area and nice space.
The perfect location for our trip. We LOVED staying here! Thank you!

We had a great stay at Clémence's flat. The location is very convenient and the neighborhood is packed with great restaurants and bakeries. The apartment was squeaky clean and very well equipped. Most importantly Clémence was incredibly kind and helpful - she arranged for a crib for our baby and even helped us carry our suitcases up the stairs! As other reviewers mentioned, it is noisy at night since we had to keep the windows open (we visited in late June), but other than that a really nice place to stay.

This was a wonderful apartment for our 5-day stay in Geneva! The lake is close by, and it doesn’t take long to get to old town by public transportation or walking. We felt incredibly safe in the apartment, as there is a gate, an apartment building door, and the apartment’s door.
There is a bar underneath the apartment, which is very crowded in the summer (when we stayed), but the windows do an excellent job of keeping it quiet. It also helped to use the fan at night, so this was not a problem at all.
Overall, amazing apartment. We’d stay again.

We loved staying at Clemence’s place in Geneva. It was convenient, close to public transportation, clean and the perfect place for a few days stay. Clemente was responsive, helpful and kind. Would definitely recommend staying here!

Fantastic place to stay in the heart of Geneva! Very cozy neighborhood and only a 5 minute walk to downtown! Would highly recommend anyone visiting Geneva for a couple of days to stay at Clémence’s! :D
Centrally located near good food and shops. The apartment was clean and well kept.

Lovely in apartment in a wonderful neighborhood. Close to everything and walked everywhere (didn't need to use our bus pass the entire time). The bed was very comfortable and the kitchen/dining setup was great. Would definitely recommend.

The apartment was well kept, and it was within walking distance to several public transit stops, Old Town, and the lake. The only draw back was the bars downstairs were quite loud at night, but the window was well insulated and blocked most of the noise when closed. Overall we had a great stay and would definitely recommend!
We stayed here 2 nights before heading out to the TMB. The apartment was clean, comfortable, and we loved the location: walking distance to the lake, grocery store, cafes. We appreciated the fan!

Getting into the flat was so easy- despite there being a few different steps, Clémence took pictures of everything and was incredibly descriptive about how to unlock the gate, get the key, and get inside. Our wifi ended up going out on the second day but she was very responsive when I messaged her and let us use her personal wifi. We never waited long for a response and she was very friendly. The area was a little noisy but honestly I expected worse because of the other reviews. We slept just fine! The kitchen and bathroom were spotless, the beds were very nice, and overall it was a lovely stay.

This is in a great location only two blocks away from the Geneva Lake, convenient for everything. The street has a couple of bars busy at night. But if you close the windows, it don’t notice all the noise outside

Clemence’s place was a perfect place for me to unwind and recover after hiking the TMB. Clemence respected my privacy but was responsive when I had a question about checkout. Her place is above a restaurant patio and in the summer open windows are a must. As an asthmatic, I struggled with the residual cigarette smoke wafting up from the restaurant and had to keep that window closed. Clemence had a fan, so I was able to turn it on and use the unaffected window to improve air circulation in the room. This isn’t a knock on her property at all, but something to be aware of given the property’s great location in relation to a very active restaurant scene. I didn’t notice any noise issues from the restaurants below.

Clémence is very responsive and friendly. The apartment was easy to get into. It is up three floors, but the landing between floors helps a lot. The apartment is small but in a great location. It is just 2 blocks from lake with lots of restaurants nearby.

My sister and I had a lovely stay in Ingrid's apartment. We were happy to find the place extremely clean and well-located (near bus stops, cafes, grocery, and a beautiful park).

Ingrid and her husband Ernie have furnished the apartment with all the essentials and more, and we enjoyed the perks of the balcony and the ability to use the building's shared washer/dryer. We were hoping to cook more meals in the apartment, but we had a really difficult time working the new stove-top. Overall, though, the amenities and experience of our stay in Ingrid's apartment were great.
Really good location - very central. Clemence's place was spotless. Clemence was a good host and responsive to my questions and concerns. Would definitely stay here again.

Clémence’s Airbnb is a wonderfully located and well maintained apartment in a great part of Geneva. Eaux-Vives has always been one of the liveliest areas ( so not quiet…) but the recent development of  Plage des Eaux-Vives (next to the beautiful park) and the new train station has made this one of the freshest parts of the city. Easy to get to (adjacent Rue du Lac buses 2 or 6 to most places, and a short stroll to the transport hub of Rive) or the lakefront at Jet d’Eau. There are restaurants bars and cafes all around as well as one of the best art-house cinemas in Geneva (Les Scala) across the road.
Clémence hat ja auf den Sound der Leute in den Bars hingewiesen, sind aber alles nette Leute und bilden einen angeregten Klangteppich. Im Winter ist es sicher ruhiger.

Definitivamente volvería otra vez, estaba súper limpio, ordenado y con detalles que hacían sentir a uno como en casa. Un departamento muuuy bonito y encantador, mejor de cómo se ve en las fotos.
Es cierto que en la noche hay mucho ruido afuera puesto qué hay 3 cafés en la calle pero también es cierto que cerrando la ventana no se escucha absolutamente nada y se descansa muy bien. Con el abanico qué hay en el departamento es más que suficiente. 10 de 10

My husband and I stayed at Clemence’s with our 10 month old son for three nights. The location is great and while it’s located on a busy street of bars and restaurants, we couldn’t hear anything with the windows shut. The place was clean and had everything we needed, including a cot. The space is very small and our son was eager to get out to move around. It’s only a ten minutes walk to Parc de la Grange which offered up big green spaces. Checkin and checkout were straightforward and Clemence was very responsive throughout!

Clémence’s place is very well located and practical. I stayed four days during a recent business trip.
The flat is easy to get to, and Clémence instructions were clear and helpful. Eaux-Vives is a great vibrant area and it can be a bit noisy in the evening, but it worked very well for me.
Kitchen, and the whole one-bedroom flat, is well-equipped with everything I needed. Many thanks!

I loved the place. I stayed for 16 nights and would happily stay in the same place if I come again. It’s a full apartment to yourself with a living room/kitchen, bathroom and bedroom. Spacious cupboards, kitchen had all the amenities, and bathroom very clean. You can easily make food yourself there, it has all the utensils. The apartment has a modern look from the inside, and is very clean, uncluttered and pretty.
The host is very responsive. She had someone help me carry my luggage up (no elevators) so that was very sweet. There were a few wifi issues but the host was responsive throughout.
The location is amazing. It’s in a very busy street with bars below, but if you close the window there is no noise.
I really loved the place and I miss it already! Thank you Clemence. :)

I had a great stay at Clemence Airbnb. It was exactly how she described it. The apartment is perfectly located with all of the restaurants close by and is easy to commute into the city or if you prefer a morning run along the lake. I definitely would recommend it for anyone wanting to visit Geneva.
Logement très bien situé j’ai pu tout faire à pied hyper pratique ! Clémence réactive si besoin ! Tout est fonctionnelle et j’ai très bien dormi
Great, thank you! I will book again if I come back

Cute little place.  Flat is actually on the 4th floor but we were super lucky and a kind gentleman helped us carry up our bags.  :)  Sadly, he was not there when we checked out.  lol.  Place was priced fairly and in a nice area.  Didn't know the bar was literally on the first floor below you so was very loud until after 1 am each night.   A fun, cute place to stay.  Host mentions not for the light sleeper, which is true, but also not for anyone wanting to go to bed even remotely early.   If you are out having fun each night it is absolutely perfect.

My wife and I had a wonderful stay and appreciated the apartment and the location. The local nightlife is practically silent as long as you keep the windows closed, which I found extremely impressive!
This is a lovely flat in a very convenient location! Clemence is very responsive and her instructions for finding and entering the flat were easy to follow.

Très bon séjour. Localisation parfaite pour nos activités. Appartement très agréable, propre et calme.
Nous recommandons fortement.

J’ai passé un agréable séjour dans cet appartement ! Très bien équipé, je salue également la propreté impeccable de celui-ci.
Il est extrêmement bien situé dans Genève, ce qui permet d’avoir le tout à proximité :)

Extremely clean flat. Lovely full kitchen with nice dining table. Comfortable bed. Enjoyed the TV in the bedroom. Organized and kind hostess. Convenient to many delicious restaurants and fantastic sites. Would definitely recommend.
Very clean, nice space. In a great area, close to everything in Geneva. Clémence was very responsive whenever I had a question. Overall, my experience was great.

Small and well-equipped apartment. Well located for old town and lake sites. The only negative was the lively bar below ( but this is clear in the details). Subject to that, I wouldn’t hesitate to recommend.

Jederzeit wieder.
Dank der guten Fenster konnten wir, trotz Bar im Haus, gut schlafen.
Die Wohnung ist hübsch und sehr sauber.

L'appartement de Clémence fut parfait: très propre et fonctionnel. Étant dans le quartier des Eaux-Vives, tous les commodités sont à proximité : boulangeries, bars, restaurants et supermarchés. Clémence a répondu à toutes mes questions très rapidement.  Je  recommande cet appartement sans hésiter!

Stayed with wife whole week. thanks to Clemence we found the place easily even during the night we came. place is not big, right enough for week for 2 persons. extremely clean (we are traveling a lot and know what it means), made form good materials, bathroom, kitchen, all. Plates, cups, forks, knives, whole set of everything you need, even paper towels, oil, peppers, salts, sugar, fairy, dishwasher tablets, all you usually missing on rented kitchen and usually forced to buy a lot just because you need a small amount - all are here! that is amazing approach towards to customers. also, Clemence is very responsive, once we got a wifi connection problems, she solved it in minutes just after sending message to her.
place is located in middle of busy street, whole night is noisy and crowds outside, but windows are nice quality too, when you close it you hear nothing. but we preferred to listen half of nights, just to be in middle of Geneva.
We will definitely come back! thanks a lot!

A beautiful flat in a great location! Located within walking distance of shops, cafes/bars/restaurants, parks, the lake, Old Town and public transport. The flat was as described, very clean and tidy with clear instructions on how to enter. A lovely place for both long and short stays in Geneva.
Great location. Walked the whole city on our 4 night stay. Super clean. Walk up was easy. Very nice bedroom, bathroom and kitchen area. Comfortable bed. We would stay again. Thank you.
Clemence is very friendly and the atmosphere here is very cozy and calm～recommend it!

Very nice and cozy apartment with great location. The kitchen is well equipped. Clémence was very helpful and answered all our questions. We stayed in the apartment for two weeks and had it cleaned twice, which was very nice. There are a couple of lively and popular bars in the street which you of course can hear in the bedroom in the evening - as also mentioned in Clémence’s description. It was no problem for us. Thank you for a great stay.

I loved the location! Really close to the center and Jardin Anglais (I was there for the Marathon), has everything necessary in the apartment for a very short stay for 1 person, and Clémence kindly helped with the transportation pass arrangements.

We loved our short stay at Clèmence's place. It was very easy to get to and convenient for walking around Geneva day and night. As made clear in the listing and the reviews, it is above a busy bar so we knew to expect some noise, which we found not too loud. We asked Clèmence a couple of questions when we arrived and she responded very quickly. She let us leave our cases for a while after the official checkout time, which we really appreciated.
Any vegetarians or vegans staying, we would highly recommend ChefMezze restaurant on Rue du 31 Décembre. The food is wonderful!
Tout était parfait, je recommande !
Una estancia muy agradable.
It was perfect for my daughter and her friend for their last night stay in Europe.
Great flat for two people. We loved how close it was to everything and well kept. We really enjoyed our stay here and also appreciated the washer/dryer and dishwasher
我们在公寓度过了愉快的假期，公寓打扫的非常干净，设施齐全，地理位置很好
Loved staying in Eaux Vives at this very cute apartment.  Will come back for sure!
La ubicación es perfecta! Céntrica pero no en el bullicio. Clemence respondió enseguida a todas las consultas y super amable. El apartamento tal cual en las fotos y muy limpio. Sin duda para repetir

Les indications étaient claires. Le logement est situé au 3e étage sans ascenseur. Ce n’est donc pas pour tout le monde. Il y a un bistro au rez-de-chaussé qui peut être bruyant si les fenêtres sont ouvertes mais la qualité de celles-ci est incroyable, une fois fermées on n’entent plus rien. Très bien situé à 2 pas du jet d’eau et de la gare eaux-vives. Quartier vivant avec une multitude de commerces. Salle de bain petite mais très propre et fonctionnelle. Cuisine bien équipée.
Exactly like described. Nice apartment in a cool neighborhood. Perfect for a few days stay in Geneva.
Nice and clean apartment. Clémence was a good and polite host

I can't say enough nice things about this place!! amazing location right above some of the best bars and restaurants in Geneva and blocks away from the best beaches!!
the place is well spaced out. I stayed here for 2 weeks and felt right at home. the host was SO responsive when I needed anything and even offered a clean halfway thru my stay which was so nice.
I wasn't worried about the noice; once you close the windows, no noise came thru.
would book again and will recommend this for any friends coming to visit Geneva!

L'appartement de Clémence est idéal pour un séjour au centre de Genève, pour des hôtes qui aiment se coucher tard et profiter des meilleurs bars de la ville. Les matins sont calmes et le quartier très vivant.
Great spot, would stay again!
Três bien , excellent emplacement.

Clémence’s place was exactly right for our 2-night stay in Geneva. It is small, but well organized, with plenty of room for a couple. We arrived on bikes and were able to park them securely in the enclosed outdoor entranceway. This was a big plus for us.
Clémence is a great host and an excellent communicator, responding to our questions (which we’re few) quickly.
Don’t let the reviews about the the noise from the restaurant and bar downstairs deter you from booking this place. The noise was, indeed, loud (even mid-week). Closing the windows did do much, but turning on the buzz fan dealt with it perfectly. With the fan on (pointed away from us because we didn’t need it for cooling), we didn’t hear a thing!
주변에 멋진 바와 상점들이 많습니다. 저녁에 사람들이 북적이지만 집안은 너무 고요하고 깨끗합니다
This is great little apartment in a great neighborhood.  The apartment is spotless and had everything I needed.  Clemence was a kind and very responsive host.  I would definitely book again.

Appartement fonctionnel et bien situé, à quelques pas du lac et de très bons restaurants. Transports publics à proximité. Le seul point noir (pour un sejour professionnel) est que le Wifi n'est pas de bonne qualité et dans mon cas, n'a pas fonctionné pendant plusieurs heures, ce qui est gênant pour qui a besoin de travailler.

I read all the reviews before I booked so nothing to add about the functionality and atmosphere. Cool hipster location and somehow quiet inside!  Certainly in autumn - and certainly by day even with open windows. I really wish to commend the cleanliness and the EXCELLENT hosting. Clémence shines in this. Really felt her attentiveness when I needed certain assistance to be Five star.

Parfait pour un séjour à Genève.
Emplacement idéal, tout est à proximité à pied. Le centre ville, des restaurants, bars, etc
L’appartement était impeccable, il y avait tout ce dont nous avions besoin.
Enfin Clémence a été très arrangeante car nous étions avec un bébé.
Vraiment rien à redire.

Ingrid and Arnie were both lovely and hospitable hosts. They picked me up at Geneva airport, drove me to their place and made sure that I was settled before driving back home! They provided several drinks in the fridge and maps of the area to help me orientate myself as well. They were always just a text or phone call away if I ever needed anything.

The flat was comfortable and clean. I appreciated having a casual espresso on the balcony every morning before going to the conference that brought me to Geneva. I had trouble accessing the Wifi on my British mobile, but I was able to connect easily with my computer.

The apartment was really nice, in a central, yet quiet location!  Ingrid and Ernie were amazing hosts! they picked me up from the airport when I arrived and they were always available and helpful! They regularly provided me clean towels and bed sheets. Highly recommended!

Le studio est aussi beau que sur les photos, baigné de lumière et chaleureux. On s'y sent très bien. Il y a des commerces tout près, et une ligne de bus qui vous dépose en plein centre ville en 10 minutes. Rien à dire sur l'accueil d'Ingrid et de son mari, ils sauront vous mettre à l'aise et en confiance très vite, et sont pleins de petites attentions. Un  grand merci.
Mal...porque me estuvo.presionando con la fecha y hora de salida...cuando ella sabia que yo dependia de un viaje y de encontrar otro alojamiento.

Ingrid is the kindest of the hosts. She met with us at the apartment at the beginning of my mother's stay, left a few chocolates to get us started during her trip to Switzerland, and guided us around the apartment.
The apartment itself is very well located, extremely clean, tidy, and well equipped for 1-3 persons.
TV and wifi work well, the kitchen is well equipped and the terrace is lovely.
Ingrid was always a text message or phone call away, and made sure we did not need anything during training stay.
I would highly recommend staying in her apartment and hope that we will have the opportunity to do so again, on an other occasion. Thank you Ingrid!
Very comfortable,  clean and quiet.  The hosts were also very kind

It is rare when your hosts greet you at the airport, took you to the apartment by their  car, showing on your way hole city! Apartment is like the place your are searching for at Airbnb! Clean, great location, perfect price and most important thing is that there is everything inside the apartment you may need during your stay! Merci Ingrid et Ernie!

Ingrid est très accueillante, l'appartement est idéalement situé à Champel et parfaitement équipé!
Le balcon en été est idéal!

Ingrid est une personne très sympathique, serviable et accueillante. La communication avec elle était super agréable et facile. L'appartement est clair, très prope et fort bien équipé. Les photos et la description correspondent tout à fait à la réalité. Il y a des restaurants, des magasins (p.ex. Migros) et un arrêt de bus à proximité. Avec les transports publics, on est vite au centre ville. Un joli parc se trouve tout proche. L'appartement est situé dans un quartier calme. Actuellement, il y a des travaux de rénovation dans l'immeuble vis-à-vis. Ingrid avait mis des boissons fraîches dans le frigo, des fruits (entre autres des cerises de son cerisier) et des chocolats m'attendaient. J'ai beaucoup apprécié mon séjour dans cet appartement et je ne peux que vivement le recommander!

I spent 3 months in Ingrid’s apartment and this is the best Airbnb I have had in Geneva so far.
If you are looking for a place to stay for both short and long periods, this is what you are looking for.
Ingrid is very nice and responsive and the apartment has all the amenities needed to make your stay as comfortable as possible.
The neighborhood is quiet since it is residential. It takes 15min by walk to get to the city center or you can take the bus.
Thank you Ingrid for letting me stay at your place!
Adrien
Good location, good communication. Cozy and comfy

Tout c’est très bien passé il fait bon et l’appartement dégage des ondes très positives
Nous le recommandons vivement si vous allez à Genève
Près de tout à pied très calme la nuit fenêtres insonorisées
Je dirais 10/10
Bravo Clémence et merci pour tout
Ana
Parfait! Un petit appartement très mignon, très propre où l'on se sent bien et comme chez soi. Très agréable d'avoir assez de matériel pour cuisiner :-) Merci Clémence !
Great location, amazing host, beautiful condo. Will book again when I’m back in town.

Loved this cozy small apartment. I travel by myself and I am usually scared to sleep alone so I end up not having the best sleeps. This cozy small apartment made me feel right at home and I loved how it’s always busy downstairs so it makes me feel safe. Perfect for 2 or 1 person. Downtown so you can walk to the lake and grocery store in 2 mins

Clemence’s place is charming and stylish. The lake is so close by. Her building is tucked away from hubub and the neighbours are all lovely. Clemence was so accommodating and responsive as a host. My daughter and I couldn’t have wished for better!

I had a great stay at Clemence's Airbnb for the week. She was very responsive and made everything easy. The check-in instructions were clear, and the apartment was very clean and cozy. The kitchen had everything I needed.
There’s no elevator, which could be a bit tricky with heavy luggage, but it wasn’t a big deal for me. When I first arrived, the internet wasn’t working, but Clemence fixed it right away. She was also flexible when I needed to change my arrival time and dates.
The location is excellent—close to everything and near some great bars and restaurants. Overall, it was a very pleasant stay. The place is perfect for one person and I would definitely recommend it!
Really enjoyed our brief stay. Super close to the lake with some nice restaurants nearby.
Wonderful flat
Thanks for a great stay. Perfect location to enjoy New Year’s Eve along the lake

The apartment is small, but very clean, tidy and functional. Everything worked well and kitchen was well equipped. Bed was comfortable. Location also very good, central, walked everywhere, and good neighborhood. Check-in was easy and very clearly explained. Coming in and out of apartment also very easy. Two negatives: it's a 3rd floor walkup, which was not a problem for me, but could be for people that can't handle stairs or carrying luggage. Très beau petit studio propre, bien situé et bien agencé. Instructions d’accès claires et détaillées, hôte réactive.
Tout était parfait pour une découverte de Genève !

Great, walkable location close to the major sites and restaurants. The apartment was exactly as shown and check-in instructions were very clear. Would recommend this apartment for two people looking to enjoy some time in the city.

Super host, super apartement, will stay there again when i come back ;), 10/10 , thanks

ottima pulizia di tutti gli spazi e della cucina. un po' piccolo il tavolo per essere utilizzato per il resto tutto corrisponde alla descrizione. comodissima posizione per il centro

Hermoso departamento, super bien ubicado ideal para una pareja, todo tal y mejor que lo publicado
Great stay, lovely area - off the street enough to enjoy peace, close to everything.  Very clean unit, simply decorated as to not clutter.  Preferable unit.

Studio rénové et propre. Idéal pour une ou deux nuits.

A great space in a central location, perfect for a one night stay for 1 in Geneva.
The place was great and was in an excellent location. It does get a bit hot in the summer without air conditioning. But this managble with the fans.
We had a great time staying at Clemence’s apartment. It’s centrally located in a lively neighbourhood with soundproof windows however. It was nice and cozy. Clémence was a great host!

Clemence is a very responsive host with great local knowledge. The apartment is a snug and spotless and right in the centre of the action. Some super craft beer bars just around the corner too.

Our stay was very positive, the apartment is well connected by transit and close to plenty of coffee shops, restaurants, and a wonderful park which was important for us with our dog. The host was very responsive and helpful throughout our stay.

Nous avons passé un très bon séjour chez Clémence ! L'appartement est confortable, agréable et très bien équipé. Je recommande !

Clémence’s place in Geneva was great for my work trip. Great location, spotless interior, and easy communication with the host. The neighborhood is lively (especially for Geneva), and the apartment is on a street with busy bars and restaurants. Definitely would recommend!

Appartement très agréable, conforme à la description. La taille est idéale pour deux personnes, on s’y sent tout de suite à l’aise. L’emplacement est excellent, très bien situé dans Genève, ce qui permet de tout faire facilement à pied ou en transports. Je recommande sans hésiter.

Le séjour chez Clémence a été très agréable. La communication était fluide et simple tout au long du séjour. L’appartement est idéalement situé, en plein centre de Genève, ce qui le rend très pratique pour se déplacer facilement dans toute la ville.
Très satisfait de cet appartement ! Propre, facile d'accès et très bien situé !

The apartment was very clean, comfortable, and fully equipped with all the amenities we needed. Had a great stay at home his apartment for a week-long stay.

all was super

Clémance is a perfect host. She always ready to help and accomodate your need. The studio is very nice, with everything you need (small bathroom with shower, kitchen, double bed).

appartement d'une propreté impeccable. l'accueil D'Ingrid est remarquable avec des petites attentions très appréciables. Je recommande

Great place. Ingrid was wonderful and helpful.

Excellents accueil et séjour chez Ingrid : l'appartement était impeccable, bien équipé, très bien situé (à deux pas d'un arrêt du 3 et de la gare de Champel si vous prenez les transports en commun) et baigné de lumière. Ingrid est une hôtesse très accueillante et réactive, toujours disponible et soucieuse de savoir si notre séjour se passe bien !

I spent a week at Clemence’s place, a very nice, clean and modern apartment in a super neighborhood. Very close to the lake, supermarket and bus/tram stops nearby. Plus good bars and restaurants. A big plus is that the apartment is really well equiped. The kitchen and bathroom are very complete, everything you need in a home!

Having stayed in Geneva many times for work, I found Clémence's place to be of great value for money, sparkling clean, with all the vital amenities, and in a fantastic location. She is also an incredibly responsive and helpful host. The place is a little noisy due to the bar downstairs, as other reviewers have pointed out, but this didn't bother me too much. I'd love to stay here again.

I stayed in Clemence's place for the long term and loved it. I was very comfortable the entire time. Many reviews mention the bar downstairs, and yes, it can get noisy but once the window is shut, no noise can be heard anymore. I would definitely stay here again should I return to Geneva.

Clèmence's appartement is a little gem in the hearth of Eaux Vives. Nested at the last floor of an historic building, the studio has character and all the necessary for a very comfortable stay. The apartment is decorated with a lot of taste and with all new furniture; the bed, in particular, is very comfortable. The location is perfect to get around Geneva centre, close to the lake and with plenty of nice bars in the street underneath (this means a bit of noise in summer, but that is the trade-off for the great opportunity of walking 2 minutes home after a drink). Check-in and check-out times are very good. Clémence is a very nice and helpful guest. Perfect setup for a business trip. Highly recommendable.
Très bonne qualité de l’accueil, le jeu de piste pour rentrer dans la chambre m'a beaucoup amusé! merci beaucoup également pour les chocolats!
Clemence was a wonderful host. Thank you again!

I stayed at Clemence's place for over 2 months. The apartment was clean, comfortable, and centrally located with plenty of shops and restaurants nearby. Access to transit was excellent, and the waterfront was only steps away. Clemence was an excellent host. She was responsive, helpful, and friendly. Highly recommended!

Studio très bien situé
Très propre et fonctionnel
Clémence est très réactive !!

Really nice flat, very good location two blocks or so from the lake. Quite small but perfect for a couple. Clémence was super helpful and responsive and let us check in two hours earlier!

Clemence is a wonderful host and very helpful. The apartment is clean, comfortable and in a great location. Comfortable bed, great shower, and a very well equipped kitchenette. Overall a wonderful place to stay, highly recommended!
Great studio, ideal location and Clémence was very easy and nice to communicate with. Definitely recommend the apartment!
El contacto con Clémance fue inmejorble, siempre estuvo dispuesta para todas mis preguntas. El piso si bien es muy pequeño es muy acogedor. Volvería sin duda.

Joli studio bien équipé très central donne en plein sur une rue très animée le soir stt le week-end en raison de bars réputés et de restaurants fréquentés. Pour quelqu’un qui a envie de se coucher tôt pas idéal sinon parfait
Nice stay in the center of town easy to walk to everything. Small apartment but was clean.

Clemence’s place is perfect for exploring the city. The space is small but well appointed and very comfortable.
Appartement idéalement situé pour profiter de Genève. Propre et bien agencé. Excellente communication avec Clémence !

Clean, small apt in nice central location.  Clemence is an excellent and very responsive host, had no issues whatsoever getting in and out.
Great place to stay to see all of Geneva, including nightlife right at the bottom of the building and along the street. Walking distance to everything. Clean, comfortable space.

Clemence’s space was very centrally located in a trendy neighborhood. She had lots of  great suggestions in terms of places to eat. The unit was nice and clean and had everything one would need. I would recommend this place to anyone looking for accommodation in Geneva.
Nous avons passé une nuit dans le logement de Pierre, nous avions un avion tôt le lendemain matin, tout s’est bien passé, la communication a été très fluide
Very nice and acommodating host. Was a pleasure to stay there even if it was briefly.
A great place to stay for a few days or weeks. The host is very friendly and accommodating. Just be aware that you'll be sharing living room, bathroom and kitchen.

Logement pratique tout proche de l’aéroport
Teresa was lovely and very welcoming. The apartment was very clean and well-equipped. Will definitely stay there again if I'm back.

It was a great location for a first experience in Geneva. The minimarket right next to the apartment made the stay very easy. The apartment was clean, nice and convenient. Better than staying at a hotel.

Teresa is a wonderful hostess. She made sure I was comfortable and provided all the basics that I needed for the month's stay. She keeps a clean and meticulous place. Her apartment is accessible to all amenities, restaurants and the lake. I truly enjoyed my stay and would highly recommend her place.

Teresa is very easy to communicate with and answers your questions very fast. She clearly has a lot of experience of foreigners who need a place in Geneva and she has been very helpful for us (especially to get a rent agreement in the right format to get a B permit).
The area is quite noisy so make sure you are not too sensitive to noise. The restaurant nearby would put loud music each night from Friday to Sunday when staff are cleaning the kitchen (usually until midnight or half past midnight), and at one time there was also a sort of “private party” at 4:00 am inside (even though the restaurant was closed). As of 03/2018, there is construction work in the building and in another building of the street, which means that there is constant noise during the day.
The apartment is fairly priced for Geneva, and it contained everything we needed for a 3 months accommodation. The apartment is quite big, even though I personally prefer apartments with less furniture so that the place feels more spacious. Some pieces of furniture are a bit worn out. For example, the bed base is clearly broken and has been hastily repaired with some scotch.

Apartamento condizente com as fotos, de tamanho muito bom e preço justo. Muito bem localizado, próximo do belo lago , das estações Gare Cornavin e Gare Routiere, do supermercado Coop e de bons restaurantes.  A anfitriã respondeu a todas as minhas questões. Recomendo!

Well appointed in a great location. Short stroll to the lake and to the main thoroughfare to catch the tram, bus or train. Close to a few supermarkets to get groceries. Several nice restaurants closeby. Host had great communication. Would stay again.
Localização ótima, apartamento em excelente estado, muito espaçoso e confortável!

The apartment is spacious, comfortable and very well located, near public transportation, supermarkets, restaurants, and, above all, at just two blocks from the lake. Teresa is a great host, she really cares you enjoy the most your stay.

Teresa’s apartment is very comfortable for any stay in Geneva.

I can recommend Teresa as a great host. She went the extra mile to ensure that I was sorted out for my stay. Communication was easy and prompt.
Thank you Teresa.
Very good stay . Thank you !!!
A great location and really good facilities. Even a bottle of bubbly in the fridge!

Great location in Pâquis if you come to work in the Sécheron area where United Nations buildings are. It took me 9 minutes door to door by bus. The apèartment is centrally located, clean, spacious and Teresa is a great host

Amazing location, 5 min from the lake and 10 min from the train station. Many restaurants and stores around and everything you could need ask to cook at home too if you're not in the mood for outing. Well equipped and very clean... And host very responsive and accomodating. Thank you Teresa !
Teresa is like a mom and the location is excellent!

The apartment is as advertised . Easy to slip into with all needed amenities and very clean.

El apartamento está muy bien situado en el barrio de Paquis. Tiene muchos restaurantes, cafés y tiendas alrededor. Sin duda un apartamento recomendable. Si tengo que alojarme más veces en Ginebra, sin duda repetiría.

Logement tout à fait conforme à la description. La situation était idéale, toutes les commodités sont à proximité ! À cette période il faisait chaud et c’est impossible de dormir la fenêtre ouverte dans ce quartier très animé et très dense en logements.

Teresa’s place was great - really clean and well equipped. I love the neighborhood it’s in - lots of activity, great cocktails (La Guidoline), and delicious food (Gandhi Café). Very close to the lake as well. Would fully recommend!!
Teresa's place is wonderful. She is very responsive! Location is excellent with cool cafes and restaurants nearby. I will definitely stay here again next time I am in town

This apartment was very clean and within walking distance to bus lines, the fountain, grocery, and several restaurants! The apartment was very comfortable, and we hope to stay here again in the future!

Location was amazing, within walking distance of everything. Place is a little small but cozy! Would recommend staying here to a friend. The host is amazing and very responsive.
Very good localization, very friendly the owner , easy contact . For sure I will back .

We had the opportunity to stay 7 nights. In the description says that it is noisy so we were warned. My girlfriend had no problems at all for sleep but I must say that I purchased a very nice wax earplugs in the pharmacy (for 8 CHF) and worked more than well. I used those earplugs two times. So it was noisy Thursday and Friday, but the rest of the nights was ok.
Regarding the toilet, it was very clean and equipped with soap, shampoo, conditioner and towels, it was a bit cold at the first time. I think the oven in the kitchen can not cook pizza, but that was not an issue for us. The TV comes with Netflix so we watched The Irishman. It was a long movie but from the bed was ok to watch it.

Emplacement idéal quartier animé, appartement bien équipé.

Excellent studio in the heart of downtown near lots of food and bars.  Only downside was there is a bar/restaurant on the lower level that was noisy until 1am or so.  Otherwise it was a wonderful and very convenient place to stay.

Clémence was extremely hospitable and welcoming during my stay in Geneva. I had recently moved to Geneva and needed a place to stay for 2-3 months while I was searching for a permanent apartment. The flat is small but equipped extremely well with all the necessities for a mid-term stay including kitchen with microwave, stove, kettle and coffee maker with all necessary utensils. Only downside for a longer-term stay is no laundry machine, however Clémence recommended me a local laundromat only 200 metres away which did the job well.
Clémence was always quick to respond to any questions I had about the apartment, and nagivating my way around Geneva in general.
As noted in other reviews, the apartment is above a bar, so if noise does bother you, I would not consider staying here. However for me, I used earplugs at night while sleeping which blocked out the noise completely (there is no heavy base coming through the floors for instance). The only other note is that the apartment is on the top floor with no lift, so if mobility is an issue for you I would also not consider staying here. For me however, it was no problem.
A great stay and a lovely welcome, thanks Clémence!

The place was super nice because of the location, sleeping area and the fact that there was Netflix on the pretty large size TV and it was in English!!! If you are around me and my sisters age (17-24) then I highly recommend staying here. Excellent location,  near shops, restaurants, lake, and old town Geneva. Clemence was excellent host. Room located on 4th floor, (no elevator) well furnished, with full kitchen. This full, private apartment is a great choice for convenience and ease accessing the heart of Geneva and other attractions.
Sparkling clean apartment with everything new inside. Location is perfect, very close to the lake. Check in and check out was smooth. I had everything I needed. Thanks Clemence!

Great AirBnB— lots of kitchen supplies, very clean, walking distance from pretty much everything we wanted to do in Geneva. Only downside is that it’s over a restaurant/bar, so Saturday night was quite loud! We liked being nearby the beach, restaurants, and bus lines though.

Die Wohnung ist extrem schön eingerichtet und hat alles was man braucht. Auch war sie sehr sauber. Die Lage ist top und super zentral. In der gleichen Strasse gibt es tolle Bars und Restaurants. Die Kommunikation hat auch einwandfrei geklappt und wir waren einfach nur zufrieden.

UN Offices are a 10-15 minutes walk away; transport connections (if needed) are decent (short walk to stops of tram 15, bus 1, 11, 25 and 28, the latter going straight to the airport); shopping for groceries a bit further away, but comfortably reachable by public transport or walking; all basic equipment and amenities are available (except a microwave and dishwasher) and LOTS of space to feel at home in (especially if you're traveling alone; there's definitely enough space for more people, though, if lack of privacy/separability is not an issue).
