The apartment is exactly as described.  Very clean, great wifi, cable tv.  Great neighborhood near big grocery store and the lake.  Thanks Philippe!
C un bon logement mais un peu cher
Very confortable place, well located in downtown, next to grocery shopping, public transportation and restauration. Street a bit noisy though. Overall I really enjoyed it and i'll come again.

It's second long term stay.  Great neighborhood with great stores for groceries and anything else you need nearby.  Walking distance to the lake and the mouette.  Transportation right outside door.  Very clean.  Great internet, cable on smart tv.  Prompt  communication with Philippe!  The apartment is exactly as described.  I was very happy with everything!
Everything was perfect, GOOD AREA , good communication with Philipe, I have nothing else to say is a very good Place to stay ;)

Philippe is one of the nicest people I have come across in Geneva, and his place was great - cosy, clean, safe and in one of the best locations in the city, close to the lake, park, bars and restaurants. Highly recommended.

Perfectly located studio in the heart of Geneva, walking distance from the main shopping avenue, the jet d'eau and public transportation. The studio is small but clean and very well organised and equipped (with a great wifi and cable TV system). I think is perfectly suited for one or two people that want to spend one week in Geneve. Interaction with Philippe has been flawless, he's very nice and efficient in providing all the needed information. Certainly I'll chose again this place next time I'll be in Geneve.

Fantastic space that is close to bars and restaurants in Eaux-Vives. Also loved that the #12 Tram was steps away to quickly get into the city. Boreal café nearby made every morning better. Didn’t get to meet Philippe, but check-in was smooth and he was super responsive. Overall great stay! Would 100% recommend!
Nice and clean place. Philippe's a great host, easy check- in and everything. But WATHC OUT for the TRASH that is put right in front of the window. A big NO NO
Once again, very nice!!!!
Everything as expected, great stay! Thank you Philippe.
Great location and Phillipe was very helpful, great spot for a night or two. Bedroom is small but clean and neat.
This was perfect for us. All the amenities we needed and excellent location. Host responded  quickly to inquiries. Good value in Geneva.

Although I never met Philippe in person he was always very responsive and helpful (especially when the hot water went out.) The location of the apartment is great and the apartment itself is suited for a short stay. It is somewhat underground so you can hear the rumble of the tram tracks when a tram goes by. But all in all the apartment was perfect as an interim solution while I waited for my new apartment.

I really loved this studio apartment, central, right amongst the restaurants with the landmark fountain just at the end of the street.  It’s cosy, with good quality appliances with a great feeling of warmth and safety (3 sets of lockable doors before you get inside). Whilst the window is at footpath level, the sound proofing meant I was able to catch up on sleep peacefully last night of my work stay. Phillipe is almost instantaneous with feedback and was helpful with last minute questions and changes. For the price it is great value, especially if you’re travelling alone.
Simply correct to sleep one night

Great stay in Geneva. The apartment is in a quiet area, but it’s about a 5 minute walk to the lake so it’s very centralized. It’s the perfect size for two people.... the room is basically one bed, a small bathroom and a kitchenette. Overall a good value.

Philipe's place was great, only 10 mins away from the city centre and very close to bus and tram stations, which was very convenient. He had a travelcard provided for us and plenty of recommendations for food, drinks and what to see in Geneva. I definitely recommend his place, he was very prompt to replies.

The place is centrally located, and had everything we needed for the weekend. Philippe was quick to communicate. One thing to note: the apartment is located partially below ground and the window opens directly into the street– which at times could get a little noisy. Beyond that, the place is as described.

great apartment , well appointed , super clean with all the amenities needed, nice kitche, cable TV, etc. located in a very good are just afew blocks from the lake, restaurants, etc. Very responsive and amia le host, I will be back ! , recommend 100%

Highly recommend Philippe's place. Location was great. Quick with response. Checking in was a breeze even without having to meet Philippe.
5*
公寓地处日内瓦Eaux-Vives区域，门口就是Tram 12车站，去往老城区、主要景点和商业街非常方便。入住过程非常便利，房间干净整洁，床很舒适。房间位于半地下，有一个临街的窗户，除了夏天可能有些闷热，早晨过往的车辆有些噪音以外，一切都很好！

Phillipe is a gracious host providing us with a spacious, comfortable apartment. The apartment was easy to find, clean, close to the tram stop, supermarket and only a short walk to the fountain/lake.
It did get somewhat noisy due to having to leave the windows open because it was hot and the apartment is at street level.
The apartment is well equipped, with adequate cooking items although a jug or bottle for water in the fridge would have been much appreciated in the hot summer Geneva was experiencing.
Overall a comfortable place to stay.

Very conveniently located.  As described.  Great communication.  There was some noise on the street, but it is much less if windows/shutters are closed.  Bring an extra pillow or blanket if you prefer.
Very nice place and great location. Very clean and great hospitality. Highly recommended

Philippe responds very quickly and you get exactly what is described.
The location is literary right next to the Roches tram station, extremely convenient. It’s also very close to many tourist sights, including the famous lake.
I was in Geneva for a conference, and very happy I chose his place.

Philippe’s apartment is a great place to stay for a night or two, as it’s located in a very safe and quiet areas and 5-7 mins of walking from the Lake. But if you decided to stay longer, it may be not very convenient, as the apartment’s floor is underground. So, take this into your consideration. But, other than that, everything is super! Apartment is very well equipped, and Philippe is great host!
Great place to stay in Geneva close to the lake and easy to find and organize check in etc. Very clean with nice amenities and comfortable bed. would stay again !!

It was a perfect location , safe and easy transport , nearby grocery store and shops a walking distance to the lake.
Were happy withe studio amenities Nice kitchen, the large comfortable bed, a smart tv wifi is good , nice bathroom. We have’nt meet Philippe but he keep in touch.
I highly recommend the philippe’s place.

Good place for business travelers. No fuss place to crash, clean with everything you need . Close to tram, cool little cafe around corner. Bed is nice and firm. Gets stuffy. So if you open window you will get the street noise but didn’t bother me.
Internet was good. There was tea etc. safe
Mes hôtes étaient ravis. Merci philippe
All as described. Easy check-in. Comfortable stay. Great location. Philippe was very efficient in communication and 100% helpful. Highly recommended.
Really nice place and good location just next to the tram stop.

Studio fidèle aux photos et très bien situé. Avec le tram on est en quelques minutes dans le centre de Genève mais tout est faisable à pied. Commerces à proximité.
Philippe est très réactif aux messages, bonne communication.
Je recommande :)

Location was great just 30sec to the Roches tram station and several bus is available in 5min distance. The space was clean and just nice for 2 persons :) if you prefer a room with sunlights, maybe you will go for another option, however this place is great for people who wants a calm hidden spot. Philippe is very nice host and usually reachable. Remember prepare for coins to pay tourist tax! He will provide you free transport ticket per person in return ;)*

excelente anfitrião sempre rápido a responder e atencioso. self check in para mim foi óptimo.
apartamento com tudo o que é necessário para uma estadia de uma semana e o pormenor da cama recolher, fantástico, pois permite ampliar o espaço.
recomendo e voltaria!

Place is very well located in Geneva, host is responsive and room is as per photos and description (incl good wi fi etc). However, be aware that the room is at underground level! Therefore, it is impossible to open the window, and entrance is among cellars and storage rooms.
Perfect location, clean, it has all what you need, just perfect!

Apartamento bien situado, al lado del transporte público y a 5 minutos del centro, limpio y que se corresponde con las fotos.

Appartement magnifique avec vue imprenable sur le lac. Seul bémol, pas de balcon pour l'été.
Check-in et check-out très pratiques et rapides grâce à la confiance du propriétaire et de Marc.
Emplacement de rêve à Cologny !
Si l'élevage de chiens n'existait pas au rez-de-chaussée de cette maison, cet appartement vaudrait 5 étoiles...

My family and I stayed for two nights in this beautiful space.  The pictures are very accurate.  The apartment is uniquely designed and spacious.  We knew there would be dogs downstairs, and yes it smells like dog in the stairwell, but we found no dog smell in the apartment. The dogs did not bark at all during the night.  The apartment was clean and well-stocked.  Communication with Marc was prompt and easy.  The views of the lake are beautiful and the little town of Cologny is quaint and delightful.   Overall we enjoyed our stay very much and found this apartment to be an incredible value compared to hotel prices in Geneva!!  We would definitely stay here again.
PERFECT PLACE TO RELAX

This property is simply amazing, exactly as listed
3 bedrooms with ensuites and an excellent mood lighting system makes for a very relaxing stay
the view and sunsets are breathtaking
The location is excellent for those happy to walk into town also
There are some dogs being bred downstairs who are fine once they get to know you and the lady who breeds them was really friendly and helpful

The flat was a really great spacious place for my family and our weekend in Geneva. Located in the beautiful district Cologny, with wonderful views of the lake and really quirky and fun interiors. Super-cool converted loft, and about a 20 minute walk into the centre of the city, along the lake. Really important to note that there are 9 dogs living below, so there is a bad smell in the stairwell before you get to the flat door and lots of barking in the day - we didn’t mind it too much as we were only there for a few days and out most of the time - but I’m not sure we would be able to put up with it for much longer. Check in instructions could be a bit clearer as there was quite a bit of confusion on arrival. Otherwise, a great space so thank you to your team!
Stay was pleasant except for the bad odor emitting from downstairs where all the dogs are.

L'appartement est somptueux, fidèle aux photos et la vue est imprenable! En arrivant devant la maison on ne sait pas trop à quoi s'attendre car en passant dans le couloir pour monter à l'appartement vous avez une odeur horrible de chiens mouillés qui provient de chez les voisins du dessous. Mais je vous rassure lorsque vous passer la porte sa en vaut la peine! La literie est très confortable et les salles de bains dans chaque chambre sont agréables lorsque vous êtes plusieurs! Mes amis et moi avons décider de revenir à Cologny une prochaine fois.. Même si nous habitons Lausanne, ce petit coin de tranquillité nous a donner l'impression d'être en vacance!!! Merci à Marc d'avoir été disponible par messages, même à 00h30!

On arrival this apartment looked absolutely amazing! It was in such a super location and had amazing views out over the lake. It really was stunning and looked just as in the photos. It was spacious and had a great open feel. There is also a fantastic little bakery right across the road which sells fresh pastries.
Outside the apartment there is a very strong smell of dog but this vanishes when you enter the apartment and it didn't bother us during our stay; we also very rarely heard the dogs.
Although the owners have tried to incorporate the latest gadgets within the house, we found many features confusing and lacked the basics. We really struggled with the lights. They were often quite dim and would randomly go off of their own accord. In the top room many of the lights didn't actually work meaning our friends were having to shower/get dressed using their iPhone lights! I feel a guide needs to be given to cover the basics of using the lights as this was a bit of a pain during our stay.
Along with this, we had no idea how to use the fireplace and were far to scared to start playing around to it left untouched during our visit even though we would have loved to have cozied up in front of it! Again, a little note of guidance would have been great.
Finally, we had NO WIFI for the duration of our stay. When first attempting to use it we were able to input the password and it appeared to connect however it never fully connected. When I contacted Marc he was responsive to begin with and asked us to re-set it. After responding to say we had done so numerous times, his last message was that he has contacted to company who said everything was fine and to make sure we were resetting the correct box. After this we had no further contact for the duration of our stay and the problem was never resolved. If you spend most of your stay out this would not really bother you however we stayed in most nights and it was very frustrating not being able to use the internet.
Overall, the apartment has a FANTASTIC location and stunning views and if you really only use the apartment to get changed and sleep, it would be perfect. However, if you plan to stay in a bit and spend time cooking it lacks some of the basics. I feel like a more thorough welcome pack should be left to explain how to work some of the amazing gadgets in the house.
The flat is absolutely gorgeous and Marc is a very nice host (and a true problem solver! :-)
Vue et design de l’appartement ++

great location and home, beautiful views and very well decorated

Bonne expérience malgré 2-3 bémols. L’appartement est sublime et la vue superbe!
The apartment is wonderful. The only negative was the dogs. It smelled pretty awful and they barked fairly late into the night. Stunning views of Geneva and I would recommend it to everyone.

Great upscale neighborhood with easy access to old town Geneva. The place was perfect for three couples. The design of the space was really enjoyable, very well done!! We loved the open space kitchen and great room. Amazing views from the main space and two of the bedrooms. Kitchen is very well equipped. Within steps of the A bus line which is handy.
There is a bistro and restaurant with Michelin star owners and chefs within steps as well. plus, a bakery that has wonderful breads and pasteries right across the street. I would visit again if my travels allow!!

We enjoyed our stay very much, the penthouse is huge and well designed with quality facilities. We never saw the host because we didn’t need too and we got the impression just use the place as your own but with respect. The lights did go out a couple of times but I think they are on a timer but it was no problem just to turn them back on again. Some past reviews have said they didn’t know how to work some of the facilities, ie: cooker, microwave, I agree there were no instructions, but you do work it out... nothing was too hard that you couldn’t solve and I’m average intelligence. There were plenty towels, lovely clean beds. WiFi worked well for us. The dogs have cropped up in a lot of reviews, but to be honest, you never really hear the dogs, the occasional bark now and again, it’s not like it’s constant and annoying. It does smell a little of dog in the entry but that’s only for a few seconds, once your in the apartment it’s fine. But if you don’t like dogs you’ll always find fault somewhere, if you like dogs then it won’t be a problem. Anyway the lady who owns the dogs was very friendly and helpful and none of the previous dog complaints in past reviews bothered me one bit. All in all the apartment is an awesome place, it’s very spacious with beautiful views. The bus stop is just outside the door, with buses running every 15/20 minutes. It was a great place to stay with an excellent bus service or a pleasant walk to central Geneva. I would stay again if I was in Geneva and would give the apartment full star rating.... Thanks Marc....
Great space, cool decor and a lot of space, nice and quiet.  Although a bit out of town, we loved it.  The dog smell in the corridor is a bit much but bearable - worth it for the flat!

Très très jolie apparemment je vous le recommande ,magnifique vu , très spacieux et très bien placé.
Il y a juste un seul point négatif c’est l’odeur au rez-de-chaussée des chiens.

Amazing flat overlooking the lake with stunning views across to Geneva and the fountain. Easy transport links via bus or a 30 minute walk to Geneva itself. The Flat is sooo cosy, lovely chill out areas, sociable kitchen area and soft lighting at night which adds to a relaxing ambience. Rooms with decent sized beds and the upstairs shower is fabulous with views across to Geneva.  Honestly one of my favourite Airbnb stays! Thank you, Lara
el apartamento es fantástico pero el acceso por el portal es tremendo por el olor de los perros de la vecina

Beautiful property overlooking the lake. Very clean, modern, and quiet. There were several great places to eat and transportation was always easily available. I traveled with two other work associates for a conference. We found the home to have plenty of room and privacy. Highly recommend!

Marc's apartment is amazing. It's perfect for up to three couples and has an incredible view. It's also on top of a dog kennel, which can make the area by the door smell strongly of wet dog...but absolutely amazing overall!
Would recommend!

Outstanding view of the lake! Awesome location- can walk to the lake and to the city.  We had a rental car as well- parking easy and available close by and on site. Close to excellent restaurant - market and bakery. Even bought flowers and a card at the flower shop. Neighbor with the dogs was nice- no dog smell in the house— place quiet- we thoroughly enjoyed our stay.

The view from Marc’s place is gorgeous.  The apartment is extremely stylish and well stocked for needs of travelers.  The dogs from the neighbor downstairs were loud at times and the smell was more prominent than I expected.  There was also some communication issues with the guests where questions were not answered.
Fantastic apartment, great location.

A casa linda, tudo limpo e organizado, ótima localização, só o cheiro da escada que tinha dia que era insuportável, mais como foi falado na descrição, ja sabíamos.
Mais tirando isso indico para todos, adoramos o lugar, tudo muito lindo, limpo.
Adoramos nossa estadia.
Very good located accommodation, lake view, stately neighborhood

La casa es espectacular, la estancia fue increíble, mejor de lo esperado, recomendable 100%. Tiene un problema, el acceso por las escaleras, huele muy fuerte por los perros de la vecina. Deberían limpiar las escaleras ya que es una zona común y es incomodo subir al apartamento por ahí. Pero el apartamento es fantástico, tiene unas vistas espectaculares.

The view is outstanding. The third bedroom is quite disappointing: there is no shades/curtain in the room, so people across the street can see you sleep or taking a showing; the shower room is not sealed perfectly, so when you take a shower, the water is leaking out a lot on the floor outside; the bed was partly broken during the stay. The most disappointing thing is the host doesn't respond to most of the messages.

Les points positifs : la literie est de grande qualité, une très belle vue, un appartement agréable et spacieux. Le service qui s'occupe de l'appartement vous envoie tous les détails pour accéder à l'appartement et récupérer les clés.
Les point négatifs : L'appartement se situe dans un petit immeuble de trois étages. Pour accéder à l'appartement vous devez passer par un couloir commun avec la voisine du premier étage. L'odeur dans le couloir est tout simplement irrespirable. La voisine a en effet une multitude de chiens et l'odeur est très présente dans le couloir et dans l'entrée de l'appartement. Nous sommes arrivés tard le premier soir et n'avions ni eau chaude, ni chauffage. Il pleuvait beaucoup dehors et dans les salles de bains se trouvant dans les chambres il y avait des fuites d'eau venant du plafond.
Conclusion: J'ai envoyé un message à notre hôte pour lui demander son aide. Il a répondu dans l'instant que rien n'était problématique. Nous sommes quand même resté 6 jours pour un prix conséquent. Prix haut de gamme pour un service pas très haut de gamme. Nous ne reviendrons pas.

Fantastique appartement, cosy, luxueux, avec tout l'équipement nécessaire. La vue est impressionnante, les lumières recherchée et la décoration très belle. On s'y sent tout de suite confortable! Je ne peux que recommander!
Appartement agréable si on fait abstraction des odeurs de chien .
Amazing place to stay to enjoy Swiss lifestyle

This house is veru nice to spending holiday with family. The room was clean, the view was perfect, and the neighboor is so kind too.
you should try this house for your holiday in geneva
Beautiful, spacious apartment with AMAZING views!
Wonderful place centrally located in Geneva. Philippe is a great host who is very responsive. Good value/money in geneva, I highly recommend.
Отличное расположение , всё рядом , чисто , организация и контакт с хозяином - Филиппом - все хорошо!!!
My second stay at Phillipes. It is a great location with all the things you need. Also Phillipe is easy to contact and helpful. The bed is comfortable and great amenities.
Great place. Very confortable and clean.

Philipe's place was very convenient to stay (main tram stop just in front, bus to the main station / airport 1 minute away, 2 major supermarkets just around the corner, many cafe, restaurants coin laundry nearby etc.). The response was quick and detailed so self-check in/out went very smoothly. The flat has things you'll need including basic cooking tools and iron which was useful for travelers!  Since it's half down stairs, it would have been great if the ventilation fan was little more efficient!! Otherwise it was nice stay at Philippe's!!

J'ai passé deux nuits à l'occasion d'un voyage professionnel sur Genève. L'appartement est bien situé. Philippe est très réactif et sympathique. Central et très pratique!

Well located studio apartment about 15 minutes walk to lake Geneva near the ‘Jet’. Supermarket close by.
The studio Apartment situated below road level is satisfactory but we recommend you bring a small torch to see the outside key box equipment on a cloudy or dark day. Although the owner has more than 50 Air BnB the studio was clean and well equipped.
Nice flat, with really good location in Geneva. Really flexible for the arrival and departure;  and excellent communication with the host.
Great clean and comfortable space with a great location!
This studio is a gem. Well located, with good public transport options. Check in was very easy and efficient, studio was very clean and Philippe was super responsive. A 5 star stay.

I booked this for my daughter who was traveling. She needed a place in a pinch. There was a large time difference and getting late on my end. I left Philippe a msg for help and by the time I woke up in the morning it was all settled. Philippe was great and my daughter loved her stay.

El apartamento está bien localizado. Lá comunicacion con  Philippe es rápida. El apartamento estava super limpio . Es pequenio pero es comodo para una perdona sola. La entrada es automática. Súper fácil .  Todo funciona en el apartamento tv e internet rapida. Yo recomiendo. El apartamento está bien ...

This cozy spot was perfect for our time in Geneva. Great location as we walked pretty much everywhere. The perfect amount of space and comfy living environment for our time in the city. We grew quite fond of the space and were sad to leave! Check in instructions and process was clear and simple. Space was clean and inviting. Would definitely stay again!
Overall Very good.
Great location to explore Geneva for a few days.  Easy access to light rail - very quiet.  Cools off and airs out quickly with the window open - a good value for a great location.
it's a nice and neat apt.

Jag och min 25-åriga dotter var i Geneve en lång-weekend och lägenheten passade oss jättebra. Läget var perfekt och lägenheten är väldigt smart planerad på litet utrymme. Vi hittade ett jättetrevligt bageri i närheten med färdiga baguetter och jättegoda bakverk. Det var nära till närmsta busshållplats och bara ca 20 min promenadväg till tåg-/busstationen.
All is well. Thanks for the hospitality. Location is really good so i can go everywhere by walk. Next visit, I will definetely stay there again.
Great location and communication with Philippe. Easy to get in and out. The appartment is just how it looks like in the pictures.

Ha sido una buena estancia, tiene todo lo que necesitas para pasar varios días en Ginebra. Es un poco chico para estancias más largas pero está bien equipado. La cocina es un poco vieja pero es funcional. Tiene un televisor hecho smart TV que nos ha servido ya que estuvimos dos meses allí. La comunicación con Philippe ha sido muy buena. Considero un poco elevada la cuota de limpieza pero tal vez es común a todas las estancias en Ginebra. Es en un sótano, entonces no le entra mucha luz pero igualmente es acogedor, está limpio y tiene su encanto.

Good location with all basic needs but way too expensive for the size and quality, I would recommend you to stay in a hotel with this price. Simple, cozy spot in excellent location.  Comfortable bed., clean. Transportation and grocery right outside the door.  Host very nice to deal with.  Great heat and hot water and fridge and stove. Daylight basement with excellent electric lighting and barrier to traffic sound.  A private, quiet get away where you can recharge for the day’s  adventures.

A well-equipped studio apartment in the basement. Very clean and stylish. Philippe provided lots of useful information about the area. While there was some noise in the morning, I did not find it very bothersome.

Thank you Guillaume and Francoise, we had a great stay it's an awesome little place, and yay the sun came out eventually! Communication: Guillaume was very prompt during the prebooking. I was new to Airbnb and was asked to go through the verification process. But once done it was all good from there. The communication was a little delayed once the reservation was about to start. Guillaume did answer all my questions and provided ample advice. Like where to get bus tix to France. The directions to the apartment were spot on. However we did find out that rather than pay for public transport on your trip to your Airbnb destination there is an 80mins free tourist duration ticket available from the airport. We found it at baggage belt 3 (from memory) as that's where we were waiting for our luggages. Apartment setup: We didn't meet Guillaume or Francoise. But the key exchange was super easy as it was pretty much a self step by step process. Check out was pretty easy as well. The apartment is as in the pictures. It is on the ground floor, however there is a small flight of stairs just as you come in from the street. It was lovely to enter into a warm apartment especially from the rain. The apartment is small but it's well arranged for our length of stay. There were also towels, shampoo, cotton buds, facial wipes, tea and all these other tid bits which made the stay more comfortable. We don't drink coffee but there were also capsules available. On the table were quite a few maps. Guillaume did have an Airbnb guidebook as well. We did wonder about the curtain near the front door. Turns out you can hear quite a bit from the entrance/lobby hallway. More so since neighbours sort of stomp down the stairs or stay in that hallway area. I would recommend a draught/door seal to try and minimise the noise. We did however both sleep pretty soundly so it wasn't a problem. But it's probably that we are not used to it that we noticed it more acutely. Cleanliness: Very clean. Even the shower head was clean which I'm usually particular about :) Towels, glasses, plates, cutlery were all clean and I'm not sure but I felt like there was a new cleaning sponge out too :) Everything was stored away which allowed room for us to put out luggage which is nice. The fridge is small but again was cleared for whatever we wanted to store. Location: Pretty central. There are a few public transport options available around. It's super close to...

There are many things to love about Fiona and her place:
* It is located in what looks like a private park and is very quiet - once you walk thru the gate at the street, you cannot see any streets or roads, even from the 2nd story window
* It is very nicely sized and appointed and the bed is super comfortable
* Proximity to the airport, UN and other international agencies - the #5 bus line stops almost right at her driveway and runs straight to the airport
* Good hot water in the shower
* A friendly dog on site
* A good value for the money based on all of the above (consider the Intercontinental hotel is across the street and runs 300€/night!)
* Fiona was great to communicate with and, despite being on holiday herself, was very responsive and helpful
Just three minor reasons that this wasn't a perfect stay:
* I experienced temporary evening infestations of winged ants in the shower around dusk. Fiona said this happens around this time of the year and she hadn't put out the bug traps yet so this isn't a permanent or ongoing issue. The apartment was otherwise spotless and well-kept.
* All of Europe was experiencing a heat wave and it was about 35C in Geneva. The apartment does not have air conditioning (which is OK) but it also made it difficult to fall asleep as the apartment was /hot/. The weather is not Fiona's fault of course, but be advised the apartment gets very warm if it is hot outside. A small fan would have made it much more bearable to blow cool air in from the large windows in the evenings.
* The door to the flat was difficult/noisy to lock from the outside as it required pulling the door very tightly shut to get the key to insert/turn.
The pros greatly outweigh the cons - I would not hesitate to stay here again in the future - it's a great airbnb and a great host!

I stayed at Fiona's place for five weeks while working at the UN. It's a very cozy and comfortable apartment where I felt at home away from home. Both the supermarket and the bus stop are very close and the UN is just a ten-minute walk away. I mostly had contact with Fiona's mum during my stay and she was very nice and always took care I had everything I needed, even without asking. And Pablo is indeed very friendly, always happy to get some petting. I would happily stay at Fiona's place again!

Almost like an enchanted place, quiet and peaceful despite the busy road nearby. Communication went very smoothly. The repair that needed to be done had been taken care of promptly. I'll recommend the apartment to colleagues for sure.

Fiona's place is super central--it's easy to get to the main train station as well as to all the UN offices. It was amazing to be able to walk to work. Fiona and her mother are kind and helpful, and their dog is very sweet. I found a few issues and notified Fiona after my stay. I believe everything will be solved for the next guest. Thanks for hosting me Fiona!
Lovely apartment located close to the U.N. and other international organizations and an easy hop from the airport. Recommend!!

I enjoyed my stay at the place very much , old house but special and beautiful. The place is full of natural light, quite, with a big bathroom. A big garden in the back, full of nature. I love it so much.
Close to UN, parks, and supermarket, public bus. Fiona’s mom checked me in and she was a very nice lady, Pablo is a very cute dog.
Thanks for the experience!

The most charming airbnb I've stayed in! A complete gem. Fiona was very responsive (she was out of town during my stay). The location of the apartment is great: nice walk to the UN,  close to the bus stop. But the place itself, is so lovely.  What a pleasure to have stayed here for over two weeks.  Would highly recommend!
I am grateful for Fiona's kind and rapid responses to my questions. They have contributed to making my stay in her comfortable apartment very pleasant.

Fiona is a super great host responding fast with nice attention.
It’s a cosy place decorated with taste and I can say that I have the feel at being home.
Lucky are the one to enjoy this peaceful place ! I definitely recommend and will come back when needed.

I am reluctant to praise Fiona's place too highly only  for fear I will never be able to get another  booking 😁 This is the most perfect, elegant old world gem  with its own eclectic character  and well positioned for the UN district  and close to  nearby amenities.  A wonderful haven and most thoughtful and  generous hosts.

If you're like me and travel internationally for work almost every month, you probably crave a 'home' over a hotel. If you're traveling to Geneva I highly recommend Fiona's studio apartment for the following reasons: location, value and tranquility. Location is half-way between Lake Geneva and the hotels/restaurants and the airport/Palexpo Convention Centre. Location is across the street from Co-op Grocery Store (open 8am-7pm but closed on Sundays .. prepare if you arrive on a Sunday). If you know Geneva, you know prices are high for everything and Fiona's place vs a hotel is a great value. Finally, the setting is surrounded by trees, street noise is minimal, and it just feels kind of cool to be in a 17th century home. Note, the studio was on up three flights of stairs! Enjoy your stay!
Very nice apartment and perfect location

Great little place a bit outside of center of town but walking to UN orgs. Very comfy bed and beautiful view.  Great/quick responses as well and fiona's mother is kind and lovelyl.  Overall very nice stay--could definitely feel you were living in shared housing and felt I had to be really quiet for fear of waking the neighbor.  Pedro the dog is cute and welcoming---he did bark for awhile one night....but fair enough.  Thanks heaps!
Very nice place! Perfect if you are in Geneva for meetings at the UN.
Lovely location and atmospheric old manor home.

An exceptional airbnb experience. A delightful apartment, perfectly located for meetings at the Palais and UN offices. There were many extremely thoughtful touches and communications were seamless. Fiona and her mother are delightful to liaise with and the house is warm, character-filled and spacious. Highly recommended
Beautiful character house with some suites. Surprisingly country feel for how close to the city it is.
Wonderful old Geneve villa, very close to the Palais des Nations. Fiona was very kind and helpful.
I am regularly coming to Geneva since thirteen years. Fiona's place is the most pleasant and comfortable I have been to. I cannot imagine a better host.

The apartment is in a great location to explore the city. There are parks around, and a big shop, plus a farmer's market. Fiona was very helpful, and she made sure my stay there was comfortable. I highly recommend staying there.
This was not the first time I have stayed with Fiona. I have reason to continue all my previous praise. Georg
I can only repeat my previous comments: erverything was excellent and Fiona is a superb host.

Fiona's place is ideal for anyone working at WHO (OMS) or the UN, as it is only around 10-15 minutes on foot. There is a bus that goes right past the house to take you either to the airport or the central station too. The apartment is really lovely - very spacious and quiet with a beautiful view over the garden. Fiona and her mum Gillian were excellent hosts, and were very welcoming. They had arranged some provisions in the kitchen (muesli, milk, fruit, tea and coffee), which was just perfect as I arrived on a delayed flight late at night and had not had chance to pick up supplies for the morning. I felt very comfortable here and would love to stay here again if I get another chance to return to Geneva. Thank you both!

Génial ! J'ai adoré mon séjour chez Fiona ! Nous avons chacun nos critères mais pour moi tout était parfait : le cachet de la maison (vieilles pierres, poutres), son environnement boisé, son accessibilité depuis la gare comme depuis l'aéroport, la proximité d'un supermarché pour les courses. Quant au logement lui-même, quel bonheur...45m2, une grande chambre donnant sur un jardin et un court de tennis, une pièce à vivre très fonctionnelle et très bien agencée. Je soulignerais la propreté impeccable du logement et surtout les petites attentions d'accueil : boissons, fruits, petits chocolats. Bref, debout en bout, ce fut une expérience parfaite.
I’ve stayed here a couple times now and Fiona has been a great host. Clean place near UN offices.

This is a lovely studio flat inside an old estate. It is located right near the intercontinental hotel and convenient to the UN and WHO- I went for work meetings and it was so lovely to have a small kitchen to eat my meals and avoid having to eat out every day. The price is very reasonable given the location. There is a lovely tub for a hot soak after a long day. The bus into town is a short walk away and since it is a short and straightforward trip I felt comfortable using it right away, likewise the airport is also very close and easy to get to via bus. The shopping plaza across the street has a great grocery store that does not have extensive hours but when open in the morning (8am) the croissants are delicious and the selections of fruits and drinks etc is extensive. I am really glad I stayed in the flat and would do so again!
A charming villa very close to Palais des Nations.
Always a good place to stay. Character house.
Beautiful flat in a great location (especially if you need to go to the UN).

This place offers a glimpse into Genevan history: A modern and cozy apartment within a true Genevan maison in "urban countryside". Lovely decor and amazing amenities.  Fiona is very responsive. 12-15 minute walk to the UN Pregny gate, not far from bus 5 into town and near shopping and restos.

Fiona’s Place was absolutely perfect for my needs. An adorable two-room suite in the most beautiful house. Her mother was so gracious and provided great food recommendations for nearby. Very close to the UN offices but easy to get everywhere in the city. I definitely recommend!
Great place in the perfect location for meeting at WHO. Would strongly recommend this place.  Impeccably clean and comfortable
The apartment a gem of a place - in a great location and surroundings. Fiona is a great host, prompt in her responses, very professional and helpful. Thank you for a fantastic stay!

Fiona and her mother are very nice and accommodating people who gave me a warm welcome. The apartment is part of their main house and it is clean. The location is about a 25-30 min walk away from the city center, but there is public transportation nearby. So its all manageable.
The place is better than the photos! Fiona is extremely nice, helpful and available to help. Highly recommended if you need to visit UN campus.
Excellent hospitality and great place!

This appartment is amazing and Fiona is a great host! The location couldn't be better. There is a colorful little market in the next street and the appartment is quiet in spite of being close to shops, bars, restaurantes. You are next by to Les Halles shopping mall and parks for small and older kids. The metro stations are close as well. Fiona is very kind and easy to communicate with. The appartment is very nice, renovated, and has great appliances including ventilators and a steamer for the clothes which can be very helpful. We hope to come back! Thanks Fiona!

Great location across the road from intercontinental hotel and a nice walk down to the UN. Lovely view of the mature gardens. Fiona left lovely snacks and I enjoyed the bath. Self-checkin is not available as far as I know. Fiona and her Mam were very helpful with late checkin.
Fiona’s apartment is a lovely place. Anyone traveling to Geneva for a couple of days would be comfortable there. It is well located, calm and green. Thumbs up!
Fantastic location close to the UN and with groceries/take out nearby. Lovely touches and thoughtfully prepared to have everything you need for a work home away from home.

This apartment was really cozy. Nice and comfortable bed and a living room with kitchenette, dining table and sofa. Bathroom had a nice tub and rain shower. Fiona's husband was nice enough to drag my heavy suitcase all the way to the top floor 😊 Location was perfect for me as it was right across the convention hotel. bus stop to airport and city center is right across the street. definitely recommend this place!
Fiona’s place is absolutely lovely. Beautiful, clean, quiet and convenient located for those who have offices nearby. This is a special find in Geneva.

J ai passé un excellent séjour chez Fiona, belle maison ancienne, l appartement est spacieux et sous les toits, chaleureux et comfortable. Accueil très gentil et généreux. Accès facile aux organisations internationales, et a pied ou par bus , on est rapidement au bord du lac et Paquis. Accès en bus direct de l aéroport.

The accommodation was amazing. Fantastic location, although in Geneva you have the feeling of living in the countryside due to its positioning in a secluded little street. I stayed during winter and I imagine that the place would be even better in the summer. Close to local shops and not too far from the Servette tram stop (about a 20 min walk). The family/host were really nice and the owner would come and clean every weekend and leave me a few drinks (a beer, orange juice and a SanBitter (never had before, but got a taste for it)).
Although not a French speaker the host could speak English, so not a problem.
I stayed for just under 3 months for work and I would highly recommend this room. The greatest attribute from my perspective was that the room/flat was self contained - large spacious room with bed, table, a connected kitchenette and a shower/toilet. The shower had great water pressure.

Marie-Pierres's apartment was a perfect place to stay in Geneva. It's in a quiet residential area, really close to a bus stop (geneva's small and the public transport is great, so a short bus ride into town is no problem) and while it is attached to the main house you have your own entrance and it really feels like your own space. Its a lovely, warm, large studio, the kitchen has everything you could possibly want, and it was spotless.
More importantly, Maire-Pierre went out of her way to welcome me, leaving tea, coffee and basic cooking things (olive oil, salt etc.) as well as bringing me the most amazing breakfast each morning - including home made jams from her own garden. Nothing was too much trouble for her, and the home was lovely. I would highly recommend staying here whilst you are in Geneva - thank you Maire-Pierre!
Great and unique place in Geneva. Located next to the Rhone valley, so you feel in the countryside in the middle of Geneva. Also great reception by the owner!

Marie-Pierre's place was absolutely no wonderful. Lovely and tranquil but so centrally located what a gem.
Marie-Pierre was the perfect host , easy to communicate with, kind, and helpful. Plus she gave me a lovely collection of food for a simple and tasty breakfast (home made fig and red berry jams from the garden were superb)

I have stayed in a number of airbnb places in Geneva over the years. This was the best. The room was spotless, Marie-Pierre was friendly and attentive, the setting was gorgeous (nothing like seeing cows graze next door each morning) and the commute into downtown Geneva really easy. I highly recommend it (and I have already booked a return trip).

Our stay at Marie-Pierre's was absolutely amazing! Her home is beautiful and she did so much to make us feel welcome. Waking up to a delicious breakfast in her lovely garden was such a treat. We hope to have the opportunity to return soon!

My stay with Marie-Pierre was wonderful! I stayed for one month, and I feel as if I stayed in the best place in Geneva for a long-term visit!
The home is located in a quiet, residential area that backs up to the Rhone River – (perfect for those who love nature walks and/or a lovely jog! Walking/jogging trails right in the backyard! Also, access to the water for a swim if you’d like!)
I felt as if I was in the countryside – (the room looks out in to the garden with views of the mountains from the side widow, and very little noise other than nature and happy birds chirping!)—yet you are just minutes from the heart of Geneva.
I rented a bicycle for the month, and getting everywhere in Geneva was less than 15 minutes by bike! It was perfect for me! (I highly recommend if you enjoy biking and don’t mind a few big hills! Also, Marie-Pierre can help you coordinate the bike rental/inform you as to where the bike rental places are).
The room is a wonderful, spacious ‘mother-in-law suite’ – attached to the back of the house with one door connecting to the main house, but a completely separate entrance in the garden. The kitchen has everything needed for cooking, and it was perfect for me, as I cooked most of my meals there during my stay. The bathroom is spotless with a great stand-up shower. All of the appliances are seemingly brand new.
Marie-Pierre and her family were also wonderful hosts. They made me feel very welcome, and were so helpful any time that I needed direction or assistance. For my long-term stay, Marie-Pierre changed my linens and towels and cleaned the apartment every week. She also gladly let me use a drying rack for laundry, etc.
I felt perfectly at home and comfortable for my month-long stay. I hope to be back soon! I have already recommended Marie-Pierre’s home to all of my family and friends! Highly recommended for your next stay in Geneva!

I have stayed with a number of airbnb hosts in Geneva over the years, but Marie-Pierre's has easily been the best. So much so that I have stayed there twice in the last three months. The studio is large and clean, with great amenities. It is located in a rural setting in the middle of Geneva, with an easy commute to downtown Geneva (15 minutes). Marie-Pierre is a gracious and welcoming host. If it is available next year when I return I will do it again.
L'hospitalité de Marie Pierre est tout simplement délicieuse et pleine de délicatesse. Le studio est très bien conçu et le jardin est charmant. Un lieu exceptionnel.

Marie-Pierre's studio is simply wonderful! Absolutely clean, in a beautiful surrounding. And if you haven't read the description fully as I did, you will be pleasantly surprised by being offered breakfast in the morning with jam made of berries from her garden! Marie-Pierre has been a wonderful host, even offering apples from the garden for the apple strudel I made in the perfectly equipped kitchen of the studio! Thank you, Marie-Pierre!
Great, clean, newly renovated place with a lovely garden and host. Close to the airport and good public transport connections across Geneva.
Excellent apartment and excellent host!

Marie's place is a terrific place to stay if your traveling for work or leisure , located in a quite and beautifull neighbourhood 20 minutes walking distance to old town (center).
The apartment is a studio with a private garden and open green spaces all around. Marie is a terrific host and is concerend for your well being.
All in all 5 stars all the way :)

If you are interested in staying at a beautiful, comfortable, clean and lovely apartment within walking distance of downtown Geneva then this apartment is ideal for you.
Our host Marie-Pierre was so welcoming and attentive. We received a beautiful breakfast and lots of tips on where we should visit.
We will be returning and recommending to our friends and family.

it was an awesome stay near a garden! It was beautiful in autumn.
The host was super nice and helpful. She also offered us breakfast which was out of expectation.
We enjoyed out stay so much

Marie-Pierre’s place is brilliant:
- The location is lovely and the rooms are fantastic.
- Marie-Pierre is a wonderful host, so very thoughtful and helpful.
- The place is very well equipped.
I would recommend anyone to stay here, you’ll have a great stay.

Квартира очень комфортабельная, оборудована всем необходимым и удобно расположена. Район находится недалеко от центра, но здесь нет шума и суеты. Соседство с большим парком обеспечивает тишину, великолепные природу и воздух, и, конечно, умиротворение. Приём был очень радушным, также было очень приятно и неожиданно получить 3 завтрака в подарок. Мари-Пьер помогала советами и находила нужную информацию. Рекомендую остановиться в этой уютной квартире, вы не будете разочарованы. В следующий свой визит в Женеву я точно знаю, где остановлюсь.

Домик находится в тихом районе, окружён цветами, рядом прекрасный парк с быстрой лазурной рекой. Если вы бегаете или любите гулять, то это наилучшее для вас расположение. Магазин в 5-7 мин, центр города в 30 мин. Хозяйка очень приветливая и добрая, помогает в любом вопросе моментально быстро. Дом находится на цокольном этаже дома, где живут хозяева. В доме безупречная чистота, ни одной пылинки.  Белоснежное белье, полотенца. Все сияет. В доме есть все необходимое, если любите готовить, то полный комплект посуды. Хозяйка баловала завтрак со свежими фруктами. Проживание было комфортно, рекомендую.

Our stay at Marie Pierre’s cottage was perfect. It was impeccably clean and she was so sweet, welcoming and helpful. We had a beautiful and delicious breakfast delivered to us each morning with a smile and offer of any help.
The grounds are lush and green with a home vegetable garden and many flowers.
I truly couldn’t have asked for a better experience.
Pulizia eccezionale, ben attrezzato
This is the place to stay!
Stayed here a 2nd time and it was everything we could of asked for!
Wonderful mother-in-law apartment.  Beautiful garden.  And very nice breakfast served.  Thank you!

This little flat is an oasis of quiet and greenery close to the city.  We loved having the garden and a backdrop of trees just outside.  The whole flat was very clean, comfortable and well equipped.  Marie Pierre is a delightful host and was very welcoming. She kindly provided some basics and initial breakfasts so no need to rush to shop on arrival.  The nearest supermarket is an easy 5 minute stroll away on the main road, where there are frequent buses to the main train station (with lots of bus connections) and city centre.  However we really enjoyed walking into the city along the river through shady woodland – took longer than the bus but very pleasant.

Marie-Pierre is a wonderful host, and the room was perfect. I really enjoyed my stay. So much so, in fact, that this was my third stay with her and her family, after two great trips last year. I highly recommend it to anyone going to Geneva.

I loved my stay at Marie-Pierre's place. Marie-Pierre is an incredibly thoughtful and generous host. She provided me with some delicious food for breakfast, regularly cleaned the flat and was always extremely warm and friendly. The flat is located in a beautiful garden and Marie-Pierre very kindly provided me with fresh vegetables from the garden during my stay. The flat is well equipped and I enjoyed working from there as well as cooking in the kitchen. I thoroughly recommend staying here - it is a wonderful sanctuary

Marie was very kind and attentive during our 2 week stay. The space was very clean with a wonderful garden out back. We took quite a bit of public transportation and her place was about 0.3 miles from  the nearest bus stop making most of city activities and day trips very accessible
Fiona's place is lovely. In such a quiet neighborhood and so close to the UN, bus stops and town. I appreciated the chocolates and fruits that were left out for me when I moved in.

Wonderful stay! Fiona and her family were so hospitable and ensured I had everything I needed. Location was convenient for the UN and also some of the cutest coffee shops and restaurants— I would stay here again.

Great location for conferences and UN, absolutely beautiful house, the studio is a lovely space, nice bed linen, all the bits and bobs for simple self contained self catering, (old fashioned proper bath will allow full submersion for someone 2m tall!)
Great place! Impecable, clean, well-equiped and quiet. Fiona is always at the guest disposal with Kind and generous disposition. Perfect for a short or long stay

I had a fantastic stay in the apartment, it is calm, spacious, nicely furnished and clean. The location is great - UN organizations are within walking distance, and there are also bus/tram stops nearby, so the city center and the main train station can be reached quickly. Both the building and the surroundings are beautiful, with squirrels running up and down in the garden each morning.

A really wonderful stay. Peaceful, impeccably clean, beautifully decorated. I stayed for a little over a week, so it had everything to feel like you're home - comfortable bed, fully equipped kitchen, shower products. The view overlooking the massive garden and tennis court was very calming. Communication was excellent, Fiona is a great host. A little gem as others have said. Highly recommend.
Really great spot, especially if you have meetings at the Palais. My time at Fiona’s place exceeded my expectations; photos do not do this spot justice! Highly recommend.
Absolutely lovely, a perfect place to stay that’s super convenient for the UN and nearby shops, with very friendly, well-informed hosts. Definitely recommend and would book again!

This is the second time I have stayed at Fiona's place and I have found it a home away from home, very welcoming, private and within easy walk to the UN, to supermarket and to transport.  It is a beautiful environment to work or relax in, and I would certainly recommend it for a peaceful stay.

The apartment was comfortable, charming, part of a larger nice house in a beautiful private garden.
Definitely my best stay with Airbnb in Geneva so far.
Fiona was very helpful throughout my stay.
Highly recommended.

I would recommend this place to anyone working at the UN. It’s close to ILO, UNICEF and the Palais des Nations on foot. The feeling is one of being at home in an old grand Bourgois manor. Strike stunning and calm environment with lovely hosts.
Fiona's place is a lovely retreat. Everything is beautiful and homey. Very close to UN and convenient for transportation. The host family is very warm and caring. A must stay :)
Lovely place and very convenient for activities in UN premises.

I had a wonderful stay at Fiona’s place. Fiona was a great host, providing excellent communication before and during my stay. Check-in/check-out was seamless. Fiona also shared helpful suggestions for nearby food. The place itself is very charming, clean, and stocked with everything you could need during your stay. The location was perfect, with easy access to/from the airport and around town, but also in a really peaceful setting. I highly recommend!
It was a pleasant, quiet stay. The location was convenient to where I was working.

An absolutely lovely stay in a magnificent house. The location could not have been more perfect as I was able to walk to/from my worksite on the WHO/UN campus very easily + easy access to grocery, cafe etc. I look forward to returning!
The place is indeed a good location for UN related work trips. Comfortable and clean!

Fiona’s place was perfect for my business trip of a few days. It’s an easy walk to the international organizations, and the bus ride to the airport is only ten minutes or so, from a very close stop.
Fiona is a kind host, and her place was spotless, with everything I needed for it stay. It was really perfect, and I’ll definitely be back.
Such a beautiful Swiss home. Within walking distance of the UN and plenty of public transport. Fiona is super friendly and easy going. The room was clean and comfortable.

As many others have said (and why I stayed here), this is the perfect location for anyone working at UN/WHO. It is a beautiful apartment, on top floor of family home, within 10 minutes walk to UN/WHO. It was perfectly clean, had everything I could need. Fiona was also lovely. Would stay here again!

Amazingly beautiful area with calm and peace in a city. Great location close to everything by short walk or bus. The apartment has everything one needs and was spotless. Super place to stay with responsive and friendly host!
I had a great stay at Fiona’s - beautiful view and green surroundings. Ideal location for work. Would happily stay again.

Such a wonderful haven to stay in, easy walking distance to WHO and UN, with supermarket and cafes close by. A top floor unit in an old mansion with expansive gardens, it had such a homey feel, with all the amenities needed. Fiona made me feel very welcomed - I'll definitely be back, and recommend to others!
Fiona's place was a very comfortable haven for me to get back to after work, very accessible, with a very responsive host, everything was very clean and functional, with eye for detail.

This is a great apartment in a gorgeous & charming historical building. Even though the owners and one other tenant are living in the building, the apartment felt very private. I never heard any sounds from others and always considered my own privacy to be complete. The furnishings were very comfortable. The grounds are unusually spacious for an in-town location, and the location was very convenient. I was able to walk to all the my meeting locations including the airport.
Very comfortable stay. Fiona was very responsive and helpful.
This was my second stay here and it was for a week. The place is quiet, tidy, great location for UN organisations, direct bus to the airport.
Lovely studio, perfectly located for work-related stays in International Geneva. You wake up with the singing of birds. I will return surely.
This is my second time staying at Fiona’s place. Perfect for anyone working at UN. And it is such a beautiful space and environment. I will stay next time!
The location is very convenient for work and leisure. Fiona was a great host and very responsive.
Nice apartment, convenient for one person or a couple. The place is within walking distance to most  UN offices, bus station, etc. a grocery store is also nearby.
Second time staying at Fiona's place for a conference. Very comfortable and very close to the UN/other things. I always feel welcome there. Would highly recommend!

This is my favorite place to stay in Geneva - perfect location, lovely accommodation and gracious hosts, bucolic and peaceful setting, and a short walk to everything I need and want. Extremely highly recommended, and thanks again to Fiona and family!

Unique place, secluded with green surroundings. Very beautifully renovated apartment with tasteful interior design. I loved the charme of the old, well-kept old house. Host is very friendly and flexible (late check-out).
Charming in so many ways.
This stay is one of the few really worth its 5 star rating. Large, well furnished, super convenient (close to UN and with an excellent supermarket across the road), lovely green, treed outlook.
Great location in a serene setting, steps from the UN and Geneva but quiet and homey. Great communication and the apartment was immaculate.

Le séjour chez Fiona était parfait!
Elle a pensé à tout! Condiments pour faire la cuisine, shampoing, gel de douche, petit chocolat et fruits à l’arrivée! De plus, elle a été flexible avec mon heure d’arrivée qui m’a permis de me reposer de mon long voyage. L’emplacement est idéal avec une épicerie à 1 minute et tout près d’un arrêt d’autobus. Également, super tranquille et pas bruyant! J’y retournerai demain matin. Merci encore Fiona pour tout!

Fiona's home is absolutely stunning. The room is on the top floor of an old charming home (so expect some stairs), it was clean, spacious, and has everything you need. The little kitchenette and tea station made my stay extra nice. The bathroom was very nice as well, I loved the big vintage tub.
The room really feels like an artist's loft and takes you back in time, I can't remember how many times I opened the window across the bed to listen to the birds and look out onto the beautiful green scenery, there are chickens and sheep in the area and it was just a lovely little retreat all whilst being just steps away from the UN conference centers (and right across from a grocery store).
Absolutely perfect location, host was responsive and it was great knowing she lives downstairs as well. I hope to rebook when I come back to Geneva!
Great stay, super helpful host on arrival and excellent location for my stay.

Great location especially if you need to be close to UN buildings. Public transport right outside. Apartment is very beautiful, clean and spacious. Hosts extremely friendly and responsive. I would stay here again.

I loved my stay in this very private two room spacious apartment on the top floor of a stately old home. The bathroom was lovely and large too. It was within easy walking distance of the Palais des Nations in a residential neighborhood, so very quiet but easy access to the city center and to the airport by bus. Fiona was an excellent host, all in all this was a jewel of a place!

I am so grateful to Fiona for hosting me! The location was beautiful and very convenient for my work. The location was approximately 15 minutes from the airport and 20 minutes from the city centre by bus - would recommend!
A lovely space - as described. Clean, comfortable, 10 mins walk to the UN, and a friendly and responsive host. Would stay at Fiona's again.
Great place to stay in Easter part of Geneva. Green, leafy and lovely residence. Felt right at home. Thank you, Fiona!

Fiona’s listing is centrally located and is an exquisite and spacious home. Absolutely loved all the amenities and the sweet treats.
The listing is on the third floor (note the two flight of stairs for luggage!). Fiona’s family lives in the two floors below and were very helpful with local recommendations.

The place is quiet, tastefully decorated and exactly as it looks in the pics. Can’t recommend the place highly enough!

Fiona’s place was a perfect haven for my stay in Geneva! I felt right at home in this lovely, peaceful and private apartment. A beautiful location, just near the Palais with easy access to the centre and a nearby shopping centre. Fiona and her family were wonderful hosts and everything was super easy. I will be recommending to friends and colleagues, and recommend it to you too!

Fiona’s place with perfectly situated around the UN buildings for my work trip. The room is on the top floor of their home and felt very cosy. The house is stunning and unique. I highly recommend you choose this stay! Thank you Fiona

This is a very comfortable apartment in a beautiful old home with charming grounds. The bed was comfortable and it had everything I needed for a short stay.
It is a reasonable walk to the nearby bus stops and is not far from the airport. I would stay here again.
tres' propre, soigne' , tres agreable

We used Helena's place for a business trip of our colleague, who was very satisfied with the accommodation. Our colleague wrote: "The apartment is elegant and well-appointed. Helena has taken great care to create an elegant environment. This is a large studio apartment with high ceilings and good light. Water pressure is also excellent.
There is a ton of storage space, because it doesn’t appear that anyone lives there, so it’s a great choice for a long term stay, as long as you don’t mind cleaning the apartment yourself, as no cleaning service is offered.
A potential downside of no one living there is that you won’t find the small welcome package you often see, with recommendations of restaurants or local things to do, but it’s easy enough to figure that out for yourself, especially in that area. A larger downside is that the apartment could use a bit of love - small broken things that someone living there would immediately notice and take care of. The owner is very clear that he doesn’t live locally, although he does have an assistant who gets you the keys and shows you around the apartment.
All in, I would recommend staying there, with one caveat. You have to be ok with second hand smoke. Geneva is a big smoking city generally, so it’s no surprise, but it can get unpleasant from people standing outside the building, or sitting at the beautiful little fountain right outside it and smoking. In good weather, it’s constant. In the rain, they stand under the awning under the living room windows and smoke. It’s just a part of staying at an apartment in old town Geneva, and there is an air purifier in the apartment, which helps a bit, but it can be unpleasant if you’re not used to it. Any apartment in the old town might have this issue, depending on what the windows look out onto and how close to the street and cafés it is, so it is worth considering generally.

great

My stay at Deus's was excellent. He was super kind and accommodating to my arrival and departure schedule and easy to communicate with. His place was clean, stylish, comfortable, well equipped, and super convenient. I look forward to my next stay there!

Deus' place is excellent! The location cannot be any better - just one block to the Cornavin train station and right across from the Manor department store. Leticia was on site to greet me with keys, but we had a few communication issues as I do not speak French and she did not speak English. But we managed with the help of technology, and she was very understanding of my inability to speak French. The apartment itself is super clean and a mix of modern and classic. The bed is very comfortable and the extra pillows were a nice touch. The biggest asset is the washing machine, which came in handy after I have been traveling for over a week. Leticia showed me how to operate the machine and the drying rack. There is no A/C, but there is a fan if you need one. It was lovely weather in Geneva this week and I slept with the windows open.
The food court at the Manor department store is a huge bonus. Anyone who has been to Geneva knows that it is outrageously expensive. However, you can get a wonderful breakfast at the Manora restaurant (upstairs in the Manor department store) for under 10CHF. That is almost unheard of in Geneva. There are plenty of restaurants and bars nearby, and the airport is only a 15-20 minute ride by taxi.
Overall a good stay. Outstanding location. Communication could be a bit improved, but happy with the stay.

The location of the apt was incredible with incredible views. Directly across the street from Manor and a 5 minute walk to Geneva’s main Cornavin train station.

Issues could be tolerated but something that could be so easily fixed (eg paying WiFi bill) was not.
Great little apartment, close to Cornavin train station and right next to local bus/streetcar lines.  Putting the TV back in the living room would help clean up the wiring 😉
Check-in and check-out went smoothly, the apartment is fully equipped and the location is perfect. I recommend it for both short and long stays.

The communication with Deus was super fast. I could write to him at any time and got an answer immediately. We could check in and out flexibly and felt welcome. Communication fluide, aisée, courtoise, rapide, efficace. Logis confortable, douillet, épatant. Espace remarquablement bien agencé. Chaque recoin est tiré à profit. Il ne manque rien : grille-pain, bouilloire, florilège d’infusions aux écorces de fruits, petits chocolats, dosettes de café avec machine à café assortie, édulcorants de synthèse pour celles et ceux qui prêtent attention à leur ligne ou surveillent leur glycémie, réfrigérateur avec compartiment de congélation. La section soin et hygiène de la salle de bain représenterait presque un spa à elle seule : douche à l’italienne agrémentée de jet latéraux de massage aquatique multidirectionnels, shampoing et après-shampoing de marque, étendoir à linge chauffant : agréable et astucieux qui permet en outre de pallier toute émergence d’olfaction de moisissures, machine à laver, fer à repasser, parapluies, cotons-tiges, trousse de secours, gel hydroalcoolique, etc. Literie boxsping de type Super King Size — 180x200 — dotée d’un confortable surmatelas à mémoire de forme : s’y allonger confère l’exquise impression de voguer sur un nuage. Tout se trouve exactement à sa place, là où il faut, comme il faut. Tout est pensé dans le détail. Tout y est judicieusement fonctionnel. J’ai apprécié les petites tables et chaises transparentes : ravissantes et ergonomiques. Le coin repos contient même une Bible à l’aimable intention de celles et ceux qui, spiritualité aidant, ressentiraient le besoin d’approfondir la teneur exégétique des Saintes Écritures. Parfait. À recommander chaleureusement.

However, Annetta handled a situation that occurred during my 2-night stay very poorly. I had booked a single occupancy stay. My godchild (in her early twenties) who lives in Geneva, during the second night, contacted me (clearly in distress) and requested to see me close to midnight. I spent time with her at the premises and eventually, given the late hour, offered for her to spend the night in my room.
Upon leaving the property with her at 8am in the morning and rushing to get to my first meeting, I was 'ambushed' by the host screaming and shouting that my behaviour not to have 'notified' her of an additional guest spending the night at the premises followed by her request that I needed to pay an additional fee to cover her costs of washing sheets and towels. I tried to explain the extraordinary circumstances but my arguments fell on deaf ears and only incurred more shouting.
Annetta proceeded to sent me a payment adjustment request by email to reflect the 2nd person to stay (and I could see she had a point), but the link didn't worked. I received many reminders from AirBnB to 'accept or deny' the additional payment request but all of them were broken. I informed Annetta of this and she requested I send her the additional charges she had raised in CASH by POST which I believe to be against AirBnB policy, so I declined. I spent some 45 minutes on a Sunday explaining the situation to AirBnB customer service and they sided with me after hearing about the events and they absorbed the additional payment request from Annetta in the process.
To reiterate, Annetta was right in asking for more money to cover the 'double occupancy during the second night'. But her way of going about it and spoiling my otherwise pleasant experience will not make me want to return.
I appreciate - customer service is not everyone's cup of tea but on AirBnB it must be. I wish Annetta well in improving her demeanour to deal with the travellers that stay with her. She has a lovely place...

We stayed in this apartment at the beginning of December for 5 nights with three adults. FACILITIES : the apartment is exactly as described on the Airbnb entry and the photo is an exact representation of the lounge area of the flat. The flat is very new and everything is to a high standard. There are two very good sized king size rooms, one has a king size bed and the other a good size double bed. Both beds were comfortable with continental quilts and pillows. There is good built in storage in both rooms with plenty of shelf space , hanging space and hangers. There is a good sized bathroom with a large walk in shower with a good supply of hot water and large and smaller shower heads which work very well, plus a sink. Also in the bathroom is a washer and tumble drier. We did not use the washer or tumble drier but both were new and good quality. The toilet is in a separate room with a sink. The lounge area is shown on the photo is accurate and is large with seating as shown, for 4 people. There is a large TV and I think a DVD player although we did not use it. There is a breakfast bar with seating for four people and a cooker ,oven ,microwave ,fridge, freezer and dishwasher . There was plenty of crockery, glasses cutlery and pans. There were also cooking implements such as a grater, colander, wooden spoons etc. There is also an nespresso machine . The weather was cold whilst we were visiting but the temperature was always comfortable in the flat -we were never cold or too hot .There was a thermostat but we didn't need to touch it. There is a balcony with a table and four chairs which we did not use. The balcony and lounge area looks out over a large grassy area and trees . There is another set of flats about 100m away but you do not feel overlooked . There are automatic adjustable blinds at all the windows . The flat is on the second floor but there is a lift that takes you to the landing immediate outside the door to the flat or there are stairs. It is a very safe area. Tip: EU travel plugs do not work instead you need specific Swiss plugs. Pascal left us a travel plug to use but you may want to bring more, or an extension cable if you have a lot of tech to charge. LOCATION: the flat is in a good location about 20-30 minutes travel from central Geneva. There are a lot of new flats being built but the area where this flat is located is finished. We were not disturbed by any building noise. The flat is 5 minutes walk from the tram stop which is right by the Patisserie. The No 18 tram will take you to Gare Cornavin in Geneva central which is about...

I can only agree with the other reviewers who have noted Christine's wonderful hospitality and the quality of the place. However, there are things that we personally greatly enjoyed but that other travellers might need to know before booking their stay:
- The hosts live in the same house, on the upper floor, and the kitchen and dining room offered to guests are also used by them. It is in many ways an advantage, because the fridge is full of food, but if you prefer to be completely on your own, this is probably not your choice.
- Equally, the hosts welcome you personally and have a cup of tea chatting with you. Again, we have much enjoyed it, but I can imagine there may be travellers who just want to get to bed after a long day - you would need to say this to Christine from the outset, and I'm sure she will show full understanding.
- The location is close to the airport. Planes start flying at about 6:30 in the morning, but there is no noise unless you open the window.
- In terms of parking, the rue du Village belongs to the "blue" zone, i.e. free of charge parking during the night. For daytime, you have to find a public parking elsewhere.
- What was a bit of incovenience was the very small bathroom. And there is no curtain between the shower and the rest of the bathroom.
But on balance, I confirm that this is a very very good place to stay.

Exactly as advertised – a spacious apartment with old Geneva charm and only a two -minute walk to the lake!
This 4th floor apartment was perfect for our travelling family – an older couple with an adult son – as the rather large living room was a completely separate room, with a very comfortable sofabed. Unlike other places that we have rented in Geneva in the past, this apartment has a fully-equipped kitchen, which is large, airy and bright. Every possible electrical device and gadget is available, including all the food basics you will need to get you started. The kitchen is also very large for Geneva standards, with room aplenty to have dinner with 8 of your friends at the enormous kitchen table, or to simply settle in with a book on the leather couch or chair which adds character to the room. Our bedroom was also a good size, with ample closet space to hang clothes and empty drawers to hold all our personal items. As this is a corner unit, both the living room and the bedroom have balconies, one of which is large enough for a picnic table and chairs!
The location is fantastic: Not only can you walk with your bags from the train station to the apartment, but there are also 2 different buses that run every few minutes a very short distance away, as well as 3 different grocery stores and a pharmacy! A traveller’s dream location! And while it is smack in the middle of a very lively, vibrant part of Geneva, it happens to be located on a relatively quiet street with little traffic!
Best of all, the apartment is only a 5 minute walk from the local city “Mouettes” – this is the form of public transportation that the Genevois use to get to the other side of the lake - small motorboats running every 10 minutes that cost the price of a bus ticket!!
And to top it all off, no problems with entry and exit. Your friendly host, Jacques, will take care of everything and ensure that you easily gain access to the unit, and he is readily available for any questions or help that you may need. We loved our one-month stay there and would gladly rent again!

everything was great. thank you.

C ist sehr gastfreundlich und hilfsbereit. Die Unterkunft ist ein Airbnb im ursprünglichen Sinn. Du bist Gast und teilst Bad und Küche mit der Bewohnerin. Alles ist sehr sauber. Die Lage ist perfekt, fußläufig zu Bahnhof und See in lebendigem Kneipenviertel.
Highly recommend!

Mon court séjour chez Cecia a été très agréable. L'appartement est très confortable et propre. De plus, son emplacement est idéal, à proximité du lac. Je recommande vivement ce logement Airbnb. Cecia est une hôte charmante.

C war eine super freundliche und hilfsbereite Gastgeberin und immer gut erreichbar 😊 Die Wohnung war sehr gemütlich und man hat sich direkt wie zuhause gefühlt. Das Zimmer war angenehm und alles war unkompliziert. Auch die Lage war top – super nah am See. Ich habe meinen Aufenthalt sehr genossen und würde jederzeit wiederkommen!

J’ai passé un excellent séjour chez Ceiça, arrangeante et sympatique !

Tudo otimo! excelente localizaçao, cama confortavel e casa muito limpa. Recomendo.
Un séjours très agréable dans un quartier vivant au cœur de Genève avec une hôtesse vraiment sympa - l‘espace est comfortable et propre et offre tout ce dont vous avez besoin. Merci!

Jolie chambre dans un appartement très chaleureux et convivial. L’emplacement est tout simplement idéal pour visiter Genève à pieds. Ceiça était très sympa et a pris le temps de bien m’accueillir à mon arrivée et de répondre à mes questions. J’y retournerais sans hésiter!
Sehr schöne und saubere Wohnung an toller Lage. Dau eine gute Kommunikation mit dem Gastgeber. Gerne wieder :)

This is a great place to stay right by the beautiful, very walkable waterfront and Jet d’Eau landmark. It’s about a 15-20 minute walk from the train station. Excelente

Prince was friendly and helpful host. We were grateful to be able to stay at such a wonderful location. Geneva is fantastic!
