Great host with a wonderful apartment! Highly recommended if staying in Geneva!

Tout avec Frédéric s'est passé très bien! Excellente communication, très disponible et flexible. C'est un joli petit appartement - idéal pour deux personnes - bien situé en Vieille Ville. À recommander!

I stayed at Frederic's place for 5 nights for a work conference, it was perfect! The apartment itself, has excellent architecture and was had amazing views of lake Geneva. I would gladly stay here again the next time I'm in Geneva.
Très chic apartement dans le centre du ville. Super!

Amazing flat in the heart of the old town- spacious, super comfortable, very clean, easy to find, everything, food, drinks, lake, tram and bus nearby! Would love to stay here again this place is perfect!
Place is centrally located but apartment is on top floor without elevators. There is no fan and it was hot. Frederic was nice to give me access personally and inform me about the apartment quickly.

I stayed in Geneva for a night to relax and enjoy the city. The apartment's location was centrally located and in what I thought was the most charming area of the city (la Vielle Ville). I arrived by train which was roughly a 20-minute walk. As a solo traveler, I felt safe walking in the area.

There is a nice view overlooking the city from the bedroom and it got a nice breeze. There was little noise except the church bells every 15 minutes but they were enjoyable.
Communication, check-in, and check-out were incredibly easy. I would definitely stay at the apartment again, and I would recommend this unit to anyone.
Merci, Frédéric!

Frédéric was a wonderful, informative host! He accommodated us on a last minute reservation and was very communicative. Highly recommend! The place is lovely and has a great view - and is around the corner from a great French bistro.  Frederic was very helpful.
A very nice place to stay. The location is very good and the apartment is nice as well!

Frederic's apartment is awesome! Great location where we could walk to a lot of places and the lake. Really cool feel to the neighborhood and felt very safe. Frederic is a great host and was so patient when we had some travel delays that pushed back our check in to quite late. Would absolutely stay here again.
Location was amazing. Short walk to anywhere, including public transportation. Apartment was well furnished, clean, and quiet.

Very nice apartment in the old town with a wonderful view of the lake.
Frédéric was helpful and communicative throughout the stay.
The place was beautiful, well located, and Frederic's direction/suggestions were fantastic.  A great host!

Frédéric was a great host! Apartment is in a perfect location and directions to get there are super clear provided by him!
The place is really comfortable and has a great view! Place is clean and pictures are as it is!

Thanks Frédéric!

Perfect spot to stay in Geneva- Frederic is an amazing host!

Excellent host!
Very clear arrival instructions and good information given about the local area.

Very central and very nice place

Very central location in characterful old town of Geneva.  Apartment is exactly as described.  Very clean.

Great place!!

Nicole’s place is really well situated in a quiet neighborhood but close to the centre of Geneva, shops, transport etc.. It has a lovely view of the Jura mountains. Communication was easy and the place has everything you need. Recommended.

Hemos pasado un mes en el apartamento de Nicole y ha sido todo un acierto reservarlo para nuestra llegada a Ginebra. La hija de Nicole, Lauriene nos ha atendido estupendamente, ayudando en todo cuanto necesitábamos. En cuanto a l tren, nada molesto. Gracias por vuestra acogida y vuestra flexibilidad con nosotros.
Just as others described already, the apartment is lovely, bright and in a great location. Great residential area with shops and bus stops at your doorstep and a lovely park also nearby.
L’appartement de Nicole est situé dans un quartier de Genève très agréable. Son accueil et son assistance ont rendu mon séjour à Genève facile et plaisant.

A good apartment with the facilities I needed, particularly a well-equipped and spotless kitchen. A little away from the centre and the UN area but under normal circumstances the public transport connections are good (there was a strike for some of my time there). Others have commented on train noise but I didn't notice it (perhaps because I lived next to a railway myself for a long time) - might be more of an issue in summer with windows open.
Un excellent sejour, appartement tres bien, cuisine bien équipée, immeuble et quartier tranquille. Parfait pour 18 jours de travail. Balcon avec belle vue sur le Jura.

This is a spacious and colorful apartment. The view from the balcony was amazing!!! We watched beautiful sunsets and had breakfasts on the balcony, looking at the mountains, even though it was winter! So nice.
Also, Nicole and her daughter were very friendly and helpful!
As for the downsides: 1) there's not much room for clothes because the commode drawers easily fall out and are hard to use, 2) some days it was pretty cold inside, 3) the shower could work a little bit better, but nothing critical.
Overall it's a great place, and I recommend it!

We had a pleasant three-month stay at this apartment. It was clean and comfortable. The location could not be more perfect. The large balcony was definitely a highlight overlooking a beautiful panoramic view of the mountains. It is also close to the centre with great nearby places to eat. The hosts are very friendly, responsive and helpful. Highly recommend staying here.

Ich kann nur bestätigen, was bereits in den Bewertungen geschrieben wurde. Die Wohnung ist ein echtes Schmuckstück, in einer sehr netten und sicheren Umgebung. Great place for a long-term stay. Nicole was easy to communicate and very welcoming. Host kindly showed us the place in person, and we felt right at home. Equipped with everything we needed. Nearby grocery stores are great time saving.
As described in the introduction, the train noise became an issue in summer along with extreme heat.

The apartment was clean, comfortable and well equipped. we would stay there again.

une appartement bien agréable!

The location is fantastic with 2 groceries, a pharmacy and a small mall within walking distance. It’s also near Jonction and Bois de la Batie which are nice places to visit for a walk.
Nicole's daughter was very helpful with information needed on the first day. The apartment was comfortable, clean with a nice view. Conveniently located for shopping and transportation.
Good place , Nicole and her daughter  were  responsive when needed ,  thank you for hosting me
This is a very open and comfortable apartment. Great view and very secure building. Well equipped kitchen. Nearby grocery. Good walking area. Nicole was very easy to work with.
Perfect accomodation in the Geneve countryside

Comme la dernière fois, j'ai passé un très bon séjour dans l'appartement de Catarina. Toujours aussi bien équipé. Je reviendrai avec plaisir.

This apartment meant is in a perfect location, and tucked away from the street, so you won’t be bothered by outside noise.  You will hear the upstairs neighbors at night, though, so bring earplugs. We really enjoyed our stay in Genève. It is a beautiful city and philippe’s place right in the heart of the old town is a great base to explore the city.
Great location
Comfortable studio apartment in a great location. We found everything we needed for a quiet two-night stay. We recommend this host and apartment.
Lovely little studio in the heart of the old town. Brilliant location, very quiet and had everything you need.
Strategically located in the heart of old town Geneve. cafes, shopping places, convenient store and public transport are nearby. well maintained and clean property. Highly recommended.

The apartment was perfect and ideal for our few days there. The apartment was very clean and it had everything we needed for our stay there.  It is located in the heart of old town Geneve and everything is nearby like shops, cafes, restaurants, and all the tourist spots. Appartement propre, bien placé avec une arrivée et un départ facilités
Very good location, just at the centre of old town. Love the old town vibes. Lots of restaurants near by and a short walk to all the busses and trams. Thanks for hosting us!
A nice flat in a great solution for a few days in Geneva.
centrally located.  great place to stay.  host is super helpful.

Herzlichen Dank für den Aufenthalt! Die Unterkunft ist sehr zentral gelegen. Alles war sehr sauber und der Self-check-in hat auch wunderbar funktioniert. Das Zimmer ist zwar etwas dunkel, aber sehr ruhig. Gerne wieder mal!
phenomenal communication and incredibly accommodating.  philippe went above an beyond to ensure my time was everything it could be!  definitely recommend!!

Philippe is a great host. Very easy to talk to and responds fast. Apartment was exactly as advertised, great location, very clean, complete amenities, and easy check in / check out. Great location in the Medieval "Old City"  - a small space, not much natural light, but clean and sufficient. I needed to shorten my stay and Phillipe the Host very graciously refunded the difference.

Another terrific stay in this lovely flat, I will of course be back!

The apartment has an outstanding location, in the heart of Old Town, and convenient to restaurants, shops, and public transportation. My only suggestion to the host would be to provide washcloths.
Perfect
Es una mujer encantadora y amable. Nos ha ayudado en todo lo que ha podido. Está ubicado en un lugar muy agradable y cercana a los puntos de interes.
Very comfortable,clean and calm place,outside Geneva ,have all you need for your stay , airport is 45 min by bus.

logement correct, idéale pour poser vos bagages une paire de jours à moindre frais.

Very clean and well equipped apartment, in a quiet residential area 15 minutes away from Geneva by car or with the bus nearby. Catarina was a helpful host, and the parking place in front of the house is a big plus, definitely recommended for a stay to visit Geneva nearby.

L'appartement est conforme aux photos, très propre et agréable. Il est situé proche du P+R / arrêts de bus de Sous-Moulin. Le centre ville est donc accessible assez rapidement. Catarina est une hôte disponible, arrangeante et très réactive. Merci à elle !
Outstanding experience! Will always be willing to visit again whenever at Geneva!
We had a wonderful stay in Geneva in Catarina’s stylish apartment. Really clean and comfortable!

Have you ever felt at home far away from home? The location is great, close to the city centre by car, but also in the proximity of various bus shuttles.
Comparing our experience at Catarina’s place with all the many other stays I’ve ever had, I can say for sure that it was the best one yet. And it’s absolutely worthy to book your stay at such a stunning place and with a host that is reliable, kind, always attentive and that is always ready to help you to enjoy your stay!
Great value. Location is super and it does include parking. Host is very kind. Internet is a bit spotty but works for basic stuff like youtube, etc.
it was great to be in you apartment. cozy, tranquil, we had a lot of fun on walks in the neiborhood. and going to shopping was easy. We recommend warmly the host
Catarina était une hôte très compréhensive et arrangeante. L'appartement était bien.

If you're on foot and use public transit, this place is conveniently close to the Sous-Moulin bus exchange to go anywhere around Geneva. The space is spacious and the separate living room, bedroom and bathroom were all very clean and tidy.

I stayed in Catarina's place for almost 3 weeks. I booked the place in the last minute, as there was a new covid restriction in the country of my new assignment that prevented me from leaving Geneva. This place had everything I needed, and the neighborhood was great for taking a walk.
The best part of my stay, however, was how responsive and flexible Catarina was. Not knowing when I can leave Geneva, I was very much stressed out at the time, and her flawless communication definitely made my life easier. She was very understanding of my situation, accommodated my check-in & check-out time, and was very helpful when I needed to extend my stay. She even helped me push the car when it got stuck on the slope.
The closest bus stop is 10 min away, and the closest supermarket is 15 min away; so if you absolutely hate walking, this is not your place. If you do not mind walking in the beautiful neighborhood, this would be a great place for your stay.
Lovely stay in this quiet setting, with everything we needed. We look forward to coming back when we are in Geneva in future. Thank you Catarina!

J’ai passé un superbe séjour , l’appartement était parfait et très pratique car bien équipé, le airbnb est proche de Genève centre ce qui est pratique pour visiter les alentours. Je recommande fortement en plus de cela notre hôte est très agréable et disponible si besoin. 🙂
It was a pleasure staying at the apartment. Clean and always in communication to make my stay pleasant. Thank you for the memorable experience. A++

I would definitely stay at Catrina’s again for a visit to Geneva/ Thonex.

The stay exceeded our expectations. I loved this flat, it's not a modern, hip flat.. but it's homey ,the host is super friendly.. everything needed is available , the location is great.
Excellent séjour, accueil chaleureux, très proche des transport publiques, l'appartement était confortable. Merci Steven

Fantastic host! Great location, value for money and cleanliness. The apartment was sparkling clean, we had all amenities we needed for a month stay. In front of tram stop. Common laundry. Thanks Steven!

Très agréable séjour , confortable, excellente situation et transports publics, quartier sympathique et plein de vie.
a recommander.

Steven is an excellent host and his apartment is great. He has been extremely responsive and helpful when needed. The pictures in the add don't do justice to how the apartment looks in reality. Très bel appartement, bien équipé et proches de toutes les commodités. Il a un charme fou avec son parquet et l'hôte est très réactif. Je le recommande vivement !
Mes parents ont passé un séjour très agréable. L appartement est situé proche des commerces, restaurants et tramway. C etait très pratique. L appartement est propre et spacieux pour 2-3 personnes.

Clean, lovely, and convenient for staying and visiting Geneva. Evrthg of the flat is good for 3 people (adults).

Splendido appartamento, ben diviso tra zona giorno e notte. Posizione ottima e ben collegata con il resto della città. Cucina nuova e attrezzata di tutto. Un host sempre pronto e di una cortesia eccezionale.

un agréable séjour, très bien situé, très pratique pour utiliser les transports en commun, pas de problème pendant six semaines. expérience à renouveler dés que possible!  Genève c'est top.

Everything was so easy and smooth, so a big five stars to the apartment and a high five for being great hosts to Vanessa & Alessandro!

great host. loved the room.

Very nice apartment and very nice owners, they helped us a lot

We absolutely loved our stay in Geneva. Alessandro & Vanessa's place is amazing. The apartment has the luxury of a hotel, but the cosiness of home. This was my first airbnb experience and it was great!

Qu'il est agréable de loger dans un appartement tout droit sorti d'un magazine de design... La gentillesse et disponibilité de Vanessa est aussi à mentionner, elle qui a su faire en sorte que je ne manque de rien avec un bébé.
Un endroit que je recommanderai sans hésiter ! Confortable, bien pensé et équipé.

The location of the apartment is great too, close to grocery stores, parks, and the water. The check-in and check-out procedures were straightforward and Vanessa was great at communicating with us throughout the process and our stay. If you are looking for a stylish and centrally located place to stay in Geneva, this is it!
Very modern apartment! Perfectly equipped and as comfortable as it can get, would definitely recommend it!

The apartment is perfectly located, just a 10 minutes’ walk from the lake and the Old City. Stylish apartment in lovely old apartment block.

This was the best Airbnb experience I've had. By far the best place in Geneva. Everything was modern, new, and impeccably clean. Communication was great, and the experience was a breeze.

Alessandro & Vanessa's Geneva apt. was just perfect for my week's stay!! Sophisticated and very tastefully furnished, it had everything I could need. Loved the high quality bedding and super comfortable mattress!

Fantastic apartment clean  and very cosy with all amenities available from Wi-Fi, Netflix, espresso machine with complentary coffee and great host. Will definitely book it again for any future trips to Geneva.

We are definitely likely to stay here again on our next trip to Geneva and would recommend to anyone looking for a quiet, convenient place to stay.

This apartment is very stylish and clean. I felt like home when I was staying here. Alessandro was very friendly and responded to me quickly. I will definitely stay here again when I come back to Geneva.

Alessandro and Vanessa were easy to communicate with and they were more than happy to provide recommendations. We stayed in Geneva during some rather high temperatures and they were quick to provide fans for us.

In any case, we highly recommend the place for families and would most certainly book again.
Thanks to Alessandro and Vanessa!

We have nothing but amazing things to say about this lovely apartment. Myself (Emily) and my boyfriend (Joe) stayed in the studio for over 5 weeks whilst I was working as an intern at the UN.
The location is fantastic, in the Charmilles/St Jean area of Geneva. After taking the no.10 bus from the airport the apartment block is just across the road from the bus stop, and is just a 15minute walk from the town centre. The area is family orientated and feels very safe. There are two doors at the entrance to the building requiring two separate safety codes, which adds to the feeling of security.
The apartment itself is light, modern and spacious and is even better than the pictures. The fold-away bed is easy to use and really comfy, as is the luxurious bedding that Emmanuelle provides. We particularly enjoyed eating our meals on the large balcony which enjoys views across the adjacent park and across to the Jura mountains. You are essentially on the penthouse level so can sun-bathe to your heart's content in the summer months.
When we arrived the apartment was clean and well presented - Emmanuelle had even left us some Swiss chocolate, fresh bottled water and coffee capsules to use in the coffee machine (which itself is a lovely bonus). We had clean towels and linen, an iron and were also happy to find a washing machine/dryer combo in the bathroom which meant we didn't need to travel to the laverie every week. The wifi and TV services are also great - we could record our favourite shows from the UK and never had any connectivity issues.
Emmanuelle was very easy to communicate with and always attentive. Picking up and dropping off the keys was easy, and she helped us store our bags on our last day before we headed to the airport.
If you are looking for somewhere to stay in Geneva do not hesitate - this apartment will not disappoint!

We stayed at Emmanuelle's flat in September 2024.  It is a 10 minute walk from the main train station to the flat or you can take the number 10 bus from the train station to the flat. There is a balcony; however due to it raining most days we were visiting we did not have a chance to utilize it.  The big table was useful for working.  There are numerous restaurants and take out places all over the near vicinity of the flat.  One grocery store around the corner and another two larger ones in opposite directions on Rue de Lyon and Rue Voltaire.  Getting to the airport was easy.  Take bus 10 from across the street from the flat to the airport.  We would recommend this flat to others.  Thank you Emmanuelle.

Emmanuelle is a fine host who responds quickly to any questions or requests. She had an electrical problem fixed very quickly.

The apartment itself has a small but very good, modern kitchen, fully supplied for cooking and eating. The bathroom is tight, mainly because there is a washer/dryer in there. High step to get into the tub/shower.
Decor is minimalist and could use some attention. But, all in all, the great location and good host are the keys.

Large balcony/patio that has nice seating but flower pots filled with weeds which made it seem most neglected. The kitchen was good had newer appliances (Euro style - I.e. small) but sufficient. Bathroom is cramped but there’s a washer/dryer which was great. Minimal amenities. Better pre cleaning needed - dust in bowls, drawers.  Host responsive

Fue nuestra cuarta vez en Ginebra por razones laborales. Las veces anteriores estuvimos en hoteles. Pero si volvemos a esta hermosa ciudad, sin dudas nos alojaríamos en el apartamento de Christine.

Christine and her partner were amazing, as was her staff member, Alan (who was sensational). Thank you Christine and colleagues.
Immaculately clean, amazingly decorated, great location with great people. Maeva (and Christine) were  extremely lovely and helpful! Highly recommend the apartment! Thanks!

El departamento está cerca de la Estación de trenes, a 15 minutos en tram. El barrio es tranquilo y el departamento amplio, luminoso y cómodo.

Nice room with enough space, enjoyable for two people. Everything we needed and more with its proximity to public transportation and the mall. Will come back if given the chance.

En la habitación teníamos un sofá cama muy cómodo, una mesa pequeña con sillas, un perchero donde colgar nuestra ropa y una pequeña nevera en la que meter nuestra comida. Más que suficiente para cubrir nuestras necesidades.
Estuvimos 2 días visitando Ginebra, así que pasábamos todo el día fuera de casa. Teníamos muy poco tiempo para visitar una increíble ciudad.
2 cosas importantes: Primero. Nada más llegar id a la oficina de turismo. Os explicarán cómo funciona todo en Ginebra, incluido el sistema de transporte (muy fácil de utilizar) y lo más relevante de visitar. Segundo. Comprad el Geneve Pass. Os da acceso gratuito al transporte público y a más de 30 actividades.
Aprovecho estas líneas para agradecer a Marilyn y a su marido su hospitalidad, amabilidad, generosidad, habernos abierto las puertas de su casa sin restricciones, su ayuda para que nuestra estancia en Ginebra fuese muy agradable y los ratos pasados charlando animadamente.
Muchas gracias por habernos abierto vuestra casa y vuestros corazones. Mi mujer y yo lo pasamos estupendamente. Nuestras bendiciones para vosotros y vuestra familia.
Sinceramente, los mejores anfitriones que os podéis encontrar.

Cozinha com tudo que precisávamos (adoro cozinhar), mas sentimos falta de microondas. Localização ótima! Votaremos!!!

Quiero agradecer a Olga por su excelente apartamento en ginebra céntrico me sentí en mi hogar su atención 24/7 y su amabilidad y l apartamento es precioso sus camas son buenas y es como las fotos lo recomiendo la zona cerca de todo

Grand appartement bien situé, 2 chambres et un salon cuisine ça nous a permis de venir visiter Genève entre amies.
Olga et Boris sont très réactifs aux messages.

舒适度高，街道很安静，室内装饰也很有品味，卫生间厨房各种用具也很齐全。房东人很好，且沟通顺畅回复及时。
An incredible place to explore the most beautiful parts of Geneva. Olga and Boris were very kind, responsive and accomodating. We will surely come back.

Fantastic stay at this beautiful nice, cosy, beautifully located home. Olga and Boris were the perfect hosts and kept us informed with very clear ,timely instructions right from the start of our trip. The apartment is tastefully decorated ,with the kitchen and the bathroom properly stocked with all the necessary stuff.Linen ,towels etc were spotlessly clean.
We stayed here for eleven days with our two grown up boys and they too found the locality, restaurants and the eateries around. Old town area, the lake, gardens ferry points and the main railway station are at walking distances from it...though the local transport bus station is just a few hundred metres away .
God willing....Would definitely love to come back to this beautiful place again.
Thanks Olga and Boris for making our this outstanding and memorable trip to Geneva so easy..so comfortable. God bless you and the family 🙏.
With warm regards.
Devinder, Anshu.

Great location especially for walking distance with kids and the surroundings - house super well equipped for kids (a lot of toys which our toddler and 3 year old were pumped about) - hosts reactive and flexible. Would recommend !

Great flat in central area. Hosts Olga and Boris were very accommodating with regards to key handover. Great explanations of how things operated made the stay very easy. Would return if available on any return trip to Geneva.
Wonderful stay and great hosts. Will definitely book again. Thanks so much Olga & Boris!

David is a great host and was very communicative. The room itself was very large and clean. Also, while the public transit was very close, it wasn't always necessary given the amazing location. The place was perfect, and I would recommend it to anyone staying in Geneva
Great flat, huge room, less than 10min walk from Geneva  main station. All was great, David wasn't  there but the flatmates are helpful and great! Thank you!!

David's room is quite nice. It's very roomy, with plenty of room for a couch, coffee table, bed and desk without ever feeling cluttered. The clothes washing machine was not yet hooked up when I stayed there, but I am under the impression that it is on its way. The roommates were nice and very considerate. A very convenient and central location, I had a great time!
Joignable ainsi que ses colocataires, tous très aimables
My stay at Peters place was very nice. Good and quick contact. I felt very welcomed. The flat was comfortable and with a nice balcony. Will not hesitate to book the flat another time.
J'ai adore l'appartement de Peter: moderne, spacieux et lumineux, sans vis a vis et avec une belle terrasse. A 50 m du parc Bertrand et a 7 min des bus 3, 5 et 8. Je le recommanderai a mes amis

The flat is very well designed and newly updated, with everything you need. The owner left some fruit, chocolate, bread, butter and even beer in the fridge, making the first night so much easier. Check in and out were really easy. Thanks!

Great apartment, about twenty five or so minutes easy walk gently down the hill and through the lovely Park du Bastion to the edge of the lake. Private balcony and lovely quiet flat for a great nights sleep. Great cafe five or ten minutes walk away.

The most enjoyable stay I've had in Geneva. The hosts are very friendly and helpful, rooms are very clean and spacious with abundant necessities. Definitely will look for this again if visiting in Geneva in the future.
Great flat in a quiet street near city center. The host welcomed us warmly. The flat is really nice and very well equipped. I definitely recommend to stay with Peter if you come to Geneva!
A tastefully refurbished appartement in a great location.

Ho soggiornato a casa di Peter e Antonia per due settimane.
La casa è moderna ben arredata luminosa con ampie finestra e molto funzionale. Equipaggiata di Smart tv, un bel balconcino, un bagno confortevole un letto matrimoniale, una grande cabina armadio e una cucina ben attrezzata con anche lavastoviglie e macchina Nespresso.
Il quartiere è molto tranquillo vicino ad un bel parco e a 5 minuti a piedi dalla fermata del bus 3 che porta in centro in pochi minuti.
Il Check in è stato effettuato dal concierge dell’immobile che vive nel palazzo e che è a disposizione per qualsiasi evenienza.
Nel palazzo è presente anche una lavanderia comune.
Antonia è stata molto affettuosa e gentile.

Peter's flat is really great, spacious, modern and functional. I wish I had a flat like this one in Geneva!! I would recommend it to anyone and will definitely book it again for future visits. Plus Antonia and Peter are fantastic hosts and made us feel at home.

This is a great place with a very nice park a couple of blocks away. There is a nearby bus station that takes you to downtown in around 15-20 minutes. The host was great and even bought a cot for us when we told him we had a baby. The apartment is as described so no surprises there.

Great location and apartment!
Its nice to find a modern space in Geneva and right next to the park.
Very nice apartment, excellent host.
All is clean and in perfect harmonie. We only can recomend this appartement.
This flat was totally accurate as to description, plus a special , quiet part of Geneva, easy to walk and explore the city with added nearby access to trams , buses, parks and shops. Hidden gem.
Really enjoyed staying at Peter's place and Antonia was a fantastic host, thanks guys!
Lovely hosts and a clean and secure apartment. Very close to the airport and a short trip into Geneva city centre.
Wonderful place and beautiful people.

Very good stay at Marc's place, hosts were extremely kind and welcoming! Location is excellent, next to Balexert mall that offers quite a variety of things. Tram stop was a 3' walk outside the house and all amenities were offered! Would stay there again, thank you!

Einfach eingerichtetes Zimmer. Gastgeber sind sehr freundlich und zuvorkommend. Sie sprechen aber nur Englisch.

La habitación es pequeña pero está bien, una cama, una mesita con silla y una nevera por si llevas comida. El baño estaba limpio y los anfitriones fueron amables con nosotros. Recomendable si quieres pasar unos días en Ginebra a buen precio.

Run by a management company. Needed texting to check in which is a problem for international travelers. "Host" just told me to contact actual host by phone. Defeats the purpose of airbnb secured communication.

excellent location, good value, friendly host. Not easy to find out night so do your homework and taxi driver wont necessarily be able to help.

We had an awesome trip! Thank you!
100% recomendado está ubicado cerca del transporte público y el aeropuerto, todo muy limpio y ordenado

It was the worst experience at an Airbnb facility. The standards of accuracy, cleaness, communication and check in directions were very under what Airbnb looks for their hosts. We sleep only one night in this room, but really nice and clean place.

Marc and Marilyn were very lovely people! When I arrived earlier than expected, Marc came back early to check us in. It was a very kind gesture.

This place was perfect for our family of four. Easy access, clean, and lots of space. We booked last minute and it worked well. It was short train ride out of downtown and close to lovely beach access in Versoix.

Our stay in the apartment was quite comfortable. The location is convenient for going back and forth between France/Geneva/Lausanne. Some of the amenities listed were not available in the apartment, which was slightly inconvenient, especially as there was about half a paper towel roll given for a 9-night stay. Neither of the phone numbers to the apartment owners given on the check-in info are connected. Your best bet is emailing the Keys'n'Fly customer support for any issues you may have.
The parking is also a bit of a head-scratcher for foreigners: you can park in the blue spaces but you need to purchase a special 'dial' that marks what time you arrived. We didn't get any parking tickets, but it would be helpful if such a dial was given in the apartment for people staying.
Also one thing to consider for pet owners: the apartment is on the 5th floor, and hawks seem to fly daily in the area, tending to swoop quite low over balconies... Just a watch-out for owners of small dogs and cats to maybe reconsider letting your pets roam freely outside/on the balcony.

My family and I enjoyed our stay in this comfortable apartment with its amazing views of the Alps and Lake Geneva. It has a nice layout and modern fitted kitchen for self-catering. There is a play area for children next to the property and another 5 minutes away. A public beach on the lake shore is a short walk away as well as larger stores and Versoix town center itself. Easy access into Geneva too. A couple of things in the apartment are a bit wonky and will hopefully get fixed and parking can be a bit tricky if you are coming by car. Nice place in a nice location. Would recommend for a family.

The apartment was very clean, spacious and comfortable. Lots of space in the apartment. It contained everything you would need during your stay.

The apartment has a beautiful view overlooking a park, with views of the mountains. Had a wonderful stay here.

Tres bon sejour! communication facile , tres bon prix car grand et propre!merci pour l adresse de fondue! c etait tres bon!

Nice Apartement, centrally located and very good communication makes this plase an awesome home while beeing in Geneva. Thanks, I‘ll come back!

Great location, great space. Cozy and well laid out--with a really comfortable bed and clean, pleasant bathroom (those are the things important to me!). Laura is a good host and you'll have a great stay if you stay at her place....good communication and a great attitude.
Easy check in and easy to get to on public transport. Bus stop right out front door! Cozy apartment and comfy bed were just what I needed.

What a great space! Well located on a busy road with easy access to public transport and the grocery. The flat is comfortable and welcoming with all the necessary amenities. Communication was easy and fast.

- Confusing communication: after booking through Airbnb, I received an email from a third-party (Keys'N'Fly) and was told to text with Marilyn. There was no messaging done through Airbnb.
- Lack of amenities: the listing described a kitchen, but we were told that we needed to schedule kitchen hours, which ended at 7:30pm (we had arrived just after 7:30). Thankfully they allowed us to use plates and a microwave. The blanket on the bed didn't cover the full mattress.
- Apartment atmosphere: at best, this felt like a hostel. There were several other rooms in the apartment, but no interactions with anyone. The check-in (and sign in the room) encouraged us to keep our doors closed at all times.

We stayed there for a whole month, as it was very close to my job. For us, it was a ok experience as we are very easy going and were there for work. If you are looking for a low-cost stay this place is a good option, but have some downsides:
1. The controlled kitchen time is not only on the time you use the kitchen, but also what you can and cannot cook on it. For that you only have 30 min in the morning and 30 min in the evening.
On Sunday you can only use the kitchen once for 30 min in the morning.
On Friday I could not use the kitchen in the evening as they hosted a service during every Friday night.
2. The host was very rude in the first week I was there. Once he got used to me he was very friendly.
Nevertheless, on the check-out he was rude again, because he agreed on an early check-in for another tenant and tried to force us out. He even turned the Wi-Fi off to force us out.
3. There are a lot of rules. They tell you the way you should handle the coffee you brew, when cooking they stay right by your side to make sure you use only 30 min and they tell you what utensils and heat-plate to use.
You only have the right for one bed sheet, does not matter how long you stay. If you want another one you need to pay.
Limited amount of times you can use the washing machine, according to how long you stay.
4. They put a microwave on the common area to allow you to heat something up without the need of the kitchen. But if you use too much or too late they complain and tell you not to use it.
If you think you can stand all those rules and behaviors for a fair low price that is a good place for you.

2) The toilet has no water, so you have to use sand
3) No shower in the bathroom
4) No WiFi
That being said, I would thoroughly recommend the yurt if you want to have a fantastic holiday in Geneva!!

Diana's flat is located in a beautiful neighbourhood, 3 min walk to bus and train stations, and with lovely restaurants nearby. Host received us with fresh flowers and proactively checked that everything was OK. Fully furnished and equipped. Highly recommended for leisure or work trips.

It has been with great pleasure that I have spent one and a half year in this wonderful appartment. Diana is indeed the perfect hostess, always friendly, helpful and ready to find solutions to any issue. Comes with my highest recommendations!

Beautiful small apartment, with a super balcony, not far from the centre of Geneva, the lac, the river, Nations, everything.  It's clear they really care about the place, as it feels very much like a home.  It was also probably the best-stocked flat I've stayed in.
Simply THE best in every aspect. We were lucky to have found Laureen's Arjun's place to stay!

My family and I absolutely loved the apartment. It's incredibly cozy, stylish, and thought-through, and you instantly feel at home and welcomed. Laureen & Arjun knew that it would be my birthday and left me a lovely card signed in Russian and French and a couple of presents, which absolutely made my day. There were also treats for my whole family that made us all feel really welcome.
Communication with Laureen & Arjun was very smooth and fast. They were very responsive both via the website and phone, so I any question I had was resolved almost immediately.
The apartment is also super easy to navigate and, for example, all of the kitchen drawers have signs indicating where you can find what. Incredibly useful and saves you from a lot of trouble!
I personally appreciated the fact that the apartment gives a zero waste / responsible consumption approach to living. Aside from a certain aesthetics, it is visible in the glass jars in which products are stored, bins for separating trash, a drawer for reused plastic bags etc.
The only upsetting point of our stay was me accidentally breaking a lamp and finding out how expansive it was. I believe that for some travelers such cost wouldn't be manageable. So I would not expect to see such fragile and expensive things in a rental apartment. Yet even in this situation Laureen & Arjun kept our communication efficient and cordial to make sure this situation is resolved swiftly.
I would definitely recommend others to stay in this lovely apartment and would do the same myself in the future if coming back to Geneva.

Lauren and Arjun are wonderful people, communication with them was excellent all along. The apartment was a perfect place for our family during our stay in Geneva. We enjoyed every day of our visit, thanks to the hospitality of the hosts and their dear home. Thank you for having us!

This renovated fully-furnished stilish apartment is located in Carouge, within 3 tram stops from Geneva city center. Tram stop is very close too. The apartment has all comforts you need to feel home, including a washing machine, a dish washer, a Nespresso machine, etc. In the area there is a Migros grocery store, as well as restaurants and shops and some car dealers. Philippe has been an extraordinary host, always helpful and attentive. He supplied all the appliances and services I requested, and made my stay much easier. Thanks, Philippe.

Loved the place and amenities. It’s a great apartment with all you need, close to all Geneva has to offer. Philippe is a great host, very responsive. The place is very clean and appliances are new. Highly recommended.
Appartement agréable, renouvelé et meublé. Très bonne connectivité avec le réseau de transport public. Les photos représentent bien la réalité. Très accueillant de même.
Philippe’s place really is sparkling clean, and it has everything you need as a business traveller. It’s much more comfirtable than a hotel and more cost effective.
Bel appartement propre et lumineux mais très très bruyant  même en été alors que c’était déjà les vacances d’été et en principe moins de traffic et ce n’était pas le cas !!!!!!

Philippe is a very hospitable host. His advices were very helpful. Punctuality was great too.
The place is clean with everything necessary for long stay including washing machine. The only drawback is that the place is quite noisy due to the neighbor street.

Séverine was an excellent host. She was willing to work with our crazy schedule and arrange a time for us to come check in. The yurt was amazing and location was very special. Rare to have such a large garden area in a city like Geneva. Very close to the tram stop and easy to access the downtown area within 20 min.
Absolutely loved our stay in the yurt. Public transportation to the center of geneva is quick and easy. The family is very kind and allowed us to use the shower inside when they were home.
We had such a wonderful time! Great location close to the tram. Lots of fun for the kids with a playground and rabbits and guinea pigs to look at. Severine was very accommodating.
It was quite rare experience. You can wash your face in the beautiful sunlight in the morning if it’s sunny. The host is so nice and kind.
Had a lovely time! The yurt is beautiful and the grounds stunning. Enjoyed spending the night in the garden playing with boomerang the dog and the unique experience of sleeping in the yurt.

This Airbnb is the best I've ever stayed in. The space is peaceful and beautiful. I would love to stay here again when I return to the area someday. The host is fantastic and she brought us tea and coffee. The space is very close to lots of restaurants and shops.
Super expérience,  Séverine est très sympathique et l'environnement très agréable.

Amazing experience in the yurt. Right outside the city and easily accessible by tram only 15 mins with a stop right outside the home. The host was great and even left us breakfast for the morning. At night you could see the stars and breath in the beautiful Swiss mountain air. Great balance of close enough to Geneva inner city but far enough to experience the beauty of Switzerland!

Séverine is a nice host. Garden stay was nice. She has a nice biotoilet. Her place is close to Meyrin village bus stop and Coop supermarket. Microwave is and coffee maker is provided in the hut. All in all a good night spent in Geneva to catch our flight.
Very beautiful setting, the yurt is great fun to stay in!

C'est un séjour hors normes qui nous attend chez Séverine.
C'est une yourte équipée basiquement avec des matelas parterre, une dizaine de litres d'eau disponible dans une demoiselle, des toilettes sèches à proximité dans un très grand parc, pourtant situé en ville.
Nous avons eu la chance d'avoir un temps magnifique et de pouvoir profiter de l'extérieur.
Séverine est très agréable et d'une très grande gentillesse et nous a permit de disposer de sa douche privée.
Le petit déjeuner prévu dans le prix n'est pas sensationnel ( 2 pains au chocolat et café soluble)
A réserver pour une soirée originale.
Very unique (in a good way) experience!  We enjoyed the diversity of the countryside within a city.

Je ne peux que recommander cet hébergement !
L'emplacement est génial et le jardin est magnifique ! La tente est très confortable et a tout ce dont vous avez besoin. Tout est magnifiquement meublé et Séverine et les enfants sont très accueillants. Nous nous sommes sentis les bienvenus.
Si vous recherchez un peu de calme et de détente, c'est l'endroit idéal pour vous.
Merci encore une fois, Séverine.

We stayed with our 3 boys and we absolutely loved it. The space was amazing with so many things that kept the boys occupied.
The yurt was beautiful and such a unique experience for us all.
Would definitely recommend staying here.
Brilliant yurt, easy to find and great hosts. A quite spot in a busy city.

This place is a real gem and the hosts are super lovely. If you are nature lovers and want an adventure then this is for you.
then stay here, you will not be disappointed.
It was a pleasant stay and Severin was very nice.
This is a great place to stay. Very different than anywhere else I’ve stayed in a good way!
Une excellente nuit dans cette yourte, avec tous les équipements nécessaires et un superbe accueil.

Un lieu exceptionnel au centre de Meyrin, non loin de l’aéroport de Genève – ce qui est à la fois un avantage et un inconvénient (les avions peuvent être bruyants). Mais le cadre et l’atmosphère unique de cette yourte rendent ces quelques désagréments sonores très secondaires.

Very cosy, clean, interesting stay in the city. The best goal is huge garden with all you want for a quiet, relaxing stay and for children to play as well!
There are plenty of pets as well!
Great location, it is situated 15 minutes (by tram) from the city center.
Shops and bakery nearby.
We'll come back here!

This place can be dodgy. It is definitely not an "experience" as it sounds like. Maybe for some people, but not for us. In the middle of June, it was like a hot gas chamber for us without any ventillation, fans, air circulation, and with a minimal light with which we could not even pack our bags or read or sit in the tent and enjoy our evening snack. Severine (the host) is a wonderful, and very kind and nice person. Very hospitable. She is very responsive, and communicates wonderfully. We have no complaints about the host or her attitude towards guests. It's just that the accommodation is very inconvenient. Hot as an oven, dim and depressing, smelly, and the bathroom very inconvenient without any water, and having to use a toilet which is nothing more than a pit covered in layers of excretia covered by sand. Just not our idea of a vacation spot or accommodation.
For Euro 20 or 30 a night, it may be OK. But for Euro 75 that we had to pay, it was absolutely not right. Even a simple dry log from the garden (for the outdoors fireplace so we could roast some smores) was priced, and we were asked to pay Euro 2 if we wanted to "buy" it. Switzerland has turned into a land of scarcity it seems!
Perhaps it was our mistake in booking this room, since we are not bohemian enough. "Mongolian" "Yurt" in a "garden" in "Geneva".... all sounds very cool on paper, and that's why we booked. Reality was very different. It may work for others though since Severine is a nice person.

I can't imagine a better way to recover from a long flight than to stay around this beautiful yurt. Everything is very clean and lovely and it's a relaxing place to be. There is a small fan to help circulate the air, but you wouldn't want to be in the yurt during the day.

Lovely yurt with loads of character. Such thoughtful touches like the breakfast, tea, coffee and hot water!
Séverine was so helpful with our check in and with our trains being late and delays it wasn’t a problem and she responded fast to messages.
Would definitely stay again!
Très belle expérience, atypique et unique. Merci pour votre accueil et votre aide.

Super yourte dans un endroit arboré qui est magnifique
Lieu Rreposant et l'hôte nous a très bien accueillie
Had to cancel last minute, but Severine was very responsive and understanding.
Had a great stay at Severine ’s place. Very unique listing, very clean and the host was very helpful and accommodating.

Her place is beautiful! I wish I could have stayed longer just to enjoy the yard. She provided tea, coffee, sweet bread, fresh water, a soap bar and towels to wash your face and much more! The yurt was so comfortable and the artisitc details in the build made it so unique. I cant speak french at all but we were able to communicate just fine. Thank you so much!

Un hébergement pour les vrais amoureux de la nature. La yourte est confortablement meublée et se trouve dans un grand jardin. À l'autre bout, il y a les toilettes. Pour le petit déjeuner, il y avait un panier avec du café en poudre, du thé et de simples petits pains au lait du supermarché le soir. Séverine est une hôtesse très amicale.

Das ist ein ganz besonderes und wunderschönes Erlebnis!  Die Übernachtung in der original mongolischen Jurte in einem wunderschönen Garten. Unsere Kinder (13 und 3 Jahre alt)  haben es sehr genossen. Alles ist sehr sauber und die Kommunikation schnell und unkompliziert und die Gastfreundschaft herzlich! Die Kinder durften das Trampolin und die Spielsachen benutzen. Wir kommen gerne wieder!
Exactly as described, good in either summer or winter season, and you will surely be able to reach CERN in a few minutes. We're happy we get to experience the yurt and meet such a wonderful host!

Severine was so kind to welcome me although I made the reservation last minute! I booked after my flight out of Geneva was canceled late in the night and she was available immediately to help me with directions (it is possible to walk from the airport although not a short walk). Her hospitality and friendliness made me feel so much better after all the stress I had been through. I highly recommend this place!
房东特别美丽温柔。从火车站坐十几分钟电车再下车步行2分钟就能到房源，非常便利。主人家里有两只可爱的小狗。蒙古包在房东家的大花园里，里面有取暖器、电风扇，一大瓶的饮用洗漱用水。床非常舒服。房东晚上9点多给我们带来了一大瓶热水和早餐篮。花园很大很美丽，有很多苹果树和一些年纪很大的松树。空气清新，非常推荐。
The yurt was spectacular - simple check-in, very close to bus station/airport, and we appreciated the great decor and thoughtful touches in and around the yurt. We’ll be back!
A unique experience, great value and a lovely welcome.
Es war sehr schön, wir kommen gern wieder!
Great garden and a really nice place to stay.

What an experience, I was surprised when found this place on Airbnb and then I was even more surprised to see this huge garden with hurt on the middle of Geneva. Severine prepared everything like in 5* hotel, all the instructions were very clear and the place was ready for us , she even left a breakfast for us. Defenetly I will come back if I'll travel to Geneva again. Highly recommended!!!
Thanks Severine! 🙏❤️
Great host family that really cares about their guests. Wonderful garden for children to play. We will definitely come again if there is an opportunity for us to be in Geneva!!

Dépaysement total, nous avons passé une très bonne nuit en yourte. Petit déjeuné agréable en extérieur.
Merci encore !
Beautiful yurt in such a good location, near to the bus for the airport and easy access to the city centre. Only stayed here for one night and wished we could stay for more!

La yourte est magnifique et même la pluie ne nous a pas empêchés de l'apprécier à sa juste valeur... nous avons reçu un bel accueil et passé une nuit atypique, un peu hors du temps sous l'orage... Notre fille a été ravie de découvrir les lapins et cochons d'Inde alors en pension dans le grand et beau jardin... seule chose préjudiciable : la proximité de l'aéroport de Genève et le bruit des avions au décollage !
Séverine nous a donné toutes les instructions à notre arrivée, c’est une hôte parfaite et de bons conseils. Le cadre est magnifique et très reposant, à proximité de Genève centre en tram.
Très bonne expérience !

La yourte est fidèle à sa description mais lorsqu'on est sur place c'est encore plus magique. Séverine est à l'écoute de ses hôtes et rend service en cas de besoin. Je conseille vivement d'y aller voyager

Amazing experience!!
Family was very welcoming and caring, I will make sure to come back again
Dans l'ensemble très bon séjour !
房东非常好，还送了我们篝火的木材，小孩非常喜欢。准备了一篮子的早餐和热开水。还有只很执着要和你玩丢球的狗。唯一就是厕所不大习惯
Très bonne expérience cadre spacieux agréable accueil chaleureux originalité assurée idéal avec les enfants et très bien situé pour visiter Genève et ses environs
Un lieu qui permet de couper de la réalité le temps d'une nuit . Très joli lieu .

Gentillesse, douceur, apaisement ... n'hésitez pas à faire un pause dans le grand jardin de cette adorable famille ! Vous en ressortirez ressourcés ... et amoureux d'au moins un de leurs pensionnaires poilus ;)

El lugar es encantador y la yurta una experiencia única. A nuestros hijos les encantó.
A pesar que es cierto que por la mañana se oía el paso de los aviones, en conjunto la estancia superó completamente nuestras expectativas.
Además, para nosotros fue muy cómodo poder hablar con ellos en español porque lo hablan perfectamente. Totalmente recomendable.
dépaysant ! parfait pour les enfants !!! ça fait du bien :) un super accueil et une extrême gentillesse ! Merci

Magical!  This was a once in a long time opportunity to glamp for the kids. They'd probably have this in their minds for the rest of their lives... the bonfire, the conservative setup, the bunnies and the ever-willing hound (Boomerang). Severine and Alban were superb hosts. Thank you both.

Sejour agreable
Merci

Philippe and Elizabeth’s space was sparkling clean and extremely well located. The tram station is right there and it’s very convenient to head anywhere in Geneva from their place. Ideal for 2 people, strongly recommended.

Philippe est un hôte avenant et disponible. L'appartement est bien équipé et fonctionnel, d'une propreté irréprochable. Proche du centre ville, le tram s'arrête à quelques minutes de marche de l'appartement.
C’est une appartement parfaite pour un séjour long duré. Il y a tout dont a besoin. Nous étions très heureux de notre séjour chez Philippe.

Philippe was kind and responsive. The apartment is well equipped and has literally everything you need to cook and for a comfortable stay. The location is good as well - there is a tram station two steps away that takes you to other parts of Geneva and the train station. It’s also a short walk away from the charming Carouge.  The only downside is that the apartment is quite noisy because it’s next to a high street, but nothing an earplug can’t solve.

I had a lovely stay at this place in Acacias. The apartment is modern, clean and well equipped. Location is good with tram stop just few steps away. Communication with Philippe was fast and efficient. I checked out earlier than expected and Philippe kindly accepted to reimburse part of the money. I will definitely go back on my next trip to Geneva!
very reactive host

The apartment is well located in sense of distance from the city-center (a few stop by trams), it has several grocery stores 2 min walk from it, but it faces a very busy street and the windows do not protect from noise, so if you’re a light sleeper or can not sleep with ear plugs, better consider another option.
The apartment is equipped with everything one need for a long stay (washing machine, dishwasher, large fridge, storage space, good wi-fi, etc). It has a nice kitchen and bathroom.
Unfortunately, upon our arrival it was not properly cleaned, but hopefully this will be fixed next time. There were 3 of us (2 grown-ups and one 2-year old) and we wished there were more than 1 sets of bed-clothing (the second one was brought by Philippe upon request) and kitchen towels.
Otherwise, the stay was fine. Thank you, Philippe!
Very clean and well located apartment. Super helpful hosts

Eine nette Wohnung in zentraler Lage von Genf. Direkte Anbindung an die Tram 15 und 17 vor der Haustür und auch noch in Laufweite zu interessanten Orten der Stadt.
In wenigen Gehminuten entfernt befindet sich ein Supermarkt.
Die Küche der Wohnung ist sehr gut ausgestattet und ansonsten hatte uns nichts gefehlt.
In der Tat ist die Geräuschkulisse ziemlich laut, da die Fenster nicht isoliert sind oder richtig dicht schließen. Dementsprechend kühl kann es in den Zimmern werden.
Philippe empfing uns freundlich und war sehr gut schriftlich zu erreichen.

Excellent séjour chez Philippe.
Très réactif ! Merci beaucoup.
Appartement très propre.
A 10 min du centre grâce au tram au pied de l’appartement.

Wish I could have stayed here longer! It was a perfect transition location for a newcomer to Geneva. The apartment is clean, well equipped, and very comfortable and the location is ideal for exploring.
Great host.
It was beautiful, clean, cosy and a little bit noisy in the evening. But we enjoyed the place. We could used this place again.

My stay at Philippe’s has been excellent. For a long term stay; it was worth every penny.
The apartment was clean and the communications were always easy and thoughtful.
I would recommend Philippe to anyone looking for a place in the future. He is a great guy and made my transition to a new country easier.
Thank you Philippe!

Philippe’s place was clean and had everything that I needed for a long stay. The washing machine inside the unit was very convenient. The location is a few steps away from the tram line that takes you straight to the train station. The hosts were always responsive and helpful. Restaurants and grocery stores nearby as well. Highly recommend.

Phillippe and his co host were great at communicating and very responsive to our needs. The apartment served us well for the 6 weeks we were there with our baby and dog.
Would definitely recommend.
Love this apartment. It’s a great location and has everything you need. The list is very pleasant to work with and quick to respond. Highly recommend.
All good

Every thing was like described in the description.
Good WiFi .

This address is highly recommended .
I will be back .

I had a wonderful stay. The place is clean, fully equipped with everything you need. Looks like the pictures. The hosts always responsive, friendly and really good communication. Grocery stores are at a walking distance and it’s generally a good location. I would definitely stay there again. Thank you!!

Excelente lugar  , muy agradable.

Logement propre et très bien situé à 1 min du tram,

Un bel appartement, exactement comme sur l'annonce, à proximité de très bons restaurants, de parcs et de rivières. L'appartement est proche du tramway, ce qui le rend très bien desservi. La personne responsable explique tout très bien et est très sympathique.
Un lugar acogedor y de fácil acceso al centro. Óptimo para  tres personas. Renovado.
Responsive host and clean, equipped space in a good location.

The apartment was very convenient, next to the tram stop and well furnished though the street noise could be a bit much at times.
The kitchen appliances were good and functional though the knives and frying pan could use some work.
Overall a very nice place and well worth the price.

We stayed at philippe’s place for 3 nights and had a great stay. Philippe was easy to communicate with and helped us out with anything we needed. The apartment is nice and spacious with a really nice window in the lounge area letting in lots of natural light. The location is nice and has a tram service on the doorstep, also bikes just round the corner which were great for getting around the city. Would recommended staying here :)

Tout était parfait vraiment magnifique ,
Merci.

Lovely apartment, very convenient to tram station (right out front). Host was very responsive to questions.
The apartment was perfect for a few day stay. Just like the photos, host was responsive and on a tram route which made it very accessible.

We had a super three nights stay at this place as it was conveniently next to a friend’s apartment. Some fantastic restaurants nearby and a really International scene. They also accepted our dog with a nearby park to take him. The tram was opposite the Apartment which made it really convenient to get into the heart of Geneva. Would highly recommend it.
Marzena and Philippe were great hosts. Responsive, personable and flexible. Location is great close to 15/17 trams. It was a great stay and recommend them !
David was always ready to answer and solve any question. The apartment is very well located and has a very good living space.
We enjoyed our long stay at Davids, communication was v smooth. Apartment is very close to majority of bus lines, house is very convenient and clean!
The communication and check in were fast and smooth. The apartment needs some improvement in terms of renovation and cleaning.
Perfect stay in Geneva, thanks David and Pavel!
David place is perfect for a stay in Geneva. Try it out!
Central area and fully stocked kitchen, but the check in and check out processes are a bit too lengthy and his colleague was very late to both
Great location near the lake. David was a great host, very responsive and flexible.

The place is small and cosy, lovely couch & very comfortable bed, a little "cave" (to store your suitcase, laundry etc.) and what I loved was the little electric heater for colder days if needed.
The microwave oven was a treat (not so common for most Geneva airbnb's) and laundry could be done for free (have to bring/buy your own washing powder though & there's some demand for the two washing machines and one dryer in the basement, especially on weekends ;)).
The location is excellent, one can see the Jet d'Eau from the window (if you lean a little :), and get to the lake in 30 seconds. Lots of restaurants and small shops around; bus stop (25 & 1) practically at your doorstep, walking distance (5-6 minutes) to Cornavin. Good for exploration & quite functional.
One little caveat: there is no dedicated space to work (only the dining table and chairs, which are not that comfortable if you have to sit & do home office for several hours), with no reading lights/desk lamp to facilitate concentration. However, it's convenient enough for checking e-mails/brief surfing sessions as needed & nice to come "home", cook a simple meal & hang out on the beautiful couch!
Overall good value for money and David was super flexible in allowing me to book & check-in the same day at almost zero notice after another booking fell through last minute. Thanks a lot for everything!

Appartement sous les toits avec beaucoup de charme, entièrement équipé et idéalement situé. Accueil très sympathique ! Je recommande cet appartement même pour un séjour relativement long, pour une personne.
Comfortable apartment in a great location.
Nice room close to the train station  and the center of the city. Good communication. Good place to stay

You will feel home from the moment you get in! Located in the heart of Paquis, you will have so many choices of bars and restaurants and shops nearby, some open all day, every day!  You can walk everywhere but you also have the choice of public transportation and the lake mouettes (public boats).  You will not regret choosing this beautiful studio for your Geneva visit.

This was the first time I have ever had an issue with an airbnb. The apartment was filthy! After I contacted the host to complain, he said he would send someone to clean. He did, but the person only cleaned the worst corners, which had been photographed and sent with my complaint (e.g. mold in the shower), instead of the whole apartment, which remained unhygienic. The cleaner also left her trash in the apartment. I left the apartment and cancelled the rest of my stay.
muy buena ubicación me fascinó
Nice comfy studio in Geneva. The studio looks like the photos and David was a good Host.
I spent three months in the apartement Jan–Apr 2023. Location is great and everything went as expected. Apartement was clean and David was very helpful throughout my stay.

The overall apartment is basically what is advertised, the place is cozy and has everything you need. The location is one of the best in Geneva, even if it can get a bit crowded at times.
In terms of pricing, the market right now seems to be inflated, so I do believe that it is an expensive place, but when comparing it to other similar places it is one of the better offers, just the overall market is expensive in my opinion.
The one issue I did have with the place was the shower, specifically the glass sliding doors to get in, they were not very well built/maintained, they fell apart pretty easy.
Everything else was fine, it was a decent little place for me to have spent a little over 6 weeks in.

Super helpful and friendly hosts, place is a bit worn but great amenities for a long stay (I was there 1.5 months) including a washing machine. Flat could have done with a deep clean for it to be really clean, but important bits were all fine. Kitchen was very well equipped, too. Overall, great experience and stay right in the centre of Geneva.
Très bon séjour dans l’appartement, super appartement de transition pour mon arrivée sur Genève

Un bon séjour à Genève en famille. Appartement propre et cuisine bien équipée. Le seule problème c'était le bruit du cabaret la nuit, mais rien de très grave sinon. Hôte toujours disponible pour communiquer en cas de problème...Merci beacoup. L'appartement est très bien situer au centre ville, gare, transports, commerces et à proximité du lac. On reviendra c'est sûr !
The Studio is very clean and located right in the center of the city. The only thing that disturbs a little is the disco downstairs that keeps the music high until 5 am.
The mongolian jourt is amazing and super comfortable!
Beautiful yurt set in an amazing garden. An adventure for adults and kids
I loved staying in the yurt, it was really cheap and close to everything especially the airport.
Great stay! Thank you Séverine & Alban
We stayed for one night, the yurt was perfect for the four of us for one night. Severine was very helpful and quick to respond to questions. Highly recommend
Agréable parenthèse, dépaysante et surprenante, un peu proche de l’aéroport pour oublier complètement la civilisation
First time experience staying at a Mongolian Yurt, we were excited, enjoyed the private garden too.  Wonderful overall value.
很漂亮的一个私人大花园就在教堂后面，环境很好，房东还有好多果树，早餐也很丰盛，总之我推荐这里。
Nous étions 4. L'ambiance était vraiment sympa! Ça dépayse juste en entrant dans la yurt. La deco est super joli, nous avons hâte de revenir! N'hésitez plus et foncez!

Absolutely amazing and unique place to stay just minutes from the airport. Quiet and relaxing and very comfortable beds in the yurt. I really can't say enough good things. We loved it.
If you happen to missing your dogs too like I was you will be happy to know the host has 2 and they are adorable. One loves balls and one loves food.

Communication: When we couldn't enter the entry and I wrote Séverine, she immediately gave us the correct code and the rest was perfectly communicated via Email.

OVERALL: The location was amazing probalbly even more in Summer

是位于市中心的整套公寓，位置很好。有电梯，拿行李很方便，房子有两个卫生间，减少了洗澡排队的时间。最主要的是房间里有空调，晚上睡觉很凉快，不巧的是正好安排到了瑞士国庆这一天，周边的店铺都放假休息了，白天只能在日内瓦湖周边闲逛

Great location near the old town, lake, and tram. We booked it for our party of six because it was air conditioned , and the air conditioning was great.   Loved having a hotel receptionist on the property to help us and give us advice. Clean, spacious, good value.

This place is perfectly located! 10/5 for location! We had plenty of restaurants, shopping, and even a farmers market down the hill. Short walk from the waterfront and transit - even includes transportation pass.

Great location. Walking distance to all the main attractions. Four of us are travelling and the apartment was spacious and perfect for us. Christine was an extremely great host and one of the most helpful when we had a problem with our arrival time. I would highly recommend this property.
I highly recommend Christine's place. It is centrally located and easily walkable to many places in Geneva. It was clean and very spacious! Great communication as well!

Christine was a wonderful host. She was very helpful and friendly. She went above and beyond her duties to take care of us. I highly recommend this place.

Great spot - centrally located to all the shopping and restaurants. Would stay here again - secure building with nice views as well.
Place was good. Easy convenient
Very nice apartment in central Geneva in a hotel with reception that is always there and available. No issues and the apartment was beautiful.
Super central and convenient, large rooms, parking is a challenge but overall great place to stay in Geneva.
Great apartment within the Hotel Central. Perfect location to shopping and restaurants. 3 bedrooms and plenty of space for 5 adults.

We had a wonderful stay at this apartment. It was exactly as described, the location was perfect. I plan on returning to the lovely city of Geneva in the future and will hopefully stay at this apartment. Thank you!
I highly recommend this apartment.
Great place with lots to do!
Very spacious and conveniently located apartment. Some morning construction noise for the two rooms facing the street, but not a big issue for us with a short stay. Worked well for our group.
Wonderful clean and comfortable place, good location, responsive and very helpful host.  Would definitely stay again. Thank you!

Christine’s Airbnb was clean, well equipped and spacious. The location was perfect. Although we only had a one night stay, we found it convenient to everything. The staff was more than accommodating and welcoming. There was more than enough room for everyone. We enjoyed our stay and would absolutely stay there again!
We love this place. It is a very convenient location. Close to every where that we wanted to visit. Transportation is easy and very convenient.
Wonderful stay. So helpful and flexible with our larger group. Would stay here again.
Christine’s place is right in the middle of shopping street. We are family of 6 with grannies & 3 years old. Everything is nice and we feel like home. The reception is very helpful.

Everything was exactly as expected/hoped for. We felt at home and enjoyed our week-long stay. Everyone was friendly and helpful. The kitchen was large, with enough counter space and a full-size oven. The location was fabulous; so close to everything that we never used the free public transport pass from the city. If we are ever in Geneva again, we will stay here!

Central location with outstanding access to the city. The host provided excellent communication. I should have read it all. I was happily surprised with clean towels and hotel service each day. Unlike other Airbnb's, you don't need to buy basic supplies for the extended stay.
Washer and dryer are crucial for easy travel. We put these to good use. The apartment is large with a fully functional kitchen. We cooked an elaborate meal here one night.
The fee for this rental included a transportation card for each of us. It was easy to access and super convenient. Every Airbnb should consider this amenity.
The apartment is in the center of the city. If you want peace and quiet, this is not your place. If you want central action with a lot of space and an excellent host, this is your place.
Fantastic location, in the heart of Geneva! Would book again.
Well located, clean and good value listing. Host is very responsive and helpful
Excellent location that is mins walk to the main shopping area and lots of food options around. Clean, pleasant and comfortable to stay in.
In a great location, close to restaurants, bars and the heart of old town. Apartment is spacious, had everything we required and very clean!
Todo tal cual como se describe en el anuncio. Zona tranquila, transporte público cercano, limpio. Definitivamente volveríamos.

Our stay at Christine's place was excellent! It's very spacious with enough bedrooms and bathrooms for our entire family. We would absolutely stay here again!
We absolutely loved it!!
Big apartment in excellent location. Check in via the hotel is perfect.

Just as expected - great location as it was a few steps from old town.  Lots of room to spread out for me & my family.

Christine is an amazing host. We arrived in Geneva after an overnight flight from Canada, the host from our original Airbnb booking was unresponsive and would not send check-in instructions. Upon arriving at the apartment, Christine gave us a tour and gave us a lot of recommendations of where to park, what to do, and where to eat in the area. She was so friendly and helpful. The apartment is spacious and squeaky clean. It looks exactly like the pictures. It was the perfect space for our family of five.
Great location in the heart of old Geneva. Really convenient walk around and find plenty to do with lots of restaurants around. The apartment was great and very comfortable for 6 people.
Great stay, very spacious and had cleaners come daily for fresh towels and to clean appartment 👍🏼

Right in the center of location. City so the noise is pretty loud. Furnitures looked old and smelled. The whole place was pretty stinky but the staff sprayed the air refresher for us each time. Lots of bathrooms/beds- good for big group if you want to budget.

Mieszkanie ogromne, ładniejsze niż na zdjęciach, idealnie w centrum, wszędzie blisko, ale jednocześnie cicho i spokojnie. This property is actually an apartment-style hotel. That worked out perfectly for us since there was a responsive front desk when we needed them (note: it's not a 24hr desk). We also got free Geneva public transport cards via the hotel.
Christine and her staff were proactive in their communications with us and very responsive. The apartment perfectly fit the needs of our group. Geneva is a small city, so the apartment itself was walkable to many restaurants, cafes, shops, and public transit. We were there a short while, but it was a lovely stay.

A great and spacious apartment in the heart of Geneva. Just a few meters away from the river Rhone, it is in walking distance from just about everything worthwhile in Geneva. The rooms were clean with nice comfortable furniture. Plenty of space in all rooms and overall a very characteristic Swiss old-style feel to the place.The check-in was easy through the hotel reception (the apartment is basically part of a hotel), but overall the privacy of your own apartment. I would definitively recommend this apartment if you want to stay for a number of days in Geneva.
地點超級好~ 下樓就是百貨公司

The apartment is linked with Hotel Central so you get the amenities of having someone at the front desk for check-in and assistance, cleaning, etc. Out of all the apartments I have stayed at in Europe this was by far the most spacious. Very nice, great blackout curtains and a street back from the main area so quiet at night but close to everything and walkable. Would highly recommend.

My friends and I stayed here for one night, but would have loved to stay longer! It was very spacious inside and a close walk to everything we wanted to do. The host was very responsive and helpful. Would recommend!

If our time in town was much longer, we would have loved to stay at this Airbnb for many days. The hotel had all the necessary accommodations and then some. Close to many restaurants and shops in center city, plus very easy to get into unit after hours. Would 100% stay here again.
Really special place so close to Genève city but also so bohemian and relaxed

une bonne expérience la yourte est très belle. C'est assez spartiate, ça va pour une nuit mais je ne ferais pas plus.

the yurt is awesome! it's very comfortable and clean. Besides Severino and Alan are super nice and they will help you with anything you need.
Great stay, beautiful location. kids loved all the rabbits and all the space. Perfect for a short stay in Geneva.

Séverine ist eine sehr nette, naturverbundene und vor allem unkomplizierte Gastgeberin. Die Kommunikation mit ihr ist sehr gut und schnell.
Eine Nacht in ihrer schönen und großen Jurte ist ein Erlebnis für sich. Der Garten, den wir auch nutzen durften, ist riesig, naturbelassen uns schön angelegt. Unsere Kinder hatten sehr viel Spaß und für uns alle war die Nacht ein Abenteuer. Man erreicht das Zentrum schnell über Öffis.
Alles in allen eine sehr gelungene Herberge für alle Genf-Besucher, die auf "zivilisatorischen" Schnick-Schnack wie WLAN und fließendes Wasser verzichten können oder das bewusst wollen. Was hier geboten wird ist die Reduktion auf das Wesentliche, und das sehr geschmackvoll und gelungen. Absolute Weiterempfehlung.
位置离机场很近，环境很好，有几只小兔子和一只很可爱的狗狗，谢谢房东准备的餐点

Comme nous sommes arrivés tard, nous n'avons pas eu l'occasion de rencontrer Séverine. Malgré cela, nous nous sommes sentis merveilleusement bien accueillis. Nous remercions Séverine pour la qualité de l'accueil et de la prestation. Une superbe nuit! Nous en gardons un magnifique souvenir!

Fabulous spot, hidden away so you don't feel like you're in the city! Incredibly comfortable with a surprise breakfast box to help us on our way with our early start! From the cleanliness and location to the comfort and communication plus the bonus little touches.

An absolute gem. If you are ready to disconnect from your current reality, this is the place. A total edén. My group and I had the best night of sleep we had in years. I look forward to my return. Great, easy communication. Thank you for creating such a beautiful space!

Séjour très court pour une nuit avant de me rendre à l'aéroport, accessible en 20 mn en tramway+bus à 3mn à pied.

Séjour atypique que nous recommandons fortement ! Excellente expérience avec nos jeunes enfants en famille, ils ont adoré ! Jurte war sehr gross und sauber, aber etwas spartanisch eingerichtet: kein Abfalleimer. Riesiger Garten. Das Frühstück war ziemlich einfach (Nescafé/Tee, weiche Brötchen und Ahornsirup). Für einen Tag spannend und schön, für länger eher nicht.

We loved staying in the yurt, and in the magical garden surrounding it. It worked very well for us for a couple of days in Geneva as it is well located for both the airport and city centre. The planes were a little noisy overhead, but that’s what comes of sleeping in a garden close to an airport!

Our hosts were very communicative and helpful - gave us all the information we needed and were flexible with bags & times to accommodate our flights.

The reception staff were very helpful with recommendations for breakfast venues and trams to get to the airport for our return journey.
The beds were comfortable and whilst there is some building work very close by, the supplied ear plugs weren’t needed as the workmen didn’t work weekends..
Very convenient, and clean. House is enough to live 5-6 people

The room was great — clean, cozy, and perfect for our family. It’s part of Hotel Central, so there’s a reception nearby, which was super convenient.
The location is excellent — right in the heart of the city, we could walk everywhere, and there’s a nice playground just a short walk away.
There was a spot to drop off luggage, but I couldn’t leave the car long enough to help bring the bags up. All paid parking nearby was full. As the only young man in a family of women, elderly, and a small child, I could only unload the bags quickly and drive off to avoid a fine. My family had to check in on the 6th floor alone. Even with an elevator, moving four large suitcases and lots of stuff was really tough for one woman, a toddler, and two seniors.
One small suggestion: it would be even better if there were a few more toys for kids.
Overall, we had a very pleasant stay!
Spacious, clean apartment! The beds were comfortable and showers hot. We appreciated having a washer and dryer and helpful reception staff to answer any questions.

We had a lovely stay. We could walk everywhere, the main train station was about a 15 minutes walk. Lots of great restaurants around. The home was just like the photos and perfect for our family of four. Thank you!

Loved the location, loved the space and cleanliness.

We had a fantastic stay at this Airbnb in Geneva!
