The apartment itself is spacious and beautiful, with three bedrooms, two bathrooms, a large kitchen, and a big living room. It’s on the sixth floor, and everything felt clean, modern, and incredibly comfortable.
Our family of five had more than enough room to spread out and relax. The air conditioning was a huge plus, and the location was ideal — central, walkable, and close to everything we needed. The hosts were kind, responsive, and genuinely welcoming.

Great place for my family of 6. Perfect ending to spend half day seeing highlights of Geneva before catching a plane home.

The apartment had a/c which is a big plus for a hot summer day! Plus a little chocolate next to the bed - letting you know you have arrived in Switzerland!

A beautiful apartment, clean and lots of space for our group of six.  The only drawback was parking for our oversized van, which we knew about before booking.  We were lucky to find a spot outside the building.  The receptionist was very friendly and helped. We would stay here again!

This was a perfect place to stay for our first time in Geneva! The apartment had all of the necessary amenities and was in a fantastic location. We were within walking distance of multiple restaurants, chocolate/gelato shops, as well as the bus/metro system.
If/when we go back to Geneva, we will absolutely be looking to stay here again.

We really loved the style of the apartment, that it looked very homely and welcoming! It had great nicknacks around the place, books, dvds etc. It was very well equipped kitchen, really nice space to chill out and great location, a nice view of the jet d’eau from the bedroom and balcony.
L'appartement de Philippe est très sympa et très bien décoré. L'appartement est chaleureux et très lumineux.

We were 4 staying for 3 nights in Geneva. The apartment has major issues. The following were the problems:
1. The rooms are small. Not enough space to keep your suitcases.
2. The house decor makes the house crowded and not easy to move about.
3. The house does not have any lighting on the ceiling. All the lighting is based on lamps which makes the space very dimly lit.
4. The beds are very small for 2 to sleep in it.
5. The floors are creaking and make lot of noise when you walk
6. One of the shower areas is very small to have a bath and is unusable
7. One of the WC area is very small and unusable.
8. Kitchen utensils need to be washed before using
9. Linen cover seemed to be old and used.
10. Can hear noises from conversations from other apartment at night when sleeping.
Definitely not meant for families. May be ok for bachelors or backpackers. Philippe was polite and helpful. The house is stoked with some food for use.

Nice apartment, convenient to public bus, several convenient cafes within a minute's walk. The apartment is on the top floor of the building, but it has a (small) elevator to get you there. Some fun decorations from, what, the 70s but the important parts are all modern enough. Felt like staying at a friend's place. Recommended.

It was an amazing place and Philippe is such an excellent communicator. I had demands as baby cot and chair and all was provided. The place itself felt truly like a home and it is spotless !!! Truly amazing !!!
You will not be disappointed.  The value is tremendous.  The service exceptional.  Philippe is a gem!

The flat is vintage style and very clean. At beginning a couple of lights in the living room were not working but Philippe was nice and sorted it out immediately. Communication was smooth and very rapid

Philippe’s apartment was great. Great location, really spacious apartment, near city center by walk and on a great neighborhood. Philippe was there at all times in case we needed anything. Had the chance to meet him on our way out, great guy! Would definitely recommend!
Wonderful apartment. Great location absolutely perfect and Philippe had everything set for us. Highly recommend.

Philippe’s place is very comfortable and stylish.  The deck space and the windows are quite spectacular with the views.  The neighborhood is a fun one, and not unreasonably loud, and quite safe.  We loved everything here and hope we can stay again when work or pleasure brings us to Geneva!
It was a nice stay.
Great communication and instructions from Philippe.  Great location and lovely view of the Jet from the balcony.

Stayed in apartment in eaux vives area. Modern design and spacious. Great location; city centre, lake, restaurants, shops are just walking distance. Great view of jet d’eau from the balcony!!! Would love to stay in this place again next time in Geneva!

Great place!! I´ll come back next year for sure!

Excelente alojamiento y  atención. Apartamento espacioso, bien amueblado y con una gran ubicación. Recomiendo al 100%.

The hosts are very responsive and hospitable. I think the house has a lot of character and I like the farm. There are cats, chickens, and dogs. It’s very cute.

The walls in the house are very thin, so I could hear everything in the kitchen, which I was directly next to. And I’m sure other guests could hear me as well. The dog is very loud and can bark continuously for 30 minutes to an hour in the morning. The Wi-Fi is extremely spotty. There’s no microwave or TV. The plumbing is not great in terms of the shower’s water pressure or temperature. And the toilet is waterless, which makes it smell bad. I also never got a key to lock my bedroom. The insulation is poor, so my room was often cold. The house is also inhabited by 10 other people, which can be a lot.
I prefer a lot more privacy. I think the place has a charm. I just don’t think it’s for me. The hosts are very nice and sociable.
A warm and welcoming, multi-cultural, secluded and quiet hideaway in the heart of Geneva.

séjour vraiment affreux je n'ai pas eu la chambre souhaité car apparemment quelqu'un était déjà dedans alors que j'avais louer la chambre et n'ayant pas beaucoup de finance j'ai du me résoudre a resté

fantastic house !!! fantastic hosts. always helpfull and interested in a nice chat.  perfect situated for both: geneva downtown and my place of work. i highly appreciated the offer of coffee and tea, the access to kitchen and the stylish living room either.

在日内瓦度过了完美的九天时间！Brigitte人特别好！交通非常方便，设施齐全，房间也打扫的一尘不染！如果大家选择来日内瓦，一定要来这里！

Beautiful house and garden in a park-like setting, super convenient to public transport, everything you could possibly want in a kitchen, plus a super-nice host and helpful long-term housemates. Le logement est parfait pour un séjour à Genève : très propre, confortable et entièrement conforme à l’annonce. L’emplacement est idéal, proche des transports et des commodités, tout en restant calme.​

Nous avons passé un excellent séjour et nous recommandons vivement ce logement à tous ceux qui viennent à Genève. Nous y reviendrons avec plaisir.
Excellent apartment in the heart of Geneva’s old town. Would stay again.

My friends and I stayed at Philippe's condo, and we had a great time! The space looked just like the photos and was just what our group needed. Overall, we had a wonderful time in Switzerland, and we are incredibly grateful for our hosts and their space!
L'emplacement est central et les hôtes sont très accueillants!
L'apartament és exactament com a les fotos, ens hi hem trobat com a casa i la ubicació és inmillorable i molt tranquila.

Ich kann allen Gästen diese Wohnung weiterempfehlen.

Philippe's apartment was great! It is comfortable and well designed for two people to stay. We really liked the bed and pillows. A couple of things to be aware of for some folks are you need to walk up (a cute spiral staircase) to the fourth floor apartment, and you can hear convivial sounds in the evening from the below restaurants if the windows are open, but we considered that part of the ambiance of being in this appealing part of Geneva.

Apartment is awesome.
Great location.

I'll definitely recommend.

This is a very nice modern apartment which is entirely renovated and decorated with a high degree of taste . It is  sparkling clean and very well equipped and no detail is left unattended. The place is very welcoming and Jean- Luc lives up to his level as indeed a super host. Book and enjoy with confidence as I sure did!

Beautiful and very spacious apartment! Absolutely perfect with young children and a great outdoor area that is very enjoyable in summer. Iva and her husband were perfect hosts, very quick to respond to emails and queries and very hospitable. Iva set up a cot for our baby at our request and everything was ready and very clean when we arrived. A very nice stay! We highly recommend this place especially for families travelling with young children. Walking distance to the park, a local shops not far away. Tram and bus also walking distance to the apartment. Would definitely stay again if coming to Geneva in the future. Thank you Iva and Tomas for letting us stay in and enjoy your beautiful home!

Iva's place is well located, spacious and well equipped. Check-in was very smooth, any questions during the stay were quickly answered. The big plus for us was the garden, our family really enjoyed it. The salon is huge and the kitchen is very well equipped. We felt like home. Thank you Iva.

This was the perfect place for our family to finish off our 3 1/2 week adventure around Europe! It’s not right in the heart of the city but it’s close enough and away from the noise! It was clean, comfy and provided lots of space especially for our 3 year old to run around, play with toys and be out in a yard! A bonus is the parking spot, very rare in Europe! Thank you Iva for opening your home to our family, we’re very grateful!

Iva's place is a pure paradise, for adults and children. Adults immediately love the central location (10 min bicycle ride to the absolute centre of time); the stylish design of the appartment, including the very well equipped kitchen. Children immediately notice the seemingly endless supply of toys, books in multiple languages and the trampoline and balls in the garden. Iva was most flexible in accommodating our special wishes and very responsive to our multiple questions. All of us would love to come back!
awesome duplex and hospitality! when you travel but you really feel like at home ❤️

We had a great stay at this apartment.  It is roomy and well-furnished.  The kitchen had all the things necessary for cooking and the beds were comfortable.  We especially appreciated the kid's activities in the house, our sons enjoyed the trampoline and scooters in the backyard and the marble run downstairs.
The house was generally quiet, we did not hear any noise from the neighbors, but there can be noise from outside -- due to construction on the large road down the hill more people were using this road and the scooters can be quite noisy.  I imagine this small street would usually be very quiet.

A stunning and very spacious apartment with a great garden to enjoy! We absolutely loved our time there, the living room being a real highlight with its high ceilings, contemporary and spacious open-plan design.
Despite the very very hot weather, the apartment was remarkably cool, aided by the wooden floors in every room. It was a real bonus that the beautiful park was so close by, and the lake too. Early morning swims were brilliant!
Our hosts were incredibly kind and nothing seemed to be too much trouble. We would love to go back and stay there when we’re next in Geneva!

Iva's apartment is much larger than we expected, our family of four had plenty of space for a week long vacation, and the garden / patio made a big difference in the hot weather. The apartment is stylish and the location is perfect to explore Geneve. We had a few travel problems getting there, but Iva was very understanding and flexible, and always responded quickly to any questions we had.
So many places to visit; relax in Parc La Grange and go and find the remains of the Roman Villa. The beach and swimming at Baby-Plage is only a 10 minute walk, or try the Blain-Bleu spa for swimming pools, sea swimming and more. Great music and shows were at the Float Inn location bateaux. See if you can hire a boat to motor round the lake ... We also went to Cern, the Patek Philippe museum ($1bn worth of watches on display), went underground at the Cathedral. Places we ran out of time to visit ... Yvoire, Annesse ... so much to do. Stay at Ivas place, perfect location and enjoy.

Maison très spacieuse, très agréable et très bien équipée pour des enfants. Très bien placée dans Genève. Nous avons été ravi de notre séjour et de l accueil d Iva. Nous conseillons très vivement la maison aux autres voyageurs

Iva was super helpful both with tips on where to go but also in communication throughout and prior to our stay.  Her home was superbly clean and well adapted for young kids with lots of toys and space for them to play and enjoy. We would stay again without a doubt.

The apartment is a lovely space, it is light and airy and very good for a small family. Plenty of space and very well equipped. The garden was a real bonus. The lake and grange park are an easy and pleasant walk away. Plenty for young kids. Fantastic!

Wir verbrachten als Familie mit 3 Kindern (14, 12, 8) vier wundervolle Tage in Ivas Wohnung. Die Unterkunft ist super gelegen und entspricht der Beschreibung.

Great host. Nice and clean apartment with beautiful garden.

We would return in a heartbeat— HIGHLY recommend!!! Thank you again Iva for everything!

Good amenities, clean environment, strong wifi and huge place. Overall, a comfortable place to stay in. Might be slight noisy as it is located at ground floor.

L’appartement est très agréable, bien décoré et avec du charme. Il était également propre.
La communication avec Giulia était facile et Giulia était disponible pour répondre aux questions. Excellent séjour !

Lovely place to stay, very clean and well set up apartment, short walk to the convention centre and to town and local buses. Would highly recommend! I had friends that stayed in hotels that were much more expensive and they were very dissatisfied, so very happy to have found this gem! And Guilia is very communicative and helpful.
Terrific place in great location. Communicative host and clean apartment. Overall, A++ !!!

The space was very clean and the furniture was well situated. Apartment is well situated in the city. The check-in process was very clear as was the check-out, and all other aspects of the living experience were supplemented with a clear document recieved a day before the booking. Overall, a great experience!
Great house and strongly recommend for stay.

Great communication and a lovely space to explore Geneva.
Kitchen was very handy as we could feed the little one.
Great clean place with all the needed facilities nearby

it’s situated on the ground floor so it may be a bit noisy and you might feel unsafe. Sometimes you hear the neighbors as well. But actually the place was very safe.
There are stairs (five, six steps) behind the entrance, so I had a little bit difficulty when my daughter fell asleep in a baby stroller.
Giulia is very helpful and flexible, she answers quickly when you have questions. And I really appreciate her early checkin/late checkout arrangement!
A comfortable apartment in a great location
Unfortunately I couldn't attend due to flight cancellation.

A wonderful place for UN, ITU, WHO, UNHCR... conference participant, its take about 10 min to walk.
abour 1km to the Gare conavine, Lake de Geneva and downtown.
Quite and comfortable apartment.
Spacious and great location.  Easy access and supermarket directly across street and very responsive to any questions I may have.
Great place to stay!  Giulia was a very gracious host. Highly recommended.

I had a great stay at Giulia’s flat. The apartment is spacious, very clean and has a fully equipped kitchen. It is also centrally located so you can easily access shops, restaurants and public transportation. Giulia is indeed a super host. She is very kind, helpful and easy to reach. I had everything I needed during my stay including the smallest things such as adapters, toothpaste, etc. At the end, it was a very positive experience. Highly recommended.
Very well located, nice place to stay - recommend even with small child :)
The perfect location for my work trip to the UN, the apartment was fully equipped, check in couldn't have been easier and Giulia was on hand to help when I needed. A really great find in Geneva!

The apartment is great: well located ( bus, shops and not far from the United Nations), well furnished and cosy. Giulia was quick to respond and very helpful. I will not hesitate to come back when I am in Geneva.

Giulia is extremely detailed in ensuring the stay went smoothly. You have everything you need in the apartment - a Nespresso machine (with capsules provided), pots, cutlery, kettle, cups, detergents, soaps, cleaning kits, clothing rack, desk lamps, and even a baby chair! Water pressure is powerful, comes with a rain shower. Kitchen appliances are well maintained. Bed is comfortable. For those who are particular about noise, rest assured that it's very very quiet. Location wise, direct bus 8 to main train station Cornavin / Nations (opposite direction). 5 minutes walk to the nearest tram station (trams 14/18). Supermarket is just across the road - if you are looking for one that is bigger, Coop is nearby (5mins walk).
We stayed just short of a month.  The apartment quickly felt like home.  The location is fantastic with many amenities including the park a short walk away.

Excelente lugar para hospedagem, me senti em casa! Perto de tudo e casa completa! O banheiro renovado foi uma diferença no local! Giulia é uma super host! Sempre disposta a ajudar e responde rápido nossas dúvidas! Super recomendo!

Giulia’s apartment is really a home away from home. If you’re working in Geneva for a few days or weeks the apartment is great. Its a great base to explore the city from. The apartment has everything you need. And Giulia is super helpful. I’ll be back next time I’m in town.

Spacious, cozy apartment (with a fully equipped kitchen and a washing machine in the basement) located in a strategic position. Very good communication with the host. Highly recommended accommodation for short-term and long-term stays.
Excellent location, very functional apartment, calm despite being on the ground floor. Smooth communication with Giulia. I recommend
The apartment is just as described and Giulia was helpful and charming whenever I needed assistance. I really enjoyed my stay.
This is the second time I am staying at Giulia’s. I love the place- super clean, well stocked, comfortable bed, and great location.
Giulia and her husband are very nice hosts, the apartment is comfortable, clean, and has a very good location! Check in & check out: easy. I would come back again!
This is an amazing place to stay when I was in Geneva for work. Perfectly clean, perfect location and great communication from Giulia.  100% recommend and will be a back when I’m next in town
Overall, a very pleasant stay.

Giulia’s place was perfect!
It was very clean, all essentials were available, from the kitchen to the bathroom, even a baby chair and baby soap which was a great surprise! The place is nicely located and is actually bigger than it looks like in the photos.
Giulia was a great communicator and checking-in was extremely simple!
I would gladly rent Giulia’s place again in the future.

The place was clean and it was easy to find as well as checking in was a breeze. Giulia was very responsive. The place was very close to WIPO where I had a week of work. Definitely would recommend to anyone travelling to Geneva!
Excellent location for those visiting Geneva …  close to all ammenities as well as public transport.  Well equipped for a short stay. Can certainly recommend …Anne and Howard/ Australia

The location was great, close to a gym, groceries and walking distance from many of the UN orgs.  It was also not far from the train station (about 15 min walk) and was nicely heated during the cold snap while I was there so was perfect. The space was nice, the bathroom and kitchen had all essentials and the check in was really easy (very good instructions).  Couldn't ask for any more for a work trip of 10 days to Geneva!

Lovely apartment, felt very cosy and homely. I was in Geneva for a 12 night stay and this was so much nicer than staying in a hotel. The kitchen was well equipped, and the sofa and bed very comfortable. The apartment is in a very handy location, easy to walk to my office and only 10mins from Cornavin with a supermarket and restaurants all near by. Giulia was a great host and I can highly recommend this place and would definitely stay again.

Das Appartement war sehr gemütlich, sauber und sehr gut ausgestattet. Es gab sogar nespresso Kapseln zum Kaffee machen. Ich habe mich sehr wohl gefühlt. Vor allem praktisch war dass die Bushaltestelle zum Bahnhof und zum Flughafen 2 min entfernt zu Fuß waren. Auch ein Supermarkt ist nur einen Sprung entfernt.
Es war sehr sauber.
Das einzige, was ich gerne vorher gewusst hätte, ist dass das Apartment im Erdgeschoss liegt. Ich war alleine unterwegs und finde es immer etwas gruselig so nah an der Straße zu sein.
Das Haus ist ein Altbau, daher auch sehr hübsch mit hohen Decken und echtholz Parkett, macht aber daher auch manchmal ein paar Geräusche Bzw ist relativ hellhörig. Im gesamten hat es mir sehr gut gefallen!
Giulia war eine sehr aufmerksame Gastgeberin, die bei Fragen und Problemen immer sofort reagiert und hilfreiche Lösungen angeborten hat.
Giulia was a great host and her apartment was everything as listed. Also in a good location and close to public transport
Great apartment, exactly as advertised and only about 7 mins walk from the CICG and Place des Nations.
Great location, looked exactly like on photos. Prefect for work and holiday stays.

Giulia’s place is great given its proximity to everything. It is exactly as listed , very clean, have everything you need and feels like home. I would definitely recommend it for anyone who would stay in Geneva and doesn’t have to worry about getting a comfortable stay. Thanks Giulia
Good location, comfortable living

Giulia was very helpful and kind in communicating, the Appartment was clean and perfect for a stay in Geneva - it is in walking distance to the UN buildings as well as to the beautiful lake. Can recommend this stay!

Excelente departamento, es tal cual como se describe, muy cómodo y con todo lo necesario para tener una estadía perfecta. Además está muy bien ubicado, al lado del supermercado, transporte público y caminando de la UN y estación de trenes.
Giulia siempre fue muy atenta y rápida para responder a todas mis inquietudes. Sin lugar a dudas me volvería a alojar en su departamento.
Everything was great, highly recommended

Stayed for the week at Giulia's place when attending a conference at the Conference Centre. It was a 5-minute walk and couldn't have been better located. The apartment was perfect and had everything we needed for a week's stay. A supermarket is over the road and a boulangerie just around the corner.

The place is strategically situated and within walking from all UN agencies. There is a supermarket right across the road and various public transport connections.
The only shortcomings was that there is no microwave )I worked very late and needed to warm up food), there was no cleaning service during my 2 week stay and I could not do laundry.
Other than the small shortcomings I would stay there again.
If you are at Geneva for a business trip nearby the UN complex, this place is great for staying.
Giulia's is very comfortable and is located close to supermarkets, cafes and bars. It is a short walk to trams into the city, and there are nearby buses to the airport. Highly recommend
Boa localização. Checkin fácil. Apartamento limpo. Sem reclamações.

The apartment looks better than in the pictures and has lots of provisions which made me feel right at home. The apartment is well located with several bus stops nearby and a supermarket across the street as well as many restaurants on the same block. Palais Nations as well as the train station are all within a walking distance. I enjoyed my stay and would definitely recommend Giulia’s place.
The apartment is great. The location is very convenient. Everything was clean and organized. The instructions were very simple and clear. I would definitely recommend this place!

I had a wonderful stay with Giulia and Fabien! The flat is perfectly located, within easy reach of major international organizations and other points of interest. (I walked to and from WHO each day, but there are also easy bus options.) The flat is extremely clean and practical, with shops and restaurants also nearby. Giulia and Fabien provide great information and were extremely responsive at all stages of the process. A great experience, and I hope to stay here again in the future!
Great stay in every way. Everything was great: clean, quiet, convenient, comfortable, very good internet, great host.

Amazing place for either short or long stay in Geneva. Very well connected, you have everything you need around you, less than 5 minutes away. The apartment was spotless, impressively clean, very well organised (I had a lot of clothes for aprox 1 month, and they all fit on hangers, kitchen very well equipped, small touches that are super useful and thoughtful. Heartfelt recommendation!
Tony's place is excellent. After about a dozen trips to Geneva, I have finally found a place I will stay again and again. Great host and excellent accommodations.

Quite simply, this was the most charming  AirBnB I have stayed in. Tranquil (apart from the distant pitter patter of the village water fountain), stylish and spotlessly clean, close to the airport and quick into town on the train - it was great. With an incredible breakfast offered - it was actually perfect! It was a great shame I had to go to a conference, I would have quite happily meandered down to the lakeside and pootled around the village....

Great place to stay! great breakfast and especially great hospitality!
Super recommended!

Toni was amazing from start to finish - very helpful with any queries and the place was clean, comfortable and tranquil. My boss used this during his business trip and he was so happy with everything. Thank you Toni!

Fantastic apartment and very friendly hosts.
Looking forward to returning again in the future.

Best host ever in airbnb...
Everyone will enjoy the stay for sure.
Great place and enormous hospitallity from very kind hosts!!

Super convenient for travel to the airport and Palexpo conference centre which we were visiting. The hosts are lovely, friendly, and welcoming. And their venue is gorgeous, all the rooms and large bathroom are to a high quality spec. The atmosphere is private and relaxed. We were given free travel cards (great touch) and had a lovely breakfast provided which we were left to enjoy. Clean, relaxed, quiet, comfortable.

I can't write enough about the incredible experience that I had at Toni and Muriel's place. The location itself is in a lovely area just a kilometre away from Palais de Nations. It is easily accessible by road, bus and rail, meaning I was easily able to make my meetings in a timely manner. More importantly, the location and its surroundings are lovely, and so peaceful, you can truly sit back and enjoy the serenity it has to offer, yet it is quaint enough to offer restaurants, cafes and even a little shopping mart.
Secondly, the Airbnb itself. Super clean, and truly magical. Toni is an architect, and it is clear to see the touches him and Muriel have made to this conversion. You have wooden floors, high ceilings, and a wonderfully comfortable bed and super bathroom all to yourself. I was on my own so never ventured into the second bedroom, but it also looks clean and comfortable. Lots of intricate touches such as the Singer sewing machine and the Espresso machine in the room make for a delightfully comfortable and eye pleasing experience.
I would be wrong if I didn't speak about the 3rd and most important factor - the hosts - Toni and Muriel are the nicest couple I have had a chance to meet - warm, friendly and always able to help. They have lived in Geneva for many years, so are very well placed to offer advice and tips for travel. I had the pleasure of dining with them the night I arrived, and I was really blown away by their sincerity. The breakfast they prepared was outstanding - lovely cheese, bread and jams, tastefully selected from local vendors. I must say I was pretty exhausted when I got to Geneva, looking for rest along with going to my meetings, Toni even set up Netflix for me to watch in the bedroom. He was really kind in offering to drop me to the airport in the early hours of the morning. Both of them are genuine people who I would love to meet again as friends.
Thank you both for a wonderful stay.
A great host, place and location. Quiet and also very convenient for Geneva

This was the best Airbnb stay I have had to date. The space is beautiful, stylish and clean set in the context of an old style Swiss village. Unusually, this stay includes a continental breakfast, with Muriel's amazing jams. Toni and Muriel are superhosts of note! Many thoughtful touches made this stay both charming and pleasurable.

This is a fabulous stay in Geneva... the photos are absolutely accurate, including the incredible bathroom. The breakfast is amazing, and the hospitality beyond lovely. An added bonus: this spot is 5 mins walk to the bus stop to the UN & 5 mins walk to the train into Geneva, so even more central than we thought but still peaceful. Just FYI for couples (and it may be google translation service that didn’t make it totally clear to me!) the apartment is on the first floor and not fully self contained, but this may be no bother for you and for work travel, a very lovely arrangement. The hosts really made our stay... so warm and friendly (and with excellent restaurant recommendations). Hard to find a better spot in Geneva!

Outstanding space, great location (15 mins from the city by train, very quiet), and some of the most hospitable hosts I have ever met. Being served breakfast every morning, even before an early morning flight, was really thoughtful and made our stay all the better.

What a wonderful host couple and beautiful home! We were welcomed and treated like family. Their only son also greeted us and was most helpful. Great location near the Geneva airport with free parking nearby (a rarity in Switzerland). They provided an absolutely delightful experience. My brother and joined them for communication and a great time together both evenings after we followed their excellent travel and destination recommendations and guidance. Their home is a converted monastery (and later grocery store) from the 1100's. They both lovingly restored their beautiful home including all the special touches. The stay included a wonderful breakfast in their home prepared with great care. If you ever have an opportunity- STAY THERE.

What a fantastic space!!
Easy to find and the hosts were so welcoming.
Travel card was a nice touch as was the delicious breakfast each morning.
The room itself is magnificent and a lot larger than I expected. It’s incredibly well appointed and the bathroom is fantastic. The whole place was immaculate and very clean.
I was made to feel so welcome and would book again.
I spent most of the week working in Geneva. It’s a 7min train ride and the station is a short 3-4 min walk from the house.

Antonio and Muriel were wonderful hosts. So warm and welcoming, providing us with a snack of local breads and cheeses upon our late-evening arrival. The space is beautiful and comfortable, with great amenities, and the house is in a lovely neighborhood and so convenient to the train. I highly recommend this place for anyone traveling for business or pleasure.

Antonio and Muriel’s place is a beautifully converted old building and the guest rooms are amazingly comfortable and spacious. The location is perfect for the UN neighbourhood. I was able to walk in every day (about 25-30 minutes walk to Appia) and the transport links are also excellent - the number 20 bus runs every 15 mins and takes under ten minutes to Appia, and the train station with links to central geneva is 2 minutes from the house.
The best thing about our stay was the incredible hospitality shown by Antonio and Muriel who are outstanding hosts and lovely people.
We had our toddler with us and she loved her stay, and Antonio and Muriel were wonderful with her.
Thoroughly recommended!!
Nous avons loué le logement pour 2 personnes âgées. Elles ont beaucoup apprécié l'accueil et la gentillesse des hôtes.

Nous avons été agréablement surpris par l’accueil très chaleureux de Toni et Muriel. Ils ont toujours été disponibles et à notre écoute durant notre séjour. Ils préparent le petit déjeuner le matin avec beaucoup d’attention et de convivialité. Leur maison est très agréable et décorée avec beaucoup de goût. Son emplacement est au top. À côté de la gare du petit village de chambesy à 7 min en train de geneve .
Très calme . Possibilité de se garer si vous venez en voiture.
Je recommande vivement.
Murielle and Antonio are amazing hosts ! The place is very nice, cozy and crystal clean. Breakfasts are tasty! The village itself is very beautiful too. I'm totally recommending this place
Lovely spacious, clean apartment. Owners on-site, prepare a nice breakfast each morning.

J’ai été très heureuse de passer quelques jours chez Antonio et Muriel. Leur accueil très chaleureux, leur attention au détail, le lieu plein d’âme et en même temps proche de tout ont rendu mon séjour exceptionnel !

Incredible experience. Close to the train, amazing breakfast and amazing company. Delicious and affordable restaurant recommendations. I know any time I am in Geneva, I will try to stay with Antonio first!!! They were so kind hearted and so helpful. The room itself is amazing, as is the entire building and it’s history. I am forever grateful.
Excellent location, quiet area, great people and hosts, Convenient and very nice breakfast!

Antonio and Muriel's place is amazing. Settled in a beautifully renovated house it has all the amenities for short and long-term stays. Two ample bedrooms and a huge and comfy bathroom made our stay super comfortable. The place is incredibly quiet by day and night as it is located in an incredible residential area.
Access to the city center is quick and easy. Cornavin central station is just two train stops away (10 min) and you can also reach Geneva's main points of interest by bus in only 10-15 minutes. The price includes a free transport card that can get you anywhere in the city. Noting the transportation costs in Geneva, this comes as a super saver.
The breakfast is incredible! There is a great variety of fruits, Swiss cheeses, bread, coffee, and delicious homemade jams. If you need to store your own food a big space in the fridge is provided.
The place itself is the best Airbnb I have been to. However, that does not account for the most important value and that is the warmth and hospitality of Antonio and Muriel. They are the best hosts I’ve met, always willing to share accurate recommendations to go around Geneva and touristic advice but, moreover, always willing to share great conversations and laughs. This was truly priceless.

What a lovely place to spend a few days while in Geneva!
I was there on business and our hosts made all of the efforts to make our lives easy. They helped with transport, reservations and activities. It was like visiting friends.
The rooms were very clean and comfortable. It’s a lovely home and well decorated.
Breakfast was so yummy and the company enjoyable.
We will definitely be back!
Great hosts and lovely well-appointed accommodation.
La gentillesse et la disponibilité de Muriel et Antonio ont été exceptionnelles ! La maison est très agréable et le petit-déjeuner est truffé de choses délicieuses. Un séjour parfait.

Toni and Muriel’s place is the perfect place to stay if you’re visiting Geneva. The apartment is very spacious, comfortable and well equipped. The hosts are welcoming and friendly, without being intrusive - we enjoyed chatting with them, and they offered helpful advice and suggestions about things to see and do.
The apartment is in a beautiful area, which is very quiet, but also easily accessible to the city by either train (2 stops) or bus (free public transport cards are issued by the hosts!). There are 2 good restaurants close by, so if you don’t feel like heading back into the city at the end of the day for dinner, there are good options.
If we return to Geneva, this is the place that we will stay!

An amazing gem near Geneva. Fantastic hosts and a great appartment. Public transport is very nearby, both to the Palexpo and downtown Geneva. But it is also a great walk to the city from this location, it brings you through nice towns, the United Nations, several missions and more. We had good chats, good guidance and lovely breakfast!

Booked the apartment for a 4-day business stay. Toni & his wife are very friendly and accommodating. The apartment is very close to the train station, just 2 stops (5min) from Geneva main station. The rooms are nice. Comfy beds and a big bathroom with great shower. The traffic outside can be heard but that was no big deal for our stay. I would stay here again. Thank you!
Excellent stay. Very nice hosts on site who make the experience feel like a quintessential bnb where you feel like invited guests within their home.
Amazing place- by far the nicest Airbnb I have stayed in!
Loved staying here.  Toni and his wife treat you like family.   Great location for work with Convenient access to both bus and train pickups.

This was the best AirBnB experience I have ever had. Toni and his wife were absolutely fantastic hosts - I will not be able to do them justice in this review!
The location is stunning - a very short bus or train ride from downtown geneva, the house is in a neighborhood that feels almost like it is in the countryside. Very green, old buildings, etc. The house has been beautifully renovated, and the two rooms and bathroom are all very spacious. Check-in and check-out were simple, and they were accommodating when we asked to arrive early. The hospitality was such a joy. Toni and his wife provided us breakfast and coffee each morning, they invited us to sit with them and have drinks outside, etc. We spent a lot of our time this week just sitting and talking with them. I would go back in a heartbeat, and I can't wait until next time I get to visit them!

Best Airbnb I have ever stayed at anywhere - and I have stayed at many. Antonio is a fantastic host and the place is amazing - simply a stunning house in a beautiful neighborhood. I really cannot say enough about how helpful and hospitable Antonio is - it makes all the difference. Wonderful place, Wonderful stay.
A házigazdák nagyon kedvesek, barátságosak, nagyon szívélyesen fogadják a vendégeket. Minden nap lehet velük beszélgetni, nagyon otthonossá tették az ottlétünket. Mindenben segítőkészek voltak.

A wonderful stay at this delightful converted old property - immaculately clean, charming hosts, and lovely location. The owners could not do enough to make me comfortable, and it was a joy meeting them. Thank you!

Wow, it's such a wonderful place that you must experience it yourself!
Toni and Muriel is the super best host that I have met in my 8 years' Airbnb experience, they are too good!
I felt I'm staying with my best friends in Geneva. We had so much talks, so much fun and so much laughs together! I feel like I'm leaving Switzerland when I'm leaving their wonderful home, although my Swiss journey has just started with Geneva...
Dear Toni & Muriel, words cannot express my appreciation for both of you, I'm so blessed for such a wonderful memory in my life with you! Thank you for everything again!
Please take care! I will come back!
With Love,
XiaoLing

I couldn't ask for any better place to stay at, short bus drive from the exhibition and airport 4 min train ride to Geneva center, location is amazing quiet and yet close to any tourists attraction as well, Host is great Def will go back.

Friendly host and hostess, sharing information and very knowledgeable about Geneva and its surroundings. Very accommodating. We mentioned what we prefer and the next day it was added to the breakfast table. Delicious and fresh breakfast, with a few special extras added. They even offered to drop us off at our meeting venues if necessary.
Antonio e Muriel sono due persone estremamente attente, disponibili e discrete. La qualita' del soggiorno ha indubbiamente superato le aspettative: 5 stelle a pochissimi minuti dal centro di Ginevra

I cannot recommend this place more! Muriel and Toni were wonderful hosts. The house was in a quiet, beautiful  area. The buses and trains were easy to navigate and Muriel was very helpful with advice about how to get around. The location was perfect and we could not have asked for better hosts.
Anne-lise & daniel’s place is very clean and comfortable
Excellent location for EBU event visit.  Wonderful view of the mountains.  Charming chalet.  Dive bar across the street.  Doesn't get better than this in Geneva.
Room is nice, Anne & Daniel are great. Will miss everything there!

Chambre chalet tres cosy et agréable. Les espaces commun sont très accessibles et confortables. Il y a 3 chambres dans le logement donc on cohabite avec d'autres voyageurs mais il y a de la place pour tout lz monde. Emplacement idéal pour palexpo et aéroport a pied. Bus facile a prendre pour le lac et le centre de Genève.

Anne-Lise and Daniel were an amazing superhost. Together they provided with a service beyond our own expectations.
As expensive as Geneva is, I was able to make a good breakfast and dinner throughout my stay. They made everything possible and were extremely fast in responding to messages and inquiries.
If you need a home away from home.. this is the place.
Bel espace proche de tout. Idéal lors de salon à Palexpo.
The room was very spacious and clean, Anne-Lise is very nice and kind.

Anne-Lise était très arrangeante pour la logistique et nous a fait parvenir les informations sur la ville!
La maison était très propre et proche des transports vers l'aéroport et le centre; juste un peu difficile de communiquer en anglais avec mon ami mais nous nous en sommes tous bien sortis finalement😁. Merci pour votre hospitalité et patience

Anne-Lise & Daniel are great hosts.  We arrive later than we expected and they still waited for us showing us around the house. The house has everything you need and it’s quite big for a family of 4.  Ann-Lise told me that this house can live up to 8 people in three different rooms.   The place is only 10 minutes drive or by bus to Geneva airport which was very convenient for us who take the early fly.  The bus station is just 5 minutes away from the house.  We took the bus and spent a lovely day in Geneva without worrying about parking.  We love to come back and stay here again when we take a fly departing from Geneva airport.
One of my favorite air B&B stays.  Anne-Lise is very helpful and friendly.  Glad to give my highest recommendation.
Anne-Lise and Daniel were very welcoming and explained all the house rules very clearly. The house was very clean and cozy and we would definitely stay here again!
Very close to the bus, clean and comfortable. Communication was very good, I would stay again.
Perfect place. Excellent and responsive hosts.
Great host. Amazing place. I would definitely recommend :)

Anne welcomes with a lot of kindness. Room is very clean. Blanket also.
Thank you.
Host war sehr zuvorkommend, entsprechend der umstände. Sehr gute Erreichbarkeit.
房东非常热情

Ann-Lise was an extremely kind, generous and helpful host. She regularly communicated with us to see if we needed help with anything. The location is near Palexpo and the airport, and just a few minutes walk from the bus stop. Also, the unit and rooms are incredible (the photos don't do the place justice). I stayed for 5 nights and it was extremely convenient as compared to staying at budget hotels, mainly thanks to the many amenities and the ability to whip up a quick meal. You have everything you could want for a few nights' stay (laundry machine, fully-functioning kitchen, fridge, electric kettle, iron and board, microwave and lots of plates, glasses, mugs and utensils. The beds were super comfy and the linen was fresh and clean. And if you need quick groceries, there's a small convenient store just downstairs. Overall, a great place to stay in Geneva!
Rien à redire, super accueillants et sympathiques. Je recommande les yeux fermés
Anne Lise was very helpful and flexible. When we missed our train connection to Geneva and arrived late after 11pm, she stayed up until 11.15pm to welcome us and let us in 🥰
Perfect place for your stay .
Apartment is as described, in a nice and quite neighborhood. Very close to supermarket and bus stop. Recommended place to stay.
Nice place, though a bit on a noisy road.

Un vrai trésor à côté de la Gare Cornavin. Studio agréable et bien aménagé—belle lumière, lit confortable et grand placard vide pour les affaires. Propreté impeccable. Hôte reactif au communications. je le conseille les yeux fermés!

This place is a gem—a half kilometer from the train station, right next to two grocery stores, an amazing Chinese restaurant and a portugese bakery with amazing “natal” tarts. The studio is attractive and comfortable—-much nicer than the photos. Nice light from the window, comfortable bed and small efficient kitchen with a table for four. Joao met me to let me in and show me the studio. He was awesome. This place is a class act at a reasonable price. Don’t pass it up (unless you’re reserving when I want it).

Emplacement parfait pour nous près de la gare. João nous a accueilli avant midi et nous avons beaucoup apprécié sa disponibilité. L'appartement est bien équipé et il y a assez d'espace de rangement. Personnellement, j'enlèverais certains items de décoration mais dans l'ensemble nous étions très satisfait.
Great location in Geneva, easy access to public transport, supermarkets, restaurants, just  about everything! Kind and cordial host, would definitely recommend and will be back!

There are pluses and minuses to this apartment.
Pluses: 1) excellent location in the old city, on the fourth floor of a nice old building, on a very quiet street with no noisy bars or restaurants. 2) very clean 3) fresh, minimalist decor.
Minuses: 1) It is not a "stunning duplex" but a very small studio apartment with a small loft platform for the bed. I would not recommend it for more that two people, even though the couch is a sofa bed. The loft is accessed via a very steep and narrow staircase. To access the bed you need to squeeze through a very narrow space between and under the rafters. The headroom in the loft is very low. I am 1.84cm tall and I could only stand up right next to bed. 2) There is only one tiny closet with a few hangers for clothes that is also packed with cleaning supplies. 3) The code for the wifi is hidden on the inside of the closet, I found it after looking for quite a while. 4) Checking in and out involves picking up a key from a convenience store. The only information provided by the host involves access codes to the building. The apartment is located in an area that is restricted to cars with a local resident permit. No information is provided as how to get to the apartment by car and where to park. I was traveling from Greece by car and the ferry boat was several hours late arriving in Italy. Concerned I would not arrive in Geneva by 12:30am when the convenience store was closing, I tried calling, texting and e-mailing the host in order to see whether the key could be left for me somewhere else so that I could have it when I arrived. The host finally replied by mail that nothing could be done. Faced with the prospect of being out on the street, I ended up driving for nine hours non-stop at maximum speed, in order to arrive before the store closed.

Through our text exchanges, of which I have substantial proof of, Lorena told us the following: that she is not a hotel and we should not expect anything from her, that she is a student who is trying her best, and that she is not our boss. To us, there is simply NO EXCUSE for this kind of ill-treatment and unpleasant behavior. First of all, we fully paid our fees way in advance and we sent several communications to Lorena prior to our scheduled check-in. Furthermore, AirBnB provides constant emails and notifications that remind both guests and hosts of any upcoming bookings which therefore makes it impossible to forget. Moreover, we are also students and employees who traveled halfway across the world, and yet we make sure to comply with our obligations. Above all else, we guests do not expect anything grand from AirBnB hosts except that we be communicated with constantly and be accorded with even the most basic respect and human decency that we deserve. If AirBnB hosts are not capable of that, we believe that they simply should NOT be on this platform. Hence, there is NO EXCUSE to justify this kind of behavior and response from Lorena. When Lorena finally arrived in Geneva an hour later than the time she told us she would arrive, she messaged us asking where we were and she told us that she cannot wait for us despite the fact that SHE was the one who was late. Because of this unfortunate situation, we had no other choice but to book another hotel which allowed us to check-in right away and cancel our booking with Lorena. We communicated with Lorena and politely asked her for a refund but she vehemently refused to do so, even going as far as telling us that she did not care if we booked another hotel. After several unsuccessful negotiations, we simply gave up. Luckily, we were able to get in touch with AirBnB and they provided us with a full refund. Hence, if you are thinking about booking this place, we strongly advise you NOT to. Please learn from our experience and instead, look for another host with better reviews or perhaps a hotel, if you can afford one. We have learned the hard way that sometimes, fleshing out a little more cash for accommodation is better than saving it and ending up getting more stressed than ever.

The airbnb market in Geneva is being taken over by companies or individuals "managing" apartments advertised on airbnb. This is yet another such case. If you are not too concerned about having the airbnb "experience" of actually meeting the host then this is the place for you. Of course, the fact that the agent takes a cut results in an inflated price, meaning that you are actually paying the price of an apartment that would/should, if advertised by the actual owner, have been lower (and more comparable to apartments in a lower price range). Don't expect much assistance/empathy either. When asked about borrowing a fan to cool the apartment down, it was explained to me that this was not possible and that the previous airbnb occupants had to purchase their own fans (during the heatwave that battered central Europe in July this year). As an airbnb veteran, that was the first time I received such response from a host.
The photos were mostly accurate. The apartment is quite lovely, even if there were issues with cleanliness. The kitchen is arguably the best room in the house (despite the giant hole left by the dishwasher that was removed - something that was not apparent from the photos). It would have, however, been useful to have been informed that the apartment was in the middle of a giant construction zone (or that Swiss construction workers work long hours, including on weekends). Be aware that a new train station is being built one block away from the apartment, and will be opening soon, with all the ensuing traffic that that will bring.

I consider myself a seasoned traveler and I am quite familiar with Airbnb as it has been one of my first choice option while traveling in the US and abroad. I have left numerous reviews and most of the time they are very positive because the hosts are playing by the rules. This is not the case here.
The first upsetting part was the moment I arrived in the building and realized it was a three floors walk up situation which is more like four floors if you take into account the steps that lead to the first set of stairs. Luckily I didn’t have a big suitcase so I managed to carry what I brought all the way up. However, if an older person rented this apartment, there is no way that they would be able to get to that floor without being exhausted, and having to stop numerous times before reaching the floor. The fact that this was never mentioned in the description is absolutely unacceptable and deceptive.
Once I entered the place, the smell that attacked my olfactive senses was awful. I looked all over the place to figure out where it came from, and I could not identify it except knowing that it was from the kitchen. It literally smelled like crushed bugs. Really gross.
The bedroom was fine, pretty clean and the bed was comfortable. That would be the only positive of this apartment. The living room was OK, as long as you take away the pubic hair or whatever hair extension that was on the floor behind the lamp by the couch. I took a picture of it and of course did not come close to it to identify what it was, but any normal housekeeper should have removed this. The fact that I paid for housekeeping service made me I feel pretty upset as I left the place probably as “clean” and tidy as I found it, however I certainly didn’t find it clean enough. And about that, a washing machine was in the bathroom with the front load glass so filthy that I can’t understand how this has been accepted by prior guests. Maybe they didn’t even look at it as most people don’t stay long enough to need to wash their clothes. I also took a picture of it in case anybody would ask. The bathtub was so high, that anyone over the age of 55 would have a hard time getting in or out without taking a risk of falling. This should have been described, or should have been planned by the owner of the apartment who should have added a system to get in and out without risking a bad accident. The water pressure was fine, however I was left with an empty bottle of shampoo probably from previous guests, that whoever cleaned the apartment did not bother to remove. There was no soap except for a hand soap by the sink. The hair dryer was the crappiest hairdryer I have ever received at any Airbnb I went to. It even smelled like burnt hair while using it. The light in the bathroom was close to nonexistent which is not what you would expect for a rental over $140 a night.
The communication with the company in charge of the apartment was very unpleasant, even though I’ve personally never responded to their messages. The tone used in every single one of their emails was bossy, and felt like I was dealing with people from the police. Terms like “be warned” or “be aware” with threatening consequences if things didn’t go the way they wanted Left me with a very unsettling feeling which is why I never bothered to email back. This is not at all and through Airbnb experience where you deal directly with the owner of the apartment and you get a warm and friendly interaction before and during your stay.
The check in/check out process was easy and the location was a bit outside of the center but conveniently located by all the trams and buses needed to quickly reach the main areas of Geneva.
Needless to say that I will never go back there , and do not recommend that place to anybody.

기대한 것 보다는 조금 아쉬운 숙소. 작은 정원이 있고 한적한 구역에 있는 집. 자주 오는 6번 버스를 타면 중앙역에 가지만, 다른 버스와 달리 정확히 역에 내리는 것이 아니라 7분 정도 걸어가야 하는 위치에 정류장이 있음. 비교적 편리하고 나쁘지 않은 위치.
숙소는 열쇠를 필요로 하는 엘리베이터를 타고 내려가는 지하에 있음. 지하에 카페트가 딸려있어 비염이 있으면 추천하지 않음. 선반과 침대 프레임 등에 먼지가 많이 쌓여있어 직접 청소했음. 정원이지만 지대가 살짝 파인 곳에 지하 창문이 있어서 환기가 잘되는 편은 아니고, 모기가 자주 들어옴. 숙소에서는 세탁기를 이용할 수 없어 밀린 빨래를 할 수 없었음. 호스트가 자기 세탁물이 많다고 게스트는 사용할 수 없다고함. 주변에 세탁 시설이 있지만 세제와 세탁기와 건조기 이용료를 합치면 총 13 스위스 프랑을 지불해야함. 세탁 시설도 너무 멀어 10분이상 걸어갔다왔다 해야함.
그리고 가지고온 토마토 파스타 재료를 가지고 저녁에 요리를 해먹었는데, 조금 냄새가 난다고 왜 요리를 해먹냐고 화를 냄. 20개가 에어비앤비 숙소를 이용하면서 주방에서 요리한다고 뭐라고 하는 호스트는 처음 봐서 어이가 없었음.
체크아웃 하는날 가방 보관서비스를 제공한다길래 캐리어 보관을 부탁했는데, 다른 게스트가 들어 온다며 열쇠를 내놓고 짐은 집 밖에 다가 두라고함. 복도나 집 문 안쪽에 보관하려고 했는데, 밖에다 두라고 해서 결국 밖에다가 놓음. 여름철이라 매우 덥고, 쉽게 열 수 있는 대문이 있는 정원에 두었는데 안전이 보장 되지 않았고, 안에 있는 화장품과 음식물이 열에 의해 손상된 듯 함.
호스트는 겉으로 친절해 보이지만, 딱히 엄청 친절하거나 머무는 동안 게스트를 잘 도와주는 느낌은 아님. 체크아웃 메세지를 보내도 인사 한마디 없는걸 보면 내 느낌이 맞는 것 같음. 가격대비 숙소 퀄리티가 조금 아쉬워서 다음에는 돈을 더 주더라도 좋은 숙소를 예약 할 것 같음. 이렇게 긴 후기는 처음 써봄.

Another reviewer mentioned the noise from the lift, which is an occasional quiet scratchy noise that can be heard throughout the apartment when the lift is in use. Transport was very easy with 2 main tramlines in the streets next to the apartment road- with trams running every 5-12 mins & early/late. It took 30 minutes to get from the airport on the tram&train, & walking to the Cathedrale in the old town, or shops in the new town 20 minutes.

Shutters were broken in the front bedroom and took 4 days for them to be repaired. This room consisted of glass doors to the living room and hallway so anyone else in the property (as well as across the street with the broken shutters) can see what is going on in the bedroom.
Photos suggest that kitchen is well stocked but there were two forks, three knives, four small spoons in drawer and one saucepan and frying pan in the kitchen. I was with 4 other people and we didn’t just make up the smoke smell to waste $600 and to book another hotel and spend more money. Dimitrios continued to call me a liar and say that it was impossible that it smelt like smoke. Again, not sure why I would make that up just to waste money and spend more.. If I were you I’d just book a hotel down the street for the same price. We got two hotel rooms at Hotel Strasbourg for the same price and got both of the rooms last minute that night. They don’t smell like smoke, they’re closer to the downtown area but still in a quiet place, and no one insisted I was lying:) this was my first time booking through air bnb and I’m a very nonchalant and not high maintenance person. Additionally, the shower head did not fit in the shower head holder so it was difficult to have a relaxing hot shower at the end of a long day of travel. The walls were also very thin so I could hear everything in the unit next door.
Last, there were literally only a couple of pieces of toilet paper provided. When I informed Estelle of this upon checking in I was told she would look into it and get back to me. Over 24 hours later I still hadn’t heard back so I reached out again. Several hours later I received a response and was told there was enough (there wasn’t).
Overall very convenient location but for the price (~$275 USD for 2 nights) I expected more.

Please note, although the street is quiet most of the time, it occasionnally gets busier, and you'll notice cars and motorbikes. I spent one month at the flat in June, working there during day time, and there were times when closing the window was preferable to reduce the noise. But overall, nothing really annoying, just a bit of city noise.
Other cool things about the flat: the good wifi, the tv with loads of channels, the amazing yet creaky wooden floor, David's welcome and good communication, including him getting my name on the mailbox on day 1 so I could get mails.
The kitchen is also rather large for a flat of this size, with a large table and even a tiny washing machine! (this type of buildings in Geneva usually have shared washing machines in the basement rather than individual ones in flats so it's definitely a plus). However, the cooking area is a little small, so you need to be well organised when preparing your dishes or make use of the dining table.
All in all, great stay, and I would recommend the flat!

Our accommodation in Geneva was not very far from the central railway station (Genève-Cornavin) For some, the distance between the station and the apartment may be walkable, but we found it more convenient to take the number 8 bus from the station, especially as we were carrying luggage. The number 8 was not easy to find, as the stop is at the rear of the railway station. The bus to the apartment is travelling in the direction of the OMS, and guests should get off at the Canoniere station. The apartment is around the corner from the bus stop, and there is also a supermarket beside the stop.
The apartment is on the ninth floor, with good views across Geneva. It is very homely, with lots of artefacts and ornaments belonging to the owner placed around the flat. The kitchen area was useful for cooking when we chose to eat in. The bed was comfortable and we did not experience any noise issues. Guests should be aware that there is a communal heating system for the building, and so we were unable to adjust the heating when the weather got cold. The owner provided an additional quilt for the bed. There is a large television, which has access to channels from across Europe, including BBC, ITV and Channel Four. There is also a large outside terrace, which we did not use as for a lot of our stay it was raining. In better weather, the terrace could be nice to sit out and have breakfast. We arrived as the cleaner was finishing cleaning the apartment. She did a very thorough job, and should be commended for her hard work. Once we found the correct bus, we were able to travel easily between the apartment and the city, which has a lot of interesting sights and attractions. In summary, this apartment is a good base for exploring Geneva.

(2) The room is not set up well for laptop work. The table was far from the only electric outlet.
(3) The apartment building has a code to get in, plus a key to access the building, but the host left the apartment door unlocked overnight all the nights I stayed there.
