Exquisite taste and super hosts who went the extra mile -or more - ti make us feel at home. It was fantastic
A rare gem. Exquisite taste, well equipped, great location, and super attentive hosts!
Amazing locatio, super convenient, awesome host

Emmanuelle's apartment was perfect for our stay.
Spacious with great decoration, it was a joy to stay. In particular, the kitchen bar area was fantastic. Also should note that the beds were all comfy, including the sofa pull out.
Location is excellent, perhaps a 5 to 8 minute walk to the central area/station. You can walk down to the lake in under 30 minutes but it's also right on a bus/tram line so you can get anywhere in the city without hassle.
Last but not least, Emmanuelle was the perfect host. Super communicative and helpful!

This is a wonderful place, very well located, nicely furbished and surrounded  by shops and a beautiful park. Emmanuelle and Mark will make everything to make you fell comfortable and at home. My family and I could not have had a better experience. Don't hesitate if you are considering staying in this place.

The location is perfect to get fast into the city center with public transportation. There is also a direct bus connection to the beach.
The apartment is very charming, the decorations in industrial style fit perfect. We feel very welcome and we enjoy the clean and cosy apartment.
좋은 숙소입니다.

Nous avons passé un super séjour. A noter deux charmantes terrasses permettant de manger ou se détendre au soleil, une propreté immaculée, des livres racontant l’histoire de la Suisse et sa culture, et un accueil formidable, de délicates attentions pour nous permettre de bien se sentir dans le logement. Un accès à Genève en 7 min depuis la gare qui se situe à quelques minutes du logement. Nous reviendrons dès que possible.

Had a very enjoyable time at Lisa's place in Bellvue. Lisa was a fantastic host from the original booking to the end of the stay.  Nothing was too hard for her. The place is not large but was perfect for the space I required. There is a nice outdoor BBQ space that I didn't use but would be nice for families. I was attending a meeting at the Palexpo and the bus transport was close by, Lisa kindly organized the transport card ahead of time. The location is excellent - access to the lake and beach and Restaurants are a short walk away. Would be definitely back.

Lisa’s place was so beautiful, quiet, comfortable and closed to everything. We were able to walk to the lake beach, taking the train to downtown easily. Even the transportation cards were included with the reservation. Lisa tried her best to make sure we had a great experience. She allowed us to use the two brand new peddle boards to play on the lake. We had a great time. We’ll be back and stay longer next time.

Lisa’s cottage is a delightful experience and charming Airbnb. It is like staying in a vintage shop with collectibles of days gone by. It is outfitted with everything one needs for a comfortable stay to include kitchen staples and a first night’s meal of pasta and a jar of sauce, which got us through the night as there are no grocery stores in the immediate area.
Lisa is on sight and readily available to answer questions or provide recommendations. She also allows the use of two SUPs, ideal for Lake Lemán, a 10 minute walk away.
Grocery stores are 2 short (10min) train stops away and she provides a collapsible trolly cart to haul your goods back.
Bellevue is a very charming lakefront location and swimming during the heat of July is a must!
We had a lovely peaceful stay and made use of the outdoor seating areas of the cottage surrounded by Lisa’s beautiful flowers and greenery.
Lisa is truly a Super Host!!

Very nice, beautiful, cozy, small and very complete guesthouse, close to Lake Leman ( nice swimming beach) and to public transport to Geneva centre. Lisa is a very active, responding host.
One small drawback: for us the noise of airplanes and trains was too present.

Wij hebben een geweldig verblijf gehad bij het Guesthouse van Lisa! De communicatie vooraf was helder en bij aankomst werden we door Lisa heel hartelijk ontvangen. Er is een fijne parkeerplaats bij het verblijf. Lisa reageert altijd heel snel wanneer je een bericht stuurt, ook tijdens ons verblijf. Zo heeft ze ons ook waardevolle tips gegeven voor activiteiten in de omgeving en het openbaar vervoer. Het treinstation bevindt zich een paar minuten lopen van het verblijf wat ook erg handig is.
Het huis zelf is erg schoon en voorzien van alle gemakken! We hebben daarnaast gebruik mogen maken van de Sups van Lisa en van de barbecue. Je hebt alle ruimte, een eigen terras en ook veel privacy. We hebben erg genoten, het voelde als thuis!

We stayed at Lisa’s apartment for 7 weeks and it was the best decision we could have taken. After living in Geneva canton for 5 years we needed to find a temporary place to feel at ease and at home. I worked most of the days from the apartment, we had a parking available and a terrace outside we could use! Its in ground floor and the apartment has everything and more you need. We felt at home from the first day and Lisa was super helpful and accommodating!  We can not thank her enough for making us feel at home. The neighborhood is calm with nice people around and location to the beach and train is near foot step away! We will definitely use this place again on our next visit to Geneva.

What an incredible host, we got there late and Lisa went out of her way to look for us in the middle of the night, we were blown away. Place has more than every thing you need for your stay, convenient, clean and amazing. Definitely will stay again.
This was my second long stay, still perfect.

We spend two-week cheerful days here, feeling like at home. Booking this guesthouse is one of the best decision we have made.
Situated in Bellevue, this place enjoys quiet and graceful surroundings. Also, it is convenient to go anywhere by train, as it is just at the middle of two stations. Lisa has prepared almost everything for guests and provided detailed instructions. She is always willing to offer help and suggestions. Looking forward to come back！

This is such a lovely guesthouse with everything you need for a wonderful visit. The most, Lisa, is so helpful and kind - she’s like a concierge to help you with your trip.  We loved staying there and will come back the next time we’re in Geneva!

I am coming for long stays at Lisa’s on regular basis and everything was again perfect. Best value for money found considering this is an independant appartment, very well maintained and equipped and the location close to lake and city. Very convenient with a bicycle.
Amazing host, amazing location, amazing home!

Our host, Lisa, is amazing. The apartment has everything you need and all the things you don’t think you need. Every bit of space is well utilised. We loved this space and it was a shame we could not stay longer.

Lisa was an extraordinary host and her place was thoughtfully prepared. From booking to check-out Lisa was available and responsive and provided helpful suggestions and local knowledge, even letting us know what time to stroll down to the lake to see the best sunset over MontBlanc. Lisa’s airBnB is complete with thoughtful provisions, everything from washing powder to first aide and a welcome basket with just the right food for a weary traveller to make your first dinner and breakfast and snacks for the first day.  We would recommend Lisa’s to any couple looking for accomodation in Geneva. Thank you Lisa!

This guesthouse is a great place to stay in the Geneva area! The train stop nearby makes it easy to get around. The area is beautiful and right next to the lake. The house itself is very cute and comfortable. Lisa has thought of pretty much everything you might need, and is very attentive and kind. Lisa is also very knowledgeable about the Geneva area. She makes a really great host!

Amazing place
My wife, I and our newborn son stayed for 2 days after arriving in Switzerland from the US. The place was conveniently close to the airport and had everything we needed including toast, jam and coffee for breakfast.
The views of the lake a short walk from the house were amazing.
Highly recommend staying here.

I fully recommend Lisa and her beautiful sunshine yellow chalet. Lisa was warm and engaging from the moment I booked. She responded to my questions quickly and went well beyond expectations to do her bit to make my stay magical. Lisa added a few personal touches that made us feel welcome from the moment we stepped onto the threshold. Upon opening the front door, I saw that Lisa has curated a unique and personal space to stay. Through imaginative use of storage, it has everything you might possibly imagine needing, while still feeling sufficiently spacious to be your home from home. We enjoyed swimming in the lake (even in April) from the local beach, cocktails at the bar there, found an amazing bakery around the corner, and thanks to the travel card, we took the two stops on the train the central Geneva frequently (5 mins to the station, less than 10 mins to Geneva). Lisa, you are a wonder, and you have created the most marvellous Airbnb.  I can’t praise you enough!

Very nice host and many foods for welcoming (coffee, tea, pasta and sauce, popcorn, chocolate, milk, cake, ...). It is nice location, just few minutes to go to train and Geneva lake. It is a amazing house! I am very impressed by a suggested picture with 12 months in Geneva. Thanks so much Lisa!
Très bon séjour chez Lisa où nous nous sommes senties comme chez nous ! Tout était parfaitement expliqué et conforme à la description

Our stay was truly "A Home Away From Home". We really enjoyed staying here. Every items in house is well arranged and theres a note describing where to find things. In addition to two private garden, there's private barbeque station only for the guests.  Lake is only 300m by walk. Lisa is a great host and was always responsive for our questions. This would be our go-to place everytime we visit Geneva.  Thank you Lisa :)

fantastic!!!!!!!!! Lisa was the best host ever! So helpful and thoughtful. we arrived and found several options of food! it was grea to make a homemade meal since we have been traveling for 1.5 week already. the place was super cozy and comfortable. the garden was so serene and relaxing. so many options for games for kids and walkable to a lovely pebble beach.
I would highly recommend Lisa's place as one of the best places we have stayed.

We stayed at Lisa's house for three nights to see friends who lived close by in Bellevue.  The house was perfect.  Peaceful, private and with easy access to the airport and train station to Geneva.   There were two of us - one slept in the bedroom and the other on the comfortable trundle bed in the sitting room.  The house was immaculately clean and superbly equipped, with clear instructions for everything.  We really appreciated the welcome basket which provided everything we needed for breakfast and more, plus some little treats.  It was also great to be able to enjoy the outside space in the sunshine.  Lisa gave us really clear information, and a local travel card, and her thoughtfulness shone through in all the details.  We would thoroughly recommend Lisa and her house to anyone planning a stay in Geneva or Bellevue.

Absolutely amazing!!! I would highly recommend Lisa’s guesthouse to anyone coming to the Geneva area. It is very cute, clean, and cozy. It is in a perfect location with easy access to the train and bus station (great public transit in Switzerland!). The town of Bellevue is very charming, and Lisa is a gem! She is extremely kind and communicative, and she really wants her guests to have the best time.

Lisa was a great host. She personally came over to welcome and also provided the extra thin pillows. The place is neat and well maintained. Everything works nicely. She even came to Geneve station to pick us when train service failed one night. The lake is just down the road and there is beautiful bar on the lake. There are good restaurants nearby. On the whole a wonderful experience

Lisa's Bellevue property was the perfect home away from home for my four weeks in Geneva. The property was clean, set up with everything you need for a short or long stay and an easy train ride to the United Nations institutions for work. Lisa is a great host with plenty of tips for travellers. Her chocolate chip cookies were are real highlight! I will stay there again on my next trip.

Lisa‘s cottage is a slice of heaven. Although very centrally located to transportation and Geneva, it feels like being way out in the country. The cottage is well decorated giving an old time feel although everything possible is amazingly placed in a relatively small space and Lisa‘s instructions make finding everything so easy. As she lives next door she is very proactive and helpful and her leaving some treats out for for the weary traveller is most appreciated. Excellent beaches are just a few minutes away and although I didn‘t have a chance to use it, her offer of 2 paddleboards (with an electric pump) is quite amazing. I‘ll take her up on it next time we are there.

Comfortable guesthouse in a quiet spot near the lake. I stayed for a couple of days to enjoy summer at the lakefront. The place is really well-equipped with lots of thoughtful home-y touches. There’s great public transport connections with central Geneva too. Lisa is a superb communicator, and was a wonderful host! I highly recommend to anyone looking to visit the lake, or looking for a quieter spot to stay just outside the city.

Lisa is a wonderful host. She took a great care of me before and during the stay. She was always helpful of finding things in the guesthouse, and if needed, would come over sand sort out things I've been struggling. Her cat is super cute too:) Definitely would stay in this place when I visit Geneva again.

The place was well kept up and cozy.  It’s in a quiet and safe location.  Lisa is very nice and helpful.  She was quick to answer questions.  Transportation was convenient.  I would stay there again. Thank you!
Very nice and helpful host. The place itself had everything we needed and is located very close to the train station. Would definitely stay again!

Lisa made sure that we were comfortable and that the things we might need such as coffee pos were available.  She was available to answer questions. The location was great.  It was easy to get to the train. We really enjoyed the barbecue.

Lisa was an excellent host! She went out of her way to help us resolve an issue with our Geneva transport cards and provided a lot of information and tips about the area and how to get around. Her guesthouse was clean and had everything you’d need. It is located close to the airport so it is a great place to stay if you have an early flight. But it is also just three train stops away from central Geneva, so it is easy to go see the sights. I highly recommend the place and would stay there again.

The apartment was fun to stay at.  I enjoyed some of the reading material and we were able to make use of the barbeque.  Transportation was very easy.  Lisa also made sure that a lot of extra things such as adapters and laundry soap were available.  There were a lot of little touches to make thing very comfortable.
Large apartment with plenty of space, comfortable beds and a well stocked kitchen. Within walking distance to train & downtown, however busses to take you there are nearby too.

This is one of those few places that is even better in person than in photos. Firstly, the place is immaculate — I know because I dropped something on under the bed and there was no dust, no crumbs, no cob webs, nothing. Secondly, the design is wonderful - exposed brick, warehouse style lighting, gleaming wooden floors. Thirdly, comfort is not sacrificed for design. The couches are incredibly comfortable and so nice to return to after a long day out. The beds and pillows are likewise comfortable. Shower gets very warm and the toilet is in a separate room (with its own sink) so there’s less of a queue if there are multiple people in your party. The kitchen is very wall stocked with superior appliances including a nespresso machine and is again, incredibly clean. Fourthly, the location is wonderful. Minutes from the bus for airport and city connections and also close enough to walk to the center of town/old town (if you enjoy walking! It is a good 15-20 minutes). There is a wonderful third wave cafe just a few minutes away.
Lastly, emanuelle and mark are fantastic hosts who are flexible and very responsive. Highly recommend!

We really enjoyed staying in this apartment our first month in Geneva. It is comfortable with everything you need for a longer stay, and very well located in walking distance to downtown Geneva, close to supermarkets, and well connected to different public transport options. It is also close to parks and playgrounds which is a plus if you are staying here with smaller kids. Most importantly, Emmanuelle and Mark are very friendly. They will respond to any message and question rapidly, and will go out of their way to help you out and facilitate your stay in their apartment and in the city.

Amazing apartment within 10 minute walking distance from central station. Has everything you may need. Emmanuelle and Mike were fantastic hosts and always very helpful. Would definitely go back anytime! 10/10

Myself and my my family were very happy with the staying . Very relaxed and family oriented, peaceful flat. Clean and with many utensils. Emmanuelle is very friendly and quick responsive person. Would definitely stay in next time and recommended to stay.

We had absolutely wonderful time at Emmanuelle's place. The host met us and came over to take the keys. We had an odd request - a kettle to make tea and here it was a few hours later.
The apartment has so much character that was created with many authentic details. We would highly recommend this place for anyone visiting Geneva. We would book it again. Thank you!

Mark and Emmanuelle were great hosts, the apartment was perfect for my family my kids’ friends. The place was pristine and very well located at walkable distance to the lake and city center. My wife had to work and thus, their high speed internet was working perfectly. We enjoyed very much being in this beautiful apartment.

This apartment was clean, well equipped, beautifully presented, good for walking into Geneva and good for public transport and good value. It is also much larger than it appears from the photos.
We had good communication from Emmanuel as the host and from Mark as the owner, who was very welcoming. We've stayed in many Airbnbs and this is an extremely good one. Highly recommended.

L’appartement était impeccable tant sur le plan de la propreté que de l’équipement. Emmanuelle très réactive par message était parfaitement complétée par Mark et son sens de l’accueil parfait, toujours le petit mot gentil et une très grande bienveillance. En pleine semaine de canicule, ils ont réussi le tour de force de trouver un ventilateur, ce qui relevait de l’exploit. La déco est juste incroyablement de bon goût et tout est accessible à pied en moins de 15 minutes. Si nous revenons, nous savons déjà quel sera notre point de chute. Je recommande fortement.

We stayed at Emmanuelle’s place for a month . Quite honestly it was the best decision we made during our relocation to Geneva . Not only was the place beautifully laid out but we also found most of the furniture very comfortable ie the bed which made us decide to invest in a similar one . We enjoyed hanging out and cooking around the kitchen / bar area . Over and above this ,the owner Mark went out of his way to make us feel at home. We are most grateful for this and feel that beyond the stay we have made a new friend . We strongly recommend this apartment.

The host was great! Super responsive and friendly. Gave us great recommendations and was very accommodating.
The place was exactly as described and very nice. We stayed for a week and had plenty of towels, sheets, and all other amenities. The porch was especially nice on the warmer days.
Would stay here again!
Excellent apartment with industrial flair. Only issue is parking. Otherwise it was great!
Perfect space for our family. Close to transit and amazing restaurants. Host is friendly and full of insights.
Emmanuelle’s place was lovely. The home was as described in the listing and both her and Mark were very accommodating with our requests.
very nice place to stay close to cornavan Station excellent place.
숙소가 고급스럽게 정리되어 있으며 베게가 좋아서 편안하게 깊은 잠을 잘수 있었음. 조용하며 근처 마트도 가까워서 나무랄데 없는 숙소입니다.
Oliver was very responsive and kind. His place is wonderful for a couple or a small family and the amenities great! Highly recommended!

Lisa was a perfect toastess. her cousin had come from the United States and the three of us went out for cocktails and sat down by the lake. it was wonderful. Lisa had plenty of snacks to keep me fed and there were places to eat close by. I would absolutely give Lisa a 10 star but unfortunately I can only do five.

Lisa’s guest house is a gem; it has many personal touches and all the amenities one might need and more. Lisa pays attention to detail and her guest ‘cottage’ is a beautiful oasis away from home. Lisa is a very friendly person who knows a lot about Geneva and can give her guests great tips. I look forward to staying at her place in the future.

I really enjoyed my stay at Lisa's place. It is a delightfully decorated and cosy apartment with a fully kitted-out bathroom, living room and kitchen, as well as a welcome pack of food! It was in a great location for my needs whilst in Geneva. It is super easy to get into the centre from the nearby train stations.

My stay at Lisa's guesthouse was great. The space is not super big, but it is very cosy. A big part of the experience was thanks to Lisa: her recommendations and the lovely vintage- decoration of the place.
The guest house is a box of suprises (you have everything you need and you can think about, including a set for foundue and raclette for you to enjoy.
The place is peaceful and next to the Lehman lake where you can have nice walks. It is 20 mins from the Center of Geneva by train.
Lisa is the best. She is very friendly and always responsive.
Lisa is an amazing host. 5 star ratings do not do justice, there should be a 6 star rating just for Lisa :)

I had the pleasure of staying at Lisa's charming Guesthouse in Bellevue for three months. The house was small, clean, and incredibly cozy, nestled in a wonderful green area by the lake. The surroundings were breathtaking, offering a peaceful and serene atmosphere.
The house was well-equipped with everything I needed, making my stay extremely comfortable. Lisa, the host, was incredibly friendly and welcoming. Our relationship was very amicable, and she always ensured that I had everything I needed.
I highly recommend Lisa's place to anyone looking for a delightful stay in Bellevue. It's truly a hidden gem!

Lisa is an amazing host. She is warm, lovely, super smart and a very interesting person. She has always been responsive and very helpful whenever I needed anything. Her green guesthouse manual is a wonderfully detailed book with all the info a guest could need regarding the guesthouse. There are restaurant flyers in the kitchen area for those who like to order food.
The space of the guesthouse is compact, sweet and interestingly decorated with antique objects; it is cozy and works well for two people. My husband and I have enjoyed staying there thoroughly and look forward to returning soon!!
The surrounding area is residential and peaceful and despite the proximity to the airport, the neighbourhood is quiet. It is also beautifully green and there are jasmine and other lovely smelling flower plants growing everywhere.
I find Lisa’s guesthouse a very special place and hope I will be able to stay there often.
Thank you Lisa for everything!

Ce guesthouse offre un séjour confortable et sécuritaire à Genève. En plus, la déco est belle et amusante. Et les déplacements sont hyper faciles !  Si je pouvais donner six étoiles, ce serait chez Lisa !

Lisa’s guesthouse is a gem. It is cozy, sweet, peaceful, homey and above all very pragmatic. There is everything there one might need and extra supplies on top.
The patio is beautiful, full of flowers and a sitting area with a large umbrella. There are additional two other sitting areas, one for dinner and one for after dinner on a lawn.
Lisa is a superb host. She is incredibly friendly and very helpful. She has gone to every extent to make our stay as comfortable and memorable as possible. I could not recommend Lisa as a host and her guesthouse highly enough. Lisa deserves ten stars!! We are so grateful to have been Lisa’s guests.

Lisa is truly an amazing host. She went out of her way to make it possible for us to stay an extra day when our overseas flight was rebooked and we are very grateful to her for that!
Lisa is a warm, smart and incredibly interesting person who is a passionate collector and knows it all! She is an author of Know-it-all Passport — a guide for everyone from locals, visitors, to professionals who are spending a considerable amount of time in and around Geneva. We highly recommend this remarkable encyklopedia of recommendations.
We have been having such a wonderful interaction with Lisa, enjoying dinner together which my husband cooked and having great conversations.
The guesthouse is a true gem for those who love cozy, smart, adorable and practical spaces. We give it 6 stars and look forward to being back hopefully soon!
Thank you Lisa for everything!!

This airbnb was one of the best I have been to so far in my life, Lisa truly went all out in making sure we felt at home and had everything we needed. The home was cozy and sleep was amazing. Thank you Lisa for the incredible stay and hospitality!

제네바에서 5일간 머물렀는데 정말 최고의 장소였습니다.
역에서 가까워서 대중교통 이용에도 좋았고, 렌트차량 주차도 편했습니다.
집 내부에는 정성을 담아 다양한 것들이 잘 준비되어 있었고, 머무는 기간 내내 감동받을수 있었습니다.
외부에도 의자와 테이블 바베큐 장비들이 잘 갖춰져 있었으며 걸어서 레만호수도 이용할 수 있도록 피크닉 물품도 있습니다.
제네바에서 시간을 보내기에 최고의 장소 입니다.

This was our second stay at Lisa’s guesthouse and it excellent as before. The location can’t be beat given how close it is to the lake (5 minute walk) with a nice beach and restaurant. There are other beaches within 10 minutes or less so you take your pick. The bike path is right there and you can cycle into downtown Geneva in 15 minutes along with waterfront or to the town center, lots to do. Lisa’s cottage is cozy but everything you could ever think of or need is right there organized like a big swiss army knife and if you can’t find it she will tell you where it is very quickly. The beds are comfortable and there is a desk and sofa to use. The front of the guesthouse has 3 separate sitting areas that you can use depending on the weather and your desires. You are very close to the train station to Geneva if you don’t drive or bike. For the pricy Geneva area to have all these facilities is an outstanding value. We had a great time and look forwards to returning soon.

Lisa’s guesthouse is a very special place. I appreciated how spacious and homey it was, especially since it was cold for a couple of days during my stay. It was nice to enjoy some time at the BnB and still have a very Swiss experience with lovely decor and everything you could need.
The shower is top notch! Really perfect. The bed is as well - the best pillows. The place is really clean. Every detail and comfort has been considered.
I probably wouldn’t have met Lisa except that I asked her to join me for a coffee on the patio. It was great to chat with her, she’s very nice and well travelled.
Overall it was a great experience and I would definitely recommend!

This is a wonderful guesthouse. You can sleep in some Airbnbs, in others you can stay, but here you can live. If there is ever an Airbnb that feels like it is managed by a professional Airbnb host, this would be it. Lisa has an amazing attention to detail. She has tried to think of everything someone might need on their travels, and stock the house with it. The home is comfortable and in a quiet neighborhood, but walkable. It is an easy walk to the lake and an easy walk to the train station. The house is comfortably configured, making it easy to relax. Lisa is exceptionally kind, helpful, and detail oriented. This is an exceptional guesthouse. One could stay many weeks here and be comfortable. Lisa is outstanding. She gets our highest recommendation.

This was a perfect place for me! The air was so fresh and clean, the place had everything one could ever imagine. Location is perfect, 3-4 mins walk from station, peaceful, near to the lake, very quiet and peaceful. Lisa is a warm and gracious host. Would want to come back again. Wish could give her 7 stars :-)

Our stay at Lisa’s airb&b was a special treat. Bellevue is a lovely suburb just an 8-min. train ride from downtown Geneva. Lisa’s charming guest house is small but the space is clean, comfortable, and cleverly designed with careful attention to detail. Lisa has thought of literally everything her guests could need to make for a comfortable and pleasant experience.  She provides a great user’s manual with everything from garbage disposal to where to go for cocktails and a breathtaking lakeside view of Mt. Blanc. The charming decor reflects Lisa’s highly creative, artistic sensibility. Lisa is a warm, gracious and caring host. She checked in with us via text periodically to make sure all was well. She is a delightful person and made our stay a highlight of our visit to Geneva. Highly recommended!

This cabin was delightful in every way. The bed was very comfortable, kitchen was fun and eclectic as were the furnishings throughout. Lisa is an artist and has a spirited and whimsical manner of displaying her art and collections.
She was very responsive and flexible and had some basic foods (pasta, sauce, granola bars, milk, coffee, tea) stocked and available which was very much appreciated!

Tuvimos una experiencia inolvidable en la casa de Lisa. El alojamiento está muy bien ubicado, es cómodo y está muy bien equipado. Pero sobre todo, lo recordaremos por los detalles de Lisa para con nosotros: nos dejó provisiones en nuestro primer día, una botella de delicioso vino porque sabía que era nuestra aniversario de bodas y estuvo muy atenta a nuestras necesidades. Sin duda regresaría a donde Lisa y lo recomendamos sin reservas. Gracias Lisa! Volveremos!

Had an absolutely wonderful stay at Lisa’s place! From the start, Lisa was incredibly helpful, providing very clear and detailed instructions about the house, which made check-in and getting settled super easy.
The location of the house is perfect, especially for anyone working with the UN or needing to access the city center.
The house itself is perfectly equipped with everything you could possibly need—I barely had to open my suitcase! From toiletries to kitchen essentials, it’s all thoughtfully provided. The attention to detail in the décor is outstanding, with beautiful, unique touches everywhere that really make the space feel special and welcoming.
I had the pleasure of having coffee with Lisa -she’s such an interesting and lovely host! Her collection of decorative items is fascinating, and her personal touch is evident in every corner of the house.
Overall, this was one of the best Airbnb stays I’ve had, and I highly recommend Lisa's place for anyone visiting the area.

Esta fue la segunda vez que visito la casa de huéspedes de Lisa. La ubicación es muy buena: útil para mis actividades de trabajo cerca de UN, pero también céntrico para conocer Ginebra y sus alrededores.
Lisa ha pensado en cada detalle que uno pueda necesitar en la casa. La casa está muy bien equipada. Lisa es muy proactiva: responde los mensajes casi de inmediato y busca genuinamente que uno se sienta bienvenido. Sin duda iría a donde Lisa si tengo que regresar a Ginebra. Gracias Lisa!

J'ai bien noté Lisa dans toutes les catégories
Pour ma part, j'ai voyagé seul en utilisant les transports en commun et ce logement correspondait à ma demande

Thank you Elise for a wonderful stay, we had a very comfortable time in Geneva. Amazing location for visiting Old Town and other attractions. Nice decor with a very cute cat!

Super week-end à Genève grace à Elise et son logement. Merci encore.

Elise is lovely! We easily felt right at home in the space, which is full of character. She also kindly let us use the washer/dryer which made a big difference one week into our trip. Elise was so kind and very responsive! Thank you for all your advice!
Elsie welcomed us into her home. It was a great location close to the station and Lac Leman. It was good to stay in someone’s home rather than an apartment that should be lived in by locals.
Elise is a great host, very responsive and helpful. Her place is in a central location and is very cosy. The chocolate was also a really nice touch. Would highly recommend!

It was a good experience to live with Elise in Geneva. The hosting was great, the location is perfect, close to the SBB station and the famous sites, and the house is very nice. I would love to stay in the house again if I come back to Geneva again in the future.

wonderful memory

Fab was an amazing host! Always there when you need her, she takes care of everything you ask her. The apartment is super comfortable, has a very cute garden and is very well located.
We will definitely be back!!!

We had a great stay at Fabiola's place when we recently moved to Geneva. The place was just as described and looks exactly as the pictures. The place was pristine and Fab was awesome. Place is a bit of a distance from the city center but an easy commute. If you're looking for quiet, this is the place for you.

For someone who has just started a job and life in Geneva, Fab’s apartment is perfect. I had stayed here for a month before I could find a permanent residence. I have nothing but good things so say about this apartment and my stay, which was for one month.  The space, the facilities, cleanliness, privacy and comfort were perfect for any length of stay and I would recommend it wholeheartedly. Fabiola is a kind and professional host who went beyond what most hosts do to ensure comfort and provide help, especially with very useful information and tips for Geneva and the area. The location is not central (yet well connected by bus) but is perfect for peace and quiet and proximity to the international organizations + the airport. Pregny-Chambesy is itself a very pleasant discovery, with lots of nature and walking.  Hats off to Fab, and I will definitely seek out her apartment for any next visit.

Great location ! Surounded by Geneva countryside and wineyards, it very calm around the housse.

Nice view of the lake, accessible on foot and you will find lovely small ports and shores.
I extended my stay by a month, everything was great as the previous weeks.

Excellent séjour ! Très calme.
Pratique : le bus juste en face pour rejoindre le centre.
Merci à Éric pour son écoute et sa réactivité.

Amazing place to stay in Geneva. The studio is well furnished, also for working. Kept clean. Amazing place in countryside, surrounded by vineyards. Great for outdoors activity. The location is good, at only 20 min to Geneva centre with public transport. The bus stop is very near. Eric and Olivia are very kind hosts. Very helpful. I prolonged my stay and I recommend it.

Great relaxing place to stay in Geneva. I returned for another stay. Beautiful location, just outside Geneva. Well served by public transport. Surrounded by nature. Ten minutes walk to the lake. Clean and well furnished. Eric and Olivia are great hosts. I recommend it.
Very good place, good location and well equipped. Very nice host, I recommend to anyone
Eric was very kind. The house is in an amazing place, in the nature with a beautiful view of the lake. Super for holidays.

Logement parfait, proche de la ville et bien desservi en bus. J'y suis resté pour 2 mois dans le cadre d'un séjour professionnel. Eric est un hôte très sympathique et arrangeant, j'ai beaucoup apprécié mon séjour
Nice little place & location & host
Séjour agréable, propriétaires très sympatiques, espace privé et paisible, bel environnement

I was looking for an airbnb, but I found a home instead. That's why I extended my stay twice. Eric also makes sure that nothing is missing and responds super fast to all questions. He is always available and still gives you your own privacy. And the area around the Airbnb is really a dream and the lake is really close! I would book the Airbnb again (and maybe even will soon). Absolute recommendation!

Staying with Eric and Olivia has been an absolute pleasure. They are such kind and approachable hosts who are willing to answer any questions you have. The loft was very cozy and offered an amazing view of the surrounding countryside. A five minute walk takes you to a nearby bus stop with access to Geneva. It has been great staying at Eric and Olivia’s and I am truly thankful for their generosity and hospitality. Also their cat is such a sweetheart!
Erich ist sehr professionell und sehr nett. Wir werden sicher wieder bei ihn buchen wenn wir in Genf sind. Danke!
Super studio dans la campagne genevoise, a 15 minutes du centre de Genève, très bien desservi par les transports. Cadre superbe. Appartement tout équipé et agréable je recommande fortement

Eric is friendly. The place is peaceful with amazing view of the countryside. It was lovely to see herons, foxes and hares :)  The studio is well equipped. Recommend for anyone looking for a quiet getaway.
Séjour parfait

Merci à Eric et Olivia pour leur accueil. J'ai pu profiter d'un coin paisible à proximité de Genève lors de mon séjour d'un mois.
Je recommande fortement!
Au top, bon emplacement et correspond au photos

Great location close to the lake and UN. Everything you need for a comfortable stay. Like many Airbnbs, there are personal belongings in the apartment but she leaves plenty of space to unpack your things. Herisoa is a lovely host with great communication !

I stayed in Herisoa's apartment for a month and time just flew by! I couldn't have asked for a more convenient place, be it for work (not even 5 minutes from the Nations entrance to the Palais des Nations complex), groceries (literally above the Coop!) or getting to town.  Herisoa is a very kind and reactive hostess, which makes it even better!

Herisoa is a lovely host who really wants you to feel at home! She is very helpful and comes with good advice on how to navigate in the city. The appartment is well located with an easy walking distance to the UN, close to the city center, shops and restaurants, and the botanical garden. I really enjoyed my stay!
Herisoa’s flat is very comfy and spacious. Lots of amenities and very charming. She was the perfect hostess. I highly recommend this great apartment.
A great, spacious place close to lots of great amenities and parks.

A very nice, functional and spacious apartment (feels bigger than the pictures suggest) with a super comfortable bed, all rooms and the balcony facing a large and quiet inner courtyard and pleasant, warm lights and deco to relax in the nicely set up living room with huge windows. Located just above Coop & the Japanese restaurant Sagano, right behind the UNHCR building, it is close to everything you might need - grocery shopping, pharmacy, bus stops (5, 20, F) & tram 15 just a few steps away, various UN offices within walking distance. Big plus for the not-so-seasoned cooks: a microwave oven! :) Laundry facilities can be accessed for free in the building on several days (schedule provided) incl. all of the weekend - all in all, nothing left to be desired. Herisoa was a very kind and responsive host, she showed me everything I needed to know & was flexible and supprotive throughout. The only remark for work travellers like myself is that the kitchen/dining table is the only desk available for work - it is large and I used it extensively with my laptop, but chairs & lighting are not ideal if you happen to work a lot after dark. It is manageable though, and I spent a very comfortable two weeks at Herisoa's place. Can only recommend. :)

Lovely flat in a great location, especially if you need to be near the UN. Close enough to the lake for a nice walk, and a large Coop just downstairs so everything you need is right there. The flat is spacious, which is kind of rare in Geneva, and very bright with a nice balcony that catches the sun.
Slight issue with cleanliness and tidiness, in the kitchen in particular, but overall a good place to base yourself if you're in Geneva for a few days.
Herisoa was a lovely host and very responsive. Her sweet and cosy flat was the perfect home away from home while I worked at CICG for a week. Thanks Herisoa!
I really enjoyed my stay at Herisoa's place. super convenient, clean and cozy. Herisoa is very friendly and always willing to help. Overall, a 5 star service!

Herisoa's apartment is located in a great area, close to public transportation, supermarket and restaurants right below the apartment.  The place is big and bright, everything works perfectly, the TV, Wifi, hot water shower, the laundry room, kitchen is all equipped and she  is a great host that offers everything in the kitchen for you to use.  The building has an elevator and is in a very safe residential area.   I highly recommend Herisoa's place.

Cozy, charming apartment in perfect location. Close to UN, close to CICG, supermarket 1 min walk, barber, restaurants, easy public transport connections <2min walk), 15 min ride direct bus to the airport.
Herisoa is a very kind and experienced host, absolutely helpful and great with communication. Thanks again!
A comfortable and convenient apartment close to Nations. There is a Coop and restaurants close by, and buses / trams to everywhere. Herisoa was a very responsive and considerate host.
Excellent place to stay with easy access from the airport, great self check-in and nice cafes and the lake nearby. Lovely outdoor space to a quiet back yard. Has everything. Would stay again.
Herisoa is a great host, friendly and easy to communicate with. Her place is ideal for work around the UN.

I spent five days in this apartment. It is very close to two grocery stores and 10 minutes away from the Place des Nations. The train station is 10 minutes away by bus.
The apartment was clean and Herisoa was very welcoming. You really stay in her place, which could seem weird but isn’t. It mainly means you have everything you need! I really enjoyed my stay.

Herisoa's apartment is true to her description. It is conveniently located, within walking distance to the UN institutions and public transport. There is a big supermarket and restaurants downstairs. It is well equipped, bright and spacious. Herisoa was helpful and responded promptly to my questions and requests. There were a couple of minor problems after I checked in, but she solved the issues quickly. There were some of  her personal belongings but she cleared plenty of space for me to use. I will stay at her's again on my next trip.

Herisoa is a great host, very responsive and helpful.
The place is better that it looks in the pictures. There is everything you may need in the apartment. The location is very good, especially if you are going to the UN building, UNHCR, WHO, ILO, IOM, etc. Shops and restaurants are simply downstairs.
I highly recommend this place.
Herisoa was very responsive with clear instructions, and her place was comfortable and quiet in a great location, especially if you want to be close to the UN. Highly recommended!

Everything was perfect! Great communication, easy check in and out. The location  is brilliant, walking distance to both the UN and the station with a gorgeous balcony. The apartment is very big and right next to a good food shop. I would recommend this place in a heartbeat!

I stayed at Herisoa’s place for almost 5 weeks. I was in Geneva for work. Pros: Herisoa is very nice, easy to communicate, and helpful; proximity to the UN, various buses and tram stops close by; there’s a co-op just downstairs and some restaurants; quiet place. Cons: the washing machine was broken when I arrived (had been broken for weeks) and only got fixed mid way through my stay; there were cleaning issues (eg, bird poo on the kitchen floor when I arrived).
I enjoyed my stay at Heriosa's. the place is spacious and in an excellent location. steps away from public transport and supermarket right downstairs.
Heriosa was a wonderful host. The location is great, it is clean and bigger than what I expected from the photos. Communication was great too.

Herisoa's place is just amazing! Very convenient for those working close to Nations. It is also at a walkable distance from the main train station. Herisoa has been an amazing host, super helpful and prompt in responding to my queries. I would definitely recommend this place.

This apartment is conveniently located and recommend to those looking for quiet, charming places to stay! Herisoa is a superb host and she had everything a guest would need. Perfect for those who want to be around Nations.

Unbeatable location if you are on a UN related business trip. Buses, restaurants, gyms, and a supermarket are at the doorstep. Apartment is not of the newest kind but found very clean on arrival, and the indoor architecture is logical. As others pointed out there are minor issues with the appliances but the overall experience works out well.
Great location and responsive host!

Very conveniently located for the UN/international organisations - a good choice if you are visiting these, and good public transport links to the city centre and airport. Convenient to have the supermarket so close by as well. The apartment feels very homely and had all the facilities I needed, and the host was very helpful.
One thing to note is that not much is open in this area on Sundays - you'll probably need to go into the city centre to find somewhere to eat out then.
My second stay at Herisoa’s was as good as my first. Great location.
Great place, very responsive host, easily walkable to WHO and UN. Would definitely stay again. Thanks for being so flexible about check in and check out times.

Lovely place, with everything one might need for a short or extended stay in Geneva, at a good location. Herisoa is a very responsive, accommodating, and pleasant host. Would definitely stay at Herisoa's again if I got a chance.

Herisoa was a great host. While I initially had problem locating the place and getting inside her flat, she immediately fixed the problem the next day.
Her flat had all the things that I needed, like extension cords in the bedroom and kitchen. She also responds quickly to my messages. While I did not physically see her, I could feel her warmth and hospitality.
The location of her apartment was perfect for me, as I was in Geneva to work. No time was wasted as the office is just walking distance. The grocery is nearby. The bus stop to and from the airport is nearby.
Perfect experience! With 5mins walk to CICG and ITU, the best place in town!

Good location and safe area.

I highly recommend Herisoa's place. It is well located, with everything you need (great grocery store, pharmacy, restaurants, public transport)  right around the corner. Very close to the Palais des Nations as well. The place was very clean, and Herisoa is one of the most respectful, flexible, responsive and supportive hostess I have encountered.
willing to recommend anybody who has issue with the UN as the place is within walking distance from the UN. It was also very neat, clean and cozy. I sincerely enjoyed staying in Herisoa's place!

It was really great decision choosing that place. Apartment was nice and clean and most importantly walkable distance to UN. Host was very responsive and practical with all the instructions. I wish would have had more time to explored the city better. Thank you so much for hosting

The actual flat is better than picture. Safe, clean, silent town. Everything in the house worked perfectly and the house was so lovely. Herisoa was very kind and quick response. I am willing to stay this flat when I go Geneva next time.

Very close proximity to the United Nations in Geneva. Very accessible and elevator worked. Heriosa was also very helpful, she said “take anything you need in the house and use whatever you see in the house”….
Very convenient for the meetings at the various international organisations such as ITU, or IEC. Very helpful and responsive host.
Perfect choice.  Everything you might need. Great communication.

This is one of the best stays I have had with AirBnB. Herisoa is a great host: everything is as announced if not better; all instructions were simple and super clear; the flat is all you need and has little extras like the balcony overlooking the park. Super convenient and practical. I'd love to be back!

I stayed in Herisoas flat for work and it was fantastic. The flat provides you everything you could need, is very close to the city centre, the lake and the United nations. Communication with Herisoa was perfect, would highly recommend her as a host and this apartment! Thanks Herisoa!

Herisoa is a great host. Always responsive and helpful. The apt is very big with a balcony, big kitchen and living and room. 2 blocks for United Nations and the international conference center.
Next to a supermarket and across from a gas station and a bar and a restaurant. Supermarket closes at 7 pm. And the restaurant and bar 8.30 pm. Next to buses and tranway (#15 to go to downtown in. 15 minutes or less). Bus # 5 to come and go to the airport. all 10 points

Perfectly situated, central to UN, WHO, city and river. Very comfortable and well equipped. Herisoa's communication was excellent - prompt responses and clear. What surprised me most was how quiet apartment is. Thank you for an extremely comfortable stay in an excellent and peaceful location.

Herisoa’s home has a very relaxed and lived-in feeling to it. That made it very easy to feel at home and feel peaceful after for a long day of work. The only slight issue is that this is a very business-oriented part of town so it was a little bit dark come nighttime, when the nearby offices and organisations are closed. But other than that, it is a lovely place to stay which I can highly recommend and Herisoa is very responsive and friendly.

Je n'ai pas rencontré de problème particulier pendant le séjour. L'appartement est grand et tous les équipements de cuisine y compris des produits de consommation étaient à ma disposition. Mon hôte a été à l'écoute et partagé des informations très utiles. Les voisins que j'ai rencontrés sont hyper sympa. Les facilités de transport étaient à deux minutes. Ma seule remarque porte sur le lit qui pourrait être un peu plus relevé. Je n'hésiterais pas y revenir.

If you are coming to Geneva for conferences, networking, or other business in the city center – I highly recommend this accommodation. With a busy week and nonstop activities, I felt right at home in this apartment. There was ample and comfortable space to cook, recharge, and plan the next day's approach from a place that felt as comfortable as my own home. Thank you so much, Herisoa!

A very comfortable place that truly feels like home. After long days of meetings at the UN, it was the perfect space to come back to and relax. The apartment is well-located, peaceful, and thoughtfully set up — ideal for work trips or anyone looking for a quiet, welcoming stay in Geneva.

Herisoa's space is conveniently located near Palais de Nations. Appreciated coming back to a place like home after long days of work. The space is well equipped with everything you need to stay for a couple of weeks and Herisoa has left clear instructions on use of materials. The space is clean and comfortable. Ideally located with grocery stores nearby and it is not too far from Gare Cornavin. Being close to several UN and other institutions, would absolutely recommend Herisoa's space for anyone visiting Geneva for the purpose of visiting these institutions.
Very convenient for guest to attend the meetings in Nations! Comfortable and lovely rooms. Thank you Herisoa!

Herisoa communicated clearly and responded quickly to any messages, requests or questions. Location is great for UN buildings, easy access to the no15 tram into town and the no5 bus from the airport drops within a few mins walk so easy access. Supermarket close by. Comfortable and convenient

Molta disponibilità e organizzazione da parte del proprietario, evidentemente è un alloggio abitato, quindi si nota il disordine e confusione tipico. It was a very convenient location near the UN offices and there is a supermarket in the apartment compound. Also very close to the tram station.

L'appartement d'Heriosa est très bien situé. L'UN et le lac sont facilement accessibles à pied, et la gare ainsi que le centre-ville ne sont pas loin en tram ou en bus. Juste à côté, il y a un grand supermarché Coop, ce qui est très pratique. L'appartement est calme et les voisins sont sympathiques.

I was in Geneva for an event at the U.N. so I wanted to find somewhere that was close.
Herisoa's flat is charming, clean and safe.
It's very close to everything - a 5 minute walk to the U.N., 15 minute walk to the train station and about a 20 minute walk to downtown Geneva.
Herisoa was wonderful. She was friendly, easy to communicate with and promptly answered any questions I had - both before I arrived and while I was there.
I would absolutely recommend her flat and will re-book it the next time I'm in Geneva.
Herisoa is an amazing host, her place is very cosy and clean and incredibly close to the UN!
Romain is a very nice person, he answers very fast. The place is very good located and you can also park your car in front of your appartment. Thank you for everything!

I stayed in Fab’s apartment for 1 ½ months and it was a great choice. She was an awesome host, very welcoming, and attentive to all my needs. The place was really clean and big and has everything you might need for a longer stay and Fab is always present and responds very quickly in case there is any issue or if you need something. The place is in the basement of a nice house, but I felt it received plenty of light. It is very close to the airport but you don’t really get any noise. The place is in a very calm area away from the city center but I consider that everything in Geneva is close. But in addition, there are a few bus stops close by from where you can easily get to the city center, to the airport and grocery stores. The area of Nation with all international organizations is very close by as well, if you enjoy walking you can get to the OMS, ILO, or the Red Cross in 25 minutes approx. In fact, I used to go walking to my office and enjoy that calm walk in the mornings. The place has a big desk and good internet connection that I used because I was working part of the time at home during my stay. I must say I really enjoyed my stay, and will definitely stay there again if I ever need a place for several weeks around Geneva and I really recommend it.

very nice quiet area. everything was super nice. i did not like the desk chair or kitchen chairs but then again I am a big dude :)) everything else was just fantastic. I enjoyed my month staying here alot.
Great place to stay during summer.

We were happy to find Fab's apartment as it is very close to some friends we were visiting in Geneva. The apartment is nice and stays cool during the evenings, with a charming garden outside. The neighborhood is pretty and residential, calm and without much going on, but is a very easy 20 minute bus ride into downtown Geneva and the apartment served as a great home base for visiting the city. Fab was a good communicator and made sure we had everything we needed.

It was great to stay in Fab's apartment. The place was clean, quiet and well equipped, with pleasant cool even on the hottest of the day. Fab was a very good host, we've found a comfort issue and Fab to address it very fast and treated us with kindness. Thank you very much and I'm looking to stay again.

Fab’s apartment is very nice: it is very clean, good air, and equipped modern and with very good taste and style. You will definitely find the space is much bigger than what you expect. The garden is very beautiful with two cute little dogs as highlights. Walking distance to a couple of international organisations and embassies. It is surrounded by natural resort and farm, and view to lake and mountain.  Can walk to lake as well. It is close to sports facilities, such as tennis.  Bus transportation very convenient. Fab and her mom is superb host. Highly recommend this lovely place.

Fab’s apartment is my first choice when I travel to Geneva for work. The apartment is in a great location within walking distance to UN organisations, surrounded by lovely gardens and fields. If you are looking for a quiet place out of the city and well serviced by public transport, this is the place. With high speed internet and all the facilities for self catering and care, the apartment is perfect for single professionals or couples.

Fab is perhaps the nicest, friendliest and most responsive host I've ever experienced. Any question or issue, she was on top of it right away to answer me. This basement apartment is comfortable and there's plenty of space for a solo or couple. The kitchen is workable, the couch is in great shape and the bedroom is large and spacious, with the bonus of a desk to use if you're working. The area is fairly quiet and there's not many stores or restaurants nearby, but bus transportation routes are plenty. Those staying here to work at IOM or WHO or ILO, for example, will find it walkable. But most of all, rent this place so you'll get a chance to have Fab as your host.

A Fab foi uma anfitriã impecável, realmente fantástica! Foi muito além do necessário em sua gentileza. Passamos muito bem em seu apartamento, que encontramos super limpo! Foi uma ótima experiência e seremos sempre gratos à Fab !

Fab’s place was beautiful, clean, spacious, safe, comfortable and very peaceful. The surroundings were also beautiful and safe. Location was ideal as it is close to the UN and other international organizations. Fab as a host was super friendly, communicative, accommodating,  responsive and always happy to help with anything, including recommendations. I thoroughly enjoyed my stay, and would recommend anyone to stay here!

Wohnung liegt in einem ruhigen Einfamilienhaus Quartier. Eingerichtet mit allem was man braucht.
Bushaltestelle in der Nähe.

Don’t miss the opportunity to make this exceptional accommodation the base for your trip for both pleasure and business. Much about this apartment made our stay pleasant. It was roomy enough for our family, looked exactly as advertised, and the kitchen was well-equipped. We were there for some length, so probably there could have been more dishwashing fluid, toilet paper, paper towels, garbage bags, and more bath towels provided. We bought all of these conveniences plus basic spices like salt and pepper, olive oil, etc ourselves upon arrival.
The apartment was in a convenient location, near enough to all busses, trams, and the train station to make getting around and grocery shopping quite easy. It was nice quiet location, just a short walk to the lake and just a bit farther to old town Geneva, and all the parks — all of which we thoroughly enjoyed.
There is an elevator, but be aware that it is tiny and is only accessible after you take the stairs up one flight. If you have a physical disability, this might make access difficult. For our young family, this was no problem.
While our initial communication was with David, he indicated upon our arrival that he would be away during our stay. In his place, his associate Pavel, handled key exchange and all other troubleshooting. Pavel was cheerful and punctual during all contacts. He let us know as we arrived that a repair to the freezer door was needed, that parts were ordered and should arrive within a day or two. This repair did not occur during our stay; David believed it was best not to disturb us, and it was nothing that bothered us, nor did it impair our stay. The clothes washer, however, more critical to the comfort of our stay, did not function as it should. We communicated with Pavel about our inability to get the washing machine to work properly. It simply spins on the wash cycle indefinitely. While Pavel indicated that he consulted a manual, he found no solution and he did not offer to come over to problem-solve this issue in person. Therefore, we were unable to use the washing machine to wash our clothing throughout our stay. We removed our clothes from the machine, rinsed them by hand and hung them to dry. Also, one should be aware that shower turns cold after less than 15 minutes, which is problematic for a family stay. When we contacted Pavel about this concern, he responded that this is a typical problem in Geneva apartments. We’ve stayed in Geneva a number of times elsewhere without encountering this problem. Perhaps this problem needs to be looked into for the comfort of future guests.
Shortly before we were to vacate the apartment, we had quite a surprise; the refrigerator simply quit functioning. Pavel came over the following morning to troubleshoot this problem, sadly, to no avail. He sincerely apologized about the inconvenience. Ultimately, he put in an order to have it repaired, but our stay ended before this repair occurred.

Additionally the apartment was exceptionally close to all amenities including tram/ bus stops which take you all over the city.

Todo estuvo muy bien. llegas en 30 minutos caminando al centro.
y esta cerca una estación para tomar el transporte público. A 15 minutos a pie puedes encontrar buenos restaurantes para comer.

Фотографии не соответствуют, кухня это отдельная комната (маленькая). Диван расположен не за кроватью, а сбоку. Квартира маленькая, но уютная и чистая. Много места занимают вещи для уборки. Гель для душа была и фен были в ванной комнате. На кухне не было подсолнечного масла, пришлось покупать 0,5 литра и оставлять его там. Есть кофе машина и для нее много капсул для кофе, на несколько раз в день хватает. Морозильная камера была грязная, холодильник был чистым.
Excelente alojamiento. El departamento estaba muy limpio y muy bien ubicado, contaba con todo lo necesario.
Had a great stay and really enjoyed the location. Easy to get into the city and in a quiet neighborhood. The place was perfect for three people.
Excelente ubicación, entorno y céntrico para hacer actividades

My family enjoyed the stay. Good communication throughout the stay.
Thank you.

Truly enjoyed my stay. The flat had everything you need for a short business trip. The neighborhood, Carouge, has a great atmosphere, picturesque and full of nice shops, bars and restaurants. While not in heart of Geneva, it is easily accessible by bus.
Il y a juste un problème avec l’ascenseur, marchait pas tout le temps. Ça veut dire qu’il fallait prendre l’escalier.
La ubicación súper bien, cercana a todo, Marc es una persona muy amable y responde rápido sus mensajes, no es la primera vez que me hospedo allí, todo muy limpio, tal como en la fotos, lo recomiendo
apartamento bien equipado y comodo las instrucciones y el lugar muy bien ordenados. gracias marc
Joli appartement, bien agencé et décoré. Fidèle au photos et description proposé. Marc a été un hôte à l'écoute.

J’ai passé un bonne semaine chez Marc, j’ai surtout très bien dormi dans un lit et une literie très confortable. Le canapé et les chaises pourraient être lavés (étaient sales), et la cuisine n’est pas dans un très bon état. La salle de bain est très bien, et l’emplacement top et calme. Merci Marc!
Très beau studio, dans un quartier calme et sans problème de voisinage
Appartement très bien placé. Florian est très arrangeant et réactif.

The apartment is extremely well located with easy access by foot to all the sights Geneva has to offer. We were very well received by Florian who showed us in, all the amenities we working. We enjoyed our stay thoroughly.

Tout était parfait, rien à redire, et je recommande vivement !

Merci pour ce petit séjour nous avons adoré !!

Le jacuzzi petit plus non négligeable

We stayed here for two nights.
First of all: the apartment is beautiful and well decorated. I think they recently renewed, as the apartment looked a bit different from the pictures (more pretty).
The kitchen has every thing you need!
The apartment downstairs was also occupied, but really no disturbance.
Only down side: the jacuzzi did not work, which we were looking forward to.
We would definitely come here again.
Great place, we had an issue with none working jacuzzi but Marie will take care of it. Very well equipped and close to all the attraction. We will definitely come back.

Le jardin est très beau et l'appartement agréable. Cependant il faut noter les points suivants : Si le studio du rez ou l'appartement du bas sont loués, et ce malgré la discrétion des locataires, vous n' aurez aucun sentiment d'intimité . De même les locataires du bas ont un accès direct à l'appartement du rez par une porte que vous ne pouvez pas fermer à clé.
Si cela ne vous gêne pas , je peux vous le recommander. Bien situé dans Genève.

Super séjour chez Marie. L'endroit est gigantesque (il s'agit du rez-de-chaussée d'une maison), très cosy et équipé à la perfection. La salle de bain et la cuisine ont été mes coups de cœur, car toutes les deux très bien décorées et agencées. Il faisait un froid glacial à l'extérieur, et la maison de Marie est très bien chauffée, douillette et impeccable. Je me suis rendu compte mon dernier jour, en voyant de la lumière, que l'étage du haut et du bas étaient occupés, mais l'appartement est très bien isolé.
Des supermarchés sont à deux pas, mais la maison est au calme, dans une impasse.
Je recommande vivement cet endroit.
J'espère pouvoir revenir chez Marie sous peu !
Bonne continuation !
Bel appartement, très grand et bien placé.
Très bon séjour, merci pour votre réactivité et pleins de geste attentionné. Je recommande fortement
Excellent host and beautiful house
Everything as expected - the living room is very spacious and well furnished!

A very charming place with a gorgeous garden and excellent public transit connectivity. One of its kind in Geneva. Marie is a great host: communicative, resourceful and accommodating. Overall a very pleasant stay!

Excellent séjour, Marie est une hôte très accueillante et accommodante. L'appartement est vaste, propre, le jardin très agréable. Nous avons bénéficié de cartes de transport gratuit sur l'ensemble du séjour.  Je recommande vivement.

We stayed for four nights while spending time with relatives who live nearby.  The spacious living accommodation and kitchen made it so much nicer than a hotel room that would probably have cost more.  We did not meet Marie but messages worked fine for getting access to the property.  The accommodation is close to an excellent bus route running from the city centre to the airport so was perfectly located for us.   We would definitely stay here again.

Un lieu très agréable. Un grand espace de vie traversé par la lumière, chaleureux, très bien équipé. Un îlot de calme dans la ville, entouré par un charmant petit jardin. Marie est une hôtesse très discrète mais attentive à ce que tout se passe bien et très réactive à toute demande.
Conforme à l’annonce, facile d’accès et bien situé en ville.

Perfect location for reaching all parts of Geneva. Free public transportation and free parking. The place is even nicer than what it looks in the photos. It is a place to go back to. Marie is very friendly, helpful and accommodating.

Marie a été très gentille et nous a permis d'avoir les transport gratuit.
je recommande vivement !
Marie was wonderful and really helped to make our short trip to Geneva a success. She provided great restaurant and activity recommendations. The place was beautiful and had everything we needed.

We found the place easily and there was more than enough space for my husband and I.  The location was great, there are multiple grocery stores a block over in a shopping center. The bus stop is really close.  Marie was a great host she was responds in a very timely manner.

My 19 year old son and I stayed in Marie’s beautiful apartment for 4 nights as part of a holiday in Switzerland. It was a lovely place with a gorgeous garden, and was in a superb location with excellent public transport links and within walking distance of the city centre. There is a fab shopping centre nearby with plenty of supermarkets and other shops, and we enjoyed a drink or two the local bars too. Marie’s apartment is even nicer than in the photos, and was absolutely spotless. She was an excellent host, very quick to reply to messages and friendly too.

The garden was delightful. The indoor space was very comfortable and had nearly everything I needed - an ironing board wouldn't go astray. Marie responded to messages quickly.  The washing machine wasn't draining when I was there.

Marie Et Jules’s place looks exactly like the pictures and the additional pictures that Marie and Jules sent were really helpful in finding the place. Marie and Jules were an excellent host and were always quick to answer any questions. The air bnb is super easy to find and has really good bus links to the airport and into Geneva, stopping at the top of the street. There are some building works across the road which were not noisy as of January 2024 but might be worth considering for any long stays as it was not clear what was being built.

The place is private but still only a 2-3 minute walk into town where you’ll find bus stops or grocery stores. The kitchen had everything you would ever need, and the rest of the house was very comfortable. I recommend this place to anyone looking to visit Geneva.

Het huis was precies wat ik verwachtte, mooie grote keuken, met echt alles wat je zou willen. Moderne badkamer en extra wc. Het contact was direct met Marie. Heel fijn dat het halverwege nog opnieuw werd schoongemaakt. Ik heb meteen geboekt voor juni en oktober als ik weer voor de VN in Genève moet zijn.
logement spacieux,  propre et très bien situé.
We had a great stay and the hosts went above and beyond to accommodate us! Thanks again
Marie Et Jules is a good place to stay. We felt like home. Almost everything we need was there. The place was absolutely clean and they are so responsive hosts.
très beau logement au calme et très grand

Отличное жилье в Женеве с удобной парковкой рядом с домом. Интерьер очень атмосферный и интересный. В квартире есть все необходимое для приготовления еды и в целом для того, чтобы чувствовать себя хорошо. Очень приятно, что гостям предлагают карту для проезда бесплатно. Я ей не воспользовался, так как можно было дойти пешком до центральных мест. Спасибо за гостеприимство!

Marie est une hôte très accueillante. L'arrivée flexible, les instructions claires et la place de parking pour se garer sont un vrai plus !
De plus l'emplacement est parfait, nous avons pu visiter Genève à pied.
Le logement est propre et les photos correspondent au logement.
Le piano dans le salon est également un vrai plus.
Je recommande ce logement pour un séjour sur Genève.
Dit was de tweede keer dat ik drie weken hier was, en ik heb voor oktober alweer geboekt.
Very easy to find. Plenty of facilities. Approx 25 min walk to Lake Geneva. Very near bus stops. Peaceful.

Logement fidèle aux photos et prestations proposées.
Si vous aimez cuisiner, il y a tout ce qu’il faut et les commerces pres du centre commercial les Charmilles sont un plus.
Le jardin est appréciable avec la terrasse afin de bénéficier du soleil .Je recommande ce logement.
Lá Deco est très sympa notamment sì vous avez une sensibilité artistique .

Jules is a very responsive and helpful host.
We encountered problems in the use of cooker and washing machine, and it would be helpful if there would have proper instructions there especially for international travellers.
Overall, the experience was comfortable.
Excelent and cozy stay. Greg helped us with everything we needed

Bonjour.
Jolie maison très propre et très bien entretenue.

Vacances en famille et profitez pour visiter la ville magnifique de Genève. Situé à 15minutes.
Grégoire et une personne trèssympa arrangeant. Absent et présent à la fois.
Je recommande vivement.

Great stay! Gregoire was a kind, generous and helpful host. The property is exactly as the photos show and perfect for a family with young children, as there are fun toys to play with and the garden is splendid. We miss it already and would definitely stay again

Maison convenable et proche de Genève (15 min en voiture). La maison est bien équipée, il y a tout ce qu’il faut pour une famille souhaitant découvrir les alentours. La piscine est propre, bien entretenue mais la maison mitoyenne a une vue direct sur la piscine. Concernant le ménage, il semble ne pas avoir été effectué au rez-de-chaussée, nous avons passé plus de deux heures à nettoyer avant de nous installer. Les jeux pour enfants et les aménagements extérieurs sont un plus.
Great thanks

Manuel's location was so perfect! It was a short walk to the bus station, tram, beautiful grocery store and lake. Tons of stores and restaurants just outside his door in a very lovely and safe neighborhood. Inside was very clean and comfortable. He thoughtfully provided everything that we needed and more. It was a wonderful place to stay!
Super emplacement. A10 minutes de marches de la gare. Près de la vieille ville
We had a lovely stay.  The apartment was very comfortable and had everything we needed... plus there was plenty of storage for our gear.  Manuel was a great host, very responsive to our questions.

Great place in a very central location. It is a pity that the Internet does not work. Manuel did leave us a Sim card to compensate, but this was not very convenient as it did not cover both devices we had with us. In the end we just tried to use our own data, as it was too inconvenient to swap sims.  Nevetheless, thank you Manuel for trying to overcome the difficulty. The TV services were not available, probably due to lack of Internet. The portable Air Con was great to have. The place was lovely and clean. Communication with Manuel was great and check in and out was all seamless.

This was our second stay at Manuel's place - we love the location & simplicity of it. It's just the right size for the 2 of us, from the tiny kitchen to the studio-apartment size. The neighborhood has a persistent low-level of friendly noise which we love.
We were a bit disappointed this visit that there was no TV/movie service, but Manuel responded quickly to our questions about it (despite being out of town), a repairman came, and it seems it was due to widespread construction that disrupted service. Not Manuel's fault.
A few comments about cleanliness that were not game-changers but bothered us - nice to have a washing machine, but there was no soap for it; the dishwashing cloth and sponge were badly in need of replacing & smelled so strongly of mildew we had to bag them up & purchase new; and the little collection of spices, etc. in the cupboard above the stove could use a going over......they were pretty sticky and some were too hardened to use.
We do enjoy this place!
Fantastic location!

鉄道駅からもアヌシーやシャモニーへ行く長距離バスの乗り場からも徒歩5分以内で行けて、Manorデパートから徒歩2分という便利さ。とても立地が良い。
部屋も広くて快適に過ごせました。

Delightful studio small but efficiently stocked laid out kitchen. Incredible location in the heart of Geneva, spotlessly clean, and I highly recommend

Las almohadas muy malas la verdad y la decoración casi te dan ganas de salir corriendo. La ubicación es muy buena y conveniente pero no estoy seguro que haga justicia.

We had a great stay in this apartment in Geneva. Everything went perfectly. The apartment is comfortable, well equipped, and very centrally located, making it easy to get around the city. It really felt like being at home — clean, practical, and with everything we needed for a pleasant stay. We would definitely recommend it and would happily stay here again.

Appartement propre et très bien placé

However, the thing we most appreciated was Manual's flexibility and generosity with our booking. I had to fly back to Australia early, dye to a medical emergency and he moved us to his other flat and allowed me to enter a day early without additional charge.
Very comfortable and easy stay at Manuels place. woudl definately stay there again

Nous avons passé un excellent séjour à Genève. Emplacement idéal pour les commerces à proximité immédiate, les déplacements à pied ou en transport (gare et aéroport).
Le logement proposé est propre et il y a tout le nécessaire pour cuisiner. Il manque juste une vraie table à manger qui serait à la hauteur de la cuisine très bien équipée.
