Manuel nous a permis de quitter le logement un peu plus tard pour nous permettre de partir sans précipitation.
Nous avons été ravis de notre séjour dans ce logement et y reviendrions volontiers. Merci Manuel 😊
とにかく、とても便利な最高の立地です。鉄道駅にも、長距離バスターミナルにも徒歩5ぐ分で簡単に行けます。生活に必要な物も全て揃っていて本当に助かりました。
Merci beaucoup à Kerena pour ses immédiates réponses à nos questions et pour son amabilité. Nous espérons collaborer à nouveau en 2021!
Beautiful apartment, excellent location, professional support
Amazing!!!! There are not enough words to describe how amazing and kind Daniela is. I had the most WONDERFUL stay and would recommend her any day any time.

El estudio esta perfecto, a 10 minuto del aeropuerto, tiene dos supermercados a 5 minuto a pie, para ir a ginebra centro tienes el bus 6 la parada esta justo bajando del apartamento, Daniela es muy amable aunque no la pude conocer pero siempre que le escribí me respondió inmediatamente , sin duda alguna lo recomiendo al 100.
Daniela est très organisée et a un appartement très bien situé
Nous avons passé un très bon séjour

happy to highly recommend this studio !
we are a couple & stayed for 3 days
easy to pick up the keys: Daniela provided detailed instructions, easy to use
apt hallway: super spacious for shoes, backpacks etc (we stayed after TMB so we had some gear)
apt bathroom: clean, spacious, all you need within immediate reach
apt main room:
- wifi: perfect (if you plan to work remote, it will certainly suit you)
- bed is super comfy - we needed the good sleep + bonus point: check out the view from the bed immediately when you wake you
- sofa: lounge area to enjoy after a city walk
- dining area: spacious to fit up to 4 comfortably, had breakfast & dinner
apt kitchen: whatever you want to do: all utensils are provided
bonus details:
- place is aery & bright (outside blindfolds are a major plus in Geneva, so you can control morning or afternoon light)
- within reach: shops for regular groceries, pharmacy, restaurant, bus station for city center (line 6), bus station for airport (we took line 10, around 10min walk)
overall, absolutely & thoroughly enjoyed our stay :)
Super accueil de Claire ! Appart beau et fonctionnel. Emplacement parfait et vue magnifique sur le lac. Nous reviendrons dès que possible :)

Claire's place was awesome! The apartment has so much soul, it's clean and tidy, beautifully furnished and cosy. There was enough room for the family of four (2 kids, 2 grown-ups).
Claire is a super friendly host, she made us feel at home.
The location is also superb. A quiet and peaceful city, a beautiful lake and a mountain view. If you need more attraction, you take a 15 min train ride and you're in Geneve.
Highly recommended!

Loved it! Wonderful place, nice decor, beautiful views of the lake, well equipped with everything you might need during a short stay. Such a convenient spot, at just 15 mins of train from Geneva station. We didn't meet Claire who was away but she was very friendly and helpful on the phone. 5 stars experience!
A casa da Clarie  é super aconchegante, estava bem quentinha. A vista espetacular do lago, a casa tem tudo que precisa. E a Clarie bem solícita. Transportes pertinho. Super recomendo e voltarei!

marie est très sympa et chaleureuse! le rez inférieur est le petit jardin mignon font partie de mon meilleur souvenir de Genève !

However the check in was very late (4 pm) and the apartment is a basement, so basically we were separated from the family on the ground floor only from a door and a glass wall.
The family upstairs was very noisy, the kids were crying and screaming (which Is normal ) but for us was not relaxing at all! Also Saturday morning at 8 30 the kids started playing and crying so we HAD to wake up. Unfortunately this thing was very annoying for us because we just wanted a quite place to spend few days.
Hope Mary can improve this situation and solve the problem.

L'appartement est propre, spacieux et bien équipé. Marie est très accueillante et discrète. Elle est également très réactive. Je recommande ce logement à 100m des lignes de bus gratuits grâce à la carte offerte par Marie.

Petit séjour tres agréable chez Marie ! Cet appartement est tres agréable et très bien situé pour découvrir Genève ! La literie est confortable et le lieu cosy ! Les petites attentions sont au rendez-vous.. Marie est attentive à ses visiteurs ! Envie de revenir !
Interesting place, very spacious

The flat was great, it also had a pool table which was really good for when we just wanted to relax and stay in. all in all, we had a fantastic stay and would 100% recommend to anyone looking to stay in Geneva.

Muy recomendado, Marie nos ayudó con el horario de llegada, también nos facilitó consejos para movernos por ginebra que viene muy bien, además el piso sótano es amplio perfecto para llegar de las excursiones ducharse y descansar. Super, appartement hyper spacieux, calme et très bien rénové, je recommande !
Great place and great host, very well connected and close to everything. I would come back again :)
excellent stay, large space in a good location next to a bus stop into town and from airport. clear instructions and a responsive host.

Gentilissimi e disponibili per qualsiasi informazione, lo consiglio molto anche a giovani che vogliono spendere poco per soggiornare a Ginevra

The staff is great and are pending any detail they can help with.

Nous reviendrons sans hésiter à notre prochain séjour à Genève et vous conseillerons auprès de proches aussi.
A bientôt ;)
Sympathique
Great place! The staff was very friendly and the location right next to the train station is perfect. Check in and out was a breeze. Would recommend!

Accueil agréable.
Très bon séjour, conforme à la description. Personnels sympathiques. Très propre et aucun bruit avec la gare à proximité !

A cozy hotel a short walk away from the water and from town! Also, it’s very conveniently located next to the train station, so would definitely recommend to anyone traveling in or out of Geneva by train!

These are my opinions about my May 28 - June 1, 2022 stay at ‘Valentino’s’:
Positive - the unit is well laid out, has a good sized kitchen with some amenities, a big closet, a good shower in a high tub and good bed mattress. The location is amazing as it is right beside the Lausanne train station (which has a couple of grocery stores etc.), and is a short walk to the lake.
The unit is in the ‘Residence’ side of the ‘Le Montbrillant’ hotel. The front desk desk staff members that I interacted with were all very good, especially “Alan”.
Note: the exterior noise (trains, traffic from the road and conversations of those sitting on the steps by one of the station entrances) can be a little disturbing, but the window facing that way in the bedroom has a good seal. There is a window in the kitchen that faces an interior quiet courtyard that can be left open for fresh air.
Negative - I never received any communication or replies to my messages from ‘Valentino’. During the below adventures, I was advised that he is a part owner of the hotel.
My main complaint is due to power outages in the residence. It went off on my first evening, and I had to go down to the hotel front desk to report it. Alan did something to turn it back on. A couple of hours later, the power went off and stayed off for the night. Thankfully my items that I had in the unit fridge didn’t spoil. I wrapped them up the next morning, and took them to the hotel front desk with a request that they place them in the hotel fridge. Because it was a weekend, no electrician was available. Thankfully when I returned on Sunday afternoon, Alan had been turning the power back on every time it went out. The power would periodically go off and on during my stay.
On my last full day, I discovered that the power issues had rendered my door lock inoperable. We stayed for 1 month. The place is not suitable for long-term stays and not worth 5 stars.

This airbnb was just the perfect match for us! Great location (riverside, central), very well equipped and amazing interior design. It felt like home and the coordination/communication was super easy! Thank you a lot!

Great stay! Not far from downtown and there’s a tram stop nearby you can access. The apartment was very clean and beautiful. I really appreciated how Marion was very responsive and very clear on all the directions! Definitely would stay here again.

But on the other hand, the heating was turned off when we had very cold weather, the chairs in the living room were very dirty as well as the duvets for the bed and i found a yellow one (dirty) in the wardrobe.
In regard to power cuts that others mentioned in the other reviews - It is still there when you use the washing machine sometimes and if you use the vacuum it will always turn off. Meaning that if you stay in the flat for a long time you won’t be able to vacuum. Doron did tell me that it was fixed before booking the flat, but it was not. Baring in mind I had no other appliances turned on.
Also the walls are very thin which means you will hear everything the neighbours do and a late night toilet flush can wake you up.
The sink broke during my stay and doron was not able to fix this
Doron was a great host. Very responsive to any issues.
Très bien je recommande 👍

We enjoyed our stay at Valentina's very much. The apartment is in a convenient location in Versoix and it is practical for a family with its three bedrooms. The wifi was fast which was important for us who worked from the apartment during the day.
Valentina was great as a host. Very friendly, accommodating and she replied to every message or question quickly.

After several cancellations by other Geneva hosts, this was a lifesaver. If the property is ever available again, I would thoroughly recommend it. Good location, spacious and clean. It really was excellent value for money.

It was a comfortable stay with most of the things in place. Great location at a nice price with everything at a stone's throw.

Only request is to ensure no civil work or paint work is done when guests stay.

I hope to come back soon.

Ramona was very welcoming and responsive. Whenever we needed to communicate with her, she always got back to us in a timely manner. Once when a bulb in the kitchen was gone, she immediately brought a new one so that we wouldn't feel uncomfortable.
There was a minor issue with shower, though: the water pressure was limited like drizzle and thus it took longer to take shower (the water temperature was fine).
Despite the above problem, the stay was overall super comfortable and I couldn't recommend the flat more :)
Thank you, Ramona, for making our stay in Geneva pleasant!
Location is great. Room is nice and clean. Bathroom is small but ok to use.

Even though its in 1st floor, the stairs is so tiring specially if you have big luggage, as there is no elevator, I stayed alone so I had to request help from others for my big luggage to carry it up and bring it down.
Really lovely room in the heart of the old town, romana and Laarbi where very friendly and helpful, would 100% recommend staying here, lovely place!
Really good location within the old town, easy interaction with Ramona overall great stay!

I would absolutely stay here again and highly recommend Romona’s place to anyone visiting Geneva. Thank you, Romona, for such a special and memorable stay!
Inoubliable !!!!

Great location not far from the train station and many restaurants.  Host was communicative and the apartment was well-stocked.  Would stay again!

Rachana was a great host. The flat was very nice and clean. Rachana even placed small welcome gifts in the room. All in all a great experience in Geneva.
Alles gut, typisches Business Hotel. Etwas unpersönlich mit vielen Stockwerken aber sehr freundliches8 Personal!

Clean and well appointed room in the Drake Hotel. Staff was very helpful and accommodating, location was central, and kitchen was a helpful feature. Could use some refurbishments, but perfectly functional and comfortable.

Amazing stay! The host responded quickly to my messages and was very helpful. The location is perfect and not far from buses and trains. Ottimo appartamento e splendida ospitalità

Samuel’s flat is an excellent place to stay in Geneva.  The flat is conveniently located in the center of the city, within walking distance of shops and restaurants and near the train and trolley lines.  The flat itself is quite large, with 3 bedrooms and 3 bathrooms, and has spectacular views of the city.  My wife and I enjoyed coffee out on the balcony overlooking the river.  Samuel is a gracious host — he and his partner gave helpful recommendations about the city, and left us fruit, eggs and fresh bread to make breakfast.  I highly recommend Samuel’s place!

Samuel's wife, Juliana, met us at their apartment and let us check in a couple hours early. The apartment is better than the pictures. They had great towels and robes available as well. The kitchen was well-equipped but we just made use of the Nespresso machine. Walking distance to Old Town and Hotel row on the new side along the lake. We were in Geneva for business and have already booked again for next year. Great hosts.

Other than that I would recommend staying here, especially if you have a larger group and want more space to relax.

What a beautiful night! My favorite is the small patio outside the front bedroom. The beautiful lights on the river and the breeze like magic. We will leave for the train station at 7:30. Next year I will stay 3 nights!! It’s a must so I hope your home is always available. It’s just perfect! 💗
Fabulous location and beautiful apartment. Really great hosts and very accommodating.

Nice place Samuel is very helpful!

This apartment along the Rhône is a great jumping off point for a stay in Geneva! The views from the apartment are incredible, the place is well appointed, and the location is convenient to just about anything. We’d definitely stay again!

The bathroom off the bedroom is large, and the other bathroom off the hall is a good size - showers are great and plenty towels etc.
Samuel was a good host, helping with bags, directions and taxis - great communication.

Inaccurate details in the listing, almost no communication from the host, and a malfunctioning toilet made this a less-than-ideal stay.
First, some positives include that it is in a good location, less than a 5 minute walk from the main train station Cornavin making public transportation easily accessible. The kitchen was well-stocked with plates, bowls, and pans for cooking. The space is also relatively clean and the furniture/bed are good.
There are some aspects of our stay that you should be aware of before you book this location. First, it is in the Pâquis neighborhood of Geneva known for its nightlife and as a generally busy neighborhood. This was not an issue except Friday and Saturday nights because the building you stay in is located directly next to a dance club called Mambo. If you enjoy that kind of nightlife this place will be fine for you, but if you are a light sleeper (like I am) you might run into issues. I had a very hard time sleeping Friday and Saturday nights because the music from the club comes up into the bedroom. The host did not mention the close proximity to a club in the listing. When we contacted him to make him aware of this discrepancy he basically denied the club was there.
This brings us to our second main issue which was host communication. Philippe communicated fine before we arrived, but during the first week of our stay we sent him three different questions and he did not respond. There is something wrong with the bathroom toilet chain or flapper because sometimes when you flush it the water will not stop running and you cannot flush it again until the water stops. The toilet did this for an entire night once, we tried contacting Philippe over Airbnb and his phone number in the listing but got no response. Really, that is a health and safety hazard having a malfunctioning toilet in your rental.
Be aware of these issues before you book this for your next trip to Geneva.

Une vue sur le jardin agréable côté rue le tramway peut-être un peu gênant. Une bibliothèque très hétéroclite. L’appartement est dans son jus…

Gorgeous place, much bigger than the pictures.  The location is perfect with a grocery store just down the corner and cafes and shops everywhere.  Dominique was very helpful and even popped out of his apartment when he heard me come back alone with the kids to help carry my stroller up the stairs!

Idéalement situé dans une ancienne maison de la proche banlieue de Genève très bien desservi par des transports en commun très accessibles

Dominique muito simpático e sorridente, nos recebeu muito bem e nos fez sentir em casa. Apartamento amplo com 2 quartos ótimos, chuveiro quente e cozinha bem equipada. 房子很干净很方便，值得推荐

The place is very nice, with a good location in residental and very safe area, where you can find everything you need. Airport is 15 min by bus (stop is just around the corner, very convinient to reach it with luggage). Danny's place is spacious, well equipped (all you need for longer stay) in nice building. It is on the 9th floor, and one of the greatest feature is the view and a huge balcony! Overall, I really enjoyed the stay, and I  recommend Danny's place! Danny, thank you for everything- I am sure we will meet again!

appartement bien placé.. clair..

Daniel's place is very well located, easily accessible by public transport from the airport, to the city center, and to the UN building. All shops and supermarkets for daily use are available within few minutes. Nice view from the top floor. All good! Thank you Daniel!

Daniel es un excelente anfitrión, el apartamento tiene un espacio confortable y bien ubicado con el supermercado abajo del edificio. Muy silencioso y con todo lo necesario para una estadía confortable, es muy luminoso. La vista es espectacular lo disfrute muchísimo.
Altamente recomendable...

Lo positivo:
Buena ubicación y zona tranquila, sin ruido.
Terraza agradable.
Equipamiento para entrenar (aunque no contaba con todo lo mostrado en las fotos).
Lavadora en buen estado.
Lo negativo:
El piso está bastante más envejecido de lo que aparenta en las fotos.
Sofá y asientos de terraza con muchas manchas, preferí no usarlos.
Cocina y bañera antiguas.
El propietario vive habitualmente en el piso, por lo que está lleno de sus pertenencias; el espacio en el armario fue muy limitado para mi ropa.
El estado general es peor de lo esperado por el anuncio.
El checkout estaba fijado a las 16:00, pero a pesar de avisar que llegaría a las 18:30, tuve que esperar en la calle con las maletas hasta las 19:30 porque el piso aún no estaba limpio. A cambio recibí cero flexibilidad para mi checkin.
La limpieza fue deficiente, probablemente por haberse hecho con prisas.
En resumen:
El piso cumple lo básico para pasar una temporada, pero la experiencia fue decepcionante y no repetiría.

Aussicht war großartig.
Lage ideal. Infrastruktur optimal.
Très bon séjour ! Logement propre, confortable et conforme à la description. Hôte réactif et accueillant. Emplacement pratique. Je recommande sans hésiter et reviendrai avec plaisir.
Tout était parfait !
Very good experience, thanks a lot
As described, centrally located, walkable to the train station and major sites. Excellent communication.
A bright and welcoming flat in a calm part of rue des Pâquis, 1 block from the lake. Perfectly appointed with all amenities and a welcoming host very responsive. Highly recommend.

Great location and nice flat. I don't know if we were just blind but we couldn't find any cooking utensils at all which was a bit annoying when you have a full kitchen. No pots or pans or oven trays to be found anywhere. Other than that, it was great.

The apartement was as described . Realy comfortable , full of light, and very easy to come and go with the public transportation. There were supermarkets and satisying little shops around.
we stayed for only 3 days so the small cuisine and small refrigarator was not a problem..but for longer stayings it should. To be fair, the small cuisine was fully equiped, everything was there!
THE ONLY PROBLEM I HAVE TO MENTION WAS THE LACK OF TOWELS! We were 3 persons and only grated with one per person bath towels. No one for face and hands...
We will come Geneve again and we will for sure try to be at this apartement again!

We had a wonderful stay in this apartment, which is close to the lake. Very convenient location especially with the nearby public transport, restaurants and supermarkets. We recommend this apartment to anyone looking to stay in Geneva.
Great place!
I could not fault Ed’s apartment and will happily return.
Best airbnb in Geneva! Such a great location, lovely apartment, great hosts. Can’t wait to return!
Great place to stay at a great location!

very convenient and great location, very closed to the lake, train station,shop store
Ed's place has the best location close to the water and walking distance of the main attractions. The place has basic things to make your staying comfortable. I highly recommend it.

We had an absolutely fantastic stay. The flat was easy to find and to get into. There is a grocery store down the street and plenty of restaurants nearby. Everything we wanted to see was casually in walking distance, I don’t think I would have preferred being anywhere else.
When we arrived everything was clean and prepared for us. Only slight negative was it did get a bit hot with only fans, but when you open the balcony door a good breeze comes through.
We were completely happy with our stay and wouldn’t hesitate to stay here again!

Ed's place was close to the lake which we enjoyed! there is no air conditioning but the apt had fans available which helped!
Thank you Ed!
The apartment is basic but reflects the photos. It’s in a convenient location to walk to the UN, Bain des Paquis, parks and old town.  Gio is a responsive host.

We enjoyed our stay at the apartment. It was very close to transportation and the lake. It was very convenient after a day out to walk a few minutes and spend time at the lake entertainment venues like Bains de Paquis.

Ed was a responsive and a wonderful host. There was an excessive heat warning when we visited Geneva so the apartment was quite hot however having 2 fans was extremely helpful. Thank you Ed!
Good apartment and neighbourhood only a block from the lake. Thank you
Great location for a trip to Geneva

Cute little place good location

Enjoyed our stay at Ed’s place. House was spacious and clean at a great location. Near to the lake geneva and restaurants.

It was like stepping back in time, but in a good way. Cute, clean and cosy. Luckily it has a lift to get your luggage to the top of the building.  Like in the old days a small bathroom and confined by having the washer and dryer in there. Everything you need to cook a meal and relax. Lots of books but uncluttered. Ed's place was a great place to be home base in Geneva. We were walking distance and easy access to the metro to get around and explore. It was clean and comfortable and the hosts were great resources and very friendly.
Great location. Ed and Gio are quite reactive, friendly, and thorough in their responses.

Ed was a great host- very responsive and friendly. I appreciated that I was able to check-in early! Location is perfect walking distance to the lake as well!

The title says it all. This is a fantastic flat!!

The location is excellent in a lively multicultural neighborhood but in a quiet residential building. Walkable from Geneva Cornavin railway station or by bus 1 and 25. Ed and Gio are great hosts, very responsive and friendly. We absolutely would have loved to stay much longer at this excellent place.
Ed’s place was a great location!  I loved the big bath towels and the balcony.

Super place! Would definitely stay again!

Suggest the host places a couple of electric heaters in the unit for those few nights when it would be an issue.
Otherwise, I would recommend it highly.

Tolle Unterkunft in super Lage! Appartement confortable et très bien équipé.

the house is located in city center. very accessible to all tourist spots by walk. The houe was very well equipped with everything.enjoyed the coffee ..

Appartement très joli, fonctionnel et bien placé. Nikhil est tres gentil et réactif par message.

Un appartement très propre et très fonctionnel extrêmement bien situé dans la ville.

Все дуже добре. Велике дякую. Ми почувалися як вдома, було затишно і тепло. Хоча на вулиці був холод і дощ. Якщо ви любите мінімалізм, то вам може не підійти ця квартира. Але особисто для мене було цікаво вивчити кожну маленьку деталь помешкання. Та багато книг. А також вразили стікери на кухні.

great place

Nikhil is a super host, very quick at responding.  it felt a real privilege to borrow his residence for a couple of days.
Nikhil’s place worked well for our two night stay in Geneva for 5. Whilst many of Nikhils personal effects remained in the apartment it was clean and tidy and our stay was comfortable
Appartement propre et agréable, très bien situé. Je recommande !

First, the WiFi instructions were incorrect; we had to get the password off the back of the router, which thankfully worked. Second, the photos are not accurate: there is much more furniture and clutter in the front room and kitchen than the photos indicate. Third, the place was dirty: trash bins not empty, old food in fridge, very strong smell of spices, trash bags in front of the door, iron burn marks on couch, etc. The kitchen was not usable due to the clutter and old food lying around. Overall this is a serviceable place for a short stay and Nikhil is lovely, but the place needs to be tidied as if for a subletter. It's a little hard to feel at home with so many of the owner's personal effects everywhere.
位置非常好，到火车站步行五分钟，周边有通往所有景点的公共交通。靠近湖，离超市近。房东沟通方便，回复及时。有电梯，厨房用料配备充分。没有空调，有个空调风扇，但夏天还是有点热。

Very convenient location near the train station, the bedrooms are a good size and the beds are comfortable. Nikhil was super friendly and helpful and made us feel very welcome! Overall, a great place to stay for a few days.

The host super nice, good communication and more than willing to help out. The building had a broken elevator so we had to carry our luggage up 6 flights. The host lives there and although it is nice to be a part of their lives, cleaning up personal items in the bathroom/kitchen should be done.

Nikhil is a very nice thoughtful host! He is very responsive and genuinely cares about the experience he is providing. Overall, this was a very pleasurable and memorable experience! Thank you once again for everything Nikhil!
Great stay. Thank you for having us. Easy and quick communication.

Very convenient place, next to the big mail. And Nathalie nearly have all the equipment which I needed. Quiet and clean room. Everything is prepared well and in order.

Very comfortable accommodation in an attractive part of town, with excellent public transport links to all parts of the city. Nathalie is a very kind and wonderful person, she takes care of all the details to make the guest feel comfortable.

All praise for the hospitality, you will always be offered by delicious coffee, something to eat and good chocolate, so you don't stay hungry if you arrive late at the night at the accommodation.
Clean, tidy, comfortable and warm place.
All recommendations from my side for this accommodation, I spent 14 wonderful days there and felt all the comforts of home.

Nathalie est très gentille et prend le temps de s'assurer que tous les besoins de son invité sont satisfaits.

Nathalie is a good reliable host. The flat is in a perfect place to go to Palexpo by walk, or take a bus or tram to the center (15-20 minutes).

it was a pleasant and comfortable stay for me. It is convenient for either long or short-term accommodation.  I found everything that I needed in the room and also at the house. Je suis très contente de la maison et de Natalie. J ai vraiment senti chez moi !!

No AC but there is a fan which helped enormously if you’re like me and need to be cool to sleep. Noise and light levels are relatively high but it’s a city, if you’re used to that you’ll be alright; trouble lies in if you crack the window to stay cool but what can you do. One word of caution Guard your keys!

Very nice apartment. Cannot beat convenience of the location. Apartment is in a very old building which makes you feel like you just walked out from
the pages of a book. The hosts were very attentive and helpful. The apartment was well stocked with everything you need and more. We were lucky it was available.
It’s a beautiful apartment and amazing location . Extremely clean and spacious . Well done Camille and Arthur and thank you 😊

Better than advertised. We had such a lovely time staying in the perfectly located apartment. Camille and Arthur were so helpful in stocking the apartment with crib and other amenities for our baby, which made travel so much easier. The beds were comfortable.  Apartment was cozy; felt like a real apartment with nice decorations.  One of our favorite AirBNBs we've ever stayed in.

I've been traveling to Geneva for almost 20 years and have stayed in many places--this was amongst the best.  The apartment is on one of my favorite streets, just down from the most picturesque 'place' and right next to the cathedral.  The apartment is in a charming and very nice old building that oozes charm and character.  It's spacious with beautiful windows, nice furnishings and lots of amenities.  I would definitely stay here again.

This is an amazing place. The location in the heart of old town just can’t be beat! The apartment itself is clean, functional, and spacious, and the shower is excellent. There’s a small view of the lake from the apartment, and you are literally steps from the cathedral and the many restaurants in Bourg-du-Four. We would definitely stay here again!
A great apartment in the old city. Perfect for a weekend and great to have nice drinks included!
Great place and a very nice host!
The flat is absolutely charming, the district lovely and Arthur a great host. We felt at home at once and would love to be back soon.
An outstanding apartment, in an outstandig location, and the service and communication with the owner was outstanding too :-)  In short: Highly recommended!

We loved the flat, it was very spacious  and beautifully  decorated with a stunning view. The location was fabulous!! You do hear the church bells but the windows were great at blocking out noise and they had light blocking  curtains which was a huge plus. The host was very helpful with suggestions all around and communicated promptly. With so many options to eat at we did not use the kitchen but it looked well equipped. It may have been nice to have some pods for the coffee machine as we were not familiar were to buy them but no worries a fabulous pastry and coffee shop one flight down. We would stay at their place again for sure!!
My second time at this place. Absolutely love it

Beautiful home in a delightful location. Very comfortable & quiet place, but right on historic Place du Bourg-de-Four. Numerous restaurants & cathedral nearby, plus all the charms of Old Town Geneva. Easy walk to the Lake, major shopping areas, University of Geneva etc. The flat has significant modern upgrades, but attractive vintage furnishings. As noted in the description, the apartment is up 2 flights (somewhat steep circular stairs). Arthur is very helpful & responsive. Highly recommended!

Wir waren begeistert von Arthurs und Camilles Unterkunft. Die Wohnung sah noch viel schöner aus als auf den Fotos. Sie ist sehr zentral gelegen und trotzdem hört man nichts vom regen Getummel in den Restaurants und Cafés, die direkt in der Nähe sind. Fürs Frühstück haben wir uns in der Bäckerei/Café, das sich unten im Haus befindet, mit frischen Backwaren eingedeckt.
Die Wohnung ist sehr geschmackvoll eingerichtet. Arthur und Camille haben ein Auge fürs Detail. Es war auch alles da, was man für einen Aufenthalt braucht. Von der Spülmaschine, Waschmaschine bis hin zur Kaffeemaschine, Wasserkocher usw.
Die Unterkunft können wir wärmstens weiterempfehlen und Arthur als Gastgeber auch! Er ist sehr aufmerksam und hat immer sehr schnell auf unsere Fragen geantwortet.
Vielen Dank! Wir werden mit Sicherheit wiederkommen.
Apartamento bem amplo e de extremo bom gosto. Confortável, elegante e lindo. Maravilhoso!!!
What an amazing stay at this beautiful apartment. If I return to Geneva, I will hope the place is open so I can stay!

I recently had the pleasure of staying at this beautiful apartment in Geneva's historic Old Town together with my parents. The apartment itself was spacious and well-appointed, offering ample room for my parents and me to relax and unwind. One of the highlights of our stay was undoubtedly the location. Situated in the heart of Geneva's Old Town, we were just steps away from the city's historic landmarks, charming cobblestone streets, and a myriad of local cafes and restaurants. While the apartment was undeniably on the pricier side, the experience it offered was truly exceptional. The attention to detail, impeccable cleanliness, and location, in arguably the most beautiful part of Geneva, all contributed to making our stay memorable and enjoyable. We would love to come back again in the future!

This place is absolutely convenient to access to any places of Geneva. The room is clean and neat, also specious for three of us. We definitely would like to get back this place for the next stay at Geneva.
The apartment is in a great location, walkable to the late and the local sights. Arthur was very responsive to our questions and ensured we had an awesome stay.
Thanks, Arthur!

Beautiful apartment (classic and modern combo) in pristinely preserved historic building in the center of the old town of Geneva. A very unique and authentic find on Airbnb. Would definitely stay here again.
This is a wonderful apartment on the main square in the old town of Geneva.  Coffee shops, gelateria's and restaurants are right down stairs.  It was spacious and comfortable with a full kitchen.
Charming apartment located  in the heart of Old Town Geneva. A step away from the lake while remaining nestled in the city center. The owners are very helpful and responsive.
The home was beautiful and well located, and Arthur was a great host! Would definitely recommend.

This apartment is beautiful, well furnished with fully updated kitchen and bath.  If it very well located in Geneva Old Town, near one of the principal squares. The apartment is tastefully and beautifully furnished, but still very down to earth.  Nice art. Great bed and bedding. The Old Town location means that the taxi can't pull up the door and staying here involves walkin up hills and stairs, but transportation and shopping is close by. Good communication from host, very responsive, very nice, flexible, and very clear instructions. This is one of the nicest places I have stayed through AirBnB and the price was quite reasonable for what it is. I am in Geneva a couple of times a year and will try to stay here again.

The apartment of Arthur and Camille is truly a one of a kind. And the gracious hosts are the same, friendly, super generous and so easy to communicate with. They really make you feel welcomed, even for a short stay. We fell in love with the charming space as soon as we opened the door. A beautiful entry that leads to the living room and bedroom furnished with tasteful art and antiques. The layout is spacious with large windows looking to the animated cobblestone street and the city. The modern kitchen with high-end appliances has everything you need. The open shower feels like a spa. We were very comfortable in this intimate elegant space. It felt like a dream. Thank you Arthur and Camille so much for sharing your home. Can’t wait to come back. Love your art collection.

Loved our stay! Apartment was in great location and very clean and updated. Hope to come back again.
Host Arthur was so helpful if we had questions but not intrusive. Apartment felt like someone’s well-cared for and loved home. Impeccably clean.
Thanks Arthur!
What a gem in Geneva! Impeccable in every way. The host is just as amazing as the apartment itself. Thank you again for hosting us.
It is the perfect place; I would recommend this place to anyone.

Wonderful, clean, beautiful apartment in the heart of Geneva! The host was very communicative and even gave us some great dinner recommendations in the area. Would definitely stay again/recommend to a friend.

This was our second stay at Arthur and Camille's place. The hosts are very friendly and good communicators. They accommodated our request for an early check-in and extra bedding for my daughter.
The place is amazing- the best you can find in Geneva - its location, style, and cleanliness are superb. We really enjoyed our stay and will definitely come back next time.

Camille et Arthur’s 3rd floor flat was very convenient to a range of local restaurants and up market shops. The accommodation was exactly as described and generally very quiet. The bathroom was modern, spacious with an excellent shower.
Our flight home was cancelled the day before we were due to depart however Arthur and Camille very kindly allowed us to extend our stay and were flexible with our checking/checkout times.
We had a very relaxing stay and would recommend to friends.

Author’s world class flat exceeded all expectations. Beautiful views from every window, high-end bathroom & kitchen, in the center of old town surrounded by shops, galleries & cafes. A truly unique & privileged way to experience Geneva. Looking forward to our next visit!

This beautifully furnished apartment is centrally located in the lovely old town of Geneva. It is very comfortable with a tasteful mix of old and new furnishings. Everything was very clean and well equipped. The views from the apartment are amazing with the lake in the distance and even a glimpse of the fountain. Being up in the old town the walk is uphill and the flat is on the second storey with no elevator. Great opportunity to build your muscles and well worth it. Lots of lovely restaurants close by. A gem, high recommended.
We had an amazing stay. Perfect location to enjoy Geneva. The apartment is even nicer than expected. Arthur is a terrific host. We can’t recommend enough.

It’s a really beautiful place. The listing is very accurate and clear. I would highly recommend it. I would say the bedroom would benefit from a bigger bed. For a big apartment it’s on the small side (but clearly advertised as such). The living room is huge - could benefit from a lovely big bed in there too!! So much space. Gorgeous vibe.

This was my second time staying in Camille and Arthur's apartment and it was wonderful again.  The apartment is in the best location--charming street in the Old City, right by the Cathedral and close to my favorite restaurants and shops.  It's incredibly spacious, well appointed and very tastefully decorated--really pretty views as well.  You really could ask for a better spot in Geneva.  Camille and Arthur are also the perfect hosts and make everything super easy. I will absolutely stay here again the next I'm in Geneva.

Ce petit séjour s’est très bien passé, je remercie Arthur pour sa réactivité au niveau des réponses à mes questions. L’appartement est spacieux, cosy et a un « je ne sais quoi » on s’y sent bien. J’ai vraiment apprécié les bougies et son atmosphère, le seul bémol le prix.

This was a great apartment and centrally located to everything yet quiet at night.  The apartment is very spacious with a beautiful view of trees, old buildings and a view of the lake. The apartment has lots of windows and the bathroom and kitchen are nicely renovated and clean. The host was exceptional and very helpful in making suggestions and answering questions. There’s also a great bakery next door for coffee and pastries.  We would definitely book again when traveling to Geneva!
Appartement et hôte 5 étoiles

I recently had the pleasure of staying at Arthur’s charming apartment in the heart of Old Town Geneva. Let me tell you, it was an unforgettable experience!
1. The Ambiance: From the moment I stepped inside, I was captivated by the warm and inviting ambiance. The tasteful furnishing and attention to detail made me feel right at home. Whether I was lounging on the plush sofa or enjoying a meal at the dining table, every corner exuded comfort and style.
2. Modern Amenities: Arthur’s place is a haven for anyone who appreciates modern conveniences. The kitchen was a dream—equipped with top-of-the-line appliances that made cooking a breeze. I brewed my morning coffee using the sleek espresso machine and savored it while gazing out of the window at the bustling streets below.
3. The View: Ah, the view! It’s hard to put into words how breathtaking it was. With windows open, I could hear the charm of the cathedral bells.
Thanks again, Arthur, for a memorable experience!
Excellent location and responsive hosts. Pity the neighbors are sooooo noisy. Overall it was fine.

Romain's place was a great find given the scarcity of affordable accommodation in Geneva. The instructions to get there were simple and easy to follow - however, do make sure to pay attention to the instructions about how to open the door, it is relatively simple if you follow the instruction. It is quite spacious for a studio and bigger than the cramped hotel rooms you will get for the same or greater price in Geneva. The kitchen is small but fully functional and served our needs well. The location is excellent, about 10 minutes walk to the train station and well served by the bus stops for three different bus lines within walking distance.
The walls are a little thin so do expect a bit of noise from neighbors though it generally quieted down during sleeping hours. There are large floor to ceiling windows which let in a lot of natural light, good for summer, but a little bit drafty in the winter (there is heating, but do dress warmly indoors.). Overall, I recommend!

I recently stayed at Dhel’s charming flat, steps from ITU and UN office. The space was spotless, beautifully decorated with modern Swiss touches, and the ensuite kitchen had everything I needed. The bed was incredibly comfortable.

Being in the old town is magical - the ambiance is incredible. Public transportation is very close and easily accessible. I will stay again when I’m back in Geneva. Thank you Arthur!!

The place is situated perfectly amongst beautiful shops and lovely restaurants. Would absolute stay here again!!  Thanks for starting our trip on the right foot!!

This apartment is lovely and perfectly situated in the Old Town. You need to able to walk up hills and stairs and the supermarket is a bit of a schlep. But I have stayed here twice and love it. I come to Geneva once or twice a year for work and will stay here whenever I can.
Wonderful apartment and exceptional location while being very quiet

Everything was as described and even better. Highly recommended.

We had a lovely stay for two nights in this apartment. The location is amazing with a charming cherry tree outside the windows and a view of the lake. It is also very convenient to explore the historic area of town, which was very charming.

We would definitely return if our travels ever bring us back to Geneva!

Hamid et Mireille

un appartement très bien équipé, tranquille et très bien placé au cœur du quartier des bains. Asimina est disponible, flexible et très sympathique

Appartement très agréable, bien situé, conforme à la description. Facilité de communication avec Asimina.

Really nice house! Fantastic location close to the center of the town!!! Assimina super helpful with excellent English!! Will definitely go back there.

In the opposite direction downtown Geneva (ie train station and paquis) is only about a 15 minute walk, with restaurants, grocery stores and everything else you need along the way.
The room was comfortable, private and had a nice work space and large closet. There were a few other guests while I was there but we never bumped into each other. The price is hard to beat in central Geneva.

The Geneva travel card that the host arranges also did not come through, despite me checking all my email inboxes and sending my husbands email address too. The apartment was clean enough, with clean bed sheets and appliances. Some areas were a little grubby but nothing that affected our stay. Par contre, la porte n’est pas directement sur la rue, mais dans une petite ruelle, et cela ne nous avait pas été mentionné. Il faut aussi savoir que l’appartement est au 6e étage (double palier pour chacun d’eux) d’un immeuble sans ascenseur. À éviter si vous avez des problèmes de mobilité, beaucoup de bagages ou de jeunes enfants. Par ailleurs, il n’y a pas de climatisation dans le logement, ce qui est bien indiqué dans la fiche, mais il n’y a pas non plus de ventilateur. Si vous êtes à Genève en plein été, c’est un gros problème. Enfin, la location est gérée par une compagnie et non un particulier, donc quand j’ai voulu savoir si nous pouvions arriver un peu avant 15h, je n’ai jamais eu de réponse… Dans l’ensemble, très bien malgré cela.

That is why I was really surprised to see a brand new electric fan in the apartment as I requested (it made a HUGE difference under 34 degrees weather). In addition to the nice view of the water jet, one of the greatest strengths of the apartment is its cleanliness. Everything was squeaky clean! Kudos to the cleaning lady! The place also comes with all types of equipment and kitchenware, from Bluetooth speaker to YouTube-enabled TV, from microwave to bath salt. The kitchen is the most well-equipped and well-functioning kitchen across all my Airbnb experiences! You literally could live there comfortably for weeks without needing to buy anything yourself. I would absolutely consider it next time I’m in Geneva!

loved this place, the host was super nice and responsive and helped us with all the questions we had. The place itself slept all three us super comfortable and the amenities and showers were great. It’s also ACTUALLY in the city center, so it’s super easy to get to anything. One thing I would add is that being in the city center, parking can be a bit tough. We found one street parking spot after 10 min but couldn’t park there because of the upcoming farmers market. We ended up parking in an underground garage that was a 5 min away. The garage was super nice and clean and the price wasn’t as high as we thought (20 CHF / $25 for overnight parking).

Yohann was very helpful. Allowed us to drop off luggage early and provided good advice about airport connections. The apartment was as described and functional. Some minor repairs are needed: a curtain is torn and the shower head is completely loose.
A great stay! Yohann was very helpful and accommodating.
Eine saubere und gut ausgestattete Wohnung an zentraler Lage. Sehr praktisch und gut gelegen um die Stadt zu erkunden
Je recommande totalement ! L’appartement est très bien situé et parfait pour un séjour à Genève. Les instructions pour arriver étaient très claires 😊

The place was a good and convenient location! Everything was ready when we got there. The host communicated everything very well to us. The large bed was good. The small day bed didn’t have a blanket or pillow. I found some extras in the drawer but no linens to go with it. The kitchen and bathroom were older but everything worked.
Overall would recommend!
Good
Ubicación top para Ginebra. El apartamento era un poco antiguo pero tenía todo lo necesario.
good location! there are many public transportation and supermarket nearby. There are many facilities in kitchen, but it is a bit old. Overall, it’s worthy.
Great place, nice to have a decent sized space. You pay for what you get, could of been a little more clean but we arent fussy. Super responsive host and very central

Appartement tranquille aux Eaux Vives très proche du Jet d'eau et du centre ville. Très bons restaurants sur place.
Arrivée facile et simple en autonomie.
Café et shampooing offerts par l'hôte.
Enjoyed my weekend stay here with a few friends! Small space but great location and the place has everything that we needed.
Super logement je recommande

Quiet apartment in a fantastic location.
Beds were comfortable.
The apartment is a little dated and could do with a little TLC, but for what we paid, in a very expensive city, we were pleased with what we got. The location could not be better - 2 minutes walk from the lake, and plenty of surrounding cafes and restaurants.
Yohann was a great host, very helpful and responsive to messages. Check in was simple and straightforward.

Yohann is very responsive,cooperative and friendly host. I felt home with very spacious and clean studio. Transportation, beautiful lake, restaurants, shopping are just walking distance. Will definitely come once again in future.

Gostei muito do espaço. Como passeamos durante o dia, o principal uso do apartamento é para tomar banho e dormir bem. O apto do Yohhan nos atendeu plenamente, pois a cama é grande (queen) e extremamente confortável. Yohan se prontificou com a cama extra para minha bebê. Estava tudo muito limpo e cheiroso.  Fica próximo de um supermercado, tem pizzaria encostada no prédio e locais para tomar café. Recomendo o local.

Fantastic location for a short break! So much to see and do close by, including great restaurant right next door. Extremely comfy and a great night’s sleep. Cute studio for a good price, pretty much everything we needed!

Logement confortable, calme : pièce principale spacieuse , coin chambre un peu séparé, bonne literie , la cuisine permet de cuisiner sans problème , ascenseur bien pratique pour monter jusqu'à l'appartement. La salle de bain dispose d'une baignoire lavabo et toilettes. Nous y sommes restés trois nuits et nous reviendrons dans ce logement si ça se représente . Pour les gens qui viennent pour le marathon de Genève c'est un très bon emplacement 10 min à pieds du village du marathon , pareil pour le départ et l'arrivée ! Donc très bien.  Pas loin du lac pour se balader c'est top , pareil pour prendre un café ou un apéro. En résumé bien situé.
Volveria sin dudarlo.

Very peaceful, quiet top floor studio with elevator, only a two minute walk from Geneva's landmark water fountain in Eaux-Vives neighborhood with lots of restaurants and retail as well aa easy access to major Geneva  spots.
Everything was perfect: the price (considering how expensive Geneva is), the location, the accommodations, etc. Ideal for groups of 2 to 4 people.

Joli studio bien équipé et spacieux, en plein centre-ville, à deux pas du lac. Je le conseille vivement.
La communication avec Yohann est facile et cordiale, l'arrivée se fait en toute autonomie.
L'endroit est parfait pour un séjour à Genève.
The apartment is great for a small group of people, right near the water with tons of things to do within walking distance!
ótima localização e apartamento confortável!
Appartement correspondant à la description, bien aménagé et bien situé pour un petit séjour en centre ville proche du lac. Je recommande !
perfect! book it now, you won't regret it. location, cleanliness and host all perfect
Yohann was amazing host! Super nice apartment that I will book again.

En recherche d’un logement pour un déplacement pro.
Le logement proposé était idéal et suffisant niveau équipement.
Merci beaucoup
very nice place!
It was very nice peaceful comfortable and quiet
A fantastic place to stay in Geneva. Spacious, clean, quiet, well equipped and with good transport connections. The hosts are always available and they are clear and attentive.

A great place to stay, convenient for the airport, city and rail/transport beyond. A lovely home and while we stayed n February the garden will no doubt be great for relaxing in the warmer months. Easy instructions to find and get in. A great offering from Marie and Jules.
Very beautiful and comfortable place, five stars at all levels!

Cucina perfetta e ambiente luminoso. Unico neo sono stati i materassi dei letti un po’ scomodi e delle sedie non proprio in buono stato.
Ci ritornerei.
Host sempre reattivo nelle risposte e dettagliato.

Bon séjour dans le logement. Central et facile d'accès. Le jardin est très agréable et nous y avons passé de bons moments. La cuisine est bien équipée et les descriptions correspondent. Hôtes très réactifs.
Seul bémol, le jacuzzi n'a pas pu être utilisé. Il était très sale dès le premier jour, nous avons fait attention en ouvrant la bâche mais il y avait de nombreuses saletés dedans. Marie a pris le temps le dimanche pour nettoyer le jacuzzi, mais il y avait finalement un trou et il restait encore des saletés dans l'eau. Le jacuzzi dans le jardin ne correspond plus à celui des photos.

We loved the place!!!!
Very clean, amazing location, beautiful place and Laura very helpful.
The perfect place to stay in Geneva. Comfortable, spacious and with an incredible location. Everything was as easy as possible

Wow! What a place, even better than the pictures. A very well dressed, characterful and spacious apartment in the perfect spot in old town. Open the windows and feel the energy of the city flood in. The super kingsize bed was great, and Laura was very responsive/ helpful. Overall, we really enjoyed our stay.
Laura's place was exactly as described. It was spacious, clean, and close to lots of restaurants and shops. I highly recommend her place.

L’appartement de Laura est super!
Il est très bien situé dans la vieille-ville, au centre de Genève, donc il est vraiment pratique.
En plus, la chambre est coté cour, donc assez calme. La literie et le lit sont très confortables.
La cuisine est grande et fonctionnelle.
Et il est joliment décoré.
Il n’y a juste pas d’ascenseur pour monter et descendre les valises, mais si non, c’est parfait!

Laura’s place was amazing. Super comfortable and plenty of room. It was spotless and we felt right at home. The location was ideal - walkable to everything, great restaurants right outside the door (best crepes I’ve ever had at Creperie Du Bourg De Four) and we really enjoyed the Maison Tavel museum which is local Geneva history (don’t miss the top floor which has a massive model of the city). Do not hesitate to stay here - could not be a better choice!
Loved laura’s place! Perfect location in old town. We truly enjoyed the beautiful Swiss feel and accessibility to local restaurants. Will definitely stay again!

The house is amazing: very convinient, close to bus station, but most importantly, you feel like you got in the antique but modern house: piano, carpets, furnuture look old but modern kitchen, hitech windows make it very comfortable and refreshing. We had nice time and enjoyed our stay.
Great large apartment not too far from the lake (25 mins walk by foot). Beautiful garden with fruit trees and herbs, great place to relax.
Large and clean apartment in a great location
Merci pour ce séjour très agréable

A anfitriã é muito receptiva e muito clara com as instruções de check-in, mas tenho considerações: A casa é grande mas é dividida em 3, podendo ou não haver outros hóspedes atrás de portas, na minha primeira noite houve muito barulho de conversas e bilhar no andar de baixo, e em outro dia, atrás de uma das portas, ouvi alguém batendo forte e reclamando de barulho enquanto eu estava vendo vídeo no meu celular (o volume não estava alto, mas ele se incomodou por só ter somente uma porta entre eu e o outro hóspede no mesmo andar, além de a fechadura da porta ser grande e não dar muita privacidade). As janelas do andar que eu estava eram do chão ao teto, as persianas precisavam ser sempre fechadas por conta dos outros hóspedes que transitavam pelo mesmo quintal. Acredito que morem pessoas nessa casa porque estava cheia de itens pessoais por todos os lados. Deixaram somente 1 travesseiro por cama e deixaram 1 toalha grande e 1 pequena para duas pessoas.

Very nice and comfortable apartment. Great furnitures with a nice piano.
The location was for me extremely comfortable too. Strongly recommended.

Sehr schöne Unterkunft mit Garten mitten in der Stadt, die Kommunikation bezüglich Check in und Busfahrkarten für Genf war problemlos. Supermärkte, Restaurants und Bushaltestellen in wenigen Minuten zu Fuß zu erreichen, super Lage.
Nur Personen in den unteren Zimmern sind auch bei normaler Zimmerlautstärke zu hören.

We had a great stay at Marie and Jules’ apartment. The house where the unit is situated is surrounded by a beautiful garden. Check in and out was quick and easy and we received clear instructions that helped us find the place. The house is very centrally located in Geneva. There is a nice park nearby, buses going to the train station and to the airport just 2 blocks away, several supermarkets, shops and restaurants. The kitchen is spacious and completely stocked with everything one needs to prepare meals. Communication was great right from the time of booking. We really appreciated the hosts arranging for us to get a transport pass for all of Geneva. This made is so we could take buses, trams, mouettes across the lake and local trains for free.

位于日内瓦的独栋别墅，房东提供了其中部分独立空间，每一个独立空间都可以看成一套公寓，而且面积远远大于一般房间。
别墅很美，房东应该花了很多心思。
房间里面的家具属于老派风格，很有特点很有气质，但不一定所有人都喜欢。
位置很好，到万国宫和大喷泉都可以直接步行到达，当然也可以使用业主给的城市公交卡免费链接。
推荐

Beautiful property. Instructions to the property were very detailed. Still a little confusing driving through the tight streets of Geneva. Easy to miss the gate when arriving. Very convenient location near the historic old town.

Wunderschönes Haus an bester Lage mit gut ausgestatteter, schöner Kuchen. Stadtzentrum sehr gut erreichbar und auch in der näheren Umgebung alles was man braucht (Bäckerei, schöner Park mit Spielplatz, Einkaufszentrum...). Wir haben den Aufenthalt sehr genossen.

Sou professor convidado na HEAD Geneve.
Todos os anos volto a esta cidade que adoro e já fiquei em diferentes bairros e alojamentos ao longo dos anos.
Este foi o mais agradável e sereno de todos.
Tem a distância e proximidade certa para podermos usufruir de tudo o que Geneve tem para oferecer e ainda assim poder descansar e dormir num local sossegado. A Marie é uma anfitriã excelente.
Espero que este alojamento esteja sempre que volte aqui para as aulas, pois não hesitarei em reservar de novo, pois aqui senti-me em casa.

The location is far away from the nicer sites in Geneva.
It is quite dated and the beds and bedding are uncomfortable.

The apartment is situated between the city center (7–10 minutes by bus) and the airport (15–20 minutes), and the bus stop is a 3-minute walk away.
The neighborhood is calm and has everything you need, but it’s not particularly pretty. If you’re looking for something more fancy and historic, you should consider staying in the city center.
Although you have the entire ground floor to yourself, it doesn’t feel completely private, as there are guests on the first floor as well, and you often see people passing by the windows.
The kitchen is very well equipped but strangely lacks some basic items: regular tea/coffee cups, large knives, and wine glasses or a bottle opener.
Marie and Jules were friendly enough, but without any extra hospitality. When I asked them to recommend a good restaurant for raclette, they suggested a place with a 3.9 rating that felt like a typical tourist spot.
And that’s the general impression of the house: it has the basics, but no soul.

Marie and Jules place is full of character and an eclectic array of furniture. It has clearly been a family home and is full of personal items. This may not be to everyone’s taste in a holiday home. The garden is beautiful and has lots of outdoor furniture. The kitchen is very well equipped. We had a couple of issues - the bed in the second bedroom is a sofa bed and was not comfortable. The shower over the bath was not fixed to the wall. However, I found the place to be charming and enjoyed the home from home feel.

Die Kommunikation mit Marie war einfachst; sie antwortet sehr schnell und erklärt alles Praktische recht gut.
Die Wohnung ist stilvoll eingerichtet, sehr einladend, und vor allem herrlich ruhig-kaum zu glauben wie zentral sie liegt. Die Verkehrsverbindungen sind 1A, besser geht es nicht (5 Gehminuten zur Bushaltestelle, auch auf der Linie zum Flughafen). Ein Einkaufszentrum mit allem Möglichen liegt ggbr von der selben Haltestelle-also urpraktisch.
Ein grosser Gewinn ist der Garten, eine Grunoase mitten in der Stadt-herrlich zum Entspannen (war zum Arbeiten in Genf).
Nachteile gibt es an dieser Unterkunft keine, höchstens der Mangel an einer wandmontierten Dusche bzw. die hohe Seiten der Badewanne-für ältere Herrschaft wenig geeignet. Es kann auch sein, daß weitere Gäste in der darunter befindlichen Whg recht laut werden aber das ist sicherlich die Ausnahme. Sehr zu empfehlen.
Logement conforme à la description, superbe jardin et terrasse dont nous avons profité tout le week-end.

Très beau séjour chez Marie et Jules.
Un endroit intime avec beaucoup de végétation.
Une maison propre et chaleureuse.
Des hôtes proactifs avec de la facilité à communiquer.

Great stay, spaceous, clean, everything at hand and clear instructions. Even though it was over 30 degrees outside, the apartment stayed relatively cool without airco thanks to the outside window blinds.
Note wrt privacy/security: sharing the same lockbox and keys for the different accomodations might not feel safe for everyone.
Thank you Marie & Jules, I had a lovely stay!
Lovely place to stay. Highly recommend
Good place to stay. Highly recommend.
Great place to stay! Very nice and sweet host☺️
Very friendly host, room exactly as in the description, walking distance from the airport and surprisingly quiet room and quiet location. Highly recommended.
Kevin and his family was a very good host, the location of the house is only 15mins to the airport. Room is very tidy and quiet!
Logement très correct
Everything good. I recommend! Thanks for hosting me :)
Muy respetuosos y amigables. Muy serviciales y atentos a lo que necesitaba. Fue una buena experiencia!
Amazing location, great facilities and hospitable host!
Everything was fine! Quiet neighborhood. Very friendly and helpful host. Stayed there for 12 days, and I would definitely come back!
Lovely stay. I stayed with Angeline, Kevin’s Mum. She was very hospitable and largely left me to my own devices, which I appreciated!

J'ai été très bien accueillie par Mme Angeline, qui vit dans le logement. La chambre était spacieuse. J'ai pu utiliser la cuisine et le lave-linge pendant mon séjour. Le bus est à 5 minutes à pied pour se rendre dans le centre-ville.
Great host, very friendly and helpful! Helped me find my way around a city I hadn't visited before! Perhaps a bit of decluttering of the room would further enhance the stay.
Je recommande le logement proposé par Kevin chez sa Maman. J'ai beaucoup apprécié y vivre ces deux derniers mois. Merci beaucoup pour cette opportunité !
Great family, super friendly and great hospitality!
Great place to stay. I recommend this place.

Kevin and Angelina were very kind to allow my earlier check-in, and I am thankful to Angelina for lending me her umbrella for the whole week. The house is close to WHO and  UNOG，3 stops by Bus  22 to WHO and 4 stops to UNOG after you walk to the bus stop of Bus 22 (about 10 minutes walk). There is a Bus 3 nearby, which is the closest bus stop, within 5-8 minutes walk, and it can take you to Gare Cornavin to connect to other buses, trams or trains.  If you come from airport, take Bus 10 only, and avoid Bus 53 connection. Although the walking distance by Bus 10 is minutes longer,  you can avoid the muddy pebble stone path after getting off from Bus 53 while carrying two trolley cases. The house is not highly sound-proof, so be very very careful when opening and shutting doors so that you don't disturb Angelina, who is a light-sleeper, especially in the morning when you get up early. If the beddings are cleaner and the bedroom chair surface not broken, this place would be even better.
We had a lovely stay in her apartment

Die Unterkunft hat eine Top-Lage, nah an der Promenade. Die Restaurants in der Umgebung sind super, unter anderem das beste Fondue-Restaurant der Stadt!!!
Auch gibt es genügend Supermärkte in der Nähe und mit dem Parking Prieuré eine sensationell günstige Tiefgarage mit Wallboxen für Elektroautos. Das Laden ist in den Parkgebühren enthalten.
Einziger Wermutstropfen, wie überall in guter Lage: Besoffene nachts auf der Straße, die grölen und anderes tun.
Wer es also ruhig will, sollte entweder Oropax dabei haben oder irgendwo außerhalb eine Wohnung buchen.
Súper cómodo y bonito 🤗👍🏻

It was our first visit of Geneva as a Family and we loved every day of our week. Mary’s place is perfectly located and spacious enough for us 3 with two independent double bed room with windows on a quiet street, Rue de Richmond. We had a dinner and few lunches at Remo’s place, the Fornello Napoletano restaurant which is just around the corner and serves good italian food carefully prepared. Our walks in the city & along the lake made great memories in the first days of November 2023. Geneva is a lovely place to visit with family and friends, and this is a good address to keep. Thank you Mady🙏🏻

It was ok, the area is not the best and the building was really dark. But the apartment is warm in winter, the shower was great and the kitchen was small but functional.
The apartment has a big room and a smaller one. The big one was cozy but the small one not so much. It has no washing machine or oven, which is ok, but just so you know. It had a hairdryer. The TVs worked perfectly.
It was more or less clean, there were some weird yellow stains in the bathroom’s cabinet, but otherwise it was ok.
Be careful and don’t stain the towels or sheets, the owner told us off for leaving some non-permanent dye on them, which goes off once you wash it. But again, there is no washing machine so idk how we were supposed to clean them.
Sehr zentral

The apartment is central and well located.
Description is incorrect: only one bed is 160x200. The second one is 140x200, contrary to the description.
Communication with the host was nonexistent: asked for a baby bed in advance, found it missing upon checkin, alerted the host; no reply - had to sleep with a newborn, which is super dangerous. Realerted the host on the second day; no reply. Found the baby bed in the lobby on the second day without any heads up that someone would come to the apartment.
Flat is exactly as described. Good location. Host quickly provided cot after it was absent when we arrived.

Séjour Agréable à Genève.
Néanmoins, quelques fausses notes sur le logement...
(907€ pour 3 nuits)
Seul un des 2 lits est de bonne qualité, il n'y a pas 2 lits de 160 mais seulement un.
Pas de sèche cheveux, manque de la vaisselle,pas de nécessaire cuisine (sel poivre huile)
Pas de balai pour entretenir un minimum pendant le séjour,pas de torchon cuisine.
À noter que le logement est au 2eme étage d'un immeuble ou se trouve un club au rez de chaussée, plutôt bien insonorisé,mais non précisé dans l'annonce..
La communication est quasi inexistante,le ménage à l'arrivée est "fait",mais il y a des choses à améliorer.
Nous doutons que qqun vive dans le logement...
Tarif et annonce à revoir,selon nous.
Super séjour

Laura’s apartment was absolutely fabulous! She has exquisite taste & it was a treat spending time in the living room with tons of natural light. Great for working remotely: lots of desk space, fast wifi. Slept so well in the quiet king size bed. Close to the student area with lots of restaurants & bars. Had everything you would want for a stay. Laura was very accommodating & responsive. Would stay again in a heartbeat!

The apartment has an amazing location within the old city so all the restaurants are walkable. It is a happening area with a lot of shops. The apartment itself is spacious and well designed. Laura is a good communicator and is always available in case any help is required.

Great location at the heart of Geneva old town! Good restaurants and amenities nearby. Spacious apartment that was very well designed! Felt right at home and enjoyed our stay! Perfect for our first time in Geneva! Hope to return someday!
Thanks so much, Laura!

This apartment is in a great location right in the historic old town square, with a nice living room view down the street, and walking distance from many great sites. The apartment is spacious, very clean, and cozy. Laura was proactive about making sure my check-in went well, and was flexible in letting me in early due to my morning arrival flight. This was a business trip for me, so I didn't use the kitchen at all, or spend too much time in the apartment, but I enjoyed it. One minor note for those who might care is that the living/dining room lighting is quite dim, so if you are someone who prefers bright light for evening activities in the living space, or to do Zoom calls with people overseas during US/Asian business hours, you might find it too dark. But it's certainly romantic and cozy!
Great location. I did find that the bedroom is smaller than it appears in the photos and there is no place to store your clothes.

Great apartment in a fantastic location close to the university. Bigger than the pictures show, and the space was much appreciated. Within easy walking distance of many cafes and shops, as well as the lakeshore. Would highly recommend!
Really pleasant stay!

Très bel appartement avec une pièce à vivre spacieuse . Déco chaleureuse avec une vraie âme qui fait revenir aux sources d’AirBnB (plutôt que des lieux impersonnels ) . Emplacement imbattable au cœur de la vielle ville , avec chambre sur cour au calme .
Laura très facilement joignable et réactive .
Bref logement à recommander à 100% .
Great spot. Owners are very trusting. Cigar shop downstairs. Great spot. Cool view. Would live there. Great spot.

Sehr angenehmer Aufenthalt, die Wohnung liegt in einer wunderschönen Umgebung mit vielen Restaurants und ist trotzdem nachts ruhig, da das Schlafzimmer zum Hof liegt. Liebevoll eingerichtet, man fühlt sich sehr wohl. Da ich nur kurz da war, habe ich die Küche nicht genutzt, aber es scheint alles da zu sein, was man braucht.  Klare Empfehlung!

Utterly charming apartment with lots of space in a terrific neighborhood.  The apartment is located in a vibrant area of the old town, swimming in restaurants and cafes.  The apartment itself is surprisingly spacious and airy, and well-appointed.  The bedroom has a (true) king bed, and is comfortable.  The apartment is charmingly and personally decorated, giving it a real "home" feel.  Only potential downside (which is made very clear in the listing) is that it's a 3rd floor walkup, so if you had tons of luggage or questionable fitness, this might not be for you (but the stairs are wide and easy and in a pleasant courtyard).  Would recommend!
G
Great place, nice location in the old city center. Large apartment, cozy and well equipped. Laura is kind and allows us a late check-out.

J'ai passé un excellent séjour dans cet appartement à Genève. L'appartement était parfaitement propre et bien rangé, offrant un cadre agréable et confortable. Situé en plein cœur de la ville, il est idéal pour découvrir Genève, avec de nombreux points d'intérêt à proximité.
L'hôte a été tout simplement parfaite, très réactive et attentive à mes besoins, elle a fait en sorte que mon séjour se passe au mieux. Je recommande vivement cet appartement spacieux pour un séjour à Genève, c'est un excellent choix. Merci Laura 🙂
super sejour en plein coeur de la vieille ville de Geneve pendant les festivités de l'escalade. L'appartement correspond totalement a la description et est super bien placé et decoré avec gout.
Lieu super accueillant, chaleureux et central. On s'y sent comme à la maison !

Laura's place was great! Right in the center of the Old Town, bright, beautifully decorated (you can tell someone lives there, it's not an airbnb-only location), very comfortable bed. Laura herself was incredibly helpful and accommodating. Would love to stay with her again in the future.
Très bonne nuit passé là-bas,  facile d'accès et quartier paisible. Beau salon et joli décoration. Lit confortable et chambre calme. Rien à redire. Merci pour ce séjour

We had an excellent stay at Laura’s place! It is a great location! Right by la Place du Bourg de Four. The apartment is also super charming and warm. So much character and personal touches. The bed was very comfortable as well! It is located on the third story and you will need to walk up the stairs.
We only stayed at Laura’s one night, wish it could have been longer. Lovely home and the area is very quaint.

Cet appartement est une perle ! Et Laura est une hôtesse remarquable. Le logement est idéalement situé, très lumineux, très bien équipé, joliment décoré et la chambre est tout à fait au calme. Grâce à la réactivité de Laura et à son merveilleux appartement, notre séjour s'est parfaitement déroulé.
Logement en vieille ville, pratique, fonctionnel et avec beaucoup de cachet.
Je recommande vivement ce logement ! Proche de plusieurs restaurants, hôte très gentille et réactive, appartement vraiment bien agencé et très beau ! J’y retournerai sans hésiter !
Laura is a lovely host and has gone above and beyond to host at short notice - amazing location if you really want a taste of old town Geneva life - great cocktail bars close by !!
Excellent location in old town center! Cozy apartment with good taste! Thanks Laura!

J’ai passé un séjour Fabuleux !!!! L’appartement de Laura est merveilleux, très bien décoré, extrêmement propre, le lit immense et très confortable.  Je recommande à 1000% et j ai hâte de venir à nouveau . Merci Laura 🙏🏻💫

The perfect base to explore the most beautiful part of Old Town Geneva. Could have stayed for much longer as it felt so easy to stay here. Apartment is a real gem and puts you right in the heart of Geneva.
Laura was terrifically kind, flexible and helpful. Her place is gorgeous with beautiful morning sun.  Highly recommend.
Great stay! Would certainly recommend!!
Tout était parfait, un grand merci
A wonderful, spacious apartment in a central location close to some lovely restaurants. The coffee Laura left for us was delicious too! We Highly recommend.
Alles top! Prachtig appartement op een top locatie!
Nous remercions Laura pour l’accueil chaleureux que nous avons eu au sein de son somptueux appartement… nous y reviendrons, c’est certain ! Merci, merci et mille mercis à Laura, sincèrement !!!

L'appartement est encore plus beau et plus grand que sur les photos! Tout ce dont on peut avoir besoin y est.. Literie haut de gamme incroyablement confortable et la chambre est vraiment au calme côté cour... vraiment une très bonne nuit de sommeil... on se sent comme à la maison et Laura est extrêmement gentille. Perfect stay at Laura's place. Great location, Laura was very responsive and also very flexible with our timings.
