Staying with Nina and her dog Olaf was the highlight of my solo trip to Geneva. Nina was lovely and gave me lots of advice on places to go in the city and even walked me to the bus stop with Olaf when I was unsure. Olaf is such a bundle of joy and will lift your spirits instantly ☺️
Having breakfast with Nina made it even more special and I miss those apricot pastry’s ! Nina’s apartment and the room is the perfect place close to the city centre with easy transport links ! Highly recommend to anyone visiting Geneva and in particular any solo female travellers.

My time with Nina and Olaf was like visiting family! It instantly felt like home. Nina took great care of me and made that I do not miss anything. The place is very clean and the mattress is simply amazing! I haven’t slept at home as well as I did at Nina’s. The fruit basket and the snacks, the tea and the coffee in the room, and all the great attention to detail make Nina a host like you rarely find today! I will always come back! For dog lovers, Olaf is going to stay in your heart forever.

Nina was the greatest host we could have asked for! Her warm and welcoming demeanor made us feel like we were at home right away, and that feeling stayed for the entirety of our stay. She provided us with a clean and comfortable room and went above and beyond making sure we had everything we could possibly need and more! The breakfast she prepared was delicious and despite our slight language barrier, we had a great conversation over our meal together. Olaf was an awesome added bonus and was a great housemate/playbuddy! We will miss Nina dearly and recommend her highly to anyone looking to stay in Geneva. Thank you, Nina!

Nina treated us very well throughout the stay. The breakfast was a great surprise. Nina introduced us about how wine is prepared in winter. Olaf is a very active dog who likes cheese, the way it glanced when it saw us eating cheese is priceless 😆.
Definitely a great and enjoyable stay.

Nina was very kind and friendly, in her flat I felt like at home. Everything was perfectly cleaned, the room was quiet and cosy with little coffee and tea bar like at the photo, also with plenky of fruits. I had my baby daughter with me, so Nina prepared especially for us baby changing place and even baby chair. I was really sad that after 4 nights we have to say good bye to her and her dog Olaf. And Nina´s breakfast and dinner? Wonderfull. For me the best Airbnb experience at all.
Es war ein wunderschöner Aufenthalt bei Nina & Olaf (Hund). Sie ist äusserst liebevoll und sehr zuvorkommend. Immer wieder gerne ☺️

Nina was a very communicative host. She welcomed us warmly, even offering to meet us at the bus stop when we arrived. She served us an amazing breakfast one day. Her dog Olaf was super sweet and calm.
Even though we shared a bathroom, there were no problems because Nina is a considerate and very tidy host. The room is cozy, has a fridge, coffee, and a very comfy bed. We had a wonderful stay with her.

5 stars is not enough to rate my stay here. The Airbnb was accurately described, and in a great location. Nina’s place is very close to the bus stop, so it’s an easy walk. The Airbnb was very clean, but there are shared spaces such as the bathroom, kitchen, and shower room. However, this did not bother me at all. I very much enjoyed my stay with Nina. She is such a sweet, kind person. She met me at the bus stop with Olaf, her sweet dog, and walked me back to the Airbnb. She even offered to make me dinner. She made me breakfast the day before I left and offered me some toast the morning of my departure. I felt like I was staying with family. Nina is so warm and welcoming!! I hope to come back and stay with her. I also enjoyed Olaf, as it felt like home having a dog in the apartment. One night while eating dinner, Nina tried to teach me some French. We had a good laugh at this. It was a lovely memory I will hold dear to my heart. Book your stay now!!!

Staying at Nina's home is such a pleasure, Nina and her dog Olaf will make you feel very welcome, and the room is clean, tidy and has everything I need. Nina was also very helpful in providing  me with a lot of information so that I could get to her place without any problems. Overall, it was a great experience, and I had a lovely time staying with Nina!!! 🥰🥰

My husband and I had the most comfortable stay at Nina's. Room was lovely, shared space was well respected and Nina went out of her way to help us. She walked me to a restaurant on our first night and was always checking in. We loved Nina's warm personality and Olaf! Hope to come back someday and truly explore the city.

Una estada meravellosa plena d’hospitalitat
La nostra estada aquí ha estat increïble! La generositat i l’hospitalitat de la nostra amfitriona han fet que aquest viatge sigui molt especial i significatiu. Ens hem sentit molt ben cuidats, i cada detall ha reflectit la seva calidesa i amabilitat.
Si busqueu un lloc on no només allotjar-vos, sinó també sentir-vos com a casa, aquest és el lloc perfecte. No podem recomanar-ho prou i esperem que moltes més persones puguin gaudir d’aquesta experiència tan única.
Gràcies de tot cor a la Nina i a l’Olaf!
Nina is very friendly, replicable and communicative person. The place she organised let guests feel like home, highly recommended to whom want spend some time in that area.
Très bon séjour , chambre fonctionnelle et calme, très bel accueil de Nina, proche à 5 min. à pieds des transports public, le chien Olaf est très gentil avec un poil très doux à caresser.

Nina fue una anfitriona maravillosa. Muy comunicativa desde el principio, creando una relación de confianza para nuestras necesidades. La habitación era cómoda, limpia y encantadora. Sin duda volveríamos a este lugar.

I was here for a short holiday, Nina had clear instructions for the bus stop/ticket. She even met me there with Olaf. She is very friendly and considerate. Made me feel right at home. Everything was just as described and she even made me breakfast. She has such a sweet soul. Hope to stay with her again soon!

니나는 제가 지금까지 만난 호스트 중에 가장
친절하고 다정한 호스트입니다. 그녀는 저희를 위해 물과 과일을 비롯한 웰컴 푸드를 준비해주었습니다. 또한 그녀가 준비해 준 조식은 정말 최고입니다:) 그녀는 글루텐 알레르기가 있는 저를 위해 글루텐 프리 음식을 준비해주었습니다. 덕분에 저는 아주 맛있는 조식을 든든하게 먹을 수 있었습니다. 조식을 먹으며 그녀와 대화를 나눴던 순간을 저는 오래도록 기억할 것 입니다! 제네바는 체르마트를 가기 위해 들른 곳이었는데, 니나 덕분에 체르마트보다 제네바에 대한 기억이 더 좋게 남았습니다. 만약 제가 제네바에 다시 간다면 저는 무조건 니나의 집을 다시 방문할 것 입니다.

This was our first home stay and I don't think it will ever be matched.   Nina and Olaf were amazing hosts, friendly, welcoming, delightful 😊.   We had everything we could wish for and more, Nina was so kind and obliging and provided everything you needed without hesitation.   The bus stop was a few minutes walk away and Nina took us there on our first day.  She provided breakfast for us one morning and it surpassed our expectations.  If you are going to Geneva you couldn't find a better place to stay.  I would highly recommend staying with Nina.

Nina and her dog Olaf are amazing! If you have the opportunity to stay with them I highly recommend. They are wonderful! Nina is the sweetest and most kind host. She even made us breakfast and gave us a fruit bowl which was amazing to come back to after hiking/exploring Switzerland all day! We had a lovely stay!

Mi esposa y yo pasamos unos dias en Ginebra y nuestra estancia donde Nina ha sido excelente. Todo estaba muy limpio y ordenado, es una anfitriona muy agradable, amable, familiar y espléndida. Su mascota Olaf es encantador y cariñoso. Recomendamos totalmente hospedarse donde Nina.

Je recommande à 200%.
Hôte accueillante, très sympathique et aux petits soins.
L'emplacement est très bien desservie en transport. Très proche de l'aéroport.
Un des meilleurs airbnb où j'ai séjourné.

I very much enjoyed my stay at Nina's apartment. Nina was easy to communicate with and she went out of her way to provide clear instructions and recommendations during my trip. A very kind host who provided a lovely breakfast! Olef, her pet dog is friendly too. The room was super clean and a nice comfy bed. I would happliy stay with Nina and Olef again.

Absolutely recommend the place if you are travelling solo. Guilherme is very gracious and he even offered me late check out because no booking was there. The room is okay for a single person and the house is very close to public transport. Guilherme also provided the free public transport pass for my stay.
Was great to stay at Guilherme’s place, very close to the centre, comfortable and exactly like advertised. He was able to give good tips on what to visit and where to eat.  Recommended!
A really lovely, cozy house in a great location ❤️
Convenient location in Geneva. Clean apartment with all amenities. Noisy neighbourhood but central.

Great and very convenient location- short walk to the Gare and very central to cafes and restaurants.
Nice decor!
Veldig bra opphold, og god kommunikasjon.
Alex is brilliant host and helpful as well. The room is cool and location is near to the city center. I do recommend the place to who is planning to be near to the main station.
Host is very kind and has resolved the concern immediately. Location is also convenient to access shops and transportation.

Alex is a responsive super host who attended to details ensuring his place is clean and well appointed.
His place has easy access to the lake, public transport, groceries, restaurants, and barber shops.
We’ll definitely return.
Thank you, Alex.

Posizione strategica in quanto vicino alla stazione e al lago. Quartiere rumoroso di notte perché si trovano molti ristoranti lungo la strada.

Nice place - had all required amenities.  Clean and convenient.  Only issue is that in the evening with the windows open , it is loud, since it is above a restaurant.

This listing is new and the host is welcoming. Great value for money in a convenient and accessible location near restaurants and transportation. This spot is sure to improve as the owner becomes more accustomed to Airbnb and what’s expected. Overall a positive stay.

The apartment is exactly as described and shown in the photos. Clean, organized and very cozy.  In an excellent location. Close to tourist attractions within a short walking distance. The hostess is very kind and is always willing to resolve any issue you may need quickly and efficiently. I definitely recommend it. And when I return to Genve I want to be able to stay here again.
todo perfecto
Great location, nice place and a lovely host.

Excellent logement

Great location and met our travel needs.

I would probably book this place again if I visited Geneva a second time. It has an excellent location for exploring the city. Right next to the train station, and with tram and bus stops literally on your doorstep. Plus walking distance to the lake promenade and all the major sights. Plus it’s a 6th floor apartment, south-facing, so lots of light and views.
Guests should be aware that the place is a bit worn though - furniture in need of repair, parquet flooring needing replacement, no shower wall fixture, cracks and stains everywhere.
Also, if you’re a light sleeper, be aware that it’s on a busy road, in the centre, so despite being high up you’ll hear traffic, tram bells, talking. I didn’t mind since it was background noise to me. The bed was comfy, which helped.
Check-in was also far from ideal. After send rather insistent messages making sure I don’t arrive after 9pm, the host then ignored my calls and messages once I arrived. I had to wait over half an hour outside.
Great location and very responsive host - would stay again!
Great location, close to the Gare Cornavin, a major hub for transportation. Good value.

Good-sized apartment on the top floor of a block very close to Cornavin railway station (pretty much the centre of Geneva).  This means that it is handy for public transport and a wide variety of cafes and restaurants as well.  Good view out over the city rooftops towards the hills to the south.  Being in the city centre there is a bit of traffic noise but it dies away at night.
Over all it was the perfect spot to be for someone new to the city!
Appartement correspond à la description, proche de la gare

The apartment was large with awesome windows letting in the light and giving you a fabulous view of the city and the mountains.
The shower/bathtub had plenty of hot water.
The location couldn’t have been better for exploring the city! Although it was on the tram and trolley line, the double pane windows did a good job of blocking out the noise below.
The one comment to note is the lack of upkeep. Not as clean as could be and for the money, one shouldn’t have to tighten screws to keep door handles from falling off etc. As previously commented in other reviews, it’s not because the building is old it is that the suite itself is poorly maintained. Light bulbs are hanging by wires from the ceiling, floor boards are broken and taped, door handles are loose etc.
BUT…. Having said that, we would rent from her again if we returned to Geneva. The suite was comfortable overall. With a little TLC, it would be even better!!

It was wonderful to stay in your apartment. Accessibility, privacy and cleanliness were some of the hallmarks of my stay. I have decided to come back here again, that’s how much I liked it here. Thank you Cameron !

Beautiful place, stunning views, very clean.
The internals need maintenance work with overhead lights hanging from cables, flooring and door handles held in place by tape. Coordinating the checkout time with Cameron was difficult, though that can be attributed to the Air BnB translator.

The host was very accommodating and allowed early check-in. While the apartment's furnishings and layout could benefit from some updates, the central location near the train station offers beautiful views of the old city and mountains.​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​

El apartamento de Cameron es muy amplio, acogedor, y estratégicamente ubicados tienes todo al rededor desde super mercados hasta tiendas, Cameron fue muy amable con el checking,  recomiendo el lugar 100 %

Posizione centrale, ottimo appartamento dotato di tutto. Non è stato difficile nemmeno trovare parcheggio per la macchina. Vicinissimo alla stazione centrale. Cameron sempre disponibile rispondeva subito ai messaggi. Ottima esperienza
I had a wonderful stay.

We have stayed at Cameron’ place for six days in April. 非常棒
tout était conforme à la description. Literie impeccable et calme absolue. A Genève ça vaut son pesant d'or.Marion est réactive et sensible aux questions. Je recommande à 200%
Je recommande. Très conforme à l’annonce. Marion est une hôte très à l’écoute, flexible et facilement joignable. Séjour très agréable :)

Appartement super, bien placé, avec grande terrasse idéale lorsqu’il fait beau.
Marion est très accueillante et ne manque pas de bonnes adresses à Genève. Je recommande
Marion’s apartment was in a wonderful location and very clean. Easy access to downtown Geneva, and she was very helpful, flexible, and went above and beyond to ensure that we had a great stay.
Very clean and well located apartment. The outdoors space is a bonus.

Marion's place was exactly in the location I needed, and it was perfectly laid out for a small space. The small terrace is a fantastic added benefit in this part of town. The bed was super comfortable and the space well heated so it was cosy and felt like home. I will very happily return if I can find dates available! Don't hesitate to book if you are looking for a cosy place at good value in this part of town.

We thoroughly enjoyed our 4 nights in Marion's apartment. It was clean, safe, comfortable, quite and peaceful, and had everything we needed.  It is super easy to get to from the airport - 1 short bus ride for 3 Euro and a <5 minute walk. The view from the balcony is lovely. It is a short walk/run to the Rhone or to the old City and the lakeshore. The wifi in the apartment is excellent. Marion was welcoming and friendly, and was available to answer questions if needed. We were blessed with great weather on all four days, and were able to use the balcony every day. In short, we had a wonderful stay and will repeat it if we ever get the chance. Thank you Marion.
moderne Wohnung in einem Altbau, sehr schön, immer gerne wieder.
merci pour tout ! parfait
Is really a nice and clean place to stay and I won’t hesitate anytime am in Geneva.
beautiful, modern and clean apartment in the heart of Geneva. Thanks for a great stay!

Un appartement très agréable !

bel appartement, chaleureux, proche du centre et de l'université. décoration simple et épurée. accès facile. arrivée et pratique (boîte à clef) je pense très certainement revenir dans l'année.
Great location, nice touches inside the house… could be cleaner but we had great time.
Nice place for a stay in Geneva. Very close to a tram line and the Arve river. The place was nice and clean!

Un apartamento muy bonito cómodo y súper tranquilo. Sin duda volvería ahí.

👍Philippe is a very friendly and helpful host who responds to messages fast. He even sent us free public transportation pass for the stay duration and was always ready to help.
👍The apartment is quiet and clean.
👎The flat is really small, especially the bathroom. To use the sink you need to stand in the shower floor which is inconvenient.
👎The entrance to the flat is through a basement and the description of the place doesn't mention this information. In my opinion, it should be written.
👎The WiFi was super slow and even sending an email was a challenge as the connection was poor most of the stay.

Esperienza molto sgradevole, mai cosi poteva neanche farsi un piatto di pasta! La porta di entrata è nella zona cantine con accanto i secchioni della spazzatura del palazzo che puzzavano. Dentro ho scoperto tante magagne: 1) Le lenzuola esternamente erano macchiate e dentro c’erano tanti capelli/peli (ne ho trovati anche in altre zone della casa); 2) In cucina NON c’erano gli attrezzi minimi per cucinare.Ho dovuto accontentarmi di un pentolino da latte (l’unico che funzionava con le piastre elettriche) e dei coltelli da tavola per tagliare (e non tagliavano quasi nulla!). Impossibile fare anche solo un piatto di pasta!
Host pessimo: il primo e il secondo giorno ha risposto dicendo che sistemava tutto subito. Invece non ha risolto nulla (ha fatto cambiare le lenzuola, anche queste con peli e capelli) e non ha equipaggiato la cucina; dopo i primi 2 giorni NON ha piu’ risposto ai miei messaggi. P.S. ho chiesto ad AIRBNB di tutelarmi rimborsandomi il 50%, ma la loro policy non aiuta.
Great place
Lieu très propre et calme, très bien situé. Hôte très réactif. On recommande.

the flat is OK for visiting Geneva because of its good location, however there are a few things that I think need improving
- WiFi is based on a phone hotspot which was not on/working for us for two days. Was eventually sorted the day before we left but I think a guide on things to check would be nice
- there are no cooking utensils and only one of the pots works on the hob. This made it harder to cook our own meals which was largely the reason we went for this place.
- the curtain fell down during our stay, which thankfully there are shutters so we weren’t exposed.
With some small fixes like the above this place could be a great place to stay as Philippe is a good attentive host who was doing his best to help with the WiFi while we were there. Thanks

We felt as staying in our own house. Very responsive and offered Swiss breakfast and dinner. As we reached second day she took us to main train station for booking my reservation . For laundrette also she accompany us. We enjoyed our stay over there.

Não existe anfitriã melhor! Apartamento próximo a mercado, restaurante e transporte público, com muita privacidade.
Espaço altamente organizado e limpo, o café oferecido foi espetacular, atenção redobrada comigo e com minha esposa.
Fiquem nesse Airbnb, custo/ benefício espetacular em Genebra!

Wow, such heartfelt thanks to Nina for being our gateway at the end our incredible trip. We were made to feel wholeheartedly at home by her and Olaf, her lovely pup. She gave detailed directions to her place and patiently made sure we could travel throughout the city by bus and rail. The breakfast she made for us was delicious and artistically set with her view of the mountainous backdrop for Geneva. Her place, herself and her pup sparkle.  Ten stars out of five!
A wonderful person and a beautiful apartment

Desde que hicimos la reservación (varios meses antes de nuestro viaje) Nina siempre estuvo pendiente de nuestra estancia. Al llegar a su casa, nos recibió con una canasta de fruta. Al día siguiente nos preparó un delicioso desayuno y nos dio recomendaciones de lugares para visitar. Al día siguiente salimos, ya que solo estuvimos un día en Ginebra y a pesar de salir a las 6:30am, ella y Olaf se despertaron para despedirnos.
Nina es una persona muy agradable y atenta, muy organizada y limpia. Y Olaf es muy lindo, obediente y juguetón. Nos encantó pasar el tiempo ahí y sin duda volveríamos a hospedarnos con ella.

Nina was an amazing host. She was the highlight of our trip to Geneva. She met us at the bus stop and accompanied us to her place. She even provided us with breakfast one morning. Her place felt very clean and it was close to the bus station. We would highly recommend this stay.

Nina was a fantastic host! She provided clear instructions that helped me to find her place and was flexible with my check in. The space was just right for the few days I was in Geneva. She provided several additional bathroom items, snacks, waters, etc. to make sure you are taken care of. She even cooked breakfast for me which was a nice treat.
Gastvrij onthaal, zeer schoon

Her place was clean and well l-stocked. Staying with Nina and Olaf was truly the highlight of our time in Geneva. We would happily come back. Thank you Nina!

This is the ideal place for a single woman traveling alone.

Nina was full of information and tips for my experience in Geneva. She felt like a friend I had known forever!
Nina, es una mujer agradable, simpática,  está alpendiente de tus nesecidases, una estancia de lo más agradable. muy recomendable. moverse de la estancia al centro de la ciudad fue muy sencillo.

Un excellent séjour chez Nina. Elle a été d’une grande gentillesse, chaleureuse et bienveillante. This was easily one of the (if not the) best AirBnb I have stayed in! Nina is such a warm and generous hostess, and a kind and knowledgeable person to talk to. The room is big, clean and decorated nicely. Easily a 10/10. It felt like a home, not a stay. Merci Nina!🙏🏻

La estancia en casa de Nina fue estupenda. Ella es muy amable y atenta. Me encantan los animales y Olaf, su perro, es muy bueno y está bien educado. Hay wifi. Destacar la excelente atención de la anfitriona con desayuno, flores frescas, frutas variadas y agua embotellada disponibles todos los días en la habitación. Nina is a fantastic host. She’s kind and considerate. She made me this incredible breakfast spread on the day of my choosing and had great recommendations for places to go. I was in Geneva for work and she always inquired about my day after I returned home.

Nina was kind enough to provide me with directions to the apartment and also had a lot of great recommendations for things to do in Geneva. The next time I am in Geneva I will stay with Nina again without a doubt!

I will never forget the kindness of Nina . From helping me when my uber dropped me off to the wrong location to taking me to the laundromat and grocery store she did it all. Nina is a lovely warm and generous host. The room is clean, cozy, comfortable and has everything you need and then some! Very close to bus and tram stops.

la estancia con Nina fue espectacular, ella desborda amabilidad y atención. Fue un placer alojarnos en su hogar y fuimos muy bien recibidos por su amoroso perrito Olaf. Nina is a perfect host and her handsome Olaf is a darling dog 🐶 . They both made us feel very welcomed and at home.

Communication was excellent and Nina helped us with recommendations of what to do and where to go!

Nina est très accueillante et très sympathique, elle nous a donné beaucoup de conseils et de renseignements sur la ville de Genève. The issue is if you have luggages or even a bag with lots of items, the initial hike to the place is really a hassle (get a cab or Uber if with heavy luggage or baby)

The room also contains unnecessary items: a gym cycling machine, a large box, and a cupboard filled with personal clothing, which makes the space less comfortable for guests. Since the flat is on the fifth floor in a building with no lift, I’d say it is best-suited to people who are quite fit and travel light. Additionally, I was there in late December, when temperatures reached -3 degrees at night, and maximum setting on the heaters wasn’t very high (there is air con, but I couldn’t figure it out so I don’t know if it blows hot air), but overall I was comfortable. A lovely place!

Everything is perfect, the house is cozy , the location is nice 5 mins walk from the train station and the kitchen have everything you need but please take note for all the elderly or family with kids you will need to climb the stairs it is at level 5

Uriel was a great host. Always responsive and helpful. The studio was well appointed and in the perfect location with access to transportation and great restaurants. We would return again if our travels allow.
Amazing flat in the centre of Geneva

It is a good base for exploring Geneva, even though not in the best part of town.

Franco a été très réactif tout au long de nos échanges, a su répondre à toutes nos questions et à toutes nos attentes. L'emplacement est idéal, très proche de la gare. Il n'y besoin d'aucun véhicule, pas même de transport en commun. Nous avons passé un merveilleux weekend dans cette ville qui a beaucoup de charme et de cachet. Tout était parfait.

Our stay was ideal, the flat is close to public transport and walkable from the lake. Host was very proactive and helped us with the Netflix login. There is a lovely coffee shop opposite also which is we made use of too! The flat is up 5 flights of stairs meaning that the stay was quiet and peaceful but be mindful if carrying luggage. Overall the apartment was ideal for us as a couple exploring Geneva and the surrounding area
Lovely stay in a light, airy studio in a very convenient area of Geneva. Great instructions and very easy to find - we had a super stay!

My stay in this apartment had several issues that future guests may want to know about.
When I arrived there was a noticeable smell of cigarette smoke in the apartment, including on the towels and bed linens, even though smoking is not supposed to be allowed. The apartment was also quite cold, and the radiators did not seem to heat up even after opening the valves.
There were also some maintenance issues, including visible mold in parts of the bathroom, a slow shower drain, and shower doors that did not close tightly, which caused water to leak onto the floor. The apartment appears quite old, with worn furniture and limited lighting in some areas.
However, after I contacted the host on the second day to explain the problems, they handled the situation professionally and refunded the remaining nights without any issues, which I appreciated.

J'ai eu un très bon séjour d'une semaine dans l'appartement, qui est très bien situé à côté de la gare, du centre-ville et du lac.

Merci aux hôtes pour le bon accueil ! :)

Super Airbnb, avec une jolie vue sur une petite place et une église, avec au loin les montagnes en plus.

- the flat has almost nothing in terms of things like spices or even a large bowl for a salad. There is only salt. - the listing says that it's on the 5th floor so that wasn't a surprise but while I was there, the stairwell was so hot, humid, & smelly most days that it made it even more difficult. I know this isn't the fault of the hosts but it did make things uncomfortable.
- the only way to get into the building is using the key fob, there is no door code. When I was going biking with a friend, I had to go down to open it for them and then go back up to finish get ready

Flat is in a great location for the train station, less than a 5 minute walk which suited us well as we were travelling every day. Todo excelente, comunicación excelente, limpieza impecable

Mon séjour s'est superbement bien passé, je recommande chaudement Pauline et sa chambre très grande et confortable. Tout y est et Pauline est très sympathique. J'espère revenir rapidement !

We were coming to Geneva for business travel during one week and we were so lucky to have rent this very comfortable house with a very beautiful garden That is located only 15 minutes drive away from Geneva city center.

A great place to stay - well located and in a good area!

Tita is a fantastic host.  Very accommodating and outgoing.  world stay again
Wonderful apartment and host in the heart of Geneva. Highly recommend

地理位置非常好, 樓下有兩間大超市, 離車站走路5分鐘可以抵達！雖然是在熱鬧的區域但晚上不會吵雜。房子舒服乾淨, 非常有家的感覺。Tita非常友善且熱於協助我們解決問題! 我們在這邊住得非常舒適, 下次回來日內瓦一定會再來住！

Le logement est très bien situé proche de la gare.

Very nice and cozy apartment !  The location is unbelievable. 2-3 mins walk to the lake side. There is a large and beautiful park very close to the building. Lots of restaraunts around. The host is absolutely 5 start as well !

Stèphane is an excellent host. Communicative and helpful prior to and on our arrival. The apartment is so well located. Many thanks for making our visit to Geneva very comfortable.

The location was great and the apartment was beautiful and well appointed. Stephane's instructions prior to check in were very thorough and she was very flexible regarding check in and check out times.

I enjoyed staying in Stephan place, The place is located in a very good area. I absolutely recommend staying at Stephan place..
the communicating and instructions from were amazing 👏

Stephane was lovely and answered all texts. His apartment is in a great location, with lots of cafes, restaurants and amenities on a street where everything is open on Sundays (rare in Geneva). Ariella

Cons:

Super séjour, appartement très agréable, bien situé et lit très confortable !

Très propre, confortable et idéalement situé. Le petit balcon est un vrai plus : il permet de profiter agréablement des repas au soleil avec une belle vue sur le lac. Great apartment in a very convenient location, walking distance to everything and lots of good cafes/restaurants at your doorstep. Highly recommend to anyone looking for a place to stay in Geneva, particularly if its for a few weeks.
Very convenient place for couple of days in Geneva. Communication with the host was easy and he was really helpful. I would highly recommend it.
Clean place within budget

Fadel était tres agréable et accueillant!
very nice and clean place. Amira was very friendly.  Ideal for me as it is in walking distance from the clinique ses grangettes where I had to work.

Instruction facile, immeuble assez calme accessibilité facile à pied ou en voiture.
Excellent all round! Great location, great modernised apartment and as always an excellent excellent host!

on a rencontre des petits soucis qui ont vite été réparé, Aischa a réagi très rapidement et envoyé un réparateur le soir en dehors des heures habituels du travail. L appartement était très propre et très bien situe
Good location and roomy space. Unfortunately we caught Geneva in a bit of a heat wave so the lack of AC was a bit tricky to navigate. Overall a good landing spot for our travels!

Aisha was a great host, and the place was as advertised - good location, trendy apartment.

Superfin lejlighed i et dejligt område af Genève tæt ved søen, butikker og restauranter. Lejligheden er rummelig og ren. I can definitely recommend this apartment and would come back myself if I visited Geneva again.

Aisha was always very friendly, and her apartment was extremely comfortable. I especially appreciated the cozy bed and the excellent water pressure. The kitchen was very well stocked, and I loved that the blackout curtains, which made it fantastic to sleep even more comfortably.
Aisha s place was very nice and conveniently located.  Aisha was very reactive to answer queries.
Aisha é uma anfitriã excelente, muito prestativa, flexível e preocupada com o bem estar do hóspede. O apartamento é funcional para até um casal.

Excellent location. Nice , clean apartment, recently painted, with all the necessary equipment. The only minor disadvantage is that there is no way for absolute darkness in the bedroom since there is light coming from the window kitchen as soon as the sun rises.

appartamento molto bello e spazioso, molto vicino sia al lago che al centro

HIGHLY RECOMMENDED.

Aisha’s place is under 5 min walk to the train station, she was an amazing host and responded very quickly when we needed help logging into the WiFi network and when we requested a fan, which is needed this time of the year; would recommend the place and would stay again in the future

Great place, close to both the main train station and centre of town. Clean, simple, but everything you need. Was a bit warm, but turns out nowhere in the city has aircon so all good. Aisha was lovely to deal with too.

Aisha’s place was exactly as we expected in a nice building and great location just steps from the waterfront, very central and close to everything. Great stay at a comfortable centrally located apartment that was walkable to the station, frequent and easy to use transit, the old town, along with numerous restaurants, and grocery options - perfect spot to drop your bags and see Geneva.

I reported the issue immediately after arrival, but no meaningful solution was provided. Being told that I could simply leave and receive a refund for unused nights was not a realistic option after arriving and settling in for a week-long stay.
Afterwards, I checked Google reviews and found that other guests had already mentioned the same construction issue. This made the lack of prior disclosure even more disappointing.

I hope future guests are properly informed before booking.
